title: What Makes High-Magnification Knowledge Transferable? A Study of Cross-Resolution Distillation in Whole-Slide Imaging
comment: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
summary: Cross-resolution knowledge distillation aims to improve low-magnification whole- slide analysis by transferring high-magnification representations, yet the conditions for useful transfer remain unclear. We develop a decomposition-based analysis of teacher access, representation loss, and model excess, motivating three questions: whether (a) teacher targets help the task, (b) low-magnification students can predict them, and (c) slide models benefit from those predictions. We investigate them through controlled experiments across ten pathology cohorts spanning classifi- cation, grading, and survival prediction. In the main comparison, providing teacher regional means alongside native low-magnification features improves downstream performance in all ten cohorts. Direct prediction achieves lower reconstruction error than residual prediction, yet the predicted features underrepresent variation in the teacher targets. Moreover, better reconstruction does not consistently improve downstream scores, and retaining native features changes performance even when the predicted teacher features are held fixed. Together, these findings expose a gap between reconstructing teacher representations and realizing their downstream value. They challenge the sufficiency of reconstruction error as a measure of cross-resolution transfer and provide a diagnostic framework for examining where that transfer breaks down. Future distillation designs must account for both what students can predict and how slide models use those predictions.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过分解式分析跨分辨率知识蒸馏中的教师可及性、表示损失与模型冗余，提出三个问题并设计受控实验。结果显示：加入教师区域均值可提升全部10个病理队列的下游性能；直接预测的重建误差低于残差预测，但预测特征低估教师目标的变异；重建更优并不稳定带来下游提升。由此揭示"重建教师表示"与"实现下游价值"之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 跨分辨率知识蒸馏被用于通过迁移高倍镜表示来改进低倍镜全切片分析，但"什么条件下迁移才真正有用"尚不明确，缺乏对教师目标是否有用、学生能否预测、以及切片模型能否利用这些预测的系统性检验。
AI.method: 提出基于分解的分析框架，将问题拆分为教师可及性（teacher access）、表示损失（representation loss）与模型冗余（model excess），并据此提出三个研究问题：(a) 教师目标是否有助于任务；(b) 低倍镜学生能否预测这些目标；(c) 切片模型能否从预测中获益。在覆盖分类、分级与生存预测的10个病理队列上进行受控实验，比较提供教师区域均值与原生低倍镜特征，并对比直接预测与残差预测的重建误差及下游表现。
AI.result: 在主要对比中，将教师区域均值与原生低倍镜特征一并提供，可在全部10个队列上提升下游性能。直接预测的重建误差低于残差预测，但预测特征对教师目标变异的刻画不足。此外，更好的重建并不一致地改善下游分数；即便固定预测的教师特征，保留原生特征也会改变性能。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现揭示了重建教师表示与实现其下游价值之间存在差距，说明重建误差不足以作为跨分辨率迁移的充分度量；研究提供了诊断框架以定位迁移失效环节，并指出未来蒸馏设计须同时考虑"学生能预测什么"以及"切片模型如何使用这些预测"。

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind: Systematically Erasing LLM's Memories
summary: We consider persistent LLMs that accumulate memories of their interactions with a user over time. Such LLMs maintain memories using external storage, which they can query to overcome the limitations of a fixed context window. Such systems have numerous practical applications, as they can draw on all past interactions when responding to user queries. In this paper, we ask whether LLMs can forget information shared with them upon a user's request. We find that current LLMs fail to delete such information---even when they claim to have forgotten it and even when operating with a limited context. To this end, we consider a new direction of study: Deletion of LLM Memories. We show that naively removing messages that match a user's deletion request is insufficient, since conversations naturally introduce message dependencies that cause information to persist. To correctly handle deletion requests, we propose the DeLLM framework. It dynamically constructs relevant context for each LLM query and maintains a provenance graph of messages to determine which ones must be removed during deletion. Our experiments show that DeLLM achieves a high deletion rate while maintaining utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM记忆删除（Deletion of LLM Memories）新方向，指出当前持久化LLM无法真正忘掉用户要求删除的信息，并提出DeLLM框架，通过动态构建上下文与消息溯源图实现高删除率且保有用性。
AI.motivation: 持久化LLM通过外部存储积累与用户的交互记忆，可在查询时调用历史信息，应用广泛。但用户要求遗忘某些信息时，现有LLM即使声称已遗忘、甚至上下文有限，也无法真正删除。简单删除匹配用户请求的消息并不充分，因为对话中的消息依赖关系会导致信息持续存留。
AI.method: 提出DeLLM框架：为每个LLM查询动态构建相关上下文，并维护消息的溯源图（provenance graph），以确定删除请求下必须移除的消息集合，从而正确执行删除。
AI.result: 实验表明DeLLM在实现高删除率的同时保持了系统的效用（utility）。
AI.conclusion: LLM记忆删除是一个值得研究的新方向；处理删除请求需考虑消息依赖关系，DeLLM通过溯源图与动态上下文构建可有效实现删除并兼顾效用。

title: FineART: Fine-Grained Annotated Robotic Trajectory Dataset and Vision-Language-Action Model for Bimanual Manipulation
comment: 26 pages. Code and model weights will be integrated into Hugging Face LeRobot https://github.com/huggingface/lerobot
summary: Robots operating in real-world environments must often execute complex, multi-step bimanual tasks over long horizons rather than single, isolated actions. Current manipulation datasets provide limited support for this capability: although single-arm datasets reach hundreds of thousands of trajectories, they typically provide only one high-level instruction per episode, while existing bimanual datasets provide subtask annotations for only part of their recorded hours. We present FineART, a densely annotated bimanual manipulation dataset comprising 40,543 episodes (1,718 hours) and 533,913 subtasks across 151 tasks. We also introduce FineART-VLA, a vision-language-action policy that predicts its own next subtask to guide its actions. Mid-training on FineART's subtask annotations improves FineART-VLA's success at following spatial instructions from 32.0% to 100.0%. With step-by-step human subtask guidance, success on unseen long-horizon tasks increases from 16.0% to 76.0%. Furthermore, FineART-VLA matches baseline performance on a new robot with 10x less fine-tuning data and generalizes zero-shot to unseen tasks. We open-source the full dataset, model weights, and training code.

AI.tldr: 本文发布FineART——一个密集标注的双臂操作数据集（40,543条轨迹、1,718小时、533,913个子任务、151个任务），并提出可自预测下一子任务的VLA策略FineART-VLA。
AI.motivation: 真实环境中的机器人需执行长时程、多步骤双臂任务，而非孤立单步动作。现有数据集对此支持不足：单臂数据集虽达数十万条轨迹，但每段仅一条高层指令；已有双臂数据集仅对部分录制时长提供子任务标注。
AI.method: 构建FineART数据集，对双臂操作提供密集子任务级标注；并提出FineART-VLA，基于视觉-语言-动作策略，让模型预测自身下一子任务以指导动作生成，并在FineART子任务标注上进行中间训练（mid-training）。
AI.result: 中间训练使模型遵循空间指令的成功率由32.0%提升至100.0%；在人类逐步子任务引导下，未见长时程任务成功率由16.0%提升至76.0%；在新机器人上以少10倍微调数据即达到基线性能，并可零样本泛化到未见任务。
AI.conclusion: 密集子任务标注对长时程双臂操作学习至关重要，FineART与FineART-VLA显著提升指令遵循、长时程任务成功率与跨本体迁移效率；数据集、模型权重与训练代码均已开源。

title: Losing the name before the box: measuring and repairing what narrow fine-tuning costs a detector outside its deployment vocabulary
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures. Supplementary material (69 pages) is included as an ancillary file. Submitted to the International Journal of Computer Vision
summary: A detector pretrained on a broad corpus is fine-tuned on a narrow domain, its in-domain accuracy improves, and it ships. We ask what happens meanwhile to its coverage of objects the vocabulary never names, which in obstacle detection and inspection carry the risk. No in-domain test set holds an example of one. We give a longitudinal protocol: one pretrained checkpoint against its own fine-tuned descendants. It tracks held-out top-$K$ proposal coverage $C_τ$: of categories pretraining covered and the vocabulary omits, the share of boxes a detector's top $K$ regions still cover. The quantity is the open-world proposal literature's; the longitudinal reading is not. $C_τ$ falls while in-domain accuracy rises, on four architectures and three domains, by $5.12$ to $63.35$ points on boxes above $1024$ px$^2$. No in-domain number identifies the fall, and neither does detection average precision, which charges a missed and a misnamed box alike. On the one architecture scoring both, adaptation costs $87\%$ of the AP against a fifth of the coverage, and the naming goes first at all six depths of its freeze ladder, every run. What breaks is structured: three architectures sharing no pretraining run agree on which categories lose coverage, and those a model never learned do not lose any. A repair follows and needs no training: mixing a quarter of the pretrained state back, normalisation statistics included, raises coverage on every cell swept for at most $2.47$ points of in-domain accuracy. Seeing it costs one extra evaluation pass.

AI.tldr: 论文提出纵向评测协议，追踪微调后检测器对预训练覆盖但词表未命名类别的top-K候选框覆盖率 $C_\tau$，发现域内精度上升时 $C_\tau$ 在4种架构、3个域上下降5.12–63.35点，且该下降无法由域内指标或AP识别；通过混入四分之一预训练状态可无训练修复。
AI.motivation: 检测器在广语料预训练后针对窄域微调，域内精度提升即可部署，但其对"词表从未命名、却在障碍检测与巡检中带来风险"的物体的覆盖能力变化未被关注，且域内测试集不含此类样本，现有指标无法揭示这一问题。
AI.method: 提出纵向协议：用同一预训练检查点与其微调后代对比，追踪留出的top-K候选覆盖率 $C_\tau$——即在预训练覆盖但词表遗漏的类别中，检测器top-K区域仍覆盖的框比例。该量取自开放世界候选框文献，纵向解读为本文新提出；在4种架构、3个域上评估，并考察AP、冻结阶梯不同深度及跨架构类别一致性，最后提出无需训练的修复：混回四分之一预训练状态（含归一化统计量）。
AI.result: $C_\tau$ 随域内精度上升而下降，在大于 $1024$ px$^2$ 的框上降低5.12至63.35点；域内数字与检测AP均无法识别该下降（AP将漏检与错名同等计罚）。在同时报告两者的架构上，适配损失 $87\%$ 的AP却仅损失五分之一覆盖，且在其冻结阶梯全部6个深度、每次运行中命名能力最先失效。破坏具有结构性：三个无共享预训练运行的架构对哪些类别失去覆盖意见一致，而模型从未学过的类别不损失覆盖。修复无需训练：混回四分之一预训练状态并包含归一化统计量，在每个扫描单元上提升覆盖，域内精度损失至多2.47点，代价仅一次额外评估。
AI.conclusion: 域内微调会系统性地、结构性地侵蚀检测器对词表外已学类别的候选覆盖，且现有域内精度与AP指标对此不可见；混回少量预训练状态可低成本恢复覆盖，说明该风险可被监测与缓解。

title: Beyond Pixel Reconstruction: Retrieval-Guided Glyph-Aware Restoration for Low-Resource Manchu Historical Documents
summary: Historical Manchu documents preserve invaluable linguistic and cultural heritage, yet their digitization is hindered by severe degradations and the scarcity of paired training data. Existing document restoration methods primarily optimize pixel-level reconstruction, which can produce visually plausible results while failing to preserve the structural identity of Manchu glyphs. To address this limitation, we propose a retrieval-guided glyph-aware restoration framework that goes beyond pixel reconstruction by explicitly incorporating glyph-level structural knowledge. Our method retrieves relevant glyph exemplars to provide structural guidance during restoration and integrates this information into the reconstruction process, improving the recovery of degraded character structures under low-resource conditions. Extensive experiments on Manchu historical documents demonstrate that the proposed approach improves both image restoration quality and glyph-level fidelity compared with existing restoration methods. These results highlight the importance of incorporating character-aware structural priors for reliable restoration of low-resource historical documents.

AI.tldr: 提出检索引导的字形感知修复框架，通过引入字形级结构先验，提升低资源满文历史文档的修复质量与字形保真度。
AI.motivation: 满文历史文档具有重要的语言与文化价值，但其数字化受制于严重退化与配对训练数据稀缺。现有文档修复方法多以像素级重建为目标，虽能产生视觉上合理的结果，却难以保持满文字形的结构身份（structural identity），导致修复后字符结构失真。因此需要突破像素重建的局限，显式引入字形级结构知识。
AI.method: 提出检索引导（retrieval-guided）的字形感知（glyph-aware）修复框架。该方法检索相关字形样例（glyph exemplars）作为结构引导，并将该信息整合进重建过程，从而在低资源条件下改善退化字符结构的恢复。
AI.result: 在满文历史文档上的大量实验表明，与现有修复方法相比，所提方法在图像修复质量和字形级保真度两方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明，引入字符感知的结构先验对于低资源历史文档的可靠修复具有重要价值，为字形敏感型文档修复提供了新思路。

title: Towards Scalable Context-Aware Single-Cell Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology Images
summary: Predicting gene expression from H&E-stained histology images offers a scalable alternative to costly spatial transcriptomics, yet most existing methods operate at the spot level, where signals from multiple cells are aggregated and critical cellular heterogeneity is obscured. Extending this paradigm to single-cell resolution is non-trivial. Naively applying pathology foundation models faces a scale mismatch: their patch-level representations mix multiple cells, whereas per-cell cropping or resizing distorts morphology and removes local context. Conversely, segmentation-based models without strong pretrained visual encoders often lack the morphological representation capacity needed for accurate molecular prediction and inherit errors from imperfect cell boundary masks. Here, we present CELLO, an efficient end-to-end framework that performs a single pathology foundation model forward pass per image and uses grid sampling to extract location-specific features for all cells simultaneously. We further introduce a distance-decay cross-attention module that refines each cell representation using spatially biased local morphological context. Using 52 public Xenium-H&E pairs from HEST-1k that span 12 organs and approximately 10 million cells, CELLO improves the average predictive accuracy over the evaluated baselines while reducing the mean whole-slide inference time compared to DeepSpot2Cell, a 14.0x speed-up on average that excludes upstream cell segmentation. Our work establishes a scalable foundation for single-cell gene expression prediction from H&E images.

AI.tldr: 提出CELLO框架，通过单次病理基础模型前向传播与网格采样实现单细胞级基因表达预测，兼顾精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有从H&E图像预测基因表达的方法多在spot级别操作，信号被多细胞聚合，掩盖了细胞异质性；而扩展到单细胞分辨率面临尺度不匹配问题——病理基础模型的patch级表示混合多细胞，逐细胞裁剪或缩放又会破坏形态与局部上下文；基于分割的模型缺乏强预训练视觉编码器，形态表征能力不足且继承细胞边界掩膜误差。
AI.method: CELLO是一个端到端框架：对每张图像仅执行一次病理基础模型前向传播，利用网格采样（grid sampling）同时为所有细胞提取位置特异特征；并引入距离衰减交叉注意力模块（distance-decay cross-attention），以空间偏置的局部形态上下文细化每个细胞的表示。
AI.result: 在HEST-1k中52对公开Xenium-H&E配对数据（覆盖12个器官、约1000万细胞）上，CELLO相比所评估基线提升了平均预测精度；相比DeepSpot2Cell，平均全片推理时间缩短14.0倍（不含上游细胞分割）。
AI.conclusion: CELLO为从H&E图像进行单细胞基因表达预测建立了可扩展的基础，兼顾准确性与推理效率。

title: Temporal-Aware Fusion for Robust Outdoor LiDAR Localization
summary: LiDAR relocalization aims to estimate the global 6-DoF pose of a sensor in the environment. However, existing regression-based approaches often encounter limitations in dynamic or ambiguous scenarios, as they typically prioritize single-frame inference, leaving the potential of spatio-temporal consistency across scans not fully explored. In this paper, we propose a Temporal-aware Localization framework (TempLoc) designed to enhance the robustness of outdoor localization by effectively modeling sequential consistency. Specifically, a Global Coordinate Estimation module is first introduced to predict point-wise global coordinates and associated uncertainties for each LiDAR scan. A Prior Coordinate Generation module is then presented to estimate inter-frame point correspondences by the attention mechanism. Lastly, an Uncertainty-Guided Coordinate Fusion module is deployed to integrate both predictions of point correspondence in an end-to-end fashion, yielding a more temporally consistent and accurate global 6-DoF pose. Experimental results on the NCLT and Oxford RobotCar benchmarks show that our TempLoc outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin, demonstrating the effectiveness of temporal-aware correspondence modeling in LiDAR relocalization.

AI.tldr: 提出TempLoc框架，通过时序感知的对应关系建模提升LiDAR重定位在动态/模糊场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于回归的LiDAR重定位方法多为单帧推理，未充分挖掘跨扫描的时空一致性，导致在动态或模糊场景中受限。
AI.method: TempLoc包含三个模块：(1) 全局坐标估计模块，预测每个LiDAR扫描的逐点全局坐标及不确定性；(2) 先验坐标生成模块，利用注意力机制估计帧间点对应；(3) 不确定性引导的坐标融合模块，端到端融合点对应预测，输出时序一致且精确的全局6-DoF位姿。
AI.result: 在NCLT和Oxford RobotCar基准上，TempLoc大幅优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 时序感知的对应关系建模对LiDAR重定位有效，可显著提升户外定位的鲁棒性与精度。

title: RA-CFGCache: From Branch-Level Criteria to Guided-Risk Control under Classifier-Free Guidance
summary: Diffusion models enable high-quality visual generation, but iterative denoising remains computationally expensive, especially under classifier-free guidance (CFG), which requires both conditional and unconditional evaluations. Training-free caching reduces this cost by reuse of previously computed features or predictions. However, existing branch-local reuse criteria do not explicitly account for how cache errors combine under CFG or how local perturbations affect the final output. We identify two misalignments in cache control: a branch-guided mismatch, where guided error depends on both the magnitudes and alignment of branch errors, and a local-final mismatch, where the downstream impact of a local error varies across timesteps. We propose RA-CFGCache, a Risk-Aligned Caching framework under CFG that incorporates both factors while keeping the sampling schedule and guidance rule fixed. CFG-aware Guided-Risk Composition combines existing branch-wise proxies using CFG coefficients and offline-calibrated cross-branch alignment. Propagation-Aware Rescaling further weights the resulting guided-risk estimate with a timestep-dependent propagation prior calibrated from isolated reuse perturbations. An online threshold controller then determines when to jointly refresh or reuse both branches. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev, Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, and CogVideoX-2B demonstrate improved efficiency--fidelity trade-offs over evaluated training-free caching baselines. Moreover, RA-CFGCache is compatible with diverse base proxy families, including TeaCache-, DiCache-, and MagCache-style estimators, and consistently improves fidelity at nearly unchanged latency. Code is available at https://github.com/yiming-l21/RA-CFGCache.git.

AI.tldr: 提出RA-CFGCache，一种风险对齐的无训练缓存框架，通过CFG感知的风险组合与传播感知重标定，在几乎不增加延迟的情况下提升扩散模型生成保真度。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型迭代去噪计算昂贵，尤其CFG需要条件与无条件两次评估；现有无训练缓存方法的复用准则属于分支局部，未显式建模CFG下缓存误差的合成方式以及局部扰动对最终输出的影响。
AI.method: 识别两类错位：分支引导错位（引导误差依赖各分支误差的幅度与对齐）与局部-最终错位（局部误差的下游影响随时间步变化）。提出RA-CFGCache，保持采样调度与引导规则不变，包含：CFG感知引导风险组合（用CFG系数与离线校准的跨分支对齐聚合分支代理）、传播感知重标定（用隔离复用扰动校准的时间步相关传播先验加权引导风险）、在线阈值控制器决定两分支联合刷新或复用。
AI.result: 在FLUX.1-dev、Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B、CogVideoX-2B上，效率-保真度权衡优于所评估的无训练缓存基线；兼容TeaCache、DiCache、MagCache风格估计器，在延迟几乎不变下持续提升保真度。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式对齐CFG下的误差合成与时间步传播效应，RA-CFGCache为无训练缓存提供更优控制策略，且具备良好的代理族通用性。

title: MemFold: Learning Compact Soft Memory for Long-Context Personalization via On-Policy Optimization
summary: An assistant that serves the same user over a long horizon has to answer from what that user has revealed: which preferences still hold, which were revised, and which constraints apply now. Retaining that information is not the same as acting on it, and the two are usually optimized as if they were. Keeping the information as text makes the reader's input grow with the retained history, while compressing it into a fixed number of latent vectors bounds the interface but is typically trained to reconstruct text or imitate reference answers, both of which are scored on sequences the reader never produced. We present MemFold, which optimizes a fixed-budget soft memory by the behavior it supports. A query-conditioned textual memory is compressed into K continuous vectors that form the reader's memory interface, and the reader is then trained on its own rollouts under two complementary signals: group-relative rewards for task outcomes, and confidence-gated on-policy distillation in which a frozen textual-memory teacher re-scores the student's sampled tokens under the textual memory. The teacher is never sampled from, so supervision stays on the student's current distribution and adds no autoregressive decoding; at inference it is removed entirely. Across three Qwen backbones, MemFold attains the highest accuracy we measure on PersonaMem-32K and PersonaMem-128K, with margins that widen at the longer history length, and transfers to PrefEval and LongMemEval without target-domain training. Ablations attribute most of the task gain to the reward term and a smaller additional gain to the teacher signal, and memory interventions show that the reader depends on the instance-specific content of its soft memory.

AI.tldr: MemFold 通过"行为驱动"的方式优化固定预算的软记忆：将查询条件化的文本记忆压缩为 K 个连续向量作为读者模型的记忆接口，并用任务奖励与置信门控的在线蒸馏两种信号在读者自身 rollout 上训练读者，从而在长程个性化任务上取得更高准确率。
AI.motivation: 长程服务同一用户的助手需要从用户历史中判断哪些偏好仍有效、哪些已修改、哪些约束当前适用。但"保留信息"与"基于信息行动"被混为一谈。以文本形式保留记忆会使读者输入随历史增长；压缩为固定数量隐向量虽能限定接口规模，却通常以重建文本或模仿参考答案为目标进行训练，而这两种监督都针对读者从未生成的序列评分，与实际行为不一致。
AI.method: 提出 MemFold：(1) 将查询条件化的文本记忆压缩为 K 个连续向量，构成读者的记忆接口；(2) 在读者自身的 rollout 上以两种互补信号训练——面向任务结果的组相对奖励，以及置信门控的在线策略蒸馏，其中冻结的文本记忆教师在该文本记忆下对学生采样出的 token 重新打分；(3) 教师从不被采样，因此监督始终位于学生当前分布上且不引入额外自回归解码，推理时教师被完全移除。在三个 Qwen 骨干网络上验证。
AI.result: 在 PersonaMem-32K 与 PersonaMem-128K 上取得所测最高准确率，且历史更长时优势扩大；无需目标域训练即可迁移至 PrefEval 和 LongMemEval。消融实验表明任务收益主要来自奖励项，教师信号带来较小的额外增益；记忆干预实验显示读者的表现依赖于其软记忆中实例特定的内容。
AI.conclusion: 优化记忆接口应以其所支持的行为为标准，而非以重建或模仿为目标；在此基础上，固定预算软记忆可以在长历史下保持甚至扩大优势，并具备跨任务迁移能力。方法对软记忆内容的实例特异性依赖也表明其并非依赖通用先验，而是真正利用了压缩后的用户特定信息。

title: Merlin Plus: A Large-Scale, Multi-Cancer, Image-Mask-Report Dataset
summary: Multi-cancer segmentation in computed tomography (CT) is fundamentally limited by the scarcity of tumor masks across different organs. We present Merlin Plus, the first large-scale CT dataset with radiologist-created tumor masks across 9 organs. Merlin Plus extends the Merlin dataset by adding 1,153 per-voxel tumor masks and longitudinal metadata. To create these tumor masks, we developed a report-based active-learning framework in which radiology reports identify tumor cases for annotation and support training of a tumor segmentation model. The model generates initial masks, which radiologists review and correct to produce the final masks, reducing annotation burden while maintaining high-quality annotations. Besides tumor masks, the longitudinal metadata in Merlin Plus enables temporal modeling of cancer progression. By directly addressing the major bottleneck of limited multi-cancer segmentation masks, Merlin Plus supports scalable multi-organ cancer detection, segmentation, and longitudinal analysis in CT. Dataset is available at: https://github.com/MrGiovanni/MerlinPlus

AI.tldr: Merlin Plus 是首个覆盖 9 个器官、由放射科医生制作肿瘤掩膜的大规模 CT 数据集，通过报告驱动的主动学习框架新增 1,153 个逐体素肿瘤掩膜及纵向元数据，支撑多器官癌症检测、分割与纵向分析。
AI.motivation: CT 多癌种分割的核心瓶颈在于不同器官的肿瘤掩膜稀缺，缺乏大规模、跨器官的高质量标注数据，限制了多器官癌症检测与分割模型的训练与泛化。
AI.method: 提出报告驱动的主动学习框架：利用放射报告识别需标注的肿瘤病例，并用于训练肿瘤分割模型；模型生成初始掩膜后由放射科医生审核修正，形成最终掩膜，在保证标注质量的同时降低标注负担。Merlin Plus 在 Merlin 数据集基础上扩展，新增 1,153 个逐体素肿瘤掩膜与纵向元数据。
AI.result: 构建了首个覆盖 9 个器官、包含放射科医生制作肿瘤掩膜的大规模 CT 数据集 Merlin Plus，并附带可支持癌症进展时序建模的纵向元数据；数据集已通过 GitHub 链接公开。
AI.conclusion: Merlin Plus 直接针对多癌种分割掩膜不足这一主要瓶颈，为 CT 中可扩展的多器官癌症检测、分割及纵向分析提供了数据基础。

title: DARE to Mitigate Hallucination: Dual-path Auto-Regressive-aware Editing
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have recently achieved remarkable progress across multimodal tasks, yet object hallucination remains a persistent challenge where models generate descriptions inconsistent with the visual input. Recent work mitigates hallucinations through training-free representation editing, typically by constructing hallucination-related directions from teacher-forcing (TF) contrasts between hallucinated and truthful responses. However, LVLMs operate through autoregressive (AR) decoding during generation, raising the question of whether TF-based analysis fully reflects the generation dynamics that lead to hallucinated outputs. In this paper, we analyze the relationship between TF-based editing and AR generation behavior and find that TF-based editing alone may be insufficient to capture both decoding dynamics and multimodal interactions associated with hallucinations. To address this limitation, we propose DARE (Dual-path Auto-Regressive-aware Editing), a hybrid hallucination editing framework that integrates two complementary contrast pathways: textual contrasts and image contrasts, together with autoregressive-aware representation signals. Specifically, DARE constructs hallucination editing directions from (1) TF-based textual contrasts, (2) AR-aware representation transitions during decoding, and (3) controlled visual differences between paired images. Extensive experiments on multiple LVLM hallucination benchmarks demonstrate that DARE consistently reduces object hallucinations while preserving multimodal perception capability and inference efficiency. Our implementation code is available at https://github.com/KU-VGI/DARE.

AI.tldr: 本文分析TF式表示编辑与AR生成行为的差距，提出DARE混合编辑框架，融合文本对比、图像对比及AR感知表示信号，有效减少LVLM物体幻觉。
AI.motivation: LVLM存在物体幻觉问题。已有免训练表示编辑方法多基于教师强制（TF）下幻觉与真实响应的对比构建幻觉方向，但生成阶段实际采用自回归（AR）解码，TF式分析是否充分反映导致幻觉的生成动态尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出DARE（Dual-path Auto-Regressive-aware Editing）混合幻觉编辑框架，整合两条互补对比路径与AR感知信号：从（1）TF文本对比、（2）解码过程中的AR感知表示转移、（3）配对图像间的受控视觉差异三方面构建幻觉编辑方向。
AI.result: 在多个LVLM幻觉基准上的大量实验表明，DARE持续降低物体幻觉，同时保持多模态感知能力与推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖TF式编辑不足以捕捉幻觉相关的解码动态与多模态交互，融合AR感知与文本、图像对比的DARE是更有效的免训练幻觉缓解方案。

title: Online Versatile Incremental Learning: Towards Class and Domain-Agnostic Adaptation at Any Time
summary: Continual learning enables vision systems to adapt to ever-changing data distributions. Despite significant advances, existing approaches fail to capture continuous and concurrent shifts in classes and domains, a critical capability for real-world deployment. This work introduces Online VIL (Online Versatile Incremental Learning), a novel scenario where class concepts and visual domains evolve simultaneously online without explicit boundaries. To better adapt to the challenges of such dynamic environments that more closely resemble real-world conditions, we propose a novel framework TopFlow, Topology preservation with Flow matching representation that contains two complementary mechanisms: Domain-agnostic Flow Matching (DFM) and Global Topology Preservation (GTP). DFM guides the model to have domain-agnostic representations by integrating the geodesic flow kernel into contrastive learning. In contrast, GTP maintains the global structure of the feature space without explicitly storing past examples. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that TopFlow effectively addresses the limitations of existing methods within the Online VIL scenario, achieving state-of-the-art performance in challenging Online VIL. The proposed methods suggest potential directions for building continual learning systems in realistic dynamic environments. Our implementation code is available at https://github.com/KU-VGI/Online-VIL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Online VIL 新场景（类别与域在线同时演变、无显式边界）及 TopFlow 框架，通过域无关流匹配（DFM）与全局拓扑保持（GTP）两机制提升在线多变化增量学习性能，达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法无法同时应对类别与域的连续并发漂移，而这更贴近真实部署需求，因此需要一个更真实的 Online VIL 场景与相应方法。
AI.method: TopFlow 框架含两互补机制：DFM 将测地流核（geodesic flow kernel）融入对比学习，引导模型学习域无关表示；GTP 在不显式存储旧样本的前提下保持特征空间的全局结构。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 TopFlow 在 Online VIL 场景下有效克服现有方法的局限，取得具有挑战性的 Online VIL 任务上的 SOTA 性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在真实动态环境中构建持续学习系统提供了潜在方向，代码已开源。

title: Invariant Atoms: Sparse Coordinates of Local Semantic Geometry in Language Model Representations
summary: Large language models often preserve meaning despite substantial changes in wording, style, and syntax, while small semantic edits can systematically alter their hidden representations. This suggests that semantic variation may be organized along recurring local directions. We propose the Invariant Atom Hypothesis: local semantic motion admits preferred sparse coordinates along directions that remain stable under meaning-preserving transformations. We learn a shared semantic frame and sparse coordinates that reconstruct semantic displacements while suppressing nuisance variation, with anchor-dependent diagonal modulation adjusting atom strengths without sample-specific rotations. Empirically, the atoms exhibit strong semantic--nuisance separation, sparse reconstruction, reproducible directions, and causal effects on model predictions. The learned geometry generalizes to unseen semantic neighborhoods and nuisance families, while local reweighting improves semantic selectivity and preserves a consistent global-to-local structure. Atom signatures also remain stable under model modification. These findings support reusable invariant directions as a sparse coordinate system for local semantic geometry in language models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"不变原子假说"：大模型中局部语义运动可沿一组在保义变换下稳定的稀疏方向（原子）组织，学习共享语义框架与稀疏坐标可分离语义与干扰，并具可复现性与因果效应。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型对措辞、风格与句法的大幅变化常保持语义不变，而细微语义编辑却会系统性改变隐藏表示。这暗示语义变化可能沿重复出现的局部方向被组织，因此需要检验局部语义几何是否存在可复用的不变方向。
AI.method: 提出不变原子假说，并学习一个共享语义框架与稀疏坐标：用其重建语义位移，同时抑制干扰变化；采用依赖锚点的对角调制调整原子强度，而不引入样本级旋转，从而在保持方向稳定的前提下实现局部重加权。
AI.result: 原子表现出强语义—干扰分离、稀疏重建、可复现方向及对模型预测的因果效应；所学几何可泛化到未见语义邻域与干扰族；局部重加权提升语义选择性并保持一致的全局—局部结构；原子签名在模型被修改后仍保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，可复用的不变方向可作为语言模型局部语义几何的稀疏坐标系，为理解与操控大模型语义表示提供结构化视角。

title: Reliable Parallel Decoding in Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) can generate text efficiently by predicting multiple masked tokens in parallel, but predictions from the same forward pass are not necessarily reliable when committed together. We study when parallel commitment is reliable. Our diagnostics show that confidence alone does not determine a reliable commitment order: confident predictions near the end of the sequence can fix an answer before its supporting computations are established, and downstream predictions become less reliable as the uncertainty of their upstream context grows. At the same time, a single forward pass can already resolve several masked tokens, and predictions that remain stable across the final layers are more likely to be correct. Based on these findings, we propose Reliable Parallel Decoding (RPD), a training-free method that selects candidates by layerwise prediction stability and final confidence, and commits them under a cumulative entropy budget over their preceding masked positions. RPD defers predictions with uncertain upstream context while committing the remaining candidates in parallel, without relying on a fixed block schedule. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks on LLaDA and Dream, RPD achieves the highest decoding throughput among the evaluated methods while maintaining or improving accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）并行承诺的可靠性条件，发现仅凭置信度无法确定可靠承诺顺序，进而提出免训练方法RPD，通过层间预测稳定性、最终置信度及累积熵预算选择并并行承诺候选token，在数学推理与代码生成任务上实现吞吐与精度的双优。
AI.motivation: MDLM虽能通过并行预测多个掩码token来提高生成效率，但同一前向传播中的多个预测同时承诺时未必可靠。作者希望明确"何时并行承诺是可靠的"，以在保证甚至提升精度的前提下获得更高解码吞吐。
AI.method: 作者先进行诊断分析，发现三点：(1) 置信度本身无法决定可靠的承诺顺序，序列末端的高置信预测可能在上游计算尚未建立时就固定答案；(2) 下游预测的可靠性随上游上下文不确定性增大而降低；(3) 单次前向已能解决多个掩码token，且在最后几层保持稳定的预测更可能正确。基于此提出RPD（Reliable Parallel Decoding）：一种免训练方法，依据层间预测稳定性与最终置信度筛选候选，并对其前置掩码位置施加累积熵预算来进行承诺；对上游上下文不确定的预测予以推迟，其余候选并行承诺，不依赖固定块调度。
AI.result: 在LLaDA与Dream模型上的数学推理和代码生成基准测试中，RPD在所评估方法中取得最高解码吞吐，同时保持或提升准确率。
AI.conclusion: 并行承诺的可靠性不能仅由置信度决定，还需考虑上游上下文的不确定性与层间稳定性；RPD通过稳定性筛选与累积熵预算约束，在不训练、无固定块调度的条件下实现了并行解码的吞吐与精度兼顾。

title: DynamicHOI: Coupled Dynamics for Physics-aware HOI Reconstruction
summary: We study hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction from monocular RGB videos, where partial observations can produce visually plausible yet mechanically inconsistent trajectories. Existing methods mainly enforce visual and geometric agreement, leaving the underlying interaction dynamics insufficiently constrained. We propose DynamicHOI, a physics-aware HOI reconstruction framework combining geometry-grounded diffusion refinement with coupled hand-object dynamics. Geometry spatially grounds visual evidence for trajectory refinement, while articulated inverse dynamics and Newton-Euler dynamics derive hand generalized forces and object wrenches for dynamics-level supervision. We further couple hand and object dynamics through contact-force transfer and recover active hand actuation as an interaction-level physical quantity. We formulate its empirical magnitude distribution into a probabilistic prior that penalizes unlikely actuation and suppresses mechanically implausible reconstructed motion. Experiments on three HOI datasets show consistent improvements in both hand and object reconstruction. The reconstructed trajectories further benefit downstream applications including hand world-model generation and robotic manipulation learning, demonstrating the value of physics-aware HOI modeling beyond reconstruction.

AI.tldr: DynamicHOI：结合几何扩散细化和耦合手-物动力学的物理感知HOI重建框架。
AI.motivation: 单目RGB视频中部分观测会导致轨迹视觉合理但力学不一致，现有方法主要约束视觉与几何一致性，对交互动力学约束不足。
AI.method: 提出DynamicHOI：几何扩散细化利用几何空间锚定视觉证据；关节逆动力学与牛顿-欧拉动力学推导手广义力和物体力旋量，实现动力学级监督；通过接触力传递耦合手物动力学，恢复主动手部驱动，并将其经验幅值分布建模为概率先验以惩罚不合理驱动。
AI.result: 在三个HOI数据集上手部与物体重建均取得一致提升；重建轨迹还促进手部世界模型生成和机器人操作学习等下游应用。
AI.conclusion: 物理感知HOI建模超越单纯重建，为下游任务提供价值。

title: Memory Consolidation Flattens the Temporal Shape of User Facts
summary: Long-term memory systems turn conversations into short stored notes. A note can keep a user fact while losing evidence about whether the fact still holds. For example, "I am driving a Peugeot" can become "The user drives a Peugeot," which drops the cue that the activity is ongoing. We call this aspectual flattening and measure it with LAPSE, a benchmark of matched user statements that differ only in temporal form. We find that memory writers flatten aspect selectively. Three writer models flattened the progressive statement but kept its simple-present match in 244 of 381 pairs, never the reverse. The asymmetry holds in all 11 model configurations tested and in the installed pipelines mem0, Graphiti, and Letta. The lost cue matters to later readers. In exploratory tests, changing only the stored verb shifted all three readers' estimates that a fact still holds. When readers could ask the user before acting, two of three acted without asking more often on flattened notes. Our planned memory-use task could not detect this, because readers there acted on almost every stored fact, even expired ones. Memory writing can thus remove evidence that later models use to decide whether to act.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"体貌扁平化"（aspectual flattening）现象：长期记忆系统将对话压缩为简短笔记时会剥离时态/进行体线索，并用LAPSE基准量化，发现该现象在多种模型与管线中系统性存在，且会改变下游模型对"事实是否仍成立"的判断。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆系统通常将对话转写为短存储笔记，笔记保留用户事实却可能丢失该事实是否仍然成立的时间性证据（如进行体线索）。这类线索对后续读者判断事实是否有效至关重要，但此前缺乏系统度量。
AI.method: 提出LAPSE基准，由仅在时间形式上不同的配对用户陈述构成；对比"进行体"陈述与其"一般现在时"对应句在记忆写入后的保留情况，测试11种模型配置及mem0、Graphiti、Letta三种已部署管线；并进行探索性读者测试，检验仅改变存储动词是否影响读者对事实持续性的估计，以及读者在可询问用户时的行为差异。
AI.result: 记忆写入模型选择性地扁平化体貌：三个写入模型在381对中的244对里扁平化了进行体陈述却保留了其一般现在时对应句，反向从未出现；该不对称在全部11种模型配置及mem0、Graphiti、Letta中均成立。仅改变存储动词即可改变三名读者对事实仍成立的估计；当读者可先询问用户再行动时，三名中有两名在扁平化笔记上更常不询问即行动。原计划的记忆使用任务因读者几乎对所有存储事实（包括已过期者）都采取行动而无法检测该效应。
AI.conclusion: 记忆写入过程可能系统性地移除后续模型用于判断是否应采取行动的证据，即体貌扁平化会损害下游决策的可靠性。

title: Fisher-IRG: Fisher-Induced Local Invariant Representation Geometry across Language and Vision Models
summary: Semantic-preserving transformations can induce substantial motion in learned representations, while small changes may strongly affect model predictions, raising a basic question: what local metric best captures semantically consequential variation? We propose Fisher-induced invariant representation geometry (Fisher-IRG), which measures local representation directions through their predictive sensitivity. Around each representation, we construct semantic-preserving and semantic-changing neighborhoods, aggregate their local Fisher information, and recover invariant directions through a contrastive generalized eigenvalue problem. Controlled displacement analyses first show that comparable Euclidean motion can have substantially different predictive consequences, supporting the need for a predictive geometry. Across language and vision models, Fisher-IRG yields stronger semantic-versus-nuisance predictive selectivity and generally more reproducible subspaces than covariance-based geometry, while recovering systematically distinct local directions. Representation interventions further localize semantic effects to the Fisher-derived subspace, and held-out separation and retrieval show that the recovered geometry generalizes beyond the discovery neighborhoods. These results support Fisher-IRG as a principled framework for characterizing local invariant representation geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Fisher 诱导不变表示几何（Fisher-IRG），用预测敏感性度量局部表示方向，通过对比广义特征值问题恢复不变子空间。
AI.motivation: 语义保持变换可使表示产生显著位移，而微小变化又可能强烈影响预测，因此核心问题是：哪种局部度量能最好地刻画具有语义后果的变化，需要一种预测性几何。
AI.method: Fisher-IRG：在每个表示周围构建语义保持邻域与语义改变邻域，聚合各自的局部 Fisher 信息，并通过对比广义特征值问题恢复不变方向。
AI.result: 受控位移分析显示相近欧氏位移可产生显著不同的预测后果；在语言与视觉模型中，Fisher-IRG 的语义-冗余预测选择性更强、子空间可复现性通常更好，并恢复出系统性不同的局部方向；表示干预将语义效应定位于 Fisher 子空间，留出集分离与检索表明所恢复几何可泛化到发现邻域之外。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持 Fisher-IRG 作为刻画局部不变表示几何的原理性框架。

title: Staircase Policy: Streaming Inference for World-Action Models with Large Action Chunks
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) improve robotic manipulation by conditioning action generation on predicted future observations, but future prediction adds further inference overhead to already expensive iterative action generation. Action chunking can amortize this cost over multiple actions, yet performance degrades over long execution horizons because later actions remain conditioned on stale observations. We introduce STAIRCASE POLICY, a streaming inference and training framework that turns a flow-matching VLA into a JEPA-style WAM and partitions a large action chunk into sub-chunks at staggered denoising stages. Near-term actions are executed as soon as they become available, while later actions continue to be refined. At each sub-chunk boundary, the future latent is re-predicted from the latest observation and used to update all unexecuted actions, enabling long-horizon execution without repeated full policy inference. The resulting future-prediction error can further serve as a signal for adaptive chunking. S-WAM achieves 97.7% on LIBERO and 87.9% on LIBERO-Plus, and improves performance across multiple policy backbones and real-robot tasks. It reaches 292.7 executed actions per second, $3.62\times$ the throughput of conventional execution at comparable accuracy, while reducing time-to-first-action from 123.6 to 73.3 ms. With additional inference optimizations, throughput further increases to 642.9 actions per second.

AI.tldr: 提出STAIRCASE POLICY（S-WAM）流式推理与训练框架，将流匹配VLA转为JEPA式世界-动作模型，通过分块错步去噪实现长时程高效机器人操作。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）通过预测未来观测来条件化动作生成以提升操作性能，但未来预测本身带来了额外推理开销，叠加在原本昂贵的迭代式动作生成之上。动作分块虽可将成本摊销到多个动作上，但在长执行时程中性能会下降，因为后续动作仍依赖过时的观测，形成陈旧观测问题。
AI.method: STAIRCASE POLICY将流匹配VLA改造成JEPA式WAM，把大幅动作分块划分为多个子块并置于错步（staggered）去噪阶段。近端动作一旦可用即执行，后续动作持续细化。在每个子块边界处，利用最新观测重新预测未来隐变量，并用其更新所有未执行动作，从而避免反复进行完整策略推理。未来预测误差还可作为自适应分块的信号。
AI.result: S-WAM在LIBERO上达97.7%，LIBERO-Plus上达87.9%，并在多种策略骨干网络和真实机器人任务上均取得提升。吞吐量达每秒292.7个执行动作，在精度相当情况下为常规执行的3.62倍，首动作时延从123.6 ms降至73.3 ms。结合额外推理优化，吞吐量进一步提升至每秒642.9个动作。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过流式推理与错步子块去噪，有效缓解了WAMs的推理开销与陈旧观测问题，实现了高精度、长时程、高吞吐的机器人操作，并以未来预测误差支持自适应分块，具有良好的通用性与实际部署潜力。

title: FinRT: Distilling Adaptive Red-Teaming Strategies into Reusable Adversarial Generators in Consumer Finance
summary: In regulated industries like consumer finance, seemingly harmless user queries can exploit large language model vulnerabilities, triggering safety failures and pushing responses dangerously close to policy limits. Existing automated red-teaming methods trade off attack effectiveness against generation cost, while treating coverage, severity, and diversity as incidental rather than joint objectives. We introduce FinRT, a structured framework that builds reusable adversarial prompt generators from adaptive red-teaming strategies. Across the six victim models in consumer finance, FinRT substantially outperforms adaptive search baselines while amortizing target-facing attack generation into a reusable generator. FinRT nearly doubles the attack success rate over the adaptive baseline Rainbow Teaming (32.9% vs. 17.2%), increases maximum adversarial severity by 33%, and preserves comparable intra-policy-domain semantic diversity to iterative search methods. Our method achieves high cross-model transferability while exhibiting distinct victim-family specialization patterns.

AI.tldr: 提出 FinRT 框架，从自适应红队策略中构建可复用的对抗提示生成器，在消费金融领域显著提升攻击成功率、严重度并保持语义多样性。
AI.motivation: 在消费金融等受监管行业中，看似无害的用户查询可能触发大语言模型的安全失效，使回应逼近政策边界。现有自动化红队方法在攻击有效性与生成成本之间权衡，且将覆盖率、严重度与多样性视为附带产物而非联合优化目标。
AI.method: FinRT 是一个结构化框架，通过从自适应红队（adaptive red-teaming）策略中提炼可复用的对抗提示生成器，替代每次面向目标的迭代搜索，从而将目标导向的攻击生成成本摊销到可复用生成器上。
AI.result: 在消费金融领域的六个受害模型上，FinRT 攻击成功率较自适应基线 Rainbow Teaming 接近翻倍（32.9% vs. 17.2%），最大对抗严重度提升 33%，并保持与迭代搜索方法相当的政策域内语义多样性；同时具备高跨模型迁移性，并呈现明显的受害模型族专业化模式。
AI.conclusion: FinRT 在提升攻击有效性与严重度的同时保持语义多样性，并降低边际生成成本，验证了将自适应红队策略提炼为可复用生成器的可行性，为受监管行业的大模型安全评测提供了高效方案。

title: Similar Choices, Different Attention: Cross-Modal Associations in Humans and Vision-Language Models
summary: Cross-modal associations are systematic pairings of features across modalities, such as the association of 'bouba' with round shapes and 'kiki' with sharp shapes. Prior work has compared humans and vision-language models (VLMs) on such associations, but often using different stimuli or tasks between humans and models. Here, we ask whether VLMs align with humans not only in choices, but also in where they look when making those choices. We study both VLMs and humans (N = 53), presenting them with the same stimuli, a pseudo-word and two images, and record participants' choices and eye movements, which we release. We find choice alignment in a few larger VLMs, but their saliency matches human gaze less closely than a center-bias baseline, a fixed Gaussian at the center of each image. Fine-tuning small VLMs on human choices brings their choice alignment to the level of a human majority-vote reference on unseen words and images, yet their attention still matches human gaze less closely than this baseline. Training model attention on human gaze raises attention-gaze correlation without improving choice alignment, and a single average gaze map per image position raises it by a similar amount. Matching human choices, or even human gaze patterns, is therefore not sufficient evidence of human-aligned cross-modal processing.

AI.tldr: 该研究用相同刺激和任务对比人类与视觉语言模型在跨模态关联上的选择与眼动，发现即使部分大模型选择与人类一致，其显著性与人类注视的匹配度仍低于中心偏置基线；微调可提升选择一致性但无法对齐注意力，说明选择或注视匹配都不足以证明跨模态加工对齐。
AI.motivation: 以往人类与视觉语言模型(VLM)在跨模态关联（如bouba/kiki效应）上的比较，常使用不同刺激或不同任务，难以公平评估模型是否真正具有类人的跨模态加工。作者希望追问：VLM是否不仅在最终选择上与人类一致，还在"做选择时看哪里"上一致，从而更严格地检验人机对齐。
AI.method: 给人类被试(N=53)与多个VLM呈现完全相同的刺激：一个伪词加两张图像，记录并公开人类的选择与眼动数据。比较模型的选项分布与人类选择的一致性；用显著性/注意力图与人类注视比较，并以中心偏置基线（图像中心固定高斯）作为参照。进一步对小模型进行人类选择微调，以及用人类注视训练模型注意力，并测试单张按图像位置平均的注视图的效果。
AI.result: 少数较大的VLM在选择上与人类对齐，但其显著性与人类注视的匹配度低于中心偏置基线。用人类选择微调小VLM后，在未见的词和图像上其选择一致性达到人类多数投票参考水平，但注意力仍不如中心基线匹配人类注视。用人类注视训练注意力可提高注意力—注视相关性，却不改善选择一致性；按图像位置取单张平均注视图也能带来相近的相关性提升。
AI.conclusion: 仅匹配人类选择、甚至仅匹配人类注视模式，都不足以作为人机对齐跨模态加工的证据。模型可能通过非类人机制达到表面一致，需更严格的注意力层面与基线对照来评估对齐。

title: DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding: Benchmarking Document Grounding and Hallucinations in Voice Agents
summary: Voice agents enable low-latency, natural interaction, yet their ability to faithfully ground responses in external documents remains underexplored. We introduce DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding (DSB-DG), a benchmark for evaluating document grounding in voice agents across five professional domains. DSB-DG targets three failure modes: Context Saturation, which measures grounding under increasing document length; Grounding Decay, which measures retention of document facts across multi-turn dialogue; and Proactive Grounding, which evaluates whether context re-injection mitigates conversational drift. The benchmark contains 1,636 adversarially verified QA pairs from 50 documents covering five professional domains, and supports fully automatic evaluation of grounding accuracy, hallucination, and response latency. Across systems spanning cascaded, proprietary full-duplex and real-time, and open-weight speech2speech architectures, we find substantial differences in effective grounding capacity. While cascaded pipeline (ASR-LLM-TTS) achieves the highest grounding accuracy, Gemini-Live and GPT-Realtime closely trail behind. Open-weight systems exhibit distinct failure modes, most notably an abrupt context-capacity collapse and multi-turn grounding decay. More broadly, grounding fidelity degrades with context and conversational load, and failures frequently manifest as unsupported generations rather than abstention. We show that contextual grounding as a key unresolved challenge for reliable full-duplex voice agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DSB-DG 基准，用于评估语音智能体的文档接地能力，涵盖上下文饱和、接地衰减与主动接地三类失效模式，并对比了级联、全双工商业与开源 speech2speech 系统。
AI.motivation: 语音智能体虽能实现低延迟自然交互，但其基于外部文档忠实生成回答的能力尚未被充分探索，缺少系统性评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 DSB-DG 基准，覆盖五个专业领域，针对上下文饱和（文档长度增加下的接地）、接地衰减（多轮对话中事实保持）和主动接地（上下文重注入是否缓解对话漂移）三类失效模式；包含来自 50 份文档的 1,636 个对抗性验证 QA 对，支持接地准确率、幻觉与响应延迟的全自动评测，并在级联、专有全双工/实时及开源 speech2speech 架构上进行对比。
AI.result: 不同系统有效接地能力差异显著：级联管线（ASR-LLM-TTS）接地准确率最高，Gemini-Live 与 GPT-Realtime 紧随其后；开源系统表现出独特失效模式，尤以上下文容量骤降和多轮接地衰减突出。总体而言，接地保真度随上下文与对话负载增加而下降，失效多表现为无依据生成而非拒答。
AI.conclusion: 上下文接地是可靠全双工语音智能体亟待解决的关键挑战。

title: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Synapse Detection and Proofreading in Connectomics
summary: We benchmarked vision-language models (VLMs) on the decisions annotators take when inspecting electron microscopy images in connectomics: synapse detection (presence and polarity) and proofreading (split errors and merge errors). For synapse detection, we evaluated 19 open and 2 closed models across various architectures and sizes under zero-shot, four-shot in-context learning and LoRA settings, against specialist models, on datasets constructed by us using public resources. For proofreading, we evaluated 3 open and 2 closed models on the ConnectomeBench2 dataset, with cross-species transfer from fly and mouse to human and zebrafish. Most models were at chance zero-shot; a few examples helped mainly the closed and largest open ones. LoRA on a few thousand labels brought open models level with specialist models. When evaluated on unseen species, the best adapted VLMs outperformed specialist models trained on the same data in identifying merge errors. The project will be publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文对视觉语言模型（VLMs）在连接组学电镜图像标注决策（突触检测与校对）上进行了系统基准测试，发现零样本性能接近随机，少样本与LoRA微调可显著提升，且适配后的VLM在跨物种迁移任务上优于专家模型。
AI.motivation: 连接组学中，标注者检查电镜图像时需做出突触检测（存在性与极性）与校对（分裂错误与合并错误）等决策，这一过程耗时且依赖专家。作者希望评估当前视觉语言模型能否胜任这些任务，并与专家模型进行比较，探索其在跨物种迁移场景下的潜力。
AI.method: 突触检测方面，作者使用公开资源自建数据集，在零样本、四样本上下文学习及LoRA三种设置下，评估了19个开源与2个闭源模型（覆盖不同架构与规模），并与专家模型对比。校对方面，在ConnectomeBench2数据集上评估3个开源与2个闭源模型，并进行从果蝇、小鼠到人类与斑马鱼的跨物种迁移测试。
AI.result: 多数模型零样本表现接近随机水平；少量示例主要帮助闭源模型及规模最大的开源模型。在数千标注上应用LoRA后，开源模型达到专家模型水平。在未见物种上，最佳适配VLM在识别合并错误方面优于使用相同数据训练的专家模型。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型在连接组学标注决策中具备可行性：零样本能力有限，但通过少样本提示与LoRA微调可大幅提升，且在跨物种泛化上展现出超越专家模型的潜力。项目将在论文接收后公开发布。

title: Reimagine Video Dynamics
summary: Most video editing methods focus on changing the appearance of the source video, while offering limited control over its dynamics. We introduce Reimagine Video Dynamics (RVD), a framework that disentangles a compact, editable dynamics token from visual context. We learn this token through self-supervised reconstruction: given the first frame as visual context, a renderer must recover the original video from the dynamics token, encouraging it to capture how the scene evolves rather than how it looks. This disentanglement allows video dynamics to be edited directly while preserving visual context. We develop a language-guided dynamics-token editor that transforms source dynamics into target dynamics, and train it with a scalable counterfactual video-pair pipeline and a two-stage training strategy. Extensive experiments show that RVD enables effective video dynamics editing, training-free retiming, and appearance-controlled re-rendering.

AI.tldr: 提出RVD框架，将可编辑的动态token与视觉外观解耦，实现视频动态的直接编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑方法主要改变源视频的外观，对其动态（dynamics）的控制能力有限。
AI.method: 通过自监督重建学习紧凑可编辑的动态token：以首帧为视觉上下文，渲染器需从动态token恢复原始视频，从而迫使其捕捉场景演化而非外观；随后用语言引导的动态token编辑器将源动态转换为目标动态，并借助可扩展的反事实视频对流水线与两阶段训练策略进行训练。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RVD能实现有效的视频动态编辑、免训练的重定时（retiming）以及外观可控的重渲染。
AI.conclusion: 动态与外观的解耦使视频动态可被直接编辑，同时保持视觉上下文不变，为视频编辑提供了新的控制维度。

title: Large-scale factor analysis shows machine intelligence is only partially interpretable
summary: A common assumption in language model development is that cognitive abilities are organized around a general, domain-free intelligence factor, like fluid intelligence in humans. This assumption is rarely tested directly, and prior attempts have done so only at a much smaller scale. We take a latent variable approach to intelligence in language models, similar to how psychometricians study psychological constructs. Performance in every specific problem set is influenced by a domain-specific and a domain-agnostic latent factor. Using factor analysis as a dimension-reduction technique, we analyzed 13,251 published evaluation scores covering 1,618 language models across 456 different text-only benchmarks. Due to the super-sparse nature of the dataset, we triangulate our analysis across different data densifiers and imputation methods. A robust pattern across different modes of bias is that 1. A general intelligence factor accounts for 70.8% of variance in model performance at our most generous estimate, and far less than that in most of our solutions, 2. Content-similar benchmarks do not necessarily cluster together, and 3. The $g$ factor is not dominated by any common theme, and there is a lack of evidence that it is well-proxied by standard "intelligence" benchmarks. Our findings go against current endeavors of defining, identifying, and targeting general intelligence as a tangible construct in language model development. This leaves the strategy of targeting a single conceptual ability without support, since the first-order abilities it would have to reach are often partially idiosyncratic and not identifiable in practice.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过潜变量/因子分析方法，分析了13251个评测分数（1618个语言模型、456个文本基准），检验语言模型是否存在类似人类流体智力的通用智能因子g。结果显示g因子解释力有限（最宽松估计仅70.8%方差，多数解更低），且无主导主题，反驳了以单一通用智能为开发目标的假设。
AI.motivation: 语言模型开发普遍假设认知能力围绕一个通用的、领域无关的智能因子（类似人类流体智力）组织，但该假设极少被直接检验，已有尝试规模也小得多。作者希望借用心理测量学的潜变量方法，在大规模评测数据上直接检验这一假设是否成立。
AI.method: 采用潜变量/因子分析作为降维技术与维度缩减方法：每个具体问题的表现受领域特异与领域无关两个潜因子影响。数据为13251个已发表评测分数，覆盖1618个语言模型与456个纯文本基准。因数据高度稀疏，作者在不同数据加密（densifier）与插补方法之间进行三角验证，以检验偏差模式下的稳健性。
AI.result: 跨不同偏差模式呈现稳健结果：(1) 通用智能因子在最宽松估计下解释模型性能70.8%的方差，多数解中远低于此；(2) 内容相似的基准并不必然聚类在一起；(3) g因子不被任何常见主题主导，且缺乏证据表明标准“智能”基准能很好地代理它。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果与当前在语言模型开发中定义、识别并瞄准通用智能作为一个实体构念的努力相悖。由于一阶能力往往部分具有特异性且在实践中不可识别，针对单一概念能力的策略缺乏支持。

title: Distilling Privileged Control Barrier Functions into RGB-Only Safety Filters for Dynamic Visual Navigation
summary: RGB-only end-to-end visual navigation policies remain vulnerable to collisions in real-world dynamic environments, motivating a dedicated safety layer. Existing visual Control Barrier Function (CBF) approaches seek to provide safety from RGB observations, but often rely on real-time rendering or explicit scene reconstruction and are primarily designed for static scenes, limiting their practicality for onboard deployment. We propose a teacher-student visual distillation framework that transfers the safety behavior of a privileged CBF teacher to an RGB-only student filter for dynamic environments. The student maps a short RGB history, robot velocity, and a nominal control action directly to a safe action, while the teacher uses ground-truth robot and obstacle states in a real-to-sim dynamic Gaussian Splatting environment. To reduce the teacher-student information gap, the teacher constructs safety constraints only from obstacles observable within the student's RGB history. It also accounts for obstacle-velocity uncertainty to improve robustness to motion variations, while action augmentation exposes the student to diverse safe and unsafe nominal actions to better capture the safety boundary. At deployment, the student requires only RGB observations and robot velocity, without explicit 3D reconstruction or online rendering. Experiments show that the proposed method outperforms visual CBF baselines and improves the safety of RGB-based navigation policies under dynamic obstacle motion. Project page: https://syeon-yoo.github.io/distill-cbf-site/.

AI.tldr: 提出师生视觉蒸馏框架,将特权CBF教师的安全行为迁移至仅用RGB的学生安全滤波器,实现动态环境下无需三维重建或在线渲染的机载安全导航。
AI.motivation: 仅用RGB的端到端视觉导航策略在真实动态环境中仍易发生碰撞,需要专门的安全层。现有视觉控制障碍函数(CBF)方法虽试图从RGB观测提供安全保障,但通常依赖实时渲染或显式场景重建,且主要针对静态场景,限制了机载部署的实用性。
AI.method: 采用师生视觉蒸馏框架:教师在有真实机器人及障碍物状态的特权信息下,于real-to-sim动态高斯泼溅(Gaussian Splatting)环境中运行CBF;学生仅输入短暂RGB历史、机器人速度与名义控制动作,直接输出安全动作。为缩小信息差,教师仅基于学生RGB历史中可观测到的障碍物构建安全约束;并引入障碍物速度不确定性以增强对运动变化的鲁棒性;通过动作增强让学生接触多样的安全/不安全名义动作,更好刻画安全边界。部署阶段学生仅需RGB观测与机器人速度,无需显式三维重建或在线渲染。
AI.result: 实验表明,该方法优于视觉CBF基线,并在动态障碍物运动下提升了基于RGB的导航策略的安全性。
AI.conclusion: 所提师生蒸馏框架可将特权CBF的安全行为有效迁移至RGB-only学生滤波器,兼顾动态环境适应性与机载部署可行性。

title: Adapting Context Compression for Long-Horizon Agents with Counterfactual Continuations
summary: Long-horizon agents require context compression to manage growing interaction histories. Compression quality, however, is ultimately determined by downstream execution. Existing prompt-adaptation methods infer compression errors by comparing full-context and compressed trajectories. Such comparisons cannot isolate individual compressions and are confounded by agent stochasticity. We first find that compression degrades reliability before solvability. Using matched counterfactual continuations that compare execution from the same agent state with versus without compression, we further show that severe degradation concentrates at isolated compression events. Motivated by this finding, we propose PAIR (Prompt Adaptation using Interventional Rollouts) for adapting structured compression prompts. PAIR identifies individual compressions that degrade subsequent execution, diagnoses their effects, and revises the relevant sections of a fixed compression template. PAIR achieves the strongest cross-run reliability among compressed methods in every main benchmark-scope combination, consistently exceeding the competing prompt-adaptation baseline. Without modifying the downstream agent, PAIR brings compressed execution close to the no-compression baseline and sometimes numerically exceeds it.

AI.tldr: 提出 PAIR 方法，通过干预式 rollout 定位并修正结构化压缩提示，使长程智能体在压缩上下文下的执行可靠性接近甚至超过无压缩基线。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体需压缩交互历史以控制上下文增长，但压缩质量最终由下游执行效果决定。现有提示自适应方法通过对比全上下文与压缩轨迹来推断压缩错误，既无法隔离单次压缩事件，又受智能体随机性干扰。
AI.method: 首先发现压缩先损害可靠性、后损害可解性；采用匹配的反事实续跑，在同一智能体状态下对比有/无压缩的执行结果，证明严重退化集中于孤立压缩事件。据此提出 PAIR（Prompt Adaptation using Interventional Rollouts），识别造成退化的单次压缩、诊断其影响并修订固定压缩模板的相关部分。
AI.result: 在所有主要基准—范围组合中，PAIR 在压缩方法里取得最强的跨运行可靠性，稳定超过对比的提示自适应基线；在不修改下游智能体的前提下，使压缩执行效果接近无压缩基线，有时数值上还略有超出。
AI.conclusion: 压缩对智能体的影响可通过干预式反事实分析精确定位到单次压缩事件，据此调整压缩提示能显著提升长程智能体在上下文压缩下的执行可靠性。

title: Triadic Linear Attention: Three-Dimensional Recurrent States for Long-Context Sequence Modeling
summary: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) compress the historical context into a memory state of fixed size, thus allowing for constant-time inference. The memory state size is a crucial factor in their performance, as exemplified by the strong performance and resurgence of linear attention, which extends the vector-valued hidden states of ordinary RNNs to matrix-valued hidden states. Crucially, linear attention does so in a parameter-efficient way, in particular by using an outer product of the key and value vectors to write to the matrix-valued hidden state. We generalize this construction and propose triadic linear attention, which writes the triadic outer product of a key, a second key, and a value, into a third-order (i.e., 3D) tensor state, and reads from it by contracting both key axes with two queries. An $E$-dimensional second key thus yields an $E$-fold increase in state size while adding only two projections. Triadic linear attention is compatible with data-dependent forgetting, the delta rule, and chunkwise-parallel training. Applied to Gated DeltaNet and scalar-gated linear attention, triadic linear attention substantially improves long-context language modeling and recall, outperforming alternatives that enlarge the state.

AI.tldr: 本文将线性注意力的"外积写入矩阵隐状态"推广为"三元外积写入三阶张量隐状态"，提出三元线性注意力（Triadic Linear Attention），在不显著增加参数的前提下扩大记忆状态，并在长上下文语言建模与召回任务上取得提升。
AI.motivation: RNN的推理时间为常数，但其固定大小的记忆状态限制了性能。线性注意力通过将隐状态从向量扩展为矩阵、并以key与value的外积写入，实现了参数量高效的状态扩容。本文希望进一步突破状态容量的瓶颈，探索更一般的状态扩展构造方式。
AI.method: 提出三元线性注意力：将key、第二个key与value的三元外积写入三阶（3D）张量状态，读取时用两个query分别与两个key轴做收缩。E维第二key带来E倍状态容量，仅增加两个投影。该方法与数据依赖遗忘、delta rule及分块并行训练兼容，并应用于Gated DeltaNet与标量门控线性注意力。
AI.result: 应用于Gated DeltaNet和标量门控线性注意力后，三元线性注意力显著提升了长上下文语言建模与召回能力，优于其他状态扩容方案。
AI.conclusion: 通过将外积写入推广到三元外积写入三阶张量，可在参数量近乎不变的情况下有效扩大RNN式模型的记忆状态，为线性注意力/门控线性注意力的状态扩展提供了一条通用且高效的路径。

title: Foresight at the Event Boundary: Evaluating Physical Prediction in Video World Models
summary: Video world models are largely regarded as predictive models of the physical world and are therefore expected to anticipate the consequences of observed events. However, evaluation has mainly focused on reference similarity, physical-law consistency, or judgment plausibility, estimating anticipation only indirectly. We address this directly: when a release or impact has just occurred but its consequence is withheld, can a world model anticipate what should happen next? We introduce an event-anchored evaluation based on 62 controlled real-world free-fall recordings and 124 clips spanning three object types, with fine-grained release and impact annotations and ground-truth trajectories. The protocol separates consequence production, temporal placement, and physical realization. Across six contemporary video generation and world models, Runway and Veo produce release and subsequent impact events at rates above 93% but often initiate them substantially late, whereas Cosmos-Predict-2.5 and MAGI-1 frequently preserve the pre-event state and produce little or no measurable consequence. Among measurable falls, plausible timing does not necessarily imply physically consistent motion. We further conduct a 15-participant, 20-condition human study in which participants describe the expected consequence from a single event-anchored frame and draw its trajectory. Human predictions favor the recorded future in aggregate while revealing genuine ambiguity among plausible continuations. Overall, physical foresight emerges as a sequence of distinct challenges: initiating a consequence, anchoring it in time, and realizing its motion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种事件锚定的评估方法，直接考察视频世界模型在事件（释放或撞击）刚发生但结果被隐藏时，能否预测接下来应发生什么。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型被视为物理世界的预测模型，理应能推断观测事件的后果；但现有评估主要关注参考相似性、物理规律一致性或判断合理性，只能间接估计这种预测能力，缺乏对后果生成的直接检验。
AI.method: 构建基于62段受控真实自由落体录像、124个片段的评估基准，涵盖三类物体，具备细粒度的释放与撞击标注及真值轨迹；协议将评估分解为后果产生、时间定位和物理实现三个环节。评测六种当代视频生成与世界模型，并开展15名被试、20种条件的人体研究，要求其从单个事件锚定帧描述预期后果并绘制轨迹。
AI.result: Runway和Veo产生释放及后续撞击事件的比率超过93%，但常显著延迟触发；Cosmos-Predict-2.5与MAGI-1常保持事件前状态，几乎不产生可测后果。在可测下落中，时间合理并不意味着运动物理一致。人类预测总体上更贴近真实未来，同时揭示了合理延续之间存在的真实歧义。
AI.conclusion: 物理预见可拆解为一系列不同挑战：启动后果、在时间上锚定后果、以及实现其运动，三者并不自动同步达成。

title: Retrieval Sensitivity to Identity Signals in Queries
comment: EMNLP 2026 camera-ready, with a correction to Fig. 4
summary: Dense retrievers decide which documents reach users and the language models that use them, yet they are typically evaluated with neutral queries. We ask whether the identity signals that real users express in their queries---political ideology and dialect---bias what a retriever returns. We design evaluations in two domains, political news and consumer-health questions, each pairing a controlled synthetic set that varies only the identity signal with naturalistic queries. Across five dense retrievers and a sparse baseline, every retriever (i) retrieves articles that align with the query's own political lean and (ii) performs worse for questions written in African American Language (AAL) than in White Mainstream English (WME). Two analyses tie these gaps to queries' identity signals beyond surface vocabulary: partialling out an aggregate lexical-asymmetry score leaves the synthetic gaps largely intact, and linear probes recover lean and dialect from the retrievers' query embeddings beyond token-level features. Left unaddressed, such retrieval biases risk contributing to polarization and reinforcing the health disparities already faced by AAL speakers. Code is available at https://github.com/Andrewtcr/bias-ret.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了稠密检索器在真实用户查询中表达的身份信号（政治倾向与方言）下是否产生检索偏差，发现所有检索器都会偏向与查询政治立场一致的文档，且对非裔美国人英语（AAL）查询的检索表现劣于白人主流英语（WME）。
AI.motivation: 稠密检索器决定哪些文档能到达用户及其下游语言模型，但通常仅用中性查询进行评估。作者质疑：真实用户查询中携带的身份信号（政治意识形态与方言）是否会引入检索偏差，进而加剧极化与健康不平等。
AI.method: 在政治新闻与消费者健康两个领域设计评估，各构建一个仅改变身份信号的控制性合成查询集与自然查询集；测试五个稠密检索器及一个稀疏基线；并通过两种分析（剔除聚合词汇不对称分数、对查询嵌入做线性探针）检验偏差是否源于表层词汇。
AI.result: 所有检索器均（i）返回与查询自身政治倾向一致的文档，（ii）在AAL书写的查询上表现差于WME。剔除聚合词汇不对称分数后，合成查询上的差距基本保留；线性探针能从查询嵌入中恢复政治倾向与方言，且超出词元级特征。
AI.conclusion: 检索偏差不仅是表层词汇问题，而是编码在查询嵌入的语义表征中。若不加以处理，此类偏差可能助推政治极化，并加剧AAL使用者已面临的健康差距。

title: When Updating Stops Being Learning: Rethinking LLM Self-Evolution via learnable information gain
summary: Self-evolution lets large language models (LLMs) improve iteratively using their own generated data, but often suffers from self-evolution degeneration: performance improves, plateaus, then declines. Existing methods address this issue at the component level, targeting either the Questioner or the Solver, and overlook that self-evolution is a tightly coupled system. We propose a holistic framework based on learnable information gain, which measures how much novel, parameterizable information a round provides relative to the previous round. Theoretically, this gain equals the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the two rounds' data distributions plus their entropy change. Practically, it is estimated by fitting a small language model to the previous round and scoring new data via negative log-likelihood. Based on this diagnostic, we propose ATRI (Adaptive Training Regulation via Information-gain), which reweights samples within a round and halts training across rounds when information gain remains low. Experiments on popular datasets demonstrate the superiority of our proposal.

AI.tldr: 提出基于可学习信息增益的ATRI框架，从系统层面解决LLM自进化退化问题。
AI.motivation: 自进化使LLM能利用自身生成数据迭代提升，但常出现"先提升、后平台、再下降"的退化现象。现有方法仅在组件层面分别优化提问者或求解者，忽视了自进化是一个紧耦合系统，因此效果受限。
AI.method: 提出可学习信息增益这一整体性度量，刻画某一轮相对上一轮提供的新颖、可参数化信息量。理论上证明该增益等于两轮数据分布的KL散度与其熵变之和；实践中通过将小语言模型拟合到上一轮数据，并用负对数似然对新增数据打分来估计。基于该诊断指标提出ATRI（Adaptive Training Regulation via Information-gain），在轮内对样本重新加权，在轮间当信息增益持续偏低时停止训练。
AI.result: 在常用数据集上的实验验证了所提方案优于已有方法。
AI.conclusion: 将自进化视为紧耦合系统并从信息增益角度统一诊断与调控，可有效缓解自进化退化，为LLM自进化训练提供整体性解决方案。

title: DraftTrace: A Multi-View Analytics Environment for AI-Integrated Writing
summary: Generative AI has changed how students produce writing assignments. The final artifact is no longer sufficient to understand the process through which it was produced. We introduce DraftTrace, a writing environment that jointly captures three complementary views of writing: the final product, the writing process and interactions with an integrated AI-assistant. DraftTrace reconstructs how a document develops over time and organizes these signals into submission, longitudinal, and class-level analytics for instructors. We deployed DraftTrace in a graduate NLP course with 81 students and compared their sessions with LLM-generated responses entered by automated tools and with copy-typed responses. While product measures distinguish differences in text formulation, process measures distinguish differences in how text is entered. Considering both views together helps characterize cases such as copy-typing. Interaction traces show that students use the assistant differently across stages of writing: to clarify the question at an early stage and to verify answers at a later stage. A preliminary instructor survey highlights the importance of multi-view writing analytics and their interpretability.

AI.tldr: DraftTrace 是一个写作环境，联合采集最终产品、写作过程与 AI 助手交互三类信号，并在研究生 NLP 课程（81 名学生）中部署，用于区分学生写作、LLM 生成与复制粘贴三类行为。
AI.motivation: 生成式 AI 改变了学生完成写作任务的方式，仅凭最终成品已不足以理解其产出过程，需要同时观察"写了什么"与"如何写出来"。
AI.method: 设计并实现 DraftTrace：重建文档随时间的演变过程，将成品、过程与 AI 助手交互痕迹组织为提交级、纵向与班级级三类教学分析；在研究生 NLP 课程中部署，并将学生写作会话与自动化工具输入的 LLM 响应、复制粘贴式响应进行对比。
AI.result: 成品指标可区分文本表述差异，过程指标可区分文本录入方式差异；两者结合可刻画复制粘贴等情形。交互痕迹显示学生在写作不同阶段使用助手的方式不同：早期用于澄清问题，后期用于验证答案。初步教师调研强调了多视角写作分析与可解释性的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 多视角写作分析（成品+过程+交互）比单一成品更能刻画生成式 AI 环境下的写作行为，且对教学场景具备实际价值与可解释性需求。

title: SCCM: Spherically Consistent Coarse Matching for ERP Dense Feature Correspondence
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 33 pages: 16-page main paper (including references) and 17-page supplementary material. Project page: https://gandanlee.github.io/sccm/ Code: https://github.com/gandanlee/sccm
summary: Dense feature matching between 360$^\circ$ panoramas underpins omnidirectional pose estimation, 3D reconstruction, and SLAM. Such panoramas are stored in the equirectangular projection (ERP), which unrolls the viewing sphere onto a flat chart and thereby introduces three distinct distortions -- a longitudinal seam (topology), latitude-dependent stretch (metric), and non-uniform pixel area (area) -- that the coarse stage of perspective-trained dense matchers does not model, so these matchers degrade systematically on ERP. We show that correcting the three distortions at the coarse-stage interfaces where they arise -- pairwise distortions in attention, per-pixel distortion in covisibility gating -- improves PCK@1$^\circ$ from 0.230 to 0.275 on Matterport3D under a fixed coarse scaffold, with the refiner architecture unchanged -- our central result. Concretely, SCCM (Spherically Consistent Coarse Matching) augments a chart-naive cross-attention/dual-softmax coarse matcher with two sphere-derived priors: Spherical Positional Attention (SPA) pairs a yaw-periodic RoPE (topology) with a tangent-plane bias (metric), and Area-Aware Covisibility (AAC) applies a pre-sigmoid log-area correction (area). The chart-naive scaffold serves as a controlled reference, separating the scaffold-replacement effect from the spherical-prior effect. Instantiated in the RoMa V1 framework with the same frozen encoder, refiner architecture, and loss, SCCM also outperforms the ERP-native EDM (0.163) and an ERP-retrained RoMa V1 (0.198) under a unified ERP dense matching protocol, while perspective-trained matchers largely fail on ERP. It further transfers zero-shot to Stanford2D3D and, when trained on outdoor Holo360D, leads there as well.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SCCM，通过在粗匹配阶段修正ERP全景图的三种球面畸变（拓扑接缝、纬度拉伸、面积不均），将PCK@1°从0.230提升至0.275，并优于ERP原生方法及透视训练匹配器。
AI.motivation: 360°全景图以ERP投影存储，将球面展开为平面时引入三种畸变：经度接缝（拓扑）、随纬度变化的拉伸（度量）和非均匀像素面积（面积）。透视训练的稠密匹配器在粗阶段未建模这些畸变，导致在ERP上系统性退化，因此需要针对性地修正。
AI.method: 提出SCCM（球面一致粗匹配），在粗阶段接口处修正畸变：Spherical Positional Attention (SPA) 将yaw周期性的RoPE（拓扑）与切平面偏置（度量）结合，修正注意力中的成对畸变；Area-Aware Covisibility (AAC) 应用sigmoid前的对数面积校正（面积），修正共视门控中的逐像素畸变。以chart-naive scaffold为对照，分离scaffold替换效应与球面先验效应，并在RoMa V1框架中实例化，保持编码器、精炼器架构和损失不变。
AI.result: 在固定粗匹配scaffold下，PCK@1°从0.230提升至0.275，精炼器架构不变，这是核心结果。在统一ERP稠密匹配协议下，SCCM还优于ERP原生的EDM（0.163）和ERP重训练的RoMa V1（0.198），而透视训练匹配器在ERP上大多失败。此外，方法可零样本迁移至Stanford2D3D，在室外Holo360D上训练后也在该数据集上领先。
AI.conclusion: 在粗匹配阶段的畸变修正接口处引入球面先验，可有效缓解ERP畸变导致的匹配退化，且不改变精炼器架构，具备跨数据集泛化和零样本迁移能力。

title: Grounded Revision vs. Prior Injection: Probing Retrieval-Augmented Patent Claim Amendment
comment: Accepted to Findings of AACL-IJCNLP 2026. 9 pages, 2 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/TeamLab/probing-rag-patent-amendment
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation is widely used in professional writing, yet whether retrieval grounds revision or merely injects templates is rarely tested where "correct" has a definable meaning. Patent claim amendment supplies that signal: the examiner names the attacked limitation and cites prior art, providing per-case ground truth. We release three artifacts: (i) a corpus of 7,385 USPTO prosecution cases with XML-aligned pre/post claims, rejection, and cited prior art; (ii) a seven-probe battery comparing random and structural-match retrieval as two policies under a fixed prompt scaffold; (iii) a deterministic five-channel metric (C1-C3 and C5 in main, C4 supplementary) requiring no LLM evaluation. Across 9,600 pre-registered calls on four frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4, Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-4o-mini), no tested model exhibits detectable classical prior-injection behavior; retrieval effects are small and direction-inconsistent between random and structural retrieval, and the null is unchanged under a dense (semantic) retriever, across retrieval depths k in {1,3,5,10}, and under a paraphrase-sensitive grounding metric. Revision locality reveals a model-specific difference that the template channel misses. The four-cell taxonomy, which we treat as exploratory, leaves the prior-injector cell unoccupied.

AI.tldr: 该论文以专利权利要求修改为可验证场景，检验检索增强生成（RAG）究竟是"有依据的修改"还是仅注入模板。作者发布7,385件USPTO审查案例语料、七项探针测试和确定性五通道指标，在四款前沿LLM上进行9,600次预注册调用，未发现经典"现有技术注入"行为。
AI.motivation: RAG在专业写作中广泛使用，但"检索是否真正为修改提供依据，还是仅仅注入模板"这一问题很少在"正确性"有明确可判定标准的场景中得到检验。专利权利要求修改恰好提供了这种信号：审查员会明确指出被攻击的权利要求限定并引用现有技术，从而给出逐案例的ground truth。
AI.method: 研究发布三项工件：(i) 含XML对齐的修改前后权利要求、驳回意见及引用现有技术的7,385件USPTO审查案例语料；(ii) 七项探针测试组，在固定提示脚手架下将随机检索与结构匹配检索作为两种策略进行对比；(iii) 确定性五通道指标（主实验含C1–C3与C5，C4为补充），无需LLM评判。在四款前沿LLM（Claude Sonnet 4、Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-5.4、GPT-4o-mini）上进行9,600次预注册调用，并额外检验稠密语义检索器、检索深度k∈{1,3,5,10}及改述敏感的地基性指标。
AI.result: 在9,600次预注册调用中，所有被测模型均未表现出可检测的经典"现有技术注入"行为；检索效应总体较小且在随机检索与结构检索之间方向不一致。该零结果在稠密（语义）检索器、不同检索深度及改述敏感地基性指标下均保持不变。修订局部性揭示出模型间的差异，而模板通道无法捕捉这一差异。四象限分类法（作者视为探索性）中，"现有技术注入"单元始终为空。
AI.conclusion: 在专利权利要求修改这一具有明确正确性标准的场景中，前沿LLM并未表现出检索注入模板的行为，检索对修改的影响微弱且不稳定。该零结果具有跨检索器类型、检索深度和评估指标的稳健性；修订局部性可捕捉模板通道遗漏的模型差异。探索性四象限分类法中"现有技术注入"单元为空。

title: How Medical VLMs Underutilize Their Vision Encoders: A Dermatology Perspective
summary: Medical Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show significant promise for clinical image understanding, offering accurate diagnosis with interpretable reasoning. However, a critical performance gap exists between their strong vision encoders and the full multimodal model: in dermatology, the MedSigLIP encoder outperforms MedGemma by an average of 10.26 percentage points even when both use zero target-task labels; few-shot linear probing provides further evidence of strong visual representations. This gap motivates an investigation of how visual information is used in end-to-end diagnosis and why plausible-sounding predictions can lack grounding in image evidence. Using dermatology as our primary testbed, we systematically investigate three hypotheses for this phenomenon. We further provide a mechanistic analysis of the model's internal attention patterns, showing that a simple describe-then-decide prompting strategy increases vision attention by 30-40% during generation. Task-specific fine-tuning improves dermatology classification but reduces cross-domain medical question-answering performance in our evaluation. To address these challenges, we combine label-free prompting with low-label encoder-assisted reranking while keeping the VLM frozen. We validate the interventions across five VLM backbones in dermatology and provide supporting representation and attention analyses across additional medical modalities.

AI.tldr: 医学视觉语言模型存在视觉编码器强于完整多模态模型的性能差距——在皮肤病学中MedSigLIP比MedGemma平均高10.26个百分点。本文系统探究该现象的成因，发现模型生成过程对视觉信息利用不足，并提出"先描述后决策"提示策略与编码器辅助重排序等干预手段。
AI.motivation: 医学VLM虽在临床图像理解上表现优异，但其视觉编码器与完整多模态模型之间存在显著性能鸿沟（皮肤病学中差距达10.26个百分点），且模型预测虽看似合理却可能缺乏图像证据支撑，这一矛盾亟需揭示视觉信息在端到端诊断中的实际使用方式。
AI.method: 以皮肤病学为主要实验平台，系统检验三种关于该现象的假设；对模型内部注意力模式进行机制性分析；测试"先描述后决策"（describe-then-decide）提示策略；尝试任务特定微调；并采用无标签提示结合低标签编码器辅助重排序，同时保持VLM冻结；在五个VLM骨干上验证干预效果。
AI.result: MedSigLIP编码器在零目标任务标签下比MedGemma平均高10.26个百分点，少样本线性探针进一步证实其视觉表征较强；"先描述后决策"提示使生成过程中的视觉注意力提升30-40%；任务特定微调虽改善皮肤病学分类，但降低了跨域医学问答性能；所提无标签提示加编码器辅助重排序的干预在五个骨干上均有效。
AI.conclusion: 医学VLM的端到端推理未能充分利用其强大的视觉编码能力，导致预测缺乏图像依据；通过提示策略提升视觉注意力、并在冻结VLM的前提下结合无标签提示与编码器辅助重排序，可有效缩小视觉与多模态性能差距，且该结论在多种医学模态中具有一定泛化性。

title: FM-ReID: Selective Competitive Token Routing for Object Re-Identification
summary: Object re-identification (ReID) faces a recurring challenge: different identities can share highly similar global appearances, while the cues that distinguish them are localized, heterogeneous, and visible only under particular viewpoints. This challenge arises in animal ReID through markings, contours, and scars, in person ReID through subtle clothing and accessory cues, and in vehicle ReID through localized appearance details. Although visual foundation models encode such information in dense tokens, a single holistic descriptor can obscure discriminative local signals. We propose FM-ReID, an end-to-end framework that formulates local representation learning as selective competitive token routing. Its Competitive Fine-grained Mining module uses multiple mining queries and a residual query to compete for dense DINOv3 tokens. Above-prior selection retains tokens preferentially allocated to each mining query, while the residual slot receives tokens excluded from the retrieval descriptors. The resulting multi-query descriptors are jointly trained with a holistic representation for retrieval, without fixed spatial partitions or equal-area constraints. FM-ReID achieves strong results on animal, person, and vehicle ReID benchmarks, supporting competitive token routing as an effective way to augment holistic foundation-model representations.

AI.tldr: FM-ReID将局部表征学习形式化为选择性竞争令牌路由，通过多挖掘查询与残差查询竞争密集DINOv3令牌，实现细粒度判别信息的提取。
AI.motivation: 不同身份可能具有高度相似的全局外观，而区分它们的线索是局部的、异质的，且仅在特定视角下可见。视觉基础模型虽在密集令牌中编码了此类信息，但单一整体描述符会掩盖具有判别力的局部信号。
AI.method: 提出端到端框架FM-ReID。其竞争性细粒度挖掘模块使用多个挖掘查询和一个残差查询竞争密集DINOv3令牌；采用"高于先验选择"保留优先分配给各挖掘查询的令牌，残差槽接收被排除在检索描述符之外的令牌；生成的多查询描述符与整体表征联合训练用于检索，无需固定空间划分或等面积约束。
AI.result: 在动物、行人和车辆ReID基准上取得强劲结果。
AI.conclusion: 竞争性令牌路由是增强整体基础模型表征的有效途径。

title: ThinkingGuard: Decoding Implicit Hazards via Step-by-Step Risk Attribution in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains, their reliability is threatened by multimodal implicit risks. Unlike explicit threats, these hazards emerge when individually benign text and neutral visual entities logically converge to induce unsafe outputs. Current detection methods fail to address this because they overlook the underlying risk activation mechanisms that govern cross-modal risk activation, leading to single-modality shortcut learning and hallucinated rationalizations. To bridge this gap, we first construct TriggerBench, the first dataset explicitly modeling risk compositionality (5,600 instances). By formally isolating Key Elements and Trigger Elements to build counterfactual contrastive pairs, TriggerBench eliminates risk residues and forces models to perform genuine logical deduction rather than superficial pattern matching, which provides a rigorous foundation for both large-scale training and fine-grained evaluation. Building on this, we propose a Step-Supervised Structured Reasoning training framework and employ it to train ThinkingGuard, a specialized guard model. Inspired by Situation Awareness theory, we decouple implicit risk identification into progressive cognitive stages, and utilize a step-reward Monte Carlo Tree Search algorithm to explore optimal reasoning trajectories, which are then distilled into the model through Dual-Constraint Preference Alignment. Extensive experiments across both standard and implicit safety benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkingGuard achieves strong performance. Project resources are available at https://github.com/FroggyChen/ThinkingGuard.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对多模态大模型（MLLMs）中"多模态隐式风险"问题，提出TriggerBench数据集与ThinkingGuard防护模型，通过结构化推理训练显著提升隐式安全检测性能。
AI.motivation: MLLMs日益部署于安全关键领域，但其可靠性受到多模态隐式风险的威胁：单独无害的文本与中性的视觉实体在逻辑上结合后，可能诱导出不安全输出。现有检测方法忽视了支配跨模态风险激活的底层机制，导致单模态捷径学习和幻觉式合理化，无法有效应对该类风险。
AI.method: 1) 构建TriggerBench数据集（5,600个实例），首次显式建模风险组合性，通过形式化隔离"关键元素"与"触发元素"构造反事实对比对，消除风险残留，迫使模型进行真正的逻辑推理；2) 提出Step-Supervised Structured Reasoning训练框架，借鉴态势感知理论，将隐式风险识别解耦为渐进式认知阶段，采用步进奖励的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）探索最优推理轨迹，并通过双约束偏好对齐（Dual-Constraint Preference Alignment）蒸馏进模型，训练出专用防护模型ThinkingGuard。
AI.result: 在标准安全基准与隐式安全基准上的大量实验表明，ThinkingGuard取得了强劲的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过显式建模风险组合性的数据集与分阶段结构化推理训练框架，有效解决了多模态隐式风险检测中的捷径学习与幻觉合理化问题，为MLLMs安全防护提供了新的数据基础与方法范式。

title: AffectReveal: Event-Grounded Emotion Recognition Beyond Visual Appearances
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to ICLR 2027
summary: Visual emotion recognition commonly assumes that all evidence required for prediction is contained in the observed image or video. Yet the same visible reaction can convey different emotions depending on events beyond the input: tears, for example, may indicate grief or joy. We formulate Event-Grounded Emotion Recognition (EGER), where emotion recognition requires recovering the affect-determining event. We construct EGER-Bench, comprising 10,052 videos and 10,734 images across 11 emotions, two source domains, and four visual settings. A study with six annotators shows that event context raises human recognition accuracy from 33.96% to 72.08%, confirming that visual evidence alone is often insufficient. Semantic relevance alone does not solve EGER: a plausible event may imply the wrong emotion if its identity, focal-person role, relationship, or outcome is misinterpreted. We therefore propose AffectReveal, a tuning-free framework that first constructs and independently verifies evidence-grounded alternatives over these affect-critical factors. It then cross-checks the recovered event against face-masked in-media facts through bidirectional atomic evidence support, while retaining the original unmasked input for final prediction. Across three downstream models and four input settings, AffectReveal yields average UAR gains of 5.26--10.53 points. For three fine-tunable models, it also enables untuned models to outperform their fine-tuned visual-only counterparts in all 12 accuracy comparisons, without updating downstream parameters.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"事件接地情感识别"(EGER)新任务，认为情感识别常需恢复输入之外的"影响决定事件"，并构建EGER-Bench基准及免调优框架AffectReveal，在多种模型与输入设置下取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉情感识别假设预测所需的全部证据都包含在观测到的图像或视频中，但同一可见反应（如眼泪）在不同事件语境下可传达不同情感（悲伤或喜悦）。因此需要引入"影响决定事件"这一信息，人类在获得事件语境后识别准确率从33.96%提升至72.08%，表明仅靠视觉证据往往不足；而仅靠语义相关性也不够，因为事件的身份、焦点人物角色、关系或结果被误判时会指向错误情感。
AI.method: 提出AffectReveal，一个免调优(tuning-free)框架：首先围绕影响关键因素构建并独立验证"有证据支撑的候选事件"；随后通过双向原子证据支持，将恢复出的事件与人脸掩蔽(in-media)事实进行交叉核对；同时保留原始未掩蔽输入用于最终预测，不更新下游参数。
AI.result: 构建EGER-Bench，包含10,052个视频和10,734张图像，覆盖11种情感、2个源域和4种视觉设置。六名标注者的研究显示事件语境将人类识别准确率从33.96%提升到72.08%。在三种下游模型和四种输入设置下，AffectReveal平均UAR提升5.26–10.53个百分点；对三种可微调模型，未调优模型在全部12项准确率比较中均超过其视觉单模态微调版本。
AI.conclusion: 情感识别需要恢复影响决定事件，而非仅依赖观测视觉内容；事件语境对人和模型均有显著增益。AffectReveal通过证据接地候选构建、独立验证与双向原子证据交叉核对，在不更新下游参数的前提下稳定提升多模型、多设置下的性能。

title: Long-Term Memory-Guided Enhancement for Target Perception in Audio-Language Models
summary: Audio large language models (ALLMs) can reason about the content of audio recordings to perform complex tasks. However, these capabilities usually collapse in real-world environments when background noise and competing sources mix the target sound. Inspired by long-term memory in human listening, we propose Long-Term Memory-Guided Audio Enhancement (LTM-AE) to improve selective target perception by refining the audio representations of ALLMs without training. LTM-AE extracts representations in hidden states from separate clean reference recordings as long-term memory for each category, guiding enhancement toward a user-specified listening target. We reconstruct incoming audio tokens in the selected category long-term memory and interpolate the reconstructions with the original tokens before language backbone decoding. This interpolation controls the influence of stored auditory experience while keeping all ALLM parameters fixed. Diagnostic readouts across twenty sound categories and three ALLMs show that LTM-AE strengthens responses to a specified target amid three interfering sources. Averaged over constrained and free-form classification, accuracy gains over raw mixtures range from 29.53 to 46.15 percentage points across multiple open source models. For speech content recovery, LTM-AE with an additional learned token-level gate reduces Qwen2-Audio's word error rate from 23.07% to 14.77%. This work takes an initial step toward using principles of human long-term memory to enhance ALLMs for real-world listening. Our code is available at https://github.com/aynlp/ltm-audio-code

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的长时记忆引导音频增强（LTM-AE），用干净参考录音的隐状态作为类别长时记忆，重构并插值音频token，提升ALLM在噪声与混叠下的选择性目标感知。
AI.motivation: 音频大语言模型（ALLM）在真实环境（背景噪声、竞争声源混合）中能力显著退化。受人类听觉长时记忆启发，希望在不训练的前提下增强对用户指定目标的选择性感知。
AI.method: LTM-AE：从各类别干净参考录音的隐藏状态中提取表示，构建类别长时记忆；将输入音频token在所选类别长时记忆中重构，并与原始token插值后再送入语言主干解码。插值系数控制存储听觉经验的影响强度，全部ALLM参数保持冻结。针对语音内容恢复任务，额外引入可学习的token级门控。
AI.result: 在20个声音类别、3个ALLM上进行诊断性读出，LTM-AE在三个干扰源存在时增强对指定目标的响应。约束与自由形式分类平均准确率相比原始混合音频提升29.53–46.15个百分点（多个开源模型）。语音内容恢复中，加入token级门控使Qwen2-Audio词错误率由23.07%降至14.77%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作初步验证了将人类长时记忆原理用于增强ALLM真实场景听觉的可行性，方法免训练、通用性较好，代码已开源。

title: DriftOPD: Sequence-Level Reverse-KL Distillation for One-Step VLA Policies
