summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models increasingly rely on action experts that generate short action chunks under receding-horizon control. While chunk-level training is convenient across robot embodiments, it optimizes local action likelihood without explicitly accounting for long-horizon task success. Sequence-level reinforcement learning can address this limitation, but typically requires policy rollouts and closed-loop interaction, which are costly for real-robot manipulation. We introduce DriftOPD, a teacher-free, rollout-free framework for sequence-level on-policy distillation of continuous VLA action experts. We show that the sequence-level reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence decomposes into a chunk-level reverse-KL term and a future-potential term that captures the long-horizon effect of the current action. DriftOPD optimizes these two terms using a one-step drifting objective and a Q-function critic learned from offline demonstrations, respectively, enabling sequence-level optimization with only offline data and one-step action generation. Across multiple VLA architectures in simulation and real-world manipulation, DriftOPD generally outperforms existing one-step distillation baselines while achieving task success performance comparable to multi-step teacher policies. These results demonstrate that long-horizon behavior can be effectively distilled into one-step VLA action experts without online interaction or a separate teacher.

AI.tldr: DriftOPD是一个无需教师、无需在线rollout的框架，通过序列级on-policy蒸馏，将长时程行为蒸馏进单步VLA动作专家，仅用离线数据和单步动作生成即可实现序列级优化。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型依赖动作专家在滚动时域控制下生成短动作块（action chunk），块级训练虽便于跨本体迁移，但仅优化局部动作似然，未显式考虑长时程任务成功。序列级强化学习可解决该问题，却需要策略rollout与闭环交互，对真实机器人操作代价高昂。
AI.method: 作者提出DriftOPD：证明序列级反向KL散度可分解为块级反向KL项与未来势能项（刻画当前动作的长时程效应）。分别用一步drifting目标优化块级项、用离线演示学习的Q函数critic优化未来势能项，从而在仅有离线数据和单步动作生成的条件下实现序列级优化。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界操作任务中，覆盖多种VLA架构，DriftOPD总体优于现有单步蒸馏基线，任务成功率与多步教师策略相当。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，无需在线交互或独立教师，即可将长时程行为有效蒸馏进单步VLA动作专家。

title: Transformers Stop Thinking Too Early, and a Tiny LoRA Fixes It
summary: Pretrained transformers use little of their depth to follow references in context. Thirteen base models reliably follow only 1.4-3.6 lines, and extra pretrained loops add little. A task-trained rank-8 LoRA at one early layer extends this computation with all model weights frozen. Qwen3-8B improves from 15.5% to 99% exact accuracy on 24-line chains; a longer-trained LoRA reaches 50 lines. Ouro-1.4B reaches 60 lines after four loops and at least 160 after eight. The LoRA starts a relay: program lines pass on their chain identity through a short range of middle layers. Frozen heads read progressively further up the chain, and removing parent-line attention stops the relay. A frozen-model measurement locates the last useful intervention layer within tolerance in three of four held-out models. Task-specific LoRAs also improve MuSiQue. Default answers therefore understate the computation accessible through a tiny edit. Code and an interactive demo are available at https://lunamos.github.io/stop-thinking-too-early/

AI.tldr: 预训练Transformer在上下文引用跟随任务中仅利用少量深度（约1.4-3.6行），但在单个早期层注入一个任务训练的rank-8 LoRA（冻结全部原始权重）后，可通过"中继"机制大幅扩展引用跟随距离（Qwen3-8B从15.5%升至99%，达24行；Ouro-1.4B八循环后≥160行），显示默认输出严重低估了通过微小编辑即可解锁的计算能力。
AI.motivation: 作者观察到预训练模型在跟随上下文中引用链时并未充分利用其深度，层数增加带来的收益有限，因此在保持模型权重完全冻结的前提下，探索能否通过极小的参数编辑来释放模型中未被利用的深层计算潜力，并据此衡量模型真实的可用计算容量。
AI.method: 在单个早期层上训练一个rank-8 LoRA，冻结全部原始模型权重；以多行引用链（如24行、50行、60行、160行）作为任务评测精确准确率；分析LoRA引发的中继（relay）机制，即程序行链身份通过一段中间层传递，冻结的下游头逐步读取更远的链位置，并通过移除父行注意力验证中继的必要性；用冻结模型测量定位最后一个有效干预层。
AI.result: 13个基础模型仅可靠跟随1.4-3.6行，额外预训练循环增益甚微；单个rank-8 LoRA使Qwen3-8B在24行链上从15.5%提升至99%；训练更久的LoRA达50行；Ouro-1.4B四循环达60行、八循环至少160行；移除父行注意力会中断中继；冻结模型测量在四分之三的留出模型中能以容差定位最后有效干预层；任务专用LoRA同时改善了MuSiQue上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 默认答案低估了模型通过微小编辑即可访问的计算量；模型内部保留了大量未被默认前向传播利用的深层计算能力，仅靠单层LoRA即可激活，这为评估模型容量与高效微调提供了新视角。代码与交互式演示已公开。

title: SEED: Self-Speculative Decoding via Implicit Encoder-Decoder
summary: Self-speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by drafting tokens from the target model itself, but faces a sharp tradeoff between the quality and cost of the draft. Early-exit methods produce drafts cheaply by terminating computation at intermediate layers, but forgo the deeper representations that later layers provide and thus suffer in draft quality. Multi-token prediction preserves draft quality by emitting from the model's final hidden states, but pays for a full forward pass to produce those states at every drafting step. We propose self-speculative encoder-decoder (SEED), a self-speculative method that obtains high-quality drafts cheaply by reusing the deep contextual representations already computed during verification. We reinterpret the standard decoder-only transformer as an implicit encoder-decoder: the first layers (encoder) build deep contextual representations, and the last few layers (decoder) emit tokens from them. Encoding and verification are merged into a single step: verification is performed by the full encoder-decoder, and the contextual representations of the verified prefix are cached for reuse during drafting. Drafting is therefore very fast: between verifications, the lightweight decoder drafts multiple tokens autoregressively, each conditioned on the cached representations and on preceding drafts. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that SEED achieves up to 2.7$\times$ average speedup on 4B-scale models, outperforming both early-exit and MTP-style self-speculative baselines and running 28% faster than the state-of-the-art EAGLE-3, while preserving or even improving the generation quality of standard autoregressive fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/lhk2004/SEED.

AI.tldr: SEED将标准解码器Transformer重新解释为隐式编码器-解码器结构，通过复用验证阶段已计算的深层上下文表示来低成本生成高质量草稿，实现自推测解码加速。
AI.motivation: 自推测解码存在草稿质量与成本之间的尖锐权衡：早退方法成本低但草稿质量差，多token预测质量高但每步需完整前向传播，成本高。需要一种兼顾两者优势的方法。
AI.method: 将解码器Transformer视为隐式编码器-解码器：前若干层作编码器构建深层上下文表示，后几层作解码器从中生成token。验证由完整编码器-解码器执行，并将已验证前缀的上下文表示缓存复用。两次验证之间，轻量解码器自回归地基于缓存表示和先前草稿生成多个token。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，4B规模模型平均加速最高达2.7倍，优于早退和MTP类自推测基线，比最先进的EAGLE-3快28%，同时保持甚至提升标准自回归微调的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: SEED通过编码与验证合并、复用深层表示进行草稿，解决了自推测解码的质量-成本权衡问题，在加速效果和生成质量上均取得优异表现。

title: Beyond Legibility: Benchmarking Visual Text Rendering and In-Place Editing in Unified Video Generation
summary: A video can exhibit convincing motion and photorealism yet fail immediately when visual text collapses. Unlike generic scene content, visual text is unforgiving in video generation: minor stroke corruption, temporal instability, or editing errors instantly break legibility and realism. Existing benchmarks overlook this challenge by treating text as incidental or using static OCR metrics that ignore temporal dynamics. We introduce VidScribe, a unified diagnostic benchmark spanning four generation regimes: writing from language (T2V), transferring text identity from a reference (R2V), sustaining text under dynamics (I2V), and localized text editing (V2V). VidScribe contains 803 human-verified samples across a 12-axis conditionally orthogonal factor space covering Intrinsic Text Properties, Physical Imaging Conditions, and Temporal Behavior. For reliable evaluation, we build a track-grounded, gated suite with 11 shared metrics and 2 task-specific probes under strict measurability conditions. Benchmarking 11 commercial and open-source systems shows that video text capability is non-monolithic, with content recognition decoupled from stroke-level glyph correctness. Performance is highly task-asymmetric: I2V sustains text most reliably, whereas V2V editing is the primary bottleneck. Counter-intuitively, degradation concentrates on a small subset of text-centric structural and temporal factors rather than adverse imaging conditions. Further probes show that visual references improve glyph and typographic fidelity rather than content accuracy, while localized editing fails to isolate target text without corrupting undeclared source text. Beyond evaluation, VidScribe also provides an actionable training signal, where benchmark-aligned preference optimization measurably improves visual text generation. https://huggingface.co/datasets/Vicky0720/VidScribe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VidScribe，一个面向视频生成中视觉文本的统一的诊断性基准，涵盖 T2V、R2V、I2V、V2V 四种生成范式，包含 803 个经人工校验的样本和 12 轴条件正交因子空间，并设计了基于轨迹、带门控的评测套件（11 项共享指标 + 2 项任务专用探针）。对 11 个系统的评测揭示视频文本能力非单一化、任务高度不对称，且该基准可作为可操作的训练信号。
AI.motivation: 视频可呈现可信的运动与照片级真实感，但一旦视觉文本崩溃即立刻失败：细微笔画损坏、时间不稳定或编辑错误都会瞬间破坏可读性与真实感。然而现有基准将文本视为附带内容，或采用忽略时间动态的静态 OCR 指标，因而忽视了这一挑战，缺乏针对视频文本生成的系统性诊断手段。
AI.method: 提出 VidScribe 统一诊断基准，覆盖四种生成范式：从语言书写（T2V）、从参考迁移文本身份（R2V）、在动态下维持文本（I2V）、局部文本编辑（V2V）。基准含 803 个人工校验样本，覆盖 12 轴条件正交因子空间，涵盖内在文本属性、物理成像条件与时间行为三类因素。评测方面构建基于轨迹、带门控的测试套件，包含 11 项共享指标与 2 项任务专用探针，并在严格可测量性条件下进行。对 11 个商业与开源系统进行基准测试，并进一步用基准对齐的偏好优化作为训练信号进行验证。
AI.result: 评测显示视频文本能力并非单一整体，内容识别与笔画级字形正确性相互解耦；性能呈现高度任务不对称性：I2V 对文本的维持最可靠，而 V2V 编辑是主要瓶颈。反直觉的是，退化集中于少数以文本为中心的结构与时间因子，而非不利成像条件。进一步探针表明：视觉参考提升字形与排版保真度而非内容准确度；局部编辑无法在不破坏未声明源文本的前提下隔离目标文本。此外，基准对齐的偏好优化可实测提升视觉文本生成效果。
AI.conclusion: VidScribe 填补了视频生成中视觉文本评测的空白，提供了覆盖多范式、多因子的可测量诊断框架，揭示了文本能力解耦、任务不对称与退化集中等关键现象，并可作为可操作的训练信号推动视觉文本生成的改进。数据与代码已开源于 Hugging Face。

title: Scaling Video Generation for Reasoning: At What Cost?
summary: We study whether scaling video generation enables models to reason about hidden information from the past frames, and at what computational cost. Our controlled benchmark requires predicting nine prescribed moves of an initially solved 2x2x2 Rubik's Cube from a fixed view of three faces. Correct predictions require inferring how actions change hidden states, and the simulator provides exact ground truth for evaluation. Models learn plausible cube geometry early, while correct sticker configurations require substantially more training. Although validation MSE follows approximate power-law scaling, lower MSE loss does not reliably indicate downstream reasoning capabilities. Smaller autoregressive models achieve higher state accuracy with limited compute, while larger models reach higher accuracy after more training. At roughly 0.1 PF-days, the 70M-parameter model correctly predicts the visible sticker configuration in 44.6% of post-action frames, compared with 0.3% for the 1B model, which reaches 83.7% at 3.14 PF-days. Symbolic state supervision raises the 20M model's frame accuracy from 31.1% to 67.3% at the same training-data budget, suggesting that learning representations of state changes can complement scaling.

AI.tldr: 论文以2x2x2魔方作为受控基准，研究视频生成模型的规模扩展是否能带来对隐藏状态的推理能力，以及所需计算代价。
AI.motivation: 作者关注视频生成模型能否从过去帧中推断隐藏信息并据此推理，同时希望明确这种能力的获取与模型规模、训练计算量之间的关系，并区分损失下降与下游推理能力提升是否一致。
AI.method: 构建受控基准：从固定视角观察三个面，要求模型预测初始已完成魔方的九个指定动作序列；正确预测需推断动作如何改变隐藏状态，且模拟器提供精确真值。比较不同规模自回归模型在不同训练计算量下的表现，并测试符号状态监督的作用。
AI.result: 模型早期学会合理几何外观，但正确贴纸配置需要显著更多训练；验证MSE近似幂律扩展，但更低MSE并不能可靠指示下游推理能力。较小自回归模型在有限计算下状态准确率更高，较大模型经更多训练后准确率更高。约0.1 PF-days时，70M参数模型对动作后帧可见贴纸配置预测正确率为44.6%，而1B模型仅0.3%，后者在3.14 PF-days达到83.7%。相同数据预算下，符号状态监督将20M模型帧准确率从31.1%提升到67.3%。
AI.conclusion: 视频生成中的规模扩展可提升隐藏状态推理能力，但存在显著计算代价与规模-训练权衡；MSE损失不足以衡量推理能力，学习状态变化表示可补充单纯扩大规模。

title: Pixel-wise Exposure for Highly Robust In-Vehicle Remote-PPG
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) offers a promising non-contact solution for heart rate monitoring, yet its real-world robustness is fundamentally limited by an inherent hardware limitation: existing camera exposure control paradigms, whether fixed or auto-exposure, impose a uniform exposure time across all pixels within a frame. In high-dynamic-range scenes such as automotive cabins with strong directional sunlight, this spatially invariant exposure constraint inevitably leads to localized facial overexposure or underexposure, irreversibly corrupting the subtle pulsatile signals essential for rPPG at the point of capture, a physical degradation that no downstream algorithm can recover. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose PixExpo (Pixel-wise Exposure), a "temporal-for-spatial" framework that sequentially captures frames under a predefined cyclic exposure schedule and performs non-iterative pixel-wise fusion. At each pixel location, PixExpo selects the observation closest to an rPPG-motivated target intensity. This criterion seeks to reduce local saturation and severe underexposure rather than optimize perceptual appearance. PixExpo requires no sensor modification but assumes programmable frame-level exposure control. We validate the proposed PixExpo framework using our newly introduced MEX-Drive dataset, comprising 48 participants under real-world driving conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that PixExpo outperforms manufacture-default auto-exposure methods, reducing the mean absolute error (MAE) by 7.21 bpm (from 13.94 to 6.73 bpm) and increasing the success rate by 37.29 percentage points (from 25.95% to 63.24%) across challenging driving scenarios.

AI.tldr: PixExpo 提出"时间换空间"的像素级曝光框架，通过循环曝光序列采集与非迭代像素级融合，缓解 rPPG 在高动态范围场景下的局部过曝/欠曝问题，在 MEX-Drive 数据集上将 MAE 降至 6.73 bpm、成功率提升至 63.24%。
AI.motivation: 远程光电容积描记（rPPG）虽可非接触式监测心率，但受硬件限制：现有相机曝光控制（固定或自动曝光）对整帧所有像素施加统一曝光时间，空间不变。在车载座舱等强方向性阳光的高动态范围场景中，这必然导致面部局部过曝或欠曝，在采集端就不可逆地破坏了 rPPG 所需的微弱搏动信号，任何下游算法都无法恢复。
AI.method: 提出 PixExpo（Pixel-wise Exposure），一种"时间换空间"（temporal-for-spatial）框架：按预定义的循环曝光计划顺序采集帧，然后进行非迭代的像素级融合。在每个像素位置，选择最接近 rPPG 驱动目标强度的观测值，该准则旨在减少局部饱和与严重欠曝，而非优化感知外观。方法无需修改传感器，但假设具备可编程的帧级曝光控制。同时构建 MEX-Drive 数据集（48 名参与者的真实驾驶条件）。
AI.result: 在 MEX-Drive 数据集上，PixExpo 优于厂商默认自动曝光方法：平均绝对误差（MAE）降低 7.21 bpm（从 13.94 降至 6.73 bpm），成功率提升 37.29 个百分点（从 25.95% 升至 63.24%）。
AI.conclusion: PixExpo 通过像素级循环曝光与融合，从采集端缓解高动态范围下 rPPG 信号被破坏的根本瓶颈，无需硬件改动即可显著提升真实驾驶场景下的心率监测精度与成功率。

title: Act First, Reason Later: Accelerating On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents via Reference-Conditioned Inverse Dynamics
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains multi-turn language agents with dense teacher supervision on student-generated responses. However, standard think-then-act rollouts require lengthy reasoning before each short action, delaying environment transitions and experience collection. Generating actions directly reduces this delay but can degrade rollout quality. To address this, we propose ActFirst-OPD, an act-first, reason-later training framework that decouples environment interaction from full-response generation. The student infers and executes actions through reference-conditioned inverse dynamics using its current interaction context and a reference next observation, and switches to autonomous next-action prediction when the resulting transition deviates from the reference trajectory. From the collected interaction contexts, the student asynchronously generates full think-then-act responses for token-level teacher supervision. Experiments across 0.6B-, 1.7B-, and 4B-parameter Qwen3 students show that ActFirst-OPD achieves average wall-clock training speedups of $2.3\times$ on ALFWorld, $1.8\times$ on WebShop, and $4.9\times$ on ScienceWorld over Vanilla OPD. It matches or exceeds all compared OPD baselines in mean task success rate across eight of nine benchmark-model settings. These results demonstrate that reasoning need not block acting during multi-turn agent distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出 ActFirst-OPD 框架，将多轮智能体的环境交互与完整响应生成解耦，实现"先行动、后推理"，显著加速训练且保持性能。
AI.motivation: 标准的"先思考再行动"（think-then-act）轨迹要求在每次简短动作前进行冗长推理，延迟了环境状态转移与经验采集；而直接生成动作虽能减少延迟，却会损害轨迹质量。
AI.method: ActFirst-OPD 是一种 act-first、reason-later 的训练框架，将环境交互与完整响应生成解耦。学生模型通过 reference-conditioned 逆动力学（inverse dynamics），利用当前交互上下文与参考下一观测来推断并执行动作；当实际状态转移偏离参考轨迹时，切换到自主的下一动作预测。随后从采集的交互上下文中，学生对完整 think-then-act 响应进行异步生成，以接受 token 级教师监督。
AI.result: 在 0.6B、1.7B、4B 参数的 Qwen3 学生模型上，ActFirst-OPD 相比 Vanilla OPD 实现了平均墙钟训练加速：ALFWorld 上 2.3×、WebShop 上 1.8×、ScienceWorld 上 4.9×；在九个基准-模型设置中的八个里，平均任务成功率与所有对比 OPD 基线持平或更优。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在多轮智能体蒸馏中，推理无需阻塞行动。

title: CrossTimeEdit: A Decade-Spanning Cross-View Dataset and Reward-Guided Editing for Historical Street-View Generation
summary: Historical street-view imagery records urban evolution, but uneven coverage leaves substantial gaps in historical records. Generating plausible past appearances requires restoring changed structures while preserving persistent scene content. We construct VIGOR-his, a decade-spanning cross-view dataset containing 43,653 location-level quadruplets across 11 cities on three continents. Its automated pipeline performs spatial pairing, consistency screening, change classification, and the generation and validation of satellite-based change descriptions and local editing instructions. Based on VIGOR-his, we propose CrossTimeEdit, a model that reformulates historical street-view generation as editing, using recent street views to constrain viewpoint and unchanged appearance and temporal satellite differences as change evidence. Starting from FLUX.2 [Klein] 4B, we train CrossTimeEdit through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by online reinforcement learning (RL). We design three street-view editing criteria, namely Instruction Alignment (IA), Background Preservation (BP), and Quality and Physical Plausibility (QP), as both RL reward dimensions and evaluation metrics. We optimize this multi-reward objective using Within Group Relative Policy Optimization for flow-matching models (Flow-GRPO) with Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO), which normalizes each reward dimension before aggregation. CrossTimeEdit improves overall performance across the three editing criteria by 17.12\% over the pretrained baseline and outperforms cross-view generation models in scene consistency, visual realism, and perceptual quality. The implementation code, dataset, and model weights are available at https://luhanwen67.github.io/CrossTimeEdit-release/.

AI.tldr: 本文构建十年跨视角数据集 VIGOR-his，并提出 CrossTimeEdit 模型，将历史街景生成重构为编辑任务，结合 SFT 与基于 Flow-GRPO/GDPO 的多奖励在线强化学习，在指令对齐、背景保持、质量与物理合理性三方面较基线提升 17.12%。
AI.motivation: 历史街景影像记录了城市演变，但覆盖不均导致历史记录存在大量空缺。生成合理的过去场景外观需要：恢复已发生变化的结构，同时保留未改变的场景内容，这一双重目标具有挑战性。现有跨视角生成方法难以兼顾结构变化与场景一致性。
AI.method: 1) 构建 VIGOR-his：覆盖三大洲 11 座城市、43,653 个 location-level 四元组的十年跨度跨视角数据集；自动化流水线包括空间配对、一致性筛选、变化分类，以及基于卫星图像的变化描述与局部编辑指令的生成和验证。2) 提出 CrossTimeEdit：将历史街景生成重构为编辑任务，以近期街景约束视角与未变外观，以时序卫星差异作为变化证据。3) 从 FLUX.2 [Klein] 4B 出发，先 SFT 后在线 RL。4) 设计 IA、BP、QP 三项街景编辑准则，同时作为 RL 奖励维度与评估指标；采用 Flow-GRPO 与 GDPO（在聚合前对各奖励维度归一化）优化多奖励目标。
AI.result: CrossTimeEdit 在三项编辑准则上的整体性能较预训练基线提升 17.12%，并在场景一致性、视觉真实感和感知质量方面优于跨视角生成模型。代码、数据集与模型权重已在项目主页公开。
AI.conclusion: 将历史街景生成建模为带多奖励约束的编辑任务，并借助跨视角时空数据与多维度强化学习优化，可有效缓解历史街景记录缺失问题，同时保持场景一致性与视觉真实性。

title: Generating Edit-Inducing Questions for AI Research Manuscripts
comment: Accepted at the DocInsights Workshop @ EMNLP 2026
summary: We study the ability of LLMs to generate edit-inducing questions whose answer will improve a paper draft. On a dataset of paired submission and camera-ready papers from ICLR and NeurIPS, we compare the helpfulness of questions from GPT models with or without full paper context to that of human reviewers. GPT produces more edit-inducing questions and its questions are associated with more extensive edits and cover a broader range of edited content compared to questions from reviewers. However, a much smaller percentage of the GPT questions are edit-inducing. Our analyses confirm that automated questions can be beneficial to authors and highlight an example task where proper attending to long context deteriorates reasoning model ability to produce helpful output.

AI.tldr: 研究LLM生成能引发论文修改的问题的能力：GPT比人类审稿人产生更多引发修改的问题，且关联更广泛修改，但GPT问题中引发修改的比例远低于人类。
AI.motivation: 探索LLM能否通过生成"引发修改的问题"（edit-inducing questions）帮助作者改进论文草稿，并与人类审稿人对比其有用性。
AI.method: 基于ICLR和NeurIPS的投稿版与camera-ready版配对论文数据集，比较有无全文上下文的GPT模型生成问题与人类审稿人问题的有用性。
AI.result: GPT产生更多引发修改的问题，其问题关联的修改更广泛、覆盖更多修改内容；但GPT问题中引发修改的比例远低于审稿人问题。分析还发现一个反例任务：恰当利用长上下文反而降低推理模型产生有用输出的能力。
AI.conclusion: 自动化生成的问题对作者有益，但需注意长上下文处理对推理模型能力的负面影响。

title: Beyond Binary Preferences: Graded Preference Optimization for Limb-Motion Captioning
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can generate rich video captions, yet often misidentify which person performs an action or which limb is involved, particularly across camera cuts. Improving these details requires evaluation and training that distinguish missing information from incorrect assertions. We introduce FlexBench, a benchmark spanning 3,105 shots and 18,161 evaluation queries, with human-verified identities and systematic per-person coverage of fine-grained limb actions and states. Its reference-derived checklists support automated assessment of complete captions in their person and shot contexts. Our Graded Physical Alignment score (GPA) awards credit for correct content and deducts points for incorrect or fabricated actions, making these errors explicit in the aggregate score. Building on this rubric, we propose Graded Margin Direct Preference Optimization (GM-DPO), which assigns stronger preference margins and greater training weight to more severe action errors. Across three VLM backbones, GM-DPO achieves the highest substantive-action and GPA scores among the evaluated preference objectives, improving GPA over DPO by 2.02-3.40 points. On Qwen3-8B, it reduces the weighted hallucination rate by 21.3% relative to DPO. These gains accompany sustained long-form output, improved shot structure, and competitive performance on three additional multimodal benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FlexBench 基准与 GPA 评分，并设计 GM-DPO 训练方法，以区分"缺失信息"与"错误断言"，显著降低视觉语言模型在视频描述中的动作幻觉。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型虽能生成丰富的视频描述，但常误判动作的执行者或涉及的肢体，尤其跨镜头切换时更明显。现有评估与训练难以区分"信息缺失"与"错误断言"，导致幻觉被掩盖。
AI.method: 1) FlexBench：包含 3,105 个镜头、18,161 条评估查询，具有人工验证的人物身份与系统化的人均细粒度肢体动作/状态覆盖，基于参考生成检查清单，可在人物与镜头语境下自动评估完整描述。2) GPA（分级物理对齐）评分：对正确内容加分、对错误或虚构动作扣分，使错误在总分中显式反映。3) GM-DPO（分级边际直接偏好优化）：依据动作错误严重程度分配更强的偏好边际与更大训练权重。
AI.result: 在三个 VLM 主干上，GM-DPO 在实质性动作与 GPA 得分上均优于所评估的偏好优化目标，GPA 较 DPO 提升 2.02–3.40 分；在 Qwen3-8B 上，相对 DPO 将加权幻觉率降低 21.3%。同时保持长文本输出、改善镜头结构，并在另外三个多模态基准上具备竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过以"错误类型分级"为核心的评估（FlexBench、GPA）与训练（GM-DPO）协同设计，可有效抑制细粒度动作幻觉，兼顾输出丰富度与通用多模态能力。

title: What Makes Recurrence Effective in Looped Language Models?
summary: Looped language models (LoopLMs) increase computational depth through parameter sharing, offering a path to scale inference computation without adding parameters. However, it remains unclear when additional recurrence is beneficial and how architectural choices affect its effectiveness. Through controlled experiments, we systematically examine (1) when recurrence helps, (2) where it should be applied, and (3) how its conditioning affects performance. Our evaluation covers inference budgets below, within, and beyond the training horizon under knowledge and reasoning tasks. (1) We find that recurrence can improve reasoning beyond the training horizon while degrading knowledge performance, but harder reasoning instances do not consistently benefit more. (2) Performance also depends on how distinct layers and recurrent iterations are allocated, showing that effective depth alone is insufficient to predict behavior. Non-recurrent output layers improve robustness to under-unrolling, while the preferred placement of input and output layers varies with inference budget. (3) Finally, we find that conventional initial-state injection offers limited robustness to varying recurrence depth. We therefore propose history-state injection as an alternative, and show that channel-wise history-state injection combined with timestep conditioning offers a low-cost and more effective design, better preserving knowledge under extended unrolling while improving robustness across inference budgets. Overall, our results clarify when recurrent computation helps, where it fails, and offer practical guidelines for designing LoopLMs across variable inference budgets.

AI.tldr: 通过受控实验系统研究循环语言模型（LoopLM）中递归计算何时有益、应施加于何处以及条件注入方式如何影响性能，并提出历史状态注入设计。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型通过参数共享增加计算深度，可在不增加参数量的前提下扩展推理计算。但额外递归何时有益、架构选择如何影响其有效性尚不明确，缺乏设计指导。
AI.method: 在知识任务与推理任务上开展受控实验，覆盖低于、处于及超出训练时间范围的推理预算，系统考察三个方面：(1) 递归何时有帮助；(2) 递归应施加于哪些层；(3) 条件注入方式对性能的影响。并对比初始状态注入与提出的历史状态注入，进一步评估逐通道历史状态注入结合时间步条件的方案。
AI.result: 递归可提升超出训练时间范围的推理能力，但会损害知识性能；更难的推理实例并未一致获益更多。性能取决于不同层与递归迭代的分配方式，有效深度本身不足以预测行为。非递归输出层提升了对欠展开的鲁棒性，输入与输出层的最优位置随推理预算变化。传统初始状态注入对递归深度变化的鲁棒性有限。
AI.conclusion: 历史状态注入（尤其是逐通道历史状态注入结合时间步条件）成本低且更有效，能在扩展展开时更好地保留知识并提升跨推理预算的鲁棒性。研究明确了递归计算何时有益、何处失效，并为可变推理预算下的LoopLM设计提供实用指导。

title: PE-OPSD: Internalizing Prompt Enhancement into Flow-matching Models via On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Text-to-image users often provide concise and underspecified prompts, whereas generative models benefit from detailed textual conditions for reliable instruction following. Existing systems bridge this gap with Prompt Enhancers (PEs) that rewrite raw prompts at inference time, introducing additional latency and leaving prompt elaboration external to the generator. We instead view enhanced prompts as privileged training information and ask whether their benefits can be internalized. We propose Prompt-Enhanced On-Policy Self-Distillation (PE-OPSD) for text-to-image flow-matching models. During training, a raw-prompt student follows its own generation trajectory, while an enhanced-prompt teacher provides vector-field targets at the states visited by the student. This on-policy supervision distills the behavior induced by enhanced prompts into the raw-prompt student without requiring additional text--image pairs. At inference, both the PE and teacher are removed, and the student generates directly from raw prompts. Across multiple model families, PEs, and benchmarks, PE-OPSD achieves the strongest aggregate prompt fidelity among the evaluated baselines, yields positive aggregate visual appeal gains, and retains the base-model inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出PE-OPSD方法，将提示增强（PE）的重写收益通过在线策略自蒸馏内化到文生图模型中，推理时无需PE和教师，即可提升提示保真度且保持基座推理效率。
AI.motivation: 文生图用户常给出简短、欠明确的提示，而生成模型需要详细文本条件才能可靠遵循指令。现有做法是在推理时用Prompt Enhancer（PE）重写原始提示，但这会引入额外延迟，且提示细化仍外在于生成器，未被模型本身吸收。
AI.method: 提出Prompt-Enhanced On-Policy Self-Distillation（PE-OPSD），用于流匹配（flow-matching）文生图模型。训练时，原始提示的学生模型沿自身生成轨迹采样，增强提示的教师模型在学生访问到的状态上提供向量场（vector-field）目标，通过在线策略（on-policy）监督将增强提示所诱导的行为蒸馏进原始提示学生模型，无需额外文本-图像对。
AI.result: 在多个模型家族、多种PE与基准测试上，PE-OPSD在所评估基线中取得最高的综合提示保真度，并在整体视觉吸引力上获得正向增益，同时保持基座模型的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 将增强提示视为特权训练信息，可把外部PE的收益内化为模型能力；推理时移除PE与教师，学生直接从原始提示生成，兼顾质量提升与效率。

title: OCA: ODE-Driven Cross-Attention for Image-to-Point-Cloud Registration
summary: Cross-attention is a crucial component in learning-based image-to-point-cloud (I2P) registration. Although existing cross-attention mechanisms have achieved promising progress, attention ambiguity remains a fundamental challenge that hinders the learning of discriminative 2D-3D correspondences. To address this problem, we revisit cross-attention and establish ordinary differential equations (ODEs) to model the ideal I2P feature interaction. Based on this formulation, we develop an ODE-driven cross-attention (OCA) module that refines feature representations and attention matrices through ODEs. In practice, OCA can be seamlessly integrated into existing I2P registration frameworks. To validate its effectiveness, we incorporate OCA into five state-of-the-art baselines and evaluate on four public benchmark datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that OCA improves registration recall by up to 5\%, 9\%, and 15\% under the standard, fine-tuning, and zero-shot settings, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对图像到点云配准中交叉注意力存在的注意力歧义问题，提出用常微分方程建模理想的特征交互过程，设计了 ODE 驱动的交叉注意力模块 OCA，可无缝嵌入现有框架，并在多个基准上显著提升配准召回率。
AI.motivation: 图像到点云（I2P）配准中，交叉注意力是学习 2D-3D 对应关系的关键组件。尽管现有交叉注意力机制已取得进展，但注意力歧义仍是阻碍学习判别性 2D-3D 对应的根本挑战，因此需要从新的角度重新审视交叉注意力的建模方式。
AI.method: 作者重新审视交叉注意力，建立常微分方程（ODEs）来刻画理想的 I2P 特征交互过程。基于该形式化建模，提出 ODE 驱动的交叉注意力模块（OCA），通过 ODE 对特征表示与注意力矩阵进行迭代细化。该模块可无缝集成到现有的 I2P 配准框架中。
AI.result: 作者将 OCA 集成到五个当前最优基线模型中，并在四个公开基准数据集上进行评测。实验结果显示，OCA 在标准设置、微调设置和零样本设置下分别最多提升配准召回率 5%、9% 和 15%。
AI.conclusion: 以 ODE 建模交叉注意力能够有效缓解注意力歧义，OCA 作为一种通用模块具备良好的兼容性与泛化性，可稳定提升现有 I2P 配准方法的性能。

title: VLM4Cluster: Benchmarking Deep Clustering In the Era of Vision-Language Pre-training
summary: Vision-language pre-training has reshaped image clustering, giving rise to language-assisted image clustering (LaIC), which leverages textual semantics to complement visual representations. Despite the rapid proliferation of LaIC methods, it remains unclear how much LaIC has actually advanced image clustering, as existing studies generally suffer from major limitations, including inconsistent experimental settings, inadequate dataset selection, and limited evaluation dimensions. To address this gap, we introduce VLM4Cluster, a comprehensive benchmark for image clustering in the era of pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs). VLM4Cluster implements 17 representative methods spanning classical, deep, and language-assisted image clustering, and evaluates them on 20 datasets covering classical, challenging, fine-grained, large-scale, and out-of-distribution settings. Beyond effectiveness, VLM4Cluster systematically investigates image clustering along three complementary dimensions: robustness to adversarial perturbations, generalization under distribution shifts, and computational efficiency. Our study shows that LaIC substantially advances the clustering performance frontier on many semantically demanding benchmarks, generally exhibits stronger generalization under distribution shifts, and achieves a more favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off. However, its gains become less consistent on large-scale and fine-grained datasets, while language assistance does not systematically reduce sensitivity to adversarial perturbations. VLM4Cluster is released at https://github.com/YuanweiHuu/VLM4Cluster.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 VLM4Cluster——面向视觉语言模型时代图像聚类的综合基准，涵盖17种代表性方法、20个数据集及三个互补评估维度，揭示语言辅助图像聚类（LaIC）的优势与局限。
AI.motivation: LaIC 方法快速发展，但尚不清楚其是否真正推动了图像聚类进步；现有研究存在实验设置不一致、数据集选择不足、评估维度有限等主要局限，因此需要一个系统化基准来公正评估。
AI.method: 构建 VLM4Cluster 基准：实现17种代表性方法，涵盖经典、深度、语言辅助图像聚类；在20个数据集上评估，覆盖经典、挑战性、细粒度、大规模与分布外场景；除有效性外，还从对抗扰动鲁棒性、分布偏移泛化性、计算效率三个互补维度系统考察。
AI.result: LaIC 在许多语义要求高的基准上显著推进聚类性能前沿，通常在分布偏移下具有更强泛化性，并取得更优的有效性-效率权衡；但在大规模与细粒度数据集上增益不够一致，且语言辅助未能系统性地降低对对抗扰动的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: VLM4Cluster 为预训练视觉语言模型时代的图像聚类提供了全面、可复现的评估基准（已开源），明确了 LaIC 的优势边界与待改进方向，为后续研究提供规范化的比较平台。

title: FocusVTC: Efficient and High-Performance Visual Text Compression with Adaptive Resolution
summary: Long-context reasoning in large language models incurs substantial computation and memory costs. Visual text compression (VTC) reduces input length by rendering text as images, but fixed-resolution rendering creates a compression-performance trade-off: low DPI saves tokens at the expense of legibility, whereas high DPI spends tokens on irrelevant content. We introduce FocusVTC, which breaks this trade-off through adaptive resolution while preserving general multimodal capabilities. It combines compressed low-DPI global views with selective region enhancement, integrating enhanced views into ongoing reasoning. We construct 29.4K high-quality Reasoning-Evidence Localization (REL) chain-of-thought examples (REL-CoT) that link reasoning traces to page indices and bounding boxes. Multi-resolution REL supervised fine-tuning (REL-SFT) teaches the model to localize relevant regions, and Group Relative Policy Optimization learns when to enhance resolution and how to use the resulting observations, without a separate continual-pretraining stage. At 72 DPI on RULER v1, FocusVTC scores 87.4 at $2.9\times$ input compression, including tool observations, versus 57.5 for Glyph at $3.0\times$ input compression. It surpasses its text-input backbone on LongBench (56.40 versus 55.86), improves the MRCR macro-average by 13.91 points, and achieves a 51.19 macro-average on VTCBench. The MRCR latency evaluation also shows a $2.79\times$ online end-to-end speedup over Text. General multimodal capabilities are preserved, with MMMU increasing from 65.12 to 66.73 and MME from 2424.02 to 2457.62.

AI.tldr: FocusVTC 通过自适应分辨率打破视觉文本压缩的性能-压缩权衡，在低 DPI 全局视图基础上选择性增强相关区域，用 REL-CoT 数据与强化学习训练定位与增强策略，实现高压缩比下更强长上下文推理并保持通用多模态能力。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理计算与显存开销大。视觉文本压缩（VTC）把文本渲染为图像以缩短输入长度，但固定分辨率渲染存在压缩-性能权衡：低 DPI 省 token 但可读性差，高 DPI 又在无关内容上浪费 token。因此需要一个自适应分辨率的方案，在不牺牲通用多模态能力的前提下打破该权衡。
AI.method: 提出 FocusVTC：将压缩的低 DPI 全局视图与选择性区域增强结合，并把增强视图整合进持续推理过程。构建 29.4K 高质量 Reasoning-Evidence Localization（REL）思维链样本 REL-CoT，将推理轨迹与页码索引和边界框关联。用多分辨率 REL 监督微调（REL-SFT）教模型定位相关区域，再用 Group Relative Policy Optimization 学习何时增强分辨率以及如何利用增强后的观测，无需单独的持续预训练阶段。
AI.result: 在 RULER v1 的 72 DPI 下，计入工具观测时 FocusVTC 以 2.9× 输入压缩取得 87.4 分，Glyph 在 3.0× 压缩下为 57.5。LongBench 上超过其纯文本输入骨干（56.40 vs 55.86），MRCR 宏平均提升 13.91 分，VTCBench 宏平均达 51.19。MRCR 延迟评测显示相对 Text 有 2.79× 在线端到端加速。通用多模态能力得到保持，MMMU 由 65.12 升至 66.73，MME 由 2424.02 升至 2457.62。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应分辨率与选择性区域增强，FocusVTC 在保持甚至提升通用多模态能力的同时，打破了固定分辨率 VTC 的压缩-性能权衡，在多项长上下文基准上以更高压缩比取得更优推理表现与显著在线加速。

title: Replay the Curvature: Accurate and Scalable NVFP4 Quantization for Large Language Model Inference
summary: Large language models make weight storage and memory traffic major inference costs, motivating low-precision formats that represent each weight with only a few bits. Such formats use a scale to map floating-point values into a small codebook; NVFP4 improves local range utilization by letting every 16 E2M1 weights share an E4M3 block scale. Choosing that scale is difficult in GPTQ because quantizing one column updates those that follow, so evaluating a block independently can misestimate its final reconstruction error. Large models pose a second challenge: full-precision weights, calibration activations, and second-order state cannot all remain on one accelerator, while assigning complete layers to devices leaves each time-consuming layer solve serial. We introduce \emph{Schur Replay}, a scale-selection algorithm that reproduces the GPTQ updates caused by each block scale and scores the resulting block error after accounting for compensation from unquantized columns. Separately, our execution infrastructure keeps only the active layer resident, tiers activations across device, host, and disk, retires full-precision layers after export, and distributes independent output rows across tensor-parallel ranks. Together, the algorithm and infrastructure attain $99.35\%$ and $100.84\%$ question-weighted recovery from BF16 across seven benchmarks on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct. On the 397B model, the infrastructure reduces measured per-layer time by $15.17\times$ over ModelOpt and $23.14\times$ over LLM Compressor, with lower memory used per GPU.

AI.tldr: 提出 Schur Replay 量化尺度选择算法与配套执行基础设施，解决 NVFP4/GPTQ 低精度量化中块尺度选择不准与超大模型无法单卡容纳的问题，在 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 与 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 上实现接近甚至超过 BF16 的恢复率并大幅加速。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型推理的权重存储与访存开销巨大，需要低精度格式（如 NVFP4，每 16 个 E2M1 权重共享一个 E4M3 块尺度）。但存在两大难题：一是 GPTQ 中量化某列会更新后续列，独立评估一个块的误差会误估其最终重建误差；二是超大模型无法把全精度权重、校准激活与二阶状态同时放在单个加速器上，而按整层分配到设备又会使耗时层求解串行化。
AI.method: 算法层面提出 Schur Replay：复现每个块尺度所引起的 GPTQ 更新，并在考虑未量化列补偿后对块误差打分，从而更准确地选择块尺度。基础设施层面：仅保留当前活动层驻留，将激活在设备、主机与磁盘间分层存储，导出后即释放全精度层，并把相互独立的输出行分布到张量并行 rank 上执行。
AI.result: 在七个基准上，于 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 和 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 分别取得 99.35% 与 100.84% 的 BF16 问题加权恢复率。在 397B 模型上，实测单层耗时较 ModelOpt 降低 15.17 倍、较 LLM Compressor 降低 23.14 倍，且每 GPU 内存占用更低。
AI.conclusion: 通过将准确的块尺度选择算法与分层卸载、张量并行的执行框架结合，可实现超大规模模型的低精度量化，在几乎无损（甚至部分超越 BF16）的精度下显著提升量化速度并降低显存占用。

title: Not Every Correction Helps: Gain-Guided Continual Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Continual test-time adaptation (CTTA) adapts a source model to an unlabeled test stream whose distribution may change over time. Existing TTA methods often assess prediction reliability using confidence or entropy, which primarily reflect the model's self-certainty for the current sample. In CTTA, accumulated target observations can provide complementary evidence for correcting the source prediction, but this history may become misaligned as the target distribution changes. The key question is therefore not how much the correction differs from the source prediction, but whether and how strongly it should be applied. This paper proposes Gain-Aware INtervention (GAIN), a backpropagation-free CTTA framework guided by a simple principle: history proposes, gain decides. GAIN maintains compact target statistics to form a correction proposal and a posterior-predictive evaluator that accounts for estimation uncertainty. The resulting source-relative gain estimates the proposal's benefit and determines a sample-specific intervention strength along a continuous path through efficient one-dimensional optimization. Gain-controlled predictions then update the target statistics online, limiting the propagation of unreliable corrections, all without backpropagation, sample storage, or replay. Across five benchmarks, our method achieves strong predictive performance, with favorable accuracy--calibration--efficiency trade-offs in continual adaptation. On ImageNet-C, for example, GAIN achieves 61.9% accuracy with near-source calibration. It remains stable under diverse and challenging continual shifts while running 15.9x faster than a representative optimization-based CTTA baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出GAIN框架，用"历史提议、增益决策"原则做免反向传播的持续测试时自适应。
AI.motivation: 现有CTTA方法用置信度或熵评估预测可靠性，只反映模型对当前样本的自我确定性；而累积的目标观测可提供互补证据来修正源预测，但随目标分布变化，历史可能失配。核心问题不是修正与源预测差多少，而是是否应用修正、应用多强。
AI.method: GAIN维护紧凑的目标统计量形成修正提议，并构建考虑估计不确定性的后验预测评估器；由此得到的源相对增益估计提议收益，通过高效一维优化在连续路径上确定样本级干预强度；增益受控的预测在线更新目标统计量，抑制不可靠修正传播。全程无需反向传播、样本存储或回放。
AI.result: 在五个基准上取得强预测性能，在持续自适应中实现良好的准确率—校准—效率权衡。ImageNet-C上达61.9%准确率并保持近源校准；在多样且具挑战性的持续偏移下保持稳定，比代表性基于优化的CTTA基线快15.9倍。
AI.conclusion: GAIN以增益感知干预替代单纯的可靠性度量，实现免反向传播、免存储的高效CTTA，兼顾精度、校准与效率。

title: LensBridge: Frequency-Guided Compound Degradation Adaptation for Lens Aberration Correction and Veiling Glare Removal
comment: All code will be available at https://github.com/XiaolongQian/LensBridge
summary: Simplified optical systems often exhibit residual lens aberrations and Veiling Glare (VG), resulting in spatially varying blur and contrast reduction. Large-scale Lens Libraries (LensLib) enable reusable aberration correction models by covering diverse Point Spread Functions (PSFs), but their aberration-only training distribution does not include target-specific veiling glare. Extending such foundations to compound degradation is challenging because realistic target-system compound pairs are difficult to obtain. To address this challenge, we propose LensBridge, a two-stage framework that first establishes a reusable aberration correction foundation and then adapts it to compound optical degradation using only a few unpaired target observations. In Stage I, we build a PSF-aware one-step diffusion foundation by constructing discrete degradation priors from LensLib PSFs and learning to retrieve them directly from aberrated images, enabling PSF-aware correction without requiring explicit PSF at inference. In Stage II, we adapt this foundation to compound degradation through frequency-domain guidance. At the data level, Frequency-guided Degradation Completion (FDC) transfers target low-frequency characteristics to LensLib aberrated images while preserving aberration structures to synthesize compound training pairs; at the model level, Frequency-guided Pseudo Decomposition (FPD) forms aberration- and VG-dominant pseudo observations to condition separate adaptation branches. Extensive experiments across multiple optical systems demonstrate that LensBridge effectively extends reusable aberration correction foundations to joint aberration correction and veiling glare removal without target-system paired supervision. All code will be available at https://github.com/XiaolongQian/LensBridge.

AI.tldr: LensBridge 提出两阶段框架：先基于 LensLib 构建可复用的像差校正基础模型，再仅用少量非配对目标观测，通过频域引导将其适配到像差与遮挡眩光的复合退化，实现联合校正。
AI.motivation: 简化光学系统普遍存在残余镜头像差与遮挡眩光（VG），导致空间变化模糊与对比度下降。LensLib 等大规模镜头库可支撑可复用的像差校正模型，但其训练分布仅含像差、不含目标系统特有的遮挡眩光；而真实目标系统的复合退化配对数据难以获取，因此难以将既有基础模型扩展到复合退化场景。
AI.method: 两阶段框架。阶段一：构建 PSF 感知的单步扩散基础模型，从 LensLib PSF 构造离散退化先验，并学习直接从退化图像中检索该先验，从而在推理时无需显式 PSF 即可实现 PSF 感知校正。阶段二：通过频域引导适配复合退化。数据层面提出频域引导退化补全（FDC），将目标低频特性迁移至 LensLib 像差图像并保留像差结构，合成复合训练对；模型层面提出频域引导伪分解（FPD），构造以像差为主导和以 VG 为主导的伪观测，分别条件化独立适配分支。
AI.result: 在多个光学系统上的大量实验表明，LensBridge 能在无目标系统配对监督的条件下，有效将可复用像差校正基础模型扩展至像差校正与遮挡眩光去除的联合任务。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以“可复用基础模型 + 少量非配对目标观测适配”的范式，缓解了复合光学退化配对数据稀缺的问题，为简化光学系统的联合像差与眩光校正提供了可行方案，代码将开源。

title: You Only Reprogram Once: Rethinking Prolonged Training for Visual Reprogramming
summary: Visual reprogramming is a parameter-efficient method for adapting pretrained models, yet its training can remain computationally expensive: even with a frozen backbone, visual prompts are often optimized through the full model for hundreds of epochs. Before changing what the pretrained model sees, we ask whether we are fully using what it already tells us. We find that modeling the full source response can already yield strong downstream predictions without prompt optimization. Motivated by this observation, we introduce You Only Reprogram Once (YORO), which constructs a downstream predictor from the frozen response space in a single forward-only traversal. Its Bayesian Discriminant Mapping (BDM) derives a covariance-aware affine mapping from streaming class statistics, requiring no backpropagation, optimizer updates, or repeated visits to the training set. When further input adaptation helps, YORO-FP optionally refines the visual prompt for 20 epochs. BDM also extends naturally to CLIP by treating attribute-prompt similarities as source responses. Across three full-data settings, YORO improves average accuracy over the strongest prior gradient-free mapping by 18.4--24.4\%. On 16-shot CLIP, it raises the four-backbone average from 71.4\% to 77.2\%. YORO-FP provides further gains on selected tasks, while validation often retains the one-pass predictor. These results suggest a different default for visual reprogramming: read out the frozen response first, and optimize the input only when needed.

AI.tldr: 提出YORO，通过一次前向遍历从冻结响应空间构建下游预测器（BDM），无需反传与优化器即可完成视觉重编程，并给出可选的20轮提示微调版本YORO-FP。
AI.motivation: 视觉重编程虽是参数高效的自适应方法，但即便主干冻结，视觉提示仍需通过整个模型优化数百轮，训练开销大。作者质疑：在改变预训练模型"看到"什么之前，是否已充分利用模型已有的信息。研究发现，对完整源响应建模本身即可获得强下游预测，无需提示优化。
AI.method: YORO在一次仅前向的遍历中，从冻结响应空间构造下游预测器。其贝叶斯判别映射（BDM）利用流式类统计量推导协方差感知的仿射映射，无需反向传播、优化器更新或重复访问训练集。当输入自适应仍有帮助时，YORO-FP可选地对视觉提示进行20轮精修。BDM可自然扩展到CLIP，将属性-提示相似度视为源响应。
AI.result: 在三个全量数据设置下，YORO相较最强的无梯度映射方法，平均精度提升18.4%–24.4%。在16-shot CLIP上，将四种主干平均精度从71.4%提升至77.2%。YORO-FP在部分任务上带来进一步提升，而验证集上通常仍保留单次遍历预测器。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明视觉重编程应采用不同的默认范式：先读取冻结响应，仅在需要时再优化输入。

title: EgoRefine: Ego-Referenced Predictive Alignment and Trajectory-Conditioned Reliability-Aware Fusion for Asynchronous Collaborative Perception
comment: The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/godk0509/EgoRefine
summary: Collaborative perception enables connected agents to share complementary observations for 3D object detection, extending sensing range and mitigating occlusion. Under asynchronous communication, however, cooperative features arrive with temporal delay. Existing prediction-based methods compensate for these features mainly from the transmitting agent's own history, leaving residual misalignment with the ego agent's current observation; subsequent fusion also often overlooks spatial variations in alignment quality. We propose EgoRefine, an ego-referenced predictive alignment and reliability-aware fusion framework for asynchronous collaborative perception. Its Ego-referenced Predictive Alignment module uses the current ego feature to guide cooperative trajectory-field prediction and refines the sampling offsets along an ego-referenced trajectory direction. Its Trajectory-conditioned Reliability-aware Fusion module treats the trajectory discrepancy between the ego and cooperative streams and the directional refinement magnitude as alignment cues, using them to condition the relation between aligned features and adaptively reweight the two streams before convolutional fusion. Experiments on V2V4Real and DAIR-V2X-Seq show that EgoRefine outperforms TraF-Align by 1.6 and 2.9 points on average in AP@0.5 and AP@0.7, respectively. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/godk0509/EgoRefine.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoRefine框架，用自车参考的预测对齐与可靠性感知融合解决异步协同感知中的时序错位问题。
AI.motivation: 异步通信下协同特征存在时序延迟。现有基于预测的方法主要依赖发送方自身历史来补偿，与自车当前观测间仍残留错位；后续融合也常忽略对齐质量的空间差异。
AI.method: EgoRefine包含两个模块：Ego-referenced Predictive Alignment用当前自车特征引导协同轨迹场预测，并沿自车参考的轨迹方向细化采样偏移；Trajectory-conditioned Reliability-aware Fusion以自车与协同流的轨迹差异和方向细化幅度作为对齐线索，用于约束对齐特征间的关系，并在卷积融合前自适应重加权两路特征。
AI.result: 在V2V4Real和DAIR-V2X-Seq数据集上，EgoRefine在AP@0.5和AP@0.7上平均分别超过TraF-Align 1.6和2.9个点。
AI.conclusion: 以自车当前观测为参考进行协同特征预测对齐，并将对齐可靠性显式用于融合加权，可有效缓解异步通信下的时空错位，提升3D目标检测性能。代码将开源。

title: Refusal Localizes, the Damage Relocates: Safety Layers Under Few-Sample Fine-Tuning
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures, 21 tables. Jungseob Lee and Dongyub Jude Lee contributed equally
summary: Fine-tuning adapts aligned large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but a few dozen harmful examples can remove their refusal of harmful requests. Prior work localizes safety-related behavior to specific layers, directions, and tokens, suggesting targets for protection. We test whether successful localization and recovery support defenses that survive changes in the attack. Across six checkpoints from four model families, harmful and benign prompts remain linearly separable after attack, and patching full clean hidden states into the compromised model restores refusal at a reproducible transition depth. Building on a prior layer-freezing defense, we freeze every layer up to this depth and repeat the attack. At a hundred harmful examples, refusal remains near zero on all six checkpoints, with recovery transitions above the frozen boundary. In a second study, removing the update's top two singular directions restores refusal after short attention-only fine-tunes on four checkpoints. On Llama-3.1-8B, ordinary training changes weaken this repair and an attacker who spreads the update defeats it. A spectral detector calibrated on benign Llama fine-tunes misses most repair failures on that checkpoint. Localized freezing can nevertheless help preserve refusal when a few harmful examples enter training data unintentionally. These results show that an attacker can bypass a region identified by recovery and defeat a repair that works across multiple checkpoints, motivating five checks for defenses against adaptive fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/refusal-relocates.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验了"安全行为定位+修复"能否构成抵御微调攻击的鲁棒防御，发现攻击者可通过转移更新绕过定位区域、击败在多checkpoint上有效的修复，并提出五项防御评估检查。
AI.motivation: 先前工作将LLM的安全相关行为定位到特定层、方向和token，暗示可据此设计防护。但作者质疑：成功的定位与修复是否能在攻击发生变化时依然有效，即这类防御能否抵御自适应攻击。
AI.method: 在4个模型家族、6个checkpoint上，先用少量有害样本攻击LLM，测试有害与良性prompt是否线性可分，并将干净隐状态patch回受损模型以定位恢复拒绝的过渡深度；在此基础上冻结该深度以内所有层并重复攻击。第二项研究移除更新矩阵的前两个奇异方向以修复短期仅注意力微调。在Llama-3.1-8B上进一步测试普通训练扰动、攻击者分散更新以及基于良性微调校准的谱检测器。
AI.result: 攻击后有害与良性prompt仍线性可分；patch完整干净隐状态可在可复现的过渡深度恢复拒绝。但在100个有害样本下，冻结层防御在全部6个checkpoint上拒绝率仍接近零，恢复过渡出现在冻结边界之上。移除前两奇异方向可在4个checkpoint的短期仅注意力微调后恢复拒绝，但普通训练变化会削弱该修复，分散更新的攻击者可使其失效；谱检测器在该checkpoint上漏检多数修复失败。
AI.conclusion: 当少量有害样本意外进入训练数据时，局部化冻结仍有助于保留拒绝行为。但总体而言，攻击者能绕过由恢复定位的区域，并击败跨多checkpoint有效的修复，说明此类防御面对自适应微调尚不鲁棒，需进行五项防御检查。

title: CAST: Cost-Aware Speculative Trees from One-Pass Block Drafters
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting future tokens cheaply and verifying them with the target model in parallel. Block drafters score a whole block of future tokens in one forward pass, yet standard decoding verifies only the top-scoring chain and discards the other candidates. Because these candidates are already scored, verifying more of them adds target computation but no extra drafting. We introduce CAST (Cost-Aware Speculative Trees), which packs these candidates into a tree and verifies it in a single target pass, leaving the target model, drafter weights, and decoding rule untouched. To decide how wide the tree should be, CAST adds candidates while the expected gain from the next one outweighs the verification time it adds. The width therefore adapts to each deployment from a latency measurement, without sweeping over widths. We evaluate CAST across five domains on three GPU generations and two model families. At its predicted width, CAST is faster than the standard chain in all eight settings, by up to 43%. We also find that the best width depends strongly on the deployment. Where verification cost jumps at a kernel boundary, a 128-token tree is only 2% faster than the standard chain, whereas the tree at the predicted width is 20% faster. Furthermore, we prove that CAST leaves the target output distribution unchanged under both greedy and sampled decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/CAST.

AI.tldr: CAST 将块式草稿器产生的候选 token 打包成树，一次目标前向并行验证，并按验证耗时自适应选择树宽，在 8 个配置下均比标准链式投机解码更快（最高 43%），且不改变目标输出分布。
AI.motivation: 块式草稿器一次前向即可为整块未来 token 打分，但标准投机解码只验证得分最高的单条链，丢弃了其余已打分的候选；验证这些候选只增加目标计算，不需额外草稿开销，存在被浪费的加速机会。同时，最优验证宽度高度依赖具体部署（如 kernel 边界处验证成本跃升），需要自适应而非人工扫参。
AI.method: 提出 CAST（Cost-Aware Speculative Trees）：将块草稿器的候选 token 组织为树，在单次目标前向中一并验证，不修改目标模型、草稿器权重与解码规则；宽度决策采用成本感知准则，当新增候选带来的期望收益大于其增加的验证时间时继续加宽，从而仅凭一次延迟测量即可按部署自适应确定宽度。
AI.result: 在三个 GPU 代际、两个模型家族、五个领域共 8 个设置中，CAST 在预测宽度下均快于标准链式解码，最高提升 43%；宽度选择对部署敏感——在验证成本因 kernel 边界跃升的场景中，128-token 树仅比标准链快 2%，而预测宽度下可达 20%。理论上证明在贪心与采样解码下均保持目标输出分布不变。
AI.conclusion: CAST 表明块草稿器的候选可低成本复用于树式验证，且验证宽度应由部署相关的收益-成本权衡自动决定而非全局固定；该方法在不损失输出正确性的前提下带来稳健且显著的推理加速。

title: Gödel Forest: Balancing Search Depth and Breadth for Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to achieve compounding gains by having models improve themselves. While most existing RSI systems optimize external agent harnesses or prompts around a frozen base model, data-centric RSI directly updates the model's own parameters by training on agent-generated data. However, because validating data strategies requires expensive model training, existing methods face a fundamental dilemma: a single agent gets trapped in narrow directions and lacks exploration breadth, while naive parallel search or heavy trace sharing sacrifices long-horizon search depth. To address this challenge, we introduce G"odel Forest, a multi-agent framework that organizes recursive self-improvement as an ensemble of co-evolving search trees. In G"odel Forest, each agent autonomously grows a persistent tree, deepening, branching, or pruning data strategies based on model feedback to secure depth, while parallel trees explore distinct regions of the data space to expand breadth. Crucially, rather than leaving trees isolated or flooding them with heavy execution logs, a dynamically co-evolving memory connects the forest: agents continuously distill their successes and failures into compact procedural lessons anchored to a global leaderboard. Through this forest ecosystem, a dead-end in one tree instantly warns the whole forest against unpromising paths, while an empirical breakthrough quickly seeds new exploration branches in neighboring trees. Evaluated on RSIBench-Data across six diverse domains, G"odel Forest outperforms the single-agent baseline by an average of 10.70% while reducing wall-clock time on five tasks. Ablations confirm that co-evolving shared memory yields a +7.00% gain over independent parallel search, demonstrating that collective distillation is key to scalable self-improvement. The code is available at https://github.com/evolvent-ai/Godel-Forest.

AI.tldr: 提出 G\"odel Forest 多智能体框架，将数据中心的递归自我改进（RSI）组织为协同演化的搜索树森林，以兼顾搜索深度与广度。
AI.motivation: 现有数据中心的 RSI 方法面临两难：单一智能体易陷入狭窄方向、缺乏探索广度；而简单的并行搜索或大量轨迹共享又会牺牲长程搜索深度。此外，验证数据策略需昂贵的模型训练成本。
AI.method: 将 RSI 构建为多个协同演化搜索树的集成。每个智能体自主生长一棵持久树，依据模型反馈对数据策略进行加深、分支或剪枝以保证深度；并行树探索数据空间的不同区域以扩展广度。通过动态协同演化记忆连接森林，智能体将成功与失败蒸馏为紧凑的程序性经验并锚定到全局排行榜，实现死胡同的快速预警与突破的跨树扩散。
AI.result: 在 RSIBench-Data 六个领域上，G\"odel Forest 较单智能体基线平均提升 10.70%，并在五项任务上减少墙钟时间。消融实验表明，协同演化共享记忆相比独立并行搜索带来 +7.00% 增益。
AI.conclusion: 集体蒸馏是可扩展自我改进的关键，G\"odel Forest 证明了协同演化森林结构在深度与广度上的有效性。代码已开源。

title: ReWorld-Track: A Recursive Event World Model for Language-Guided Multi-Camera Tracking
comment: 41 pages, 8 figures. Corrected an author name; scientific content unchanged
summary: Language-guided multi-camera tracking must preserve a target identity across unobserved gaps, where similar candidates and uncertain returns can make early associations unreliable. A wrong match can corrupt the history used to predict later observations and propagate identity errors across subsequent camera handoffs. We propose ReWorld-Track, a recursive event world model that carries association uncertainty into future predictions. Candidate matches and continued waiting define alternative target states, whose posterior probabilities are used to update a persistent recurrent belief. This representation preserves uncertainty about alternative trajectories through successive observations. This belief predicts the next camera, arrival time, and entry region, while appearance and language evidence guide association. By training across successive handoffs, the model learns to retain uncertainty that remains useful for later predictions and identity decisions. ReWorld-Track achieves HOTA scores of 65.19 on CityFlowV2 and 45.36 on MTMMC, with improved identity continuity across repeated handoffs. On MTMMC, its structured posterior update gains 0.50 HOTA points over a similarly sized generic updater and 0.94 points over fixed-moment soft association, raising next-camera accuracy from 86.03% to 87.41% and reducing median arrival-time error from 0.78 s to 0.71 s for subsequent target returns.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReWorld-Track，一种递归事件世界模型，将关联不确定性保留在持续更新的循环信念中，用于语言引导的多摄像头目标跟踪，在 CityFlowV2 与 MTMMC 上取得领先 HOTA，并改善跨摄像头身份连续性。
AI.motivation: 语言引导的多摄像头跟踪需在目标未被观测的间隙中保持身份一致；相似候选与不确定回归易导致早期关联出错，错误匹配会污染用于预测后续观测的历史，并在后续摄像头交接中传播身份错误。
AI.method: 将候选匹配与继续等待定义为备选目标状态，用其后验概率更新持久的循环信念，从而在连续观测中保留对备选轨迹的不确定性；该信念预测下一摄像头、到达时间与进入区域，外观与语言证据用于引导关联；通过在连续交接上训练，学习保留对后续预测与身份决策仍有用的不确定性。
AI.result: 在 CityFlowV2 上 HOTA 为 65.19，在 MTMMC 上为 45.36，跨重复交接的身份连续性提升。在 MTMMC 上，结构化后验更新比同等规模的通用更新器高 0.50 HOTA，比固定时刻软关联高 0.94 HOTA；下一摄像头准确率由 86.03% 提升至 87.41%，后续目标回归的到达时间中位误差由 0.78 s 降至 0.71 s。
AI.conclusion: 通过将关联不确定性显式递归建模并跨交接训练，可有效抑制身份误差传播，提升多摄像头跟踪的预测精度与身份持续性。

title: Reprogramming Vision-Language Models via Structured Prompt Reparameterization
summary: Visual reprogramming adapts pretrained models to downstream tasks by modifying their input and output interfaces while keeping the backbone fixed. In vision-language models, existing methods mainly rely on intra-class prompt aggregation and do not explicitly model relationships among classes. However, fine-grained categories often exhibit highly overlapping attribute descriptions and strong inter-class correlation in the text embedding space, where discriminative cues lie in subtle low-variance components. We propose Reparameterized Inter-Class Visual Reprogramming (RVP), a structured framework that aggregates multiple text prompts within each class and applies residual correction across classes. We also show that CLIP-based visual reprogramming with input-independent linear output aggregation can be expressed as a linear mapping from frozen image embeddings to downstream logits, and use this view to design a structured reparameterization that models shared semantic components and class-specific differences. RVP uses only a single visual prompt and can be reparameterized at inference into a frozen backbone followed by a linear classifier, incurring nearly zero computational overhead. Across 11 few-shot classification benchmarks and four CLIP backbones, RVP consistently improves over prior visual reprogramming methods with comparable or better inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RVP（重参数化类间视觉重编程）框架，通过在类内聚合多个文本提示并在类间进行残差修正，将CLIP视觉重编程建模为冻结图像嵌入到下游logits的线性映射，以极低计算开销提升少样本分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型的视觉重编程方法主要依赖类内提示聚合，未显式建模类间关系。而细粒度类别在文本嵌入空间中常具有高度重叠的属性描述与强类间相关性，判别性线索藏在细微的低方差分量中，因此需要显式建模类间结构。
AI.method: 提出RVP框架：在每个类内聚合多个文本提示，并在类间施加残差修正；证明具有输入无关线性输出聚合的CLIP视觉重编程可表达为从冻结图像嵌入到下游logits的线性映射；据此设计结构化重参数化，建模共享语义分量与类间差异；RVP仅用单一视觉提示，推理时可重参数化为冻结骨干加线性分类器。
AI.result: 在11个少样本分类基准和4种CLIP骨干上，RVP一致优于先前的视觉重编程方法，且推理效率相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: RVP通过显式建模类间关系与结构化重参数化，在几乎零额外计算开销下有效提升少样本视觉重编程性能，兼顾精度与效率。

title: MARCO: Multi-Round Agentic Reinforcement for Conditional Molecular Optimization
summary: Molecular optimization is inherently iterative: a candidate is proposed, evaluated against several objectives, and revised while preserving a relationship to the source molecule. Most instruction-following models instead emit one edited molecule, forcing validity, property improvement, and similarity control into a single response. We introduce MARCO, an evaluator-grounded reinforcement-learning framework that trains molecular editors on bounded proposal--feedback--revision trajectories. MARCO aggregates shaped turn rewards into an undiscounted trajectory return for group-relative policy optimization. We evaluate two consequences of this training: Same-1 tests the trained policy under a one-response budget, while Same-5 tests whether the same policy can use verifier feedback when up to five responses are available. Across the three-objective MuMOInstruct benchmark, three Qwen backbones, and seen/unseen instruction splits, SFT-initialized MARCO obtains the highest product of property success rate and similarity in every reported primary setting. Same-5 further improves the observed score under the tested budget, while four-objective and public-checkpoint experiments test transfer across constraint sets and initialization regimes.

AI.tldr: MARCO 是一个基于评估器反馈的强化学习框架，将分子编辑建模为有界的"提议—反馈—修正"轨迹，在 MuMOInstruct 三目标基准上取得最优的性质成功率与相似度乘积。
AI.motivation: 分子优化本质上是迭代过程：提出候选分子、针对多个目标进行评估、并在保持与源分子关系的前提下进行修正。然而多数指令跟随模型只输出一次编辑结果，将有效性、性质提升与相似度控制强行压缩到单一响应中，缺乏利用反馈迭代修正的能力。
AI.method: 提出 MARCO——一个以评估器为依托的强化学习框架，在有界的提议—反馈—修正轨迹上训练分子编辑器。该框架将每轮经过塑形的奖励聚合为无折扣的轨迹回报，用于组相对策略优化（group-relative policy optimization）。评测通过 Same-1（单次响应预算）与 Same-5（最多五次响应并可利用验证器反馈）两种设置，考察同一策略的两种行为后果。
AI.result: 在 MuMOInstruct 三目标基准、三个 Qwen 主干模型以及已见/未见指令划分下，经 SFT 初始化的 MARCO 在所有报告的主要设置中均取得最高的"性质成功率 × 相似度"乘积。Same-5 在给定预算下进一步提升观测得分；四目标实验与公开检查点实验检验了跨约束集与不同初始化方式的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 将分子编辑显式建模为可迭代的提议—反馈—修正轨迹，并用轨迹级组相对策略优化训练，能有效兼顾性质提升与相似度保持，且策略可复用验证器反馈在多轮预算下持续改进，并具备跨约束集与初始化方式的迁移潜力。

title: ProgressCompass: Embodied Progress Reward Models Are Lost Without the Right Context
summary: Embodied agents now take on ever longer tasks. For long tasks, knowing only whether a task finally succeeds or fails says little; the steps along the way matter. Progress Reward Models (PRMs) score how far a task has come at every step, and serve as dense rewards, verifiers and monitors. Yet in long tasks the current frame alone often cannot tell how far the task has come, because progress depends on what happened before. We call this problem context-dependent progress estimation. Existing benchmarks on progress estimation mostly focus on short tasks whose progress can be read from the current observation, and whether PRMs can estimate progress when context is needed remains underexplored. We therefore build ContextProgress-Bench, with 24 manipulation tasks for 120 episodes. The benchmark covers three settings: (i) State Recall, where information needed for progress appeared earlier but is not in the current frame; (ii) Sequence Tracking, where steps follow a fixed order, so progress requires knowing which steps are done and which comes next; and (iii) Recurrence Disambiguation, where look-alike frames sit at very different progress. We then run a paired diagnosis: each PRM keeps the same input format in both runs, and in one run its instruction integrates the right context. Even PRMs that read the entire history get lost in estimating progress, yet with the right context the same five models cut their progress error by 77-82%. Embodied PRMs are thus not incapable of progress estimation, but lost without the right context. We therefore propose ProgressCompass, an autonomous agentic loop that reorients an existing PRM and uses current general-purpose VLMs to supply the context the PRM needs. Wrapped in the loop, the same frozen PRM cuts its progress error by 63% and raises its rank agreement by 76%. With such a compass, PRMs estimate progress far better on longer, more complex tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ContextProgress-Bench 基准与 ProgressCompass 智能体循环，揭示进度奖励模型（PRM）在长任务中因缺乏上下文而失效，并通过外部提供上下文将其进度估计误差降低约63%-82%。
AI.motivation: 长任务中仅凭最终成败无法反映过程质量，PRM 可提供稠密奖励、验证与监控功能。但现有进度估计基准多聚焦可仅凭当前观测判断的短任务，存在"上下文依赖的进度估计"问题未被充分探索，即进度依赖历史信息而当前帧无法体现。
AI.method: 构建 ContextProgress-Bench，包含 24 个操作任务、120 个回合，覆盖三种设置：State Recall（所需信息出现在早期帧）、Sequence Tracking（步骤顺序固定，需判断已完成与下一步）、Recurrence Disambiguation（相似帧对应差异极大的进度）。随后设计配对诊断实验：同一 PRM 两次运行输入格式一致，仅一次在指令中整合正确上下文。基于此提出 ProgressCompass，一个自主智能体循环，重新定向现有 PRM，并调用通用 VLM 提供其所需上下文。
AI.result: 即使读取完整历史的 PRM 也难以准确估计进度；但在给定正确上下文后，五个模型的进度误差降低 77%-82%。在 ProgressCompass 循环中，同一冻结 PRM 的进度误差降低 63%，排名一致性提升 76%。
AI.conclusion: PRM 并非不具备进度估计能力，而是缺少正确上下文而失效；通过智能体循环借助通用 VLM 补充上下文，可使冻结 PRM 在更长、更复杂任务上显著提升进度估计性能。

title: When Semantics Matter: Reliability-Aware Semantic-Rhythm Control for Co-Speech Gesture Generation
summary: Co-speech gesture generation aims to synthesize natural gestures that are both temporally synchronized with speech and semantically consistent with the spoken content. Although recent methods can generate rhythmically plausible motions, they often rely heavily on acoustic prosody while underutilizing textual semantics, especially when semantic annotations are incomplete, noisy, or unavailable. Consequently, the generated gestures may follow speech rhythm while failing to express the intended semantics. To address this problem, we propose a reliability-aware semantic-rhythm control framework for co-speech gesture generation. We first learn a discrete motion prior that represents continuous gestures in a compact and structured motion-code space. We then introduce a dual-branch semantic contribution estimation mechanism consisting of a full multimodal branch and an audio-only branch. Their distributional discrepancy is formulated as conditional information gain to quantify how much textual semantics changes the predicted motion. Based on this estimate, a controllable semantic-rhythm objective selectively strengthens semantic guidance in content-relevant segments while limiting unnecessary semantic intervention in rhythm-dominant segments. Furthermore, we treat background noise as an acoustic reliability condition and introduce noise-conditioned feature modulation together with beneficial latent perturbation to improve generation robustness under realistic acoustic environments. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves a favorable balance among semantic expressiveness, rhythmic synchronization, motion diversity, and robustness, enabling reliable and controllable co-speech gesture generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出可靠性感知的语义-节奏控制框架，用于语音伴随手势生成，通过离散运动先验与双分支语义贡献估计实现语义与节奏的平衡控制。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多依赖声学韵律而忽视文本语义，尤其在语义标注不完整、含噪或缺失时，生成手势虽节奏合理但语义表达不足，因此需要一种能可靠平衡语义与节奏的控制机制。
AI.method: 首先学习离散运动先验，将连续手势表示在紧凑结构化的运动码空间；其次设计双分支语义贡献估计机制（全多模态分支与纯音频分支），用其分布差异作为条件信息增益来量化文本语义对预测运动的影响；据此构造可控语义-节奏目标，在内容相关片段增强语义引导、在节奏主导片段抑制语义干预；并将背景噪声视为声学可靠性条件，引入噪声条件特征调制与有益潜在扰动。
AI.result: 基准数据集实验表明，该框架在语义表达力、节奏同步性、运动多样性与鲁棒性之间取得良好平衡，实现了可靠且可控的语音伴随手势生成。
AI.conclusion: 通过可靠性感知的语义-节奏控制，结合条件信息增益估计与噪声鲁棒建模，可有效缓解语义利用不足与声学环境干扰问题，提升手势生成的语义一致性与可控性。

title: CHAIN: Calibrated LLM Forecasting via Causal-Temporal Hypergraph Inference
summary: Large language models have achieved significant progress in event forecasting, yet their probability outputs exhibit systematic calibration bias that varies heterogeneously across different domains and question types, undermining the trustworthiness of probabilistic outputs for decision-making under uncertainty. However, existing calibration methods typically correct probability outputs after prediction is complete, without modeling the structural sources of bias within the prediction process itself. To address this challenge, we decompose probabilistic prediction over causal-temporal hypergraphs into three stages, evidence weighting, evidence aggregation, and source fusion, and propose CHAIN, which designs stage-specific mechanisms to mitigate bias at each stage: (i) modulating the temporal decay function by causal topological distance, (ii) aggregating approximately independent causal chains via Noisy-OR after direction-aware deduplication, and (iii) driving adaptive fusion by causal coverage and directional balance. Experimental results on cross-domain forecasting benchmarks show CHAIN outperforms existing methods in expected calibration error, Brier score, and accuracy. Our project is available at https://github.com/QwenQKing/Chain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CHAIN，将因果-时序超图上的概率预测分解为证据加权、证据聚合与信源融合三阶段，并在各阶段设计针对性机制缓解校准偏差，在跨领域事件预测基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在事件预测中虽取得进展，但其概率输出存在系统性校准偏差，且该偏差在不同领域和问题类型间呈异质性，削弱了不确定性决策下概率输出的可信度。现有校准方法通常在预测完成后才修正概率，未建模预测过程内部的结构性偏差来源。
AI.method: 将因果-时序超图上的概率预测分解为证据加权、证据聚合、信源融合三阶段，并提出CHAIN，为每个阶段设计特定机制以缓解偏差：（i）用因果拓扑距离调制时间衰减函数；（ii）在方向感知去重后通过Noisy-OR聚合近似独立的因果链；（iii）由因果覆盖度与方向平衡驱动自适应融合。
AI.result: 在跨领域预测基准上，CHAIN在期望校准误差、Brier分数和准确率方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过在预测过程内部的三阶段结构上建模并缓解偏差，CHAIN有效提升了概率预测的校准质量与准确性，代码已开源。

title: Video2Skill: From Streaming Experience to Reusable Embodied Skills
summary: Manipulation behaviors vary widely across objects and scenes, but they share a small set of reusable skills, and planning with these skills helps embodied agents generalize to new tasks. Yet an agent can only plan with skills it knows. Recovering skills from observed experience, the inverse of planning, builds this knowledge over time and yields skill data for training future agents. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) describe individual manipulation events well, but can they organize a stream of events into reusable skills? We formulate this problem as Streaming Embodied Skill Discovery (SESD): a model watches videos in sequence and maintains a persistent skill library that shapes its later decisions. To systematically measure this ability, we introduce Video2Skill, a benchmark that covers robot tabletop manipulation and human kitchen activity and tests three core capabilities: (i) locating manipulation events in time, (ii) grouping events of the same transformation, and (iii) deciding when to reuse an existing skill or create a new one. Across 19 open-source VLMs, many models group events at near-chance level, and scale does not consistently help. Their errors depend on how perception and library updates are coupled: joint models merge distinct transformations into one skill, while models that update the library from text descriptions duplicate recurring ones. Supervised fine-tuning, including our counterfactual library-state rebalancing (CLaRe), improves grouping but exposes a deeper bottleneck: trained models consolidate familiar skills yet rarely expand the library. Their libraries stall below half the reference size, and transformations unseen in training are located in time but almost never given a new skill. Recognizing when existing skills are insufficient thus emerges as the central challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文将"从视频流中持续发现可复用操作技能"形式化为Streaming Embodied Skill Discovery (SESD)，并提出Video2Skill基准（覆盖机器人桌面操作与人类厨房活动）评估三项能力：事件时间定位、同一变换事件分组、复用/新建技能决策。测试19个开源VLM发现多数模型分组接近随机水平，规模无稳定增益；监督微调（含CLaRe）改善分组但暴露核心瓶颈——模型会整合熟悉技能却极少扩展技能库，库规模不足参考值一半，未见过的变换几乎从不被赋予新技能。
AI.motivation: 操作行为在物体与场景间差异很大，但可归结为少量可复用技能，用技能规划能帮助具身智能体泛化到新任务；然而智能体只能规划其已知技能，因此需要从观察经验中反推技能（规划之逆），持续积累技能知识并为未来智能体提供训练数据。VLM虽能描述单次操作事件，但能否把事件流组织为可复用技能尚不明确，且缺乏系统评测手段。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为SESD：模型按序列观看视频，并维护一个持续存在、会影响其后续决策的技能库。构建Video2Skill基准，涵盖机器人桌面操作与人类厨房活动，测试三项核心能力：(i)在时间上定位操作事件；(ii)将同一变换的事件分组；(iii)判断何时复用已有技能或创建新技能。评测19个开源VLM，并采用监督微调及反事实技能库状态重平衡（CLaRe）。
AI.result: 19个开源VLM中许多模型的事件分组接近随机水平，且模型规模并不稳定带来提升。错误模式取决于感知与技能库更新的耦合方式：联合模型会把不同变换合并为同一技能，而从文本描述更新技能库的模型会重复生成已出现的技能。监督微调（含CLaRe）能改善分组，但暴露更深层瓶颈：训练后的模型能整合熟悉技能，却很少扩展技能库，库规模停滞在参考规模的一半以下；训练中未见过的变换虽能被时间定位，却几乎从不被赋予新技能。
AI.conclusion: 识别"现有技能何时不足"成为该问题的核心挑战；模型具备事件感知与熟悉技能整合能力，但缺乏对新变换主动创建新技能的机制，导致技能库难以持续扩张与覆盖。

title: AESplat: Advancing Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting via Decoupled Appearance Modeling
summary: Pose-free feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated remarkable potential for generalized novel view synthesis. However, existing methods typically predict Gaussian appearance attributes represented by spherical harmonics (SH) in the same manner, overlooking the fundamental distinction between view-independent and view-dependent appearance, which results in suboptimal rendering quality. In this paper, we present AESplat, a novel and general framework for pose-free feed-forward 3DGS that introduces an effective decoupled appearance modeling strategy based on an analysis of SH, enabling higher-quality rendering. Specifically, AESplat directly derives the zeroth-order SH coefficient, which represents the base view-independent appearance component, from the input images without training. The higher-order SH coefficients are subsequently predicted by a shallow multilayer perceptron equipped with two efficient 3D-aware inductive biases to model view-dependent appearance variations. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, achieving a $0.8$ dB improvement in PSNR over the pose-free method NAS3R and a $1.1$ dB improvement over the pose-required method DepthSplat on the RealEstate10K dataset. Project page: https://aesplat.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AESplat，一种无需位姿的前馈 3D 高斯泼溅框架，通过解耦外观建模策略分别处理视角无关与视角相关外观，显著提升新视角合成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有无需位姿的前馈 3DGS 方法普遍以相同方式预测球谐（SH）表示的高斯外观属性，忽视了视角无关外观与视角相关外观的本质区别，导致渲染质量欠佳。
AI.method: 基于对 SH 的分析，提出解耦外观建模策略：直接从输入图像无训练地推导表示基础视角无关外观的零阶 SH 系数；高阶 SH 系数则由浅层 MLP 预测，该 MLP 配备两种高效的 3D 感知归纳偏置，以建模视角相关的外观变化。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法显著优于现有最先进方法：在 RealEstate10K 数据集上，较无需位姿方法 NAS3R 提升 0.8 dB PSNR，较需要位姿方法 DepthSplat 提升 1.1 dB PSNR。
AI.conclusion: 通过分析 SH 并解耦视角无关与视角相关外观建模，AESplat 作为一种通用且有效的无需位姿前馈 3DGS 框架，能够显著提升渲染质量并超越现有最先进方法。

title: Lost in Conversation or Lost in Translation? Diagnosing Multi-Turn Degradation in RAG
summary: When conversing with large language models (LLMs), users often begin with a simple question and build towards a multi-hop question through follow-up turns. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and its graph-based variant (GraphRAG) have become the dominant approaches for grounding LLM responses in external evidence, yet both are evaluated almost exclusively on single-turn, fully specified queries. We systematically investigate this evaluation mismatch through a large-scale simulation study. Building on prior work on multi-turn LLM evaluation, we transform questions from multi-hop question answering (QA) benchmarks into underspecified conversations and evaluate ten LLM assistants with eight retrieval systems across 1.5 million simulated conversations. Our findings reveal that multi-turn interaction causes widespread performance degradation, incurring relative performance drops of up to 21% and increasing unreliability by 47%, making RAG systems simultaneously less accurate and less reliable. We identify two distinct failure modes behind this degradation. Systems are either lost in translation, where conversational rephrasing distorts the retrieval query, or lost in conversation, where retrieval succeeds but the LLM fails to synthesize evidence distributed across turns.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过150万次模拟多轮对话，系统考察了RAG与GraphRAG在多轮欠规范问答场景下的表现，发现多轮交互会导致性能相对下降最高21%、不可靠性上升47%，并归纳出"翻译失真"与"对话迷失"两种失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG与GraphRAG几乎只在单轮、语义完整的查询上进行评估，而真实用户往往从简单问题出发、通过多轮追问逐步构建多跳问题，这种评估范式与实际使用场景存在系统性错配，亟需大规模实证检验。
AI.method: 基于既有单轮评估工作，将多跳问答基准中的问题转化为欠规范的多轮对话，构建包含10个LLM助手与8种检索系统的实验矩阵，共模拟150万次对话，对比单轮与多轮条件下的性能与可靠性指标。
AI.result: 多轮交互引发普遍的性能退化，相对性能下降最高达21%，不可靠性增加47%，使RAG系统同时变得更不准确、更不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 多轮场景暴露了RAG评估与实践之间的关键鸿沟；失败可归为两类机制——"翻译失真"（对话改写扭曲检索查询）与"对话迷失"（检索成功但LLM无法综合跨轮分布的证据），提示未来需针对多轮交互设计检索与证据整合策略。

title: Quantum Fidelity Landscape-Guided Prior Calibration for Single-Circuit QGAN Image Generation
summary: Quantum Generative Adversarial Networks (QGANs) have emerged as representative generative models in the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era and have attracted increasing attention in quantum machine learning. However, most existing QGAN methods rely on patch-based decomposition strategies, which weaken the global consistency of generated images and increase quantum resource overhead. In this work, we investigate a simpler approach: pixel-level, end-to-end image generation using a single-quantum-circuit QGAN. By analyzing the structural matching relationship between the quantum prior and the target data distribution in Hilbert space, we provide a new theoretical perspective for understanding the training behavior of naive end-to-end QGANs. Specifically, we introduce the Quantum Fidelity Landscape (QFL), defined as the pairwise-fidelity structure induced by an ensemble of quantum states and preserved under shared unitary transformations of the quantum generation process. We show that, under a fixed Lipschitz readout, this invariant imposes a one-sided bound on decoded sample separation, motivating calibration of the prior-induced QFL before adversarial training. To validate this theoretical insight, we propose BasicQGAN, a QGAN framework incorporating quantum prior calibration. Before adversarial optimization, BasicQGAN aligns the prior-induced QFL with the data-induced QFL. Experimental results on small-scale grayscale image datasets show that BasicQGAN achieves stable and effective end-to-end pixel-level image generation while requiring fewer qubits and trainable parameters than representative patch-based quantum generators. Furthermore, experiments with different initial quantum-state ensembles show that QFL-calibrated ensembles achieve better generative performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BasicQGAN，通过量子先验校准实现单量子电路的像素级端到端QGAN图像生成，在减少量子比特和参数的同时保证生成稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有QGAN多采用分块（patch-based）分解策略，削弱了生成图像的全局一致性，并增加量子资源开销，因此需要探索更简洁的像素级端到端生成方法。
AI.method: 引入量子保真度景观（QFL），即由量子态集合诱导、在量子生成过程共享酉变换下保持不变的两两保真度结构；在固定Lipschitz读出下证明该不变量对解码样本分离施加单侧界，从而提出BasicQGAN框架，在对抗训练前将先验诱导的QFL与数据诱导的QFL对齐。
AI.result: 在小规模灰度图像数据集上，BasicQGAN实现了稳定有效的端到端像素级生成，所需量子比特和可训练参数少于代表性分块量子生成器；不同初始量子态集合实验表明，经QFL校准的集合生成性能更好。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为朴素端到端QGAN的训练行为提供了新理论视角，并验证了量子先验校准对提升生成性能的有效性。

title: LAURA: Knowledge Distillation for Interpretable Ambiguous Clause Identification in Legal Contracts
summary: Legal contracts contain ambiguities that expose enterprises to financial and legal risks. Some ambiguities allow flexible interpretation without triggering disputes, while others lead to significant legal conflicts. This makes identification alone insufficient, and interpretable rationale analysis essential. We propose LAURA, a post-training framework for interpretable ambiguous clause identification. LAURA leverages knowledge distillation with an IRAC-Unlearning prompting technique to transfer knowledge from a teacher LLM to an open-weight student model (<=1B parameters), which is then trained using a joint objective combining classification and rationale generation losses. The framework supports both legal and non-legal stakeholders in making informed decisions about which ambiguities require further attention. Extensive experiments across 7 baselines and 7 open-weight models demonstrate that LAURA with Flan-T5 (250M) delivers state-of-the-art interpretability over all interpretable baselines while matching the identification performance of the best-performing opaque baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LAURA，一个用于可解释歧义条款识别的后训练框架。它利用知识蒸馏与IRAC-Unlearning提示技术，将教师LLM知识迁移到≤1B参数的开源学生模型，并通过分类与理由生成的联合目标训练，在保持最优识别性能的同时实现领先的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 法律合同中的歧义会使企业面临财务与法律风险。但并非所有歧义都会引发争议——有些可灵活解释而无纠纷，有些则导致重大法律冲突。因此仅靠"识别歧义"不够，还需可解释的理由分析来支撑决策。
AI.method: 提出LAURA后训练框架：1）采用知识蒸馏，配合IRAC-Unlearning提示技术，将教师LLM知识迁移至≤1B参数的开源学生模型；2）使用分类损失与理由生成损失的联合目标进行训练；3）框架同时服务于法律与非法律利益相关者。
AI.result: 在7个基线和7个开源权重模型上进行大量实验。LAURA搭配Flan-T5（250M）在所有可解释基线中取得最优可解释性，同时识别性能与表现最佳的不透明基线相当。
AI.conclusion: LAURA证明小型开源模型（≤1B）可兼顾高性能歧义识别与可解释性，帮助利益相关者判断哪些歧义需进一步关注，具有实际应用价值。

title: ATTUNER: Recomputation-Free KV Cache Reuse via Query-Side Adaptation
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents repeatedly load reusable content, such as skills, documents, and memory entries, into the current context. Re-encoding this content for every request wastes computation. Position-independent caching (PIC) alleviates this by encoding each artifact independently and reusing its key-value (KV) states at arbitrary positions, but it incurs a quality loss relative to full-context prefill. Existing methods repair this loss by restoring global position IDs or recomputing selected tokens. In this work, we isolate the source of the loss, finding that the positional mismatch has minor effect, and independently cached artifacts retain faithful representations: reading a provided artifact stays largely accurate, and performance degrades only when the model must select among multiple artifacts. Moreover, replacing PIC's attention scores with full-prefill scores recovers performance with the cached KV unchanged, localizing the failure to the attention rather than KV recomputation. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{Attuner}, a query-side adaptation method that learns to read a frozen artifact cache. \textsc{Attuner} inserts low-rank adapters into the query projections and is trained by distilling full-prefill distribution into the student. It trains fewer than 0.05\% of the model parameters and, at inference, requires neither cache recomputation nor a full-context reference. On Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across seven benchmarks covering skills, documents, memory, and code, \textsc{Attuner} substantially outperforms prior PIC baselines in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, matches full-context prefill quality while providing up to $3.73\times$ speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文定位了位置无关缓存(PIC)相对全上下文预填充的质量损失来源——问题在于注意力而非KV重算，据此提出Attuner，仅训练查询投影上的低秩适配器来学习读取冻结的工件缓存，显著优于先前PIC基线并在匹配全上下文质量的同时提供最高3.73倍加速。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体需反复加载技能、文档、记忆等可复用内容，每次请求都重新编码浪费算力。位置无关缓存(PIC)通过独立编码工件并在任意位置复用KV状态来缓解，但相比全上下文预填充存在质量损失。现有修复方法依赖恢复全局位置ID或重算选定token，本文旨在厘清损失来源并找到更优修复方案。
AI.method: 首先隔离损失来源：发现位置不匹配影响较小，独立缓存的工件表示忠实；失败仅在模型需在多个工件间选择时出现，且用全预填充注意力分数替换PIC注意力分数即可在KV不变的情况下恢复性能，将故障定位到注意力。据此提出Attuner：在查询投影中插入低秩适配器，通过将全预填充分布蒸馏到学生模型进行训练，仅训练少于0.05%的参数，推理时无需缓存重算或全上下文参考。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上，覆盖技能、文档、记忆和代码的七个基准中，Attuner在域内与域外设置均大幅优于先前PIC基线，匹配全上下文预填充质量，并提供最高3.73倍加速。
AI.conclusion: PIC的质量损失源于注意力而非KV重算，可通过查询侧自适应高效修复；Attuner以极小参数开销实现无损读取冻结工件缓存，兼具质量与速度优势。

title: Can Agents Design Libraries for Agents?
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/SprocketLab/librarydesignbench
summary: Agents increasingly build on code written by other agents, and they reimplement rather than reuse, growing the codebases later agents must work in. To measure how well agents design libraries for other agents, we introduce LibraryDesignBench, a two-phase benchmark in which an agent implements a full-featured library from a specification that defines required capabilities and potential use cases without prescribing the design. We evaluate the library through the correctness and simplicity of programs written by three user agents from different model families. The benchmark spans 242 expert-validated programming problems across 15 library-design tasks in four languages. On eleven of the fifteen tasks, agent designers reproduce the abstractions of the human-written production library. Downstream agents adopt agent- and human-written libraries alike but underuse them, reimplementing capabilities the library already provides. Our failure analysis finds that downstream agents write extra code mainly because agent-written libraries are rigid or hard to use, not because capabilities are missing. We also experiment with giving designers more prescriptive, agent-first guidance and having them test their library with subagents; this improves downstream scores and yields simpler programs.
