LibraryDesignBench provides both a testbed for evaluating library-design practices for agent users and an initial design baseline that improves downstream reuse.

AI.tldr: 提出LibraryDesignBench，一个两阶段基准，用于评估智能体为其他智能体设计库的能力，涵盖4种语言、15个库设计任务、242道专家验证问题。
AI.motivation: 智能体日益基于其他智能体编写的代码构建，且倾向于重写而非复用，导致代码库不断膨胀，加重后续智能体的负担。目前缺乏衡量智能体为其他智能体设计库能力的基准。
AI.method: 两阶段基准：第一阶段，设计智能体根据仅规定所需能力与潜在用例、但不规定设计的规格，实现一个功能完整的库；第二阶段，通过三个来自不同模型家族的用户智能体编写程序的正确性与简洁性来评估该库。基准包含15个库设计任务、四种语言、242道专家验证的编程问题。此外，实验了让设计者获得更具规定性、面向智能体的指导，并让其用子智能体测试所设计的库。
AI.result: 在15个任务中的11个上，智能体设计者复现了人类编写的生产库的抽象。下游智能体对智能体编写与人类编写的库采用程度相当，但均使用不足，重写了库已提供的功能。失败分析表明，下游智能体编写额外代码的主因是智能体编写的库僵化或难用，而非功能缺失。额外的面向智能体指导与子智能体测试提升了下游得分，并产生了更简洁的程序。
AI.conclusion: LibraryDesignBench既为评估面向智能体用户的库设计实践提供了测试平台，也提供了一个可改善下游复用的初始设计基线。

title: Distilling What Matters: Confidence-Aware Selective Distillation for Large Language Models
summary: Knowledge Distillation (KD) trains a smaller-capacity student model to imitate a larger-capacity teacher model by matching output distributions, implicitly assuming the teacher to be a reliable oracle. In large language models (LLMs), this assumption often fails: teacher predictions can exhibit high entropy and hallucinations, causing standard KD to degrade well-calibrated student priors. We propose CaRE-KD, a confidence-gated distillation framework that replaces static objectives with uncertainty-adaptive optimization. CaRE-KD has two components: a token-level loss (CaRE-Divergence) that adaptively switches between Forward and Reverse KL divergence based on teacher--student confidence, and a batch-level epistemic rejection mechanism (Revival) that suppresses updates when the teacher is more uncertain than the student. We provide a gradient-level analysis showing how this dual-granularity design induces a conditional calibration mechanism that prior static divergences cannot reproduce. Empirically, across eight teacher--student pairs and eleven benchmarks spanning instruction following, chat alignment, code generation, and mathematical reasoning, CaRE-KD delivers consistent gains over strong baselines (Skewed-KL, $α$--$β$ divergence). Highlights include up to $+3.2$ average ROUGE-L on instruction-following tasks, $+2.1$ pass@1 on MBPP, $+1.7$ accuracy on GSM8k, and $+1.8$ accuracy on CollegeMath over the strongest baseline, with consistent gains in LLM-as-a-judge factuality (up to $+2.5$ per task over Skewed-RKL). Revival further acts as a principled, loss-agnostic plug-in that systematically strengthens existing distillation objectives by filtering epistemically unreliable teacher supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出CaRE-KD置信度门控蒸馏框架，用不确定性自适应优化替代静态目标，缓解LLM教师幻觉导致的蒸馏退化。
AI.motivation: 传统知识蒸馏假设教师模型是可靠"神谕"，但在大语言模型中该假设常失效：教师预测高熵并含幻觉，使标准KD损害学生模型原本良好校准的先验分布。
AI.method: CaRE-KD含两个组件：(1) token级损失CaRE-Divergence，依据师生置信度自适应在Forward KL与Reverse KL间切换；(2) batch级认知拒绝机制Revival，当教师比学生更不确定时抑制更新。作者提供梯度级分析，说明该双粒度设计可诱导出静态散度无法复现的条件校准机制。
AI.result: 在8组师生对、11个基准（涵盖指令跟随、对话对齐、代码生成、数学推理）上，CaRE-KD一致优于Skewed-KL、α–β散度等强基线。指令跟随平均ROUGE-L最高+3.2；MBPP pass@1 +2.1；GSM8k准确率+1.7；CollegeMath准确率+1.8；LLM-as-a-judge事实性每任务较Skewed-RKL最高+2.5。
AI.conclusion: CaRE-KD通过置信度门控与双粒度自适应优化有效克服LLM教师不可靠问题，取得一致性能提升；Revival作为与损失无关的插件机制，可系统性地增强现有蒸馏目标。

title: From Neurons to Conversation: Speech Brain-Computer Interfaces
comment: Review article, 28 pages, 4 figures, 2 boxes, 2 tables
summary: Speech brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) aim to restore communication by transforming neural activity related to speech, language, or communicative intent into external outputs such as text, synthesized voice, or avatar control. Recent advances in intracortical and electrocorticographic recording, deep sequence models, and language-model-assisted decoding have enabled rapid progress, including high-performance attempted-speech decoding and increasingly naturalistic speech synthesis. Yet these achievements also reveal that speech BCIs are not simply neural-to-text decoders. They are adaptive clinical systems in which neural representations, recording hardware, decoding architectures, language priors, feedback, and user learning interact over time. Here, we synthesize speech BCI research from a system-level perspective. We first examine the neural substrates of speech and language, emphasizing their hierarchical, distributed, temporally structured, and non-stationary organization. We then examine recording and decoding choices, closed-loop adaptation, evaluation, clinical translation, and ethics. Across these domains, we highlight recurring trade-offs between signal resolution and invasiveness, low-level motor and high-level semantic targets, decoder accuracy and user agency, and language-model fluency and faithful neural evidence. We argue the next generation of speech BCIs should be evaluated not only by offline accuracy, but also by robustness across sessions, calibration burden, latency, uncertainty, usability, and safeguards against unintended decoding. By reframing speech BCIs as adaptive, user-centred systems, we outline the interdisciplinary priorities spanning speech neuroscience, neural engineering, machine learning, clinical practice, and neuroethics needed to move from proof-of-concept decoding toward reliable, expressive, and controllable communication neuroprostheses.

AI.tldr: 本文从系统层面综述语音脑机接口研究，主张其并非单纯的"神经到文本"解码器，而是神经表征、硬件、解码架构、语言先验、反馈与用户学习随时间相互作用的适应性临床系统，并提出面向可靠、可表达、可控神经假体的跨学科优先方向。
AI.motivation: 语音脑机接口的目标是通过将语音、语言或交流意图相关的神经活动转化为文本、合成语音或虚拟形象控制来恢复交流能力。近年来皮层内与皮层脑电记录、深度序列模型及语言模型辅助解码的进展带来了快速突破，但也暴露出这些成果不能被简单理解为"神经到文本"的解码问题；研究需要从孤立的解码精度转向对系统整体交互机制的重新审视。
AI.method: 采用系统层面的综述与综合分析方法：首先考察语音与语言的神经基础，强调其层级化、分布式、时间结构化与非平稳的组织特征；随后依次讨论记录与解码方案的选择、闭环适应、评估方法、临床转化与伦理问题。
AI.result: 识别出贯穿各领域的若干反复出现的权衡：信号分辨率与侵入性之间、低层运动目标与高层语义目标之间、解码器精度与用户自主性之间、语言模型流畅性与神经证据忠实性之间。并指出仅以离线精度评估语音脑机接口是不充分的。
AI.conclusion: 下一代语音脑机接口的评估应同时涵盖跨会话鲁棒性、校准负担、延迟、不确定性、可用性以及对非预期解码的防护机制。将语音脑机接口重新界定为适应性、以用户为中心的系统，有助于明确横跨语音神经科学、神经工程、机器学习、临床实践与神经伦理学的跨学科优先事项，从而推动从概念验证式解码走向可靠、可表达且可控的交流神经假体。

title: Reconstructing the Vocal Tract with Differentiable Acoustic Simulation
comment: Accepted as NeurIPS 2026 spotlight paper. Supplementary material at https://people.csail.mit.edu/echen/vocal_recon/
summary: The vocal tract is the region of the human body responsible for filtering one's voice to create speech. In this paper, we present a differentiable and GPU accelerated acoustic simulator for the vocal tract. The differentiable simulator synthesizes speech by propagating sound along an acoustic tube model of the vocal tract, and via its gradients, can solve the inverse problem: reconstructing the shape of the vocal tract solely from the sound it produces. Although the inverse mapping between geometry and sound is notoriously non-convex, we discover that gradient descent succeeds with three technical contributions: (1) we design a frequency domain formulation of the vocal tract's fluid dynamics that is 70x more GPU parallelizable than finite differences in time, (2) we integrate a differentiable model for turbulence to synthesize consonants, and (3) similar to prior work in implicit neural representations (INRs) and neural fields, we find that parameterizing the geometry with a neural network accelerates convergence and escapes local minima that trap discrete representations. Because the simulator is differentiable, it is readily integrated with other deep learning pipelines to enable novel linguistics and medical imaging applications. (1) We demonstrate self-supervised autoencoding of vocal tract shapes across 11 languages, and (2) we couple our simulator with a generative model of MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) images to reconstruct one's moving vocal tract from only their speech without paired data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可微分且GPU加速的声道声学模拟器，通过频域流体力学建模、可微湍流模型与神经网络几何参数化，成功求解从语音重建声道形状的非凸逆问题。
AI.motivation: 声道是人体中负责对声音滤波从而产生语音的区域。从语音反推声道几何形状（逆问题）具有重要语言学与医学影像价值，但几何与声音之间的逆映射高度非凸，传统方法难以求解。作者希望构建可微分模拟器以结合深度学习管线实现该逆问题求解。
AI.method: 提出可微分、GPU加速的声道声学模拟器：声音沿声学管模型传播合成语音，并通过梯度求解逆问题。三项技术贡献：(1) 声道流体力学的频域形式化，相比时域有限差分在GPU并行度上提升70倍；(2) 集成可微分湍流模型以合成辅音；(3) 类似INR与神经场，用神经网络参数化几何，加速收敛并逃逸离散表示的局部极小值。
AI.result: (1) 实现跨11种语言的声道形状自监督自编码；(2) 将模拟器与MRI图像生成模型耦合，在无配对数据条件下仅由语音重建运动中的声道。
AI.conclusion: 可微分模拟器可与深度学习管线无缝集成，为语言学和医学影像应用开辟新途径。

title: Backpropagated Output Momentum: Relocating Optimizer History from Parameters to Task Space
summary: Optimizer momentum is usually stored as a parameter-sized moving average of past gradients, which makes history costly and fixes each past signal in the coordinates in which it was computed. We introduce Backpropagated Output Momentum (BOM), which instead stores a compact moving average of prediction errors at the model output and reprojects that history through the current network at every step. A batch-level analysis characterizes the information retained and omitted by this relocation, while the implementation preserves the current supervised gradient and can replace the first-moment component of several adaptive optimizers. As a plug-in for momentum-based optimizers, including ones that already compress their state, BOM reduces parameter-shaped optimizer state by 49.7-99.8% in three compositions and, averaged over three language backbones, paired step time by 4.0%. It also improves mean validation performance across language and vision fine-tuning, by 1.42 points in the primary five-task comparison. Language and vision pretraining studies, together with matched mechanism controls, further test the construction across output spaces and model scales.

AI.tldr: 提出Backpropagated Output Momentum (BOM)，用输出层预测误差的紧凑滑动平均替代参数级动量状态，并通过当前网络反向重投影该历史，从而大幅降低优化器状态开销。
AI.motivation: 传统优化器动量以参数规模的滑动平均存储历史梯度，存储代价高，且将历史信号固定在计算时的坐标中，无法随参数更新而调整。
AI.method: BOM在模型输出端存储预测误差的紧凑滑动平均，每步通过当前网络将历史重投影；保持当前监督梯度不变，可作为一阶矩组件替换若干自适应优化器，兼容已有状态压缩的动量优化器。
AI.result: 在三种组合中参数形状优化器状态减少49.7-99.8%；在三个语言骨干上平均每步时间配对改善4.0%；语言与视觉微调平均验证性能提升，主要五任务对比提升1.42点；语言与视觉预训练及匹配机制对照进一步验证了跨输出空间与模型尺度的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将动量历史从参数空间迁移到输出空间并动态重投影，可显著压缩优化器状态、略微降低步时并提升微调性能，具备作为通用动量插件的潜力。

title: SIPO: Unifying Reinforcement Learning with On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for improving large language models (LLMs) on various tasks, yet its sparse outcome rewards lack token-level credit assignment for intermediate steps. To address this, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) leverages a self-teacher with privileged context to provide additional dense learning signals. However, because the self-teacher is often overconfident and imposes excessive penalties on long reasoning trajectories, OPSD frequently struggles in practice. To mitigate this, we propose self-instructing policy optimization (SIPO) with a contrastive self-teacher to provide dense credit. At each iteration, SIPO samples multiple rollouts per prompt from the current policy, scores them with environment rewards, and constructs two teacher contexts for each rollout by pairing the reference answer with mistakes made within the group. The model then re-evaluates its own responses under both contexts, using the difference between the two teacher log-probabilities as token-level feedback, so that biases shared by both contexts are expected to largely cancel. The resulting objective yields a token-level advantage for every rollout: the reward still sets the main direction of each update while the self-teacher redistributes credit across tokens. Even in groups where every rollout fails and group-relative advantages vanish, SIPO still provides a learning signal. By preserving direct optimization of the task reward while providing dense, token-level feedback, this approach bridges reinforcement learning and on-policy self-distillation. Extensive experiments across multiple reasoning and code-generation benchmarks demonstrate that SIPO outperforms both RLVR and OPSD baselines without an external teacher or additional generation.

AI.tldr: 提出SIPO方法，用对比式自教师提供token级密集信用分配，在推理与代码生成任务上优于RLVR和OPSD基线。
AI.motivation: RLVR仅提供稀疏的结果奖励，缺乏token级信用分配；而现有OPSD依赖自教师提供密集信号，但自教师常过度自信，对长推理轨迹施加过度惩罚，实践中表现不佳。
AI.method: SIPO在每次迭代中对每个prompt采样多条rollout，用环境奖励打分；将参考答案与该组内出现的错误配对，构造两个教师上下文。模型在这两种上下文下重新评估自身回答，以两个教师对数概率之差作为token级反馈，从而抵消共享偏差。该目标为每条rollout产生token级优势：奖励决定更新主方向，自教师在各token间重新分配信用。即使整组失败、组相对优势消失时仍能提供学习信号。方法保留对任务奖励的直接优化，兼具RL与在线自蒸馏特性，无需外部教师或额外生成。
AI.result: 在多个推理与代码生成基准上的大量实验表明，SIPO优于RLVR和OPSD基线，且无需外部教师或额外生成开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过对比式自教师提供密集token级反馈，SIPO弥合了强化学习与在线自蒸馏，在保持任务奖励直接优化的同时实现了更优的信用分配与性能。

title: Group-Marginalized Self-Rewarding RL Drives Zero-Label Self-Evolving
summary: Self-rewarding reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to self-evolve without human labels. Existing ensemble-based methods construct reward references from rollout groups and assign rewards accordingly. However, a response's reward representation also depends on its randomly sampled group context, i.e., the other responses in its group. Using only one group-context realization may miss desired reward signals and provide unreliable guidance for policy optimization. To address this issue, we propose Group-Marginalized Advantage Estimation (GMAE), which aggregates reward realizations across possible contexts into a response-level distribution and estimates expected advantages. Experiments across eight benchmarks and four base models demonstrate strong performance and cross-domain generalization. GMAE also exhibits stable learning, low extra cost, and good applicability across training datasets and RL backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出 GMAE，通过对可能的组上下文进行边缘化，将奖励整合为响应级分布并估计期望优势，提升自奖励强化学习的稳定性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于集成的自奖励方法依赖 rollout 分组构建奖励参考并分配奖励，但某个响应的奖励表示还取决于其所在组的随机采样上下文（即同组的其他响应）。仅使用单一组上下文实现可能遗漏所需的奖励信号，从而给策略优化提供不可靠的引导。
AI.method: 提出组边缘化优势估计（Group-Marginalized Advantage Estimation, GMAE）：将响应在不同可能上下文下的奖励实现进行聚合，形成响应级分布，并据此估计期望优势。
AI.result: 在八个基准和四个基座模型上的实验表明性能强劲且具备跨域泛化能力；GMAE 还表现出学习稳定、额外开销低、在不同训练数据集和 RL 主干上适用性好。
AI.conclusion: 通过边缘化组上下文来获得更稳健的奖励分布与优势估计，GMAE 为自奖励强化学习提供了可靠且高效的改进方案。

title: Does a prosody-trained representation help beyond trainable fusion? A parameter-matched study with frozen HuBERT
summary: Explicit prosodic cues may help automatic speech recognition (ASR) of spontaneous speech, but auxiliary representations typically require additional trainable components, making it unclear whether gains come from the auxiliary information or the fusion mechanism. We address this using a frozen HuBERT backbone and a 64-dimensional representation trained to predict log F0, voicing, Delta log F0, log energy, and spectral tilt. We compare a frozen-backbone recognizer (Baseline), trainable fusion with zero auxiliary input (Null), and the same fusion supplied with the learned representation (Learned). Across Buckeye, Switchboard, and AMI IHM, Null reduces WER by 0.71-1.45 points over Baseline, whereas Learned differs from Null by +0.07, -0.09, and +0.00 points, with no significant differences. However, removing or mismatching the representation at inference increases Learned WER. Thus, Learned depends on the representation yet shows no measurable incremental WER benefit over the parameter-matched control.

AI.tldr: 在冻结HuBERT骨干与参数匹配对照下，显式韵律表征未带来可测量的WER提升，但模型确实依赖该表征。
AI.motivation: 自动语音识别中引入显式韵律线索通常需要额外可训练模块，导致增益来源不明：究竟来自辅助信息本身，还是来自融合机制带来的额外参数。本文旨在解耦这两者。
AI.method: 使用冻结的HuBERT骨干，训练一个64维表征预测log F0、清浊、Delta log F0、log能量和频谱倾斜。设置三个条件：冻结骨干识别器（Baseline）、零辅助输入的融合（Null，参数匹配对照）、以及提供学习表征的相同融合（Learned）。
AI.result: 在Buckeye、Switchboard和AMI IHM上，Null相对Baseline将WER降低0.71–1.45个百分点；Learned相对Null的差异分别为+0.07、-0.09和+0.00个百分点，均无显著性差异。但推理时移除或错配该表征会使Learned的WER上升。
AI.conclusion: Learned模型依赖该韵律表征，但相较于参数匹配对照并无可测量的WER增量收益，说明既有增益主要来自融合机制而非辅助韵律信息。

title: Drag as Evidence: Motion-Grounded Latent Recomposition for Drag-Based Editing
summary: Modern image editors excel at semantic manipulation and visual synthesis, yet remain limited in precise spatial control, motivating the development of drag-based editing. However, existing drag-based methods often struggle to balance drag accuracy with natural, plausible, and intent-aligned generation. We propose MoRe-Drag, a motion-grounded drag-based editing method. Our key insight is to treat pixel-space warping as coarse motion evidence, and to inject this evidence into the generative sampling trajectory. Specifically, MoRe-Drag performs region-aware latent recomposition over refinement, inpainting, and anchor regions, coupled with stage-adaptive conditioning that progressively shifts from motion-grounded structure formation to semantic refinement. We further support an instruction-free interface by adapting the MLLM-based text encoder for drag-aware instruction inference. Experiments on DragBench-SR and DragBench-DR show that MoRe-Drag substantially improves drag precision over strong base editors and achieves superior drag accuracy among SOTA drag-based methods, while delivering strong semantic consistency and visually realistic results. Code and dataset will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出MoRe-Drag，一种基于运动引导的拖拽式图像编辑方法，将像素空间形变作为粗运动证据注入生成采样轨迹，并结合区域感知潜变量重组与阶段自适应条件，实现高精度、语义一致且逼真的拖拽编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑器在语义操作和视觉合成上表现优异，但空间精确控制能力有限；已有拖拽式编辑方法难以在拖拽精度与自然、合理、符合意图的生成之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 核心思想是将像素空间形变视为粗粒度运动证据并注入生成采样轨迹。方法包含：区域感知潜变量重组（针对精修区、修复区和锚点区）；阶段自适应条件（从运动引导的结构形成逐步过渡到语义精修）；并适配基于MLLM的文本编码器实现无指令接口的拖拽感知指令推理。
AI.result: 在DragBench-SR和DragBench-DR上，MoRe-Drag较强基线编辑器显著提升拖拽精度，在SOTA拖拽方法中取得更优的拖拽准确率，同时具备强语义一致性和视觉逼真效果。
AI.conclusion: MoRe-Drag通过将运动证据注入生成轨迹，有效兼顾拖拽精度与语义一致性，为拖拽式图像编辑提供了新的解决思路，代码与数据集将公开。

title: NesTok: Nested Self-Aligned 1D Tokenizer for Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: One-dimensional (1D) variable-length visual tokenizers enable adaptive compression by varying the number of tokens, allowing downstream autoregressive (AR) models to flexibly trade off generation quality against computational cost using a single tokenizer. However, existing approaches based on nested dropout often fail to fully exploit the representational capacity of the tokenizer, resulting in suboptimal performance in both image reconstruction and generation. In this work, we introduce NesTok, a nested self-alignment framework tailored to dynamic visual tokenizers. NesTok introduces cross-length training, which jointly optimizes reconstruction across token lengths while using the full-length sequence to guide shorter counterparts, enabling shorter token sequences to approach the reconstruction quality of full-length sequences. On ImageNet, NesTok improves substantially over standard training and achieves an rFID score of 0.98. On downstream image generation, it achieves the state-of-the-art gFID score of 1.46 on ImageNet 256$\times$256 among existing variable-length autoregressive image generation methods. Code will be available at https://github.com/Jiawei804/NesTok.

AI.tldr: 提出NesTok嵌套自对齐框架，通过跨长度训练提升变长视觉tokenizer的表示能力，在重建与生成任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 一维变长视觉tokenizer可自适应压缩，使下游自回归模型用单一tokenizer在生成质量与计算成本间灵活权衡。但现有基于嵌套dropout的方法未能充分利用tokenizer的表示能力，导致图像重建与生成性能次优。
AI.method: NesTok是一个面向动态视觉tokenizer的嵌套自对齐框架，核心是跨长度训练：联合优化不同token长度下的重建，并利用全长序列指导较短序列，使短token序列逼近全长序列的重建质量。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上，NesTok相较标准训练显著提升，重建rFID达0.98；在下游图像生成任务中，于ImageNet 256×256上取得现有变长自回归图像生成方法中最优的gFID 1.46。
AI.conclusion: NesTok通过跨长度自对齐有效释放变长视觉tokenizer的表示潜力，兼顾重建与生成性能，为动态tokenizer训练提供了新思路。

title: FastVR: Efficient Streaming Video Restoration with One-Step Diffusion
summary: Diffusion-based video restoration recovers realistic details, but its practical deployment is limited by two efficiency bottlenecks: costly VAE encoding and decoding, and the quadratic cost of full self-attention in diffusion transformers (DiTs). This paper presents FastVR, a streaming video restoration framework built on a one-step diffusion model, which delivers strong restoration quality and temporal consistency while processing 1080p video at 11 FPS on a single H20 GPU. To improve inference efficiency, FastVR combines a lightweight VAE with chunk-wise causal attention, which substantially reduces the computational cost. During training, it further adopts velocity consistency regularization and continuous trajectory learning, which improve restoration quality. Extensive experiments show that FastVR is more efficient than the evaluated diffusion baselines while achieving state-of-the-art performance on synthetic and real-world benchmarks. We hope that this work supports further progress in the community.

AI.tldr: FastVR：基于一步扩散模型的流式视频修复框架，通过轻量VAE+分块因果注意力降低计算成本，单张H20 GPU上处理1080p视频达11 FPS，并在合成与真实基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 扩散式视频修复虽能恢复真实细节，但实际部署受两个效率瓶颈限制：VAE编解码开销高，以及DiT中全局自注意力的二次复杂度成本。
AI.method: FastVR构建于一步扩散模型之上，采用流式视频修复框架；推理阶段结合轻量VAE与分块因果注意力大幅降低计算量；训练阶段引入速度一致性正则化与连续轨迹学习以提升修复质量。
AI.result: 在单张H20 GPU上可对1080p视频实现11 FPS处理；在合成与真实世界基准上达到SOTA性能，且效率优于所评估的扩散基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FastVR在保证修复质量与时间一致性的同时显著提升效率，为扩散式视频修复的实际部署与后续研究提供支持。

title: Dual-Mode Low-Rank Learner with Bridge-Prototype Ensemble for Vision-Language Class-Incremental Learning
comment: 21 pages, 11 figures, and 12 tables, including the appendix
summary: Benefiting from transferable visual-textual alignment, CLIP has been widely adopted for class-incremental learning (CIL). However, existing learners either repeatedly update components shared across tasks, leading to knowledge overwriting, or overly isolate new-task updates, hindering the reuse of CLIP's transferable knowledge and limiting plasticity. Moreover, the text-based or bimodal classifier designs still fail to effectively integrate complementary information from the visual and textual modalities. To address these challenges, we introduce DuLBE, which couples dual-mode low-rank learning with a bridge-prototype ensemble classifier for exemplar-free CIL. DuLBE allocates two visual low-rank update modes according to the gradient demand and uses gradient routing to coordinate them: a compact and rewritable shared mode is selected from historically occupied visual directions to reuse transferable knowledge, while residual modes provide low-interference channels for task-specific variations. Building on the resulting stable inter-modal structure, we further construct geodesic bridges between visual prototypes and text embeddings on the unit hypersphere, and ensemble reliable bridge prototypes to compensate for the modality-gap limitations of textual decision boundaries. Extensive experiments under multiple settings show that DuLBE achieves state-of-the-art CIL performance while retaining the high parameter efficiency of low-rank tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出 DuLBE：将双模式低秩学习与桥原型集成分类器耦合，用于无样本类增量学习，在保持低秩微调参数高效性的同时取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP的类增量学习要么反复更新共享组件导致知识覆盖，要么过度隔离新任务更新，阻碍CLIP可迁移知识复用、限制可塑性；且基于文本或双模态的分类器设计未能有效融合视觉与文本的互补信息。
AI.method: DuLBE由两部分组成：1）双模式低秩学习，按梯度需求分配两种视觉低秩更新模式并用梯度路由协调——从历史占用的视觉方向中选择紧凑可重写的共享模式以复用可迁移知识，残差模式为任务特定变化提供低干扰通道；2）在所得稳定跨模态结构上，于单位超球面上构建视觉原型与文本嵌入之间的测地桥，并集成可靠的桥原型以补偿文本决策边界的模态鸿沟。
AI.result: 在多种设置下的广泛实验表明，DuLBE取得了SOTA的类增量学习性能，同时保持低秩微调的高参数效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过梯度路由的双模式低秩更新与桥原型集成分类器的耦合设计，DuLBE为无样本类增量学习提供了兼顾稳定性与可塑性、并有效融合跨模态补信息的高参数高效方案。

title: QuantMLA: Function-Aligned Dual-Path Quantization for Low-Bit MLA KV Caching
summary: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) enables expressive multi-head attention with compact caches for its content and decoupled RoPE paths, yet cache memory still scales linearly with context length and batch size. In this work, we establish a systematic model of MLA's dual-path quantization errors, characterizing their distinct effects on attention-output distortion and explaining the pronounced amplification of RoPE-path errors. Guided by this analysis, we introduce QuantMLA, a function-aligned framework for low-bit dual-path quantization. We derive path-specific transformation spaces that preserve full-precision computation while remaining fully fusible into model parameters offline, eliminating online transformation overhead. Within these spaces, QuantMLA learns path-specific transformations with function-aligned objectives: attention-output reconstruction captures the content path's coupled matching and aggregation errors, while positional QK reconstruction preserves the RoPE-induced component of the attention logits and admits a theoretical bound on output distortion. Across four MLA model families, QuantMLA enables, to our knowledge, the first reported joint INT4 caching of the content and RoPE caches with minimal accuracy degradation. Further compressing the content cache to INT2 while retaining the RoPE key cache at INT4 maintains competitive performance on challenging reasoning and code benchmarks. We develop a native low-bit MLA attention kernel that integrates unpacking and dequantization directly into attention computation. The physical cache layout provides 3.59x compression at 128K context, while a cache-pressure serving workload achieves 5.168x higher whole-job output throughput than BF16. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 QuantMLA，一个面向 MLA 双路径（content 与 RoPE）的低比特量化框架，通过路径特定的可融合变换空间与函数对齐目标，实现首次 content 与 RoPE 缓存联合 INT4 缓存，并开发原生低比特注意力内核。
AI.motivation: MLA 虽支持紧凑缓存与解耦 RoPE 路径，但缓存显存仍随上下文长度与批大小线性增长。现有低比特量化方法未系统刻画 MLA 双路径量化误差的差异，尤其忽视 RoPE 路径误差被显著放大的问题，导致低比特下精度退化严重。
AI.method: 1) 建立 MLA 双路径量化误差的系统模型，分析其对注意力输出失真的不同影响及 RoPE 路径误差放大机制；2) 推导路径特定变换空间，保持全精度计算且可离线融合进模型参数，消除在线变换开销；3) 在该空间内以函数对齐目标学习路径特定变换：content 路径采用注意力输出重建目标，捕捉耦合匹配与聚合误差；RoPE 路径采用位置 QK 重建，保留注意力 logits 的 RoPE 分量并给出输出失真理论界；4) 开发原生低比特 MLA 注意力内核，将解包与反量化直接融入注意力计算。
AI.result: 在四个 MLA 模型族上，QuantMLA 实现首次 content 与 RoPE 缓存的联合 INT4 缓存且精度损失极小；将 content 缓存进一步压至 INT2、RoPE key 缓存保持 INT4 时，在推理与代码基准上仍具竞争力。物理缓存布局在 128K 上下文下实现 3.59 倍压缩；缓存压力服务负载下整作业输出吞吐较 BF16 提升 5.168 倍。
AI.conclusion: QuantMLA 通过误差建模、可融合路径特定变换与函数对齐目标，有效解决了 MLA 双路径低比特量化的精度与效率问题，并配合原生低比特内核在长上下文推理与高缓存压力场景下获得显著压缩与吞吐收益，代码将在录用后开源。

title: Emergent Specialization in Populations of Self-Supervised Collaborative Vision Experts Without a Shared Gate or Cross-Agent Gradients
summary: Can a population of neural networks develop a useful division of labor without a shared gate or gradients between agents? We study a setting where each network has its own weights, trains independently on the same heterogeneous data, and can ask another agent for help through a forward pass. Unlike mixtures of experts, where a jointly trained gate assigns inputs to experts, specialization here must emerge without central control. We test this in a small scale proxy for predictive visual pretraining. Initially identical agents are finetuned on an unlabeled mixture of six visual domains using masked prediction of frozen DINOv3 features. We measure specialization by asking whether the best agent for an input aligns with its latent domain, and utilization by asking whether responsibility is distributed across agents. We progressively remove central control, ending with DISCO (DIStributed COllaboration) where each agent locally selects a helper, reads its internal state through a gradient free channel, and rewards its router only for the improvement that help provides. Specialization emerges and is useful. Randomly routed populations underperform a single generalist, while semantically routed populations outperform it, showing that specialization rather than population size drives the gain. Specialization persists without a central router, and gradient free communication lets nonexperts exploit emergent expertise. In DISCO, a random agent helped by the expert matches the solo generalist, while experts surpass it, including on data outside the specialization mixture. Local routers select the emergent expert for 98% of inputs. These effects persist across population size, model capacity, data imbalance, and finetuning seeds, providing measurable evidence for the dynamics needed by decentralized predictive pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无共享门控与无梯度通信条件下神经网络群体的分工涌现问题，提出DISCO框架，证明专门化可在去中心化条件下自发形成且带来实际收益。
AI.motivation: 现有专家混合（MoE）依赖联合训练的中心化门控分配输入，专门化由中心控制驱动。作者希望探究：在无中心门控、无智能体间梯度的去中心化设置下，是否仍能涌现出有用的分工。
AI.method: 以六类视觉域的无标注混合数据做预测式视觉预训练的小规模代理任务，各网络权重独立、独立训练，通过前向传播向其他智能体求助。用掩码预测冻结的DINOv3特征。渐进移除中心控制，最终形成DISCO：每个智能体本地选择助手，经无梯度通道读取其内部状态，仅依据帮助带来的提升奖励其路由器。
AI.result: 专门化自发涌现且有用。随机路由群体表现不及单一通才，语义路由群体则超越通才，说明收益来自专门化而非群体规模。专门化在无中心路由器时持续存在；无梯度通信使非专家能利用涌现的专长。DISCO中，被专家帮助的随机智能体达到单通才水平，专家则超越之，且在专门化混合数据之外的数据上亦然。本地路由器在98%的输入上选中涌现出的专家。这些效应在群体规模、模型容量、数据不平衡与微调随机种子下均稳健。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明去中心化预测式预训练所需的分工动态确实可被度量验证，为无中心控制的协作式表征学习提供了证据。

title: DSPO: Diversity-aware Subjective Policy Optimization for Robust Emotional Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement Learning has significantly advanced the complex reasoning capabilities of MLLMs. However, prevailing RL algorithms suffer a severe failure in emotion reasoning tasks. These methods heavily rely on deterministic hard-label supervision and point-wise isolated evaluation, creating a fundamental gap with the inherently subjective and continuously distributed nature of human emotions. Furthermore, unlike explicit physical objects, emotional states are deeply implicit within visual cues. This abstract nature exacerbates visual hallucinations in MLLMs, leading to plausible yet ungrounded emotional evidence. To address these limitations, we propose Diversity-Aware Subjective Policy Optimization (DSPO), a reinforcement learning framework that jointly promotes subjective affective coverage and visual grounding. First, we construct a context-grounded emotional distribution prior in the VAD space by combining the lexical prior of the annotated emotion with image-specific contextual information. Based on this prior, we introduce a Distribution-Aligned Emotional Diversity Reward (DEDR), which measures the leave-one-out marginal contribution of each candidate emotion within a rollout. DEDR rewards candidates whose inclusion brings the predicted affective set closer to the context-grounded prior, thereby preserving plausible subjective interpretations without encouraging unconstrained dispersion. We further develop Counterfactual Visual Intervention Gating (CVIG), which masks the visual region highlighted in the reasoning process and uses the resulting candidate-wise probability changes to reduce the weights of interpretations unsupported by visual evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSPO achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple public benchmarks, especially on the cross-domain performance, i.e., improving +10.8\% on average cross-domain accuracy than EMO-R3.

AI.tldr: 提出DSPO强化学习框架，通过分布对齐的情感多样性奖励与反事实视觉干预门控，同时提升多模态大模型情感推理的主观覆盖度与视觉 grounding，跨域准确率平均提升10.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有RL算法在情感推理任务上存在严重失效：依赖确定性硬标签监督与逐点孤立评估，与情感主观且连续分布的本质存在根本性鸿沟；同时情感状态隐含于视觉线索中，加剧了MLLM的视觉幻觉，产生看似合理却无视觉依据的情感证据。
AI.method: DSPO包含三部分：(1) 在VAD空间构建上下文接地的情感分布先验，融合标注情感的词汇先验与图像特定上下文信息；(2) 分布对齐情感多样性奖励DEDR，在单次rollout内以留一法衡量每个候选情感的边际贡献，奖励使预测情感集合更接近该先验的候选，保持合理主观解释且不鼓励无约束发散；(3) 反事实视觉干预门控CVIG，遮蔽推理过程中高亮的视觉区域，利用候选概率变化降低缺乏视觉证据支持的解读权重。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准上取得SOTA性能，跨域表现尤为突出，平均跨域准确率较EMO-R3提升+10.8%。
AI.conclusion: DSPO通过联合促进主观情感覆盖与视觉接地，有效缓解硬标签监督与视觉幻觉问题，验证了分布化奖励与反事实视觉门控在情感推理中的有效性。

title: Causal-EVC: Breaking Emotional Spurious Causality via Spatiotemporal Grounding and Counterfactual Intervention
summary: Emotional Video Captioning aims to generate factually accurate and emotionally empathetic descriptions. While recent methods have recognized the importance of visual causes to guide emotion perception and caption generation, they fundamentally rely on simple attention matching, which inevitably suffers from {causal redundancy and spurious correlations} in co-occurrence bias (e.g., misclassifying ``sadness'' as ``joy'' on a sunny beach), leading to severe shortcut learning from confusing backgrounds. Furthermore, existing evaluations fail to verify whether models have genuinely mastered causal reasoning or merely exploited background confounders. To address these limitations, we first construct {EVC-CauseGround}, a comprehensive benchmark with dense spatio-temporal causal annotations. Crucially, it introduces a carefully selected {Causal-Faithfulness Subset} to explicitly quantify genuine emotion-cause attribution. Second, we propose {Causal-EVC}, an emotion-grounding captioning framework, which introduces a Motion-guided Causal Spatiotemporal Localization module to precisely decouple causal triggers from background confounders. Besides, we introduce an Interpretable Sparse Emotion Routing module. By synthesizing counterfactual representations and formulating a novel counterfactual contrastive objective, we enforce the model to anchor its emotion predictions strictly on authentic causal triggers instead of confusing background. Extensive experiments show that Causal-EVC not only achieves the best performance on semantic metrics but also exhibits significant advantages in the causal-faithfulness subset, which demonstrates that our model could mine emotional cues from genuine visual causes and mitigate co-occurrence bias for interpretable multimodal emotion understanding.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对情感视频描述中因共现偏差导致的因果冗余与虚假相关问题，构建了带密集时空因果标注的基准 EVC-CauseGround 及因果忠实子集，并提出 Causal-EVC 框架，通过运动引导的因果时空定位、可解释稀疏情感路由与反事实对比目标，将情感预测锚定于真实因果触发因素。
AI.motivation: 现有情感视频描述方法虽已意识到视觉原因对情感感知与描述生成的重要性，但仅依赖简单的注意力匹配，容易受共现偏差影响，产生因果冗余与虚假相关（如在阳光沙滩场景中将“悲伤”误判为“喜悦”），导致模型从困惑性背景中进行严重的捷径学习。此外，现有评测无法验证模型是否真正掌握因果推理，还是仅利用了背景混淆因素。
AI.method: 1）构建 EVC-CauseGround 基准，包含密集的时空因果标注，并引入精心挑选的 Causal-Faithfulness Subset 以显式量化真实的情感—原因归因；2）提出 Causal-EVC 情感定位描述框架，包含 Motion-guided Causal Spatiotemporal Localization 模块，用于精确地从背景混淆因素中解耦因果触发因素；3）引入 Interpretable Sparse Emotion Routing 模块，通过合成反事实表示并制定新的反事实对比目标，强制模型将情感预测严格锚定于真实因果触发因素而非困惑性背景。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Causal-EVC 不仅在语义指标上取得最佳性能，还在因果忠实子集上表现出显著优势，证明该模型能够从真实视觉原因中挖掘情感线索，并缓解共现偏差，实现可解释的多模态情感理解。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过基准构建与因果建模双重路径，揭示了现有情感视频描述方法的捷径学习缺陷，并验证了以因果触发因素为核心进行情感定位与描述生成的有效性，为可解释的多模态情感理解提供了新思路。

title: DRHeC: Differentiable Rendering for Hand-Eye Calibration with RGB-Based Gradients
summary: Accurate hand-eye calibration is crucial for precision manipulation. Traditional methods rely on markers, with their precision dependent on marker accuracy and observability. In contrast, markerless methods, such as learning-based approaches, use deep neural networks to directly extract keypoints or features from images, enabling the computation of hand-eye transformation with a single image and without the need for physical markers. Recently, differentiable rendering-based methods for hand-eye calibration have leveraged physical models to render binary masks and compare them with observations, enabling hand-eye calibration without fiducial markers in the calibration stage and providing interpretable optimization. While the state-of-the-art differentiable rendering methods achieve remarkable accuracy, the use of binary masks can result in the loss of internal profile details, reducing precision. Additionally, these methods can also suffer from unstable optimization and local minima. In this study, we propose a novel RGB-based differentiable rendering framework that provides richer geometric and appearance cues by incorporating color and mask geometric features, thereby improving calibration accuracy and optimization stability. Additionally, we propose a mask-guided image-to-image translation method to ensure explicit preservation of color and geometric consistency throughout the translation. Our approach is validated through both simulation and real-world experiments, with results demonstrating strong accuracy and robustness and clear improvements over existing differentiable rendering methods. Our method achieves a grasping success rate of 88.9% and insertion success rate of 57.4% on the UR5e real-world experiment, outperforming the state-of-the-art differentiable rendering hand-eye calibration method EasyHeC by 46.3 and 48.1 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出基于RGB的可微渲染手眼标定框架，通过引入颜色与掩码几何特征提供更丰富的几何与外观线索，并采用掩码引导的图像翻译方法保持颜色与几何一致性，在仿真和真实实验中精度与鲁棒性均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 精确的手眼标定对精密操作至关重要。传统方法依赖标记物，精度受标记物精度与可观测性限制；无标记的学习类方法虽可单图计算手眼变换，但缺乏可解释性。近期基于可微渲染的方法利用物理模型渲染二值掩码并与观测对比，实现无需基准标记且可解释的优化。然而二值掩码会丢失内部轮廓细节导致精度下降，且优化不稳定、易陷入局部极小值。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的基于RGB的可微渲染框架，通过融合颜色与掩码几何特征，提供更丰富的几何与外观线索，以提升标定精度与优化稳定性；并提出一种掩码引导的图像到图像翻译方法，确保翻译过程中显式保持颜色与几何一致性。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界实验中验证了方法的精度与鲁棒性，相较现有可微渲染方法有明显提升。在UR5e真实实验中抓取成功率达88.9%，插入成功率达57.4%，分别比最先进的可微渲染手眼标定方法EasyHeC高出46.3和48.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 基于RGB的可微渲染框架结合颜色与几何特征，能有效提升手眼标定的精度与优化稳定性，并在真实机器人操作任务中显著超越现有可微渲染方法。

title: Decoding Affective Nuances: Enhancing MLLMs via Hierarchical Emotion Reasoning and Contrastive Discriminative Pruning
summary: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in objective understanding tasks, their performance in affective reasoning still falls significantly short of human standards. We attribute it to a central capability gap: MLLMs are difficult to reliably distinguish semantically proximal emotions based on fine-grained visual evidence, which could be decoupled as two limitations: 1) Insufficient Attribution. The global reasoning paradigm of conventional MLLMs severely dilutes fine-grained emotion cues, where subtle emotional states are usually implicitly encoded, thereby generating emotional misjudgments in complex scenarios. 2) Insufficient Discrimination. Existing methods could only identify regions generally associated with emotions, which fails to distinguish discriminative regions between semantically similar emotions, leading to ambiguous emotion judgements. To overcome these limitations, we present a training-free inference-time optimization framework, named Decoding Affective Nuances (DAN). Specifically, we propose a Hierarchical Emotional Reasoning Chain (HERC) that enhances the insufficient attribution by harmonizing fine-grained scene/object-level cues and performing a soft-gated reasoning. Furthermore, to discriminate between semantically proximal emotions, we design a Contrastive Discriminative Visual Pruning (CDVP), which isolates discriminative visual tokens to reason the final emotion category by computing the absolute discrepancy between the attention distributions of similar emotions. Performances on several benchmarks demonstrate that DAN significantly improves discrimination for affective nuances without consuming additional training resources, especially achieving +10.47% improvements with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on WebEmo25 dataset that contains 25 fine-grained emotion categories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练推理期优化框架 DAN，通过分层情感推理链与对比判别视觉剪枝，提升多模态大模型对细粒度近似情感的区分能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在客观理解任务上表现优异，但在情感推理上远不及人类。作者将此归因于一个核心能力缺口：模型难以依据细粒度视觉证据可靠区分语义上近似的情感。该缺口可拆解为两点局限：一是归因不足，传统全局推理范式稀释了细粒度情感线索，细微情感状态常被隐式编码，在复杂场景中引发情感误判；二是判别不足，现有方法只能识别与情感大体相关的区域，无法区分语义相近情感之间的判别性区域，导致情感判断模糊。
AI.method: 提出免训练的推理期优化框架 DAN（Decoding Affective Nuances）。其中包含两个组件：其一为分层情感推理链 HERC，通过协调细粒度的场景级与物体级线索并进行软门控推理，缓解归因不足问题；其二为对比判别视觉剪枝 CDVP，通过计算相似情感注意力分布之间的绝对差异，分离出具有判别性的视觉 token，以此推理最终情感类别，从而区分语义近似情感。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，DAN 在不消耗额外训练资源的情况下显著提升了对情感细微差别的判别能力，尤其在包含 25 个细粒度情感类别的 WebEmo25 数据集上，配合 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 取得了 +10.47% 的提升。
AI.conclusion: DAN 作为一种免训练、推理期即插即用的优化框架，通过增强情感线索归因与近似情感判别，有效弥补了 MLLM 在情感推理上的能力缺口，无需额外训练即可获得显著性能增益，为细粒度情感理解提供了可行路径。

title: Seeing What Should Be Heard: Diagnosing and Repairing Cross-Modal Shortcuts in Omni-Modal LLMs
summary: Omni-modal large language models (LLMs) are expected to answer a question using the modality it explicitly refers to. However, existing training paradigms rarely verify whether models actually follow this modality, because multimodal inputs from the same sample often provide redundant evidence for the same answer. In this work, we uncover a pervasive cross-modal shortcut in omni-modal LLMs: when asked an audio-related question, models rely on the image as much as on the audio, and sometimes even more. To systematically diagnose this behavior, we introduce the Factorized Modality Diagnostic, which independently swaps audio and images between samples to isolate each modality's causal contribution. Across two model families in different settings, we find that this shortcut persists throughout supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning post-training, while judge-based RL may further amplify such reliance on irrelevant visual information. Based on this finding, we propose DMC-Repair, which trains models on the same kind of cross-modal swapped samples while assigning supervision according to the modality specified by the question. This prevents models from exploiting the spurious correspondence between modalities within the same clip. Experiments demonstrate that DMC-Repair reduces the image-induced share of the answer effect by 59.9%, effectively suppressing the cross-modal shortcut without compromising audio-question answering performance. The reduction in shortcut reliance generalizes across two model families and zero-shot to an unseen dataset and an unseen benchmark, and persists through subsequent post-training. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DMC-Repair.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了全模态大语言模型中普遍存在的跨模态捷径现象，并提出DMC-Repair方法加以修复。
AI.motivation: 全模态LLM本应根据问题所指模态作答，但现有训练范式很少验证模型是否真正遵循该模态。原因在于同一样本的多模态输入常为同一答案提供冗余证据，导致模型可依赖无关模态（如用图像回答音频问题）而不被察觉。
AI.method: 提出因子化模态诊断（Factorized Modality Diagnostic），通过在同一样本间独立交换音频与图像来分离各模态的因果贡献。基于该发现提出DMC-Repair：在同类跨模态交换样本上训练模型，并按问题指定模态分配监督信号，从而阻断模态间的虚假对应。
AI.result: 跨两个模型家族、不同设置下，该捷径贯穿监督微调与强化学习后训练，且基于评判的RL可能放大对无关视觉信息的依赖。DMC-Repair将图像诱导的答案效应占比降低59.9%，在不损害音频问答性能的前提下有效抑制捷径，且该效果可泛化至未见数据集与基准，并持续到后续后训练。
AI.conclusion: 全模态LLM存在可利用的跨模态捷径，需显式诊断与干预；按问题指定模态进行监督的DMC-Repair能有效抑制该捷径并具备良好泛化性。

title: Scene Retargeting: Learning Object Placement with Analogical Transfer
summary: Interactive simulations of embodied AI or spatial computing applications build on realistic 3D scenes that support daily activities. However, sparse, irregular layout structures impose scene-specific physical constraints, making it hard to define a generalizable framework for generating similar functional context. We formalize Scene Retargeting as stably transferring the semantically coherent spatial organization across layouts, rather than relying on textual descriptions or pairwise relationships. Our cluster-wise transfer flexibly handles mismatched object instances and adapts to distinctive floor plans. We optimize to preserve the rich semantic context of individual clusters by respecting the spatial distribution of foundation features. We can then impose physical constraints to refine wall contacts, pairwise alignment, or clear passageways and openings. Our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods on layout generation on the 3D-FRONT dataset, and demonstrates downstream applications including real-to-sim transfer, analogical trajectory transfer, and multi-reference composition.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"场景重定向"（Scene Retargeting）任务，通过簇级空间组织迁移实现跨布局的语义一致性场景生成，兼顾不匹配的物体实例与不同户型，并在3D-FRONT上超越SOTA，支持real-to-sim迁移、类比轨迹迁移与多参考组合等应用。
AI.motivation: 具身AI与空间计算的交互仿真依赖真实3D场景，但场景布局稀疏、不规则，带来场景特定的物理约束，难以构建可泛化的功能性场景生成框架；已有方法多依赖文本描述或成对关系，无法稳定迁移语义一致的全局空间组织。
AI.method: 将Scene Retargeting形式化为跨布局稳定迁移语义连贯的空间组织；采用簇级（cluster-wise）迁移机制灵活处理物体实例不匹配并适配不同户型；通过优化保持各簇的丰富语义上下文，即在基础特征（foundation features）的空间分布约束下保留语义结构；随后施加物理约束以精修墙体接触、成对对齐、通行通道与开口。
AI.result: 在3D-FRONT数据集的布局生成任务上优于现有SOTA方法；验证了下游应用，包括real-to-sim迁移、类比轨迹迁移（analogical trajectory transfer）与多参考组合（multi-reference composition）。
AI.conclusion: 以簇级语义空间组织迁移替代文本/成对关系建模，为可泛化的功能场景生成提供统一框架，并可支撑多种具身AI与空间计算下游应用。

title: EGSD: Event-Grounded Self-Distillation for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Real-time video understanding requires incrementally maintaining a memory of streaming content, and optimizing this requires dense process signals. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which lets one model serve as both teacher and student with the teacher receiving additional privileged information such as the question and ground-truth (GT) answer, can supply such token-level signals. However, applying it directly to streaming video raises two problems. (1) The student cannot be optimized end-to-end, where memory is written before the question arrives, yet the teacher scores it with the question-and-GT privilege, misaligning their preferences. (2) Effective-entity memory collapses, where the question-and-GT privilege makes the teacher favor only question-relevant entities, and token-mean averaging over a memory renders its signal invariant to how many entities that memory covers, both driving memory against the streaming need for diversity. To address these issues, we propose Event-Grounded Self-Distillation (EGSD), which characterizes streaming memory as an incremental update over verifiable Events (key visual entities, actions, and details) and targets the two problems on this basis. For problem (1), we adapt the OPSD signal into a multiplicative weight combined with the outcome reward; for problem (2), we re-weight the teacher with Events as privileged information to counter its question-relevance bias, and add an entity-coverage reward to supply the coverage preference the token-mean teacher lacks. Extensive experiments on mainstream online and offline benchmarks show EGSD achieves strong performance, reaching 79.8% on StreamingBench and 73.4% on the OVO-Bench Real-Time track, while memory analysis shows effective-entity recall rises 17.4% at only 6.8% more memory length.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Event-Grounded Self-Distillation (EGSD)，通过将流式记忆建模为可验证事件的增量更新，并针对 On-Policy Self-Distillation 在流式视频中的两个问题（学生无法端到端优化、有效实体记忆坍缩）设计乘法权重与事件加权重及实体覆盖奖励，实现流式视频理解性能提升。
AI.motivation: 实时视频理解需要增量维护流式内容的记忆，而优化这一过程需要密集的过程信号。On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) 可提供 token 级信号，但直接用于流式视频存在两个问题：(1) 学生无法端到端优化——记忆在问题到来之前写入，而教师却用问题与真实答案的特权来打分，导致师生偏好错位；(2) 有效实体记忆坍缩——问题与真实答案特权使教师只偏好与问题相关的实体，且对记忆做 token 均值平均使信号对记忆覆盖多少实体不敏感，这两者都使记忆偏离流式场景对多样性的需求。
AI.method: 提出 Event-Grounded Self-Distillation (EGSD)，将流式记忆刻画为对可验证事件（关键视觉实体、动作与细节）的增量更新，并在此基础上针对两个问题分别处理。针对问题 (1)，将 OPSD 信号改编为与结果奖励相结合的乘法权重；针对问题 (2)，以事件作为特权信息对教师重新加权以抵消其问题相关性偏差，并加入实体覆盖奖励，以提供 token 均值教师所缺乏的覆盖偏好。
AI.result: 在主流在线与离线基准上开展大量实验，EGSD 取得强劲性能：StreamingBench 达到 79.8%，OVO-Bench Real-Time 赛道达到 73.4%；记忆分析显示有效实体召回率提升 17.4%，而记忆长度仅增加 6.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将流式记忆建模为可验证事件的增量更新，并针对性解决 OPSD 在流式视频中的偏好错位与记忆坍缩问题，EGSD 在流式视频理解任务上实现了性能与记忆效率的良好平衡。

title: VAA-CSEC: Vote-guided Advantage Allocation for Chinese Semantic Error Correction
summary: Chinese Semantic Error Correction (CSEC) targets semantic errors in Chinese text, which are typically more subtle and complex than spelling and grammatical errors but remain relatively underexplored. Existing LLM-based approaches face two recurring obstacles in this task: over-correction, and unclear interaction between Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning and self-consistency decoding, such that the benefits brought by CoT cannot be reliably transferred to final corrections. We propose Vote-guided Advantage Allocation for CSEC (VAA-CSEC), a multi-stage framework that combines CoT distillation, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning (RL) and self-consistency decoding. During RL, we design a task-specific reward function that directly aligned with the minimal-editing principle of CSEC. We further introduce Group-Level Relative Policy Optimization (GLPO), which reallocates GRPO advantages according to the margin between individual rollout rewards and the vote-aggregated group reward, aligning the RL training objective with the self-consistency objective used at inference time. Experiments on CSED-C and NaSGEC-Exam show that VAA-CSEC outperforms all LLM-based baselines on CSED-C with an F0.5 of 47.72%, achieves the highest recall of 42.15% among all methods, and establishes a new state of the art of 41.55% F0.5 on NaSGEC-Exam.

AI.tldr: 提出VAA-CSEC多阶段框架，通过投票引导优势分配（GLPO）统一RL训练与自一致性解码目标，缓解中文语义纠错过纠与CoT收益难以转移问题。
AI.motivation: 中文语义纠错（CSEC）错误更隐蔽复杂，现有LLM方法存在两大障碍：过度纠正，以及CoT推理与自一致性解码交互不清晰，导致CoT收益无法可靠转化为最终纠错结果。
AI.method: VAA-CSEC多阶段框架，融合CoT蒸馏、SFT、强化学习与自一致性解码；设计符合最小编辑原则的任务特定奖励函数；提出组级相对策略优化（GLPO），依据单条 rollout 奖励与投票聚合组奖励之间的差值重新分配GRPO优势，使RL训练目标与推理时的自一致性目标对齐。
AI.result: 在CSED-C和NaSGEC-Exam上，VAA-CSEC在CSED-C上F0.5达47.72%，超越所有LLM基线；在所有方法中取得最高召回率42.15%；在NaSGEC-Exam上以41.55% F0.5刷新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 通过奖励对齐与GLPO将RL优化目标与推理端自一致性统一，可有效提升中文语义纠错性能并刷新基准SOTA。

title: MeteoVerse: Unified Weather-Controllable Video World Model
summary: Video world models aim to predict future content from an observed scene while following prescribed camera motion. Real-world scene evolution is determined not only by changes in viewpoint and object dynamics, but also by environmental conditions such as weather, which can substantially alter scene appearance and visibility. Modeling such realistic weather evolution is challenging because the required weather modification depends jointly on the observed and desired weather states. Depending on their relation, the model may need to preserve, introduce, or remove a weather effect. Existing video world models typically leave this weather transition implicit, forcing the generation backbone to infer weather evolution together with scene dynamics and camera motion, which leads to imprecise weather control. To address this limitation, we propose MeteoVerse, a unified weather-controllable video world model that generates future videos from a single sunny or adverse-weather image, conditioned on a weather-free scene description, a target-weather instruction, and a camera trajectory. Rather than conditioning only on the desired weather, MeteoVerse explicitly estimates the observed and target weather states and represents the required weather transition. A transition-aware mixture of weather experts then translates this transition into category-specific residual weather features, unifying weather preservation, introduction, and removal while enabling fine-grained control over introduced weather intensity. We further construct the MeteoVerse dataset with over 50K real-world weather video clips, generated sunny counterparts, disentangled scene and weather descriptions, weather-intensity annotations, and camera trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantially improved weather controllability while retaining competitive scene consistency and camera-control performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 MeteoVerse，一种统一且天气可控的视频世界模型，通过显式建模观测与目标天气间的过渡状态，实现晴朗或恶劣天气图像到未来视频的生成，支持天气的保持、引入与移除及强度精细控制。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型通常将天气过渡隐含处理，让生成主干同时推断天气演变、场景动态与相机运动，导致天气控制不精确。而真实场景演化不仅取决于视点和物体动态，还受天气等环境条件影响，天气建模需依赖观测与期望天气状态的联合关系。
AI.method: MeteoVerse 以单张图像、无天气场景描述、目标天气指令与相机轨迹为条件生成未来视频。模型显式估计观测与目标天气状态并表征所需天气过渡，采用过渡感知的天气专家混合（mixture of weather experts）将过渡转化为类别特定的残差天气特征，统一天气保持、引入与移除，并支持引入天气强度的细粒度控制。同时构建 MeteoVerse 数据集，含 5 万余真实天气视频片段、生成的晴朗对应帧、解耦的场景与天气描述、天气强度标注及相机轨迹。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MeteoVerse 在显著提升天气可控性的同时，保持了具有竞争力的场景一致性与相机控制性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模天气过渡状态并解耦天气与场景动态，MeteoVerse 有效解决了视频世界模型中天气控制不精确的问题，实现了统一的天气可控视频生成。

title: CurvSpec: Adaptive Multi-Curvature Learning for Partial Relevant Video Retrieval
summary: Partially Relevant Video Retrieval (PRVR) seeks to retrieve untrim-med videos containing a moment that matches a text query, without temporal annotations. The relevant moment may last only seconds within a video spanning several minutes, creating an extremely low signal-to-noise ratio that makes PRVR more challenging than standard full-video retrieval. This task presents two intertwined challenges: (1) signal dilution, where coarse global representations blur the brief relevant signal into the dominant irrelevant surroundings;(2) curvature rigidity, where embedding all videos in the same fixed-geometry space distorts representations for videos that range from flat atomic events to deep compositional hierarchies. Existing PRVR methods have improved moment selection and cross-modal matching, but they still typically encode all videos in a single fixed-curvature retrieval space, limiting their ability to model diverse video structures. To address both challenges, we propose CurvSpec, a framework that learns content-adaptive curvature for video retrieval representations rather than imposing a fixed geometric prior. CurvSpec processes features through parallel Euclidean and hyperbolic attention layers, with independently learned curvatures assigned to the hyperbolic layers, and a content-aware fusion mechanism routes each input to its most suitable geometric regime. To further suppress signal dilution, CurvSpec represents each video with semantic centroids whose number is determined by the video's content complexity, projects them onto the learned manifold, and matches each query against its nearest centroid by geodesic distance. Experiments on ActivityNet Captions, TVR, and Charades-STA demonstrate state-of-the-art retrieval performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CurvSpec 框架，通过内容自适应曲率学习与语义质心表示，解决部分相关视频检索（PRVR）中的信号稀释与曲率刚性问题，在多个基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: PRVR 需在无时序标注下从未剪辑视频中检索与文本查询匹配的片段。相关片段可能仅持续数秒而视频长达数分钟，信噪比极低。现有方法面临两大交织挑战：(1) 信号稀释，粗粒度全局表示将短暂的相关信号淹没于主导的无关内容中；(2) 曲率刚性，将结构从扁平原子事件到深层组合层次的各类视频统一嵌入固定几何空间会扭曲表示。已有方法虽改进了片段选择与跨模态匹配，但仍普遍采用单一固定曲率检索空间，难以建模多样视频结构。
AI.method: 提出 CurvSpec：不预设固定几何先验，而是学习内容自适应的曲率。特征经并行的欧几里得与双曲注意力层处理，各双曲层分配独立学习的曲率；内容感知融合机制将每个输入路由至最合适的几何机制。为抑制信号稀释，用语义质心表示每个视频，质心数量由视频内容复杂度决定，并将其投影至所学流形上，通过测地距离将查询与最近质心匹配。
AI.result: 在 ActivityNet Captions、TVR 和 Charades-STA 三个数据集上的实验表明，CurvSpec 取得了当前最优的检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过内容自适应曲率学习与复杂度驱动的语义质心表示，CurvSpec 同时缓解了信号稀释与曲率刚性两大问题，验证了自适应几何在部分相关视频检索中的有效性，为 PRVR 提供了新的建模范式。

title: CorrGRPO: Correlation-Normalized GRPO for Multi-Reward Learning
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used to train reasoning language models, where it computes advantages by centering and normalizing rewards across rollouts of the same prompt. For multiple rewards, GRPO sums the reward components and normalizes the total reward by its within-group standard deviation. The corresponding variance equals the sum of all pairwise reward covariances. For a fixed centered reward, larger aggregate covariance produces smaller advantages, and vice versa, allowing update magnitudes to adapt to reward dependence. However, correlated rewards with large scales can dominate this normalization and suppress signals from smaller-scale rewards. We propose Correlation-Normalized GRPO (CorrGRPO), which normalizes pairwise covariances into Pearson correlation coefficients. CorrGRPO keeps the centered total reward unchanged while balancing the influence of differently scaled rewards on the correlation-based normalization. This allows advantage magnitudes to adapt to reward correlations without the normalization being dominated by large-scale reward components. We compare CorrGRPO with GRPO and other variants on code generation, tool calling, and agent security, using models ranging from 0.5B to 8B parameters. These tasks all involve multiple rewards that can improve together or present tradeoffs. Results show improvements across three domains, including code generation, tool calling, and agent security. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/CorrGRPO.

AI.tldr: 提出 CorrGRPO，将 GRPO 中基于协方差的奖励归一化改为基于皮尔逊相关系数的归一化，在保持中心化总奖励不变的同时，避免大尺度相关奖励主导归一化过程，从而在代码生成、工具调用与智能体安全三个多奖励任务上取得提升。
AI.motivation: GRPO 在多奖励场景下通过对总奖励做组内标准化计算优势，其方差等于所有奖励对的协方差之和。当相关奖励尺度较大时，协方差会主导归一化项，压制小尺度奖励的信号，导致优势更新失衡。作者希望对奖励依赖性的建模与奖励的绝对尺度解耦。
AI.method: 提出 Correlation-Normalized GRPO（CorrGRPO）：将 GRPO 归一化中的两两协方差替换为皮尔逊相关系数，使归一化项不再随奖励尺度放大。该方法保持中心化总奖励不变，仅调整归一化机制，使优势幅度依据奖励间的相关性（而非协方差）自适应，从而平衡不同尺度奖励对归一化的影响。
AI.result: 在代码生成、工具调用和智能体安全三类任务上，使用 0.5B 至 8B 参数规模的模型，将 CorrGRPO 与 GRPO 及其他变体进行比较。这些任务均涉及多个可共同提升或存在权衡的奖励。结果显示 CorrGRPO 在三个领域均取得性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 基于相关性的归一化能够在不改变中心化总奖励的前提下，缓解大尺度奖励对 GRPO 优势归一化的主导问题，验证了在多奖励强化学习中对奖励依赖建模时去尺度化的重要性，并为推理语言模型训练提供了可推广的改进方案。

title: RED: Reconstruction Evolution Dynamics for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: The rapid evolution of image generators calls for forensic cues that generalize beyond known generation mechanisms. Existing detectors often rely on static image representations or endpoint reconstruction discrepancies, leaving the evolution of intermediate reconstruction stages underexplored. We observe that the relative token predictability of real and generated images can reverse across reconstruction scales, suggesting that intermediate stages may expose forensic evidence overlooked by endpoint comparisons. Motivated by this observation, we propose RED (Reconstruction Evolution Dynamics), a framework that captures transferable forensic cues from coarse-to-fine reconstruction evolution. To our knowledge, RED is the first framework to use scale-wise token predictability to guide forensic evidence aggregation across intermediate reconstruction states. It represents the reconstruction trajectory produced by a frozen multiscale VQ-VAE in the shared feature space of a frozen CLIP encoder. To connect the observed predictability variations with visual evidence, RED learns image-adaptive stage weights from scale-wise token negative log-likelihoods provided by a frozen VAR model. A cross-stage evidence aggregation module then jointly models the original-image representation and the weighted reconstruction features, capturing complementary forensic cues through interactions along the reconstruction trajectory. Experiments on six diverse benchmarks demonstrate that RED achieves the highest average accuracy of 92.5\% and average precision of 97.5\% among the evaluated methods. Further evaluations show strong robustness to common image degradations, supporting the value of reconstruction evolution for generalizable AI-generated image detection. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance of this paper.

AI.tldr: 提出RED框架，利用多尺度VQ-VAE重建轨迹中尺度级token可预测性变化作为可迁移取证线索，在六个基准上达到平均92.5%准确率与97.5%精度。
AI.motivation: 图像生成器快速演进，现有检测器依赖静态图像表示或端点重建差异，忽视了重建过程中间阶段的演变；作者观察到真实与生成图像的相对token可预测性会在不同重建尺度间发生反转，提示中间阶段蕴含被端点比较忽略的取证证据。
AI.method: RED将冻结的多尺度VQ-VAE产生的重建轨迹表示在冻结CLIP编码器的共享特征空间中；利用冻结VAR模型给出的尺度级token负对数似然，学习图像自适应的阶段权重，将可预测性变化与视觉证据关联；跨阶段证据聚合模块联合建模原图表示与加权重建特征，沿重建轨迹交互互补取证线索。
AI.result: 在六个多样化基准上，RED在所评估方法中取得最高平均准确率92.5%和平均精度97.5%；进一步评估显示其对常见图像退化具有较强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 重建演化动态为可泛化的AI生成图像检测提供了有效价值，RED首次以尺度级token可预测性指导跨中间重建状态的取证证据聚合，代码将在论文录用后公开。

title: Learning via Self-Consistency for Diffusion-based Video Reasoning
comment: 23 pages, including 10 pages for the main body
summary: Video generation models have demonstrated emerging zero-shot capabilities for visual reasoning, perception, and other vision tasks. However, diffusion-based video generation is inherently stochastic, while many downstream vision tasks are deterministic. Motivated by the effectiveness of self-consistency in chain-of-thought reasoning for large language models, we investigate whether self-consistency can similarly improve diffusion-based video reasoning. We first introduce a training-free test-time scaling method that samples multiple video generations and aggregates their predictions through self-consistency. Specifically, we aggregate extracted paths, locations, or masks from multiple rollouts into a consensus prediction. To reduce the inference overhead of multi-rollout generation, we read out predictions early in the denoising trajectory, which preserves consensus quality while reducing denoising steps by more than half. We further propose Rejection Fine-Tuning (RFT) to distill consensus predictions into the video generation model. The resulting model internalizes the benefit of multi-sample consensus and requires only a single generation at inference time, while substantially outperforming the original model. Experiments on three tasks, including maze solving, visual search, and referring segmentation, show that both our self-consistency inference and consensus distillation dramatically improve video-based perception and reasoning, without requiring ground-truth videos or task-specific verification. For visual search, self-consistency raises task accuracy from 48.4% for a single generation to 99.0%. The distilled model retains much of the consensus benefit with a single rollout. For 4-by-4 maze solving, consensus-based training improves the single-generation strict success rate from 72.0% to 84.0% with the same inference latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向扩散视频生成模型的自一致性测试时扩展方法，并通过拒绝微调（RFT）将多轮采样的共识结论蒸馏回模型，使其单次生成即可获得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散式视频生成具有内在随机性，而许多下游视觉任务（如视觉搜索、迷宫求解、指代分割）是确定性的。受大语言模型中自一致性提升思维链推理效果的启发，作者探究自一致性是否同样能增强基于扩散的视频推理能力。
AI.method: 1）免训练测试时扩展：对同一输入采样多条视频生成轨迹，将各轨迹中提取的路径、位置或掩码聚合为共识预测；2）在去噪轨迹早期读出预测，在保持共识质量的同时将去噪步数减少一半以上，降低多轮推理开销；3）拒绝微调（RFT）：将共识预测蒸馏进视频生成模型，使模型内化多采样共识的收益，推理时只需单次生成。
AI.result: 在迷宫求解、视觉搜索、指代分割三个任务上，自一致性推理与共识蒸馏均显著提升视频感知与推理性能，且无需真值视频或任务特定验证器。视觉搜索任务准确率由单次生成的48.4%提升至99.0%；蒸馏模型以单次推理保留了大部分共识收益。4×4迷宫求解中，基于共识的训练在相同推理延迟下将单次生成严格成功率从72.0%提升至84.0%。
AI.conclusion: 自一致性可有效迁移至扩散式视频推理，结合早期读出与共识蒸馏，能在不增加推理延迟的前提下大幅提升确定性视觉任务的表现，为视频生成模型作为通用视觉推理器提供了可行路径。

title: Motion Concept Unlearning in Video Diffusion Models
comment: Accepted to ACM MM 2026. Dr. Chi Zhang is the corresponding author
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models can generate realistic depictions of actions such as kicking, stabbing, and shooting, raising safety concerns that motivate targeted concept erasure. Although concept erasure has been extensively studied for static concepts in text-to-image and T2V models, erasing motion concepts remains largely unexplored. We present a systematic study of motion concept erasure in video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). Through causal interventions, we show that text-conditioning attention carries concept-specific motion information and supports selective intervention, whereas perturbing temporal positional encoding suppresses both target and non-target dynamics. We further find that directly adapting ESD, a representative weight-level image erasure method, to a video DiT yields modest and uneven motion suppression: reducing its erasure training loss does not by itself remove the concept signal from the difference between the conditional and unconditional predictions, which classifier-free guidance (CFG) then scales at every denoising step. From these findings, we derive three requirements for motion concept erasure: concept specificity, spatial selectivity, and temporal naturalness. Each determines one component of MUTE (Motion concept Unlearning in Text-to-video gEneration): at each denoising step, MUTE extracts a concept direction through token neutralization, derives a spatial gate from the direction's intrinsic structure, and subtracts the resulting correction from the velocity output before CFG is applied. MUTE is training-free and requires no weight modification. Experiments on 20 motion concepts show that MUTE outperforms representative prompt-level, weight-level, and inference-time baselines on Wan2.1-T2V, and the same formulation transfers to CogVideoX, supporting its applicability across distinct T2V attention architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出运动概念擦除的系统性研究，并给出免训练方法MUTE，在视频DiT中高效抹除特定运动概念且保持非目标动态。
AI.motivation: T2V扩散模型能生成踢打、刺击、射击等真实动作视频，带来安全隐患，需针对性擦除；然而现有概念擦除研究多针对静态概念，运动概念擦除几乎空白。
AI.method: 通过因果干预定位机制：文本条件注意力携带概念特异运动信息且可选择性干预，扰动时间位置编码会同时抑制目标与非目标动态。据此提出三项要求（概念特异性、空间选择性、时间自然性），并构建MUTE：每步去噪时经token中和提取概念方向，由其内在结构导出空间门控，在CFG前从速度输出中减去修正量；全程免训练、不改权重。
AI.result: 在20个运动概念上，MUTE在Wan2.1-T2V上优于提示级、权重级与推理时基线；同一形式可迁移至CogVideoX，验证跨T2V注意力架构的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 运动概念擦除需同时满足概念特异性、空间选择性与时间自然性；基于文本条件注意力干预的免训练框架MUTE有效且可跨架构迁移。

title: You Cannot Recover What Was Never Measured: Quantifying the Information Ceiling of Ultra-Low-Field MRI Super-Resolution
summary: Generative super-resolution models can turn portable 64 mT MRI into images that look like 3T scans, and the field evaluates them with PSNR, SSIM, and pixelwise uncertainty, most often on pairs built by synthetically degrading high-field images. Prior work acknowledges that these models hallucinate and that the problem is ill posed, but to our knowledge no study measures how much information about the individual subject the real low-field scan actually contains. We measure it. Using paired 64 mT and 3T scans of the same subjects from three public datasets, and a measurement protocol validated on tests whose correct answer is known in advance, we find that, judged over the whole brain, real 64 mT scans carry structure specific to the individual only down to approximately 3 to 4 mm half-pitch in plane, and coarser still through plane. Standard synthetic degradations preserve subject information roughly 1 mm beyond this ceiling, so models trained and benchmarked on synthetic pairs are evaluated on information that real scanners never record. We then test trained diffusion models and a publicly released external model on real paired acquisitions; 24 trained runs of five architectures (GAN, diffusion, and transformer families) give the coverage of the audit. On every subject where faithfulness can be measured, fine output detail is no more correlated with the subject's own 3T scan than with a stranger's, while sample-variance uncertainty does not distinguish fabricated structure from reconstruction difficulty. Because PSNR and SSIM score resemblance to a reference rather than whether detail belongs to the subject, a benchmark scored by them cannot tell recovery from fabrication. Code for the measurement protocol will be released so that recoverability claims can be tested for newer models.

AI.tldr: 该研究测量了真实64 mT低场MRI所含个体特有信息的上限（约3–4 mm平面半周期），发现合成退化对保留了超出此上限的信息，导致现有生成超分模型的评测基准高估其可信度。
AI.motivation: 生成式超分模型能将便携64 mT MRI"美化"为3T外观，但领域常用PSNR/SSIM和像素级不确定性评测，且多在合成退化的高场图像对上评测。既有工作承认模型会幻觉、问题病态，但尚无研究量化真实低场扫描究竟包含多少个体受试者信息。
AI.method: 采用三个公开数据集中同一受试者的64 mT与3T配对扫描，使用一套在已知正确答案的测试上验证过的测量协议，从全脑范围量化真实64 mT扫描所携带的个体特异结构信息；并将该上限与标准合成退化所保留的信息作对比。随后对训练好的扩散模型及一个公开外部模型在真实配对采集上测试，共24次训练、覆盖5种架构（GAN、扩散、Transformer族）。
AI.result: 真实64 mT扫描在全脑范围内仅保留约3–4 mm平面半周期的个体特异结构，层间更粗；标准合成退化比该上限多保留约1 mm的信息。在所有可测faithfulness的受试者上，模型输出的精细细节与受试者自身3T扫描的相关性并不高于与陌生人的3T扫描；样本方差不确定性无法区分虚构结构与重建困难。
AI.conclusion: 由于PSNR和SSIM衡量的是与参考图像的相似度而非细节是否属于该受试者，以此评分的基准无法区分"恢复"与"虚构"。研究将公开测量协议代码，以便对新模型的可恢复性主张进行检验。

title: On-Policy Visual Evidence Distillation
comment: 44 pages, including appendices. Project page: https://sylvain-wei.github.io/ReVuE/ . Code: https://github.com/sylvain-wei/ReVuE
summary: Visual agents solve problems by interleaving reasoning with image operations, and on-policy distillation (OPD) provides guidance from a strong teacher on student-generated interaction trajectories. However, image operations change the evidence available for subsequent reasoning, so local errors in evidence acquisition (Acquire), reading (Read), or answer grounding (Ground) can propagate through the trajectory and lead to incorrect answers. Existing multimodal OPD methods primarily construct or contrast auxiliary views of the original image to strengthen supervision, without explicitly modeling the connections between student actions, resulting observations, and subsequent reasoning. This limits their ability to provide corrections tailored to different failure stages. We introduce Reflection on Visual Evidence (ReVuE), an on-policy distillation method for visual agents. ReVuE compares multiple student-generated trajectories for the same query, summarizes the observed visual evidence, and diagnoses the first failure across the Acquire, Read, and Ground stages. The resulting reflections provide training-time context for the teacher. We group and reweight token-level distillation losses according to how strongly these reflections affect the teacher's predictions. This design translates trajectory-level evidence diagnosis into targeted token-level supervision, guiding students to improve their visual evidence acquisition and reasoning. Across 11 benchmarks spanning the Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3.5 model families, ReVuE outperforms all evaluated OPD baselines in weighted-average scores for perception, mathematical reasoning, and general tasks. ReVuE also reduces redundancy in reasoning and tool calls while improving tool-call accuracy and task accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/sylvain-wei/ReVuE

AI.tldr: ReVuE 是一种面向视觉智能体的 on-policy 蒸馏方法，通过对比多条学生轨迹诊断首个失败阶段（获取、读取、定位），并将轨迹级证据诊断转化为针对性的 token 级监督。
AI.motivation: 视觉智能体通过推理与图像操作交替解决问题，但图像操作会改变后续推理所依赖的证据，因此获取、读取或定位阶段的局部错误会沿轨迹传播导致错误答案。现有多模态 OPD 方法主要构建或对比原图辅助视图来加强监督，未显式建模学生动作、观测结果与后续推理之间的联系，难以针对不同失败阶段提供定制化纠正。
AI.method: ReVuE 对同一查询的多条学生生成轨迹进行对比，总结观测到的视觉证据，并诊断 Acquire、Read、Ground 三阶段中的首个失败。所得反思作为训练时上下文提供给教师模型。依据这些反思对教师预测的影响强度，对 token 级蒸馏损失进行分组与重新加权，从而将轨迹级证据诊断转化为针对性的 token 级监督。
AI.result: 在覆盖 Qwen2.5-VL 与 InternVL3.5 模型家族的 11 个基准上，ReVuE 在感知、数学推理与通用任务的加权平均得分上优于所有评估的 OPD 基线，同时减少了推理与工具调用中的冗余，并提升了工具调用准确率与任务准确率。
AI.conclusion: ReVuE 通过显式建模学生动作、观测与后续推理的联系，将轨迹级失败诊断转化为细粒度监督信号，有效提升视觉智能体的证据获取与推理能力；代码已开源。

title: Does the VGGT Family Need All Its Layers?
summary: Which layers of a feed-forward geometry model are needed to preserve both camera poses and dense 3D structure? We study layer redundancy in VGGT, $π^3$, and VGGT-$Ω$: 3,018 pruned configurations, scored on seven camera-pose and dense-geometry metrics across four indoor and outdoor datasets. Four findings follow: (i) Removable layers cluster in two redundancy regions: a dominant early region and a narrower late one, while deletions spanning the intervening layers are consistently more disruptive. This recurring pattern holds across models, datasets, and metrics, and contrasts with the middle-to-late redundancy commonly reported in the literature. (ii) Within these regions, we observe that the joint degradation from deleting two intervals is approximately the sum of their individual degradations, reducing the number of model evaluations for pruning search from $O(L^4)$ to $O(L^2)$, where $L$ is the aggregator depth. (iii) We find that CKA provides a cheaper representation-based proxy for interval degradation, offering a practical trade-off between pruning quality and calibration cost. (iv) Closed-form linear calibration recovers accuracy after pruning without end-to-end retraining. A least-squares analysis shows that using a shared map for special and patch tokens generally incurs excess reconstruction loss, motivating token-aware recovery. Recovery maps fitted on just 100 calibration scenes generalize to held-out scenes and unseen datasets. The resulting models reduce aggregator parameters by up to 44% while maintaining accuracy comparable to their intact counterparts. Code and experimental results will be available at our project page: https://xian-bei.github.io/vggt-family-layer-redundancy/

AI.tldr: 该研究系统分析了前馈几何模型（VGGT、π³、VGGT-Ω）的层冗余，通过3018种剪枝配置在7个位姿与稠密几何指标上评测，发现可移除层集中于早期主区域与晚期次区域，且双区间退化近似可加，使搜索复杂度从O(L⁴)降至O(L²)，并可用CKA代理与闭式线性校准实现无需端到端重训练的恢复，聚合器参数最多减少44%。
AI.motivation: 探究前馈几何模型（如VGGT系列）中哪些层对同时保持相机位姿与稠密3D结构是必要的，以理解其层冗余结构并指导高效剪枝。
AI.method: 对VGGT、π³、VGGT-Ω进行3018种剪枝配置，在四个室内外数据集的七个相机位姿与稠密几何指标上评分；分析双区间删除的退化可加性、CKA作为区间退化的廉价代理，以及闭式线性校准（含token-aware恢复映射）。
AI.result: 发现四类结果：(i) 可移除层聚集于早期主冗余区和较窄的晚期区域，跨中间层的删除更具破坏性，且该模式跨模型、数据集与指标一致；(ii) 双区间联合退化约等于各自退化之和，将剪枝搜索从O(L⁴)降至O(L²)；(iii) CKA可作为区间退化的廉价代理；(iv) 闭式线性校准可无需端到端重训练恢复精度，100个校准场景拟合的恢复映射可泛化至留出场景与未见数据集，聚合器参数最多减少44%且精度与完整模型相当。
AI.conclusion: 前馈几何模型存在可预测的层冗余结构，结合可加性近似、CKA代理与token-aware闭式校准，可在不重训练的情况下实现最高44%聚合器参数压缩并保持精度。

title: GlassFormer: Learning Real-time Glass Segmentation using Radar-Depth Fusion
comment: Accepted for presentation at IEEE IROS 2026. Code available at https://github.com/Suhani92/GlassFormer
summary: Transparent surfaces are ubiquitous in built environments, yet they remain a persistent failure case for robotic perception. RGB cameras perceive the background behind glass rather than the surface itself, while depth sensors such as LiDAR, time-of-flight, and RGB-D often return invalid or background measurements in transparent regions. As a result, systems that rely solely on optical sensing may misinterpret glass walls, doors, or mirrors as free space, compromising safe and reliable navigation. Existing glass segmentation approaches address this by learning visual cues such as reflections, boundaries, and semantic context from RGB images. While effective under favourable lighting and viewing conditions, these cues degrade in low-light environments, under glare, or when glass surfaces are featureless or partially occluded. In this work, we propose a multimodal framework that fuses millimetre-wave radar with RGB-D sensing for real-time transparent surface segmentation. Radar reflects strongly off glass surfaces, providing a geometric cue that remains reliable precisely where vision and depth fail. We exploit this cross-modal inconsistency to generate a radar-guided spatial prior, which is integrated into a lightweight transformer-based segmentation network, GlassFormer, via cross-modal attention. We report results on a mixed-condition test split covering all scene types and a dedicated low-light split designed to stress vision-only methods. GlassFormer achieves 0.88 mIoU on the mixed split, and 0.59 mIoU on the low light split, demonstrating substantial robustness gains over vision-only baselines while maintaining real-time performance on resource-constrained platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出融合毫米波雷达与RGB-D的多模态框架GlassFormer，通过跨模态注意力利用雷达反射的几何先验实现实时透明表面分割。
AI.motivation: 透明表面（玻璃墙、门、镜子）是机器人感知的固有失效场景：RGB相机看到的是玻璃后的背景，LiDAR、ToF、RGB-D等深度传感器在透明区域返回无效或背景测量，导致系统将玻璃误判为自由空间，危害导航安全。现有玻璃分割方法依赖RGB图像中的反射、边界、语义等视觉线索，在低光、眩光、无纹理或部分遮挡条件下性能显著下降。
AI.method: 提出融合毫米波雷达与RGB-D的多模态框架，用于实时透明表面分割。利用雷达对玻璃表面的强反射特性，获取在视觉与深度失效处依然可靠的几何线索；基于跨模态不一致性生成雷达引导的空间先验，并通过跨模态注意力将其集成到轻量级Transformer分割网络GlassFormer中。
AI.result: 在覆盖全部场景类型的混合条件测试集上，GlassFormer达到0.88 mIoU；在专门针对纯视觉方法设计的低光测试集上达到0.59 mIoU，相较纯视觉基线取得显著鲁棒性提升，同时在资源受限平台上保持实时性能。
AI.conclusion: 毫米波雷达与RGB-D的跨模态融合可有效弥补视觉与深度传感在透明表面上的失效，为透明环境下的机器人感知与导航提供了一种兼具鲁棒性与实时性的分割方案。

title: Rethinking Multimodal Fake News Detection in the Generative AI Era
summary: Generative content is increasingly entering the production and dissemination of news, transforming fake news from manually fabricated or simply manipulated material into complex forms in which native and generated content jointly participate. Existing multimodal fake news detection research primarily focuses on veracity assessment and rarely characterizes how generativity differences affect the reliability of evidence. In contrast, AIGC detection primarily determines whether content is generated or modified by generative models, but it does not by itself establish whether the underlying news event is true. To bridge the separation between these tasks in data and evaluation, we construct Weibo26, a multimodal fake news detection dataset for generative-content scenarios. On this basis, we propose the Generativity-Aware Hierarchical Reasoning (GAHR) framework, which combines global judgment with local correction so that generativity information participates in news-veracity reasoning. Experiments on multiple existing fake news detection benchmarks and Weibo26 show that GAHR achieves competitive veracity-detection performance while effectively identifying generative content.

AI.tldr: 本文针对生成内容融入新闻传播的现实，指出现有多模态假新闻检测偏重真实性判断、而AIGC检测只判断内容是否由生成模型产出，二者在数据与评估上割裂。为此构建了面向生成内容场景的多模态假新闻数据集Weibo26，并提出"生成性感知层级推理"（GAHR）框架，将全局判断与局部校正结合，使生成性信息参与真实性推理。实验表明GAHR在多个基准及Weibo26上检测性能有竞争力，并能有效识别生成内容。
AI.motivation: 生成内容日益进入新闻生产与传播，假新闻形态从人工编造或简单篡改转向原生内容与生成内容协同参与的复杂形式。现有多模态假新闻检测研究主要关注真实性判定，很少刻画"生成性差异"如何影响证据可靠性；而AIGC检测只判定内容是否由生成模型生成或修改，本身并不能确定新闻事件是否真实。两类任务在数据与评估上相互分离，导致生成性信息难以服务于新闻真实性推理。
AI.method: 1) 构建Weibo26——面向生成内容场景的多模态假新闻检测数据集；2) 提出Generativity-Aware Hierarchical Reasoning（GAHR，生成性感知层级推理）框架，采用全局判断与局部校正相结合的分层结构，将生成性信息纳入新闻真实性推理过程。
AI.result: 在多个现有多模态假新闻检测基准数据集和Weibo26上开展实验，GAHR在真实性检测上取得有竞争力的性能，同时能够有效识别生成内容。
AI.conclusion: 通过在数据与框架两个层面打通AIGC检测与多模态假新闻检测，GAHR验证了将生成性信息显式引入真实性推理的可行性，实现了真实性判断与生成性识别的一体化。

title: RoXDrive: Closed-Loop Reinforcement Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Action-Faithful Rollouts
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving policies are commonly trained via imitation learning on logged demonstrations without observing the consequences of their own actions, leading to causal confusion in closed-loop real-world deployment. To address this issue, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training offers a promising alternative by leveraging world models as interactive training environments to enable future scene generation for policy improvement. Nevertheless, existing approaches either rely on reconstruction-based simulators, offering limited counterfactual interaction, or adopt synthetic simulators to enable long-horizon closed-loop interaction at the cost of a substantial sim-to-real gap. Recently, video world models have exhibited the ability to generate realistic multi-step future rollouts but may not faithfully reflect action conditions, resulting in action-vision mismatch. In this paper, we introduce RoXDrive, a plug-and-play closed-loop RL framework that enables reliable policy optimization by identifying action-faithful world-model rollouts, consisting of two stages: 1) Model pre-training: In addition to imitation-based policy pre-training, we devise an Action-Vision Faithfulness Evaluator for inverse dynamics estimation with our geometry-aware auxiliary trajectory supervision, enabling long-horizon assessment of whether visual dynamics faithfully reflect the conditioning ego actions. 2) Action-faithful RL post-training: Agents iteratively interact with world models to form long-horizon scene rollouts, retaining only action-faithful ones for dense safety-aware scoring and scene-level closed-loop RL post-training. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and an in-house dataset with over 130K training scenarios demonstrate consistent gains across planners, reducing safety violations by 27.6% with DiffusionDrive on nuScenes and 33.7% with Qwen3-VL on the internal data.

AI.tldr: 提出RoXDrive：一种即插即用的闭环强化学习框架，通过识别"动作忠实"的世界模型推演来可靠优化端到端自动驾驶策略。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶策略通常以模仿学习在日志演示上训练，无法观察自身动作后果，导致闭环部署中的因果混淆。RL后训练可提供交互式改进，但现有方案要么依赖重建式模拟器（反事实交互能力有限），要么使用合成模拟器（存在巨大sim-to-real差距）。视频世界模型虽能生成真实的多步未来推演，却可能无法忠实反映动作条件，造成"动作-视觉不匹配"。
AI.method: RoXDrive包含两阶段：1）模型预训练——除基于模仿的策略预训练外，设计动作-视觉忠实度评估器（Action-Vision Faithfulness Evaluator），结合几何感知的辅助轨迹监督进行逆动力学估计，从而长时域评估视觉动态是否忠实反映条件化自车动作；2）动作忠实的RL后训练——智能体迭代与世界模型交互形成长时域场景推演，仅保留动作忠实的推演用于密集安全感知评分与场景级闭环RL后训练。
AI.result: 在nuScenes及包含超13万训练场景的内部数据集上大量实验表明，该方法在多种规划器上均取得一致提升：nuScenes上使用DiffusionDrive减少27.6%安全违规，内部数据上使用Qwen3-VL减少33.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过筛选动作忠实的视频世界模型推演，RoXDrive实现了即插即用、可靠的闭环RL策略优化，有效缓解因果混淆与动作-视觉不匹配问题，在真实数据集上显著降低安全违规率。

title: Socialality Anchors: Towards Group-bounded Trajectory Prediction
summary: Trajectory prediction is a key component for understanding human behavior patterns in dynamic scenes. Researchers have devoted substantial efforts to modeling social interactions, especially group-wise interactions, since group membership often reflects shared intention, coordinated motion, and stable mutual adaptation, thus providing a persistent and semantically meaningful social prior for forecasting. However, existing group modeling methods may rely on a fixed threshold and infer groups mainly from agents' relative positions within the observation window, overlooking the fact that grouping rules should be agent-specific, temporally coherent, and context-adaptive across diverse personalities, culturalities, and evolving interaction contexts. Inspired by human social perception that alternates between interpersonal distance in boundary-sensitive situations and relative speed consistency in dynamic interactions, we propose Socialality, a human-inspired trajectory prediction framework with interpretable Socialality anchors and an extended grouping window for stable, context-aware grouping inference. Concretely, Socialality introduces a duo-scalar-controlled grouping kernel Socialality that jointly leverages historical observations and short-term future trajectory previews to learn agent-specific grouping rules, and employs a group-wise perception mechanism to model in-group and out-of-group interactions in an intuitive and explainable manner. Furthermore, we conduct extensive experiments on standard benchmarks to demonstrate the performance gains of Socialality, and provide qualitative analyses and statistical studies of anchor distributions to verify the interpretability and stability of the proposed Socialality anchors.

AI.tldr: 提出Socialality框架，用可解释的"社交性锚点"和扩展分组窗口实现稳定、上下文自适应的轨迹预测分组推断。
AI.motivation: 群体成员关系反映共享意图、协调运动与稳定相互适应，是持久且语义化的社会先验；但现有分组建模依赖固定阈值、仅用观测窗内相对位置推断群体，忽略了分组规则应具备个体特异性、时间连续性与上下文自适应性。
AI.method: 受人类在边界敏感情境依赖人际距离、在动态交互中依赖相对速度一致性的社会感知启发，提出Socialality：引入双标量控制的"社交性"分组核，联合历史观测与短期未来轨迹预览，学习个体特异的分组规则；并采用组内/组外感知机制建模交互。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明性能提升；通过定性分析与锚点分布的统计研究验证了社交性锚点的可解释性与稳定性。
