SFT improves observed accuracy on all five benchmark splits, including a 4.17-point gain on HR-Bench 4K. Role-specific RL further reshapes search behavior: main-only RL reduces mean tool use from 2.65 to 2.11 with similar pass@1 in an internal four-response evaluation, while external accuracy changes are mixed. Joint training reveals an asymmetry between local evidence reading and global search control. Together, these results support VPS as an effective inference-time scaffold and a trainable decomposition for visual evidence acquisition.

AI.tldr: VPS是一种视觉并行搜索框架：主智能体先用grid_search并行检查图像分块，再自适应调用zoom_in定位精确或合并区域，兼顾免训练推理与后训练，在多数对比中提升高分辨率VQA准确率。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率视觉问答常因多模态模型未能获取回答所需的小尺度、空间局部证据而失败；顺序式缩放虽可恢复细节，但要求主模型在获得可靠全局概览前就选择区域，存在决策顺序上的矛盾。
AI.method: 提出VPS视觉并行搜索框架：主智能体首先调用grid_search，由问题条件化的子智能体并行检查图像分块，随后自适应调用zoom_in聚焦精确或合并区域。统一接口同时支持免训练推理与主/子智能体后训练。进一步构建带无提示验证的监督流水线，以及成对、角色特定的GRPO替代目标，用于学习控制器与分块读取器角色。
AI.result: 在五个基准划分和三种模型规模上，VPS在15组同模型对比中的14组优于专用zoom-only搜索，最高提升8.0分，对较小主模型增益尤为明显；ZoomBench在各测试规模上保持约3.2分增益。SFT在全部五个基准划分上提升观测准确率，HR-Bench 4K提升4.17分。角色特定RL进一步重塑搜索行为：仅主模型RL将内部四响应评估中的平均工具使用从2.65降至2.11且pass@1相近，外部准确率变化不一。联合训练揭示了局部证据读取与全局搜索控制之间的不对称性。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持VPS既可作为有效的推理期支架，也是一种可训练的视觉证据获取分解方案。

title: VesselBench-800K: A Large-scale Perception Benchmark for Multimodal Vessel Detection, Counting, and Density Estimation
summary: Vessel perception from space is crucial for a wide range of maritime applications, from traffic monitoring to environmental protection. However, most existing datasets predominantly focus on general object detection tasks in optical remote sensing (RS) images. Relying solely on single-modality optical RS images proves inadequate for effectively perceiving vessel objects in complex maritime scenarios, where ever-changing weather conditions (e.g., clouds and rain), the need for day-and-night coverage, and the inherent limitations of a single imaging modality pose significant challenges. To fill this gap, we introduce VesselBench-800K, the largest-to-date benchmark dataset on a global scale for vessel perception in multimodal RS images. As its name suggests, VesselBench-800K comprises 800,000 images, each at a resolution of 512x512 pixels, specifically curated for vessel perception tasks such as detection, counting, and density estimation. These multimodal image pairs (i.e., optical, SAR) are collected from diverse platforms, sensors, scenes, shooting heights, and synthetic sources, spanning spatial resolutions from 4.5m to 0.1m. Furthermore, we evaluate numerous state-of-the-art detection, counting, and density estimation models on VesselBench-800K through both qualitative and quantitative comparisons. By revealing previously unrecognized cues, this dataset holds immense potential to significantly advance our understanding of marine traffic. Our VesselBench dataset will be publicly available at https://github.com/danfenghong/IEEE_TGRS_VesselBench to support and contribute to community development.

AI.tldr: 提出迄今全球规模最大的多模态遥感船舶感知基准数据集VesselBench-800K，含80万张512×512的光学-SAR配对图像，覆盖4.5m至0.1m分辨率，支持检测、计数与密度估计任务，并评测多种SOTA模型。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集多聚焦光学遥感图像中的通用目标检测，单一模态在复杂海上场景（云雨天气、昼夜覆盖需求、成像模态固有局限）下难以有效感知船舶目标，缺乏多模态、多任务、全球尺度的船舶感知基准。
AI.method: 构建VesselBench-800K：收集来自多样平台、传感器、场景、拍摄高度及合成来源的光学与SAR多模态配对图像，共80万张512×512分辨率图像，空间分辨率覆盖4.5m至0.1m；针对检测、计数与密度估计任务进行标注；在统一基准上对多种SOTA检测、计数与密度估计模型开展定性与定量对比评测。
AI.result: 建成全球规模最大的多模态遥感船舶感知数据集，涵盖广泛平台、传感器、场景、高度与合成源，分辨率跨度大；通过多模型定性与定量对比揭示以往未被识别的线索，验证数据集的挑战性与价值。
AI.conclusion: VesselBench-800K填补了多模态遥感船舶感知基准的空白，可显著推进海上交通理解研究；数据集将公开于https://github.com/danfenghong/IEEE_TGRS_VesselBench，以支持社区发展。

title: World2Motion: Turning Video World Models into 3D Human Motion Generators
summary: We present World2Motion, a framework that generates scene-aware 3D human motion and corresponding video from a single image and a text prompt. While existing 3D motion generators learn from motion datasets, their generalization is constrained by limited coverage of environments. In contrast, video world models such as Cosmos 3 offer broader environmental priors but are not designed for full-body motion generation; recovering motion from their generated videos requires costly two-stage inference. To address these, we turn Cosmos 3 into a single-stage 3D motion generator. This adaptation has two challenges: the scarcity of paired video--motion data and temporal instability in the generated motion. First, we construct a training dataset combining synthetic video--motion pairs with real videos paired with estimated 3D motion. Second, we propose a shift-decoupled noise schedule that assigns different noise levels to video and motion through shared denoising progress. This design accommodates the different denoising requirements of the two modalities, reducing motion jitter. Experiments on a multi-source interaction benchmark show that World2Motion has better motion--text alignment and scene interaction compared with the evaluated 3D motion generators. It also matches the interaction success rate of the two-stage baseline while achieving approximately 3.3$\times$ faster inference. Our project page is available at https://fyantu.github.io/World2Motion/.

AI.tldr: World2Motion 将 Cosmos 3 视频世界模型改造为单阶段 3D 人体运动生成器，通过构建混合训练数据集与移位解耦噪声调度，实现从单张图像和文本提示生成场景感知的 3D 人体运动及对应视频。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 运动生成器依赖运动数据集，环境覆盖有限导致泛化性受限；而 Cosmos 3 等视频世界模型虽具更广的环境先验，却不支持全身运动生成，从其生成视频中恢复运动需昂贵的两阶段推理。
AI.method: 将 Cosmos 3 转变为单阶段 3D 运动生成器，针对配对视频-运动数据稀缺与时序不稳定两大挑战，构建合成视频-运动对与真实视频配估计 3D 运动的混合训练数据集，并提出移位解耦噪声调度，通过共享去噪进程为视频与运动分配不同噪声水平。
AI.result: 在多源交互基准上，World2Motion 相比所评估的 3D 运动生成器具有更好的运动-文本对齐与场景交互；交互成功率与两阶段基线相当，同时推理速度约提升 3.3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明可将视频世界模型高效适配为单阶段 3D 运动生成器，在保持交互成功率的条件下显著提升推理效率，为场景感知运动生成提供了新范式。

title: Embedded Bi-Temporal Building Damage Assessment for On-Board Data Reduction
comment: 8 pages. Accepted at OBPDC 2026 (International Workshop on On-Board Payload Data Compression), Barcelona, October 2026
summary: Rapid assessment of building damage after natural disasters is essential to support emergency response. Earth Observation satellites can acquire relevant imagery shortly after an event, but exploitation is limited by uplink and downlink capacity and by ground-processing latency. We address this with a bi-temporal building damage assessment pipeline built on a siamese detector derived from YOLOX, designed to compress information at both ends of the ground/space link. On the ground, pre-disaster reference images are encoded into a compact latent space -- compressed by up to a factor of 64 -- and uplinked to the satellite. On board, this reference is compared with a fresh post-disaster acquisition so that the downlink carries only actionable object-level products, bounding boxes and damage classes, instead of full scenes. This cuts the data exchanged in both directions, while on xBD the strongly compressed reference still preserves most of the detection performance. Because on-board acquisitions suffer from residual pre/post co-registration errors, we introduce a latent-space shift estimation and correction module that regresses the global offset from the coarse feature level and realigns the post-disaster features before fusion. It substantially improves robustness to de-registration -- especially under large shifts, where fusion-only variants collapse -- while also raising nominal accuracy and remaining compatible with the strongest compression. We finally port the pipeline to two embedded targets, a Xilinx Versal VCK190 and an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, and report hardware performance (latency, throughput, power efficiency). The core detector and its compression port cleanly to both, but the operators needed for long-range robustness survive only on the Jetson GPU, whereas the Versal DPU does not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于YOLOX孪生检测器的双时相建筑损毁评估流水线，通过地面端隐空间压缩上行、星上端仅下传目标级产品来压缩天地链路数据，并引入隐空间位移估计与校正模块提升配准误差鲁棒性，最后在VCK190与Jetson AGX Orin两个嵌入式平台完成部署评测。
AI.motivation: 自然灾害后的建筑损毁快速评估对应急响应至关重要。遥感卫星虽能快速获取影像，但上行/下行链路容量有限、地面处理时延大，制约了数据的高效利用。因此需要在天地链路两端压缩信息，并将处理前移至星上。
AI.method: 构建由YOLOX衍生的孪生检测器双时相损毁评估流水线：地面端将灾前参考影像编码为紧凑隐空间表示（压缩率最高达64倍）并上传；星上将该参考与灾后新采集影像比对，下传仅含边界框与损毁类别的目标级产品。针对星上残余的前后时相配准误差，引入隐空间位移估计与校正模块：在粗特征层回归全局偏移，融合前对灾后特征进行重对齐。最后将流水线移植至Xilinx Versal VCK190与NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin两个嵌入式平台。
AI.result: 在xBD数据集上，即使参考影像被强压缩仍能保留大部分检测性能；位移校正模块显著提升对去配准的鲁棒性，尤其在大位移下优于仅融合变体，同时提高标称精度并与最强压缩兼容。硬件评测显示，核心检测器及其压缩版本可干净移植至两平台，但实现长程鲁棒性所需的算子仅在Jetson GPU上可行，Versal DPU不支持。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了在天地链路两端压缩信息的星上建筑损毁评估可行性，配准校正模块是保障鲁棒性的关键，但长程鲁棒算子的嵌入式部署受硬件算子支持限制，GPU平台比DPU更具兼容性。

title: RBF-GNN: Rational Basis Functions for Pseudo-Coordinate based Graph Convolutions
summary: We propose RBF-GNN, a new pseudo-coordinate based graph neural network architecture that takes into account Euclidean, spherical or angular coordinates and uses them to induce a powerful spatial inductive bias. Similar in architecture to SplineCNN, we improve upon the latter by replacing the less efficient sparse-activation based B-splines whose number grows exponentially with dimension by rational Padé basis functions. For effective training we propose a spline-subspace initialization and a variance-preserving weight rescaling. Experimentally, we evaluate on a number of popular neural network architectures that use SplineCNNs. We replace only the SplineCNNs with RBF-GNN. We achieve improved results, including on semantic keypoint matching, shape matching, event based camera computer vision tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/pawelswoboda/RationalBasisCNN.

AI.tldr: 提出RBF-GNN，用有理Padé基函数替代SplineCNN中随维度指数增长的稀疏B样条，并配合样条子空间初始化与方差保持权重重缩放，在多种任务上取得改进。
AI.motivation: SplineCNN采用的稀疏激活B样条基函数数量随维度指数增长，效率较低，需要更高效的伪坐标图神经网络架构以引入空间归纳偏置。
AI.method: RBF-GNN：基于伪坐标的图神经网络，考虑欧氏、球面或角度坐标以引入空间归纳偏置；架构类似SplineCNN，但用有理Padé基函数替换稀疏B样条；训练上采用样条子空间初始化和方差保持的权重重缩放。
AI.result: 在多种使用SplineCNN的神经网络架构上，仅将SplineCNN替换为RBF-GNN，即在语义关键点匹配、形状匹配和事件相机视觉任务上取得改进结果。
AI.conclusion: RBF-GNN通过有理Padé基函数与针对性训练策略，可高效引入空间归纳偏置，并作为SplineCNN的即插即用替代在多个任务上提升性能；代码已开源。

title: Actions with Receipts: Jointly Binding Claims, Evidence, and Execution for Replayable Tool-Agent Auditing
summary: Tool-using agents can expose citations and execution logs while leaving a critical association unaudited: whether the claim shown to a user is the claim emitted by the committed execution and supported by the cited source. A valid citation and a valid trace can therefore remain individually well formed while being transplanted across claims, actions, runs, or source versions. We introduce a claim-anchored execution contract that jointly binds the emitted claim, its exact source span, the ordered execution prefix that produced it, and the source version and access state observed by that execution. Each receipt contains an emission anchor that deterministically locates the claim inside a committed answer or claim-bearing action, together with source identifiers, offsets, hashes, quotes, and a domain-separated execution commitment. A deterministic integrity verifier reconstructs these bindings before semantic or task labels are joined. We separate this integrity plane from a pluggable support plane, so structural validity is not used as a proxy for entailment. The contract exposes seven independently testable properties: claim-emission binding, source binding, ordered-execution binding, oracle separation, persisted-object replay, execution-rerun consistency, and version/access binding. Across 1,280 cross-object attacks, the joint contract detects 1,275 substitutions (0.9961). Removing a targeted property reduces its attack-detection rate to 0.0156-0.0625. On an independently adjudicated 384-pair split, the conflict-aware support guard reaches F1 0.8865 and false acceptance 0.0729; on unseen failure families, these rates are 0.8679 and 0.0938.

AI.tldr: 提出"声明锚定执行契约"（claim-anchored execution contract），将声明、源片段、有序执行前缀及源版本/访问状态联合绑定，用确定性完整性验证器与可插拔支持平面分离，检测跨对象移植攻击。
AI.motivation: 工具调用型智能体虽会暴露引用与执行日志，但"呈现给用户的声明是否就是已提交执行所发出、并被引用来源所支持的声明"这一关键关联未被审计。合法引用与合法轨迹可能各自形式完备，却被跨声明、跨动作、跨运行或跨源版本移植。
AI.method: 形式化一个声明锚定执行契约：每条收据包含发射锚点（在已提交答案或承载声明的动作中确定性定位该声明）、源标识、偏移、哈希、引文及域分离的执行承诺。确定性完整性验证器在接入语义或任务标签之前重建这些绑定；并将完整性平面与可插拔的支持平面分离，使结构有效性不被当作蕴含关系的代理。契约暴露七个可独立测试的性质：声明-发射绑定、源绑定、有序执行绑定、预言机分离、持久对象重放、执行重跑一致性、版本/访问绑定。
AI.result: 在1,280次跨对象攻击中，联合契约检测出1,275次替换（0.9961）；移除任一目标性质后，其攻击检测率降至0.0156–0.0625。在独立裁定的384对划分上，冲突感知支持守卫达到F1 0.8865、误接受率0.0729；在未见失败族上分别为0.8679与0.0938。
AI.conclusion: 将完整性平面与支持平面解耦，可对声明-引用-执行关联实施可测的细粒度审计；联合绑定对移植式替换攻击近乎完全检测，且各绑定性质单独不可或缺，支持判定在跨分布失败族上保持稳健。

title: Back2Struct: Making Structured Images Editable Again
summary: Structured images, such as diagrams, charts, and flowcharts, are inherently symbolic and can be compactly represented in an editable format, yet in practice, they are often rendered as images, and therefore not graphically editable. This mismatch presents a significant challenge for researchers, engineers, and designers who wish to incorporate modified versions of existing graphic content into new materials without manually reconstructing it. In this study, we presentBack2Struct, which "makes structured images editable again" by directly recovering vector graphics code (SVG / XML) from image representations. Given an image of a structured graphic, Back2Struct predicts semantically object-level SVG / XML code that explicitly encodes text, shapes, topology, and layout, rather than performing low-level pixel vectorization. The generated code can be seamlessly imported into tools such as PowerPoint, allowing users to edit, refine, restyle, and reuse graphic content while preserving structural fidelity. Beyond supervised fine-tuning on ground-truth SVG token sequences, we further optimize Back2Struct with reward-based learning to better match deployment-time requirements: the output should be syntactically valid, properly concise, and visually faithful to the input diagram. Specifically, we design a composite reward that jointly encourages SVG / XML compilability, length consistency with the reference code, and structural or semantic similarity between the generated and ground-truth graphics. These complementary signals guide the model to produce SVGs that are not only closer to the training distribution, but also more complete, editable, and renderable in practice. Experiments show that Back2Struct improves accuracy, editability, validity, and user alignment over baselines. Dataset and code are available at: pengyu965.github.io/Back2Struct.github.io

AI.tldr: Back2Struct 将结构化图像（图表、流程图等）直接还原为可编辑的矢量化代码（SVG/XML），并借助复合奖励的强化学习优化，生成语法合法、简洁且视觉忠实的目标级 SVG。
AI.motivation: 结构化图像本质上是符号化的，可紧凑地以可编辑格式表示，但实际中常以位图形式存在，无法图形化编辑。研究人员、工程师和设计师若想把已有图形内容修改后复用到新素材中，就必须手动重建，成本高昂。现有低层像素矢量化方法难以恢复语义结构。
AI.method: 提出 Back2Struct，从图像表示直接恢复矢量图形代码（SVG/XML）。给定结构化图形图像，模型预测语义级、对象级的 SVG/XML 代码，显式编码文本、形状、拓扑与布局，而非低层像素矢量化。训练上先做真值 SVG token 序列的监督微调，再用基于奖励的学习优化部署需求：设计复合奖励，联合激励 SVG/XML 可编译性、与参考代码的长度一致性、以及生成图形与真值图形之间的结构/语义相似度。生成代码可无缝导入 PowerPoint 等工具进行编辑、精修、换风格与复用。
AI.result: 实验表明，Back2Struct 在准确性、可编辑性、有效性和用户对齐度上均优于基线方法。数据集与代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 通过对象级 SVG 生成与复合奖励强化学习，Back2Struct 让结构化图像重新可编辑，输出更贴近训练分布，同时更完整、可编辑、可渲染，满足实际部署需求。

title: LatCom: Cross-Agent Latent Compression for Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) increasingly use latent collaboration to avoid the information loss and repeated encoding-decoding overhead of natural-language communication. However, directly forwarding all sender latents makes the receiver-side context scale with both the number of agents and the reasoning length, increasing computation, memory usage, and collaboration latency. A natural solution is latent compression. But we find that cross-agent redundancy remains unresolved in existing latent compression approaches, which typically compress each sender independently and then concatenate the results. We propose LatCom, a cross-agent latent compression framework for efficient multi-agent latent collaboration. LatCom maps multiple sender latents into a fixed number of receiver-readable and task-relevant slots. Rather than reconstructing all sender hidden states, it optimizes the compressed latents for receiver-side task utility. LatCom trains the compressor in two stages: single-sender readability learning first establishes a latent interface interpretable by the frozen receiver, and multi-sender fusion learning then trains the compressor to fuse complementary evidence and remove redundancy across agents. Experiments on multiple benchmarks with Qwen3-4B show that LatCom achieves an average 2.46x inference speed-up over LatentMAS and reduces output token usage by 70.3% while maintaining comparable average accuracy.

AI.tldr: LatCom：一种跨智能体潜在压缩框架，将多个发送方潜在表示映射为固定数量的接收方可读槽位，在保持精度的同时显著加速多智能体潜在协作。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统采用潜在协作以避免自然语言通信的信息损失和反复编解码开销，但直接转发全部发送方潜在表示会使接收端上下文随智能体数量和推理长度增长，导致计算、内存和延迟上升。现有潜在压缩方法通常独立压缩各发送方再拼接，跨智能体冗余未被解决。
AI.method: 提出LatCom框架，将多个发送方潜在表示映射到固定数量的、接收方可读且任务相关的槽位；不重建所有发送方隐状态，而是以接收端任务效用为目标优化压缩潜在表示。训练分两阶段：单发送方可读性学习先建立冻结接收方可解释的潜在接口，多发送方融合学习随后训练压缩器融合互补证据并去除跨智能体冗余。
AI.result: 在多个基准上使用Qwen3-4B实验，相比LatentMAS平均获得2.46倍推理加速，输出token用量减少70.3%，同时保持可比的平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨智能体潜在压缩与面向接收端任务效用的两阶段训练，LatCom有效去除跨智能体冗余，实现多智能体潜在协作的效率与精度平衡。

title: ContractRL: Shielded Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Auditable Tool-Call Repair
summary: Structured tool calls often fail after only a small number of fields violate a schema or an execution contract. Regenerating the complete object enlarges the action surface and makes repeated repair difficult to audit. We introduce ContractRL, a contract-constrained sequential repair protocol that models verifier-guided JSON repair as a bounded decision process. At each step the policy observes the candidate, typed verifier feedback, JSON Pointer, immutable repair history, and remaining budget; a contract-derived action mask filters malformed or prohibited RFC-6902 operations before a deterministic validator performs the transition. We specify a contract-constrained group-relative objective for patch, retry, and abstention decisions while keeping canonical targets and semantic labels outside the online state until trace freeze. Under identical verifier information, ContractRL attains 0.9362 semantic success with 34.4 generated tokens, compared with 0.9076 and 44.9 tokens for Patch-SFT and 0.9148 and 137.2 tokens for full regeneration over 192 cases per seed and five seeds. Policy optimization improves semantic success from 0.9186 for supervised ContractRL to 0.9375. A separate three-seed paired evaluation against Patch-SFT yields a semantic difference of +0.0396 (95% CI $[+0.0137,+0.0662], p=0.0039$). Feedback, action-mask, budget, and schema-shift analyses connect these gains to localized correction, while adversarial and multi-turn evaluations characterize the remaining failure modes.

AI.tldr: 提出 ContractRL——一种契约约束的序列化修复协议，将验证器引导的 JSON 修复建模为有界决策过程，在保持语义正确率的同时显著降低 token 消耗。
AI.motivation: 结构化工具调用在仅少数字段违反 schema 或执行契约时就会整体失败；完整重新生成会扩大动作空间，使重复修复难以审计。因此需要一种局部化、可审计的修复方式。
AI.method: 将修复建模为有界决策过程：每步策略观测候选对象、类型化验证器反馈、JSON Pointer、不可变修复历史与剩余预算；由契约推导的动作掩码过滤非法或禁止的 RFC-6902 操作，再由确定性验证器执行状态转移；设计契约约束的组相对目标用于 patch、retry 与弃权决策，并在轨迹冻结前保持规范目标与语义标签不进入在线状态。
AI.result: 在相同验证器信息下，每 seed 192 例、五个 seed：ContractRL 语义成功率 0.9362、生成 34.4 token；Patch-SFT 为 0.9076/44.9 token，全量重生成 0.9148/137.2 token。策略优化将语义成功率从监督版 0.9186 提升至 0.9375。与 Patch-SFT 的三 seed 配对评估语义差为 +0.0396（95% CI [+0.0137,+0.0662], p=0.0039）。反馈、动作掩码、预算与 schema 漂移分析将增益归因于局部化纠正；对抗与多轮评估刻画了剩余失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 契约约束的顺序修复可在少量 token 下实现更高的语义成功率，增益源于局部化纠正；对抗与多轮场景下的残余失败模式仍有待解决。

title: MotionInsight: Diagnosing Object Motion Deficiencies in Generated Videos
summary: Despite rapid progress in video generation models, they still exhibit obvious motion deficiencies, often manifested as incorrect object motion. However, most existing video quality evaluations focus on aesthetic quality or text-video alignment. To address this gap, we study object-centric motion fidelity assessment, evaluating target objects along object consistency, motion continuity, and physical plausibility. To achieve this, we first introduce VidMotion, a diagnostic dataset of 6,879 videos with designated moving objects and fine-grained annotations including dimension-wise scores and failure causes. We further propose MotionInsight, a diagnostic evaluator that shifts assessment from implicit RGB-frame observation to explicit motion-space diagnosis. By constructing motion-aware representations, MotionInsight makes subtle motion deficiencies more observable. We also introduce motion-specific rewards during GRPO to transform observed motion into a diagnostic assessment. Experiments demonstrate that MotionInsight provides an effective basis for diagnosing object motion deficiencies, producing human-aligned scores along three dimensions and grounded explanations.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对视频生成模型的物体运动缺陷，提出以物体为中心的运动保真度评估任务，构建诊断数据集VidMotion并提出诊断评估器MotionInsight。
AI.motivation: 现有视频质量评估多聚焦美学质量或文本-视频对齐，忽视运动缺陷；而视频生成模型常出现物体运动错误，因此需要专门评估以物体为中心的运动保真度。
AI.method: 1) 提出VidMotion诊断数据集，包含6,879个带指定运动物体的视频，并提供维度分数与失败原因的细粒度标注；2) 提出MotionInsight评估器，从隐式RGB帧观察转向显式运动空间诊断，通过构建运动感知表示使细微运动缺陷更易观测；3) 在GRPO中引入运动特定奖励，将观测到的运动转化为诊断评估。
AI.result: MotionInsight能有效诊断物体运动缺陷，在物体一致性、运动连续性、物理合理性三个维度上给出与人类对齐的分数，并提供有依据的解释。
AI.conclusion: 以物体为中心的运动空间诊断方式为视频生成的运动保真度评估提供了有效基础。

title: UniBuild: Unified Building Mapping From Multi-Source Optical Remote Sensing Imagery With Detail Decoding and Geometry Regularization
summary: Building extraction from optical remote sensing (RS) imagery is fundamental to urban mapping, yet existing methods are often dataset-specific and generalize poorly to unseen domains. Their practical use is also limited by insufficient detail recovery and weak geometric regularization, leading to blurred boundaries, irregular shapes, and merged adjacent buildings. To address these issues, we propose UniBuild, a unified building extraction framework for multi-source RGB optical RS imagery. First, a unified multi-dataset training scheme is constructed over heterogeneous RGB optical datasets to learn transferable building representations across sensors and resolutions. Second, a novel detail-preserving HR-DPT decoder is designed to integrate high-level semantic features with high-resolution spatial features, enhancing building detail recovery. Third, geometry-aware regularization is introduced through a structure-tensor-based direction-aware loss for boundary direction consistency and a saddle-aware loss for suppressing false activations in narrow inter-building gaps under low-resolution conditions. We train and evaluate UniBuild on multi-source RGB optical datasets, including 10 public high-resolution datasets and two self-collected low-resolution datasets. Experiments show that UniBuild consistently improves building-region accuracy, boundary sharpness, and adjacent-building separation across diverse datasets. It also generalizes well to unseen domains and supports practical building extraction from RGB optical RS imagery up to 10\,m resolution. The predicted masks can be further converted into GIS-compatible building footprints through simple polygonization. The trained model and inference code are released at https://github.com/zhu-xlab/UniBuild.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniBuild，一个面向多源RGB光学遥感影像的统一建筑物提取框架，通过多数据集统一训练、细节保持的HR-DPT解码器和几何感知正则化，提升建筑物区域精度、边界锐度与相邻建筑物分离度，并具备良好跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有光学遥感影像建筑物提取方法通常针对特定数据集，跨域泛化能力差；同时细节恢复不足、几何正则化薄弱，导致边界模糊、形状不规则以及相邻建筑物粘连。
AI.method: 提出UniBuild统一框架，包含三部分：(1) 在异构RGB光学数据集上进行统一多数据集训练，学习跨传感器、跨分辨率的可迁移建筑物表征；(2) 设计细节保持的HR-DPT解码器，融合高层语义特征与高分辨率空间特征；(3) 引入几何感知正则化，包括基于结构张量的方向感知损失（保证边界方向一致性）和鞍点感知损失（抑制低分辨率下建筑物窄间隙中的虚假激活）。
AI.result: 在10个公开高分辨率数据集和2个自采低分辨率数据集上训练与评估，UniBuild在多样数据集上持续提升建筑物区域精度、边界锐度与相邻建筑物分离度，对未见域泛化良好，支持最高10米分辨率的RGB光学遥感建筑物提取。
AI.conclusion: UniBuild有效解决了多源RGB光学遥感建筑物提取中的跨域泛化差和几何细节不足问题，预测掩膜可通过简单多边形化转换为GIS兼容的建筑物轮廓；模型与推理代码已开源。

title: LoRA Direction Extraction for Controllable Light Toggling in FLUX.1 Kontext
summary: We propose a fine-tuning method for flow-matching diffusion models aimed at realistic artificial light modeling without the need for a large training dataset. We address the task of controllable interior image editing, where the goal is to turn artificial light sources on or off while preserving the scene geometry, object placement, materials, and visual identity of the original image. To achieve this, we decompose the task into two independent formulations. We introduce the LoRA Direction Training Method, which extracts the pure direction of the LoRA adapter effect in the diffusion model flow field, and we also introduce specialized loss functions to ensure the realism of the inverse transformation. Additionally, the resulting increment map is used for more precise adjustment of the lighting color and temperature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向flow-matching扩散模型的微调方法，无需大规模数据集即可实现逼真的人工光照建模，并用于可控室内图像编辑（开/关光源）同时保持场景几何、物体布局、材质与视觉一致性。
AI.motivation: 室内图像中人工光源的开关编辑需要可控且逼真，但传统方法依赖大规模训练数据；同时编辑应在改变光照的同时不破坏场景几何、物体位置、材质及原图视觉身份。
AI.method: 将任务分解为两个独立子问题；提出LoRA Direction Training Method，在扩散模型流场中提取LoRA适配器效应的纯方向；并设计专门损失函数以保证逆变换的真实性；此外，利用生成的增量图（increment map）对光照颜色与色温进行更精细调整。
AI.result: 方法能够在无需大量训练数据的情况下实现人工光照建模与可控室内图像编辑，支持光源开/关操作，并可通过增量图精确调节光照颜色与温度，同时保持原图几何、布局、材质与视觉身份。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为flow-matching扩散模型的轻量微调与可控室内光照编辑提供了新思路，兼具数据高效性与编辑精细度，适用于逼真人工光照建模场景。

title: NowcastDiT: Diffusion Transformers are Effective Precipitation Nowcasters
summary: Precipitation nowcasting demands accurate short-term forecasts under strong spatiotemporal variability. Diffusion models are well suited to modeling complex precipitation distributions, yet existing approaches often introduce increasingly specialized designs, leaving the capability of a standard diffusion architecture underexplored. We show that a standard Diffusion Transformer already provides a simple and scalable foundation for precipitation nowcasting, with domain-specific requirements accommodated naturally within its design space. Based on this principle, we develop NowcastDiT and instantiate this flexibility through two complementary adaptations: a dynamics-aware noise prior for temporally coherent forecasts, and end-to-end reinforcement learning with timestep-aware rewards for meteorological skill. Experiments on SEVIR and MRMS benchmarks show that NowcastDiT achieves state-of-the-art performance in both perceptual quality and meteorological skill. These results suggest that standard DiT can serve as an effective foundation for precipitation nowcasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NowcastDiT，证明标准 Diffusion Transformer 本身即可作为降水临近预报的简单可扩展基础，并通过动力学感知噪声先验与端到端强化学习两项适配实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 降水临近预报需在强时空变异性下给出准确短期预报；扩散模型适合建模复杂降水分布，但现有方法偏向引入日益专门的定制设计，忽视了标准扩散架构本身的潜力。
AI.method: 以标准 Diffusion Transformer 为基础构建 NowcastDiT，将领域需求自然纳入其设计空间，并实例化两项互补适配：面向时间连贯预报的动力学感知噪声先验，以及带时间步感知奖励的端到端强化学习以提升气象技能。
AI.result: 在 SEVIR 与 MRMS 基准上，NowcastDiT 在感知质量与气象技能两方面均取得最先进（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明标准 DiT 可作为降水临近预报的有效基础架构，无需过度专门化设计即可满足领域需求。

title: Selecting The Most Informative Tokens in Natural Language Autoencoders
summary: Natural language autoencoders translate a language model's internal activations into readable explanations. Explaining every token position is costly. Which positions should an auditor inspect to understand a potential threat? We study this question across $4.7$ million explanations on prompt injection and concealment. We compare signals from model computation with a ranker trained only on chat structure. Chat structure usually selects more relevant explanations than the computational signals, without requiring a model forward pass for position selection. On three of four datasets, explaining just $5\%$ of positions retains nearly all of the success rate from explaining every position, where success means obtaining an explanation about the threat. The benefit varies with the audit task. We also show that pretrained verbalizers recover words that models have learned to conceal through fine-tuning, without additional verbalizer training. These results identify where auditors can concentrate explanation generation and show that useful explanations can extend beyond the model a verbalizer was trained to describe.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究自然语言自编码器解释的“位置选择”问题：在410万条关于提示注入与隐瞒行为的解释上，比较模型计算信号与仅基于对话结构训练的排序器，发现对话结构通常能选出更相关的解释，且仅解释5%的位置即可在多数数据集上保留近乎全部成功率。
AI.motivation: 自然语言自编码器可将语言模型内部激活转译为可读解释，但逐一解释每个token位置成本高昂。审计者需要知道应优先检查哪些位置，才能高效理解潜在威胁。因此论文探究“在何处集中生成解释”这一问题。
AI.method: 在提示注入与隐瞒（concealment）场景下，构建约470万条解释的数据集。将来自模型计算过程的信号（如激活相关指标）与一个仅在对话结构上训练的排序器进行对比，用于位置选择。评估指标为“成功率”，即是否获得关于威胁的解释；并考察仅解释5%位置时的表现，以及预训练verbalizer在无额外训练下对被微调隐藏词汇的恢复能力。
AI.result: 对话结构排序器通常比计算信号选出更相关的解释，且位置选择无需模型前向传播。在四个数据集中的三个上，仅解释5%的位置即可保留接近全量解释的成功率。该收益随审计任务而变化。此外，预训练verbalizer可在无需额外训练的情况下恢复模型通过微调学会隐瞒的词。
AI.conclusion: 审计者可据此集中解释生成的位置，显著降低成本。对话结构是高效的位置选择信号；少量位置解释即可覆盖大部分威胁信息；且有益解释可超越verbalizer原本被训练描述的模型范围。

title: GleanVID: Complementary Token Selection for Efficient Video Large Language Models
summary: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) have achieved strong video understanding capabilities but incur substantial inference overhead due to the large number of visual tokens. Existing VideoLLM token compression methods largely rely on selection-independent scoring, overlooking cross-frame complementarity and consequently retaining redundant evidence across frames. Instead, we view video token selection as a progressive evidence accumulation process. It aims to retain visual evidence that is individually informative and collectively complementary under a limited token budget. Building on this insight, we introduce GleanVID, a training-free inference acceleration framework for VideoLLMs. Specifically, GleanVID first allocates the global token budget across frames according to temporal novelty and then selects tokens by jointly considering local representativeness and subspace complementarity, thereby preserving richer and less redundant visual evidence. Extensive experiments across diverse VideoLLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that GleanVID consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, with only 25% of visual tokens, GleanVID preserves 98.6% of Qwen3-VL's original performance while reducing its prefill latency by 44.7%. On LLaVA-OV-7B, GleanVID at a 25% retention ratio even slightly surpasses the original model.

AI.tldr: GleanVID：一种免训练的视频大模型推理加速框架，将视频token选择视为渐进式证据累积过程，兼顾单帧信息量与跨帧互补性，在25%token预算下保持近乎无损性能。
AI.motivation: 视频大模型（VideoLLMs）视觉token数量庞大，推理开销高昂。现有token压缩方法多采用"选择独立"的打分策略，忽略了跨帧互补性，导致保留的视觉证据在各帧间高度冗余。
AI.method: 将视频token选择建模为渐进式证据累积过程，目标是保留在有限token预算下既单独有信息量、又整体互补的视觉证据。GleanVID包含两步：1）依据时间新颖性（temporal novelty）在帧间分配全局token预算；2）在帧内联合考虑局部代表性（local representativeness）与子空间互补性（subspace complementarity）进行token选择。方法无需训练。
AI.result: 在多种VideoLLMs和多个基准上取得一致的SOTA表现。仅用25%视觉token时，GleanVID保留Qwen3-VL原性能的98.6%，并将prefill延迟降低44.7%；在LLaVA-OV-7B上，25%保留率下性能甚至略优于原始模型。
AI.conclusion: 跨帧互补性是视频token压缩中被忽视的关键维度；以渐进式证据累积视角进行预算分配与token选择，可在免训练条件下实现高压缩率与近乎无损性能的平衡，为VideoLLM高效推理提供了有效方案。

title: Learning from Think-Mode Advantage via On-Policy Distillation
summary: Explicit intermediate reasoning gives large language models (LLMs) a stronger problem-solving mode. We study learning from this think-mode advantage via on-policy distillation (OPD). OPD preserves student-generated trajectories and provides dense token-level teacher targets at student-visited prefixes. Privileged reasoning is used during distillation rather than student inference. Uniform ThinkOPD, a natural think-enabled OPD baseline, conditions a fixed teacher on one shared think trace and uniformly distills every sibling student response. Although its prefixes are on-policy, the trace need not follow a route compatible with every complete response: the same privileged trace can induce different teacher-student discrepancies even when responses reach the same outcome. We summarize this interaction with trace-response divergence (TRD) and introduce ThinkOPD, which routes supervision at the response level by combining group-relative reward gain with a TRD-based compatibility proxy. Final response weights are normalized within each rollout group. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation, ThinkOPD outperforms Uniform ThinkOPD in both same-model settings and both cross-model teacher-student pairs, and it exceeds representative rationale and self-distillation baselines in a controlled comparison. Controlled interventions show that outcome benefit and the TRD-based proxy provide complementary routing signals in this setting. Think-enabled OPD provides a controlled setting for studying how teacher advantage becomes transferable along student responses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何通过在线策略蒸馏（OPD）从LLM的显式中间推理（think模式）优势中学习，提出用trace-response divergence（TRD）刻画特权推理轨迹与不同学生响应间的错配，并据此提出ThinkOPD，在响应级别进行监督路由，在数学推理与代码生成任务上优于Uniform ThinkOPD及代表性基线。
AI.motivation: 显式中间推理赋予大模型更强的解题能力，但如何把这种think模式优势有效迁移给学生模型仍不清楚。已有OPD在学生在策略前缀上提供密集的token级教师监督，但若用固定的think轨迹作为特权信息，同一特权轨迹未必与每个完整响应兼容，导致即便结果相同，教师-学生差异也不同，需研究这种错配如何影响蒸馏。
AI.method: 提出trace-response divergence（TRD）来总结特权think轨迹与响应的交互错配。基于此提出ThinkOPD：在响应级别路由监督，将组相对奖励增益与基于TRD的兼容性代理结合，最终响应权重在每次rollout组内归一化。作为对照的自然基线Uniform ThinkOPD则把固定教师条件于一个共享think轨迹，对每个同组学生响应统一蒸馏。
AI.result: 在数学推理与代码生成任务上，ThinkOPD在同模型设置和两组跨模型教师-学生配对中均优于Uniform ThinkOPD，并在受控比较中超过代表性rationale基线和自蒸馏基线。受控干预实验表明，结果收益与基于TRD的代理在该设定下提供了互补的路由信号。
AI.conclusion: 启用think的OPD为研究教师优势如何沿学生响应转化为可迁移能力提供了一个受控实验框架；通过TRD驱动的响应级路由可更有效利用特权推理。

title: Speed in the Blind Spot: An Interpretability Analysis of Dynamic Perception in VLMs for Autonomous Driving
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Vision-Language Models are increasingly used in autonomous-driving systems, yet their ability to recover dynamic physical state from visual input remains insufficiently characterized. We study velocity understanding as a controlled diagnostic across three tasks: surrounding-agent speed, current ego speed, and short-horizon future ego-speed proposal. On nuScenes, we evaluate open-weight general-purpose and PhysicalAI VLMs, together with the driving-oriented Alpamayo-1.5 Vision-Language-Action model, using multiple input and output formulations. We combine verbal evaluation with temporal perturbations, counterfactual ego-speed hints and linear probes of hidden representations. The tasks exhibit distinct failure modes. Surrounding-agent speed is weakly encoded in an agent-specific form, whereas current ego speed is often internally accessible but poorly verbalized: continuous probes achieve 4.7-5.8 km/h MAE compared with 10.2-16.8 km/h MAE for verbal outputs. Multiple frames provide inconsistent verbal gains to single frame inputs, and frame order is rarely exploited. Under non-optimized QLoRA, task-specific adaptation improves both task-relevant latent speed representations and verbal readout, but continuous surrounding-agent speed estimation remains weak, while most future-speed gains survive frame shuffling, indicating limited temporal grounding. Driving specialized Alpamayo-1.5 shows stronger latent representations for surrounding-agent and future ego speed, while current ego-speed decodability is comparable and substantial probe-verbal gaps remain. Thus, driving specialization can strengthen motion representations but does not guarantee stronger encoding across both scene and ego states or reliable readout. The results show that plausible planning outputs do not necessarily imply reliable recovery or temporal grounding of the underlying dynamic state.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"速度理解"作为受控诊断任务，系统检验视觉语言模型（VLM）从视觉输入中恢复动态物理状态的能力，发现当前自车速度常可内部恢复但难以语言表达，且时间信息利用不足。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶系统日益采用视觉语言模型，但其从视觉输入中恢复动态物理状态的能力尚未被充分刻画；同时，合理的规划输出未必意味着对底层动态状态具有可靠的恢复能力与时间接地。
AI.method: 在nuScenes上，围绕三项任务（周边智能体速度、当前自车速度、短时程未来自车速度建议）开展受控诊断，评估开放权重通用VLM、PhysicalAI VLM及面向驾驶的Alpamayo-1.5 VLA模型，采用多种输入输出形式，并结合语言评估、时间扰动、反事实自车速度提示与隐层线性探针。
AI.result: 三类任务呈现不同失效模式：周边智能体速度仅以智能体特定形式弱编码；当前自车速度内部可及但语言化差，连续探针MAE为4.7–5.8 km/h，而语言输出MAE为10.2–16.8 km/h；多帧相对单帧的语言增益不一致，帧顺序几乎未被利用。非优化QLoRA下，任务特定适配改善了任务相关的隐层速度表征与语言读出，但连续周边智能体速度估计仍弱，且多数未来速度增益在打乱帧序后仍保留，说明时间接地有限。驾驶专用的Alpamayo-1.5在周边智能体与未来自车速度上隐层表征更强，当前自车速度可解码性相当，探针-语言差距依旧显著。
AI.conclusion: 驾驶领域特化可以增强运动表征，但并不保证对场景状态与自车状态同时具备更强编码或可靠读出；看似合理的规划输出并不必然意味着对底层动态状态具有可靠恢复与时间接地。

title: Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion for Feedforward, Locally Trained Spiking Neural Networks
comment: 22 pages. Submitted to Neurocomputing. Code available at https://github.com/aidinattar/multi-depth-temporal-fusion-snn
summary: We propose a new spiking neural network (SNN) design to process static images and event streams using time-to-first-spike (TTFS) latencies. Our key research question is which architectural choices best accommodate local and online learning in multi-layer convolutional SNNs. This question is addressed via an original framework combining residual-like connections with multi-depth feature aggregation and consensus. The full SNN pipeline features an early-vision front end, to convert raw visual data into sparse spike latencies, a four-layer convolutional backbone trained layerwise with unsupervised spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP), a deterministic Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion (MDTF) and a final classifier trained with reward-modulated spike-timing-dependent plasticity (R-STDP). Rather than replacing early features in deeper layers, the proposed MDTF preserves early temporal evidence, adding sparse residual events from intermediate layers, and incorporating deeper features only when they agree in time with earlier representations. The resulting architecture is experimentally validated across MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and N-MNIST, delivering strong classification performance under a fully local learning regime. Selective multi-depth fusion significantly outperforms traditional STDP/R-STDP baselines on higher-variability visual tasks (achieving +18.2 pp on Fashion-MNIST and +29.2 pp on CIFAR-10). Furthermore, activity-budget analyses show that the network retains high accuracy even when removing a large fraction of late or weak spike events, confirming its high data efficiency and reduced event-processing requirements. The codebase is publicly available at github.com/aidinattar/multi-depth-temporal-fusion-snn.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于TTFS延迟编码的脉冲神经网络（SNN）架构，结合残差式连接、多深度时间融合（MDTF）与逐层局部在线学习，在静态图像与事件流分类任务上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 核心研究问题是：何种架构选择能最好地支持多层卷积SNN中的局部在线学习。现有STDP/R-STDP方法在多层卷积SNN中难以兼顾早期时间证据的保留与深层特征的利用，导致在视觉变异性较高的任务上性能受限。
AI.method: 设计完整SNN流水线：早期视觉前端将原始视觉数据转换为稀疏脉冲延迟（TTFS）；四层卷积骨干采用无监督STDP逐层训练；引入确定性多深度时间融合（MDTF），保留早期时间证据并加入中间层稀疏残差事件，仅当深层特征与早期表示在时间上一致时才整合；最后用奖励调制STDP（R-STDP）训练分类器。评估覆盖MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10和N-MNIST。
AI.result: 在完全局部学习机制下取得强分类性能；选择性多深度融合在高变异性视觉任务上显著优于传统STDP/R-STDP基线：Fashion-MNIST提升+18.2个百分点，CIFAR-10提升+29.2个百分点。活动预算分析表明，即使移除大量晚期或弱脉冲事件，网络仍保持高准确率，体现高数据效率与低事件处理需求。
AI.conclusion: MDTF通过保留早期时间证据并选择性融合一致的深层特征，有效支持多层卷积SNN的局部在线学习，在高变异性任务上大幅超越基线，且具备高数据效率与稀疏事件处理优势。代码已公开。

title: NHO: A Neural Hamiltonian Operator for Anchor-based Region Localization and Dense Correspondence
summary: Non-rigid partial-to-full shape correspondence from sparse anchors requires identifying the corresponding region on the full surface and recovering dense correspondences between the partial shape and that region. We present NHO, which combines sparse anchors with the intrinsic geometry of the partial shape to learn a neural Hamiltonian operator whose localized eigenspace encodes both the region support and intrinsic coordinates for dense correspondence. NHO parameterizes the Hamiltonian potential as an intrinsic neural field and optimizes it using anchor evidence together with spectral and geometric constraints. To resolve the spatial ambiguity left by sparse anchors, we introduce reciprocal refinement between operator estimation and correspondence recovery. At each round, the current eigenspace provides spectral coordinates and restricts matching to its induced support, while geometrically reliable correspondences provide additional evidence for updating the potential. After refinement, aggregated eigenfunction energy yields the final localization, and the recovered map initializes dense correspondence refinement. Experiments demonstrate competitive accuracy on both tasks and robustness to uniform scaling and rotation.

AI.tldr: 提出NHO，用稀疏锚点结合部分形状内蕴几何学习神经Hamiltonian算子，其局部化特征空间同时编码区域支撑与内蕴坐标，通过算子估计与对应恢复的相互迭代精化，实现非刚性部分到完整形状的对应。
AI.motivation: 非刚性部分到完整形状对应需先从稀疏锚点确定部分形状在完整表面上的对应区域（定位），再恢复该区域内的稠密对应。稀疏锚点证据不足，会留下空间歧义，单独的定位或匹配难以可靠完成两个子任务。
AI.method: 1) 将Hamiltonian势函数参数化为内蕴神经场，用锚点证据加谱约束与几何约束优化该算子；2) 局部化特征空间同时给出谱坐标（用于稠密对应）与区域支撑（用于定位）；3) 引入算子估计与对应恢复的相互精化迭代：每轮由当前特征空间提供谱坐标并把匹配限制在诱导支撑内，几何可靠的对应再作为新证据更新势函数；4) 迭代后聚合特征函数能量得到最终定位，恢复的映射用于初始化稠密对应精化。
AI.result: 在部分到完整对应与定位两个任务上取得有竞争力的精度，并对均匀缩放和旋转具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 以神经Hamiltonian算子的局部化谱空间统一处理部分形状的区域定位与稠密对应，并通过相互精化机制缓解稀疏锚点带来的空间歧义，验证了谱方法与神经内蕴场结合的有效性与几何鲁棒性。

title: OmniRoute: Mapping Temporal Semantic Evidence to Audio-Visual Token Budgets for Efficient Omnimodal Large Language Models
summary: Omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) encode audio and visual streams into temporally interleaved token sequences for multimodal reasoning. However, processing long audio-visual token sequences incurs substantial prefill costs. Existing compression methods have made progress, but often overlook temporal changes in audio-visual semantic relevance. Motivated by temporal variation and local continuity, we propose OmniRoute, a training-free, two-stage compression framework. First, Temporal Evidence-Guided Budgeting (TEGB) derives chunk-wise modality preferences and initial leading-modality budgets from semantic relevance and local content variation. Second, Budget-Constrained Semantic Compression (BCSC) compresses the leading modality and then calibrates the follower's retention target using the actual retained fraction. For video, it combines spatiotemporal grouping with query-guided selection; for audio, it selects tokens based on encoder attention and query relevance, then merges residual tokens into context anchors under visual guidance. Experiments on four representative benchmarks demonstrate a better trade-off between inference efficiency and performance than competitive baselines. The code and interface will be released to facilitate further research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OmniRoute，一个免训练的两阶段音视频 token 压缩框架，通过时序证据引导预算分配与预算约束的语义压缩，在降低预填充开销的同时保持多模态推理性能。
AI.motivation: Omni-LLM 将音视频流编码为时序交织的 token 序列，长序列带来高昂的预填充成本。现有压缩方法虽有进展，但普遍忽略了音视频语义相关性的时序动态变化，导致压缩效率与性能难以兼顾。
AI.method: OmniRoute 为免训练的两阶段框架。第一阶段 Temporal Evidence-Guided Budgeting (TEGB)：基于语义相关性与局部内容变化，推导分块的模态偏好及初始主导模态预算。第二阶段 Budget-Constrained Semantic Compression (BCSC)：先压缩主导模态，再依据实际保留比例校准跟随模态的保留目标；视频侧结合时空分组与查询引导选择，音频侧基于编码器注意力与查询相关性选 token，并在视觉引导下将残余 token 合并为上下文锚点。
AI.result: 在四个代表性基准上，OmniRoute 在推理效率与性能之间取得了优于竞争基线的权衡。
AI.conclusion: OmniRoute 以免训练方式实现了时序自适应的音视频 token 压缩，验证了利用时序变化与局部连续性进行预算分配的可行性，代码与接口将开源以促进后续研究。

title: Spatial-OPSD: Self-Improving Spatial Reasoning via Label-Free Self-Distillation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly operate in embodied and spatially grounded settings, where accurate understanding of depth, viewpoint, and three-dimensional relations is essential. However, improving spatial reasoning typically relies on ground-truth answers, answer-derived rewards, or other forms of task-specific supervision. We introduce Spatial-OPSD, a label-free self-improvement framework that instead exploits spatial structure naturally available from perception and reconstruction tools. During training, a privileged teacher receives automatically obtainable spatial priors, such as depth, reconstructed 3D relations, and camera geometry, while the student observes only the original visual-language input. On trajectories sampled by the student itself, the teacher provides dense token-level supervision, allowing the student to internalize spatial knowledge without ground-truth answer labels or privileged information at inference time. To extend this supervision beyond a single round, we adopt a round-wise recursive training scheme: the teacher remains frozen within each round to provide a stable learning target, and the improved student initializes both teacher and student in the next round, where privileged spatial priors re-establish an informative teacher--student asymmetry. This enables repeated self-improvement while avoiding a rapidly moving teacher during optimization. Across four VLM families, a single round of Spatial-OPSD consistently improves the five-benchmark average, while three rounds further push a strong spatially specialized model to the open-source frontier, achieving the highest average among the open models and the best results on three of five spatial reasoning benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/vermouth599/Spatial-OPSD.

AI.tldr: 提出Spatial-OPSD，一种无需标签的空间推理自提升框架，利用深度、重建3D关系和相机几何等自动可得的空间先验，通过特权教师-学生蒸馏与轮次递归训练，让VLM内化空间知识。单轮训练一致提升四个VLM家族的五基准平均分，三轮训练将强空间专用模型推至开源前沿。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型越来越多地应用于具身和空间化场景，准确理解深度、视角和三维关系至关重要。然而现有空间推理改进方法依赖真值答案、基于答案的奖励或其他任务特定监督，成本高且受限。
AI.method: Spatial-OPSD为无标签自提升框架：训练时特权教师接收自动可得的空间先验（深度、重建3D关系、相机几何），学生仅见原始视觉-语言输入；在学生自采样轨迹上，教师提供稠密token级监督，使学生无需真值答案标签或推理期特权信息即可内化空间知识。采用轮次递归训练：每轮内教师冻结以提供稳定学习目标，改进后的学生在下一轮同时初始化教师与学生，特权空间先验重建信息化的教师-学生不对称，实现反复自提升并避免教师在优化中快速移动。
AI.result: 在四个VLM家族上，单轮Spatial-OPSD持续提升五基准平均分；三轮训练进一步把强空间专用模型推向开源前沿，在开源模型中取得最高平均分，并在五个空间推理基准中的三个上取得最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: Spatial-OPSD证明了利用自动获取的空间先验进行无标签教师-学生蒸馏与轮次递归自提升，可有效增强VLM的空间推理能力，且推理时不需特权信息或真值标签，为空间化VLM训练提供了一种可扩展方案。

title: Context without Commitment: Robust Dense Correspondence under Non-Rigid Deformation
summary: Non-rigid point-cloud registration aims to find the corresponding target point for each point on a deforming source surface. Point-level matching keeps the full target cloud available, but correspondence becomes ambiguous when different regions have similar local geometry. Regional or coarse-to-fine methods provide broader spatial context, but an incorrect regional match can exclude the correct correspondence before dense matching. We propose CoCo-Reg, which uses regional patches to enrich dense point features without allowing patch predictions to restrict the final point-level search. CoCo-Reg constructs farthest-point-sampled patches, exchanges geometric information within and between source and target, supervises patch similarity using identity-corrected point overlap, and projects the resulting regional information back to dense point features. The final registration stage still scores the full target cloud before global point-level candidate selection. On 726 held-out ModelNet10 objects across nine deformation levels, two established learning-based baselines obtain mean correspondence errors of 0.1993 and 0.1921, whereas CoCo-Reg obtains 0.0547. Relative to its point-level baseline, this is a 72.6\% reduction. CoCo-Reg achieves lower correspondence error on 92.3\% of paired test objects and reduces the mean fraction of points with error above 0.1 from 47.3\% to 17.3\%. Chamfer distance and HD95 decrease in the same direction, and CoCo-Reg remains lower across all tested deformation levels. These results support using regional context for dense non-rigid correspondence without imposing a hard patch-level restriction on the final search. Because evaluation uses one checkpoint per method, the reported gains characterize the complete systems rather than the isolated causal contribution of an individual component. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出CoCo-Reg：用区域块富集稠密点特征但不用块预测限制最终点级搜索，实现非刚性点云配准。
AI.motivation: 点级匹配保留完整目标点云，但局部几何相似时对应关系模糊；区域或由粗到细方法提供更广空间上下文，却可能因错误的区域匹配在稠密匹配前排除正确对应。需要兼顾两者优势。
AI.method: 构建最远点采样块，在源与目标内部及之间交换几何信息，用身份校正的点重叠监督块相似性，将区域信息投影回稠密点特征；最终配准阶段仍对完整目标点云打分，再进行全局点级候选选择。
AI.result: 在726个留出的ModelNet10对象、九种形变水平上，两个学习基线的平均对应误差为0.1993和0.1921，CoCo-Reg为0.0547，相对点级基线降低72.6%；在92.3%成对测试对象上误差更低；误差大于0.1的点比例均值由47.3%降至17.3%；Chamfer距离与HD95同样下降，且在所有形变水平上保持更低。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持利用区域上下文进行稠密非刚性对应，同时不对最终搜索施加硬性块级限制。因每方法仅用一个检查点评估，报告增益刻画的是完整系统而非单个组件的孤立因果贡献。

title: LDM-is-AE: Latent Diffusion Model is an Auto-Encoder for End-to-End Image Generation
comment: Accepted by NIPS 2026. More info can be found in https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/LDMisAE
summary: Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) typically adopt a two-stage pipeline: an auto-encoder (AE) is first pre-trained to define a latent space, then a diffusion model is trained to perform denoising within it. Such a two-stage design introduces a representation mismatch, as the latent space is optimized for reconstruction rather than adapting the denoising dynamics. We reveal that the LDM itself is an AE, and consequently present LDM-is-AE, an end-to-end one-stage LDM training framework that eliminates the need for a separately trained tokenizer. Our key observation is that the LDM backbone actually performs a latent-to-feature-to-latent transformation at each denoising step, which can be interpreted as an internal decoding--encoding process. Leveraging this structure, we split the DiT backbone into two reciprocal components, DiT-E (i.e., DiT Encoding) and DiT-D (i.e., DiT Decoding), and impose image-space supervision on the intermediate features across all timesteps. Our model encourages the internal representation to align with the image domain throughout denoising, thereby establishing an explicit latent-to-image-to-latent path. At the zero-noise timestep, our model further performs an image-to-latent-to-image mapping, corresponding to an auto-encoding process. As a result, LDM-is-AE jointly learns latent representations and denoising dynamics in an end-to-end manner, yielding a diffusion-native latent space tailored to the generation process. Experiments demonstrate that LDM-is-AE exhibits highly competitive generation performance, achieving an FID of 1.80 and 1.90 on 256x256 and 512x512 class-conditional image generation, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出LDM-is-AE，一种端到端单阶段LDM训练框架。将DiT骨干拆分为DiT-E和DiT-D，通过全程图像空间监督建立显式latent-to-image-to-latent路径，无需单独训练tokenizer，在256/512分辨率上取得FID 1.80/1.90。
AI.motivation: 传统LDM采用两阶段流水线：先预训练自编码器定义latent space，再训练扩散模型在其中去噪。这引入了表征不匹配（representation mismatch），因为latent space是为重建而非适应去噪动态而优化的，两者目标不一致。
AI.method: 核心洞察是LDM本身即是一个AE，且DiT骨干在每个去噪步实际执行latent-to-feature-to-latent变换，可视为内部解码-编码过程。据此将DiT拆分为互为逆过程的DiT-E（编码）与DiT-D（解码），在所有时间步对中间特征施加图像空间监督，使内部表征在整个去噪过程中对齐图像域；在零噪声时间步执行image-to-latent-to-image映射，对应自编码过程。
AI.result: LDM-is-AE以端到端方式联合学习latent表征与去噪动态，获得面向生成过程的diffusion-native latent space。在256×256和512×512类条件图像生成上分别达到FID 1.80和1.90，生成性能极具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除两阶段设计中表征不匹配问题，LDM-is-AE无需独立tokenizer即实现单阶段端到端训练，在保持竞争性生成质量的同时构建了与去噪动态相适配的latent空间。

title: Traverse: Learning When to Remember, Reset, and Redirect for Long-Horizon Web Search
summary: Long-horizon information-seeking agents often accumulate noisy or misleading context, causing early mistakes to persist and making recovery increasingly difficult. We introduce an autonomous search harness in which the agent manages its own search process through three states: Rubric, Answer, and Verify. The agent first defines criteria for a valid answer, searches under these criteria, and then independently verifies the result before deciding whether to terminate or continue searching. It is further equipped with a Seal Memory tool that enables active context management. Training this behavior with reinforcement learning, however, can induce Seal Collapse, resulting in unstable training and preventing the agent from reliably learning when and how to use its memory tools. We solve this with a simple strategy that trains only the final segment after context management. Our 35B model achieves 72.83 on BrowseComp, outperforming comparable open-source systems, and consistently improves over the base model across BrowseComp-ZH, xbench, DeepSearchQA, WideSearch, financial investigation, and product search. Ablations show that autonomous compression outperforms automatic compaction and validate our RL design.

AI.tldr: 提出自主搜索harness（Rubric/Answer/Verify三状态）与Seal Memory工具，用"仅训练上下文管理后片段"的RL策略解决Seal Collapse，35B模型在BrowseComp达72.83。
AI.motivation: 长程信息搜索智能体会累积噪声或误导性上下文，导致早期错误持续存在且难以恢复；同时用强化学习训练记忆工具使用行为会引发Seal Collapse，使训练不稳定且无法可靠学到何时、如何使用记忆工具。
AI.method: 引入自主搜索harness，agent自主管理搜索流程，包含Rubric（定义有效答案标准）、Answer（按标准搜索）、Verify（独立验证结果并决定终止或继续）三个状态；配备Seal Memory工具实现主动上下文管理；采用仅训练上下文管理之后最终片段的简单RL策略来规避Seal Collapse；并以消融对比自主压缩与自动压缩。
AI.result: 35B模型在BrowseComp上取得72.83，优于同类开源系统；在BrowseComp-ZH、xbench、DeepSearchQA、WideSearch、金融调查与商品搜索上稳定超越基座模型；消融显示自主压缩优于自动压缩，并验证了RL设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 三状态自主搜索框架结合Seal Memory与针对性RL训练策略，可有效缓解上下文噪声累积与Seal Collapse问题，显著提升长程信息搜索性能，且自主压缩方案优于自动压缩。

title: Energy Variation in Training Modern Computer Vision Architectures
comment: International Conference on Next-Generation AI Technologies (ICNGAIT) Shanghai, China, 5 pages, 1 table
summary: The rapid growth of deep learning has substantially increased the energy consumption associated with model training, making energy efficiency an increasingly relevant design criterion. This study empirically measures the energy variation of training seven modern computer vision architectures, MobileNetV3-Small, MobileNetV3-Large, EfficientNet-B0, EfficientNet-B1, ViT-B/32, ConvNeXt-Tiny, and ViT-B/16 for the ImageNet-1k classification task, using a homogeneous 10,000-image subset (ImageNet-10k) and a uniform 40-epoch baseline configuration executed on two NVIDIA Tesla P100 GPUs at the Bioinformatics and Computational Biology Center of Colombia (BIOS). Energy was recorded directly via NVML and contrasted with the computational complexity of each model. The results show a Pearson correlation of 0.85 between floating-point operations (GFLOPs) and energy consumption in kWh, indicating that computational complexity is a strong but imperfect predictor of energy expenditure: architectures with comparable GFLOPs exhibited consumption differing by up to 3.1x due to differences in the hardware efficiency of their dominant operations. The EfficientNet variants offered the best balance between classification performance (Val Top-5 up to 97.15%) and energy efficiency (0.457-0.611 kWh), while Vision Transformers exhibited the highest relative energy consumption and lower classification performance under the evaluated configuration. These findings guide architecture selection in energy-constrained computing environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究实证测量了七种现代视觉架构在ImageNet-10k子集上训练40个epoch的能耗，发现GFLOPs与能耗的Pearson相关系数为0.85，说明计算复杂度是能耗的强但非完美预测因子；EfficientNet在性能与能效间取得最佳平衡，ViT能效最差。
AI.motivation: 深度学习规模快速增长显著提高了模型训练的能耗，能效正成为越来越重要的设计准则；然而计算复杂度（如GFLOPs）能否可靠预测实际能耗尚不明确，需要实证数据支撑在能源受限环境下的架构选择。
AI.method: 在哥伦比亚生物信息学与计算生物学中心（BIOS）的两块NVIDIA Tesla P100 GPU上，采用统一配置（ImageNet-1k分类任务、10,000张图像的ImageNet-10k子集、40个epoch基线）训练七种架构：MobileNetV3-Small、MobileNetV3-Large、EfficientNet-B0、EfficientNet-B1、ViT-B/32、ConvNeXt-Tiny和ViT-B/16；通过NVML直接记录能耗，并与各模型的计算复杂度进行对比分析。
AI.result: GFLOPs与能耗（kWh）的Pearson相关系数为0.85；GFLOPs相近的架构能耗差异可达3.1倍，原因在于主导算子的硬件效率不同。EfficientNet变体在分类性能（Val Top-5最高97.15%）与能效（0.457–0.611 kWh）之间平衡最佳；Vision Transformers在本评估配置下相对能耗最高且分类性能较低。
AI.conclusion: 计算复杂度是能耗的强但不完美预测因子，架构选择需结合实测能耗而非仅依赖GFLOPs；研究结果为能源受限计算环境下的架构选型提供了依据。

title: Real2Gym: Building Gyms from Videos, Bringing Skills to Robots
summary: Real-world videos provide rich demonstrations of manipulation, but turning them into reusable robot skills requires visually aligned environments, executable physical interactions, and mechanisms for learning from experience. We introduce Real2Gym, an agentic Real2Sim2Real framework that turns human and robot demonstrations into interactive simulation gyms and brings skills acquired in simulation to physical robots. The Real2Sim module reconstructs editable scenes, aligns objects and cameras with the input, validates demonstrated or retargeted actions through native physics execution, and generates task-conditioned variations with action-feasibility checks. Within these environments, the agent generates executable code for manipulation stages, observes their outcomes, and distills successful attempts and failures into reusable task procedures, object-relative motions, and recovery strategies. Through a shared perception-and-control interface, these skills guide subsequent execution in simulation and on real robots, with motions adapted to current observations and no updates to the underlying model weights. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that Real2Gym enables high-fidelity simulation environment reconstruction, outperforming GPT-6 Astra Direct Mode by 16.7% in success rate with approximately 74.9% fewer policy-execution tokens across these environments, while exceeding it by 33.3% in physical robot execution success rate across four tasks on a real Franka robot.

AI.tldr: Real2Gym是一个智能体式Real2Sim2Real框架，将人类与机器人演示转化为可交互的仿真gym，并把仿真中习得的技能迁移至真实机器人。
AI.motivation: 真实视频虽蕴含丰富的操作演示，但将其转化为可复用机器人技能需要视觉对齐的环境、可执行的物理交互以及从经验中学习的机制，现有方法难以同时满足这些要求。
AI.method: 该框架包含Real2Sim模块，可重建可编辑场景、对齐物体与相机、通过原生物理执行验证演示或重定向动作，并生成带动作可行性检查的任务条件化变体；智能体在环境中为操作阶段生成可执行代码、观察结果，并将成功与失败蒸馏为可复用的任务流程、物体相对运动与恢复策略；通过共享的感知与控制接口，这些技能在仿真与真机上指导后续执行，且无需更新模型权重。
AI.result: 评估表明Real2Gym可实现高保真仿真环境重建，在成功率上比GPT-6 Astra Direct Mode高16.7%，策略执行token减少约74.9%；在真实Franka机器人四项任务上，物理执行成功率高出33.3%。
AI.conclusion: Real2Gym验证了从真实演示到仿真gym再到真实机器人的智能体式Real2Sim2Real路径的有效性，兼顾高保真重建、token高效与真机迁移性能。

title: Task-Oriented Visual Feature Compression via Residual Vector Quantization for Device-Edge Multimodal Inference
comment: 13 pages. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing
summary: Large multimodal models (LMMs) support diverse visual understanding and reasoning tasks but are often impractical to run entirely on resource-constrained devices. Device-edge co-inference reduces device computation, yet transmitting visual data over bandwidth-limited uplinks can introduce substantial delay. Task-oriented feature compression (TOFC) reduces the payload through feature aggregation and entropy coding. However, continuous-feature coding remains costly, and query-agnostic aggregation may discard task-relevant local evidence. We propose query-guided task-oriented feature compression (Q-TOFC) for device-edge multimodal inference. Q-TOFC employs residual vector quantization (RVQ) to encode each merged feature as a compact sequence of codebook indices, reducing its representation cost and allowing more features to be transmitted. It further incorporates query relevance into feature aggregation and uses a quantization error compensation adapter to mitigate the distortion introduced by discrete quantization. Experiments on seven multimodal benchmarks show that Q-TOFC reduces the visual payload by 53.6% relative to TOFC while maintaining comparable average normalized task performance. End-to-end latency evaluations further demonstrate lower latency under bandwidth-constrained uplinks.

AI.tldr: 提出查询引导的任务导向特征压缩方法Q-TOFC，用于设备-边缘多模态推理，通过RVQ编码、查询相关性聚合与量化误差补偿，在保持任务性能的同时将视觉载荷较TOFC降低53.6%。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型（LMMs）难以在资源受限设备上完全本地运行，设备-边缘协同推理虽可减轻设备算力负担，但带宽受限的上行链路传输视觉数据会带来显著延迟。现有任务导向特征压缩（TOFC）虽通过特征聚合与熵编码降低载荷，但连续特征编码开销仍高，且与查询无关的聚合可能丢失任务相关的局部证据。
AI.method: 提出查询引导的任务导向特征压缩（Q-TOFC）：采用残差向量量化（RVQ）将每个合并特征编码为紧凑的码本索引序列，降低表示开销以传输更多特征；在特征聚合中引入查询相关性；并使用量化误差补偿适配器缓解离散量化带来的失真。
AI.result: 在七个多模态基准上，Q-TOFC相较TOFC将视觉载荷减少53.6%，平均归一化任务性能相当；端到端延迟评估显示在带宽受限上行链路下具有更低延迟。
AI.conclusion: Q-TOFC通过离散量化编码、查询引导聚合与量化误差补偿，有效降低设备-边缘多模态推理的传输载荷与延迟，同时保持任务性能，适用于带宽受限场景。

title: Why MLLMs Struggle to Count: Overcoming Individuation and Aggregation Bottlenecks with ConvStack
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) consistently struggle with fine-grained visual counting, yet the underlying causes remain poorly understood. In this work, we present a mechanistic analysis of this failure mode, identifying two critical bottlenecks inherent to the global attention pipeline of MLLMs. First, we reveal an individuation bottleneck stemming from image patchification: because Vision Transformers process patches independently, they struggle to group fragmented geometric features across boundaries into distinct object representations. Second, we identify a collapse in the subsequent counting aggregation process, where representation separation rapidly diminishes as numerosity increases due to attention compression. Identifying and formalizing these twin bottlenecks constitutes our first major contribution. To overcome them, we propose ConvStack, a lightweight architecture that operates directly in the visual token space to explicitly aggregate and inject local spatial structures via zero-initialized residual connections. By explicitly addressing the individuation bottleneck, ConvStack provides unambiguous geometric evidence for downstream aggregation. Remarkably, by fine-tuning exclusively on counting tasks, the model achieves substantial improvements in dense object counting and broader spatial understanding benchmarks, without compromising on general visual capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）细粒度计数失败进行机制性分析，揭示图像分块导致的“个体化瓶颈”与注意力压缩导致的“聚合崩溃”双重瓶颈，并提出轻量架构ConvStack，在视觉token空间显式注入局部空间结构，显著提升密集计数与空间理解能力且不损害通用视觉能力。
AI.motivation: MLLMs在细粒度视觉计数上持续失败，但其根本原因尚不明确。作者希望从机制层面定位失败根源，而非仅做性能修补。
AI.method: 1) 机制分析：剖析MLLMs全局注意力流水线，识别出两个瓶颈——(a) 个体化瓶颈：ViT独立处理图像块，难以跨边界将碎片化几何特征分组为独立物体表征；(b) 计数聚合崩溃：随数量增加，因注意力压缩导致表征分离度迅速衰减。2) ConvStack：一种轻量架构，直接在视觉token空间操作，通过零初始化残差连接显式聚合并注入局部空间结构，为下游聚合提供无歧义的几何证据。
AI.result: 仅在计数任务上微调，ConvStack即在密集物体计数和更广泛的空间理解基准上取得显著提升，同时不损害通用视觉能力。
AI.conclusion: MLLMs计数失败源于个体化与聚合的双重瓶颈；显式注入局部空间结构可有效缓解该问题，表明机制性分析与针对性架构设计的结合，能在极低微调成本下提升空间感知能力并保持通用性能。

title: V2X-WAM: A Cooperative World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Vehicle-infrastructure cooperation can complement onboard sensing with broader and more informative observations of the traffic environment, providing valuable support for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing cooperative driving methods mainly exploit roadside information to enhance the representation of the current scene, while the future consequences of prospective driving actions are rarely modeled explicitly. This limits the ability of the planner to anticipate how its decisions may interact with the evolving traffic environment. To address this issue, we propose V2X-WAM, a cooperative world action model that tightly couples cooperative scene understanding, action generation, and future-world reasoning. V2X-WAM constructs a reliability-aware spatiotemporal representation from vehicle- and infrastructure-side observations, while compressing infrastructure information into a compact quantized message for efficient communication. Based on the resulting cooperative representation, a multimodal planner generates prospective trajectories, which explicitly condition future occupancy and dynamic-flow prediction. The predicted world consequences are then fed back to refine the planned trajectory, forming a closed interaction between action and future-world evolution. Experiments on a large-scale real-world cooperative driving dataset demonstrate that V2X-WAM consistently improves planning accuracy and safety over representative end-to-end cooperative driving methods, while achieving stronger future-world prediction and substantially lower communication overhead. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of the proposed design.

AI.tldr: 提出V2X-WAM协同世界动作模型，紧耦合协同场景理解、动作生成与未来世界推理，并压缩路侧信息以降低通信开销。
AI.motivation: 现有协同驾驶方法主要利用路侧信息增强当前场景表征，较少显式建模驾驶动作的未来后果，限制规划器对决策与动态交通环境交互的预判能力。
AI.method: 从车端与路侧观测构建可靠性感知的时空表征，并将路侧信息压缩为紧凑量化消息以实现高效通信；基于该协同表征，多模态规划器生成候选轨迹，并显式条件化未来占据与动态流预测；预测的世界后果回馈以精化轨迹，形成动作与未来世界演化的闭环交互。
AI.result: 在大型真实协同驾驶数据集上，规划精度与安全性一致优于代表性端到端协同驾驶方法，未来世界预测更强且通信开销显著降低；消融实验验证了设计有效性。
AI.conclusion: V2X-WAM通过显式建模动作的未来后果并回馈精化规划，提升了协同端到端自动驾驶的规划精度、安全性与通信效率。

title: What Does Post-Training Change in Multilingual Reasoning?
comment: 20 pages, 9 figures, 21 tables. Main paper and supplementary material in one document
summary: Open-source reasoning models provide unequal access to reasoning capability across languages. When a model can solve a problem but cannot deliver a complete solution in the user's language, language becomes an access barrier rather than merely a source of performance variation. We audit Qwen3 checkpoints on competition-mathematics tasks in eleven languages. Across the ten non-English languages, only 15.4-17.9% of problems receive a correct, terminating solution with visible reasoning in the requested language in any of 16 samples, compared with 92.9% in English. To identify the source of this disparity, we evaluate thirteen endpoints from one model family, spanning released checkpoints, multilingual supervised fine-tuning (SFT) at two scales, controlled SFT ablations, and three reinforcement-learning (RL) reward formulations. We jointly track correctness, language adherence, termination, and delivery efficiency. The dominant bottleneck shifts across post-training stages. Released models often reason in English. Multilingual SFT restores target-language reasoning, but accuracy declines across multilingual, English-only, and single-language SFT runs, showing that this cost is not specific to multilingual mixing; non-English reasoning traces additionally become prone to non-terminating loops. RL restores termination in both arms at no cost in accuracy, but only the arm whose reward includes a language term delivers: rewarding correctness alone returns the model to English. Together, these stages establish a constructive post-training path from English-pivoted capability to multilingual reasoning that is reliably delivered.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计Qwen3系列模型在11种语言竞赛数学任务上的表现，发现非英语存在严重的"语言访问障碍"，并定位了各后训练阶段的主导瓶颈，提出可行路径。
AI.motivation: 开源推理模型在不同语言间提供不均等的推理能力。当模型能解题却无法用用户语言给出完整解时，语言就不再只是性能差异，而成为"访问障碍"。作者希望厘清这一不平等的来源及补救方法。
AI.method: 在11种语言的竞赛数学任务上审计Qwen3各个检查点；评估同一模型家族的13个端点，覆盖已发布检查点、两种规模的多语言SFT、受控SFT消融，以及三种RL奖励形式；联合追踪正确性、语言遵循度、终止性和交付效率。
AI.result: 10种非英语语言中，16次采样里仅15.4–17.9%的题目能获得正确、终止且以目标语言给出可见推理的解，而英语为92.9%。已发布模型常用英语推理；多语言SFT恢复了目标语言推理，但准确率下降（在多语言、仅英语、单语言SFT中均出现，说明并非多语言混合特有），且非英语推理轨迹易陷入不终止循环。RL在两条路径上都无损恢复了终止性，但只有奖励中包含语言项的路径有效；仅奖励正确性会使模型回归英语。
AI.conclusion: 主导瓶颈随后训练阶段转移。多语言SFT恢复语言但损准确率，RL（含语言奖励）恢复终止性且不损准确率。这些阶段共同构成一条从"英语枢纽"能力走向"可靠交付的多语言推理"的建设性后训练路径。

title: VACE: Validation-Gated Alternating Co-Evolution of Agent Models and Harnesses
summary: Language model agents can be improved by updating their model weights or refining the harness that guides task execution. These components are coupled: weight updates change how the model uses the harness, while harness updates change the trajectories used for training. We propose VACE, Validation-Gated Alternating CoEvolution, which alternates agentic reinforcement learning with trajectory-driven harness refinement. After each RL stage, VACE reuses the collected trajectories to propose a harness revision and evaluates the incumbent and candidate with the updated model held fixed. The candidate guides subsequent training only if it improves validation performance. With Qwen3.5-9B, VACE achieves 45.26% test accuracy on OfficeQA and a mean partial-credit score of 75.19% on AutomationBench, exceeding weight-only RL by 6.43 and 9.09 percentage points and ungated alternation by 4.59 and 6.95 points, respectively. Across 44 harness proposals, 17 reduce validation performance at the updated checkpoint and are rejected before subsequent RL training, highlighting the importance of validation gating.

AI.tldr: 提出VACE，将智能体强化学习与轨迹驱动的harness优化交替进行，并用验证门控确保每次harness修改都带来验证性能提升。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体可通过更新模型权重或改进引导任务执行的harness来提升，但二者相互耦合：权重更新会改变模型对harness的使用方式，harness更新又会改变用于训练的轨迹。因此需要一种能处理这种耦合、并避免劣质harness拖累训练的协同优化方法。
AI.method: VACE（Validation-Gated Alternating CoEvolution）交替执行智能体强化学习与轨迹驱动的harness优化。每个RL阶段结束后，复用收集到的轨迹提出harness修改方案，并在更新后的模型固定不变的情况下，评估现有harness与候选harness；仅当候选方案能提升验证性能时，才用于指导后续训练。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-9B上，VACE在OfficeQA取得45.26%的测试准确率，在AutomationBench取得75.19%的平均部分得分；分别比仅更新权重的RL高出6.43和9.09个百分点，比无门控交替方法高出4.59和6.95个百分点。44个harness提案中有17个在更新后的检查点上降低了验证性能，因此被拒绝而未进入后续RL训练。
AI.conclusion: 验证门控对于权重与harness协同进化至关重要，可有效筛除损害性能的harness修改，从而稳定并提升智能体整体表现。

title: Waypoint-1.5: A Real-Time Video World Model for Consumer Hardware
summary: We present Waypoint 1.5, a real-time diffusion world model for interactive video generation on consumer-grade hardware. Unlike general video diffusion models, interactive world models (iWMs) must respond to dense user controls under strict latency and throughput constraints. Waypoint 1.5 is pre-trained on 100,000 hours of diverse, control-aligned video game data across hundreds of games, and generates playable video conditioned on full keyboard and mouse input. The model includes two resolution variants that run across a wide spectrum of consumer hardware. To characterize this unique setting, we distinguish rendered FPS, latent FPS, and control rate. We describe the data pipeline, architecture, training methodology, and runtime system behind Waypoint 1.5. We evaluate interactivity through latency and throughput. Finally, we discuss the safety and ethics considerations unique to iWMs.

AI.tldr: Waypoint 1.5 是一个面向消费级硬件的实时扩散世界模型，用于交互式视频生成，基于10万小时游戏视频预训练，支持完整键鼠控制并可在多种消费级设备上运行。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型（iWMs）与通用视频扩散模型不同，必须在严格的延迟与吞吐量约束下响应高密度用户控制。论文旨在刻画并解决这一独特场景下的生成需求。
AI.method: Waypoint 1.5 在10万小时、覆盖数百款游戏的控制对齐视频数据上预训练，以完整键盘与鼠标输入为条件生成可玩视频；提供两个分辨率变体以适配多种消费级硬件。论文定义了渲染 FPS、潜在 FPS 与控制速率三个指标，并介绍了数据管线、架构、训练方法与运行时系统。
AI.result: 通过延迟与吞吐量两个维度评估模型的交互性，并在广泛消费级硬件上验证了可运行性。
AI.conclusion: Waypoint 1.5 展示了在消费级硬件上实现实时交互式视频生成的可行性，并讨论了 iWMs 特有的安全与伦理问题。

title: NRF-GS: Neural Residual Fields for Expressive and Compact Gaussian Splatting
summary: We revisit the role of appearance modeling in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and show that limited expressiveness in view-dependent reflectance is a key driver of representation redundancy. In standard 3DGS, low-order spherical harmonics (SH) are used, restricting the splats' ability to model high-frequency directional effects, which is typically compensated by increasing the number of splats. We propose \emph{NRF-GS: Neural Residual Fields for Gaussian Splatting}, a hybrid representation that replaces per-splat SH-bases with a shared neural residual field. Each Gaussian encodes a compact set of appearance features and a lambertian base color, while a lightweight \emph{global scene-level MLP} predicts view-dependent residuals conditioned on viewing direction, distance, and per-splat features. This formulation enhances directional reflectance modeling by combining diffuse per-splat reflectance representations with a shared global function for high-frequency details, enabling both higher expressiveness and parameter sharing across splats. Our key insight is that by accurately capturing high-frequency directional reflectance, especially in specular regions, the GS-representation becomes more expressive, reducing the need for geometrically redundant splats. As a result, NRF-GS achieves comparable or better rendering quality while reducing the number of Gaussians by up to 50\%, and produces visibly improved specular and high-frequency details.

AI.tldr: 提出NRF-GS，用共享神经残差场替代逐高斯的低阶球谐，在减少最多50%高斯数量的同时保持或提升渲染质量，改善高光高频细节。
AI.motivation: 标准3DGS使用低阶球谐（SH）建模视角相关反射，表达能力有限，难以刻画高频方向性效果，通常只能通过增加高斯数量来补偿，导致表示冗余。
AI.method: 用共享的神经残差场替代逐高斯的SH基：每个高斯仅编码紧凑的外观特征和朗伯基色，由一个轻量的全局场景级MLP以观察方向、距离和逐高斯特征为条件预测视角相关残差，将漫反射的逐高斯表示与共享全局函数结合以建模高频细节，实现参数共享。
AI.result: 渲染质量相当或更优，高斯数量减少最多50%，高光与高频细节有可见改善。
AI.conclusion: 准确捕捉高频方向性反射（尤其高光区域）可提升GS表示的表达力，减少对几何冗余高斯的依赖，为外观建模与表示紧凑性提供新思路。

title: Unlocking the Critic: Reward-Free Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training
summary: Recent approaches to reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for large language models increasingly remove the critic to reduce training instability and memory overhead. Even where a critic is trained, it is discarded once training ends, although it has learned to predict outcomes. We revisit this trend and show that a pretrained critic's ability to predict future outcomes can make it a valuable asset for efficient long-horizon reasoning. First, we find that instability in critic-based RL for long chain-of-thought reasoning is largely an optimization artifact: keeping policy updates small and low in variance restores stable convergence. Second, a well-pretrained critic estimates the posterior probability of eventual success from later trajectory states and unfinished prefixes. Its predictions provide outcome-derived, dense, per-prefix learning signals that, during policy optimization, require neither completed rollouts, step-level annotations, nor external reward labels. Building on this insight, we introduce Reward-Free Policy Optimization (RFPO), which repurposes a single calibrated, frozen critic as a rollout-level reward, a value baseline for generalized advantage estimation, and a success forecaster for unfinished prefixes. We further show that binarizing the debiased score stops the policy from exploiting the critic's length bias. Binarized, RFPO matches supervised PPO without a single label in the training loop, while cutting compute and memory overhead. This makes RFPO well suited to long-horizon reasoning tasks, where outcomes arrive late and generation dominates cost: because rollouts can be rewarded before they finish, training no longer has to pay for waiting on every trajectory to complete. Our findings challenge the prevailing critic-free paradigm and establish critic-based, reward-free optimization as a scalable and computationally efficient path for LLM post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Reward-Free Policy Optimization (RFPO)，复用单个已校准、冻结的critic作为rollout级奖励、价值基线和成功预测器，实现无需任何奖励标签的策略优化，在长程推理任务上匹配有监督PPO，同时降低计算与内存开销。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM强化学习后训练趋势倾向于移除critic以降低训练不稳定性和内存开销，即便训练了critic也在训练结束后丢弃。作者认为这一趋势值得重新审视，因为预训练critic预测未来结果的能力可成为高效长程推理的宝贵资产。
AI.method: 首先论证critic-based RL在长链式思维推理中的不稳定性主要是优化伪影，通过保持策略更新小且低方差即可恢复稳定收敛。其次，利用预训练良好的critic估计后续轨迹状态和未完成前缀的最终成功后验概率，其预测提供基于结果、稠密、逐前缀的学习信号，且不依赖完整rollout、步级标注或外部奖励标签。基于此提出RFPO，将单个校准、冻结的critic复用为三用途：rollout级奖励、GAE的价值基线、未完成前缀的成功预测器；并通过对去偏分数二值化，防止策略利用critic的长度偏差。
AI.result: 二值化后的RFPO在训练循环中无任何标签的情况下匹配有监督PPO，同时削减计算和内存开销。由于rollout可在完成前获得奖励，训练无需为等待每条轨迹完成付出代价，特别适用于结果延迟、生成主导成本的长程推理任务。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果挑战了当前主流的critic-free范式，确立了基于critic、无奖励的优化作为LLM后训练中可扩展且计算高效的路径。

title: Cross-Linguistic Effects in Bilingual Phoneme BabyLMs
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables; Accepted at the 2nd BabyLM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Cross-linguistic effects are a central topic in bilingual first-language acquisition. Artificial learners can help investigate L1-L2 interactions by enabling controlled comparisons across language combinations and learning conditions. Recent work explores this direction by training bilingual language models under developmentally plausible constraints. However, human and model learners still diverge in fundamental ways, with one major difference being input modality: children learn primarily from spoken input, whereas language models are typically trained on orthographic text. To reduce this gap, researchers have trained models on phonemic representations of speech. In this work, we combine these research directions to train bilingual BabyLMs with phonemic input. We keep English fixed as the L2 and vary the L1 across German, Swedish, Persian, and Basque, selected to represent contrasting combinations of syntactic and phoneme-inventory distance from English. Our results show stronger L1-related variation in grammatical learning trajectories under phonemic than orthographic input, while early lexical differences align with phoneme-inventory similarity.

AI.tldr: 该研究训练了以音素为输入的双语BabyLM，固定英语为L2，变换L1（德语、瑞典语、波斯语、巴斯克语），发现音素输入下语法学习轨迹的L1相关差异比正字法输入更强，而早期词汇差异与音素清单相似度一致。
AI.motivation: 跨语言效应是双语一语习得的核心议题。人工学习者可通过受控的语言组合与学习条件比较来研究L1-L2互动。已有工作以发展上合理的约束训练双语语言模型，但人类与模型学习者仍在根本层面存在分歧，其中最显著的差异之一是输入模态：儿童主要从口语输入学习，而语言模型通常以正字法文本训练。为缩小这一差距，研究者开始用语音的音素表征训练模型。本文结合这两条研究路线。
AI.method: 训练以音素为输入的双语BabyLM：固定英语为L2，L1在德语、瑞典语、波斯语、巴斯克语之间变化，这些语言被选取以代表与英语在句法距离和音素清单距离上的对比组合。随后比较音素输入与正字法输入下的学习表现。
AI.result: 在音素输入下，语法学习轨迹呈现出比正字法输入更强的L1相关变异；而早期词汇层面的差异与音素清单相似度相一致。
AI.conclusion: 输入模态（音素 vs. 正字法）显著影响双语语言模型中的跨语言效应：音素输入放大了L1对语法学习轨迹的影响，词汇层面的早期差异则由音素清单相似度驱动。这表明在发展上更贴近儿童学习条件的音素输入有助于更真实地模拟双语习得中的L1-L2互动。

title: EviViT: Evidence-Adaptive Vision Transformers for Fine-Grained Perception
summary: Fine-grained visual perception enables vision-language models to distinguish subtle attributes and ground their answers in visual evidence. In high-resolution scenes, processing the whole image at greater resolution spends visual tokens on irrelevant content, while isolated crops can lose the context needed to interpret the selected evidence. We introduce EviViT, a lightweight attachment that learns where a pretrained vision transformer should acquire detail. Human visual-search traces supervise a question-conditioned evidence density, which guides regional re-reading from the original pixels and the allocation of visual tokens. A sparse, coordinate-aware bridge then connects the regional features to the global scene, allowing the host to interpret precise evidence in context. Learned with the host backbone frozen, the attachment serves both the base model and compatible post-trained descendants without refitting. Experiments across nine hosts show consistent gains in average fine-grained accuracy. Matched-budget comparisons further show that EviViT outperforms global-only processing at every tested token ceiling while using fewer visual tokens.

AI.tldr: EviViT是一种轻量级附加模块，学习预训练视觉Transformer应在何处获取细节，通过人类视觉搜索轨迹监督的问题条件证据密度引导区域重读与视觉token分配，实现高分辨率细粒度视觉感知。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型需要细粒度视觉感知来区分细微属性并将答案锚定于视觉证据。在高分辨率场景中，直接处理整图会浪费视觉token于无关内容，而孤立裁剪又会丢失解读证据所需的上下文。
AI.method: EviViT以人类视觉搜索轨迹监督一个问题条件的证据密度，据此从原始像素进行区域重读并分配视觉token；随后用稀疏、坐标感知的桥接结构将区域特征与全局场景连接，使宿主模型能在上下文中解读精确证据。训练时冻结宿主骨干。
AI.result: 在九个宿主模型上实验，平均细粒度准确率均一致提升。相同预算对比显示，EviViT在每个测试token上限下均优于仅全局处理，且使用更少视觉token。
AI.conclusion: 该轻量级附加模块可同时服务基础模型及兼容的后训练衍生模型而无需重新拟合，有效提升细粒度视觉感知效率与准确率。

title: LLM unbranding: Erasing Commercial Identity while Preserving Generic Utility
summary: Establishing unbranding as a critical practice to prevent visual logos from acquiring negative connotations is standard in image generation. Large Language Models (LLMs) now face a parallel and emerging challenge. These models frequently generate brand descriptions within diverse contexts. This frequency introduces significant risks, such as trademark dilution, false attribution, and brand defamation. In response, we formally define the novel task of LLM Unbranding. We specifically address the complex challenge of managing trade dress within textual outputs. This involves neutralizing characteristic language, slogans, and stylistic markers that define brand identity. Crucially, these elements are less evident than explicit visual logos. To benchmark this task, we introduce a comprehensive evaluation dataset incorporating prominent brands from multiple commercial domains. We rigorously evaluate existing state-of-the-art machine unlearning models using this benchmark. This evaluation identifies their limitations in selective textual unbranding. Finally, we propose MUTE, a novel inference-time method that effectively neutralizes textual trade dress while preserving the LLM's general capabilities and utility. By leveraging an iterative refinement loop, MUTE systematically optimizes system instructions to safely eliminate brand leakage without requiring fragile parameter updates. Code and dataset: The evaluation dataset and code for LLM Unbranding are available at https://github.com/KajetanOzog/LLM_unbranding. The implementation of MUTE is available at https://github.com/KajetanOzog/MUTE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"LLM Unbranding"新任务，针对LLM生成品牌化文本描述（商业外观/trade dress）带来的商标稀释、误归属和品牌诽谤风险，构建了评测数据集，评估了现有机器遗忘模型，并提出推理时方法MUTE，通过迭代优化系统指令消除品牌泄漏。
AI.motivation: 图像生成领域已有"去品牌化"实践以防止视觉logo产生负面联想。LLM在多样语境中频繁生成品牌描述，带来商标稀释、误归属、品牌诽谤等风险。文本中的商业外观（口号、风格标记、特征语言）比显性视觉logo更隐蔽，是新兴且复杂的挑战，现有研究尚缺乏针对性方案。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义"LLM Unbranding"任务，聚焦文本输出中trade dress的中和；2) 构建涵盖多商业领域知名品牌的综合评测数据集；3) 用该基准严格评估现有SOTA机器遗忘模型；4) 提出MUTE——一种推理时方法，通过迭代精炼循环系统优化系统指令，无需脆弱的参数更新即可消除品牌泄漏。
AI.result: 现有SOTA机器遗忘模型在选择性文本去品牌化任务上存在明显局限；MUTE能有效中和文本商业外观，同时保持LLM的通用能力与实用性。数据集与代码已开源于GitHub。
AI.conclusion: 文本去品牌化是LLM面临的新兴挑战。相比参数更新式机器遗忘，推理时的指令迭代优化（MUTE）为安全消除品牌泄漏提供了更有效、更稳健的方案，兼顾品牌风险防控与模型通用效用。

title: Multi-Granularity Language-Guided Imitation Learning via Instruction Decomposition
