summary: Using language instructions as conditions to guide robot policy learning has recently become an important research domain. However, existing language-guided policy learning methods typically use an overall task description to guide the entire demonstration trajectory. For manipulation tasks involving multiple execution stages, these methods assign the same language description to different subtasks, making it difficult to distinguish the behaviors required at different stages. In this work, we propose a multi-granularity language guidance method based on instruction decomposition. The proposed method decomposes an overall task description into more fine-grained, concrete subtask-level language instructions, thereby enhancing learning efficiency and improving performance. We evaluate the proposed method in the setting of multi-task imitation learning and validate its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于指令分解的多粒度语言引导方法，将整体任务描述拆解为更细粒度的子任务级语言指令，用于机器人策略学习，在多任务模仿学习设置下验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有语言引导策略学习方法通常用整体任务描述指导整条示教轨迹；对于包含多个执行阶段的操作任务，不同子任务被赋予相同的语言描述，难以区分各阶段所需行为。
AI.method: 提出基于指令分解的多粒度语言引导方法：将整体任务描述分解为更细粒度、更具体的子任务级语言指令，以增强学习效率并提升性能。
AI.result: 在多任务模仿学习设置下进行了评估，验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过子任务级细粒度语言指令替代整体任务描述，可有效提升多阶段操作任务的策略学习效率与表现。

title: TaoFlowForge: Progressive Native Mesh Generation via Cascaded Flow Matching
summary: 3D content generation technology has significantly advanced the work of designers, as well as the 3D printing and gaming industries. However, it remains difficult to produce lightweight, editable, and topologically clean artistic content that is directly production-ready. To achieve this, we present TaoFlowForge, an artistic mesh foundation model that generates production-ready meshes. Specifically, TaoFlowForge decomposes the mesh generation process into vertices generation and their connectivity prediction, i.e., edges. We formulate vertices generation as a two-stage coarse-to-fine process and incorporate several effective loss functions to further enhance its performance. In the connectivity prediction stage, we propose a simple yet effective method for estimating the connectivity affinity between vertices and additionally predict per-vertex normals, which determines the correct orientation of faces. Besides, we construct a large-scale dataset combining hand-crafted 3D assets with public high-quality topology datasets. Based on this, a carefully designed data curation pipeline is employed to filter the raw dataset, retaining only high-quality topology data for model training. Our model is trained on the combined dataset and tested on both out-of-distribution hand-crafted set of 3D assets and public datasets. Under image-conditioned generation, TaoFlowForge outperforms autoregressive methods and achieves state-of-the-art results among open-source mesh topology generators. We will release all the code and weights together with a portion of our test dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TaoFlowForge，一种可直接投产的艺术网格基础模型，通过顶点生成与拓扑连接预测解耦，结合大规模数据筛选，在图像条件下生成轻量、可编辑、拓扑干净的三维网格，性能超越自回归方法并达到开源网格拓扑生成器的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有3D内容生成技术虽推动了设计、3D打印和游戏行业发展，但难以生成轻量、可编辑、拓扑干净且可直接投产的艺术内容，这是本文要解决的核心痛点。
AI.method: TaoFlowForge将网格生成拆解为顶点生成与顶点间连接（边）预测。顶点生成采用由粗到细的两阶段流程并引入多种有效损失函数增强性能；连接预测阶段提出简单有效的顶点间连接亲和度估计方法，并额外预测逐顶点法向量以确定面的正确朝向。同时构建了融合手工3D资产与公开高质量拓扑数据集的大规模数据集，并设计数据筛选流水线，仅保留高质量拓扑数据用于训练。
AI.result: 模型在合并数据集上训练，并在分布外手工3D资产集与公开数据集上测试。在图像条件生成任务下，TaoFlowForge优于自回归方法，在开源网格拓扑生成器中达到SOTA。作者将公开全部代码、权重及部分测试数据集。
AI.conclusion: TaoFlowForge通过顶点-连接解耦生成范式与高质量数据筛选，实现了可直接投产的艺术网格生成，在图像条件下取得开源网格拓扑生成的最优结果，并承诺开源代码、权重与部分测试数据以促进后续研究。

title: MSTypography: Multi-character Semantic Typography via Balancing Word Legibility and Object Recognizability
summary: Semantic typography is a design technique where the visual representation of a word conveys its semantic meaning, while maintaining its legibility. Existing digital typography methods mainly focus on single-character scenarios. They suffer from a lack of legibility constraints and insufficient local deformation when extended to multi-character words, as the intricate structures among multiple characters are hardly preserved during the typography process. In this paper, we propose a global-to-local typography framework for multi-character scenarios. It performs mask-driven silhouette approximation at the global level, while semantic-guided refinement at the local level, with a culling step in between to improve efficiency. To preserve word legibility, we designed structural losses (including explicit collision constraints and implicit Jacobian singular value constraints) and an OCR constraint for character-level readability. To enhance the object recognizability, we leverage semantic guidance with diffusion priors, which drives the character glyph toward the target concept while preserving its structural integrity. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first multi-character semantic typography method that effectively balances word legibility and object recognizability. Evaluations on five representative languages (English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic) demonstrate superiority over SOTA methods. Codes will be open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 提出首个多字符语义排版框架，通过全局掩码驱动轮廓逼近与局部语义引导精修，结合结构损失和OCR约束，平衡单词可读性与物体可识别性。
AI.motivation: 现有数字排版方法主要针对单字符场景，扩展到多字符单词时存在可读性约束不足、局部变形不充分的问题，因为多字符间的复杂结构在排版中难以保持。
AI.method: 提出全局到局部的排版框架：全局层面进行掩码驱动的轮廓逼近，局部层面进行语义引导精修，中间加入剔除步骤提升效率；设计结构损失（显式碰撞约束与隐式Jacobian奇异值约束）和OCR约束以保持字符级可读性；利用扩散先验的语义引导驱动字形趋近目标概念并保持结构完整性。
AI.result: 在英语、中文、日语、韩语、阿拉伯语五种代表性语言上的评估表明，该方法优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个能有效平衡单词可读性与物体可识别性的多字符语义排版方法，代码将开源。

title: LoLBench: Evaluating Coding Agents with Long-Horizon Proposals on Large Software Systems
summary: Modern coding agents can deliver increasingly large repository-level changes, and recent benchmarks reflect this by emphasizing long-horizon tasks with large reference implementations. Many benchmarks evaluate coding agents' implementation capability to produce correct code edits from detailed specifications. However, practical modular development tasks also require the perception capability of grounding user intent and high-level design to derive a specification. We introduce LoLBench to evaluate both capabilities through the entire proposal-to-implementation process on large software systems. It is a multilingual benchmark of 100 tasks across 29 software systems in five domains. Each task provides a human-written enhancement proposal with user intent and high-level design. On average, proposals contain about 5,000 words, software systems contain 2.4 million source lines of code (LoC), and implementation pull requests (PRs) change approximately 5,500 LoC. Across 28 agents we evaluated, the best agent resolves only 14% of tasks and achieves a 52.7% Fail-to-Pass (F2P) pass rate. Failure analysis identifies incomplete code localization as a major bottleneck, while providing reference-derived file trees alongside API specifications improves resolved rates by 16--22 percentage points (2.4--17$\times$), reaching at most 34%. These results show that both perception and implementation remain central challenges for coding agents in practical modular development on large software systems. LoLBench is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/lolbench26/LoLBench.

AI.tldr: 提出LoLBench基准，评估编码代理在大型软件系统上从提案到实现的全流程"感知+实现"能力。100个任务、29个系统、5个领域，最佳代理仅解决14%任务。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要评估编码代理依据详细规格说明产出正确代码编辑的"实现能力"，而实际的模块化开发还需要"感知能力"——即从用户意图和高层设计出发推导出规格说明。作者认为这两种能力都需被评估，因此构建覆盖从提案到实现全流程的基准。
AI.method: 构建LoLBench：多语言基准，包含5个领域、29个软件系统上的100个任务。每个任务提供人类撰写的增强提案，含用户意图与高层设计。平均提案约5000词，软件系统平均240万行代码，实现PR平均改动约5500行代码。评估28个代理，并进行失败分析及消融实验（提供参考派生的文件树与API规格说明）。
AI.result: 28个代理中最佳仅解决14%的任务，F2P通过率52.7%。失败分析显示不完整的代码定位是主要瓶颈；提供参考派生的文件树与API规格说明后，解决率提升16-22个百分点（2.4-17倍），最高仅达34%。
AI.conclusion: 在大型软件系统的实际模块化开发中，感知能力和实现能力仍是编码代理面临的核心挑战，LoLBench可作为评估此类全流程能力的基准。

title: Improved Distributional Diffusion Models
summary: Distributional Diffusion Models (DDMs) replace the standard mean-prediction denoiser with a \emph{distributional} denoiser trained via a scoring rule objective, learning a stochastic approximation to $p(x_1 \mid x_t)$ rather than its conditional mean. However, scaling DDMs to modern image-generation settings faces two obstacles: (i) multi-particle training incurs overhead that scales with the number of particles, (ii) DDMs use globally fixed scoring rule hyperparameters, forcing a single trade-off across sampling budgets. We mitigate these limitations by deferring particle expansion to late transformer layers, and the hyperparameter trade-off by introducing time-dependent scoring rule schedules informed by the dynamical regimes of~\citet{Biroli2024}. Combined with a DiT-based latent setup, these changes make DDM training practical on class-conditional ImageNet-$256^2$, achieving 4.48 FID at 4 steps and 2.38 at 50 steps with DiT-XL/2, from a single model trained from scratch in one stage, without a teacher, self-distillation or JVPs. The result is a stochastic few-step generator whose FID does not degrade as the sampling budget grows from 4 to 50 NFE, and the same recipe transfers to text-to-image generation. Code and pre-trained models available at https://github.com/CompVis/iDDM.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对分布式扩散模型（DDMs）在多粒子训练开销和固定评分规则超参两个瓶颈，提出将粒子扩展推迟到Transformer后层、并引入时间相关的评分规则调度，结合DiT潜空间设定，使DDM首次在ImageNet-256²上实用化。单模型、单阶段、无需教师/自蒸馏/JVP，4步FID 4.48、50步2.38，FID不随采样预算增加而退化，并可迁移到文生图。
AI.motivation: DDMs用分布式去噪器（通过评分规则目标训练）替代标准均值预测去噪器，学习p(x1|xt)的随机近似而非条件均值。但扩展到现代图像生成面临两个障碍：(i) 多粒子训练开销随粒子数增长；(ii) 全局固定的评分规则超参迫使在单一采样预算下做权衡。作者希望在不牺牲DMM随机性优势的前提下，降低训练开销并适配从少步到多步的不同采样预算。
AI.method: 1) 将粒子扩展推迟到Transformer的后层（late layers），减少多粒子训练带来的开销；2) 引入随时间变化的评分规则超参调度（time-dependent scoring rule schedules），其设计受Biroli2024关于动力学区域的启发，以缓解固定超参带来的单一权衡；3) 采用基于DiT的潜空间（latent）设定，使DDM训练在ImageNet-256²类条件生成上可行。整个方案为单阶段从头训练，不使用教师模型、自蒸馏或JVP。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-256²上使用DiT-XL/2，达到4步FID 4.48、50步FID 2.38。所得随机少步生成器的FID不会随采样预算从4 NFE增至50 NFE而退化。相同方案可迁移到文本到图像生成。代码与预训练模型已开源于https://github.com/CompVis/iDDM。
AI.conclusion: 通过将粒子扩展推迟到后层Transformer并采用时间相关评分规则调度，DDM训练在现代图像生成规模上变得实用，且以单阶段、无教师/自蒸馏/JVP的简单流程实现了少步与多步一致的优异FID，并具备向文生图任务的迁移能力。

title: Multimodal Detection of Higher-Order Behavioral Constructs: Self-Compassion in Structured Reflective Interaction
summary: Many of the qualities that matter most in how people learn and grow, how someone regulates their emotions, reflects on a setback, or stays aware of others during a difficult conversation, are not directly observable. They have to be inferred from how someone speaks, moves, and sounds over time, and they resist the kind of clean labeling that most machine learning pipelines are built around. We study this challenge through a case that is well grounded in psychological theory but rarely modeled computationally: self-compassion, the tendency to respond to one's own setbacks with patience rather than harsh self-criticism. We examine how it appears during structured reflective interviews in a technology-mediated training setting, where people naturally talk through socio-emotionally demanding situations. Since no existing dataset captures this kind of construct in this kind of setting, we collected and annotated 51 reflective dialog sessions using an independent, temporally overlapping annotation scheme grounded in established theory. We consolidate the underlying six-component psychological model into a three-class supervision space, balancing self-kindness and mindfulness against self-critical or overwhelmed states, and build a reproducible window-based pipeline that aligns video, audio, and text on a shared timeline. Unimodal models trained on each modality separately are compared against a simple probability-level fusion strategy, which yields modest but consistent gains over the best single modality. We close by discussing where each modality succeeds or struggles, what this suggests about how this kind of construct is actually expressed in reflective speech, and what would be needed to model it, and constructs like it, more effectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何在技术中介的反思性访谈中计算建模"自我同情"这一难以直接观测的心理构念。作者采集并标注了51段反思对话，将六成分心理模型压缩为三类监督空间，构建对齐视频、音频、文本的时间窗口流水线，并比较单模态模型与概率级融合策略，发现融合带来小幅但稳定的提升。
AI.motivation: 许多对学习与成长至关重要的心理品质（情绪调节、挫折反思、对话中的共情觉察）无法直接观测，只能从言语、动作和声音随时间的变化中推断，且难以进行机器学习流水线所需的清晰标注。作者选择"自我同情"——即面对自身挫折时以耐心而非严厉自我批评回应——作为案例，因为它有扎实的心理学理论支撑，却极少被计算建模。
AI.method: 在技术中介的培训场景中，通过结构化反思访谈采集数据，参与者自然叙述具有社会情感挑战性的情境。由于缺乏现成数据集，作者采集并标注了51段反思对话会话，采用独立且时间重叠的标注方案，该方案以既有理论为基础。将底层六成分心理模型整合为三类监督空间（自我仁慈与正念 vs. 自我批评或不堪重负状态），并构建可复现的基于窗口的流水线，在共享时间轴上对齐视频、音频和文本。分别训练各模态的单模态模型，并与简单的概率级融合策略进行比较。
AI.result: 概率级融合策略相较最佳单模态模型取得了适度但一致的性能提升。论文还讨论了各模态在何处成功或遇到困难，以及这对该构念在反思性言语中实际表达方式的启示。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了自我同情这类难以观测的心理构念在反思性言语中的表达特点，提出了一个可复现的多模态建模框架，并指出要更有效地建模此类构念所需的条件，为未来研究提供了方向。

title: End-to-End Self-Supervised RGB-T Tracking without Modality Misleading
summary: RGB-T object tracking leverages the complementary characteristics of visible and thermal infrared modalities to improve robustness under adverse conditions. Existing supervised methods typically rely on costly modality-aligned bounding box annotations, while most self-supervised approaches follow a two-stage pseudo-labeling paradigm, making tracker training sensitive to pseudo-label quality and preventing joint end-to-end optimization. In this paper, we propose ESMTrack, a fully end-to-end self-supervised RGB-T tracking framework without offline pseudo-label generation or dense frame-level bounding box annotations. Given only the standard initial-frame annotation used in visual tracking, ESMTrack learns discriminative and temporally consistent representations through two complementary objectives: a grounding triplet loss on annotated initial frames and a cross-frame temporal triplet loss on unlabeled search frames, with reliable samples selected by forward-backward consistency. To address modality dominance bias, ESMTrack employs a three-branch architecture consisting of a fusion branch and two unimodal branches for RGB and thermal inputs. We quantify modality contributions using the Average Peak-to-Correlation Energy by measuring response discrepancies between the fusion and unimodal branches. The resulting reliability estimates guide a training-time modality decoupling mechanism that suppresses dominant-modality shortcuts and adaptively weights cross-modal contrastive learning for task-level alignment. Extensive experiments on five RGB-T tracking benchmarks show that ESMTrack achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance, strong cross-dataset generalization, and real-time inference speed. The source code is available at https://github.com/LiShenglana/ESMTrack.

AI.tldr: ESMTrack：首个全端到端自监督RGB-T跟踪框架，仅用首帧标注，通过双重三元组损失与模态解耦机制实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有监督式RGB-T跟踪依赖昂贵的模态对齐边界框标注；自监督方法多采用两阶段伪标签范式，训练对伪标签质量敏感且无法联合端到端优化。
AI.method: 提出全端到端自监督框架ESMTrack。仅用标准首帧标注，采用两个互补目标：标注首帧上的grounding triplet loss与无标签搜索帧上的跨帧时序triplet loss，样本由前向-后向一致性筛选。针对模态主导偏差，设计三分支架构（融合分支+RGB/热红外单模态分支），用APCE量化模态贡献，据此指导训练时模态解耦机制，抑制主导模态捷径并自适应加权跨模态对比学习。
AI.result: 在五个RGB-T跟踪基准上达到有竞争力的SOTA性能，具备强跨数据集泛化能力和实时推理速度。
AI.conclusion: ESMTrack无需离线伪标签生成或密集帧级标注，实现了自监督RGB-T跟踪的端到端联合优化，兼顾性能、泛化与效率。

title: Trajectory Soup: Pushing the Compute-Scaling Frontier of LLM Mid-training via Diverse Trajectories
summary: Mid-training equips pretrained large language models with specialized and reasoning capabilities, but the returns of this stage are bounded since additional serial compute yields little further downstream improvement and can even degrade some capabilities, which places a practical ceiling on how much compute mid-training absorbs. We revisit how this compute should be allocated to a single run or multiple similar optimizations. We find that branches forked from a shared checkpoint under various controlled recipe reaches measurably different regions of parameter space, and establish a form of compatible diversity that extending one run cannot supply. Therefore, we introduce Trajectory Soup, which distributes a mid-training budget over several independent branches, and consolidates strongest checkpoints selected on validation through intra- and inter-trajectory averaging into a single model. A local bias and variance analysis separates the two averaging levels, showing that inter-trajectory averaging removes residual error beyond the reach of averaging within a trajectory, while checkpoint selection carries a bias that bounds how many checkpoints are worth merging. Across model scales, learning-rate schedules, token budgets, and trajectory counts, Trajectory Soup improves aggregate downstream performance over the strongest single-trajectory average under matched budgets and keeps improving as budgets expand, with the advantage preserved after an identical post-training pipeline. These results position trajectory allocation and merging as a practical way to extend the compute-scaling frontier of mid-training beyond serial saturation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Trajectory Soup，将中训练算力分配到多条独立分支，通过轨迹内与轨迹间平均合并验证集上最优检查点，突破单次串行训练的算力饱和瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 中训练虽赋予预训练大模型专门化与推理能力，但收益有界：额外串行算力对下游提升甚微，甚至导致部分能力退化，形成算力吸收上限。作者反思这笔算力在单次运行或多次相似优化间应如何分配。
AI.method: 从共享检查点在不同受控配方下分叉出的分支会落入参数空间中可测量地不同的区域，作者据此提出"兼容多样性"概念，即扩展单条轨迹无法提供。据此设计Trajectory Soup：将中训练预算分配给多条独立分支，在验证集上选出最强检查点，通过轨迹内平均与轨迹间平均整合为单一模型；并用局部偏差-方差分析区分两层平均的作用。
AI.result: 轨迹间平均可消除轨迹内平均无法触及的残差误差；检查点选择带来的偏差限制了值得合并的检查点数量。在多种模型规模、学习率调度、token预算与轨迹数量下，Trajectory Soup在同等预算下优于最强的单轨迹平均，且随预算扩大持续提升，经相同后训练流程后优势依然保持。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹分配与合并是将中训练算力扩展前沿推向串行饱和之外的一条实用路径。

title: Bridging Semantic Gaps in RAG through Generated Context Knowledge Fusion
comment: This paper is accepted by NLPCC 2026
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation has established itself as a fundamental framework in natural language processing, seamlessly integrating information retrieval with the generative capabilities of large language models. However, this process is fundamentally constrained by a critical challenge: semantic space mismatch between queries and retrieved contexts. We propose Knowledge-Aware Semantic Bridging (KASB), a novel framework that improves passage selection quality through semantic space alignment between queries and retrieved documents through intelligent knowledge fusion. Our approach leverages the complementary strengths of generative and retrieval-based knowledge through a multistage process that enhances both relevance and accuracy. We evaluate KASB on three popular open-domain Question Answering datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出知识感知语义桥接框架（KASB），通过多阶段知识融合对齐查询与检索文档的语义空间，提升段落选择质量，并在三个开放域问答数据集上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成自然语言处理中的基础框架，将信息检索与大语言模型的生成能力相结合。然而该过程受限于一个关键挑战：查询与检索上下文之间存在语义空间不匹配，导致检索段落与查询的相关性受限，进而影响生成质量。
AI.method: 提出KASB（Knowledge-Aware Semantic Bridging）框架。该框架利用生成式知识与检索式知识的互补优势，通过多阶段处理流程，在查询与检索文档之间进行语义空间对齐与智能知识融合，以提升段落选择质量，从而同时增强相关性与准确性。
AI.result: 在三个主流的开放域问答（Open-domain Question Answering）数据集上对KASB进行了评估，实验结果证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: KASB通过语义空间对齐与知识融合有效缓解了RAG中查询与检索上下文语义空间不匹配的问题，提升了段落选择的质量，在开放域问答任务上表现有效。

title: VLM Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have provided a unified interface for end-to-end combinatorial optimization (CO), but textual serialization alone may obscure spatial and relational structures that are important for generating effective CO solutions. This paper presents a general-purpose vision-language solver that augments textual instance descriptions with input-derived visual representations. A single vision-language model (VLM) is applied across different CO tasks and trained using supervised fine-tuning followed by verifier-guided reinforcement learning. While the visual inputs contain no gold solutions or solution-derived information, our experiments show that the VLM generally improves solution quality over its text-only counterpart, with particularly clear gains on more complex CO problems such as CVRP and JSSP. The advantage of visual information is more pronounced at large problem scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通用视觉-语言求解器，用问题实例衍生的视觉表征增强文本描述，通过监督微调与验证器引导的强化学习训练单一VLM跨CO任务求解，视觉输入不含解信息但在大规模复杂问题上带来明显增益。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM将组合优化（CO）统一为端到端文本接口，但纯文本序列化可能丢失对生成有效解至关重要的空间与关系结构。作者希望借助视觉表征弥补这一信息缺口，并验证视觉信息是否能在不依赖解信息的前提下提升求解质量。
AI.method: 构建通用视觉-语言求解器：在文本实例描述基础上，加入由输入本身导出的视觉表示（不含gold solution或任何解相关信息）。使用单一VLM覆盖多种CO任务，训练分两阶段：先监督微调，再进行验证器引导的强化学习。
AI.result: VLM整体优于纯文本基线；在更复杂的CO问题（如CVRP、JSSP）上增益尤为明显；且问题规模越大，视觉信息的优势越显著。
AI.conclusion: 视觉输入可在不引入解信息的情况下为LLM式组合优化提供有效补充，是一种通用且可扩展的增强手段，尤其适用于大规模复杂CO任务。

title: Sparse cubical complexes for efficient topology-preservation in image data
summary: Persistent homology (PH) is a frequently used tool for extracting and preserving topological information from image data, particularly in image segmentation, where preservation of topological structures is important. However, despite its general applicability across dimensionality, domains, and target structures, the runtime cost of PH-based methods often makes their practical use infeasible. In this work, we argue that this runtime cost is largely driven by processing information that is unimportant for downstream application (e.g. as optimization objective). We propose sparse cubical filtrations as an alternative foundation for PH computation, reducing subsequent computational costs by factors of up to 100 on real datasets. We show close agreement with the optimization signal of the dense counterpart and empirically evaluate our solution's effectiveness as an optimization objective in realistic training regimes where other PH-based objectives can practically not operate (i.e., 3D data with large patch sizes). We show how our solution improves topological accuracy by up to 80\% across six diverse datasets while maintaining pixel- and region-based accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出稀疏立方过滤（sparse cubical filtrations）作为持续同调（PH）计算的替代基础，将后续计算成本最高降低100倍，同时保持与稠密方法接近的优化信号，在六类数据集上最多提升80%的拓扑准确率，使PH目标可用于此前无法运行的大尺寸三维图像训练场景。
AI.motivation: 持续同调（PH）能提取并保留图像数据中的拓扑信息，在图像分割中尤为重要，因其需保证拓扑结构正确。尽管PH在维度、领域和目标结构上具有通用性，但其运行成本高昂，导致实际应用常常不可行。作者认为，这一成本主要来源于处理了对下游应用（如优化目标）并不重要的信息。
AI.method: 提出以稀疏立方过滤（sparse cubical filtrations）作为PH计算的新基础，仅对与下游应用相关的信息进行处理，从而降低后续计算开销；并将其作为优化目标，与稠密（dense）对应方法进行对比验证。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上，后续计算成本最高降低100倍；其优化信号与稠密对应方法高度一致；作为优化目标在现实训练场景（如大图块尺寸的三维数据）中有效，而其他PH目标在此类场景下实际无法运行；在六个多样化数据集上，拓扑准确率最高提升80%，同时保持像素级与区域级准确率。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏立方过滤可显著降低PH计算成本，并可作为有效的拓扑优化目标，在保持像素级与区域级精度的同时提升拓扑正确性，拓展了PH方法在大尺寸三维图像等实际场景中的可行性。

title: InsightMap: Structured Spatial Modeling for Embodied Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Language-guided navigation requires connecting partial observations to a persistent spatial reference and learning how actions change that representation. We introduce InsightMap, a framework that uses top-down maps as both explicit spatial memory and action-conditioned prediction targets. Historical views are linked to labeled map locations, and a shared multimodal backbone jointly learns navigation action prediction and post-action map generation. Map prediction provides auxiliary training supervision, while navigation inference decodes actions from the observed spatial context. An aligned RGB-D data pipeline supports a common interface for navigation, visual question answering, situated reasoning, and 3D grounding. On the validation-unseen splits of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, InsightMap achieves success rates (SR) of 56.9% and 54.9%, respectively. Adding map-prediction supervision improves R2R-CE SR by 4.3 and success weighted by path length (SPL) by 3.2 percentage points. On static spatial tasks, InsightMap achieves 103.7 CIDEr on ScanQA, 60.1% exact-match accuracy on SQA3D, and 53.1% grounding accuracy at 0.5 IoU on ScanRefer with detected object proposals. On Unitree Go2, it outperforms NaVid and NaVILA in hallway, lab, and office environments.

AI.tldr: InsightMap：以俯视地图作为显式空间记忆与动作条件预测目标的语言引导导航框架，统一支持导航、VQA、情境推理与3D定位。
AI.motivation: 语言引导导航需将局部观测关联到持久空间参照，并学习动作如何改变该表征，现有方法缺乏显式且可预测的空间记忆机制。
AI.method: 将历史视角与带标注地图位置关联，用共享多模态骨干联合学习导航动作预测与动作后地图生成；地图预测提供辅助监督，导航推理从观测到的空间上下文解码动作；配套对齐的RGB-D数据管线，提供导航、VQA、情境推理、3D定位的统一接口。
AI.result: R2R-CE与RxR-CE验证未见集SR分别为56.9%和54.9%；加入地图预测监督使R2R-CE SR提升4.3、SPL提升3.2个百分点；ScanQA 103.7 CIDEr、SQA3D 60.1%精确匹配、ScanRefer 0.5 IoU定位准确率53.1%；Unitree Go2上在走廊、实验室、办公环境优于NaVid与NaVILA。
AI.conclusion: 以俯视地图兼作显式空间记忆与动作条件预测目标，并通过地图预测辅助监督，可同时提升连续环境导航与静态空间理解任务的表现，并在真实机器人平台上验证了有效性。

title: HaPRL: Human-Anchored Process Reinforcement Learning for Visual Search Agent
summary: Multi-turn visual search agents answer questions about high-resolution images by iteratively deciding where to look. Reinforcement learning for these agents rewards only the final answer, leaving the search process unsupervised. Consequently, faulty routes in which the reasoning process is erroneous yet the final result is correct arise frequently, which in turn leads to ineffective training, i.e., scaling along the wrong paths. In this paper, we introduce HaPRL, the first framework to reinforce the search process with human search behavior. We first build an annotation platform and collect 1K+ human-annotated data with fine-grained behavioral signals. During training, a carefully designed judge scores each rollout with task-adaptive weights, anchored on the distilled trace of how a human annotator actually searched the same image. Extensive experiments show that HaPRL consistently outperforms outcome-based RL, and early-stage process supervision yields 6.7x more improvement in subsequent outcome-based scaling. Our results also demonstrate the importance of aligning model behavior with human process annotation signals, which offer new insight into the training of foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HaPRL，首个利用人类搜索行为监督多轮视觉搜索智能体搜索过程的强化学习框架，通过1K+人类标注行为信号对rollout进行任务自适应评分，显著优于仅基于结果的RL，并使后续结果导向扩展的收益提升6.7倍。
AI.motivation: 多轮视觉搜索智能体在高分辨率图像上迭代决定观察位置，但现有强化学习仅以最终答案作为奖励，搜索过程缺乏监督。这导致"推理过程错误却最终答案正确"的故障路径频繁出现，造成训练低效——即沿着错误路径扩展（scaling along the wrong paths）。因此需要引入对搜索过程的监督信号。
AI.method: 1）构建标注平台，收集1K+条带细粒度行为信号的人类标注数据；2）提出HaPRL框架，将人类搜索行为作为过程监督引入强化学习；3）训练时使用精心设计的judge，以任务自适应权重对每个rollout打分，其锚点是人类标注者搜索同一图像的实际轨迹的蒸馏表示（distilled trace）。
AI.result: HaPRL持续优于基于结果的RL（outcome-based RL）；早期阶段的过程监督使后续结果导向扩展（outcome-based scaling）的改进提升6.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 将模型行为与人类过程标注信号对齐至关重要，这为基座模型的训练提供了新见解。

title: Exploring In-Context Learning for Handwritten Text Recognition
summary: Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) systems have become an indispensable tool for the digitization of historical documents. Not only do they cut down time and cost, but they also allow democratizing access and processing of their contents by generating their transcripts. However, literature in HTR currently focuses mostly on specialized models that require large amounts of annotated samples to achieve satisfactory performance. We explore the use of In-Context Learning with pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to create a transcription pipeline without updating the model's parameters. We then evaluate this pipeline across multiple collections and models, and demonstrate that general-purpose VLMs can be effectively taught how to transcribe handwritten text from images. To assess how our observations may translate to practical applications, we evaluate the performance in a Cross-Domain (CD) scenario, where context examples are drawn from a different collection than the query image. Results in both the controlled In-Domain (ID) scenario and the realistic CD scenario follow the same patterns. First, as context size grows, the error range is expected to narrow towards the average performance. Thus, larger context sizes sacrifice the performance of the oracle-best sampling for lower expected error rates. The results obtained show that, without any parameter updates, this methodology has strong potential to compete with traditional HTR in the presence of domain shift. Moreover, we show and argue that some context samplings work better than others and suggest more effort should be put into finding an ideal sampling method in future work.

title: Adaptive Reward Routing: Dynamic Multi-Reward Optimization for Joint Audio-Video Diffusion via Forward-Process RL
summary: Multi-reward guided reinforcement learning (i.e., RL) offers a promising way to improve joint audio-video diffusion models along several complementary objectives, including modality-specific quality, cross-modal semantic alignment, and temporal synchronization. Its effectiveness, however, depends on two quantities that change during training: where reward-driven updates should act, and how competing rewards should be combined. Existing methods tend to rely on fixed routing and reward weights, failing to track evolving model functions. To address these limitations, we propose Adaptive Reward Routing to jointly adapt update locations and reward coordination during forward-process RL (i.e., DiffusionNFT) of joint audio-video diffusion models. Our method consists of two components. (i) Cross-Modal Influence-Guided Routing (Localizing Updates): We use bidirectional cross-attention responses as an efficient proxy for evolving cross-modal influence, dynamically reweighting token-aware losses and scaling gradients across cross-modal layers without additional model interventions. (ii) Preference-Preserving Modality-Aware Reweighting (Coordinating Rewards): We preserve predefined weights as preference priors and use branch-specific reward-gradient interactions as residual corrections after warm-up. This resolves evolving conflicts without letting dominant rewards suppress weak but essential objectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in modality quality, semantic consistency, and audio-video synchronization over strong RL baselines. Ablations and mechanism analyses further validate the complementary benefits of adaptive update routing and reward coordination.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应奖励路由（Adaptive Reward Routing），在联合音视频扩散模型的前向过程强化学习（DiffusionNFT）中同时自适应更新位置与奖励协调权重，提升模态质量、语义一致性与音视频同步性。
AI.motivation: 多奖励强化学习可同时优化联合音视频扩散模型的多个互补目标（模态质量、跨模态语义对齐、时序同步），但其效果依赖两个随训练变化的量：奖励驱动更新应作用于何处，以及竞争性奖励应如何组合。现有方法多采用固定的路由与奖励权重，无法跟踪模型功能的演化。
AI.method: 方法含两个组件：（i）跨模态影响引导路由（更新定位）：以双向交叉注意力响应作为演化中跨模态影响的高效代理，对 token 感知损失动态重加权，并在跨模态层上缩放梯度，无需额外模型干预；（ii）偏好保持的模态感知重加权（奖励协调）：将预定义权重作为偏好先验，在预热后用分支特定奖励梯度交互作为残差修正，以解决演化中的冲突，避免主导奖励压制弱但必要的目标。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在模态质量、语义一致性和音视频同步方面相较强强化学习基线取得一致提升；消融与机制分析进一步验证了自适应更新路由与奖励协调的互补收益。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合自适应更新位置与奖励协调，可有效缓解固定路由与固定权重的局限，为联合音视频扩散模型的多奖励强化学习提供更稳健的优化方案。

title: Barycentric Anchored Weight Search for Robust Model Merging
summary: We propose Barycentric Anchored Search, a post-hoc weight-space procedure for improving fine-tuned vision models under distribution shift without additional gradient training or increased inference cost. Given a pre-trained initialization and two checkpoints fine-tuned on a source dataset, the method constructs barycentric candidate weights and performs a small derivative-free search along directions connecting each candidate to the pre-trained model. Candidate weights are selected using a small validation subset of one or more out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets; the selected model is then evaluated on the held-out portions of those datasets, on additional OOD benchmarks, and on the ImageNet validation set to quantify the robustness-accuracy trade-off. The method is inspired by simplex-based derivative-free optimization, including Nelder-Mead and Torczon multidirectional search, but is specialized to the geometry of neural network weight merging. Unlike Model Soup, which typically benefits from many fine-tuned checkpoints, and unlike Model Stock, which applies a fixed geometric merge, our approach uses only two fine-tuned checkpoints and iteratively adapts the merge using validation feedback from OOD data. Experiments with CLIP ViT-B/32 show that the proposed search substantially improves performance on held-out OOD data, including ImageNet-A, ImageNet-R, and ImageNet-Sketch, while keeping ImageNet accuracy competitive. The resulting weights also improve transfer to OOD datasets not used during candidate selection, outperforming the original fine-tuned checkpoints, naive model soups, and Model Stock in our evaluations. These results suggest that lightweight optimization in anchored weight space provides a practical alternative to fixed weight-averaging rules, geometric merging, or single-model selection.

AI.tldr: 提出Barycentric Anchored Search（重心锚定搜索）：一种后验权重空间方法，仅用两个微调检查点与预训练初始化，通过无梯度搜索迭代自适应地融合权重，以OOD验证反馈选模，在CLIP ViT-B/32上提升分布偏移鲁棒性且保持ImageNet精度。
AI.motivation: 微调视觉模型在分布偏移（OOD）下性能下降，而提升鲁棒性通常需要额外梯度训练或增加推理开销。现有权重融合方法各有局限：Model Soup依赖大量微调检查点，Model Stock使用固定几何融合规则，单模型选择则无法兼顾鲁棒性与精度。因此需要一种轻量、无需重新训练、不增加推理成本的自适应权重融合方案。
AI.method: 给定预训练初始化与两个在源数据上微调的检查点，构造重心候选权重，并沿每个候选与预训练模型相连的方向执行小规模无导数搜索。该方法受单纯形无导数优化（Nelder-Mead、Torczon多方向搜索）启发，但专门适配神经网络权重融合的几何结构。候选权重使用一个或多个OOD数据集的小型验证子集进行选择，随后在留出部分、额外OOD基准以及ImageNet验证集上评估鲁棒性-精度权衡。
AI.result: 在CLIP ViT-B/32上的实验显示，该搜索显著提升留出OOD数据（ImageNet-A、ImageNet-R、ImageNet-Sketch）的性能，同时保持ImageNet精度具有竞争力。所得权重对候选选择阶段未使用的OOD数据集也具备更好的迁移性，在评估中优于原始微调检查点、朴素model soup与Model Stock。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在锚定权重空间中进行轻量优化，是固定权重平均规则、几何融合或单模型选择的一种实用替代方案，可在不增加训练与推理成本的前提下改善分布偏移下的鲁棒性-精度权衡。

title: CredWise: A Controlled Agentic Decision-Intelligence Framework for Explainable and Auditable Credit-Risk Assessment
summary: Credit-risk prediction is important in banking, but a prediction alone does not explain why an applicant is risky or how it should be combined with other evidence. This paper presents CredWise, a decision-support framework that integrates credit-risk prediction, probability calibration, explainable artificial intelligence, policy retrieval, SQL analytics, and controlled agent-based workflows. An XGBoost model is trained on Lending Club data (1,345,310 loans, 18 features) using a temporal split: 2007--2016 for training, 2017 for validation, and 2018 for testing. On the 2018 test set, the calibrated model achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.7109, PR-AUC of 0.2993, F1-score of 0.3714, and accuracy of 65.44\%. Calibration reduced the Brier score from 0.2157 to 0.1273 and the expected calibration error from 0.2862 to 0.0585. SHAP explanations were temporally stable, with a Spearman correlation of 0.9959 between 2017 and 2018 feature rankings. On 28 labeled queries covering nine policy sections, FAISS achieved the best Hit@1 (0.929) and MRR (0.964), while all three retrieval methods reached Hit@5 = 1.0. Agent routing achieved 95.6\% accuracy (43 of 45 cases), and the SQL benchmark scored 1.0 on exact-match, execution-success, and result-match across six cases. These results show that CredWise can combine predictions, explanations, policy evidence, and structured analytics in one controlled workflow. It is an academic research prototype, and final decisions remain with a human reviewer.

AI.tldr: CredWise是一个整合信用风险预测、概率校准、可解释AI、政策检索、SQL分析与受控智能体工作流的决策支持框架，在Lending Club数据上验证了各模块性能。
AI.motivation: 银行信用风险预测中，仅给出预测结果无法解释申请人为何具有风险，也难以与其他证据结合使用，因此需要将预测、解释、政策依据与结构化分析统一到一个可控的工作流中。
AI.method: 基于Lending Club数据（1,345,310笔贷款、18个特征），按时间划分训练集（2007—2016）、验证集（2017）与测试集（2018）；训练XGBoost模型并进行概率校准，使用SHAP生成解释，采用FAISS等方法进行政策检索，并构建SQL分析与受控智能体路由工作流。
AI.result: 2018测试集上校准模型ROC-AUC为0.7109、PR-AUC为0.2993、F1为0.3714、准确率65.44%；校准将Brier分数由0.2157降至0.1273，期望校准误差由0.2862降至0.0585；SHAP特征排序在2017与2018年间Spearman相关达0.9959；28条标注查询上FAISS取得最佳Hit@1（0.929）与MRR（0.964），三种检索方法Hit@5均为1.0；智能体路由准确率95.6%（45例中43例），SQL基准在六个案例上精确匹配、执行成功与结果匹配均为1.0。
AI.conclusion: CredWise能够将预测、解释、政策证据与结构化分析整合于同一受控工作流，但作为学术研究原型，最终决策仍由人工审核者负责。

title: ResComEmb: Effective and Efficient Multimodal Embedding via Residual Homogeneity Compression
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for universal multimodal representation learning. However, existing methods either compress each input into a single vector, limiting fine-grained expressiveness, or retain long sequences of visual-token vectors, incurring substantial storage and interaction costs. To resolve this trade-off, we propose ResComEmb, a trainable framework for effective and efficient universal multi-vector multimodal embedding. ResComEmb first encodes each input at native dynamic resolution into ordered global, intermediate, and fine-grained views. After MLLM contextualization and embedding projection, a trainable Residual Homogeneity Compression (RHC) module reduces within-granularity redundancy and cross-granularity repetition under explicit visual token budgets. Then, ResComEmb introduces a length-adaptive Bidirectional Late-Interaction Matching mechanism for robust query-document scoring, which averages the strongest token-level matches in each direction and combines the two scores using a weight based on how many valid tokens each side has. Extensive experiments on MMEB, ViDoRe V1, and ViDoRe V2 show that ResComEmb produces higher-quality universal multimodal embeddings than VLM2Vec-V2, and outperforms ColQwen2.5 in visual document retrieval using only 37.5% of its full visual token budget, demonstrating a favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off.

AI.tldr: ResComEmb：可训练通用多向量多模态嵌入框架，通过残差同质压缩与双向后期交互匹配，在效率与效果间取得更优权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型嵌入方法存在权衡问题：单向量压缩损失细粒度表达，长视觉token序列则带来高存储与交互成本。
AI.method: 先按原生动态分辨率编码为全局、中间、细粒度有序视图，经MLLM上下文化与嵌入投影；用可训练残差同质压缩（RHC）模块在显式视觉token预算下减少粒度内冗余与跨粒度重复；再引入长度自适应双向后期交互匹配，对各方向最强token级匹配取平均，并按有效token数加权融合两方向得分。
AI.result: 在MMEB、ViDoRe V1、ViDoRe V2上，使用VLM2Vec-V2更高的通用多模态嵌入质量；在视觉文档检索中，仅用ColQwen2.5全部视觉token预算的37.5%即超过后者。
AI.conclusion: ResComEmb实现效果与效率的良好权衡，优于VLM2Vec-V2和ColQwen2.5。

title: Follow the Entities: A Corpus Map for Agentic Search
summary: Answering questions and completing tasks over large document collections often requires connecting evidence spread across multiple documents, such as a project's approval recorded in one, its requirements in another, and its latest status in a third. Recent LLM agents approach this by iteratively searching the full corpus rather than reading only a fixed set of top-ranked documents. However, when the corpus is exposed only as a flat collection of files, a relevant document gives no indication of how it relates to others, so the agent must rediscover these relationships for every query, often missing complementary evidence while simultaneously consuming substantial additional tokens. To address this, we introduce CorpusMap, a navigation layer that organizes the corpus around its recurring entities, which are identifiable from the documents themselves and can link a single document to many others across sources. Specifically, CorpusMap represents each recurring entity as an Entity Page that aggregates information about it and links to every document that refers to it, forming a graph between entities and documents that the agent can traverse to gather otherwise disconnected evidence. Moreover, since CorpusMap is constructed offline by resolving mentions of the same entity across documents, its links are shared across queries rather than rediscovered repeatedly at inference time. Using 7 different models with 3 benchmark datasets, we show that CorpusMap improves both evidence discovery and answer quality over raw-corpus agentic search while using fewer tokens on average, and further outperforms 4 alternative navigation layers, suggesting that entities serve as effective anchors for navigating large document collections.

AI.tldr: 提出 CorpusMap 导航层，以“实体页”组织大规模文档语料并构建实体-文档图，供 LLM 智能体跨文档检索证据，在 7 个模型、3 个数据集上优于原始语料智能搜索与 4 种替代导航层。
AI.motivation: 跨文档问答需连接分散在多份文档中的证据（如项目审批、需求、最新状态）。现有 LLM 智能体在“扁平文件集合”上迭代搜索，文档间缺乏关系线索，导致每次查询都要重新发现关联，既漏掉互补证据又消耗大量 token。
AI.method: CorpusMap 作为语料导航层，围绕文档中可识别的“重复出现实体”组织语料。每个实体表示为一个 Entity Page，聚合该实体信息并链接到所有提及它的文档，形成实体-文档图，智能体可沿图遍历收集原本孤立的证据。该层通过离线跨文档实体提及消解构建，链接在不同查询间复用而非在推理时重复发现。
AI.result: 在 7 个不同模型、3 个基准数据集上，CorpusMap 相较原始语料智能搜索同时提升证据发现与答案质量，平均 token 消耗更少；并优于 4 种替代导航层。
AI.conclusion: 实体可作为导航大型文档集合的有效锚点，通过离线构建共享的实体-文档图，缓解智能体在扁平语料中重复发现关系、遗漏互补证据和高 token 开销的问题。

title: AESOP: Asymmetric Human-Camera Generation with Translation-Intensity Control
summary: Human motion defines an action, while a camera trajectory determines how it is presented. Camera generation for a given human motion and joint human-camera generation are usually treated as separate tasks, although both share an asymmetric dependency: human motion can be generated independently, whereas the camera responds to the realized action. We introduce AESOP, a unified framework with an independent human pathway and a shared human-conditioned camera generator. Its asymmetric architecture serves both tasks while preserving the human output during camera generation. Although human context anchors the shot to the action and camera text describes its movement, translation intensity remains underspecified. We therefore construct trajectory pairs that differ in camera translation magnitude while sharing human motion and camera text, then use these pairs to learn an explicit intensity condition. Experiments on the PulpMotion dataset demonstrate strong camera distributional and framing quality in both tasks and effective control over camera translation intensity. Project page is available at https://ripemangobox.github.io/AESOP.

AI.tldr: 提出统一框架AESOP，以非对称架构同时处理"给定人体动作生成相机轨迹"与"人体-相机联合生成"两个任务，并显式建模相机平移强度。
AI.motivation: 人体动作与相机轨迹通常被作为两个独立任务处理，但二者存在非对称依赖：人体动作可独立生成，相机则需响应已实现的动作。此外，现有方案中人体上下文锚定动作、相机文本描述运动，但相机平移的强度（magnitude）缺乏明确描述与控制。
AI.method: AESOP包含独立的人体生成通路与共享的人体条件相机生成器，该非对称结构可服务两类任务，并在相机生成时保留人体输出。为学习平移强度条件，构造轨迹对：共享同一人体动作与相机文本，仅相机平移幅度不同，据此学习显式的强度条件。
AI.result: 在 PulpMotion 数据集上，两类任务均取得良好的相机分布质量与构图（framing）质量，并能有效控制相机平移强度。
AI.conclusion: 验证了以非对称统一框架耦合人体与相机生成的有效性，并表明可通过成对数据实现相机平移强度的显式可控生成。

title: Seeing Is Not Addressing: Auditing Linguistic Access to Frozen Visual Geometry
summary: Visual distinctions are often finer than those reflected in linguistic conceptualization. Vision-language models exhibit a similar asymmetry: a distinction can remain discriminable in frozen image geometry while being weakly addressable through the native text interface. We study this gap by separating visual discriminability from linguistic addressability in text-to-image retrieval. Using FactorAtlas, a fully crossed testbed of 23,040 images spanning shape, hue, pattern, and nuisance variation, we compare both readouts on held-out images of the same distinctions. We then derive image-side contrasts that separate each value from its alternatives for matched visual grounding, and test whether this reduces the native-text access gap across factors and models. Direction-specific and visual-absence controls tie these gains to the relevant visual contrast; the gains persist after global alignment and extend to compositional retrieval and natural images. Together, these results show that visual discriminability and linguistic addressability need not coincide, and that matched visual grounding can probe and reduce the resulting access gap.

AI.tldr: 该论文在文本到图像检索中区分"视觉可辨别性"与"语言可指称性"，利用FactorAtlas数据集构建图像侧对比，证明匹配的视觉接地可缩小原生文本接口的访问差距。
AI.motivation: 视觉区分往往比语言概念化更精细，视觉-语言模型也存在类似不对称：某区分在冻结的图像几何中可辨别，但通过原生文本接口却难以被准确指称。作者希望研究并量化这一"访问差距"。
AI.method: 构建FactorAtlas全交叉测试集（23,040张图像，涵盖形状、色调、图案及干扰变量）；在同一批区分上比较视觉可辨别性与语言可指称性两种读出方式；推导图像侧对比，将每个取值与其替代值分离以实现匹配的视觉接地；引入方向特异性与视觉缺失控制，检验增益是否归因于相关视觉对比。
AI.result: 匹配的视觉接地可减少原生文本访问差距，且该增益在不同因子和模型间均成立；增益在全局对齐后依然存在，并可推广到组合式检索与自然图像；方向特异性与视觉缺失控制将增益与相关视觉对比绑定。
AI.conclusion: 视觉可辨别性与语言可指称性并不必然一致；匹配的视觉接地可作为探测并缩小由此产生的访问差距的有效手段。

title: Framing the Narrative: Ideological Mimicry in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to answer questions about politically contentious issues, yet evaluations typically treat a model's stance as a relatively stable property. Real users, however, communicate political signals through their terminology, assumptions, and personal context. We investigate whether such signals produce ideological mimicry: systematic shifts in the political stance expressed by an LLM toward the position conveyed by the interaction. If LLMs adapt their responses to these signals, they risk creating personalised political information environments in which users with opposing views receive systematically different accounts of the same issue, potentially reinforcing existing divisions. We build the Poli-SHIFT dataset and evaluation framework and assess seven open-weight LLMs across ten contentious political topics in the United States, United Kingdom, and Australia, systematically manipulating contested terminology, politically valenced premises, and user information, and eliciting responses in both multiple-choice and open-text formats. Across models, we find robust evidence that prompt framing shapes the political stance of LLM outputs. Changing terminology alone reverses which side of an issue a model supports in 16.9% of matched comparisons. Stated political ideology also systematically shifts responses toward the user's position. These findings show that political stance is not a fixed property of LLMs; the views expressed are conditional on the interaction with the user. As LLMs become increasingly personalised sources of information, such interaction-dependent adaptation could contribute to political information environments that reinforce users' existing perspectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Poli-SHIFT 数据集与评估框架，测试七个开源 LLM 在美英澳十个争议性政治议题上的"意识形态拟态"现象。结果显示：仅改变措辞即可在 16.9% 的匹配比较中使模型立场反转；用户明示的政治意识形态也会系统性地将回答拉向用户立场。故 LLM 的政治立场并非稳定属性，而是随交互条件而变，可能加剧信息回音室效应。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 政治倾向评估通常将模型立场视为相对稳定的固有属性，但真实用户会通过术语选择、预设前提和个人背景传递政治信号。若模型对这些信号做出适应性调整，持相反观点的用户可能对同一议题获得系统性不同的回答，从而形成个性化政治信息环境并强化既有分歧。因此有必要检验"意识形态拟态"是否存在。
AI.method: 构建 Poli-SHIFT 数据集与评估框架，覆盖美国、英国、澳大利亚的十个争议性政治议题，选取七个开源权重 LLM。系统操纵三类变量：争议性术语、带政治倾向的预设前提、用户个人信息；并在多选题与开放式文本两种作答格式下收集回答，进行匹配比较分析。
AI.result: 跨模型均发现稳健证据表明提示框架会塑造 LLM 输出的政治立场。仅改变术语一项，即在 16.9% 的匹配比较中使模型支持的议题一方发生反转。用户明示的政治意识形态也会系统性地使回答向用户立场偏移。
AI.conclusion: 政治立场并非 LLM 的固定属性，其表达的观点取决于与用户的交互条件。随着 LLM 成为日益个性化的信息来源，这种依赖交互的适应性可能促成强化用户既有观点的政治信息环境。

title: Asking for What Was Never Requested: Horizontal and Vertical Proactivity in Agents
summary: An agent that uses tools typically responds to what the user explicitly asks, yet completing the task may require information the user never requested. Work on proactive agents mainly studies whether and when an agent should act on its own, not what information it should pursue. We study a distinct axis of proactivity: its content. Horizontal proactivity pursues unstated information that the current context already identifies, and vertical proactivity pursues needs that only earlier evidence reveals. A need graph, recovered from a benchmark's own decomposition, records which needs depend on which, so both forms, and whether the agent stops at the right time, can be scored from a transcript without a model judge. To learn this behavior, we propose Q&D (questioner and drafter), which trains a questioner to prefer the question whose continuation retrieves more of the required evidence, with no reward model or judge. On held-out splits of three multi-hop question-answering benchmarks, at equal retrieval spend, the trained questioner improves both forms of proactivity over the same model, prompted, and outperforms a prompted model $15\times$ larger in the same role on two of the three, and the gain persists after controlling for question volume and length. Without further training, we place the questioner in an interactive customer-service agent with a simulated customer, where it completes more tasks while asking fewer questions, and in retail it outperforms the $15\times$ larger model with fewer follow-up turns from the customer. These results show that proactivity depends not only on whether an agent acts without being asked, but also on what it chooses to pursue and when it stops.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"主动性内容"这一新维度：横向主动性追求当前上下文已指明的未陈述信息，纵向主动性追求只有靠早期证据才暴露的需求；用"需求图"实现无需模型评判的自动打分，并提出Q&D训练提问者以"提问后能检索到更多所需证据"为偏好目标，在多跳问答与交互式客服/零售场景中提升任务完成率并减少提问量。
AI.motivation: 现有主动式代理研究主要关注"是否/何时"主动行动，而忽略了"应主动追求什么信息"。但仅回应用户显式请求往往不足以完成任务，因此需要研究主动性的内容维度。
AI.method: 1) 将主动性分为横向（上下文已隐含的未陈述信息）与纵向（需由早期证据揭示的需求）；2) 从基准自身的分解中恢复"需求图"，记录需求间依赖，从而仅凭对话记录即可对两种主动性及"是否在正确时机停止"打分，无需模型评判；3) 提出Q&D（提问者-起草者），训练提问者偏好"其续写能检索到更多所需证据"的问题，不用奖励模型或评判器。
AI.result: 在三个多跳问答基准的留出划分上，相同检索开销下，训练后的提问者在两种主动性上均优于同一模型的提示版本；在其中两个基准上超过规模大15倍的提示模型；增益在控制提问数量与长度后依然存在。在无额外训练情况下用于交互式客服（模拟用户）可完成更多任务且提问更少；在零售场景中优于大15倍模型，且用户后续追问轮次更少。
AI.conclusion: 主动性不仅取决于代理是否未被请求就行动，也取决于它选择追求什么信息以及在何时停止。

title: Codebook-Guided Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Structurally Heterogeneous Features
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Cross-modal knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a teacher modality to a student modality. Existing feature-level alignment methods typically assume that teacher and student features reside in structurally alignable representation spaces. However, this assumption does not hold when cross-modal features are structurally heterogeneous and lack clear unit-level correspondence, such as 2D spatial visual grids and 1D temporal audio sequences, thereby limiting the applicability of feature-level alignment. To address this challenge, we propose a cross-modal distillation framework that enables effective knowledge transfer across structurally heterogeneous feature spaces via a vector-quantized codebook. Specifically, teacher features are abstracted into a set of vector-form codes regardless of their original feature structure, and the selected codes serve as concept-level anchors for student learning. Code selection is guided by both task relevance and student compatibility, allowing the student to receive transferable teacher knowledge without requiring direct unit-level feature alignment. Experimental results across diverse cross-modal distillation scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework on classification and semantic segmentation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于向量量化码本的跨模态蒸馏框架，将教师特征抽象为码本中的向量码，以概念级锚点指导学生，无需单元级特征对齐即可实现异构特征空间间的知识迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态知识蒸馏的特征级对齐方法假设教师与学生特征处于结构可对齐的表示空间。但当跨模态特征结构异构、缺乏清晰的单元级对应关系时（如2D空间视觉网格与1D时序音频序列），该假设不成立，限制了特征级对齐方法的适用性。
AI.method: 引入向量量化码本：不依赖原始特征结构，将教师特征抽象为一组向量形式的码；码的选择由任务相关性与学生兼容性共同引导，被选中的码作为概念级锚点指导学生网络学习，从而无需直接进行单元级特征对齐。
AI.result: 在多种跨模态蒸馏场景下的实验表明，该框架在分类与语义分割任务上均有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过码本实现概念级的跨模态知识迁移，可突破结构异构特征空间的对齐限制，为跨模态蒸馏提供更通用的范式。

title: V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents
summary: World-action models (WAMs) couple future visual-state prediction with action generation. By adapting video generators or image-editing models pretrained at scale, a prominent line of recent WAMs inherits both predictive knowledge and the models in which it was learned. We ask whether a predictive visual latent space induced by large-scale predictive pretraining can instead provide a sufficient foundation for effective WAM learning without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generative model. To answer this question, we introduce V-JEPA Policy, a simple framework that builds a WAM on the latent space of a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. An instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor and a flow-matching action expert are jointly learned from scratch in a single downstream stage, with the predictor's future-informed context key--value states conditioning action generation. With 0.9B total parameters, of which 0.6B are trainable, V-JEPA Policy achieves competitive performance with representative WAM and vision-language-action baselines across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa-GR1. Comparing visual foundations under the same downstream framework and training budget identifies V-JEPA latents as more effective than the discriminative, reconstructive, and video-understanding-oriented alternatives, particularly under distribution shifts. Beyond task-specific learning, pretraining the predictor on DROID video--instruction pairs without action labels and adapting it into a WAM yields substantial gains in downstream control and out-of-distribution generalization. Together, these findings establish predictive visual latents as a foundation for effective WAM learning from task-specific demonstrations and for transferring future-modeling knowledge acquired from broader in-the-wild videos. Project page: https://breez3young.github.io/vjepa-policy/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 V-JEPA Policy，一个基于冻结 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器潜在空间的简洁世界-动作模型（WAM）框架，验证了预测性视觉潜空间可作为有效 WAM 学习的基础，而无需继承完整的预训练视觉生成模型。
AI.motivation: 现有 WAM 多通过适配大规模预训练的视频生成器或图像编辑模型构建，因而继承了完整的预训练视觉生成模型。作者质疑：是否可仅依赖大规模预测性预训练所诱导的预测性视觉潜空间，而不必继承整个生成模型，即可为 WAM 学习提供充分基础。
AI.method: 在冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器潜空间上构建 WAM。指令条件化的未来潜变量预测器与流匹配（flow-matching）动作专家在单一下游阶段从零联合训练，预测器产生的未来信息上下文 key-value 状态用于条件化动作生成。总参数 0.9B，其中可训练 0.6B。此外，在 DROID 视频-指令对上（无动作标签）预训练预测器后再适配为 WAM。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboCasa-GR1 上，V-JEPA Policy 与代表性 WAM 和 VLA 基线性能相当。在相同下游框架与训练预算下对比不同视觉基础，V-JEPA 潜空间比判别式、重建式及面向视频理解的替代方案更有效，尤其在分布偏移下。在 DROID 上无动作标签预训练预测器并适配为 WAM，可显著提升下游控制与分布外泛化。
AI.conclusion: 预测性视觉潜空间可作为有效 WAM 学习的基础，既支持从任务特定示范中学习，也支持迁移从更广泛野生视频中获得的未来建模知识。

title: Collision-Aware and Observation-Aligned Object-Centric Scene Reconstruction from Point Cloud
summary: Object-centric scene reconstruction requires completing partial object observations while preserving metric alignment and avoiding collisions with the surrounding. Existing generation-based methods are often image-conditioned and suffer from scale ambiguity and insufficient geometric constraints. We propose COOL, a framework for COllision-aware and Observation-aLigned reconstruction. Based on an object generation model, COOL conditions the generation on instance and background point clouds. Instance geometry anchors generation in scene coordinates, while background geometry provides local context for scene-consistent completion. We further introduce an explicit collision loss and use joint optimization and resampling to reduce collisions during inference. Experiments on 3D-Front and Scan2CAD demonstrate strong scene-level fidelity, observation alignment, and collision reduction. Moreover, additional studies validate its robustness to mask errors and its applicability to real-world scene replicas.

AI.tldr: COOL：以实例+背景点云为条件的无碰撞、对齐观测的单物体场景重建框架。
AI.motivation: 现有基于生成的场景补全方法多为图像条件、存在尺度歧义且几何约束不足，难以在补全部分观测的同时保持度量对齐并避免碰撞。
AI.method: 提出COOL（COLsion-aware and Observation-aLigned）框架：基于物体生成模型，以实例点云与背景点云作为条件——实例几何将生成锚定于场景坐标，背景几何提供局部上下文以保证场景一致补全；引入显式碰撞损失，并在推理阶段使用联合优化与重采样减少碰撞。
AI.result: 在3D-Front与Scan2CAD上展现强场景级保真度、观测对齐与碰撞减少；额外实验验证了对掩码错误的鲁棒性及在真实场景重建中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: COOL通过点云条件化与碰撞感知优化，有效解决尺度歧义与几何约束不足问题，实现度量对齐、低碰撞的场景级重建。

title: Beyond Attention Imbalance: Mitigating Hallucinations via Spectral Surgery
summary: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve remarkable success, hallucinations remain a significant barrier to their reliable deployment. Recent studies primarily attribute these issues to cross-modal attention imbalances; most solutions therefore focus on reweighting visual tokens or suppressing language priors. However, such approaches often overlook the spectral characteristics of the visual information flow and frequently rely on Contrastive Decoding (CD), which doubles inference time. Instead of following conventional approaches, we identify two distinct hallucination patterns-Perceptual-Semantic Dissociation and Localized Fixation-and propose FLASH (Frequency-Localized Attention SHaping), a training-free and CD-free framework. FLASH utilizes a Spectral Vortex Score to detect vision heads within multi-head attention layers and applies adaptive spectral modulation to rectify the visual information flow during decoding. Empirical results demonstrate that FLASH achieves a superior balance between performance and efficiency compared to SOTA methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的幻觉问题，指出既有方法忽视视觉信息流的频谱特性且依赖对比解码（CD）导致推理耗时翻倍。作者提出免训练、免CD的FLASH框架，通过频谱涡旋分数检测视觉注意力头并施加自适应频谱调制。实验表明FLASH在性能与效率间取得优于SOTA的平衡。
AI.motivation: LVLMs幻觉阻碍可靠部署，现有研究多归因于跨模态注意力失衡，解决思路集中于重加权视觉token或抑制语言先验；但这些方法忽视视觉信息流的频谱特征，并常依赖对比解码（CD），使推理时间翻倍。
AI.method: 作者识别出两种幻觉模式——感知-语义分离与局部固着，并提出FLASH（Frequency-Localized Attention SHaping）框架。该方法免训练且不使用对比解码，利用频谱涡旋分数（Spectral Vortex Score）在多注意力层中检测视觉头，并在解码过程中施加自适应频谱调制以校正视觉信息流。
AI.result: 实证结果显示，FLASH在性能与效率之间实现了优于当前SOTA方法的平衡。
AI.conclusion: FLASH从频谱视角切入解决LVLM幻觉，避免了对对比解码的依赖，在保持性能的同时提升效率，为免训练幻觉缓解提供了新范式。

title: UniAfford: Token-Routed Multitask Learning for Generalizable 2D-3D Affordance Perception
summary: Affordance perception aims to localize actionable regions supporting embodied interaction, yet 2D and 3D affordance grounding have evolved as separate problems, with different task definitions, supervision formats, datasets, and evaluation protocols. This fragmentation limits the learning of transferable object-affordance semantics across visual and geometric spaces. We propose Token Router for Tasks, a multitask training paradigm for MLLM-based systems that routes contextual hidden states to task-specific branches without requiring the language head to generate predefined markers. Routed states are supervised directly by branch-specific objectives, enabling dense prediction losses to shape shared MLLM representations. We instantiate this paradigm as UniAfford, a unified framework for generalizable 2D-3D affordance perception, together with UniAfford-Data, a dataset integrating pixel-level 2D annotations, point-level 3D annotations, and language instructions under a shared object-affordance taxonomy, supporting heterogeneous supervision through semantic-level 2D-3D pairing. UniAfford adopts an MLLM as a shared semantic hub and a modality-aware token router to produce image- and point-cloud-affordance queries. These queries respectively condition a SAM-style pixel decoder and a SONATA-based point decoder, enabling flexible 2D, 3D, and joint affordance inference from image-only, point-cloud-only, or paired multimodal inputs. Experiments demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization across 2D and 3D affordance benchmarks without target-specific fine-tuning, alongside state-of-the-art branch-wise performance under modality-isolated protocols. Ablations validate token routing, joint 2D-3D supervision, and decoder coupling, while language-head diagnostics show that routed latent states carry meaningful object-affordance semantics. Project page: https://4dvlab.github.io/UniAfford

AI.tldr: 该文提出Token Router for Tasks多任务训练范式与UniAfford统一框架，实现2D-3D可供性感知的联合建模与零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 2D与3D可供性定位长期分离，任务定义、监督格式、数据集与评测协议各异，阻碍了跨视觉与几何空间的可迁移对象-可供性语义学习。
AI.method: 提出Token Router for Tasks范式，将上下文隐状态路由至任务专用分支，无需语言头生成预定义标记，路由状态由分支目标直接监督；实例化为UniAfford：以MLLM为共享语义枢纽，模态感知token router生成图像与点云可供性查询，分别驱动SAM式像素解码器与基于SONATA的点解码器；并构建UniAfford-Data数据集，统一对象-可供性分类体系。
AI.result: 在2D与3D可供性基准上无需目标特定微调即展现出强零样本泛化能力，在模态隔离协议下取得分支最优性能；消融验证了token路由、联合2D-3D监督与解码器耦合的有效性，语言头诊断表明路由隐状态携带有效语义。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一训练范式与共享语义枢纽，实现了灵活的2D、3D及联合可供性推理，验证了密集预测损失塑造共享MLLM表示的有效性。

title: SAM Meets VLM: Parameter-Decoupled Full-Parameter Training for Unified Medical Reasoning and Segmentation
summary: Medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly expected not only to answer clinical questions, but also to localize the visual evidence behind their predictions. A common strategy connects a vision--language model (VLM) with SAM-style segmentation through a special <SEG> token, yet full-parameter training of this unified architecture is difficult because image-level reasoning and pixel-level segmentation impose different requirements on the shared representation space. To address this issue, we propose a parameter-decoupled training framework for unified medical reasoning and segmentation. The framework treats the <SEG> hidden state as a semantic-to-spatial prompt for the mask decoder and encourages it to become separable from generic language states, reducing ambiguous segmentation prompts and potential disruption to reasoning representations. It first performs medical shallow alignment to adapt visual features to clinical language without disturbing the LLM; then controlled instruction tuning shapes separable <SEG> prompt states, monitored by the Davies--Bouldin Index (DBI), while scaling segmentation gradients entering the language backbone; finally, the SAM branch is specialized with the VLM frozen to improve mask precision without altering reasoning parameters. Experiments on medical referring segmentation, grounding, visual QA, and textual QA benchmarks show that our framework achieves strong language-conditioned segmentation while preserving competitive reasoning ability. Ablations show that two-phase instruction tuning, gradient scaling, and segmentation specialization all contribute to the model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种参数解耦训练框架，通过三阶段（医学浅层对齐、受控指令微调、SAM分支专门化）解决医学多模态大模型统一推理与分割时的表征冲突问题，在保持推理能力的同时实现强语言条件分割。
AI.motivation: 医学多模态大模型不仅需回答临床问题，还需定位预测所依据的视觉证据。常见做法是用<SEG> token连接视觉语言模型与SAM式分割，但图像级推理与像素级分割对共享表征空间的要求不同，全参数训练统一架构十分困难。
AI.method: 提出参数解耦训练框架：将<SEG>隐藏状态作为语义到空间的提示送入掩码解码器，并使其与通用语言状态可分离。流程分三步：1）医学浅层对齐，适配视觉特征到临床语言且不扰动LLM；2）受控指令微调，用DBI监测，塑造可分离的<SEG>提示状态，同时缩放进入语言主干的���割梯度；3）冻结VLM专门化SAM分支，提升掩码精度而不改变推理参数。
AI.result: 在医学指代分割、grounding、视觉问答和文本问答基准上，框架实现了强语言条件分割，同时保持有竞争力的推理能力。消融实验表明两阶段指令微调、梯度缩放与分割专门化均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 通过参数解耦与分阶段训练，可有效缓解医学MLLM中推理与分割的表征冲突，实现统一模型中推理与分割能力的兼顾。

title: VISTA-Bench: Benchmarking Multilingual Image Translation with Image-Specific Rubrics
summary: Image translation is a fundamental capability of multimodal models for multilingual applications, requiring visual understanding and meaning preservation across languages. However, existing benchmarks have limited language coverage and often lack explicit image-specific evaluation criteria, making it difficult to comprehensively assess this capability. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce VISTA-Bench, covering 22 languages and 10 domains, and develop an image-specific rubric evaluation protocol. The benchmark combines sampling for language and scenario coverage with model-assisted, human-verified annotations that group related text into coherent semantic units and provide multilingual reference translations. The rubrics specify essential content, semantic relations, and acceptable translation variants, yielding separate output-based scores for translation quality and the preservation of visual and knowledge-dependent information. We conduct extensive evaluations of 16 mainstream models, including 12 multimodal models and four text-input models, and provide systematic analyses across languages, domains, and evaluation dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VISTA-Bench，一个覆盖22种语言、10个领域的图像翻译基准，并设计图像特定的评分细则评估协议，对16个主流模型进行了系统评测。
AI.motivation: 图像翻译是多模态模型在多语言应用中的基础能力，需兼顾视觉理解与跨语言语义保持。但现有基准语言覆盖有限，且缺乏明确的图像特定评估标准，难以全面评估该能力。
AI.method: 构建 VISTA-Bench：覆盖22种语言和10个领域；采用语言与场景覆盖采样，结合模型辅助、人工验证的标注，将相关文本归组为连贯语义单元并提供多语言参考译文；设计图像特定评分细则，规定核心内容、语义关系与可接受译文变体，分别给出基于输出的翻译质量得分和视觉/知识依赖信息保持得分。
AI.result: 对16个主流模型（12个多模态模型与4个纯文本输入模型）进行广泛评测，并从语言、领域和评估维度方面开展系统分析。
AI.conclusion: VISTA-Bench 提供了更全面、细粒度的图像翻译能力评估框架，弥补现有基准在语言覆盖与图像特定标准上的不足，并揭示主流模型在该任务上的表现差异。

title: Why Cross-Skeleton Retargeting Is Non-Identifiable: Structural Limits of Generative Motion Models
summary: Cross-skeleton motion generation trains generative models to carry action structure and motion intention from one body to another. Yet a target motion that shows the right action has two explanations that the training data cannot tell apart: the model transferred the source clip, or it recovered a typical motion for the requested action. We show that this ambiguity is structural rather than incidental: under standard generative objectives, the source-conditioned retargeting map is non-identifiable in sparse heterogeneous motion domains. Unpaired distribution matching yields gauge non-identifiability: the latent spaces of different skeletons can be transformed relative to one another without changing the training evidence, so different source-conditioned maps fit it equally well. Sparse paired supervision admits the complementary failure mode, \emph{conditional-mean degeneration}: when clips are paired only by action, squared-error training converges to an average target motion that ignores the source clip. To make the missing evidence observable, we introduce Source-Instance Fidelity (SIF), a diagnostic that tests whether outputs differ from one another the way their source clips do, with the target skeleton and action held fixed. Under this diagnostic, methods that succeed at the standard action-level test on animal motion data often sit at the source-blind floor, while the methods that rise above it retain only a partial relational signal. Retargeting therefore needs objectives and evaluations that can identify the source-conditioned map it claims to learn. Project page: https://cross-skeleton-retargeting.netlify.app/.

AI.tldr: 本文指出跨骨架动作生成中"源条件重定向映射"在标准生成目标下本质不可辨识，并从理论与实证两方面揭示该问题。
AI.motivation: 跨骨架动作生成旨在将动作结构与运动意图从一个身体迁移到另一个身体。但目标动作合理可能有两种解释：模型真的迁移了源片段，或只是恢复了该动作的典型运动；训练数据无法区分二者。作者希望证明这种歧义是结构性的，而非偶然现象。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为源条件重定向映射的可辨识性分析。指出在稀疏异质运动域下：1）非配对分布匹配导致"规范不可辨识性"（gauge non-identifiability），不同骨架的隐空间可相互变换而不改变训练证据；2）稀疏配对监督导致互补的失效模式"条件均值退化"（conditional-mean degeneration），仅按动作配对时平方误差训练收敛到忽略源片段的平均目标运动。为此提出 Source-Instance Fidelity (SIF) 诊断，在固定目标骨架与动作的条件下，检验输出之间的差异是否与其源片段的差异方式一致。
AI.result: 在动物运动数据上，通过标准动作级测试的方法往往处于"源盲"下限，而能超越该下限的方法仅保留部分关系信号。
AI.conclusion: 跨骨架重定向需要能够真正识别其声称学习的源条件映射的目标函数与评估方法，现有目标与评测不足以刻画源实例保真度。

title: Scaling Full Conformal Image Classifiers
summary: Conformal prediction provides set-valued predictions with distribution-free coverage guarantees, making it attractive for high-stakes image classification. However, split conformal prediction is data-inefficient, while full conformal prediction (FCP), despite its stronger statistical efficiency, is computationally prohibitive at scale because it requires candidate-specific model refits at test time. We address this limitation by leveraging zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs) to guide scalable FCP in large label spaces. We introduce Targeted Full Conformal Prediction (T-FCP), which uses a lightweight inductive conformal predictor to prune unlikely labels and applies FCP only to the remaining candidates, reducing computation while retaining the formal guarantee of the combined conformal procedure. We further propose Stabilized Online LDA (SO-LDA), an efficient VLM adaptation solver based on rank-one inverse-covariance updates. Across multiple benchmarks, including ImageNet, T-FCP enables practical full-conformal image classification with modest test-time overhead, yielding efficient prediction sets and more stable empirical coverage than split conformal alternatives.

AI.tldr: 提出T-FCP框架，借助零样本视觉语言模型剪枝候选标签，使全共形预测在大标签空间图像分类中可行，并用SO-LDA高效求解VLM适配。
AI.motivation: 全共形预测（FCP）虽统计效率高，但需在测试时为每个候选标签重新拟合模型，计算代价随标签空间规模急剧增长；而split conformal prediction数据利用效率低。因此需要一种既能保留FCP正式覆盖保证、又能在大标签空间可扩展的方案。
AI.method: 1) T-FCP：先用轻量归纳式共形预测器剪除不可能标签，仅对剩余候选执行FCP，从而降低计算量并保留组合共形流程的正式保证；2) SO-LDA：基于秩一逆协方差更新的高效VLM适配求解器。
AI.result: 在包括ImageNet在内的多个基准上，T-FCP以适度的测试时开销实现实用的全共形图像分类，生成更高效的预测集，并比split conformal方法具有更稳定的经验覆盖。
AI.conclusion: T-FCP通过VLM引导的候选剪枝与SO-LDA高效适配，在保持FCP理论保证的同时显著提升大规模图像分类的可行性与统计稳定性。

title: Technical note on: Zero-Training Feature-Space Alignment via Information Geometry
summary: Deep vision models often degrade under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation can improve robustness but typically requires iterative optimization, hyperparameter tuning, and multiple forward-backward passes. We propose Zero-Training Fisher Geometry Alignment (ZFGA), a closed-form method that improves robustness under covariate shift without modifying model parameters. ZFGA is based on the observation that distribution shifts distort feature-space geometry. It estimates the Fisher information matrix of the predictive distribution with respect to feature embeddings and applies a linear transformation that aligns test-feature Fisher geometry with a reference geometry computed from clean data. This provides a natural-gradient-inspired preconditioning step in feature space. We evaluate ZFGA on CIFAR-10-C and ImageNet-C using ResNet-50, DINO ViT-S/16, and CLIP ViT-B/32. ZFGA consistently improves over zero-shot inference across all three models, although it is not the strongest method for every model. Covariance whitening performs better on ResNet-50, while Fisher whitening is statistically indistinguishable from ZFGA on CLIP. Across six training-free and gradient-based alternatives (covariance whitening, Fisher whitening, TENT, T3A, LAME, and AdaNPC), ZFGA is the only method that does not substantially harm any of the three model families. The Fisher geometry distortion is also positively correlated with ZFGA gain (Pearson r = 0.366, p = 0.017), providing preliminary evidence that geometric misalignment contributes to robustness degradation. ZFGA requires only forward passes and matrix operations at inference time, offering a lightweight and deterministic alternative to optimization-based test-time adaptation.

AI.tldr: ZFGA是一种免训练、闭式的测试时适应方法，通过Fisher几何对齐改善分布偏移下的鲁棒性，仅需前向传播与矩阵运算。
AI.motivation: 深度视觉模型在分布偏移下性能下降，现有测试时适应方法通常需要迭代优化、超参调优和多次前向-反向传播，成本高且非确定性。
AI.method: 基于分布偏移扭曲特征空间几何的观察，估计预测分布关于特征嵌入的Fisher信息矩阵，并施加线性变换，使测试特征的Fisher几何与干净数据计算的参考几何对齐，从而在特征空间实现自然梯度启发的预条件处理；不修改模型参数。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10-C和ImageNet-C上以ResNet-50、DINO ViT-S/16、CLIP ViT-B/32评估，ZFGA在三个模型上均优于零样本推理，但并非每个模型上的最强方法：协方差白化在ResNet-50上更优，Fisher白化在CLIP上与ZFGA统计不可区分。在六种无训练与基于梯度的对比方法中，ZFGA是唯一未对三个模型家族造成实质损害的方法。Fisher几何扭曲与ZFGA增益正相关（Pearson r=0.366, p=0.017）。
AI.conclusion: 几何错配是鲁棒性退化的重要成因；ZFGA以仅前向传播和矩阵运算的轻量、确定性方式，提供了一种优于优化式测试时适应的替代方案。

title: Hidden Reasoning Must Leak, but Need Not Be Readable: Fundamental Opportunities and Limits for Chain-of-Thought Monitoring
summary: Can reasoning models trick chain of thought (CoT) monitors and perform hidden computation without revealing it in their thinking traces? We show that the answer depends on the underlying task difficulty and the model size. Simple computations can be performed covertly; however, beyond a threshold depending on model size, successfully solving the task necessarily leaks a near-linear amount of information about the covert task input into the CoT. Therefore, sufficiently complex hidden computation always leaves an information-theoretic footprint. However, concerningly, this leakage need not be readable: Under plausible cryptographic assumptions, even a one-layer Transformer can encrypt its reasoning online so that no polynomial-time monitor can extract information about the hidden computation. Overall, our theoretical and empirical results provide a holistic view of both the opportunities and the limitations of CoT monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文研究推理模型能否在不暴露思考过程的情况下进行隐藏计算，发现答案取决于任务难度和模型规模：简单任务可隐蔽完成，但超过某一阈值后必然在CoT中泄露近乎线性量级的输入信息；且这种泄露在密码学假设下可被加密而无法被多项式时间监控器读取。
AI.motivation: CoT监控被视为监督推理模型的重要手段，但模型是否能在思考痕迹之外执行隐藏计算、从而绕过监控，尚缺乏系统性的理论与实证认识。作者希望厘清隐藏计算的机会与局限。
AI.method: 结合信息论分析与实证研究，界定任务难度、模型规模与CoT信息泄露量之间的关系；并借助密码学假设构造单层Transformer在线加密其推理过程的情形。
AI.result: 简单计算可被隐蔽执行；但当任务复杂度超过随模型规模变化的阈值时，成功求解必然向CoT泄露关于隐藏任务输入的近乎线性量级的信息。不过该泄露不一定可读：在合理的密码学假设下，即便单层Transformer也能在线加密推理，使任何多项式时间监控器都无法提取隐藏计算的信息。
AI.conclusion: 研究从信息论与计算复杂性两个层面给出了CoT监控的机会与局限的全景：复杂隐藏计算必留信息论痕迹，但该痕迹未必可被有效读取，提示监控能力存在原理性边界。

title: FLASH: A "Generate Once, Synthesize Many" Framework for Synthetic Anomaly Generation in Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Synthetic anomaly generation helps expand industrial anomaly datasets when real defects are scarce or unavailable. Existing approaches lie at two extremes: procedural approaches are fast but struggle to represent complex anomalies, while generative approaches produce diverse defects but require costly per-sample generation. We present FLASH, a framework that decouples defect generation from anomaly synthesis under a ``generate once, synthesize many'' paradigm. Given only normal images, FLASH uses Vision-Language Model (VLM) guidance and an image-generation model to produce a small set of defect images, from which it extracts, validates, and banks reusable defect patches. For synthesis of anomalous images, Object Boundary Suppression (OBS) first identifies the probable foreground object-aware region of the host image, while Multi-Resolution Spectral Pyramid (MRSP) noise generates diverse, size-controllable masks that determine the defect location and spatial extent. It then composes a large and diverse synthetic anomalous image set by localizing the defect region, sampling size-controllable placement masks and seamlessly blending retrieved defects onto new defect-free images without further need for image generation. Experiments on the MVTec AD 2 dataset show that FLASH-generated anomalies nearly close the calibration gap on real defects, reaching 78.1% image-level F1 against an 83.6% real-anomaly upper bound and providing the most consistent calibration transfer across detectors among procedural and generative alternatives. Moreover, FLASH synthesizes anomalies more than 11.95x faster than per-sample generative approaches.

AI.tldr: FLASH 提出"一次生成、多次合成"范式，用 VLM 引导生成少量缺陷图并建立可复用缺陷块库，再通过 OBS 与 MRSP 噪声在正常图上合成大规模异常样本，在 MVTec AD 2 上接近真实缺陷效果且比逐样本生成法快 11.95 倍以上。
AI.motivation: 工业异常检测中真实缺陷稀缺，合成异常生成可扩充数据集。现有方法存在两难：过程式方法速度快但难以刻画复杂缺陷；生成式方法缺陷多样却需逐样本高成本生成。因此需要兼顾多样性、逼真度与生成效率的新框架。
AI.method: FLASH 将缺陷生成与异常合成解耦，遵循"generate once, synthesize many"。仅用正常图像，借助视觉语言模型（VLM）引导与图像生成模型产生少量缺陷图像，从中提取、验证并存储可复用缺陷块；合成阶段，Object Boundary Suppression（OBS）定位宿主图像的物体前景区域，Multi-Resolution Spectral Pyramid（MRSP）噪声生成多样且尺寸可控的掩码以决定缺陷位置与空间范围，最终通过定位缺陷区域、采样尺寸可控放置掩码并无缝融合缺陷块到新的无缺陷图像上，无需再次图像生成。
AI.result: 在 MVTec AD 2 数据集上，FLASH 生成异常接近真实缺陷的校准性能：图像级 F1 达 78.1%，真实异常上界为 83.6%；在过程式与生成式替代方法中，跨检测器的校准迁移最为一致；合成速度比逐样本生成方法快 11.95 倍以上。
AI.conclusion: FLASH 通过解耦缺陷生成与合成，在仅用正常图像的条件下实现了高效、多样且逼真的异常合成，显著缩小了与真实缺陷的校准差距并大幅提升生成效率，为工业异常数据扩充提供了兼顾质量与成本的可行方案。

title: Leveraging LLM-Generated Explanations for Detecting Emotionally Rewritten Fake News
summary: The spread of fake news may cause severe social consequences. Existing fake news detection methods mainly focus on stylistic variations or incorporate external information such as explanations. However, news articles are often rewritten under different emotional backgrounds while preserving their underlying factual claims, which may affect the robustness of detection models. In this work, we investigate fake news detec- tion under fact-preserving emotional variations. To study this problem, we construct emotion-rewritten test sets and generate explanations from the original news articles as stable background knowledge. We then propose a Gated Cross Attention (GCA) framework that adaptively integrates emotionally rewritten news with the corresponding explanations, enabling the model to focus on informative explanation content while reducing potential mismatches caused by emotional reframing. Experiments on PolitiFact, GossipCop, and LUN demonstrate that the proposed method achieves notable improvements under multiple emotional conditions on PolitiFact and LUN, while maintaining competitive performance on GossipCop. We further analyze the effects of explanation guidance and gating mechanisms under different emotional conditions. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/Flulike/fakenews gca .

AI.tldr: 本文研究事实保持的情感改写下的假新闻检测，构建情感改写测试集并从原文生成解释作为稳定背景知识，提出门控交叉注意力（GCA）框架自适应融合情感改写新闻与解释，在 PolitiFact、LUN 上取得显著提升，在 GossipCop 上保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有假新闻检测方法主要依赖文体特征或引入解释等外部信息，但新闻常在不同情感背景下被改写而保留其事实主张，这会削弱检测模型的鲁棒性；该事实保持的情感变化场景尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 构建情感改写测试集；从原始新闻文章生成解释，作为稳定的背景知识；提出门控交叉注意力（GCA）框架，自适应地整合情感改写新闻与对应解释，使模型聚焦于有信息量的解释内容，同时缓解情感重构带来的潜在错配。
AI.result: 在 PolitiFact、GossipCop 和 LUN 数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在 PolitiFact 与 LUN 的多种情感条件下取得显著提升，同时在 GossipCop 上保持有竞争力的性能；并进一步分析了不同情感条件下解释引导与门控机制的作用。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入稳定解释知识并对情感改写新闻进行门控交叉注意力融合，可有效提升假新闻检测在事实保持情感变化下的鲁棒性；代码与数据已公开。

title: ContextAdapt: Evaluating Contextual Adaptation and Value Alignment in LLMs
summary: Values such as honesty, autonomy, and confidentiality are often regarded as general principles underpinning AI alignment. However, what it means to act in accordance with these values can depend on the context in which a decision is made. In this paper, we ask whether large language models (LLMs) appropriately adapt the application of a value across professional settings, while remaining consistent when contextual changes do not alter the relevant professional norm. To study this, we introduce ContextAdapt, an evaluation framework covering honesty, autonomy, and confidentiality across medicine, law, finance, and national security. Drawing on primary-source professional and regulatory documents, we construct a value x domain framework and use this to develop scenarios testing both default professional rules and recognised exceptions. We evaluate 12 LLMs on both the actions they recommend and the justifications they provide. In our main experiment, models achieve 95.6% mean appropriateness, although the use of the correct domain-specific justification varies substantially across models, from 25.6% to 76.9%. In a separate factorial experiment, explicitly naming the professional domain and changing the role of the model have limited effect on behaviour. Varying stakes, however, reveals severe but localised failures: in some cases, models alter their responses even though the underlying professional obligation remains unchanged. In particular, perceived severity appears to act as a cue for disclosure across both honesty and confidentiality scenarios. These results show that evaluating value alignment requires us to consider not only whether models follow abstract principles, but whether they apply them appropriately across different contexts.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ContextAdapt 评测框架，考察 LLM 能否在不同专业情境中恰当地应用诚实、自主、保密等价值，并保持情境无关变化下的一致性。12 个模型在推荐行为上平均恰当性达 95.6%，但正确使用领域专属理由的比例差异悬殊（25.6%–76.9%）；显式标注专业领域与改变模型角色影响有限，而风险程度的变化会引发局部但严重的失败。
AI.motivation: 诚实、自主、保密等价值常被视为 AI 对齐的普遍原则，但"遵循某价值"的具体含义取决于决策情境。既有对齐评测多关注模型是否服从抽象原则，忽略了模型能否在不同专业情境中恰当调整价值的应用、并在情境变化不影响相关专业规范时保持一致。论文旨在填补这一"情境化价值应用"评测的空白。
AI.method: 提出 ContextAdapt 评测框架，覆盖医学、法律、金融、国家安全四个领域与诚实、自主、保密三项价值。基于一手专业与监管文献构建"价值×领域"框架，据此设计同时测试默认专业规则与公认例外的情境题。对 12 个 LLM 同时评测其推荐行为与给出的理由。另设析因实验，分别操控是否显式命名专业领域、模型角色以及风险程度（stakes）。
AI.result: 主实验中模型推荐行为的平均恰当性为 95.6%，但使用正确领域专属理由的比例在模型间差异显著，从 25.6% 到 76.9%。析因实验显示：显式命名专业领域与改变模型角色对行为影响有限；改变风险程度则暴露出严重但局部化的失败——部分模型在底层专业义务未变的情况下改变回答，且感知到的严重性似乎成为诚实与保密情境中披露行为的线索。
AI.conclusion: 评测价值对齐不仅需考察模型是否遵循抽象原则，更需考察其能否在不同情境中恰当应用这些原则。行为层面的高恰当性可能掩盖理由层面与风险敏感性层面的缺陷，情境化评测是必要的。

title: What Comes Next? Omni-StoryBench for Evaluating Story-Grounded Omnimodal Generation
summary: Omnimodal evaluation should go beyond independent text, image, and speech production: individually plausible outputs may not express a coherent shared event. We introduce Omni-StoryBench, a story-grounded omnimodal benchmark evaluating whether models can coherently continue stories across image, narration, and speech. Each instance provides a current storybook page and structured next-page conditions, requiring models to generate the next illustration, narration, and spoken character utterance. Omni-StoryBench contains 900 rigorously validated story transitions from openly licensed children's books, with ground-truth next-page references and speech metadata. We evaluate systems with modality-specific metrics and consistency-centered LLM-as-a-judge rubrics for context preservation, condition following, reference consistency, and cross-modal coherence. Across 32 baseline configurations spanning orchestration, semi-orchestration, and native any-to-any paradigms, we find orchestration with strong VLM planning most reliable, while current native omnimodal models often struggle with output completeness and controllability. Our analysis shows text-side performance is associated with image and speech quality, but image generation and visual continuity form the clearest observed bottleneck among the evaluated configurations. These results position Omni-StoryBench as a system-level benchmark measuring coherent omnimodal generation beyond isolated modality quality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Omni-StoryBench，一个以故事为背景的全模态基准，评估模型能否在图像、旁白与角色语音上连贯续写故事，并揭示编排式方案优于原生全模态模型、视觉连续性为主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态评估多以文本、图像、语音各自独立的质量为指标，但各模态单独看似合理的输出未必共同表达连贯的同一事件，缺乏衡量跨模态连贯生成的系统级评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 Omni-StoryBench，含 900 个经验证的故事转场（取自开放许可童书），每例给定当前故事页与结构化下一页条件，要求生成下一幅插画、旁白及角色口语语句，并提供下一页真值参考与语音元数据；采用模态专属指标与以一致性为核心的 LLM-as-a-judge 评分标准，涵盖上下文保持、条件遵循、参考一致性与跨模态连贯性；共评测 32 种基线配置。
