AI.result: 在编排式、半编排式与原生任意到任意三类范式中，强 VLM 规划的编排式方案最可靠；当前原生全模态模型在输出完整性与可控性上常表现不佳。文本侧表现与图像、语音质量相关，而图像生成与视觉连续性是被评估配置中最明显的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: Omni-StoryBench 是一个系统级基准，用于衡量超越单模态质量的全模态连贯生成能力，为全模态系统的整体评估提供新范式。

title: Solving Without Stopping: On-Policy Distillation at Small Scale
summary: On-policy distillation, where a student learns from a stronger teacher's feedback on its own outputs, is a common way to pass reasoning to smaller models. We analyze what it transfers at small scale, distilling Qwen3-8B into Qwen3 4B, 1.7B and 0.6B students, in thinking mode (reason at length, then end the reasoning and answer) and, for comparison, in non-thinking mode (no separate reasoning phase). Long reasoning needs two abilities, solving a problem and knowing when it is solved, and we find that distillation transfers the first, but in thinking mode not the second. Solving improves at every size, up to two ceilings, which we measure comprehensively across both modes and all student sizes: a student's single attempt never exceeds what it could already reach in many attempts before training, and the smaller the student, the further it stays below the teacher. Stopping is where the modes part. In non-thinking mode every student keeps stopping; in thinking mode students stop ending their reasoning early in training, and the smaller the student, the less of this ability survives: the teacher signals a stop almost only where a student already ends its reasoning, so distillation teaches no new stops; it only keeps the student's existing stops that land on a right answer, and a weak student has few such stops. The smallest students often reach the right value but do not commit to it: they either rarely mark it or mark it and write past it. Together, these results describe how small students behave under on-policy distillation, and a diagnostic that separates answer marking, correctness and stopping.

AI.tldr: 本文在小规模上分析on-policy蒸馏究竟迁移了什么：将Qwen3-8B蒸馏到Qwen3 4B/1.7B/0.6B，比较thinking与non-thinking两种模式。发现蒸馏迁移了"解题能力"但未迁移"知道何时已解出"的能力；解题能力在所有规模上提升但存在两重上限；停止行为在两种模式下分化，且学生越小该能力留存越少。
AI.motivation: On-policy蒸馏被广泛用于把推理能力迁移到小模型，但此前对其"究竟迁移了什么"缺乏细粒度分析。长推理需要两种能力——解题与判断何时已解，作者希望区分这两者，并刻画不同学生规模下的迁移边界与失效模式。
AI.method: 以Qwen3-8B为教师，蒸馏到Qwen3 4B、1.7B、0.6B三个学生模型，分别在thinking模式（先长推理再结束推理并作答）与non-thinking模式（无独立推理阶段）下进行对比。测量指标包括解题成功率、单次尝试上限与训练前多次尝试可达上限的对比、停止/结束推理行为，并提出一个分离"答案标记、正确性与停止"的诊断方法。
AI.result: 解题能力在所有学生规模上都提升，但受两重上限约束：学生的单次尝试不超过其训练前多次尝试所能达到的水平，且学生越小与教师的差距越大。停止行为在两种模式下分化：non-thinking模式下所有学生保持停止；thinking模式下学生在训练早期提前结束推理，学生越小该能力留存越少。教师几乎只在学生本身已结束推理处发出停止信号，因此蒸馏不教新的停止，只保留落在正确答案上的已有停止，而弱学生此类停止很少。最小学生常能到达正确值却不"确认"它：或极少标记，或标记后继续写下去。
AI.conclusion: On-policy蒸馏主要迁移解题能力而非"知道何时已解"的停止/确认能力；停止能力在thinking模式下随学生规模减小而衰减，源于教师信号只覆盖学生已有停止点。作者据此给出一个区分答案标记、正确性与停止的诊断工具，用以描述小学生在on-policy蒸馏下的行为特征。

title: The Domain Is a Residue: Adapting Self-Supervised Features, Not Generators
comment: 9 pages main text, 28 pages including appendix. 12 figures, 13 tables
summary: Clearing fog, rain or snow from footage, or turning renders into photographs, must remove the source domain and keep the scene. Unpaired translators carry it through because their generator sees the source appearance (pixels, a near-invertible latent or a control map) and keeps it. A DINO feature map fixes what is in the scene and carries weather, lighting and rendering style as a residue of 13 to 14% of the feature norm. We propose the Representation Feature Adapter (RFA), a 2.9M-parameter network that moves this residue. We train only the adapter and its discriminators; the encoder and a feature-conditioned decoder, trained once for all conditions, stay frozen. Against CycleGAN-Turbo it is ahead on both metrics on fog and on KID on night, and level within noise on snow, rain and haze. On sim-to-real it leads REGEN and HyPER-GAN on both metrics. Only the RFA removes the rain while keeping the scene. The removal costs scene structure: CycleGAN-Turbo keeps more on every condition but fog. On VAE latents the identical adapter collapses to the identity, and decoders from other groups that never saw it render its output. The RFA has about 160 times fewer trainable parameters than CycleGAN-Turbo and under a fifth of its per-condition training time.

AI.tldr: 提出 Representation Feature Adapter (RFA)，一个仅 2.9M 参数的网络，通过移动 DINO 特征图中承载天气/光照/渲染风格的残差（约占特征范数 13-14%）来实现去雾、去雨、去雪及渲染转照片，编码器与解码器冻结。
AI.motivation: 现有非配对转换器依赖生成器保留源域外观（像素、近似可逆潜变量或控制图）来同时"去除源域并保留场景"。作者希望找到一种更轻量、更可控的方式，在保留场景内容的同时仅去除源域（天气、光照、渲染风格）。
AI.method: 基于 DINO 特征图固定场景内容、并将天气/光照/渲染风格表征为约 13-14% 特征范数残差的观察，提出 RFA，一个 2.9M 参数网络用于移动该残差。仅训练适配器及其判别器；编码器与特征条件解码器（一次训练、跨所有条件通用）保持冻结。在 VAE 潜变量上相同适配器退化为恒等映射作对照分析。
AI.result: 相比 CycleGAN-Turbo，在去雾两项指标及夜晚场景 KID 上更优，在雪、雨、雾上处于噪声范围内持平；sim-to-real 上两项指标均领先 REGEN 与 HyPER-GAN；仅 RFA 能在去除雨的同时保留场景。代价是场景结构：除雾外 CycleGAN-Turbo 在每种条件下保留更多结构。VAE 潜变量上适配器坍缩为恒等，未见过该适配器的其他组解码器可直接渲染其输出。RFA 可训练参数比 CycleGAN-Turbo 少约 160 倍，单条件训练时间不到其五分之一。
AI.conclusion: 通过冻结编码器-解码器、仅训练轻量适配器来移动 DINO 特征残差，可高效完成跨天气与 sim-to-real 的域去除，且参数量与训练时间大幅降低，但在多数条件下场景结构保留略逊于 CycleGAN-Turbo。

title: OFBD: Object-Focused Background Debiasing for Long-Tailed Learning
summary: Balancing performance trade-offs on long-tailed data distributions remains a long-standing challenge in visual recognition. Existing methods mainly improve tail classes through re-balancing, representation learning, or data augmentation, but the underlying cause of tail class degradation is still insufficiently explored. In this paper, we find that standard long-tailed training induces background-biased representation and optimization: tail classes suffer larger background distribution shifts and become increasingly driven by background gradients. This reveals that tail degradation is not merely caused by insufficient samples, but also by the learning of irrelevant background features. To tackle this issue, we propose Object-Focused Background Debiasing (OFBD), a framework that mitigates background bias from both distribution and optimization perspectives. Specifically, Foreground-guided CutMix preserves target-related foregrounds while diversifying complementary backgrounds, and Background-guided Feature Rectification suppresses background-biased features without learnable parameters or additional training. Extensive experiments show that our method improves overall accuracy, achieves significant tail-class gains, and can serve as a plug-in for mainstream long-tailed methods without external data or pretrained recognition models. The code is available at: https://ofbd-neurips2026-longtail-learning.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文发现长尾训练会诱导背景偏置的表征与优化，导致尾部类退化；提出OFBD框架，从前景引导CutMix与背景引导特征矫正两方面缓解该偏置，在不使用外部数据或预训练识别模型下提升整体与尾部类精度。
AI.motivation: 长尾识别中尾部类退化问题长期存在。现有方法多依赖重平衡、表征学习或数据增强来提升尾部类，但未充分探究其根本成因。作者发现标准长尾训练会引入背景偏置：尾部类面临更大的背景分布偏移，且越来越受背景梯度主导，因此尾部退化不仅源于样本不足，也源于无关背景特征的学习。
AI.method: 提出Object-Focused Background Debiasing（OFBD）框架，从分布与优化两个视角缓解背景偏置。包含两个组件：Foreground-guided CutMix，在保留与目标相关前景的同时多样化互补背景；Background-guided Feature Rectification，无需可学习参数或额外训练即可抑制背景偏置特征。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法提升了整体准确率，在尾部类上取得显著增益，并可作为插件嵌入主流长尾方法，且无需外部数据或预训练识别模型。
AI.conclusion: 尾部类退化可归因于背景偏置的表征与优化，而非仅是样本不足；通过前景保持的背景混合与无参特征矫正可有效缓解该偏置，为长尾识别提供了一种即插即用的去偏方案。

title: UGO: Unified Architecture for General Multi-Object Tracking by Segmentation
summary: General multi-object tracking (GMOT) tracks all instances of a user-specified category from a single first-frame exemplar. Prior work relies on bounding boxes and surrogate training, and struggles with non-rigid objects, crowded scenes, and distractors. We introduce UGO, a unified GMOT tracker that pairs a pretrained exemplar-conditioned detection head with an instance-propagation head in a common architecture. A novel training-free, energy-minimization consolidation method converts overlapping proposals into exclusive pixel-wise masks and detections, resolving over-segmentation, duplicates, and conflicts. A hierarchical memory spanning global and instance levels improves recall and per-instance segmentation accuracy using a new memory management protocol. UGO sets a new state-of-the-art on GMOT benchmarks and video object counting, and is competitive with specialist MOT methods, establishing a strong paradigm for unified, open-category multi-object tracking.

AI.tldr: UGO：统一通用多目标跟踪框架，结合示例条件检测头与实例传播头，通过无训练能量最小化整合与层次记忆，实现开类别多目标跟踪与视频目标计数的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 既有通用多目标跟踪（GMOT）依赖边界框与代理训练，在非刚性物体、拥挤场景和干扰物上表现不佳，且缺乏统一的像素级分割与检测能力。
AI.method: 提出UGO统一跟踪器：在统一架构中融合预训练的示例条件检测头与实例传播头；引入无训练的、基于能量最小化的整合方法，将重叠候选转化为互斥的像素级掩码与检测，解决过分割、重复与冲突；设计涵盖全局与实例两级的层次记忆，并提出新的记忆管理协议以提升召回率与逐实例分割精度。
AI.result: 在GMOT基准和视频目标计数任务上取得新的最优性能，并与专用MOT方法具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: UGO为统一、开类别多目标跟踪提供了强有力的新范式，验证了检测与传播联合建模加能量式整合的有效性。

title: HyperSAM: A Promptable Foundation Model for Hyperspectral Remote Sensing
comment: Accepted by IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Magazine (GRSM)
summary: Hyperspectral remote sensing provides dense spectral measurements that are indispensable for material-level Earth observation, yet the construction of a general-purpose hyperspectral foundation model remains difficult. Two bottlenecks are especially limiting. First, large hyperspectral corpora rarely provide high spatial resolution together with reliable dense annotations. Second, many hyperspectral models are still trained almost from scratch, so the geometric and interactive priors learned by modern vision foundation models are not fully reused. To alleviate these issues, we \highlight{present} \textbf{HyperSAM}, a promptable hyperspectral foundation model that couples a data-centric hyperspectral synthesis pipeline with a spectral adaptation architecture based on Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3). On the data side, HyperSAM synthesizes full-spectrum hyperspectral cubes from high-resolution SpaceNet multispectral imagery through a physics-informed abundance-transfer generator, while SAM3-derived pseudo-masks provide object-centric supervision. On the model side, the latest implementation uses a frozen SAM3 RGB image branch, a trainable hyperspectral side encoder initialized from the RGB vision transformer (ViT), ControlNet-style zero-initialized feature injection, and a lightweight mixture-of-experts mask refiner. To enhance training robustness against noisy pseudo-labels, Cross-modal Sample Selection (CromSS)-style confidence selection is incorporated for noisy-label weighting. Extensive experiments show that HyperSAM obtains strong generalization on diverse hyperspectral tasks (e.g., classification, anomaly detection, change detection, target detection, and airborne oil-spill mapping) and that high-quality synthetic hyperspectral data can be more effective than simply scaling noisy hyperspectral supervision.

AI.tldr: HyperSAM：以数据合成+基于SAM3的谱段适配架构构建提示式高光谱基础模型，在分类、异常/变化/目标检测、溢油制图等任务上表现良好。
AI.motivation: 高光谱遥感可提供密集光谱测量，对物质级对地观测至关重要，但通用高光谱基础模型构建困难：一是大规模高光谱语料难以同时具备高空间分辨率与可靠的密集标注；二是多数高光谱模型几乎从零训练，未能充分利用现代视觉基础模型学到的几何与交互先验。
AI.method: 提出HyperSAM——提示式高光谱基础模型，结合数据中心的合成管线与基于SAM3的光谱适配架构。数据侧：通过物理信息引导的丰度迁移生成器，从高分辨率SpaceNet多光谱影像合成全谱段高光谱立方体；以SAM3生成的伪掩膜提供目标中心监督。模型侧：冻结SAM3 RGB图像分支；以RGB ViT初始化可训练高光谱侧编码器；采用ControlNet式零初始化特征注入；引入轻量级专家混合（MoE）掩膜精修器；并结合CromSS式置信度选择对噪声伪标签加权以增强训练鲁棒性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，HyperSAM在多种高光谱任务上具有强泛化能力，包括分类、异常检测、变化检测、目标检测及机载溢油制图；同时高质量合成高光谱数据比单纯扩展含噪高光谱监督更有效。
AI.conclusion: HyperSAM通过“物理信息合成数据+复用SAM3视觉先验的谱段适配架构+噪标签置信度加权”的组合，缓解了高光谱基础模型的数据与预训练先验瓶颈，并验证了高质量合成监督在跨任务泛化上的价值。

title: When to Retrieve, When to Stay: Uncertainty-Aware Temporal Evidence Allocation for Streaming Video-LLMs
summary: Streaming video understanding requires Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) to reason over continuous visual streams under causal constraints. As the visual history grows, a bounded visual?processing budget requires evidence selection that balances temporal recency with query relevance. Recent-only selection excludes potentially relevant historical evidence, whereas Semantic-only retrieval can displace useful recent context when relevance scores are ambiguous. We introduce WRWS (When to Retrieve, When to Stay), a training-free framework for uncertainty-adaptive evidence allocation. A lightweight external vision-language encoder scores query relevance across the observed history, while an adaptive allocation module uses the normalized entropy of the similarity distribution as a proxy for retrieval uncertainty. WRWS favors semantic retrieval when relevance cues are reliable and strengthens the recency prior under uncertainty. Following a retrieve-first, encode-later pipeline, WRWS selects evidence before target-model visual encoding, such that only the selected observations are processed by the costly target Video-LLM. Experiments across four Video-LLM families and multiple model scales demonstrate competitive accuracy on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench. In our efficiency evaluation, WRWS reduces average vision-to-answer time to 47.93% of the state-of-the-art method. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架WRWS，用相似度分布的归一化熵度量检索不确定性，自适应平衡语义检索与近期性先验，在流式视频理解中先选证据再编码，兼顾精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解需在因果约束下处理连续视觉流，视觉历史不断增长而有界处理预算有限，必须进行证据选择。仅取近期会遗漏潜在相关的历史证据；仅做语义检索在相关性分数模糊时会挤占有用的近期上下文。因此需要一种能自适应权衡时间近期性与查询相关性的证据分配方法。
AI.method: WRWS为免训练框架，面向不确定性自适应的证据分配。使用轻量外部视觉-语言编码器对已观测历史打分得到查询相关性；自适应分配模块以相似度分布的归一化熵作为检索不确定性的代理。相关性线索可靠时偏向语义检索，不确定性高时强化近期性先验。采用"先检索、后编码"流程，在目标模型视觉编码前完成证据选择，使昂贵的目标Video-LLM只处理被选中的观测。
AI.result: 在四个Video-LLM系列与多种模型规模上实验，于StreamingBench和OVO-Bench取得具竞争力的精度；效率评估中，WRWS将平均"视觉到回答"时间降至当前最优方法的47.93%。
AI.conclusion: 通过以熵为不确定性代理自适应分配证据预算，WRWS在无需训练的前提下统一了检索相关性与时间近期性，在不牺牲精度的同时显著降低流式视频理解的视觉处理时延，代码将开源。

title: TAEC: Trajectory-Aware Evidence Coordination for Multi-Step Visual RAG
summary: Multi-step visual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) answers complex questions by repeatedly retrieving visual evidence, updating an intermediate state, and deciding whether to continue searching or answer. Yet retrieving relevant evidence does not ensure its effective use throughout the reasoning trajectory. As multi-step reasoning progresses, redundant sources occupy context capacity needed for missing evidence, observations tied to resolved requirements or unproductive searches linger in context, and visual sources are revisited with insufficient detail for fine-grained reading. We term this loss of usable evidence over a reasoning trajectory trajectory-level evidence utilization degradation. To address it, we propose Trajectory-Aware Evidence Coordination (TAEC), a training-free framework that coordinates evidence use around unresolved answer requirements. TAEC tracks these requirements in a shared trajectory state to guide which evidence enters the context, how accumulated memory is retained, and at what level of detail visual evidence is examined. Under a unified evaluation protocol on ViDoSeek, SlideVQA, and MMLongBench-Doc, TAEC achieves the best overall performance against leading training-free visual RAG baselines, with the highest average accuracy across multiple proprietary vision-language models. These results demonstrate that aligning evidence with evolving reasoning needs improves evidence use throughout multi-step visual RAG.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出免训练框架TAEC，通过围绕未解决的答案需求协调证据使用，缓解多步视觉RAG中的"轨迹级证据利用退化"问题，在多个基准上取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 多步视觉RAG通过反复检索视觉证据、更新中间状态并决定是否继续搜索来回答复杂问题，但检索到相关证据并不保证其在推理轨迹中被有效利用。随着多步推理推进，会出现三类问题：冗余来源占用上下文容量而挤占缺失证据的空间；已解决需求或无产出搜索的观察滞留上下文；视觉来源被重复查看却缺乏细粒度阅读所需的足够细节。作者将这种沿推理轨迹丢失可用证据的现象称为"轨迹级证据利用退化"。
AI.method: 提出轨迹感知证据协调（TAEC），一种免训练框架，围绕未解决的答案需求来协调证据使用。TAEC在共享的轨迹状态中跟踪这些需求，以指导哪些证据进入上下文、累积记忆如何保留，以及以何种细节层次检查视觉证据。
AI.result: 在ViDoSeek、SlideVQA和MMLongBench-Doc上采用统一评估协议，TAEC相对领先的免训练视觉RAG基线取得最佳总体性能，并在多个专有视觉语言模型上取得最高平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将证据与不断演化的推理需求对齐，可以改善多步视觉RAG全过程中的证据利用。

title: PCaPaint: Prostate Cancer Inpainting by Mitigating Shortcut Learning
comment: Accepted at the DGM4MICCAI workshop at MICCAI 2026
summary: The development of AI systems for tumor-specific applications is limited by the scarcity of labeled data. Synthetic tumor inpainting offers a promising approach but faces challenges for prostate cancer MRI which contains high-resolution multi-sequence data. Although methods leveraging latent diffusion models (LDMs) enable large-volume synthesis, they are prone to shortcut learning, simply reproducing the condition image created by masking the lesion region. In this work, we introduce PCaPaint, a prostate cancer inpainting method based on LDMs that explicitly addresses this failure mode. To overcome shortcut learning that compromises synthetic tumor texture, we propose a simple yet efficient conditioning strategy in which the condition image is filled with Gaussian noise, and we provide theoretical justification. In addition, we propose a novel training objective for LDM that emphasizes the error within the lesion region. Furthermore, we introduce a multi-sequence latent design, in which T2w scans and DWI&ADC scans are compressed using two separate autoencoders to preserve their distinct frequency characteristics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the generated synthetic data improves downstream performance in prostate lesion segmentation, patient-level classification and lesion-level detection. Furthermore, our method significantly outperforms a recent state-of-the-art LDM-based tumor inpainting method both in downstream performance and in synthetic image quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PCaPaint，一种基于潜在扩散模型（LDM）的前列腺癌MRI肿瘤修复方法，通过高斯噪声填充条件图像、病灶区域加权训练目标以及多序列潜在表示设计，解决了条件图像复用导致的捷径学习问题，合成的肿瘤数据在下游任务中显著提升性能并超越当前最先进的LDM肿瘤修复方法。
AI.motivation: AI在肿瘤特异性应用中受限于标注数据稀缺。合成肿瘤修复是有前景的方案，但前列腺癌MRI为高分辨率多序列数据，现有基于LDM的大体积合成方法容易出现捷径学习（shortcut learning），即简单复制由掩膜病灶区域生成的条件图像，导致合成肿瘤纹理质量受损。
AI.method: 1) 条件策略：将条件图像用高斯噪声填充，并给出理论论证，以打破捷径学习；2) 新的LDM训练目标：强调病灶区域内的重建误差；3) 多序列潜在设计：用两个独立自编码器分别压缩T2w与DWI&ADC，以保留其不同的频率特性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，生成的合成数据提升了前列腺病灶分割、患者级分类和病灶级检测的下游性能；且该方法在下游性能和合成图像质量上均显著优于近期最先进的基于LDM的肿瘤修复方法。
AI.conclusion: PCaPaint通过针对性的条件策略、训练目标和多序列潜在表示设计，有效克服了LDM肿瘤修复中的捷径学习问题，实现了高质量前列腺癌MRI合成，并可有效增强下游任务性能。

title: Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation: Mitigating the Deliberation Drift Cliff in Test-Time Compute Scaling
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code and evaluation artifacts available
summary: Test-time compute scaling has emerged as a cornerstone of advanced machine reasoning, yet performing iterative deliberation directly within continuous latent representation spaces reveals a catastrophic pathology: the Deliberation Drift Cliff. While unconstrained recurrent latent models achieve initial reasoning gains at short horizons (K <= 4), their reasoning collapses when extrapolated to deeper thinking steps (K >= 16), dropping by 22% to 62% across standard logical benchmarks. We resolve the trilemma among expressivity, Lyapunov stability, and computational efficiency in test-time latent reasoning through a 22-round empirical and theoretical investigation. We demonstrate that strictly conservative scalar potential gradient flows suppress long-range drift (cliff 3.40%) but bottleneck peak reasoning accuracy at 32.73%, whereas unconstrained rotational flows achieve high symbolic expressivity (82.33%) but suffer a severe 36.87% drift cliff. To resolve this geometric duality, we establish Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation (PH-LD) and propose the Direct-Gradient Pure-Tensor Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition (DG-HHD). DG-HHD parameterizes the attracting flow as a tangent projection tensor network while orthogonally decoupling non-zero circulation (Hodge machine error 1.65e-17, contraction error 5.55e-17), eliminating runtime autograd dependencies to achieve 1.84x vector field and 2.09x RK45 rollout speedups. In a 15-arm symmetrical Pareto benchmark, DG-HHD achieves 58.67% peak accuracy (+25.94% absolute gain over conservative HHD) and retains 35.27% at K=32. Transferred to small language model (SLM) multi-hop causal reasoning, DG-HHD delivers monotonic compute scaling (49.33% to 51.56%) and suppresses out-of-distribution drift (cliff -0.66%). All 30 Level 0 deterministic invariants are certified.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示连续隐空间测试时推理存在"Deliberation Drift Cliff"（深层思维步数下推理崩溃），提出Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation (PH-LD)及Direct-Gradient Pure-Tensor Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition (DG-HHD)，通过切向投影张量网络参数化吸引流并正交解耦非零环流，在保持符号表达能力的同时抑制长程漂移，实现更优的精度-稳定性-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 测试时计算扩展是高级机器推理的基石，但在连续隐表示空间内进行迭代推理会出现"Deliberation Drift Cliff"病理：无约束循环隐模型在短视野(K<=4)有初始推理增益，但外推到更深思维步(K>=16)时推理崩溃，在标准逻辑基准上下降22%-62%。现有方法难以同时兼顾表达能力、Lyapunov稳定性与计算效率。
AI.method: 通过22轮经验与理论研究，建立Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation (PH-LD)框架，并提出Direct-Gradient Pure-Tensor Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition (DG-HHD)。DG-HHD将吸引流参数化为切向投影张量网络，同时正交解耦非零环流，消除运行时autograd依赖。
AI.result: DG-HHD的Hodge机误差1.65e-17、收缩误差5.55e-17，实现1.84倍向量场与2.09倍RK45 rollout加速。在15臂对称Pareto基准中达58.67%峰值精度（较保守HHD绝对增益+25.94%），K=32时保持35.27%。迁移至SLM多跳因果推理时实现单调计算扩展(49.33%至51.56%)并抑制OOD漂移(cliff -0.66%)，全部30项Level 0确定性不变量通过认证。
AI.conclusion: 严格保守标量势梯度流可抑制长程漂移(cliff 3.40%)但峰值精度受限(32.73%)；无约束旋转流符号表达力高(82.33%)但漂移严重(36.87%)。DG-HHD通过几何对偶解决方案，在表达力、Lyapunov稳定性与计算效率三难问题间取得更优平衡，且不依赖运行时autograd。

title: NinaXander: Feasibility and Limits of Composing Frozen Language Models Across Architecture Families via a Shared Latent Space
summary: In this paper we propose NinaXander, a series of composed language models obtained by connecting layers of frozen language models from different architecture families with a single trained shared-latent adapter. A composed model runs the first layers of one model, converts the resulting intermediate representation once with the adapter, and then runs the remaining layers of the other model. Once the adapter is trained, several composed models that connect at different layers are obtained without retraining. Using the recurrent RWKV-4-Raven-7B and the Transformer-based Tulu-Pythia-6.9b, abbreviated as RWKV and Pythia, this study examines whether frozen models from different families can be recombined post hoc. The composed models answered multiple-choice questions, and those whose generations we examined produced syntactically well-formed text. The configuration that combines the first 5 layers of Pythia with the remaining 27 layers of RWKV reduced the Transformer key-value (KV) cache by 84.4% with accuracy not significantly different from that of RWKV alone. In multiple-choice accuracy, however, no composed model matched the parent model Pythia, and language-modeling performance decreased sharply on WikiText, a corpus of Wikipedia articles outside the training domain. The correspondence between intermediate representations was also obtained in one favorable case, with a shared tokenizer, the same depth, and the same hidden width, and does not show that the models share a general semantic space.

AI.tldr: 提出NinaXander组合语言模型，将不同架构家族的冻结模型层通过单个共享潜在适配器连接，一次训练即可获得多种组合。
AI.motivation: 探究来自不同架构家族的冻结模型是否能在事后被重新组合，并利用此方式降低推理成本（如KV缓存）。
AI.method: 用单个可训练的共享潜在适配器连接不同架构家族冻结模型的层：先运行一个模型的前若干层，适配器转换中间表示一次，再运行另一模型的剩余层；适配器训练一次后可在不同层位置组合而无需重训。实验用RWKV-4-Raven-7B（循环）与Tulu-Pythia-6.9b（Transformer），在多项选择题与WikiText上评估。
AI.result: 组合模型生成语法通顺；Pythia前5层+RWKV后27层的配置在准确率与单独RWKV无显著差异下减少84.4%的Transformer KV缓存；但无组合模型在选择题准确率上匹敌父模型Pythia，且在域外WikiText上语言建模性能急剧下降；仅在有共享分词器、相同深度和隐藏宽度的有利情形下获得中间表示对应，不足以证明模型共享通用语义空间。
AI.conclusion: 不同家族冻结模型可事后组合并带来效率收益，但组合模型难以匹配强父模型性能，且层间表示对应不代表共享通用语义空间。

title: Encore: Few-Shot Agentic Discovery of Manipulation Strategies
summary: Coding agents can now write, run, and debug programs with little human help. Robot tasks, however, are usually specified by a sentence that leaves out how to grasp, in what order to make contact, and what the result should look like, and an agent given only the sentence must find these details by trial and error. We introduce ENCORE, which gives the agent a few demonstrations as evidence to read rather than as training data. A deterministic builder distills each demonstration into a pack of multi-view keyframes, gripper events, frame strips, and the full trajectory. A coding agent studies the pack, writes a policy program against a fixed perception and action API, refines it iteratively over a few development rollouts, and freezes it before a sealed evaluation that never reveals the success signal. On LIBERO-PRO, the agent's first program already succeeds in half of the perturbed tasks with demonstrations and in one task without them, and the frozen programs outperform the strongest prior agentic system run with the same language model (96.3% against 89.3%). On RoboDojo tasks whose instructions leave the goal unstated, no program succeeds without demonstrations. ENCORE also runs on a real bimanual robot, learning cube handover and cup inversion from five demonstrations each.

AI.tldr: 提出 ENCORE：将少量演示作为"可读证据"而非训练数据，由确定性构建器压缩为多视角关键帧、夹爪事件与轨迹包，编码智能体据此编写策略程序并迭代精炼，冻结后在封闭评测中取得优于先前智能体系统的成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人任务通常仅以一句自然语言指令描述，缺失抓取方式、接触顺序与期望结果等关键细节，智能体只能靠反复试错推断。如何利用少量演示把隐含的任务细节显式传达给编码智能体，是本文要解决的问题。
AI.method: ENCORE 提供少量演示作为"证据"。确定性构建器将每条演示蒸馏为演示包，包含多视角关键帧、夹爪事件、帧条带与完整轨迹。编码智能体阅读该包，基于固定的感知与动作 API 编写策略程序，经少量开发回合迭代精炼，随后在封闭评测前冻结策略，评测过程不泄漏成功信号。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-PRO 上，智能体的首个程序在有演示时已成功完成半数的扰动任务，无演示时仅成功一个任务；冻结后的程序以 96.3% 的成功率超过使用同一语言模型的最强先前智能体系统（89.3%）。在目标未被明确表述的 RoboDojo 任务上，无演示时没有任何程序成功。ENCORE 亦在真实双臂机器人上运行，每条仅用五条演示即学会方块交接与杯子翻转。
AI.conclusion: 将演示作为结构化、可供阅读的证据，而非训练数据，能有效让编码智能体在缺乏任务细节的机器人场景中获得成功策略，并在仿真与真实双臂平台上得到验证。

title: Visual Anomaly Synthesis for Model Selection in Data Scarcity
summary: Defect detection systems for industrial condition monitoring can only be relied upon if they are validated, yet defective samples are rare and, for a specific asset, often nonexistent. We present a framework that synthesizes severity-graded defects on real non-defective images without any defect references for the target asset, that can be used for model selection and validation. A defect taxonomy for common failure modes is distilled from literature into prescriptive prompts at varying defect severities. Regions of interest are cropped from in defect-free images and edited with a pre-trained image generation model ("FLUX.2 [klein]"). Color-matching and blending are employed to improve structural coherence with the original image. Generations are filtered out by a scorer and by estimated detection difficulty. Model selection experiments on MVTecAD show image AUROC choice regret over model selection can be nearly halved compared to the best fixed model chosen with access to test data. Experiments show the need for severity-graded anomaly synthesis. A case study investigates the proposed method for in-situ monitoring of Pelton turbine runners in hydropower, where real defect images are rare and expensive to collect. A PatchCorebased anomaly detection model is fit on Pelton turbine images and selected and validated using synthetic images, showing strong detection performance (94 % correct detection at optimal threshold and AUROC 0.97). The model reliably detects moderate and advanced defects, while early-stage defects remain challenging, indicating the synthetic data meaningfully stresses detector sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 提出一个无需目标资产缺陷样本的框架，利用预训练生成模型在真实无缺陷图像上合成按严重程度分级的缺陷，用于工业缺陷检测模型的选型与验证，在MVTecAD与水电Pelton水轮机案例中验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 工业状态监测中的缺陷检测系统必须经过验证才可被信赖，但缺陷样本稀少，对特定资产往往完全不存在缺陷参考图像，导致模型选择与验证缺乏数据支撑。
AI.method: 从文献中归纳常见失效模式的缺陷分类体系，转化为不同严重程度的规范性提示词；在无缺陷图像中裁剪感兴趣区域，用预训练图像生成模型FLUX.2 [klein]进行编辑；通过颜色匹配与融合提升与原图的结构一致性；再用评分器与估计的检测难度过滤生成样本。
AI.result: 在MVTecAD上，相较使用测试数据选出的最佳固定模型，模型选择带来的图像AUROC选择后悔值可减少近一半；实验显示分级缺陷合成的必要性。Pelton水轮机案例中，PatchCore异常检测模型用合成图像选型与验证，达到94%最优阈值检出率与AUROC 0.97，可可靠检测中度与重度缺陷，早期缺陷仍具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 无需目标资产缺陷参考的严重程度分级缺陷合成框架，可为工业缺陷检测的模型选择与验证提供有效支持，并真实地压测检测器灵敏度，但早期缺陷检测仍是局限。

title: SemOPT: Fixing Semantic Errors in LLM-based Optimization Modeling via Reward-Guided Search
summary: Operations research supports decision-making in domains such as energy, economics, and healthcare. Solving operations research problems typically begins with optimization modeling, which translates a natural-language problem description into executable solver code. LLMs offer a promising way to automate this process, but they remain prone to errors. In practice, these errors can be divided into two categories: syntactic errors refer to solver code that fails to run successfully or is judged infeasible by the solver; semantic errors refer to solver code that successfully returns an objective value but violates the intent of the original problem. Since semantic errors do not trigger runtime failures, they are difficult to detect and rectify. To address this problem, we introduce SemOPT, a semantic-guided framework for correcting LLM-based optimization models. SemOPT combines a semantic reward model that distinguishes faithful math models from plausible but incorrect ones with an adaptive correction system that applies hierarchical reward-guided search over the modeling space. Experiments on seven optimization modeling benchmarks show that SemOPT establishes a new state of the art and achieves an average 7.6% accuracy improvement over the strongest baseline on complex datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出SemOPT，一个语义引导的优化建模纠错框架，通过语义奖励模型与自适应分层搜索修正LLM生成的求解器代码中的语义错误，在七个基准上实现新的SOTA，复杂数据集上平均提升7.6%。
AI.motivation: 运筹学问题求解通常从优化建模开始，即将自然语言问题描述转化为可执行的求解器代码。LLM有望自动化该过程，但仍易出错。错误分为两类：语法错误（代码无法运行或被求解器判定不可行）和语义错误（代码能返回目标值但违背原问题意图）。由于语义错误不触发运行时失败，难以检测与纠正，因此需要专门的方法来解决这一问题。
AI.method: SemOPT是一个语义引导的纠错框架，包含两个核心组件：（1）语义奖励模型，用于区分忠实的数学模型与看似合理但错误的模型；（2）自适应纠错系统，在建模空间上执行分层的、奖励引导的搜索。
AI.result: 在七个优化建模基准上进行实验，SemOPT建立了新的SOTA，并在复杂数据集上相较最强基线取得平均7.6%的准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: SemOPT通过语义引导的奖励模型与分层搜索机制，有效纠正LLM优化建模中的语义错误，显著提升建模准确率，证明了语义层面纠错在自动化运筹学建模中的价值。

title: Compiling Learning Problems into Adaptation Programs for Language Models
summary: Model adaptation is typically governed by a fixed recipe, even though different update programs can produce substantially different behavioral outcomes. We introduce adaptation compilation, which reframes where, how, and to what extent a model should adapt as a joint prediction and decision problem. Rather than searching over candidate programs anew for each learning episode, a compiler learns from prior adaptations to predict a vector-valued counterfactual response surface over candidate programs---their expected effects on acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation---and selects a program before adaptation begins. Because this predicted geometry captures multiple behavioral consequences rather than a single winner or scalar score, it can be reused under different downstream priorities without retraining. Across five learning types, preferred programs vary meaningfully across episodes, and this variation is predictable from pre-adaptation information. On Llama-3.1-8B, compiler-selected programs approach exhaustive search while outperforming global and objective-specific defaults. Replication on Gemma-2-9B preserves program heterogeneity and selection headroom, but shows that exploiting this headroom requires accounting for uncertainty when departing from strong defaults. Together, these results show that adaptation search can be amortized across related learning problems, turning prior adaptation experience into a basis for deciding how future learning should occur.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"适配编译"（adaptation compilation），将模型适配的位置、方式和程度重新表述为联合的预测与决策问题，通过学习代理（compiler）预测候选适配程序的向量化反事实响应面并预先选择程序，从而将适配搜索在不同学习任务间摊销。
AI.motivation: 传统模型适配通常遵循固定的"配方"，但不同的更新程序会产生显著不同的行为结果。逐个学习回合重新搜索候选程序成本高，因此需要一种能够复用历史适配经验、为未来学习决策提供依据的方法。
AI.method: 提出适配编译方法：代理不再对每个学习回合重新搜索候选程序，而是从先前的适配中学习，预测候选程序上的向量化反事实响应面——即其对获取（acquisition）、迁移（transfer）、有界性（boundedness）和保持性（preservation）的预期影响——并在适配开始前选择程序。由于该预测几何刻画了多种行为后果而非单一赢家或标量分数，因此可在不同下游优先级下复用而无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在五种学习类型上，首选程序在各回合间差异显著，且这种差异可从适配前信息中预测。在 Llama-3.1-8B 上，代理选择的程序接近穷举搜索的效果，同时优于全局和特定目标的默认设置。在 Gemma-2-9B 上的复现保留了程序异质性和选择空间，但表明利用该空间需要在偏离强默认设置时考虑不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明适配搜索可以跨相关学习问题摊销，将先前的适配经验转化为决定未来学习如何进行的基础。

title: Think Before You Score: Thinking Reward Model for Visual Generation
summary: Visual reward models are essential for evaluating and improving visual generation models, yet existing approaches typically map task conditions and candidate outputs directly to scalar rewards, leaving implicit what should be evaluated for each individual case. We introduce Think Before You Score, a paradigm that explicitly determines what matters for each case before judging how well the candidate performs. Following this principle, we propose the Thinking Reward Model (TRM), which formulates case-adaptive rubrics, performs rubric-guided assessment, and produces fine-grained pointwise rewards. We further observe that conventional pairwise preference optimization can induce score polarization, and introduce Pairwise Dual-Group Relative Policy Optimization (PD-GRPO), which leverages pairwise supervision to improve reward discrimination while preserving fine-grained pointwise scoring. Extensive experiments on image generation and editing reward-modeling benchmarks demonstrate that TRM achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source reward models while remaining highly competitive with proprietary alternatives. Moreover, using TRM as a reward for reinforcement learning consistently improves diverse visual generation models, demonstrating that its fine-grained, case-adaptive rewards translate into effective optimization signals for visual generation.

AI.tldr: 提出Thinking Reward Model (TRM)范式，先明确每个案例的评估要点（自适应评分标准），再进行细粒度打分，并用PD-GRPO解决分数极化问题，在视觉生成奖励建模上达到开源SOTA并有效用于强化学习。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉奖励模型将任务条件与候选输出直接映射为标量奖励，隐含了"每个案例究竟应评估什么"这一问题，缺乏案例自适应性，限制了奖励的细粒度与判别力。
AI.method: 提出"Think Before You Score"范式与TRM：为每个案例构造自适应评分标准（case-adaptive rubrics），进行标准引导的评估，输出细粒度的逐点奖励（pointwise rewards）；并针对常规成对偏好优化导致的分数极化问题，提出PD-GRPO，利用成对监督提升奖励判别力，同时保留细粒度逐点打分。
AI.result: 在图像生成与编辑的奖励建模基准上，TRM在开源奖励模型中达到state-of-the-art，并与专有模型高度竞争；作为强化学习奖励时，能稳定提升多种视觉生成模型的表现。
AI.conclusion: 显式、案例自适应的细粒度奖励可转化为有效的优化信号，验证了先确定"评什么"再判断"评多好"这一范式的有效性与通用性。

title: MG-Thinker: Bi-Axial Self-Reflection for Multi-Image Reasoning Grounding
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently delivered substantial gains in multimodal reasoning, opening a promising route for fine-grained visual perception. Yet for multi-image reasoning grounding (MRG), reasoning over real-world multi-image contexts toward pixel-precise localization, existing RL-based approaches overlook two characteristics intrinsic to this paradigm: a coarse-to-fine hierarchical reasoning pattern, and heterogeneously distributed task--sample difficulties. In this work, we present MG-Thinker, a post-training RL framework that advances a new MRG paradigm featuring such hierarchical reasoning, supported by a curated 25K MRG dataset with task-adaptive Chain-of-Thought (CoT) annotations that elicit multi-perspective evidence before conclusion. To remedy the heterogeneous task--sample difficulties, we further propose Bi-Axial DAPO (BiA-DAPO), which decomposes rollout advantages along an intra-group signal axis and an inter-group competence axis through two complementary mechanisms, both grounded on our defined candidate pool for stable group-level statistics. Extensive experiments show that MG-Thinker achieves state-of-the-art performance on multi-image reasoning grounding while consistently improving generalization across multi-image understanding and diverse multimodal benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MG-Thinker，一个面向"多图推理定位"（MRG）新范式的后训练强化学习框架，配合25K任务自适应CoT数据集与Bi-Axial DAPO算法，在MRG任务上取得SOTA并提升多图理解泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态推理RL方法忽视MRG范式的两个内在特性：(1)由粗到细的层次化推理模式；(2)任务与样本难度异构分布。这导致现有RL方法难以胜任在真实多图语境下进行像素级精确定位。
AI.method: 1) 提出MG-Thinker后训练RL框架，支持层次化推理的新MRG范式；2) 构建25K MRG数据集，含任务自适应CoT标注，引导模型在得出结论前先获取多视角证据；3) 针对难度的异构性提出Bi-Axial DAPO（BiA-DAPO），沿组内信号轴与组间能力轴分解rollout优势，两种机制均基于所定义的候选池以获取稳定的组级统计量。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MG-Thinker在多图推理定位任务上达到SOTA性能，同时在多图理解及多种多模态基准上持续提升泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将层次化推理与难度异构性纳入RL后训练设计，可有效推动多图推理定位，并带来跨任务的正向泛化收益。

title: Do-JEPA: From Masking to Intervention in Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models are trained to predict what happens next, so nothing in their objective separates what an action caused from what merely co-occurred with it. Object-masking models such as C-JEPA intervene on what the predictor can see; we intervene on what physically happens. From one saved simulator state we run the dynamics under an action $a$ and under a reference action $a_{\varnothing}$, and train the model to predict the difference $Δz=z^{a}-z^{a_{\varnothing}}$ between the two latent futures. The resulting objective, Do-JEPA, has an effect loss, a support loss (where the action enters), a propagation loss (where its effect travels) and invariance losses (what must not change). In a synthetic system with object-aligned variables, support supervision finds the directly intervened object in 99.95% of test cases, where a sparse action mask sends the action to a nuisance slot in every case, and response-onset supervision recovers the ring-shaped propagation graph (edge AUROC 0.975 vs. 0.624). From pixels, the effect loss beats a control trained on exactly the same data: it lowers latent effect error by 28.4% on an end-to-end LeWM model and physical effect error by 13.5% when trained and tested on natural action sequences, and on three independently generated CausalWorld benchmarks it lowers responsive effect error by about 20% under physics shifts and the latent context sensitivity of predicted effects by 66%. Trained from scratch it costs factual accuracy; fine-tuning an existing model with it removes this cost. Together, these results show that intervening on the world, rather than on what the model sees, helps latent world models predict what their actions cause.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Do-JEPA，通过对物理世界施加干预（比较动作a与参考动作a∅下的潜在未来之差Δz）来训练潜在世界模型，使其区分动作的因果效应与单纯共现，显著提升效应预测的准确性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在世界模型的训练目标是预测"下一步发生什么"，其目标函数无法区分"由动作引起"的变化与"仅仅与动作共现"的变化。像C-JEPA这类对象掩码方法干预的是预测器"能看到什么"，而非物理上"实际发生了什么"，因此未能从根本上解决因果归因问题。作者希望直接对物理世界进行干预，从而让模型学会识别动作的真实因果效应。
AI.method: 从同一保存的模拟器状态出发，分别在动作a与参考动作a∅下运行动力学，训练模型预测两个潜在未来之差Δz=z^a−z^{a∅}。所得目标Do-JEPA包含：effect loss（效应损失）、support loss（动作进入位置的支撑损失）、propagation loss（效应传播损失）以及invariance losses（不应变化之处的不变性损失）。
AI.result: 在对象对齐变量的合成系统中，支撑监督在99.95%的测试案例中找到被直接干预的对象，而稀疏动作掩码在所有案例中都把动作错误地送到无关槽位；响应起始监督能恢复环形传播图（边AUROC 0.975 vs. 0.624）。从像素输入看，效应损失优于在完全相同数据上训练的对照模型：端到端LeWM模型的潜在效应误差降低28.4%，在自然动作序列上训练测试时物理效应误差降低13.5%；在三个独立生成的CausalWorld基准上，物理偏移下响应效应误差降低约20%，预测效应的潜在上下文敏感性降低66%。从头训练会损害事实准确性，而对已有模型微调则可消除该代价。
AI.conclusion: 对世界本身（而非模型所见）进行干预，能帮助潜在世界模型更准确地预测其动作所造成的后果，实现更强的因果归因与泛化能力。

title: Anatomy-Aware Prediction of Bronchoscopic Accessibility from 3D CT
summary: Pre-operative planning for bronchoscopy is critical for the diagnosis of lung lesions. Current accessibility assessment relies on subjective manual inspection of CT scans, which is time-consuming and prone to inter-observer variability. In this paper, we formalize bronchoscopy accessibility prediction as a novel supervised learning task and present the first end-to-end framework to address it. We propose an Anatomy-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model that integrates specialized modules: a CT Expert for local morphological features, a Lobe Expert for anatomical priors, and a Path Geometry Expert that encodes the sequential constraints of the bronchial tree. To support this task, we curated the first clinical dataset of 438 cases with pre-operative CT scans and documented procedural outcomes. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves an AUROC of 0.8052, significantly outperforming both state-of-the-art baselines and experienced human experts. This work establishes a new benchmark for computer-aided interventional planning in pulmonary medicine. Our data and code will be publicly available at https://nubagcilab.github.io/BronchoAccess/.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将支气管镜可及性预测形式化为有监督学习任务，提出解剖感知混合专家（MoE）模型，构建首个438例临床数据集，AUROC达0.8052，显著优于SOTA基线与人类专家。
AI.motivation: 支气管镜检查的术前规划对肺部病灶诊断至关重要。当前的可及性评估依赖医生对CT扫描的主观人工判读，既耗时又存在观察者间差异，缺乏客观、自动化的量化手段。
AI.method: 将支气管镜可及性预测定义为一个新的有监督学习任务，并提出首个端到端框架。模型采用解剖感知混合专家（MoE）结构，集成三个专门模块：CT专家提取局部形态特征，肺叶专家引入解剖先验，路径几何专家编码支气管树的序列约束。同时构建首个包含438例术前CT与记录手术结局的临床数据集。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法取得0.8052的AUROC，显著优于当前最先进的基线方法以及经验丰富的人类专家。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为肺部医学的计算机辅助介入规划建立了新的基准，数据与代码将公开于 https://nubagcilab.github.io/BronchoAccess/。

title: Multi-task learning for the automatic grading of enlarged perivascular space burden using MRI
summary: Enlarged perivascular spaces (PVS) visible in brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are increasingly thought to be linked to poor brain health. PVS are elongated structures of less than 3 mm in diameter and can be numerous. To reflect the incidence of PVS, radiologists visually score their burden following a clinical grading scale - a task that would benefit from automation to accelerate analyses and overcome the influence of inter-observer differences. We developed and evaluated methods for training machine learning models to score PVS incidence in the basal ganglia (BG) and centrum semiovale (CSO) leveraging the Potters/Wardlaw scale. The novelty in our work lies in the use of imperfect, semi-automatically generated "silver-standard" PVS segmentation masks during training, in addition to PVS radiological scores. We comparatively evaluated a conditional convolutional neural network (CNN) which accepts PVS masks as an extra input channel, a multi-task CNN which performs both PVS segmentation and scoring, and a logistic regression model which utilises features derived from PVS masks to predict PVS scores. Multi-task learning was the most effective method, achieving a mean average precision of 64.08% compared to 60.22% for the conditional CNN, 52.11% for a baseline CNN trained only to predict PVS scores, and 49.32% for the logistic regression model. The multi-task model showed an ability to localise individual PVS not shown by the other CNNs, and behaved in a probabilistically sensible way, predicting with lower confidence on inherently harder classes. Age, sex, hypertension status, white matter hyperintensity volume, and ischaemic stroke lesion status were shown to be associated with the multi-task model's PVS score predictions and the ground truth in a similar way.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了多种机器学习方法，利用不完美的"银标准"血管周围间隙（PVS）分割掩膜和放射学评分来预测基底节与半卵圆中心的PVS负荷。多任务CNN（同时进行分割与评分）效果最佳，平均精度达64.08%。
AI.motivation: 脑MRI中扩大的血管周围间隙（PVS）与脑健康不良相关，放射科医生依靠临床分级量表（Potters/Wardlaw量表）进行视觉评分，但该过程耗时且存在观察者间差异，亟需自动化方法以加速分析并减少主观性影响。
AI.method: 在训练中除了使用PVS放射学评分外，还引入半自动生成的不完美"银标准"PVS分割掩膜。对比评估了三种模型：（1）以PVS掩膜作为额外输入通道的条件CNN；（2）同时执行PVS分割与评分的多任务CNN；（3）利用PVS掩膜特征进行评分预测的逻辑回归模型。
AI.result: 多任务学习最有效，平均精度（mAP）为64.08%，高于条件CNN（60.22%）、仅预测评分的基线CNN（52.11%）和逻辑回归模型（49.32%）。多任务模型还能定位单个PVS，且预测置信度合理（对较难类别置信度更低）。年龄、性别、高血压状态、白质高信号体积及缺血性卒中病灶状态与多任务模型预测评分和真实标签的关联方式相似。
AI.conclusion: 利用不完美的银标准分割掩膜进行多任务学习可有效提升PVS自动评分的性能，优于单任务及条件模型，且其预测与临床相关因素的关系同真实标签一致，表明该自动化方法具有临床可行性。

title: BeatDance: Generating Beat-Consistent 3D Dance with Hierarchical Spatial-Temporal Modeling
summary: Generating realistic 3D dance from music is a challenging task that requires accurate synchronization with musical rhythms while capturing the spatial complexity of human motion. Although existing methods can generate physically plausible dance motions, they often struggle to achieve precise alignment with music, such as the beat. To address this limitation, we propose a novel diffusion-based framework, BeatDance, with two components: 1) We present a Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA) module, which first disentangles the learning of human pose and temporal dynamics. A hierarchical structure is then employed to capture both short-term and long-term dependencies, thereby enhancing spatial-temporal modeling. 2) We adopt cycle-consistent learning by introducing an auxiliary dance-to-music module. During training, discrepancies between the reconstructed and original music induce a stronger loss signal, effectively encouraging the consistency property between the music and dance motion. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms recent competitive methods on two benchmark datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BeatDance，一种基于扩散模型的音乐驱动3D舞蹈生成框架，通过层次解耦注意力与循环一致性学习提升音乐-动作对齐精度，在两个基准数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 从音乐生成真实3D舞蹈需兼顾与音乐节奏的精确同步以及人体运动的时空复杂性。现有方法虽能生成物理合理的舞蹈动作，但难以实现与音乐（如节拍）的精准对齐。
AI.method: 提出基于扩散的框架BeatDance，包含两个组件：(1) 层次解耦注意力（HDA）模块，先将人体姿态与时间动态的学习解耦，再通过层次结构捕获短期与长期依赖，增强时空建模；(2) 采用循环一致性学习，引入辅助的dance-to-music模块，训练时重建音乐与原始音乐的差异产生更强的损失信号，促使音乐与舞蹈动作保持一致。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，所提方法优于近期竞争性方法。
AI.conclusion: BeatDance通过HDA与循环一致性学习有效改善了音乐驱动舞蹈生成的节奏对齐与时空建模能力，验证了框架的有效性。

title: Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting for Consistent Long-Form Video Generation
summary: While recent video foundation models excel at generating high-quality short videos, long-form video generation remains a critical challenge, where a major bottleneck lies in conditioning independently generated shots to preserve consistent characters, scenes, and objects throughout a story. Existing training-free approaches typically condition target shots using retrieved historical visuals. However, these references often suffer from severe informational mismatch, either introducing irrelevant contextual redundancy or failing to provide the full combination of required elements for the target shot. To resolve this, we present Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting, an agentic framework that strategically aggregates a compact set of mutually supportive historical references to achieve complete and targeted conditioning for long-form video generation without retraining or modifying the underlying generator. Specifically, our framework explicitly models the visual elements required by each target shot by parsing the narrative script into a text-grounded visual element registry that tracks characters, objects, scenes, and their shot-level states. A VLM-annotated keyframe library further maps these elements to past visual observations. Guided by the required elements, our agent retrieves complementary references that maximize target-element coverage while minimizing historical noise. Finally, the retrieved references, structured element states, and grounding instructions are assembled into a unified prompt for the frozen video generator. This element-aware process provides comprehensive conditioning while remaining fully interpretable. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on multi-shot story generation demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms recent-frame, memory-based, and entity-level retrieval baselines in cross-shot consistency and text-controllability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting（互补检索增强提示）框架，一种智能体式、免训练的方法，通过聚合互补的历史参考帧为长视频生成提供完整且精准的条件控制。
AI.motivation: 长视频生成的核心瓶颈在于独立生成镜头间难以保持角色、场景和物体的一致性。现有免训练方法通常用检索到的历史视觉帧作为参考，但这些参考存在严重的信息不匹配：要么引入无关的上下文冗余，要么无法提供目标镜头所需的完整元素组合。
AI.method: 将叙事脚本解析为文本接地的视觉元素注册表，追踪角色、物体、场景及其镜头级状态；构建VLM标注的关键帧库，将元素映射到历史视觉观测；智能体据此检索互补参考，最大化目标元素覆盖并最小化历史噪声；最后将检索参考、结构化元素状态与接地指令组装为统一提示，输入冻结的视频生成器。整个过程无需重训练或修改底层生成器。
AI.result: 在多镜头故事生成的定量与定性评估中，该方法在跨镜头一致性和文本可控性上持续优于最近帧检索、基于记忆检索和实体级检索等基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过元素感知的互补检索增强提示，可在不修改生成器的前提下实现完整、可解释的长视频条件控制，有效提升跨镜头一致性与可控性。

title: Look What You Made Us Cluster: Hate Narrative Extraction from Reddit Discourse
summary: Narrative extraction allows us to identify online hate narratives, supporting the construction of rigorous detection systems. Existing computational approaches, however, are limited in precision as they rely on semantic representations, which tend to capture only surface-level meaning. To detect more precise and interpretable narratives, we present an extraction pipeline that represents narratives as entity-evaluation pairs. Narratives are extracted using a Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning process that extends Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis, identifying the aspect, classifying its judgement type as the basis for evaluation, and deriving the evaluation accordingly. Extracted narratives are then clustered using Leiden, following which clusters are resolved to an intended level of granularity through an LLM-guided refinement process. We illustrate this narrative pipeline with English Reddit comments from 2024 that criticize Taylor Swift, analyzing a representative cluster that exhibits hate speech patterns to demonstrate its interpretive value.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将在线仇恨叙事表示为"实体-评价"对，利用大语言模型推理流程（扩展方面级情感分析）抽取叙事，再通过Leiden聚类与LLM引导的细化获得指定粒度的叙事簇，并以2024年英文Reddit中批评Taylor Swift的评论为例展示方法的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有在线仇恨叙事抽取的计算方法多依赖语义表示，只能捕捉表层含义，导致精度不足，难以支撑严格、可解释的检测系统，因此需要更精确、可解释的叙事表示与抽取方法。
AI.method: 提出一个叙事抽取流水线：以"实体-评价"对表示叙事；用LLM推理过程扩展方面级情感分析（ABSA），依次识别方面、判定其评判类型作为评价依据、并据此推导评价；随后用Leiden算法对抽取的叙事聚类，并通过LLM引导的细化过程将簇解析到目标粒度。
AI.result: 以2024年英文Reddit中批评Taylor Swift的评论为案例，验证了流水线的可行性，并分析了其中一个表现仇恨言论模式的代表性簇，展示其可解释价值。
AI.conclusion: 将叙事建模为实体-评价对并结合LLM推理、Leiden聚类与LLM引导细化，可获得更精确、可解释的仇恨叙事表示，有助于构建更严格的在线仇恨叙事检测系统。

title: LazySloth: Bounded LLM-based Lazy Tree Search for Fast Long Video Comprehension
comment: Under review at conference. Preprints allowed when under review
summary: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promising results in long-video understanding due to the rich semantic information they can capture. However, most methods focus on coarse captioning of extracted image frames that are computationally inefficient and require models with large context windows. While past work has explored efficient methods through multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), they rely on lossy embeddings that lose temporal context and fine-grained detail. Few works to date have investigated how VLM-based query-relevant information retrieval can be optimized. We introduce LazySloth, an efficient tree-based search method that speeds up video comprehension and retrieval tasks 2.9-8.3x (compared to existing agentic methods) through bounded captioning of portions of the video considered irrelevant by a VLM of the video. Compared to contemporary specialized video-understanding VLMs and RAG-based methods, LazySloth achieved similar or better final task accuracy across two recent open-source base VLMs--Gemma 4 31B and Qwen3.6 27B--across four benchmarks. LazySloth reduced the gap between the base open-source model and a closed-source model, GPT-4o. Ablations showed that replacing VLM scene understanding with CLIP-based retrieval cost 8.8-19.9% in accuracy, while lazy tree construction matches eager construction at a fraction of the captioning cost. With LazySloth, we demonstrate the possibility of faster long-video comprehension without substantial loss in performance.

AI.tldr: LazySloth：基于树搜索的高效长视频理解与检索方法，通过惰性、有界字幕生成将速度提升 2.9–8.3 倍，并在多个基准上保持或超越专用视频 VLM 与 RAG 方法。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频理解方法多依赖对抽取帧进行粗粒度字幕生成，计算低效且需大上下文窗口；基于多模态 RAG 的高效方法又依赖有损嵌入，丢失时序上下文与细粒度信息；且少有工作研究如何优化基于 VLM 的查询相关信息检索。
AI.method: 提出 LazySloth：一种高效的树状搜索方法。由 VLM 判断视频中"不相关"的部分，对其仅生成有界（受限）字幕，从而避免对所有片段做昂贵字幕生成；采用惰性树构建（lazy tree construction）以低字幕成本逼近积极构建的效果。
AI.result: 在 Gemma 4 31B 与 Qwen3.6 27B 两个开源基座 VLM 上、四个基准中取得与专用视频理解 VLM 及 RAG 方法相当或更优的准确率，并将速度提升 2.9–8.3 倍；缩小了与闭源模型 GPT-4o 的差距。消融显示：以 CLIP 检索替代 VLM 场景理解会损失 8.8–19.9% 准确率。
AI.conclusion: LazySloth 证明可在性能基本无损的前提下实现更快长视频理解，惰性树构建在极低字幕成本下达到与积极构建相当的检索效果。

title: Retrospective Open-Vocabulary Memory for Long-Term Object Search
summary: Long-term object search requires learning where objects usually appear from repeated but uneven observations of a changing environment. We formulate retrospective open-vocabulary memory as probabilistic inference from censored observations, where the key idea is to reason with evidence per opportunity: a detection or non-detection should influence belief only in proportion to the robot's opportunity to observe the corresponding location. We introduce ECROM, which uses this principle to estimate long-term prevalence for concepts specified only at query time and converts the resulting belief directly into an active-search prior. To evaluate this problem, we introduce a controlled long-term benchmark in ten HM3D homes that independently varies object placement and observation opportunity across repeated traversals. ECROM improves support-level AP on held-out queries by 4.5 points and search SPL by 4.2 points over the strongest competing memory in each metric. The benchmark, dataset, and code will be open-sourced. Project page: https://jiaming.im/ecrom/

AI.tldr: 提出ECROM方法，将长期开放词汇记忆建模为删失观测下的概率推断，按"观测机会"加权证据，估计长期物体出现先验并用于主动搜索。
AI.motivation: 长期物体搜索需要从重复但不均匀的环境观测中学习物体常见位置。核心难点在于：观测并非均匀覆盖，未检测到物体可能只是因为机器人没机会看到该位置，而非物体不存在，因此需要解决观测机会不均带来的偏置。
AI.method: 将回溯式开放词汇记忆形式化为删失观测下的概率推断，核心原则是按机会加权证据：一次检测或未检测对信念的影响应与机器人在该位置获得观测的机会成比例。基于此提出ECROM，对仅在查询时指定的概念估计长期出现概率，并将所得信念直接转换为主动搜索先验。
AI.result: 在10个HM3D家庭上构建可控长期基准，独立变化物体摆放与重复遍历中的观测机会。ECROM在留存查询上将support-level AP提升4.5个点，搜索SPL提升4.2个点，均优于各自指标下最强的对比记忆方法。
AI.conclusion: 按观测机会加权证据的建模原则能有效处理不均匀长期观测，提升开放词汇物体搜索的定位与搜索效率。作者将开基准、数据集与代码。

title: Learning to Retrieve Missing Evidence for Long-Term Memory QA
summary: Long-term memory enables language models to use past interactions in future conversations. However, evidence needed to answer a question may be scattered across distant turns, while the question itself omits clues needed to locate it. Retrieved facts can reveal these clues, motivating retrieval decisions conditioned on evidence already found. We introduce MERA (Missing-Evidence Retrieval Augmentation), which separates globally searchable memory from a question-specific evidence state. Verified evidence guides subsequent retrieval without restricting access to the global memory. We train a lightweight planner through reinforcement learning, rewarding queries that recover previously missing evidence. MERA achieves strong answer accuracy across Qwen3-30B and GPT-4o-mini backbones. With Qwen3-30B for evidence processing and answer generation, the trained 0.6B planner achieves 77.40% accuracy on LoCoMo and 71.29% on LongMemEval-S, exceeding a 30B planner without retrieval-grounded training by 4.10% and 3.96%, respectively. On LoCoMo, later retrieval rounds increase cumulative evidence recall from 55.5% to 80.5%.

AI.tldr: MERA提出分离全局可检索记忆与问题特定证据状态的长时记忆检索增强方法，用强化学习训练轻量规划器，以已找到的证据引导后续检索，显著提升长对话问答准确率。
AI.motivation: 长时记忆使语言模型能利用过往交互，但回答所需证据常分散在相隔很远的对话轮次中，且问题本身缺少定位线索。已检索到的事实可揭示这些线索，因此检索决策应基于已发现的证据进行条件化。
AI.method: 提出MERA（Missing-Evidence Retrieval Augmentation）：将全局可检索记忆与问题特定的证据状态分离；用已验证证据引导后续检索，同时不限制对全局记忆的访问；通过强化学习训练一个轻量规划器，奖励能够找回此前缺失证据的查询。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-30B和GPT-4o-mini骨干上均取得较强答案准确率。以Qwen3-30B进行证据处理与答案生成时，训练后的0.6B规划器在LoCoMo上达77.40%、LongMemEval-S上达71.29%，分别超过未进行检索接地训练的30B规划器4.10%和3.96%。在LoCoMo上，后续检索轮次将累计证据召回率从55.5%提升至80.5%。
AI.conclusion: 证据条件化的检索规划能有效弥补问题线索缺失，轻量强化学习规划器可超越更大规模但未做检索接地训练的规划器，并通过多轮检索显著提升累计证据召回率。

title: From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own reasoning trajectories using feedback from a stronger teacher. Teacher interventions can improve these trajectories, but also change the distribution on which the student learns. Our controlled studies show that rollout quality alone is an incomplete criterion for allocating teacher guidance. Deeper intervention yields diminishing gains in rollout accuracy while increasing off-policy load. In a training probe with a restricted rollout horizon, peak student accuracy and performance retention favor different intervention strengths. The preferred intervention depth and placement also vary across benchmarks. These findings motivate MAESTRO, which uses local policy disagreement to jointly adapt when the teacher takes over and how long it generates. Its {policy disagreement score} combines teacher-weighted candidate coverage with local distribution similarity and is aggregated within reasoning paragraphs. Across eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks, MAESTRO achieves the highest macro-average accuracy among the compared methods for both 0.6B and 1.7B Qwen3 students, with the 1.7B student leading on every benchmark. MAESTRO also reduces average training response length by 67.3\% relative to standard OPD. The code is available at https://github.com/yhao-wang/MAESTRO.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究on-policy distillation中教师干预的深度与位置问题，提出MAESTRO方法，通过局部策略分歧自适应决定教师接管时机与生成长度，在八个数学推理基准上取得最高宏平均准确率，并将平均训练响应长度减少67.3%。
AI.motivation: On-policy distillation中学生基于自身推理轨迹接受更强教师的反馈。教师干预可改善轨迹质量，但同时改变学生学习所依据的分布。作者发现仅用rollout质量作为分配教师指导的标准并不充分，需系统研究干预深度与位置的影响。
AI.method: 通过控制实验研究干预深度的影响：更深的干预在rollout准确率上收益递减，却增加off-policy负荷；在受限rollout训练探针中，峰值学生准确率与性能保持偏好不同的干预强度，且最优干预深度与位置因基准而异。据此提出MAESTRO，利用局部策略分歧分数联合自适应教师接管时机与生成时长；该分数结合教师加权的候选覆盖率与局部分布相似度，并在推理段落内聚合。
AI.result: 在八个数学推理基准上，MAESTRO在0.6B与1.7B Qwen3学生上均取得对比方法中最高的宏平均准确率，1.7B学生在每个基准上均领先；相对标准OPD，平均训练响应长度减少67.3%。
AI.conclusion: 教师指导的分配不应仅以rollout质量为依据；基于局部策略分歧自适应控制干预深度与位置，能在提升推理准确率与保持性能的同时显著降低训练响应长度。代码已开源。

title: Hierarchical Compression of Vision-Language Model Benchmarks
summary: Thorough evaluation of vision-language models (VLMs) has become prohibitively expensive, as benchmarks span an ever-broader spectrum of capabilities and new models arrive at a relentless pace. Benchmark compression methods that preserve model rankings at a fraction of the cost are well studied for language models, but for VLMs the question remains under-explored. We present PRIMEBench (Pruning Redundant Items for Multimodal Evaluation), a vision-aware hierarchical benchmark compression framework that substantially reduces evaluation cost while preserving model rankings. This hierarchical framework operates in four stages: data cleaning to remove items answerable without the image and all-correct items, category representative selection to pick one benchmark per capability category, item pruning with Vision-Aware Variance (VAW), and category-count pruning. VAW combines inter-model variance with a vision-dependence score computed from multimodal embeddings alone, while encouraging coverage of diverse items within each benchmark. On models held out from item selection, it has the highest mean fidelity at the released 5% retention. The hierarchical design lets practitioners stop at any stage to match their compute budget; the released suite removes over 97% of items while preserving model rankings. Beyond compression, our analyses show how VLM evaluation behaves as model panels grow and evolve, providing guidance for designing future benchmarks that are more efficient, robust to model turnover, and explicit about the limits of evaluation-side pruning.

AI.tldr: 提出PRIMEBench，一种面向视觉语言模型（VLM）的视觉感知分层基准压缩框架，通过四阶段流水线在保留模型排名的前提下大幅降低评测成本，释放套件可移除超过97%的评测项。
AI.motivation: VLM评测成本随能力维度扩展与新模型快速迭代而变得极高；基准压缩在语言模型中已有成熟研究，但在VLM领域仍处于探索不足的状态，缺少兼顾视觉特性的压缩方法。
AI.method: PRIMEBench为视觉感知的分层压缩框架，包含四个阶段：(1)数据清洗，剔除无需图像即可作答的项与全对项；(2)类别代表选择，为每个能力类别挑选一个基准；(3)基于视觉感知方差（VAW）的条目剪枝，VAW融合模型间方差与仅由多模态嵌入计算的视觉依赖分数，并鼓励覆盖每基准内的多样条目；(4)类别计数剪枝。分层设计允许使用者在任意阶段停止以匹配算力预算。
AI.result: 在未参与条目选择的留出模型上，PRIMEBench在公开的5%保留率下取得最高的平均保真度；释放套件在保留模型排名的同时移除超过97%的评测项。
AI.conclusion: 除压缩效果外，分析还揭示了VLM评测在模型面板规模增长与更替时的行为规律，为设计更高效、对模型更替更鲁棒、并明确评测侧剪枝边界的未来基准提供了指导。

title: Raw Imagery Impacting Your AI: Should You Care?
summary: Onboard AI is gaining interest for space applications such as vessel, wildfire, and cloud detection, where real-time processing can improve mission reactivity and reduce downlink needs. However, onboard models may operate on raw or minimally processed imagery rather than on restored ground products. This study evaluates how image degradation affects object detection by varying Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), Modulation Transfer Function (MTF) at Nyquist, and Ground Sampling Distance (GSD). Controlled degradations are applied to Very High Resolution Maxar imagery, and three lightweight detectors, YOLOv5s, YOLOX-S, and NanoDet, are evaluated on the resulting operating points. The results show that the impact of image quality depends on the degradation mechanism, and that increasing degradation does not necessarily lead to a proportional decrease in vessel detection performance. GSD produces the most consistent performance shift, while MTF and SNR effects depend more on the model and resolution. Severe combinations of blur and noise produce the largest losses. These results provide task-level information that can support sensor, processing, and AI trade-offs for future onboard systems.

AI.tldr: 本文评估图像退化（SNR、Nyquist处MTF、GSD）对星载目标检测的影响，用Maxar甚高分辨率影像对YOLOv5s、YOLOX-S、NanoDet三种轻量检测器测试，发现退化影响依赖退化机制，GSD影响最稳定。
AI.motivation: 星载AI在船只、野火、云检测等空间应用中受到关注，实时处理可提升任务响应速度并减少下传需求。但星载模型通常处理原始或最低限度处理的影像，而非地面复原产品，因此需要明确图像退化如何影响目标检测性能，以支持传感器、处理链与AI的权衡设计。
AI.method: 对甚高分辨率Maxar影像施加受控退化，变化信噪比（SNR）、Nyquist频率处的调制传递函数（MTF）和地面采样距离（GSD）；在生成的不同工作点上评估YOLOv5s、YOLOX-S和NanoDet三种轻量级检测器的船只检测性能。
AI.result: 图像质量的影响取决于具体退化机制，退化加剧并不必然导致船只检测性能成比例下降。GSD造成最一致的性能变化；MTF与SNR的影响更依赖模型和分辨率；模糊与噪声的严重组合造成最大性能损失。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了任务级信息，可用于支撑未来星载系统的传感器、处理与AI之间的权衡决策。

title: Principled MAP estimation for inverse problems: bridging the gap between convergence and performance
summary: Pretrained denoisers provide a powerful way to incorporate image priors into restoration algorithms. Plug-and-Play and RED approaches exploit fixed-noise-level denoisers within first-order optimization schemes, with convergence guarantees, but often struggle to achieve high-quality reconstruction on severely ill-posed inverse problems. In contrast, recent state-of-the-art approaches leverage denoisers derived from flow- or diffusion-based generative models and evaluate them along a sequence of decreasing noise levels. While these methods achieve strong empirical performance, their convergence theory remains limited. In this paper, we bridge this gap by specifically designing an algorithm that combines denoisers at decreasing noise levels with a schedule tailored to ensure convergence. From a Bayesian perspective, we prove that our method converges to a $\textit{Maximum a Posteriori}$ (MAP) estimate, under suitable assumptions. Subsequently, we apply our method to various ill-posed inverse problems and show that it surpasses convergent methods while competing with state-of-the-art empirical ones.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种结合递减噪声级去噪器与专门调度策略的算法，在贝叶斯框架下证明其收敛到MAP估计，并在严重病态逆问题中兼顾收敛性与高质量重建。
AI.motivation: 现有Plug-and-Play与RED方法虽有收敛保证，但使用固定噪声级去噪器，在严重病态逆问题上重建质量不足；而基于流/扩散生成模型、采用递减噪声级去噪器的方法虽经验表现优异，却缺乏收敛理论。论文旨在弥合这一理论与实践之间的差距。
AI.method: 设计一种算法，将递减噪声级下的去噪器与一个专门为收敛性定制的调度策略相结合；从贝叶斯视角在适当假设下进行理论分析，证明算法收敛到最大后验（MAP）估计。
AI.result: 在多种病态逆问题上的实验表明，该方法优于具有收敛保证的方法，并且与当前最先进的经验方法具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过为递减噪声级去噪器设计确保收敛的调度，论文在保持理论收敛保证（收敛至MAP估计）的同时实现了高质量重建，成功连接了收敛性理论与强经验性能。

title: RawVLA: Embodied Neural Image Signal Processor For Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models typically operate on RGB images produced by a fixed camera image signal processor (ISP), leaving the imaging pipeline outside the learning and evaluation loop. We systematically examine the consequences of this overlooked design choice across five fundamental ISP dimensions: gain, sensor noise, chromatic response, tonal response, and bit depth. Our analysis reveals that RAW-to-RGB processing materially shapes both action prediction and manipulation success, with different ISP dimensions exerting substantially different effects. Guided by these findings, we introduce RawVLA, a streaming neural ISP that adaptively renders RAW observations for frozen VLA policies while concentrating its capacity on the imaging factors relevant to embodied behavior. We further present RawVLA-Bench, a RAW-domain manipulation benchmark to expose image processing as an explicit evaluation variable across clean and adverse acquisition conditions. Experiments on RawVLA-Bench show that RawVLA preserves performance under standard conditions while substantially improving robustness under degraded imaging, establishing adaptive RAW processing as an effective interface between physical cameras and embodied policies.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出VLA模型依赖固定ISP的RGB图像，忽视了成像管线对具身策略的影响；系统分析了ISP五个维度的影响，并提出可自适应处理RAW的流式神经ISP（RawVLA）及RAW域基准RawVLA-Bench，证明自适应RAW处理能提升退化成像下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型通常直接使用固定相机ISP输出的RGB图像，将成像管线排除在学习与评测环路之外。作者认为这一被忽视的设计选择会实质影响动作预测与操作成功率，因此有必要系统考察ISP各维度的影响，并将图像处理作为显式评测变量。
AI.method: 作者系统分析五个基础ISP维度（增益、传感器噪声、色度响应、色调响应、位深）对VLA行为的影响；在此基础上提出RawVLA——一种流式神经ISP，在冻结的VLA策略前自适应地将RAW观测渲染为合适输入，并将容量集中于与具身行为相关的成像因素；同时构建RAW域操作基准RawVLA-Bench，在干净与恶劣采集条件下评测图像处理变量。
AI.result: 分析表明RAW到RGB的处理会实质性影响动作预测与操作成功率，且不同ISP维度的影响差异显著。在RawVLA-Bench上，RawVLA在标准条件下保持性能，同时在成像退化条件下显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 自适应RAW处理可作为物理相机与具身策略之间的有效接口，成像管线应被纳入VLA的学习与评测环路。

title: E-MoE: Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts for Non-Factorized Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate sequences by progressively unmasking several tokens per denoising step, but their reverse process is typically factorized over positions, limiting sample quality in the few-step regime where diffusion's speed advantage over autoregressive decoding matters most. A recent line of work introduces a continuous Gaussian latent, trained as a variational autoencoder, to capture correlations across positions, but such approaches are prone to posterior collapse, where the latent is silently ignored. We propose Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts (E-MoE), which builds the reverse process as a mixture of factorized distributions over a discrete shared latent given by the expert-routing decisions of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) backbone, without increasing active parameters over the factorized baseline. Across synthetic multi-modal benchmarks, binarized MNIST, and LM1B, E-MoE improves few-step generation over factorized baselines.

AI.tldr: E-MoE 用 MoE 路由决策作为离散共享隐变量，把 MDM 的反向过程建模为多个因式分解分布的混合，在不增加激活参数的前提下提升少步生成质量。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散模型（MDM）逐步解掩多个 token，但其反向过程通常按位置因式分解，缺乏跨位置相关性建模，在少步采样（diffusion 相对自回归的主要速度优势区间）下样本质量受限。已有工作引入连续高斯隐变量（VAE 式）来捕获位置间相关性，但容易出现后验坍缩，隐变量被模型静默忽略。
AI.method: 提出 Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts（E-MoE）：以 Mixture-of-Experts 主干网络的路由决策作为离散共享隐变量，将反向过程构建为该隐变量条件下的多个因式分解分布之混合。该设计避免引入额外连续隐变量，因而规避后验坍缩，且相比因式分解基线不增加激活参数量。
AI.result: 在合成多模态基准、二值化 MNIST 和 LM1B 上，E-MoE 相比因式分解基线均改善了少步生成表现。
AI.conclusion: 用 MoE 路由构成的离散隐变量可为 MDM 提供有效的跨位置相关性建模，在少步生成场景下优于因式分解基线，同时保持参数效率。

title: Weeding Out Bad Seeds: Initial-Noise-Robust Unlearning for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: Machine unlearning has emerged as a critical post-hoc safety measure to erase sensitive concepts from Text-to-Image (T2I) models without prohibitive retraining. However, we reveal that current state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches are brittle due to a severe lack of robustness to noise initialization. We call this phenomenon ``probabilistic forgetting'': suppressed concepts re-emerge under specific random initial noise conditions, despite appearing unlearned on other initializations. We trace this failure to the misalignment between standard Gaussian sampling during unlearning and the unlearning objective. Since the target concept manifests only in specific initial noise regions throughout the unlearning phase, uniform random sampling yields sparse, uninformative gradient updates that fail to drive robust erasure. To overcome this issue, we propose an adaptive, concept-conditioned sampling strategy that dynamically concentrates gradient updates on regions where the target concept manifests, down-weighting uninformative areas. We integrate our framework with six distinct SOTA unlearning methods across four diffusion backbones and evaluate it across safety, object, and artistic-style unlearning, as well as under black-box and white-box adversarial attacks. Our method reduces the conditional nudity re-emergence rate across random initializations by 67.2% on average over four baselines and lowers attack success rates across both adversarial evaluations. Across concept domains, Adaptive Noise Sampling strengthens adversarial robustness and non-target retention while preserving competitive generative quality and target-erasure performance.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示现有T2I机器遗忘方法的"概率性遗忘"脆弱性，并提出自适应、概念条件化的噪声采样策略以增强擦除鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有SOTA机器遗忘方法对噪声初始化缺乏鲁棒性，被抑制的概念在特定随机初始噪声下会重新出现（"概率性遗忘"）。其根源在于遗忘过程中标准高斯采样与遗忘目标之间的错位：目标概念仅在特定初始噪声区域显现，均匀随机采样导致梯度更新稀疏且信息量不足，无法实现稳健擦除。
AI.method: 提出自适应、概念条件化的采样策略，动态将梯度更新集中在目标概念显现的区域，降低无信息区域的权重，从而获得更具信息量的梯度更新。
AI.result: 将框架集成于六种不同的SOTA遗忘方法、四个扩散骨干网络，并在安全、物体、艺术风格遗忘以及黑盒与白盒对抗攻击下评估。方法在四种基线上将条件裸露再现率平均降低67.2%，并降低两类对抗评估中的攻击成功率，同时增强对抗鲁棒性和非目标保留能力，保持有竞争力的生成质量与目标擦除性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过修正遗忘过程中的噪声采样错位问题，自适应噪声采样策略有效缓解了"概率性遗忘"，在多种方法与骨干网络上提升了机器遗忘的鲁棒性、对抗稳健性与生成质量，具有良好的通用性。

title: RunyaNER: Auxiliary Language Selection for Runyankore NER
comment: Accepted to the 6th Workshop on Multilingual Representation Learning (MRL 2026) at EMNLP 2026. Camera-ready version. 4 figures
summary: Cross-lingual zero-shot transfer and multilingual fine-tuning are promising approaches for NLP tasks such as Named Entity Recognition (NER) in low-resource languages, but in the absence of target language benchmarks, it is unclear which auxiliary language selection strategy leads to the best transfer. We introduce RunyaNER, the first publicly available NER benchmark for the East African language Runyankore, and use it to investigate the choice of which languages to use for transfer. Created with a semi-automated pipeline and fully manually verified, RunyaNER contains over 237k annotated words across 30k sentences. We benchmark pretrained models on RunyaNER, establishing that our dataset is of sufficient quality and size to produce effective Runyankore NER models. We then use RunyaNER to investigate auxiliary language selection in cross-lingual zero-shot and multilingual fine-tuning settings. Our experiments show that while transfer performance is highly sensitive to auxiliary language selection, embedding-based measures computed from labelled training spans correlate more strongly with downstream transfer performance than traditional linguistic features based on metadata or typology. By releasing RunyaNER and providing a systematic analysis of auxiliary language selection strategies, this work contributes both a new benchmark resource and practical insights for multilingual transfer in low-resource settings.

AI.tldr: 提出首个Runyankore语NER基准RunyaNER（237k+词，30k句），并系统研究跨语言迁移中辅助语言选择策略，发现基于标注训练片段的嵌入度量比传统语言学特征更能预测迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言NER常依赖跨语言零样本迁移或多语言微调，但缺乏目标语言基准时，难以判断应选哪些辅助语言才能带来最佳迁移效果；同时东非语言Runyankore缺乏公开NER数据资源。
AI.method: 构建半自动化流程并完全人工校验的Runyankore NER基准RunyaNER；在其上对预训练模型进行基准评测；随后在跨语言零样本迁移与多语言微调两种设定下，比较辅助语言选择策略，并对比基于嵌入的度量（由标注训练片段计算）与基于元数据/类型学的传统语言学特征的相关性。
AI.result: RunyaNER包含30k句子、237k+标注词，数据质量与规模足以训练有效的Runyankore NER模型；迁移性能对辅助语言选择高度敏感；嵌入度量与下游迁移性能的相关性强于传统语言学特征。
AI.conclusion: 发布RunyaNER新基准，并给出辅助语言选择策略的系统分析，为低资源场景下的多语言迁移提供实用启示。

title: APM-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-session Persistent Memory for Egocentric Streaming Video Assistants
summary: To serve as real-world personal assistants, streaming video models need persistent memory that retains past experiences for later use. Yet existing streaming benchmarks and methods often focus on individual continuous videos or short clips, overlooking that real-world interactions are often intermittent and require memory to persist across interruptions. To fill this gap, we introduce APM-Bench, which reformulates real-world streaming interaction as multi-session life trajectories. It contains 549 sessions, 104 trajectories, and 2,719 candidates, spanning both objective and open-ended questions. Each session is a video with fine-grained annotations, and sessions within a trajectory revolve around related activities. Models then use persistent memory to answer questions about past sessions and provide proactive responses while maintaining real-time interaction. This raises challenges: persistent memory must be storable, selectively retain information, be injected at the right time, and remain efficient. Moreover, finite storage may leave required evidence unavailable, so assistants should recognize missing evidence. Therefore, we systematically evaluate general video models under different memory protocols and diverse specialized streaming memory systems, and test whether models acknowledge insufficient evidence. Our evaluation reveals a clear utility--latency--storage trade-off: existing methods still struggle to simultaneously achieve reliable long-term recall, low overhead, and effective proactive assistance across sessions. APM-Bench provides a comprehensive testbed for developing and comparing persistent memory systems under realistic streaming conditions. We hope it encourages future work that jointly considers utility, latency, and storage toward more practical persistent memory for real-world streaming assistants.

AI.tldr: 提出APM-Bench基准，将真实世界流式交互重构为多会话生活轨迹，用于评估流式视频模型的持久记忆能力（可存储、选择性保留、适时注入、高效）及证据缺失识别能力，揭示现有方法存在效用—延迟—存储的明显权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频基准与方法多聚焦于单个连续视频或短片段，而真实世界交互是间歇性的，需要记忆跨越中断持续存在；同时面临持久记忆的可存储、选择性保留、适时注入与效率等挑战，且有限存储可能导致所需证据不可用，故需助手能识别证据缺失。
AI.method: 构建APM-Bench，包含549个会话、104条轨迹、2719个候选，涵盖客观题与开放题；每个会话为带细粒度标注的视频，同一轨迹内会话围绕相关活动；模型需借助持久记忆回答过去会话的问题并提供主动响应，同时保持实时交互；系统评估不同记忆协议下的通用视频模型与多种专用流式记忆系统，并测试模型是否承认证据不足。
AI.result: 评估揭示出清晰的效用—延迟—存储权衡：现有方法难以同时实现可靠的长期召回、低开销与跨会话的有效主动辅助。
AI.conclusion: APM-Bench为在真实流式条件下开发和比较持久记忆系统提供了综合测试平台，期望推动未来工作联合考虑效用、延迟与存储，面向更实用的真实世界流式助手持久记忆。

title: Orthogonal Yet Coupled: Decoupling Geometric Components for Model Merging
summary: Merging pretrained models has emerged as an effective approach for consolidating diverse capabilities into a single unified model. However, prevailing merging methods typically treat each task vector as an indivisible merging unit, overlooking the heterogeneous geometric changes encoded within it. This treatment can induce cross-component coupling: when merging decisions are derived from statistics of the complete task vector, the geometric characteristics of one component may influence how another is selected, weighted, or combined, potentially degrading the quality of the merged model. To address this issue, we propose DiGA, a Disentangled Geometry-Aware model merging framework. Using the pretrained weights as a shared geometric reference, DiGA orthogonally decomposes each task vector into components corresponding to distinct geometric attributes. Rather than merging the task vectors as a whole, DiGA aggregates corresponding components independently within their respective subspaces and subsequently recombines them into a unified update. This component-wise formulation preserves the geometric identity of each component and prevents the characteristics of one component from interfering with the aggregation of another. Furthermore, DiGA can be incorporated into a broad range of existing model merging methods. Extensive experiments across diverse models, tasks, and merging methods demonstrate that DiGA improves merged-model performance and reduces capability degradation. Our repository is on https://github.com/wzj1718/DiGA.

AI.tldr: 提出DiGA框架，通过将任务向量正交分解为不同几何属性的分量并独立聚合，缓解模型合并中的跨分量耦合问题，提升合并模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多数模型合并方法将每个任务向量视为不可分割的合并单元，忽视了其内部编码的异质几何变化。这种处理会引发跨分量耦合：当合并决策基于完整任务向量的统计量时，某一分量的几何特征可能影响另一分量的选择、加权或组合，从而降低合并模型质量。
AI.method: 提出DiGA（Disentangled Geometry-Aware）框架。以预训练权重作为共享几何参考，将每个任务向量正交分解为对应不同几何属性的分量；不整体合并任务向量，而是在各自子空间内独立聚合对应分量，再重组为统一更新。该分量级公式化保持各分量的几何身份，防止一个分量的特征干扰另一个分量的聚合。DiGA可嵌入多种现有模型合并方法。
AI.result: 在多种模型、任务和合并方法上的大量实验表明，DiGA提升了合并模型的性能并减少了能力退化。代码库：https://github.com/wzj1718/DiGA。
AI.conclusion: DiGA通过解耦几何感知的分量级合并，有效缓解跨分量耦合，具有良好通用性，可广泛应用于现有模型合并方法并持续改善合并效果。

title: Devils in Question Relay: Source-Conditioned Relay Steering to Mitigate Hallucinations in Audio-visual Large Language Models
summary: Audio-visual large language models (AVLLMs) have made remarkable progress in multimodal understanding and reasoning through interactions among visual, auditory, and linguistic information. However, recent studies show that AVLLMs face a critical challenge: $\textbf{source-confused grounding hallucination}$, where cues from the unused modality induce responses that the required modality does not support, undermining reliability in real-world applications. Existing methods have made progress in mitigating this failure, yet how it arises from internal cross-modal interactions remains insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we conduct path-intervention and representation analyses, revealing a $\textbf{question-relay}$ mechanism: question states carry interfering cues alongside required-source evidence, undermining grounding in required-modality evidence. Cutting pathways from interfering modality to question states yields greater correct-answer logit recovery than cutting those to the generation position. Motivated by these findings, we propose $\textbf{SECRET}$ ($\textbf{S}$ourc$\textbf{E}$-$\textbf{C}$onditioned $\textbf{RE}$lay s$\textbf{T}$eering), a training-free method that mitigates cross-modal interference at the question relay. Using contrasting question representations elicited through different modality-pathway interventions, SECRET steers the original question states toward required-source evidence. Experiments on two widely adopted benchmarks CMM and AVHBench across three AVLLMs show that SECRET consistently outperforms prior training-free methods, substantially mitigating source-confused grounding hallucinations (e.g., up to +18.0 and +7.1 percentage points over base models). Modality-specific captioning further demonstrates its generalizability to open-ended generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究音频-视觉大语言模型中的"源混淆接地幻觉"，揭示其源于"问题中继"机制，并提出免训练的SECRET方法进行干预缓解。
AI.motivation: AVLLMs在跨模态理解中面临源混淆接地幻觉：来自未使用模态的线索诱导出所需模态并不支持的响应，损害了实际应用的可靠性。已有方法虽能缓解，但对这种失败如何从内部跨模态交互中产生仍缺乏理解。
AI.method: 通过路径干预与表征分析，发现"问题中继"机制：问题状态同时携带干扰线索和所需源证据，削弱了对所需模态证据的接地。基于此提出免训练方法SECRET（源条件中继引导），利用不同模态路径干预得到的对比性问题表征，将原始问题状态引导向所需源证据。
AI.result: 在CMM和AVHBench两个基准、三种AVLLM上，SECRET一致优于先前的免训练方法，显著缓解源混淆接地幻觉（相较基模型最高提升+18.0和+7.1个百分点）。模态特定描述任务进一步验证了其向开放式生成的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SECRET作为一种免训练方法，通过干预问题中继处的跨模态干扰，有效缓解源混淆接地幻觉，并具备向开放式生成任务的泛化性。

title: Decompose Radicals, Then Reward: Fine-Grained Inspection for Accurate Chinese Text Rendering
summary: Rendering accurate Chinese text remains challenging for text-to-image models. Existing OCR-based reinforcement-learning rewards compare decoded transcripts with target strings. Such rewards overlook the compositional nature of Chinese writing: an ideograph consists of reusable components arranged through explicit spatial relations, yet OCR evaluates it as an atomic character. Consequently, visually different radical-level errors may receive equally coarse feedback, encouraging glyphs that merely resemble the target instead of faithfully reproducing its internal structure. We employ Ideographic Description Sequences (IDS), which comprise spatial operators and character components, and train an expert IDS recognizer to transcribe rendered Chinese text into this representation. Building on this recognizer, we introduce IDSpect, which deterministically decomposes the target text into IDS tokens and aligns crop-level visual IDS predictions with the target sequence. Globally unique token credit makes this comparison robust to the order of detected text regions. Combined with a whole-character semantic reward, IDSpect supplies fine-grained credit with component and spatial-relation without changing the image generator or adding inference-time cost. Experiments with GRPO post-training of Qwen-Image demonstrate that IDSpect achieves leading structural quality and semantic alignment on LongText and GenTextEval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IDSpect，用表意文字描述序列（IDS）将汉字拆解为部件与空间关系，并训练专家IDS识别器，从而为文生图模型的强化学习提供部件级细粒度奖励，无需修改生成器或增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有基于OCR的强化学习奖励将汉字视为原子字符，直接比较解码文本与目标字符串，忽略了汉字的构字性——即由可复用部件按明确空间关系组合而成。这导致部首级视觉错误获得同样粗糙的反馈，模型倾向于生成"形似"而非结构忠实的字形。
AI.method: 1）采用表意文字描述序列（IDS），由空间操作符与部件构成，训练专家IDS识别器把渲染的中文文本转录为IDS表示；2）提出IDSpect，确定性地将目标文本分解为IDS token，并将裁剪级视觉IDS预测与目标序列对齐；3）通过全局唯一token credit机制使比较对检测文本区域的顺序鲁棒；4）与整字语义奖励结合，提供部件与空间关系的细粒度信用，不改变图像生成器、不增加推理成本；5）基于GRPO对Qwen-Image进行后训练。
AI.result: 在LongText与GenTextEval上，IDSpect取得领先的结构质量与语义对齐效果，验证了部件级细粒度奖励在中文文本渲染中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以IDS为中间表示的奖励设计能够克服OCR整字级奖励的粗粒度缺陷，在保持推理效率的同时显著提升中文文本渲染的结构忠实度与语义一致性。

title: MERGE: Multi-LLM Ensemble for Retrieval via Generative Enrichment
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to enrich user queries in information retrieval (IR) so that a standard retriever such as BM25 can bridge vocabulary gaps with the target corpus. Any single LLM, however, is limited by its training data and architectural biases, and its enrichment behavior depends on hand-crafted prompts that must be re-engineered for each new model -- an expensive and poorly scalable process.
