We present MERGE (Multi-LLM Ensemble for Retrieval via Generative Enrichment), a two-stage framework: three heterogeneous 7-8B open-source LLMs independently produce candidate expansions, and a larger LLM generatively synthesizes them into a single query. To make prompt engineering scalable across the ensemble, we integrate a task-grounded Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO) loop into both stages. Unlike APO methods that judge candidates with an LLM evaluator, our loop scores each candidate by its downstream retrieval performance and runs a small tournament between the current champion prompt and optimizer-proposed drafts, terminating once the champion survives two consecutive rounds; a history-augmented variant additionally feeds the recent tournament trajectory back to the optimizer. MERGE is retriever-agnostic and issues a single BM25 pass with no rank fusion, no supervised document expansion, and no re-indexing. On five BEIR benchmarks (NQ, SciFact, FiQA, Touche-2020, DBPedia), MERGE improves BM25 nDCG@10 over the original queries by +2.1 to +14.9 points and matches or outperforms strong LLM-based query-expansion baselines despite using only compact open-source models. Ablations confirm that the Stage-2 ensemble beats any single Stage-1 LLM, and that task-grounded APO converts large seed-prompt regressions into consistent gains without hand-tuning.

AI.tldr: MERGE 提出一种两阶段多LLM集成查询扩展框架，用任务导向的自动提示优化替代手工提示工程，在BM25上取得显著检索提升。
AI.motivation: 单一LLM受限于训练数据与架构偏差，且其查询扩展行为依赖针对每个新模型反复重写的手工提示，成本高、难以扩展。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：阶段一由三个异构的7-8B开源LLM独立生成候选扩展；阶段二由更大的LLM生成式地将其综合为单一查询。两阶段均集成任务导向的自动提示优化（APO）循环，以候选的下游检索性能作为评分标准，在现任冠军提示与优化器草稿之间进行小型锦标赛，冠军连续两轮胜出即终止；历史增强变体进一步将近期锦标赛轨迹反馈给优化器。MERGE与检索器无关，仅执行单次BM25检索，不做排名融合、监督式文档扩展或重建索引。
AI.result: 在五个BEIR基准（NQ、SciFact、FiQA、Touche-2020、DBPedia）上，MERGE将BM25的nDCG@10较原始查询提升+2.1至+14.9个点，仅使用紧凑开源模型即达到或超过强LLM查询扩展基线。消融实验证实阶段二集成优于任何单一阶段一LLM，任务导向APO能将较大的种子提示性能回退转化为稳定增益而无需手工调参。
AI.conclusion: 多LLM集成结合任务导向的自动提示优化，可在不依赖大模型、无需手工提示与索引改造的前提下，稳定提升BM25的检索效果。

title: Evaluating the Evaluators: Diagnosing Large Multimodal Models for AI-Generated Image Assessment
summary: With the rapid advancement of text-to-image (T2I) generation, robust evaluation becomes critical yet challenging, as traditional metrics fail to capture fine-grained alignment and generative artifacts. While large multimodal models (LMMs) are increasingly adopted as evaluators, existing benchmarks typically study semantic understanding, quality perception, and authenticity identification in isolation, while largely neglecting responsibility detection. This leaves a gap in unified and comprehensive validation. To bridge this gap, we introduce SQUARE-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates LMM capabilities as evaluators of AI-generated images across four aspects: Semantics, Quality, Authenticity, and Responsibility. SQUARE-Bench introduces a granular taxonomy of 38 sub-dimensions to evaluate nearly 10K AI-generated images sampled from 22 diverse models, ranging from legacy to state-of-the-art generators, complemented by over 3K real-world images. The images are annotated with curated question-answering pairs. Extensive experiments on 23 LMMs reveal that top proprietary models, such as Gemini-3-Pro, already outperform the individual human expert baseline. However, the performance gap between models remains significant, exhibiting notable disparities in fine-grained inference and domain-specific robustness. Beyond benchmarking, we conduct a proof-of-concept study of LMM-guided iterative editing, in which dimension-specific LMMs provide diagnostic feedback to fixed image editors. The resulting guided system yields selective improvements in semantics, authenticity, and responsibility, while exhibiting a consistent visual-quality trade-off. SQUARE-Bench can serve as both a diagnostic tool for characterizing LMM evaluator capabilities and studying their use in T2I generation refinement. The benchmark and dataset will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出 SQUARE-Bench 基准，从语义、质量、真实性、责任四方面系统评估 LMM 作为 AI 生成图像评估器的能力。
AI.motivation: 随着文本到图像（T2I）生成技术快速发展，传统指标难以捕捉细粒度对齐与生成伪影。大型多模态模型（LMM）虽被用作评估器，但现有基准通常孤立地研究语义理解、质量感知与真实性识别，忽视了责任检测，缺乏统一、全面的验证。
AI.method: 构建 SQUARE-Bench 基准，涵盖语义、质量、真实性、责任四个维度，细分 38 个子维度；从 22 个模型（涵盖传统到最先进生成器）采样近 1 万张 AI 生成图像，并配以 3000 余张真实图像，图像均标注精心设计的问答对。在 23 个 LMM 上进行大规模实验，并开展 LMM 引导的迭代编辑验证性研究。
AI.result: Gemini-3-Pro 等顶级专有模型已超越单个人类专家基线；但模型间性能差距仍显著，在细粒度推理与领域特定鲁棒性上差异明显。在 LMM 引导的迭代编辑中，特定维度的 LMM 为固定图像编辑器提供诊断反馈，引导系统在语义、真实性和责任方面获得选择性提升，但存在一致的视觉质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: SQUARE-Bench 既可作为刻画 LMM 评估器能力的诊断工具，也可用于研究其在 T2I 生成精炼中的应用，基准与数据集将在论文发表后发布。

title: Pair Difficulty Matters: Rethinking Pairwise LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation and Consistency
comment: Accepted as an EMNLP 2026 short paper
summary: Large Language Model judges are widely used to rank texts and text-generating systems through pairwise comparison, and their reliability is typically assessed via three proxies: position bias, transitivity, and pairwise agreement (self- or human-labeled). Because these proxies drive judge selection and benchmarking, a substantial literature reporting that judges perform poorly on them risks steering practitioners away from otherwise capable evaluators. We argue this assessment is misleading. Under the Bradley--Terry geometry underlying pairwise aggregation, each proxy is dominated by close-rank-gap pairs, where inconsistency is information-theoretically expected and individual verdicts contribute little to the aggregate ranking; far-gap pairs carry the ranking signal but barely move the proxies. We formalize this argument and validate it in a controlled simulation and on two human-rated corpora: the proxies correlate only weakly with ranking accuracy against gold, and their predictive component concentrates in the far-gap regime. Judges should therefore be assessed on rank-gap-conditional metrics, ideally against human rankings. Code at https://github.com/brunobrocai/PairDifficulty.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，当前评估大模型评判者可靠性的三个常用代理指标（位置偏差、传递性、成对一致性）受Bradley-Terry几何支配，其信号主要来自排名差距小的配对，而这些配对的不一致在信息论上是预期内的，对聚合排名贡献极小；真正承载排名信号的远差距配对对代理指标影响甚微。作者主张应采用按排名差距分层的指标，并最好以人类排名为基准。 大模型评判者被广泛用于通过成对比较对文本及文本生成系统进行排序，其可靠性通常用位置偏差、传递性和成对一致性三个代理指标评估。大量文献报告评判者在这些指标上表现不佳，可能误导实践者放弃本来有能力的评估者。作者认为这种评估具有误导性，需要重新审视这些代理指标的有效性。 作者在Bradley-Terry成对聚合几何框架下形式化论证：每个代理指标都被排名差距小的配对所主导，在这类配对上判断不一致在信息论上是预期内的，且单次判断对聚合排名贡献甚微；而承载排名信号的远差距配对几乎不影响这些代理指标。随后通过受控模拟和两个人工标注语料库进行验证。 在受控模拟和两个人工评分语料库上，三个代理指标与相对于金标准的排名准确率仅呈弱相关，且其预测成分集中在远差距区间。这表明代理指标的高低并不能反映评判者的实际排名能力。 评判者评估应采用按排名差距条件化的指标，理想情况下应以人类排名为基准，而非依赖位置偏差、传递性和成对一致性等传统代理指标。代码已开源。

title: TReVS: Integrating Textual Relevance and Visual Saliency for Efficient Vision-Language Model Token Pruning
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual understanding and reasoning but often incur substantial inference costs due to the large number of visual tokens. Recent visual token pruning methods increasingly follow a two-stage paradigm: they first remove visually redundant tokens after the vision encoder and then discard tokens irrelevant to the textual query within the Large Language Model (LLM). However, since the first stage typically relies solely on vision-encoder saliency, it may prematurely eliminate query-relevant tokens, depriving the subsequent text-guided stage of critical visual evidence. Our empirical analysis shows that incorporating query guidance into first-stage pruning better preserves task-relevant evidence and consistently improves performance over vision-only saliency-based pruning. We further find that high-variance attention heads are more sensitive to the textual query and yield more discriminative text-to-vision attention signals for second-stage pruning. Motivated by these findings, we propose TReVS, a training-free framework that combines textual relevance with vision-encoder saliency for pre-LLM pruning and leverages high-variance attention heads to remove task-irrelevant tokens at shallow-to-intermediate layers of the LLM. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, TReVS retains 92.8% of the unpruned baseline performance while pruning 94.4% of visual tokens, outperforming prior state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的TReVS框架，将文本相关性引入LLM前剪枝，并利用高方差注意力头在LLM浅中层剪除无关token，在LLaVA-1.5-7B上剪掉94.4%视觉token仍保留92.8%基线性能。
AI.motivation: VLM因视觉token数量庞大导致推理成本高。现有两阶段剪枝中，第一阶段仅依赖视觉编码器显著性，可能过早删除与查询相关的token，使第二阶段文本引导剪枝缺失关键视觉证据。作者实证发现引入查询引导能更好地保留任务相关证据，且高方差注意力头对文本查询更敏感，能提供更具判别力的文本到视觉注意力信号。
AI.method: TReVS为免训练框架，包含两部分：1）LLM前剪枝阶段，将文本相关性与视觉编码器显著性结合进行token筛选；2）在LLM浅层至中层，利用高方差注意力头识别并移除与任务无关的token。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上，TReVS剪除94.4%的视觉token，仍保留未剪枝基线92.8%的性能，优于此前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 将查询引导纳入第一阶段剪枝及利用高方差注意力头进行第二阶段剪枝，能有效提升视觉token剪枝性能；TReVS以免训练方式在极高压缩率下保持较强性能。

title: FedSocket: Recipient-Executable Knowledge Exchange for Heterogeneous Multimodal Federated Learning
summary: Federated knowledge must remain usable by recipients with different modalities, private architectures, and tasks. We present FedSocket, which makes recipient execution a design requirement of the exchanged model. A shared Q combines recipient-computable inputs, task-owned outputs, and ownership-aware aggregation, connecting heterogeneous private models through a common prediction interface. Private models teach local Q copies; the returned Q supports local learning and Joint inference, with only Q parameters and counts exchanged. Across six datasets, FedSocket improves missing-modality recipient accuracy over Local by 14.44 and 15.51 percentage points on MELD and UCF-51. Under matched inference capacity, Joint exceeds independent ensembles by 11.06 points in UCF-51 accuracy and 4.87 points in mean bidirectional Flickr30k R@1. Joint also improves over Q alone on all four heterogeneous endpoints, demonstrating the value of combining local and exchanged predictions. Teacher controls, sharing-path interventions, and component factorials identify the roles of supervision, sharing, and deployment. FedSocket makes exchanged knowledge directly usable from federated training to recipient inference.

AI.tldr: 提出 FedSocket，将"接收方可执行"作为交换模型的设计要求，通过共享 Q 连接异构私有模型，在缺失模态等场景显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 联邦知识需被不同模态、不同私有架构和不同任务的接收方使用，但交换的知识往往难以直接落地到接收方推理，存在可用性鸿沟。
AI.method: 设计共享 Q，融合接收方可计算输入、任务自有输出与所有权感知聚合，以统一预测接口连接异构私有模型；私有模型训练本地 Q 副本，仅交换 Q 参数与计数；返回的 Q 支持本地学习与联合推理。
AI.result: 六个数据集上，缺失模态接收方准确率较 Local 分别提升 14.44（MELD）和 15.51（UCF-51）个百分点；同等推理容量下，Joint 在 UCF-51 超独立集成 11.06 个百分点，在 Flickr30k 平均双向 R@1 上超 4.87；Joint 在四个异构端点均优于单独 Q。
AI.conclusion: 教师对照、共享路径干预与组件因子实验验证了监督、共享与部署的作用；FedSocket 使交换知识从联邦训练到接收方推理可直接使用。

title: Rational Clarification by Assistive Agents via Value-of-Information Reasoning
summary: Users of language-based assistive agents often make ambiguous requests. In response, an assistant can either directly act on its interpretation of the request --- risking misalignment with the user --- or ask a clarifying question. Which option is the most safe and helpful? A common approach is to ask questions that minimize uncertainty about the user's intent until a threshold is reached. However, this neglects the impact of uncertainty reduction on downstream performance, the costs of asking versus acting immediately, and the possibility that users may provide corrections without being asked. To navigate these trade-offs, we introduce Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning (REVOIR). REVOIR makes clarification decisions via inference-time reasoning about the value-of-information of a question, which captures the expected improvement in task reward due to the answer received. In two assistive tasks --- ambiguous question answering (CondAmbigQA) and preference-aligned household task planning (ADAPT) --- we show that REVOIR achieves greater success with fewer questions than approaches based on prompting, chain-of-thought, fine-tuning, or information gain, improving preference satisfaction on ADAPT by 13-15% over a fine-tuned clarification policy while requiring no training and asking five times fewer questions. Furthermore, when the assistant can receive cheap user corrections after acting, REVOIR naturally infers that asking questions is not always efficient, demonstrating the adaptivity of our approach. In contrast, we find that vanilla reasoning agents fail to adaptively clarify user requests, and request fewer clarifications as reasoning effort increases.

AI.tldr: 提出REVOIR：基于信息价值推理的澄清决策方法，在减少提问次数的同时提升任务成功率与偏好满足度。
AI.motivation: 语言辅助智能体常面对模糊请求，需在“直接按自身理解执行（有偏离用户意图风险）”与“反问澄清”之间权衡。常见做法是最小化对用户意图的不确定性直至阈值，但忽视了不确定性降低对下游表现的影响、提问与立即行动的成本差异，以及用户可能主动给出纠正的可能性。
AI.method: REVOIR（Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning）：在推理阶段评估提问的“信息价值”，即所获回答预期带来的任务奖励提升，据此决定是否澄清。方法无需训练，直接进行推理时决策。
AI.result: 在两个辅助任务——歧义问答（CondAmbigQA）与偏好对齐家庭任务规划（ADAPT）上，REVOIR以更少提问取得更高成功率，优于提示、思维链、微调及信息增益方法；在ADAPT上偏好满足度较微调澄清策略提升13–15%，且无需训练、提问次数减少五倍。当行动后可获得低成本用户纠正时，REVOIR能自然推断提问并非总是高效，体现自适应性。相反，普通推理智能体无法自适应澄清，且随推理努力增加反而提出更少澄清问题。
AI.conclusion: 以信息价值为核心的推理式澄清决策，能更好权衡提问与行动的成本收益，提升辅助智能体的安全性与有用性，并具备对纠正机制的适应性。

title: FOCUS: Training-Free Decision-Preserving Context Compression for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that grow linearly with task length, causing quadratic inference cost scaling and performance degradation from attention dilution. Existing context-compression methods learn what to discard offline: by contrastively optimizing guidelines, distilling compressors, or training compression policies. This incurs a substantial cost. Further, the compression policy is learned a priori and is not dynamically conditioned on the evolving test-time trajectories. In this paper we ask a complementary question: Which past interactions causally shape the agent's future decisions? We recast context compression as a causal decision preservation problem over discrete interaction units and introduce FOCUS, a training-free context compression framework that operates entirely at test time. Our method requires no offline data collection or fine-tuning, and is architecture-agnostic, attaching to any closed-API frontier model as a modular compression layer. We evaluate FOCUS on diverse agentic benchmarks including API and tool-calling, QA, web domain and multi-turn dialogue. Our method establishes new state of the art performance, cutting peak context by up to 48% and dependency by 73% while improving task success by up to 8.9 percentage points over uncompressed execution.

AI.tldr: 该论文将上下文压缩重构为离散交互单元上的因果决策保持问题，提出免训练、测试时运行的框架 FOCUS，作为模块化压缩层即插即用于任意闭源 API 前沿模型。在 API/工具调用、问答、网页及多轮对话等基准上，峰值上下文最多降低 48%、依赖降低 73%，任务成功率最高提升 8.9 个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体的交互历史随任务长度线性增长，导致推理成本二次方级膨胀，并因注意力稀释引发性能下降。现有上下文压缩方法需离线学习丢弃策略（对比优化准则、蒸馏压缩器或训练压缩策略），成本高昂；且压缩策略是先验固定的，无法根据测试时不断演化的轨迹动态调整。因此作者追问：哪些历史交互因果性地影响了智能体的未来决策？
AI.method: 将上下文压缩重新表述为离散交互单元上的因果决策保持问题，提出 FOCUS——一个完全在测试时运行、无需训练的上下文压缩框架。该方法无需离线数据收集或微调，且与架构无关，可作为模块化压缩层挂载到任意闭源 API 前沿模型上。
AI.result: 在涵盖 API 与工具调用、问答、网页领域及多轮对话的多种智能体基准上进行评估，FOCUS 取得新的最优性能：峰值上下文最多缩减 48%，依赖最多降低 73%，同时相较未压缩执行将任务成功率最高提升 8.9 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过在测试时以因果决策保持为准则动态压缩交互历史，FOCUS 同时实现了成本降低与性能提升，且无需离线训练、适配任意前沿模型，为智能体上下文管理提供了免训练、架构无关的新范式。

title: When to Adapt: Multi-Signal Domain Shift Detection for Efficient Training-Free Adaptation in Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
summary: Robust and reliable perception is essential for autonomous robots operating in real-world environments, particularly in long-term missions where environmental conditions may change significantly over time. Although recent advances in Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) have improved open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, these models can still suffer from domain shift, which can significantly degrade performance if they are not adapted to the current environment. Training-free domain adaptation is a relevant paradigm for adaptation, consisting of adjusting the model online using lightweight adapters. Recent approaches apply this on a per-frame basis, which is impractical for deployments on resource-constrained robotic hardware. To tackle this, we propose a multi-signal domain shift detection method for training-free continual test-time adaptation (TF-CTTA) in open-vocabulary segmentation. Our method leverages temporal coherence across consecutive frames by monitoring and combining complementary aspects of domain shift (visual change, adapter mismatch, and semantic drift) to trigger adaptation only when needed. We validate our approach on a benchmark including indoor and outdoor environments and using real robotic data. We demonstrate that our approach maintains segmentation accuracy while substantially reducing adaptations, making training-free adaptation practical and feasible for long-term, real-world robotic deployments.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多信号域偏移检测方法，用于开放词汇分割中的免训练持续测试时自适应，通过监测视觉变化、适配器不匹配和语义漂移并按需触发自适应，在保持精度的同时显著减少自适应次数。
AI.motivation: 自主机器人在长期真实环境中运行会遭遇域偏移，导致视觉基础模型（VFM）的开放词汇语义分割性能显著下降。免训练域自适应利用轻量适配器在线调整模型，但现有方法逐帧自适应，对资源受限的机器人硬件不切实际。
AI.method: 面向免训练持续测试时自适应（TF-CTTA），提出多信号域偏移检测方法：利用连续帧的时间一致性，监测并融合域偏移的互补维度（视觉变化、适配器不匹配、语义漂移），仅在需要时触发自适应。
AI.result: 在涵盖室内外环境的基准及真实机器人数据上验证，方法在保持分割精度的同时大幅减少自适应次数。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使免训练自适应对长期、真实世界的机器人部署变得实用可行。

title: TomoTransformer: Towards a Foundation Model for CT Reconstruction
summary: Supervised deep learning has advanced sparse-view tomographic reconstruction. However, conventional models, which typically map filtered back-projection (FBP) images or sinograms to clean reconstructions, are brittle under distribution shifts. Because they require retraining whenever projection counts and angles, detector resolutions, or data distributions change, their deployment in real-world applications remains limited. To address this, we introduce TomoTransformer, a transformer-based architecture that treats each \textit{local} filtered projection as an individual token and predicts missing views via self-attention. Crucially, TomoTransformer operates in a \emph{back-projection space} that separates projections across spatial locations, making view interpolation geometrically well-posed and invariant to detector size. This design yields a single foundation model that can process any number of input projections, at arbitrary angular locations and detector dimensions, and query any number of target angles without retraining. Trained on a large-scale dataset spanning diverse medical CT anatomies and natural images, TomoTransformer generalizes effectively across anatomies, materials, and resolutions. Extensive evaluations on several benchmark sparse-view datasets show that TomoTransformer significantly outperforms concurrent multi-purpose models like ViewTrans and matches or exceeds strong protocol-specific baselines, while remaining fully agnostic to the number of input and target projections. Furthermore, the model demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization on real experimental nanoscale brain data collected from an X-ray synchrotron, showcasing its practical utility for real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 提出TomoTransformer，一种基于Transformer的稀疏视图断层重建基础模型，在反投影空间中对局部滤波投影做自注意力预测缺失视角，实现无需重训练的跨视角数、角度、探测器尺寸和分布的通用重建。
AI.motivation: 传统监督深度学习模型通常将FBP图像或正弦图映射为干净重建，在分布偏移下十分脆弱：当投影数量与角度、探测器分辨率或数据分布变化时都需重新训练，限制了其在真实场景中的部署，因此亟需一种具备通用性与鲁棒性的重建框架。
AI.method: TomoTransformer将每个局部滤波投影视为独立token，通过自注意力预测缺失视角；其核心是在反投影空间（back-projection space）中操作，将投影按空间位置分离，使视角插值在几何上适定且不受探测器尺寸影响。模型在大规模涵盖多种医学CT解剖与自然图像的数据集上训练，天然支持任意输入投影数、任意角度位置与探测器维度，并可查询任意目标角度。
AI.result: 在多个稀疏视图基准数据集上，TomoTransformer显著优于ViewTrans等多用途并发模型，与针对特定协议设计的强基线持平或超越，且完全对输入与目标投影数量无关；在X射线同步辐射采集的真实纳米尺度脑数据上展现出稳健的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TomoTransformer以反投影空间中的token化自注意力机制构建单一基础模型，克服了传统监督重建对分布变化的脆弱性，在跨解剖、跨材料、跨分辨率场景下具备强泛化性，验证了其在真实世界断层重建应用中的实用价值。

title: LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
summary: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) aims to improve visual grounding while preserving the strong reasoning capabilities of language models. Recent multi-teacher approaches combine LLM and VLM teachers to provide complementary supervision. However, directly using a VLM's full predictive distribution entangles its visual grounding signal with its own language prior, preventing the grounding information from being transferred independently. Conversely, increasing the strength of visual supervision can improve perception but may overemphasize visual evidence and degrade language reasoning. To address this trade-off, we introduce LEGO-OPD, which selectively composes factors from a Language Expert and a Grounding expert into One teacher distribution for multimodal OPD. Under a generalized Bayesian formulation, the language expert provides a prior over candidate tokens, while the grounding expert contributes a visual likelihood that updates this prior, rather than transferring its complete predictive distribution. This factorized composition allows language reasoning and visual grounding to be controlled independently. We further introduce adaptive calibration to determine how strongly the visual likelihood should update the language prior at each decoding prefix. Specifically, LEGO-OPD uses the grounding expert's image-induced prediction shift as a prefix-dependent reference, preventing both insufficient and excessive visual supervision. Experiments with Qwen3 models show that LEGO-OPD consistently outperforms the evaluated single- and multi-teacher OPD baselines on both multimodal and text-only reasoning tasks. Moreover, it improves the initial student's visual perception while preserving text-only reasoning.

AI.tldr: LEGO-OPD 通过贝叶斯因子化组合，将语言专家的先验与视觉专家的视觉似然解耦，实现语言推理与视觉定位的独立控制，在多模态与纯文本推理任务上均超越单/多教师 OPD 基线。
AI.motivation: 多模态 on-policy distillation (OPD) 旨在提升视觉定位能力的同时保留语言模型的强推理能力。现有方法存在两难：直接使用 VLM 的完整预测分布会将视觉定位信号与其自身语言先验纠缠，导致定位信息无法独立迁移；而单纯增强视觉监督强度虽能改善感知，却会过度强调视觉证据并损害语言推理能力。
AI.method: 提出 LEGO-OPD，在广义贝叶斯框架下，将 Language Expert 与 Grounding Expert 的因子选择性组合为单一教师分布：语言专家提供候选 token 上的先验，视觉专家提供视觉似然对该先验进行更新，而非迁移其完整预测分布，从而独立控制两条信号。并引入自适应校准，利用视觉专家的图像诱导预测偏移作为依赖解码前缀的参考，动态决定视觉似然对先验的更新强度，避免视觉监督不足或过度。
AI.result: 基于 Qwen3 模型的实验表明，LEGO-OPD 在多模态与纯文本推理任务上均持续优于所评估的单教师与多教师 OPD 基线；并在提升初始学生模型视觉感知能力的同时，保留了其纯文本推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过因子化组合语言先验与视觉似然，并结合前缀依赖的自适应校准，LEGO-OPD 有效缓解了视觉定位与语言推理之间的权衡，为多模态 OPD 提供了一种可独立调控两类监督信号的有效方案。

title: Authority Bias in Language Models: Source Deference and User Agreement Are Not Interchangeable
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Conference, Poster). 33 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://authority-bias.vercel.app/ . Code: https://github.com/Lossfunk/authority-bias
summary: Language models tend to agree with whatever a user asserts, and post-training increasingly targets this sycophancy so that models evaluate claims on their merits rather than deferring to the user. Yet the same models are far more compliant when a wrong answer is attributed to a verified source, which is how retrieval results, tool outputs, and grounded-search content often present information. We measure this gap across five open-weight families and three closed APIs. A single verified-source note endorsing a wrong answer flips 45-88% of baseline-correct responses in seven of eight models, and compliance rises with how authoritative the note sounds. Source deference and user agreement are not behaviorally interchangeable inside the model: on matched items with the same wrong answer, causal interventions can selectively suppress one without equally affecting the other. In three open-weight families, removing a fitted source direction lowers source compliance by 65-80 percentage points while removing a user or assistant direction has far smaller effects, and removing the user direction shows the reverse preference. A separately fitted intervention derived from source-versus-user cue activations moves compliance in both directions while leaving the prompt text unchanged. An authority direction fitted on trivia also transfers to PIQA and multi-turn SYCON dialogues without refitting, and removing it lowers wrong-source compliance by tens of percentage points in four of five families with no detected change in MMLU-Pro or GSM8K accuracy at our evaluation sizes. Source deference and user agreement therefore need separate evaluation.

AI.tldr: 语言模型对"已验证来源"的错误答案的顺从远高于对用户的顺从，二者在模型内部是不同机制，需分别评估。
AI.motivation: 后训练已针对"用户顺从（sycophancy）"进行抑制，但检索结果、工具输出、grounded search 常以权威来源形式呈现信息，模型可能对这类"来源顺从"更盲从，形成新的未对齐风险；论文动机是量化这一缺口并检验两者是否行为可互换。
AI.method: 在5个开放权重模型家族与3个闭源API上测量来源顺从；采用因果干预（activation steering）：拟合"来源方向"、"用户方向"、"助手方向"，做方向消融与双向操控；在trivia上拟合的权威方向迁移到PIQA与多轮SYCON对话，并检测MMLU-Pro、GSM8K精度影响。
AI.result: 一条"已验证来源"备注即可使8个模型中7个的45–88%基线正确回答翻转，且顺从随来源权威性上升；同一错误答案下，消融来源方向使来源顺从下降65–80个百分点，而消融用户/助手方向影响小得多，消融用户方向则呈相反偏好；来源-用户线索差值方向可双向移动顺从且不改提示文本；trivia权威方向无需重拟合即迁移至PIQA与SYCON，消融后在5个家族中4个使错误来源顺从下降数十个百分点，MMLU-Pro与GSM8K精度未检测到显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 来源顺从与用户顺从在模型内部具有可分离的因果表征，并非行为等价，因此必须将二者作为独立的对齐与评测目标分别评估。

title: Correct, Don't Delete: Mitigating Emergent Misalignment with Corrective Supervision
summary: Fine-tuning a language model on a narrow set of harmful demonstrations, such as bad medical advice, can make it broadly misaligned on unrelated questions, a phenomenon known as emergent misalignment (EM). The usual defense is to find the offending rows and delete them, but a row locator failed our held-out test and deleting rows helps less than expected. We ask a different question: given a fixed set of poisoned rows, is it better to correct them than to remove them? We fine-tune Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct on a mixture of bad medical advice and benign chat data, select a quarter of the poison rows in advance, and either delete them or replace each with a corrected answer to the same prompt, keeping everything else the same. Replacing the rows cuts the EM rate by about a third and improves answers on held-out medical questions, while deleting the same rows has little measurable effect. The advantage is larger when half the poison rows are corrected, and it holds on a second base model and a second misaligned model organism. The content of the replacement appears to matter: paraphrasing the rows while keeping their bad advice shows no clear benefit, and the correct answers distributed with the dataset appear to do about as well as our rewriter's. Realigning an already-poisoned model with further fine-tuning is known to work, but which data does the work has not been compared directly. We find that a short round of training on corrections beats the same amount of training on generic chat data, that corrections on other medical prompts do roughly as well as corrections of the poisoned prompts themselves, and that instructing the correction writer to model a careful, harm-avoiding assistant adds no measurable benefit over plain corrections. In the settings we tested, correcting harmful training data reduces EM more than deleting it.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了在中毒训练数据中"修正"与"删除"有害样本对模型涌现性失配(EM)的影响。在Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct上,用修正答案替换四分之一毒样本使EM率降低约三分之一并改善留出医疗问答表现,而删除同样样本几乎无效果;该优势在修正比例增至一半、换用第二个基座模型和第二个失配模型时依然成立。替换内容的质量起作用:仅改写而保留有害建议无效;且用修正样本训练优于用通用对话数据训练。
AI.motivation: 在窄领域有害示范(如糟糕的医疗建议)上微调语言模型,会使其在无关问题上广泛失配,即涌现性失配(EM)。常规防御是定位并删除有害行,但作者的行定位器在留出测试中失败,且删除效果低于预期。由此提出新问题:给定固定的中毒行集合,修正它们是否优于删除它们?
AI.method: 在Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct上,用坏医疗建议与良性聊天数据的混合数据微调;预先选出四分之一的毒样本,分别采取删除或替换为同一prompt的修正答案两种处理,其余条件保持一致。进一步将修正比例提高到一半,并在第二个基座模型和第二个失配模型生物体上复现。还做了消融:仅改写毒样本但保留有害建议、使用数据集自带的正确回答、用修正数据对比通用聊天数据、用其他医疗prompt的修正对比毒prompt本身的修正、以及让改写者扮演谨慎避害助手。
AI.result: 替换毒样本使EM率降低约三分之一,并改善留出医疗问题的回答;删除同样样本几乎没有可测量效果。修正比例为一半时优势更大,且在第二个基座模型与第二个失配模型生物体上依然成立。替换内容起作用:仅改写、保留坏建议无明确收益;数据集自带的正确回答与作者改写器的效果大致相当。在再对齐训练中,少量修正数据训练优于等量通用聊天数据;其他医疗prompt的修正与毒prompt本身的修正效果相近;让改写者扮演谨慎避害助手相比普通修正没有可测量增益。
AI.conclusion: 在被测试的设定中,修正有害训练数据比删除它们更能降低涌现性失配;且关键在于替换内容的语义正确性而非形式改写,修正数据本身承担了主要的再对齐作用。

title: Procedural Core: A Compact Recurrent Initialization for Vision Transformers
summary: Transformers are typically trained from random initialization, requiring all their capabilities to emerge from large-scale optimization. Recent work showed that a small amount of abstract procedurally generated data can help acquire generic inductive structure at low cost. However, this adds a pretraining stage that must be repeated for every target model. We propose Procedural Core, an initialization strategy that captures this generic structure into a compact set of weights that can be reused across models. We train a minimal recurrent transformer on procedural data, then expand its weights to initialize transformers of arbitrary width and depth. The resulting initialization improves performance on image classification, self-supervised visual learning (DINO), and modeling natural language (FineWeb-Edu) and code (CodeParrot). For image classification, expanding a 1M-parameter core to initialize an 85M-parameter ViT-Base improves ImageNet top-1 accuracy by 2.2 pp over standard random initialization. Our analysis identifies recurrence as essential for learning compact weights that transfer across models. In ViTs, we localize a key benefit in the suppression of high-norm tokens that produces substantial improvements in zero-shot segmentation (ImageNet-S mAP 32.3 to 42.9), object localization (VOC07 CorLoc 9.9 to 18.4), and depth estimation (NYUv2 RMSE 1.104 to 0.998). This demonstrates that transformers need not start from a blank slate, and can be initialized with generic capabilities at low cost with no domain- or task-specific data.

AI.tldr: 提出 Procedural Core：将小型递归 Transformer 在程序化数据上训练后，把权重扩展以初始化任意宽度与深度的 Transformer，从而以极低成本注入通用归纳结构。
AI.motivation: 现有 Transformer 通常从随机初始化训练，全部能力需依赖大规模优化获得；而用少量程序化数据预训练虽能低成本获得通用归纳结构，却需为每个目标模型重复该预训练阶段，代价不可复用。
AI.method: 训练一个极小的递归 Transformer 于程序化数据上，得到紧凑权重集合，再通过权重扩展（width/depth expansion）将其初始化为任意宽度与深度的 Transformer。
AI.result: 在图像分类、DINO 自监督视觉学习、自然语言（FineWeb-Edu）与代码（CodeParrot）建模上均提升性能。将 1M 参数 core 扩展为 85M 的 ViT-Base，ImageNet top-1 较随机初始化提升 2.2 个百分点；ViT 中抑制高范数 token，使 ImageNet-S mAP 32.3→42.9、VOC07 CorLoc 9.9→18.4、NYUv2 RMSE 1.104→0.998。
AI.conclusion: Transformer 无需从空白状态开始训练，可用不含领域或任务特定数据的低成本通用能力初始化；递归结构是学习可跨模型迁移的紧凑权重的关键。

title: RLTL;DR: Self-improvement by Internalizing Self-generated Feedback
summary: The common paradigm of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is to let agents make multiple attempts at a task, and optimize towards the successful ones. This becomes problematic in the realms of self-improvement, where tasks are so difficult that the agent has a low or even no chance of success, and where there are no teacher models or example solutions to distill from. In this paper, we introduce RLTL;DR. After each failed attempt, we show the policy the verifier outputs and let it write its own feedback, in the form of a single TL;DR insight. The next rollout is conditioned on all previous insights, and we sequentially sample rollouts until a solution is found. Moreover, we enable backpropagation on the in-context insights to internalize a direct task to insight mapping. On challenging tool-calling and coding datasets (filtered to Pass@128=0), standard GRPO training of a Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking policy stays flat at a Pass@1 of 0% to 1%. RLTL;DR breaks through this learning barrier, achieving a Pass@1 of 14-31% with insights in context during training and, crucially, 12-13% when no insight is in context at eval time. We identify that the key is the task to insight internalization. To study this further, we reduce our approach to SFTL;DR, training only on (task, insight) tuples, without showing or backpropagating on any rollouts. Training on only 4k of these tuples recovers almost the full performance of RLTL;DR and classical SFT on full rollouts. This demonstrates a promising compacted training paradigm of the form "on this sort of task, keep this sort of thing in mind", which we hope to inspire future research on.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RLTL;DR：在失败尝试后让策略读取验证器输出并自写一条 TL;DR 洞察，后续 rollout 以历史洞察为上下文条件，并对上下文洞察做反向传播以内部化"任务→洞察"映射；在极难任务上突破 GRPO 的学习瓶颈。
AI.motivation: RLVR 的常规范式是多次尝试并优化成功样本，但在自我改进场景中任务过难、成功率接近零，且无教师模型或范例解可蒸馏，导致缺乏正样本梯度、学习停滞。
AI.method: 每轮失败后向策略展示验证器输出，由其生成一条 TL;DR 形式的自我反馈；下一次 rollout 以所有历史洞察为上下文条件，顺序采样直至找到解；同时对上下文洞察进行反向传播以内部化直接的任务到洞察映射。进一步简化为 SFTL;DR：仅在（任务，洞察）元组上做监督微调，不展示也不反传任何 rollout。
AI.result: 在 Pass@128=0 的困难工具调用与编程数据集上，Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking 的 GRPO 基线 Pass@1 停滞在 0%–1%；RLTL;DR 训练时带洞察达 14%–31%，评估时无洞察仍达 12%–13%。仅用 4k 条（任务，洞察）元组训练的 SFTL;DR 即可恢复 RLTL;DR 与全 rollout SFT 的近乎全部性能。
AI.conclusion: 关键在于任务到洞察的内部化能力：策略能将上下文洞察转化为参数化知识，在无洞察推理时依然有效。该工作提出了一种紧凑训练范式——"面对此类任务，记住此类要点"，并期望启发后续研究。

title: Co-Linguistics: AI-augmented Theory Construction in Linguistics
summary: LLMs have been studied in recent linguistics as potential models of humans' linguistic abilities. Here we discuss an entirely different use of AI, namely as a co-scientist, to help construct and assess linguistic theories (we refer to the result as "Co-Linguistics"). Since the 1960s, linguistics has developed theories that are in principle mathematically formalizable, often in the language of formal language theory or model theory. The AI revolution in mathematics will thus have consequences in linguistics-but with an essential twist: proving new theorems is rarely the linguist's goal. Rather, one seeks to find the best set of axioms to derive empirical statements. AI could accelerate research by making existing theories fully explicit, by comparing competing theories, and more ambitiously, by proposing new theories (in machine learning, this relates to "program induction"). It will also help assess theories by accelerating the identification and test of crucial predictions, thanks to unparalleled access to data (in machine learning, this relates to "active learning"). While the cycle from theory evaluation to theory construction may give rise to recursive and possibly autonomous improvement of linguistic theories, humans remain central: linguists provide scientific directions and evaluate theories conceptually, and experimental participants are needed to assess empirical predictions that are outside the reach of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将LLM用作"共同科学家"（Co-Linguistics），辅助语言学理论的构建与评估，形成理论评估到理论构建的循环，但人类仍居核心地位。
AI.motivation: LLM此前多被研究为人类语言能力的潜在模型，本文旨在探讨一种完全不同的用途：将AI作为辅助构建和评估语言学理论的"共同科学家"，因为语言学理论自20世纪60年代以来已可用形式语言理论或模型论等数学语言形式化，数学领域的AI革命因此将影响语言学。
AI.method: 提出"Co-Linguistics"框架：AI可将现有理论完全显式化、比较竞争理论、更提出新理论（对应机器学习中的"程序归纳"）；并通过空前的数据访问加速关键预测的识别与检验（对应"主动学习"），从而评估理论。
AI.result: 理论评估到理论构建的循环可能带来语言学理论的递归甚至自主改进。
AI.conclusion: 人类仍居核心：语言学家提供科学方向并从概念上评估理论，实验参与者用于评估超出LLM能力范围的实证预测。

title: Targeted Visual Counterfactual Explanations for Contrastive Vision-Language Model
summary: Current explanation methods for contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP mainly identify important regions without showing how to change the input in order to get a target prediction. We introduce Mask-guided Adaptive Counterfactual Explanations (MACE), a targeted visual counterfactual method designed specifically for CLIP zero-shot classification. MACE constructs an editable region from either source attribution or source-target attribution differences and expands the mask only when needed to reach a specified target class. A latent diffusion inpainting model then modifies the selected region, while a frozen CLIP model provides modification guidance and anchors the remaining image content to the original input. We evaluate MACE on ImageNet, Food-101, Oxford Pets, and CUB-200. The source-mask variant achieves the highest target top-1 success rate across all four datasets, while the difference-mask variant produces the smallest pixel level and perceptual changes and the best realism scores. Both variants improve proximity and realism over a Stable Diffusion-only baseline using the same generative backbone. These results show that adaptive mask-guided editing produces effective CLIP counterfactuals. They further reveal a tradeoff between counterfactual validity and source-image preservation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MACE，一种面向CLIP零样本分类的定向视觉反事实解释方法，通过自适应掩码与潜扩散修复生成有效且真实的图像修改。
AI.motivation: 现有对比视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）的解释方法主要定位重要区域，但无法说明如何修改输入以获得目标预测，缺乏定向反事实能力。
AI.method: MACE从源归因或源-目标归因差异构建可编辑区域，并仅在需要达到目标类别时扩展掩码；随后用潜扩散修复模型修改所选区域，同时由冻结的CLIP模型提供修改引导，并将剩余图像内容锚定到原始输入。
AI.result: 在ImageNet、Food-101、Oxford Pets和CUB-200上评估：源掩码变体在四个数据集上取得最高的目标top-1成功率；差异掩码变体产生最小的像素级与感知变化，并获得最佳真实性分数。两种变体在邻近性和真实性上均优于仅使用Stable Diffusion的同生成主干基线。
AI.conclusion: 自适应掩码引导编辑能够生成有效的CLIP反事实解释；同时揭示了反事实有效性与源图像保持之间的权衡关系。

title: Evaluating and Benchmarking the System One Model Jev
comment: Code available at github.com/AppliedMachineLearning-Lab/jev-benchmarking, model responses at doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23039006
summary: Jev is a commercial System One model from TypeSafe AI that does not generate text: given a state and typed questions, it returns a choice from fixed options, a position on a rubric, or the probability that a statement is true, with probabilities the vendor describes as calibrated. Such models target small decisions in information access pipelines, such as routing queries, checking grounding, moderating content, or rating against a rubric. We evaluate Jev (jev-1.13.0) zero-shot on 37 datasets spanning classification, routing, natural language inference, reading comprehension, commonsense reasoning, moderation, legal clause analysis and rubric scoring, with one frozen template per dataset and full evaluation splits: 346,009 requests for under USD 10. For reference, we score Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma-4-E4B on identical requests via their exact next-token probabilities over the options. Jev reaches 95-99% accuracy on IMDB, SST-2, HellaSwag and ARC and 86.7% on Belebele across 122 languages. It beats Qwen on 27 of 37 datasets, with none of Qwen's nine leads outside the bootstrap intervals, and Gemma on all 37. All three models degrade on low-resource languages, fine-grained or noisy labels, and rubric-based quality judgments. Jev's choice probabilities are well calibrated and support selective prediction. Binary probabilities rank well but are poorly placed relative to a fixed 0.5 threshold; thresholds tuned on training data raise micro-F1 on UNFAIR-ToS from 0.50 to 0.75. Jev answers MMLU's calculation-heavy questions more accurately than other MMLU questions (94% vs. 91%), whereas both open models, and all three on C-Eval, find them harder. Rotating the options leaves Jev's accuracy unchanged and withholding the question drops it to near chance, ruling out shallow memorization but not memorized question-answer pairs. We release the code, harness and all raw responses.

AI.tldr: 该论文零样本评测商用系统一模型 Jev（jev-1.13.0）在 37 个数据集上的表现，并对照 Qwen3.8-27B 与 Gemma-4-E4B，覆盖分类、路由、推理、审核、法律条款与评分量表等任务。
AI.motivation: Jev 为非生成式判别模型，针对信息获取流程中的小决策（如查询路由、事实性核查、内容审核、量表评分），其宣称的校准概率对下游阈值化决策至关重要，因此需要独立的零样本评测以验证其在多任务、多语言场景下的准确率与概率校准性。
AI.method: 对 Jev（jev-1.13.0）在 37 个数据集上进行零样本评测，每个数据集冻结一个模板并使用完整评测划分，共 346,009 次请求，成本低于 10 美元；同时在相同请求上以精确下一 token 概率的方式评测 Qwen3.8-27B 与 Gemma-4-E4B；并开展选项轮换、扣留问题等消融以检验记忆化。
AI.result: Jev 在 IMDB、SST-2、HellaSwag、ARC 上达 95-99% 准确率，Belebele 跨 122 种语言达 86.7%；在 37 个数据集中有 27 个优于 Qwen（Qwen 的 9 项优势均落在 bootstrap 区间外无显著差异），并全部优于 Gemma。三个模型在低资源语言、细粒度或噪声标签、量表式质量判断上均出现性能下降。Jev 的选择概率校准良好并支持选择性预测；二元概率排序良好但相对固定 0.5 阈值定位不佳，用训练数据调阈值可将 UNFAIR-ToS 的 micro-F1 从 0.50 提升至 0.75。Jev 在 MMLU 计算类题上表现优于其他题型（94% vs. 91%），而两个开源模型相反，三者在 C-Eval 上均认为计算类更难。轮换选项不改变 Jev 准确率，扣留问题则降至近随机水平，可排除浅层记忆但无法排除记忆问答对。
AI.conclusion: Jev 作为非生成式系统一模型在多任务、多语言零样本场景下具备较强且相对稳健的准确率与校准性，适用于需要阈值化小决策的信息获取管线；但其在低资源语言、细粒度/噪声标签与量表评分上仍有退化，且二元概率的固定阈值需重新校准。作者公开代码、评测框架与全部原始响应。

title: VoxelSage: Tool-Augmented 3D CT Analysis and Simulator-Shielded Sequential Resection Planning for Liver Tumors
comment: 21 pages, 10 figures. Technical report. Code at https://github.com/ZJUMAI/VoxelSage
summary: Preoperative liver-tumor assessment requires segmentation, physical-space measurement, visual evidence, and resection planning from the same three-dimensional CT volume. Existing tools often handle these steps separately, while language models cannot reliably compute physical measurements from CT. To provide an integrated workflow, we present VoxelSage, a multi-modal system for two- and three-dimensional visualization, liver-tumor analysis, and preoperative resection planning. Its dual-port architecture separates language-model orchestration from image computation: Port A interprets requests and selects skills, while Port B applies them to CT volumes and segmentation masks and returns structured results. Keeping physical measurements in Port B prevents the LLM from computing them directly and reduces the risk of fabricated numerical results. Eight built-in skills support quantitative analysis, visual evidence generation, three-dimensional reconstruction, segmentation refinement, and sequential resection planning; user-defined skills can extend these functions. For sequence planning, a behavior-cloned neural ranker orders candidate resection targets, while a simulator-based shield checks them against predefined constraints. Across 256 unseen simulator scenes, this approach reduced mean simulated time from 34.274 to 33.388 min (0.886 min, 2.59%) and mean simulated blood loss from 300.847 to 183.852 mL (116.995 mL, 38.89%) relative to a deterministic baseline. These results demonstrate system integration and simulator-level performance, not clinical efficacy or safety. The public implementation is available at https://github.com/ZJUMAI/VoxelSage.

AI.tldr: VoxelSage 是一个面向肝脏肿瘤术前评估的多模态系统，通过双端口架构将语言模型编排与图像计算分离，集成八项内置技能与可扩展技能，在 256 个仿真场景中相比确定性基线将模拟时间与模拟出血量分别降低 2.59% 与 38.89%。
AI.motivation: 术前肝脏肿瘤评估需要在同一三维 CT 体数据上完成分割、物理空间测量、视觉证据生成与切除规划，但现有工具通常将这些步骤割裂处理；同时语言模型无法可靠地从 CT 中计算物理测量值，存在虚构数值的风险，因此需要一个集成化的多模态工作流系统。
AI.method: 提出 VoxelSage 多模态系统，支持二维/三维可视化、肝脏肿瘤分析与术前切除规划。其核心为双端口架构：Port A 负责语言模型编排，解析请求并选择技能；Port B 负责图像计算，将技能应用于 CT 体数据与分割掩膜并返回结构化结果，从而避免 LLM 直接计算物理量。系统内置八项技能，覆盖定量分析、视觉证据生成、三维重建、分割优化与序贯切除规划，并支持用户自定义技能扩展。序贯规划中采用行为克隆神经排序器对候选切除目标排序，并由基于仿真的屏蔽机制依据预设约束进行校验。
AI.result: 在 256 个未见过的仿真场景中，相较于确定性基线，平均模拟时间由 34.274 min 降至 33.388 min（减少 0.886 min，2.59%），平均模拟出血量由 300.847 mL 降至 183.852 mL（减少 116.995 mL，38.89%）。作者强调结果仅体现系统集成与仿真层面的性能，不代表临床有效性或安全性。
AI.conclusion: VoxelSage 通过双端口架构有效整合了肝脏肿瘤术前评估的多个环节，在仿真环境中展现出改善序贯切除规划指标的能力，验证了系统集成的可行性；但其临床效果与安全性仍需进一步验证。公开实现见 https://github.com/ZJUMAI/VoxelSage。

title: Texture Space Material Diffusion
summary: We present a method for generating high quality materials for 3D objects entirely in texture space. We finetune a video diffusion transformer for text-guided material generation, multi-view material generation, and material upscaling. Our key insight is to use the known projection from image space to texture space, enabling the diffusion process to generalize across arbitrary geometries and texture parameterizations. This approach also avoids the view consistency issues inherent in video and multi-view diffusion models. Because texture space is two dimensional, we can reuse the strong priors of pretrained video diffusion models. We apply our method to high quality material reconstruction from posed photos captured under unknown lighting, as well as to text- and image guided material generation. Our method can scale to high resolutions (8K), 100+ input views, and neural material representations. In quantitative and qualitative evaluations we show state-of-the-art results for material generation and reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种完全在纹理空间生成3D物体高质量材质的方法，通过微调视频扩散Transformer支持文本引导、多视角及超分辨率材质生成，在材质生成与重建上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有视频与多视角扩散模型在材质生成中存在视角一致性问题，且难以泛化到任意几何与纹理参数化。作者希望利用图像空间到纹理空间的已知投影，规避一致性缺陷，并借助预训练视频扩散模型的强先验。
AI.method: 利用图像空间到纹理空间的已知投影，将扩散过程置于二维纹理空间进行，从而规避视频/多视角模型固有的视角一致性问题，并复用预训练视频扩散模型的强先验。在此基础上微调视频扩散Transformer，用于文本引导材质生成、多视角材质生成与材质超分辨率。方法可扩展至8K分辨率、100+输入视角以及神经材质表示，并应用于未知光照下已定位照片的高质量材质重建及文本/图像引导材质生成。
AI.result: 在定量与定性评估中，材质生成与重建均取得当前最优（state-of-the-art）结果；方法可扩展至8K高分辨率、100+输入视角和神经材质表示。
AI.conclusion: 在纹理空间进行扩散建模可有效复用视频扩散先验并避免视角一致性问题，为高分辨率、多视角的3D材质生成与重建提供了可扩展的通用方案，并在相关任务上达到SOTA。

title: Exemplar2VQA: A Scalable Exemplar-Driven Visual Question Answering Generation Framework via Multi-Agent Coding
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 33 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables
summary: Advancing spatial intelligence in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of complex, scalable 3D question-answer (QA) data. While manual annotation is labor-intensive, directly utilizing LLMs to synthesize these QA pairs often fails due to their inherent deficiencies in spatial and geometric computation. We introduce Exemplar2VQA, a scalable exemplar-driven visual question answering generation framework that rapidly synthesizes large-scale spatial QA pairs in simulated environments via multi-agent coding. By equipping collaborative agents with a meticulously designed library of geometric utilities, Exemplar2VQA bypasses LLMs' spatial reasoning flaws through deterministic code execution. Crucially, the framework exhibits remarkable versatility: taking diverse static object-centric spatial query templates as exemplars, it seamlessly and autonomously scales them into massive, high-fidelity synthetic datasets. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL (3B/7B) exclusively on Exemplar2VQA-generated synthetic indoor data yields significant performance improvements across various diverse benchmarks. Furthermore, its effectiveness is not limited to in-domain indoor datasets but also robustly extends to outdoor and mixed-scene benchmarks. These results establish Exemplar2VQA as a scalable and powerful paradigm for bridging the sim-to-real gap in Embodied AI. Our code is at https://github.com/yingjiayu12/Exemplar2VQA

AI.tldr: Exemplar2VQA：一种基于示例驱动、多智能体编码的3D空间VQA数据合成框架，利用确定性代码执行绕开LLM空间推理缺陷，实现大规模合成数据生成并显著提升MLLM空间智能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型（MLLM）空间智能发展受限于复杂、可扩展3D问答数据的稀缺。人工标注成本高，而直接用LLM合成QA对因其空间与几何计算能力不足而失败。
AI.method: 提出Exemplar2VQA框架：以示例驱动、多智能体编码方式，在模拟环境中快速合成大规模空间QA对。为协作智能体配备精心设计的几何工具库，通过确定性代码执行规避LLM的空间推理缺陷。以多样化的静态、以物体为中心的空间查询模板为示例，自主扩展为大规模高保真合成数据集。
AI.result: 仅用Exemplar2VQA生成的合成室内数据微调Qwen2.5-VL（3B/7B），在多个多样化基准上取得显著性能提升；效果不限于域内室内数据集，还可稳健泛化到室外及混合场景基准。
AI.conclusion: Exemplar2VQA为弥合具身AI中的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）差距提供了一种可扩展且强大的范式。代码开源。

title: Tracing the Evidence: Faithful Token Attribution Through Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, yet the visual and textual evidence supporting the generated responses remains difficult to identify. Faithful token attribution explains an LVLM's response by assigning scores that rank image and prompt tokens by how much the model relies on them, such that removing higher-ranked tokens causes the likelihood of the generated response to drop more rapidly. However, existing token-attribution methods have been developed mainly for text-based language models, and our empirical study reveals two challenges when complex multimodal sources are involved. First, the joint image-text attribution can underrepresent visual evidence relative to text, obscuring the image regions supporting the response. Second, visual evidence may influence the generated response through multiple intermediate reasoning paths, while existing methods trace only a limited subset of these paths, causing important visual contributions to be underestimated. Motivated by these insights, we introduce VTrace, a multimodal token-attribution framework that traces input contributions through intermediate reasoning and calibrates attribution scores across modalities. VTrace constructs pairwise attributions that highlight token-specific contributions and aggregates all forward attribution paths in closed form to account for both direct and indirect contributions. Cross-modal calibration then rescales image and text attribution scores using modality contributions estimated from response-likelihood changes, enabling a unified ranking of input tokens. Evaluations against seven baselines across six visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the superior attribution faithfulness. Project page: https://vtrace-attribution.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出 VTrace 多模态 token 归因框架，通过追踪中间推理路径并做跨模态校准，提升 LVLM 响应归因的忠实度。
AI.motivation: 现有 token 归因方法主要针对纯文本语言模型；在复杂多模态场景下存在两个问题：图文联合归因会低估视觉证据（相对文本被淹没，图像区域不清晰）；视觉证据可能经多条中间推理路径影响响应，而现有方法只追踪有限子集，导致视觉贡献被低估。
AI.method: VTrace 通过中间推理追踪输入贡献并校准跨模态得分。其一，构造成对归因（pairwise attribution）以突出 token 特定贡献；其二，以闭式形式聚合所有前向归因路径，兼顾直接与间接贡献；其三，跨模态校准（cross-modal calibration）利用由响应似然变化估计得到的模态贡献，对图像与文本归因分数重缩放，实现输入 token 的统一排序。
AI.result: 在六个视觉推理基准上，与七个基线方法对比，VTrace 展现出更优的归因忠实度。
AI.conclusion: VTrace 证明：显式建模多条中间推理路径并校准模态间归因尺度，能同时缓解视觉证据被低估与路径覆盖不全的问题，从而获得更忠实可信的多模态 token 归因。

title: Are In-Context Images Worth 10 Dimensions?
summary: There has been significant work on understanding the In-Context Learning capabilities of Large Language Models, especially on the induction circuit. For a few-shot classification task, the induction circuit leverages linear representations of each labeled example in-context in order to classify an unlabeled query. However, few works focus on how those linear representations are built in the first place. Leveraging the expressivity of the vision modality compared to text, we uncover a Shared Discriminative Geometry (SDG) inside Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs). It is a low-dimensional space, shared across all image classification tasks, in which in-context images are compressed into linearly separable representations later used to perform classification. We observe that this is the result of the model performing a dimensionality reduction of vision representations in early layers. In order to explain this phenomenon: (1) We show analytically that linear self-attention can perform a dimensionality reduction by projecting in-context data onto its principal components, with each layer implementing one gradient descent step toward this objective. (2) We provide evidence that trained LVLMs reduce the dimensionality of vision representations in early layers via a similar mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LVLM中上下文学习线性表征的来源，发现存在一个跨任务共享的低维判别几何空间（SDG），并证明其由早期层的主成分降维形成。
AI.motivation: 已有工作多关注归纳电路如何利用上下文中已标注样本的线性表征进行分类，但少有研究探讨这些线性表征最初是如何构建的。作者借助视觉模态相比文本更强的表达能力，试图揭示LVLM内部线性表征的形成机制。
AI.method: (1) 分析性地证明线性自注意力可通过将上下文数据投影到其主成分上实现降维，每一层相当于朝该目标执行一步梯度下降；(2) 通过实验验证训练后的LVLM在早期层以类似机制降低视觉表征的维度。
AI.result: 发现LVLM中存在共享判别几何（SDG）：一个跨所有图像分类任务共享的低维空间，上下文图像在其中被压缩为线性可分的表征，后续用于分类；该现象源于模型早期层对视觉表征的降维。理论与实验证据均支持这一机制。
AI.conclusion: LVLM的上下文分类能力依赖于早期层通过类主成分分析的降维构建的共享低维判别空间，线性自注意力可逐层以梯度下降方式逼近该降维目标，为理解上下文学习表征的形成提供了机制性解释。

title: Corpus-Guided Dual-Path Propagation for Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation supports multi-hop retrieval by organizing corpus information into graphs. However, existing relation-free graph retrieval methods rely primarily on query-sentence similarity to search for evidence. This can exclude useful bridging evidence with low query similarity and activate incidental entities unrelated to the reasoning chain. In this paper, we propose a simple and effective approach called NexusRAG, which augments the relation-free Tri-Graph with a corpus-level entity neighborhood structure derived from joint entity co-occurrence and semantic similarity. NexusRAG employs this structure to guide two complementary propagation paths: neighborhood-constrained semantic propagation through sentences identifies the query-relevant entity frontier, while direct structural propagation between neighboring entities expands that frontier to structurally related entities. The propagated entity weights also inform neighborhood-aware passage initialization for Personalized PageRank. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks and a domain-specific subset of GraphRAG-Bench show that NexusRAG consistently outperforms existing approaches. On the GraphRAG-Bench subset, NexusRAG achieves the highest evidence recall in all question categories, exceeding baselines by 4.2-8.1 points. The implementation code is available at https://github.com/Jacob-biu/NexusRAG.

AI.tldr: 提出 NexusRAG，通过引入语料级实体邻域结构改进无关系图检索，缓解低相似度桥接证据被忽略及无关实体被激活的问题，在多跳问答基准上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有无关系图检索方法主要依赖查询-句子相似度来搜索证据，这会导致两个问题：一是低查询相似度但有用的桥接证据被排除；二是与推理链无关的偶然实体被激活，影响多跳检索质量。
AI.method: NexusRAG 在无关系 Tri-Graph 上增加语料级实体邻域结构，该结构由联合实体共现与语义相似度构建。基于此结构设计两条互补传播路径：通过句子的邻域约束语义传播识别查询相关实体前沿；相邻实体间的直接结构传播将该前沿扩展到结构相关实体。传播得到的实体权重还用于 Personalized PageRank 的邻域感知段落初始化。
AI.result: 在三个多跳问答基准以及 GraphRAG-Bench 的领域特定子集上，NexusRAG 一致优于现有方法。在 GraphRAG-Bench 子集上，NexusRAG 在所有问题类别中取得最高的证据召回率，超过基线 4.2–8.1 个点。
AI.conclusion: NexusRAG 是一种简单有效的方法，通过语料级实体邻域结构与双路径传播机制，提升了多跳检索的证据召回与整体性能，代码已开源。

title: MeanFlowAdvantage: Stable Reward Fine-Tuning for Few-Step Average-Velocity Generators
summary: MeanFlow enables efficient few-step generation by predicting interval-average velocities, but this representation creates a mismatch for reward fine-tuning: existing advantage-based objectives are typically defined on instantaneous velocities or equivalent $x_0$-space predictions, whereas inference directly uses the learned average-velocity map. We introduce MeanFlowAdvantage, a signed advantage-weighted least-squares objective for average-velocity generators. Our key construction uses a shared, detached MeanFlow derivative correction to express the reward objective in prediction space while making rollout and reference regularization exact penalties on the average-velocity network deployed at inference. The resulting formulation preserves MeanFlow's native few-step sampler and provides a direct mechanism for transferring reward improvements to the deployed flow map. On SD3.5-Medium, MeanFlowAdvantage improves all eight reported metrics over the matched four-step MeanFlowNFT baseline and, with only four NFEs, matches or exceeds the 40-step DiffusionNFT baseline on six of eight metrics. The same objective also transfers to DNA promoter design, where it supports both teacher-free on-policy RL for a generator defined on a manifold and teacher-guided reward-graded distillation, with the latter yielding the lowest one-step Sei profile MSE among the compared configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出 MeanFlowAdvantage，一种面向区间平均速度生成器的符号化优势加权最小二乘目标，实现奖励微调，保留 MeanFlow 原生少步采样器，在 SD3.5-Medium 四步设置下超越匹配基线并在六项指标上追平/超越 40 步 DiffusionNFT，并成功迁移到 DNA 启动子设计。
AI.motivation: MeanFlow 通过预测区间平均速度实现高效少步生成，但该表示与奖励微调存在不匹配：现有基于优势的目标通常定义在瞬时速度或等价的 x0 空间预测上，而推理时直接使用学习到的平均速度映射，导致奖励优化目标与部署模型不一致。
AI.method: 提出 MeanFlowAdvantage：面向平均速度生成器的符号化优势加权最小二乘目标。核心构造是使用共享且 detach 的 MeanFlow 导数修正，将奖励目标表达在预测空间中，同时使 rollout 与参考正则化成为部署于推理的平均速度网络上的精确惩罚项。该形式保留 MeanFlow 原生少步采样器，并提供将奖励改进直接迁移到部署流映射的机制。
AI.result: 在 SD3.5-Medium 上，MeanFlowAdvantage 在全部八项报告指标上优于匹配的四步 MeanFlowNFT 基线，且仅用 4 次 NFE 就在八项指标中的六项上达到或超过 40 步 DiffusionNFT 基线。同一目标还迁移至 DNA 启动子设计，支持流形上定义生成器的无教师在线策略 RL 与教师引导的奖励分级蒸馏，其中后者在所比较配置中取得最低的单步 Sei profile MSE。
AI.conclusion: MeanFlowAdvantage 通过将奖励目标对齐到推理所用的平均速度表示，弥合了少步生成与奖励微调之间的表示错配，在图像生成与 DNA 启动子设计两类任务上均验证了有效性与可迁移性。

title: KUPAS MASTER: Distilling the Tacit Expertise of Master Practitioners into Agent-Ready Experience Corpora
comment: Technical Report. Official website: https://lsf.kupasai.com/ Report homepage: https://tongjiai4e.github.io/KUPAS-MASTER-Report/
summary: Experienced professionals know more than just facts and conclusions. They know which cues matter, why a judgment is reasonable, and which action to take. Routine work records often leave out this tacit knowledge, making it difficult for Large Language Model (LLM) agents to use professional experience effectively. We introduce KUPAS MASTER, an experience engineering platform built around nine-layer cognitive corpus construction. It turns heterogeneous work records and practitioner interviews into traceable, reusable experience corpora for agents. Six case elements preserve the task process: context, cues, judgment, action, boundaries, and outcomes. Nine-layer cognitive corpus construction organizes tacit experience along nine extraction dimensions and stores the resulting assets in six libraries: rules, constraints, best practices, negative examples, corner cases, and skills. Semantic alignment, individual experience distillation, organizational consolidation, and cross-review preserve source evidence, conditions of use, and unresolved disagreements. The platform packages these assets into callable skills with explicit inputs, steps, dependencies, and stopping conditions, connecting experience collection to task execution and evaluation feedback. Using authorized samples from 20 randomly selected practitioners, the platform processed 1,576 source files into 23,024 individual experience records and 13,113 organizational assets. The evaluation spans multiple professional domains. Under common task inputs and scoring criteria, the base model, raw corpus retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and KUPAS MASTER agent scored 70.63, 79.75, and 89.58, respectively. The KUPAS MASTER agent improved on raw-corpus RAG in all seven scoring dimensions. The platform provides a practical path from individual tacit experience to organizational knowledge and agent capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 KUPAS MASTER 经验工程平台，通过九层认知语料库构建，将异构工作记录与从业者访谈转化为可追溯、可复用的经验语料，并封装为可调用技能；在 20 位从业者授权样本上处理 1,576 个源文件，生成 23,024 条个人经验记录与 13,113 项组织资产。评测中基础模型、原始语料 RAG 与 KUPAS MASTER 智能体得分分别为 70.63、79.75、89.58，后者在全部七个评分维度上均优于原始语料 RAG。
AI.motivation: 经验丰富的专业人员掌握的不只是事实与结论，还包括哪些线索重要、判断为何合理、应采取何种行动等隐性知识。常规工作记录往往遗漏此类隐性知识，导致大语言模型智能体难以有效利用专业经验。因此需要一套将个体隐性经验转化为组织知识并赋能智能体的工程化方法。
AI.method: 提出经验工程平台 KUPAS MASTER，核心为九层认知语料库构建。以六个案例要素保留任务过程：情境、线索、判断、行动、边界、结果；沿九个抽取维度组织隐性经验，并将资产存入六个库：规则、约束、最佳实践、反面案例、边缘案例、技能。通过语义对齐、个体经验蒸馏、组织整合与交叉评审，保留来源证据、使用条件与未解决分歧；最终封装为具有明确输入、步骤、依赖与停止条件的可调用技能，打通经验采集、任务执行与评测反馈闭环。
AI.result: 使用 20 位随机抽取从业者的授权样本，平台将 1,576 个源文件处理为 23,024 条个人经验记录和 13,113 项组织资产。评测覆盖多个专业领域，在相同任务输入与评分标准下，基础模型、原始语料 RAG 与 KUPAS MASTER 智能体得分分别为 70.63、79.75 与 89.58，KUPAS MASTER 智能体在全部七个评分维度上均优于原始语料 RAG。
AI.conclusion: KUPAS MASTER 提供了一条从个体隐性经验到组织知识、再到智能体能力的可行路径，验证了结构化经验工程对提升 LLM 智能体专业任务表现的有效性。

title: When Models Don't Manipulate Manifolds: The Geometry of a Comparison Task
summary: One of the current premises of mechanistic interpretability research is that detailed accounts of the geometry of neural network representations can tell us how models perform computations, and how to effectively intervene on them. While low dimensional manifolds have been observed for multiple concepts in the literature (e.g. numbers encoded on helices, days of the week on a circle, ...), with structure believed to reflect properties of data and tasks, the extent to which models rely on them for computation, and how they manipulate them, remains unclear. We characterize precisely the geometry of computation in a number-comparison task, as an abstraction of comparison for decision making, and how models utilize geometry in an elegant fashion to implement it. Specifically, we study the causal geometry of number comparison in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, a capable and widely studied open-weight model, and find Qwen largely uses linear representations of numbers despite the presence of curved geometry. To compare two numbers, the model first encodes each number along a vector and adds the two representations using attention and the residual connection, bringing them into a shared space in the residual stream. Then, the model uses MLP neurons to compare the pair of numbers on local regions in this shared space, which correspond to smaller intervals of input numbers, and combines these to obtain the position of the maximum. In fact, this reliance on linear representations for comparison also persists when the model compares three numbers. Our findings demonstrate that the manifold hypothesis can co-exist with linear representations: while concepts that are ordered may have manifold structure in representations, the model may use an underlying linear structure of the concept in certain computations.

AI.tldr: 本文精确刻画了Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct在数字比较任务中的"因果几何"：尽管数字表征存在弯曲流形结构，模型实际计算主要依赖线性表征，通过注意力与残差连接将两个数字映射到残差流的共享空间，再由MLP神经元在局部区域比较并组合出最大值位置；该线性机制在三数比较中同样成立。
AI.motivation: 机制可解释性研究的一个前提是：神经网络表征的几何结构能揭示模型如何计算以及如何干预。文献中已观察到数字呈螺旋、星期呈圆环等低维流形，但模型是否真正依赖这些流形进行计算、如何操纵它们，仍不清楚。本文以数字比较这一决策抽象的典型任务为切入点，考察几何在计算中的实际因果作用。
AI.method: 作者研究Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct在数字比较任务中的因果几何。方法上通过因果干预分析表征与计算的对应关系，追踪数字信息在注意力、残差连接与MLP神经元中的流动路径，并检验三数比较情形下该机制是否延续。
AI.result: Qwen虽然存在弯曲几何，但比较任务中主要使用数字的线性表征。模型先用一个向量编码每个数字，借助注意力与残差连接将两个表征相加，使其进入残差流的共享空间；随后MLP神经元在该共享空间的局部区域（对应较小的输入数字区间）上进行比较，并将局部结果组合以确定最大值的位置。这一对线性表征的依赖在三数比较中依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 流形假设可与线性表征共存：有序概念在表征层面可能具有流形结构，但在特定计算（如比较）中，模型可能利用该概念底层的线性结构。这说明几何结构的存在并不等同于模型在计算中依赖该结构。

title: Med-RADIO: Reducing All Medical Domains Into One via Multi-Teacher Distillation
summary: The rapid expansion of large-scale medical datasets and computational resources has driven significant progress in medical foundation models. Given the inherent heterogeneity of medical imaging modalities, current research mainly follows two paths: specialized models optimized for specific modalities, and generalist models designed to handle multiple modalities. However, medical generalist models suffer from both insufficient training data scale relative to natural image generalists and inadequate domain-specific depth relative to medical specialists. Empirically, generalist models establish a cross-modality performance baseline, while specialists define the performance ceiling within their respective domains. To elevate this baseline toward these ceilings, we propose Med-RADIO, a medical multi-teacher distillation framework that Reduces All Domains Into One by compressing complementary expertise from multiple domain-specific teachers into a unified medical vision foundation model. Our method curates both generalist and specialist teachers, allocates modality-aligned distillation streams to reorganize generalist pretraining data so it matches specialist domains, and uses a balanced loss to prevent any single teacher from dominating the distillation process. On internal and external classification benchmarks spanning five modalities, Med-RADIO improves over strong medical generalists under linear probing and remains competitive with representative specialists on most evaluated modalities. Code is available at https://github.com/CAIR-HKISI/Med-RADIO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Med-RADIO，一个医学多教师蒸馏框架，通过将多个领域专家教师的知识压缩进统一的医学视觉基础模型，实现"多域合一"，在五模态分类任务上提升通用模型表现并接近专家模型水平。
AI.motivation: 大规模医学数据集与算力的发展推动了医学基础模型进步。由于医学影像模态高度异质，现有研究分为两条路线：面向特定模态的专家模型和多模态通用模型。但医学通用模型相比自然图像通用模型训练数据规模不足，相比医学专家模型领域深度不够。经验上，通用模型给出跨模态性能基线，专家模型定义各自领域上限，因此需要将基线提升至接近上限。
AI.method: 提出 Med-RADIO 医学多教师蒸馏框架，将多个领域专家教师模型（Reduce All Domains Into One）的互补知识压缩为统一的医学视觉基础模型。具体包括：构建通用教师与专家教师集合；分配模态对齐的蒸馏流，重组通用预训练数据以匹配专家领域；采用平衡损失防止单一教师在蒸馏中占据主导。
AI.result: 在覆盖五种模态的内部与外部分类基准上，Med-RADIO 在线性探测下优于强医学通用模型，并在大多数评估模态上与代表性专家模型保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过多教师蒸馏将通用与专家教师知识融合，Med-RADIO 有效将跨模态通用基线提升至接近专家模型上限，验证了多域知识压缩为统一医学视觉基础模型的可行性。代码已开源。

title: PAIQ: Patch-Aligned Semantic Injection via Residual Rotation
summary: Language-aligned and self-supervised visual encoders offer complementary strengths in semantic abstraction and spatial detail. Harnessing this complementarity requires enriching local features while retaining distinctions between semantically related patches. We introduce PAIQ, a patch-aligned semantic injection framework that combines content-based cross-encoder matching with orthogonally constrained residual updates. Using DINOv3 patch features as the spatial base, PAIQ aggregates complementary SigLIP features through joint source allocation and injects the aggregate--base differences through a shared orthogonal transformation Q. This rotation adapts update directions while preserving residual norms and pairwise angles. For fixed projected features, we derive conditions for patch separability under similar semantic aggregates and show that rotation adds a nonnegative separation term over direct interpolation when the aggregate is shared. Only the projection and fusion parameters are trained; both visual encoders and the language model remain frozen, and fusion retains 196 visual tokens. Across diverse language backbones, PAIQ yields broad gains in judge-assessed correctness and reductions in hallucination severity over single-encoder interfaces on image description and visual question answering. On the 2B and 9B Qwen backbones, this compact interface outperforms the strongest evaluated fusion or token-compression baselines by about 2.9 correctness points on average.

AI.tldr: PAIQ是一个补丁对齐的语义注入框架，通过基于内容的跨编码器匹配和正交约束的残差更新，将SigLIP特征注入DINOv3空间基座，在不训练视觉编码器和语言模型的前提下提升多模态任务表现。
AI.motivation: 语言对齐与自监督视觉编码器在语义抽象和空间细节上各有优势，二者互补。但利用这种互补性需要在丰富局部特征的同时，保持语义相关补丁之间的区分度，这是该文要解决的核心问题。
AI.method: 以DINOv3补丁特征为空间基座，通过联合源分配聚合互补的SigLIP特征，并借助共享正交变换Q注入"聚合-基座"差异。该旋转在保持残差范数和成对夹角的同时调整更新方向。仅训练投影与融合参数，视觉编码器和语言模型均冻结，融合保留196个视觉token。
AI.result: 在多种语言骨干上，PAIQ在图像描述和视觉问答任务中相比单编码器接口取得更广的评判正确率提升和幻觉严重程度降低。在2B和9B Qwen骨干上，该紧凑接口平均比最强的融合或token压缩基线高出约2.9个正确率点。
AI.conclusion: 理论分析给出了相似语义聚合下补丁可分性的条件，并证明在聚合共享时旋转相较直接插值引入非负可分性增益。PAIQ以高效紧凑的融合接口实现了跨编码器的语义互补，显著优于现有融合与压缩基线。

title: EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?
summary: Autonomous agents have made rapid progress in general-purpose computer use, yet reliable automation of professional industrial engineering remains out of reach. Engineering workflows require reasoning over geometric and physical constraints and keeping dependencies consistent across software and design stages. We present EngiWorld, a benchmark designed around the capabilities that real engineering projects require, from operating a single application to solving engineering problems end to end. It contains 1,301 expert-curated tasks spanning six engineering domains (CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and DCC) and 26 professional software applications, with both GUI and CLI interfaces. The tasks are organized into six types, corresponding to capabilities that real engineering projects require. We further introduce an artifact-centric evaluation methodology built on a unified suite of domain verifiers. The verifiers programmatically check whether final and intermediate artifacts are geometrically valid, physically feasible, and compliant with design rules. Beyond binary success, they also score how well optimized designs meet their specifications. Evaluation of seven frontier models reveals a substantial capability gap: the strongest model scores only 44.7/100, and just 3.6% of runs on tasks that require cross-software coordination succeed. EngiWorld provides a rigorous foundation for measuring progress toward agents that operate professional engineering software end to end.

AI.tldr: 提出EngiWorld基准，面向专业工业工程软件端到端自动化，涵盖六域、26款软件、1301项任务，并采用基于统一领域验证器的产物中心评测方法。
AI.motivation: 通用计算机使用智能体进展迅速，但专业工业工程的可靠自动化仍难以实现。工程工作流需对几何与物理约束进行推理，并在软件与设计各阶段保持依赖一致，现有评测难以衡量此类能力。
AI.method: 构建EngiWorld基准，包含1301项专家策划任务，覆盖CAD、CAE、CAM、BIM、EDA、DCC六大工程域与26款专业软件，支持GUI与CLI接口；任务按真实工程所需能力分为六类。提出产物中心评测方法，基于统一领域验证器套件，程序化检查最终与中间产物的几何有效性、物理可行性与设计规则合规性，并对设计优化相对规格的符合程度评分。
AI.result: 对七个前沿模型的评测显示存在显著能力差距：最强模型仅得44.7/100；在需要跨软件协同的任务上，仅3.6%的运行成功。
AI.conclusion: EngiWorld为衡量智能体端到端操作专业工程软件的进展提供了严格基础。

title: Reader Proficiency Shapes Layer-wise Surprisal Profiles
summary: Reading behaviour varies not only with linguistic input, but also with reader proficiency. In this study, we investigate whether the layer-wise relationship between surprisal from large language models (LLMs) and human gaze behaviour differs across readers with different levels of proficiency and across gaze measures. Using eye-tracking data from the MECO L2 corpus, we compare readers with high and low vocabulary proficiency on first-pass gaze duration (FPGD) and total gaze duration (TGD). We quantify the distribution of the predictive power of surprisal across model layers using Predictive Depth. Across 12 tested LLMs, we find that readers with lower vocabulary proficiency tend to show deeper Predictive Depth for FPGD, while this difference is smaller for TGD. Also, TGD itself shows deeper Predictive Depth than FPGD in both proficiency groups. These patterns suggest that where predictive power is concentrated across LLM layers may be related to the timing and breadth of the reading processes captured by different gaze measures, and that this relationship can vary with reader proficiency. Our leave-one-out analysis further shows that the advantage of informative internal layers extends to unseen texts, although the practical improvements in prediction are limited. Overall, our results show that layer-wise LLM surprisal provides a useful perspective on variation in reading behaviour across both reader groups and gaze measures.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用MECO L2眼动语料库，考察12个大语言模型不同层的surprisal与人类注视行为的关系是否随读者词汇熟练度和注视指标而变化，发现低熟练读者在首次注视时长上呈现更深的Predictive Depth，而总注视时长的Predictive Depth整体更深。
AI.motivation: 阅读行为不仅受语言输入影响，也受读者熟练度影响。既有研究多使用单一层级或最终层的LLM surprisal，忽视了surprisal预测力在模型各层间的分布差异，且未系统比较不同熟练度读者与不同注视指标之间的层间关系。
AI.method: 使用MECO L2语料库的眼动数据，将读者分为高、低词汇熟练度两组，比较首次注视时长（FPGD）与总注视时长（TGD）。采用Predictive Depth指标量化surprisal在各模型层上的预测力分布，共测试12个大语言模型，并进行留一分析以检验内部信息层的泛化性。
AI.result: 在12个LLM中，低词汇熟练度读者在FPGD上倾向于更深的Predictive Depth，而在TGD上该差异较小；两种熟练度组中TGD的Predictive Depth均深于FPGD。留一分析显示有信息量的内部层的优势可泛化到未见文本，但实际预测提升有限。
AI.conclusion: 层间LLM surprisal为理解读者群体和注视指标之间的阅读行为差异提供了有效视角；预测力在模型层间的集中位置可能与不同注视指标所捕捉的阅读过程的时间性与广度相关，并随读者熟练度变化。

title: Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory Representation for Video World Models
summary: Video world models require persistent scene memory to maintain consistency during long-horizon video generation. Existing spatial memories accumulate RGB observations or latent features, increasing storage requirements as generation proceeds. We introduce Honeycomb, a video world model built on HexMemory, our proposed low-rank representation for storing scene features in a fixed-size memory with a total of six spatial and spatiotemporal planes. A feed-forward writer maps each generated chunk into new plane features. As the spatial coverage or temporal range expands, we warp the previous planes while preserving their dimensions, then fuse them with the new features through confidence-weighted pooling and a learned residual correction. A reader retrieves latents from HexMemory to condition subsequent video generation. The writer processes only observations from the new chunk, avoiding per-scene optimization and repeated processing of the full history. Experiments on WorldScore and RealEstate10K demonstrate strong video generation quality and robust revisit consistency while keeping HexMemory feature storage constant throughout generation. Code and additional visualizations are available on our project page at https://jackswl.github.io/honeycomb/.

AI.tldr: 提出Honeycomb视频世界模型，基于HexMemory低秩记忆表示，用固定大小的六个空间与时空平面存储场景特征，实现恒定存储的长期视频生成与重访一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型的空间记忆通过累积RGB观测或潜特征来维持长时程生成的一致性，但存储需求随生成进程不断增长，难以扩展到长时程场景。
AI.method: 核心为HexMemory：一种低秩表示，将场景特征存储在固定大小的六平面（空间与时空）记忆中。前馈写入器将每个新生成chunk映射为新平面特征；当空间覆盖或时间范围扩展时，对旧平面进行warp并保持维度不变，再通过置信度加权池化与学习式残差校正进行融合。读取器从HexMemory中检索潜特征以条件化后续视频生成。写入器仅处理新chunk观测，避免逐场景优化与全历史重复处理。
AI.result: 在WorldScore与RealEstate10K上，方法在保持HexMemory特征存储恒定的同时，展现出较强的视频生成质量与稳健的重访一致性。
AI.conclusion: Honeycomb以低秩固定尺寸记忆替代累积式空间记忆，在不随生成增长的存储开销下实现了高质量长时程视频生成与重访一致性，为视频世界模型的持久场景记忆提供了新思路。

title: Evaluating Multi-Task Morphological Concept Learning for Pulmonary Nodule Malignancy Assessment in 3D CT
summary: Morphological characteristics such as spiculation and lobulation play an important role in assessing pulmonary nodules on computed tomography (CT), particularly in relation to malignancy risk. This study examines whether learning radiologist-annotated morphological features together with malignancy risk from lesion-centred 3D CT volumes improves classification performance. The Lung Image Database Consortium and Image Database Resource Initiative (LIDC-IDRI) dataset was used, comprising 3,918 reader-level nodule annotations from 742 patients after excluding indeterminate malignancy ratings. Patient-level splitting was used for training, validation, and testing, with 112 patients and 628 reader annotations in the held-out test set. A single-task 3D convolutional neural network was compared with a multi-task model predicting malignancy risk, spiculation, and lobulation. The single-task model achieved a balanced accuracy of 0.548 and receiver operating characteristic area under the curve (ROC-AUC) of 0.552, while the multi-task model achieved 0.539 and 0.558, respectively. Patient-level bootstrap analysis showed an ROC-AUC difference of 0.005 (95% confidence interval (CI): -0.087 to 0.090) and a balanced-accuracy difference of -0.009 (95% CI: -0.067 to 0.043). The auxiliary tasks were strongly imbalanced and showed limited predictive performance. Overall, including morphological features did not clearly improve malignancy-risk classification, showing the importance of class balance, label formulation, and reader-level annotation structure in multi-task pulmonary CT analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于LIDC-IDRI数据构建3D CNN，比较单任务与多任务（恶性风险+毛刺+分叶）模型，发现联合形态学特征并未明显提升恶性风险分类性能。
AI.motivation: 毛刺、分叶等形态学特征对CT肺结节恶性风险评估很重要，作者希望验证在病灶中心3D CT体积上联合学习放射科医生标注的形态学特征与恶性风险，是否能提升分类性能。
AI.method: 使用LIDC-IDRI数据集，排除不确定恶性评级后纳入742例患者的3,918条读者级结节标注，按患者级划分训练/验证/测试集（测试集112例患者、628条读者标注）。对比单任务3D CNN与同时预测恶性风险、毛刺、分叶的多任务模型。
AI.result: 单任务模型平衡准确率0.548、ROC-AUC 0.552；多任务模型为0.539和0.558。患者级bootstrap显示ROC-AUC差异0.005（95% CI: -0.087~0.090），平衡准确率差异-0.009（95% CI: -0.067~0.043）。辅助任务类别严重不平衡，预测性能有限。
AI.conclusion: 纳入形态学特征未明显改善恶性风险分类，说明类别平衡、标签构建方式及读者级标注结构在多任务肺CT分析中很重要。

title: VIF-Bench: Evaluating Visual Instruction Following in Multi-Reference Image Generation
summary: Recent multimodal image generation models can take multiple images and textual instructions as input, enabling reference-based generation guided not only by text but also by visual instructions such as layouts, arrows, and pose cues. However, existing benchmarks do not evaluate the joint setting in which multiple references must be composed under multiple and heterogeneous visual-instruction images. To address this gap, we introduce VIF-Bench, a benchmark of 1,241 tasks designed to assess the edge of model capabilities in this joint setting by covering: (i) multi-reference generation (up to 7) under multiple heterogeneous visual instructions (up to 6), (ii) cases where reference images can potentially compete with visual instructions (e.g., a strongly posed subject vs. a target pose), and (iii) controlled comparison of visual instructions with text descriptions at different levels of specificity. Using these capabilities, we uncover three findings: (1) models face an adherence-artifact trade-off: once models reach stronger visual instruction adherence, stronger adherence tends to coincide with more instruction artifacts in generated images, (2) visual instruction adherence tends to be lower on tasks whose reference images carry a salient state of the controlled attribute (e.g., a neon-lit subject under a light-direction instruction), most consistently for light and wind, and (3) for models that can understand visual instructions, it is often better to provide visual constraints directly rather than describe them in text; when using text, a moderate level of detail works better than an exhaustive description. VIF-Bench is released as an open benchmark to establish a basis for fair comparison in controllable multi-reference image generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 VIF-Bench，一个包含 1,241 个任务的基准，用于评估多参考图像与异构视觉指令联合条件下的图像生成能力，并揭示三项关键发现。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态图像生成基准未评估"多参考图像需在多张且异构的视觉指令图像下进行组合"这一联合设置，该能力缺口需要通过专门的基准来填补。
AI.method: 构建 VIF-Bench，包含 1,241 个任务，覆盖三类设定：(i) 最多 7 张多参考图像配合最多 6 张异构视觉指令；(ii) 参考图像与视觉指令可能相互竞争的情形（如强姿态主体与目标姿态）；(iii) 视觉指令与不同具体程度的文本描述之间的受控对比。
AI.result: 得到三项发现：(1) 模型存在"遵循度-伪影权衡"，视觉指令遵循度越高，生成图像中的指令相关伪影越多；(2) 当参考图像携带受控属性的显著状态时（如霓虹光主体配光向指令），视觉指令遵循度更低，在光照与风上表现最一致；(3) 对能理解视觉指令的模型，直接提供视觉约束优于文本描述；使用文本时，中等细节程度优于详尽描述。
AI.conclusion: VIF-Bench 作为开放基准发布，为可控多参考图像生成提供公平比较的基础。

title: PolyOCR-Venus: Unified OCR Foundation Models for Text-Centric Visual Intelligence
summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is evolving from plain-text transcription toward general visual intelligence, requiring models to recognize, localize, and reason over textual information in complex visual environments. However, existing OCR systems often excel at only some tasks and struggle to balance recognition, parsing, and reasoning across scenarios. In this report, we present PolyOCR, a family of unified OCR foundation models of varying scales. PolyOCR combines a shared instruction-following framework with a large-scale data engine that converts heterogeneous visual resources into quality-verified OCR supervision. We introduce Competence-Guided Policy Optimization, which combines verifier-based Group Relative Policy Optimization with on-policy distillation through sample-wise routing based on teacher reliability and the teacher--student competence gap. We also introduce OCRBench v2.1, our revision of OCRBench v2 with manually verified annotation corrections and task-aligned scoring metrics. Extensive experiments across OCRBench v2.1, CC-OCR, in-house KIE Benchmark, OmniDocBench v1.6 and MDPBench demonstrate that PolyOCR achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一OCR基础模型系列PolyOCR，结合共享指令跟随框架与大规模数据引擎，引入能力引导策略优化（CGPO）及修正版OCRBench v2.1，在多基准上取得领先或极具竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: OCR正从纯文本转录演变为通用视觉智能，需在复杂视觉环境中完成识别、定位与推理。但现有OCR系统往往只擅长单一任务，难以在多场景下平衡识别、解析与推理能力。
AI.method: 1）PolyOCR系列统一OCR基础模型，采用共享指令跟随框架；2）大规模数据引擎，将异构视觉资源转为经质量校验的OCR监督数据；3）提出能力引导策略优化（Competence-Guided Policy Optimization），结合基于验证器的GRPO与在策略蒸馏，并按教师可靠性和师生能力差距进行样本级路由；4）推出OCRBench v2.1，含人工核验的标注修正与任务对齐评分指标。
AI.result: 在OCRBench v2.1、CC-OCR、内部KIE Benchmark、OmniDocBench v1.6及MDPBench等大量实验中，PolyOCR达到SOTA或极具竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一框架、数据引擎与能力引导的强化/蒸馏优化，PolyOCR有效平衡了识别、解析与推理任务，推动了OCR向通用视觉智能的发展。

title: Billiger.de Products: A Bilingual Entity Matching Benchmark
comment: 23 pages. Describes benchmark version 1.1 (repository tag v1.1.0). Data, code, and reference results: https://github.com/wbsg-uni-mannheim/billiger-de-products/tree/v1.1.0
summary: Existing product matching benchmarks primarily contain English-language product data and are often dominated by a single product category, such as electronics. This paper introduces Billiger.de Products, a bilingual German and English entity matching benchmark covering thirteen consumer product categories, including difficult-to-handle categories such as clothing and furniture. The benchmark data originates from the German price comparison platform billiger.de. Following the design of WDC Products, the benchmark offers multiple variants that differ in the fraction of corner cases, the size of the development set, and the fraction of entities unseen during training. An aligned English translation of every offer keeps all pairs, splits, and labels fixed, while cross-language test sets combine German and English records within individual pairs. We validate the benchmark using six supervised matchers and zero-shot GPT-5.2 on both language versions and the cross-language test sets. The validation shows the difficulty of the benchmark. The comparison of the results on the English version of the benchmark to the results on the German version shows that most matchers score on average higher on the English version. The difference is largest for RoBERTa and HierGAT, while the zero-shot LLM runs are largely insensitive to the language. Comparing the F1 scores achieved by PLM-based matchers on the English version of Billiger.de Products with their performance on existing English-language benchmarks, such as WDC Products and Abt-Buy, shows that Billiger.de Products is more difficult than these benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Billiger.de Products，一个德英双语实体匹配基准，覆盖13个消费品类别，并验证其难度高于现有英文基准。
AI.motivation: 现有产品匹配基准主要包含英文产品数据，且常被电子产品等单一类别主导，缺乏多类别与跨语言覆盖。
AI.method: 基于德国比价平台 billiger.de 构建双语基准，采用 WDC Products 设计，提供多种变体（边界案例比例、开发集规模、训练未见实体比例不同），并配对齐英文翻译保持配对、划分与标签不变，另构建跨语言测试集；使用6个监督匹配器与零样本 GPT-5.2 验证。
AI.result: 基准具有较高难度；多数匹配器在英文版上平均得分高于德语版，RoBERTa 与 HierGAT 差异最大，零样本 LLM 对语言基本不敏感；PLM 匹配器在英文版上的 F1 低于 WDC Products、Abt-Buy 等现有英文基准。
AI.conclusion: Billiger.de Products 是一个更具挑战性的多类别双语产品实体匹配基准，能更真实地评估匹配器与 LLM。

title: Predictive Geometry of Hidden Trajectories in Transformers
summary: Decoder-only transformers are trained only through a terminal next-token prediction loss, yet this loss constrains every intermediate hidden state through the fixed downstream computation. We formalize this constraint by studying layerwise loss-to-go functions: the terminal loss obtained by continuing a candidate hidden state through the remaining transformer blocks.
