Around successful validation trajectories, we show that the local second-order geometry of these functions is governed, up to low-loss residual terms, by a pullback Fisher operator on hidden-state space. Its spectrum identifies output-sensitive directions and approximately prediction-null directions, yielding a local observable subspace of the residual stream. For causal transformers, the same geometry induces a tokenwise curvature score: a Fisher-weighted sensitivity of the target logits to perturbations of each token's hidden state. This score vanishes outside the causal ancestor set of the target and is controlled by downstream Jacobian couplings, making it a loss-aware alternative to attention magnitude. We estimate these quantities using matrix-free Jacobian-vector and vector-Jacobian products and evaluate them across decoder-only language models on WikiText, OpenWebText, and FineWeb. Empirically, the induced geometry predicts perturbation sensitivity, supports nonuniform layerwise rank allocation, yields competitive structured token-pruning signals, and improves low-rank student recovery when added to stronger autoregressive distillation objectives such as reverse KL and skew KL. These results support a predictive-geometric view of transformer computation: near successful trajectories, the terminal loss induces a thin, anisotropic set of output-relevant hidden-state directions that can be measured and exploited for compression and distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化了decoder-only Transformer的"层级损失函数"（loss-to-go），证明在成功验证轨迹附近，其局部二阶几何由隐状态空间上的pullback Fisher算子主导，并据此导出tokenwise曲率分数，实验证明该几何可用于扰动敏感性预测、非均匀层级秩分配、结构化token剪枝及蒸馏改进。
AI.motivation: Decoder-only Transformer仅通过终端next-token预测损失训练，但该损失通过固定的下游计算约束了每一个中间隐状态。作者希望形式化这一约束，理解终端损失如何塑造隐状态的局部几何结构，从而揭示哪些方向对输出敏感、哪些方向近似"预测无关"，并为压缩与蒸馏提供理论依据。
AI.method: 提出layerwise loss-to-go函数：将候选隐状态经剩余Transformer块继续前传得到的终端损失。在成功验证轨迹附近，证明其局部二阶几何（Hessian）在低损失残差意义下由隐状态空间的pullback Fisher算子决定；其谱分解出输出敏感方向与近似预测零方向，形成残差流的局部可观测子空间。对因果Transformer，该几何诱导tokenwise曲率分数——目标logit对每个token隐状态扰动的Fisher加权敏感度，该分数在目标因果祖先集外为零，受下游Jacobian耦合控制。采用matrix-free JVP/VJP估计这些量。
AI.result: 在WikiText、OpenWebText、FineWeb上对decoder-only语言模型评估：所诱导的几何可预测扰动敏感性；支持非均匀层级秩分配；产生有竞争力的结构化token剪枝信号；将其加入reverse KL、skew KL等更强的自回归蒸馏目标时，可改善低秩学生模型恢复效果。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一种"预测-几何"视角的Transformer计算观：在成功轨迹附近，终端损失诱导出一组稀薄且各向异性的、与输出相关的隐状态方向，这些方向可被测量并用于压缩与蒸馏。

title: CogWAM: Aligning Semantic Cognition with World Action Modeling via Event-Driven Interfaces
summary: Robot policies increasingly incorporate semantic reasoning and future-world prediction, yet combining these capabilities does not guarantee that local predictions and actions remain aligned with task progress. We introduce CogWAM, a cognition-guided world-action model that establishes an explicit semantic interface between task reasoning and world-action learning through a persistent Semantic State, which stores completed task events and the active subtask. CogWAM updates this state only when observations indicate semantic transitions, allowing task-level context to persist across multiple action chunks. To bridge semantic context with physical prediction and control, CogWAM employs progress-conditioned WORLD and ACTION queries that selectively extract task-relevant information for future-world prediction and action generation. During training, the Semantic State provides shared task-progress context for both branches, while inference removes the future-prediction branch and directly generates actions from observations and the maintained state. We further introduce semantic training strategies to improve transition learning and closed-loop conditioning. Without additional robot-action pretraining, CogWAM achieves 15.56 / 11.70 % Score/SR on RoboDojo and state-of-the-art performance on BiCoord, while real-world experiments demonstrate closed-loop dual-arm manipulation with 16.4 fewer Semantic State regenerations than step-wise updating.

AI.tldr: CogWAM 提出一种认知引导的世界-动作模型，通过持久语义状态建立任务推理与世界-动作学习之间的显式语义接口，仅在观测到语义转换时更新状态，并用进度条件化的 WORLD/ACTION 查询桥接语义与物理预测控制，在 RoboDojo、BiCoord 及真实双臂任务上取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人策略虽融合语义推理与未来世界预测，但二者结合并不能保证局部预测与动作始终与任务进度保持一致，导致预测、动作与任务级语义脱节。
AI.method: 构建持久 Semantic State 存储已完成任务事件与当前子任务，仅在语义转换时更新；设计进度条件化的 WORLD 与 ACTION 查询，选择性提取任务相关信息用于未来预测与动作生成；训练时两分支共享任务进度上下文，推理时移除预测分支直接由观测和维持状态生成动作；并引入语义训练策略提升转换学习与闭环条件化。
AI.result: 无需额外机器人动作预训练，在 RoboDojo 上取得 15.56 / 11.70 % 的 Score/SR，在 BiCoord 上达到 SOTA；真实世界实验中实现闭环双臂操作，语义状态重生成次数比逐步更新减少 16.4 次。
AI.conclusion: 显式语义接口与进度条件化查询可有效对齐任务推理、世界预测与动作控制，在降低状态更新开销的同时提升任务成功率与操作性能。

title: Context Language Models
summary: We introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), language models that natively manage their own context. We implement this by treating the context as a file and allowing the model to make unrestricted updates to this file. This allows the model to learn what is most important to maintain in context, and naturally extends to multi-agent systems where multiple agent contexts coexist as files. Building CLMs zero-shot with existing models outperforms SOTA context management strategies across a variety of tasks: 11.4% higher accuracy with 21.5% fewer FLOPs on BrowseComp-Plus, 5% higher scores with 59% fewer FLOPs on 12-hour EdgeBench, and 65% greater improvement with the same compute on a 24-hour multi-repository agent-swarm task. Moreover, by shifting context management from external harness control to intrinsic model behavior, CLMs naturally enable both in-context and parametric learning of context-management strategies. We show that CLMs can be steered with natural-language instructions evolved through a standard skill-optimization loop, improving held-out accuracy by up to 35.9 points on a context-management task while reducing compute. We also introduce an online reinforcement learning method for CLMs, improving Qwen3.5-9B performance on BrowseComp-Plus by 47.6% while using 12% fewer FLOPs. Finally, we co-design Suffix Cache Reuse for CLM serving, further reducing server-side compute by 35% relative to standard SGLang at matched performance.

AI.tldr: 提出上下文语言模型（CLM）：将上下文作为文件，由模型自主管理，零样本即超越现有上下文管理策略，并支持指令优化、在线RL与专用推理缓存。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型的上下文管理依赖外部框架（harness）人工设计规则，模型无法自主学习"什么信息值得保留"。作者希望把上下文管理从外部的工程控制转变为模型的内在能力，从而提升长时程、多智能体任务的效率与准确率。
AI.method: 将上下文视为一个文件，允许模型对该文件进行不受限制的增删改操作；多智能体场景下多个智能体的上下文以并存文件的形式组织。基于已有模型零样本构建CLM。此外提供两条学习路径：用标准技能优化循环进化出自然语言指令来引导CLM（在上下文内学习），以及针对CLM的在线强化学习方法（参数化学习）。在服务侧，联合设计Suffix Cache Reuse以适配CLM的推理特性。
AI.result: 零样本CLM在多任务上超过SOTA上下文管理策略：BrowseComp-Plus上准确率高11.4%、FLOPs少21.5%；12小时EdgeBench上得分高5%、FLOPs少59%；24小时多仓库智能体集群任务上同等算力下提升65%。自然语言指令引导使留出集准确率最多提升35.9点并减少算力；在线RL使Qwen3.5-9B在BrowseComp-Plus上提升47.6%且FLOPs减少12%。Suffix Cache Reuse在同等性能下较标准SGLang再降35%服务端算力。
AI.conclusion: 将上下文管理内化为模型行为，可同时实现上下文内与参数化的策略学习，并在准确率与算力上双重获益；配套的服务侧缓存设计进一步降低部署成本，为长时程与多智能体应用提供了新范式。

title: The Camera Inside the Editor: Reading the Implicit Camera of Image Editors with Painted Calibration Patterns
summary: Instruction-based image editors insert objects, restyle scenes and render new viewpoints, but it is unknown which camera they assume when they paint into a photograph. Asked to cover the floor with a checkerboard, an editor paints projective structure from which classical vanishing-point geometry reads pitch, roll, focal length, yaw and, on renders, the principal point, without any training. Unlike a calibrator such as GeoCalib, which estimates the camera of an image, this isolates the camera under which the editor paints. On 120 rendered cameras with exact ground truth, Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 paints tile edges that meet their vanishing points within 0.26 degrees, and its implicit camera matches the true one to 0.8 degrees in pitch and 6% in focal length, more accurately than GeoCalib except in roll. Asked to draw the horizon or mark a vanishing point instead, the editor fails, so this knowledge is revealed by painting and not by the explicit tasks we tried. The implicit camera has two priors: roll is pulled towards level (slope 0.71), and telephoto perspective towards a default of about 30 mm, which roughly matches the camera the models paint without any scene. For Qwen, the priors do not grow when blur removes four fifths of the line evidence. They are stronger on real photographs, and on NYUv2 a shorter wording of the task removes the difference for roll. On photographs from a 24--240 mm zoom lens the painted perspective grows with only 0.62 of the lens's slope, while GeoCalib and MoGe-2 saturate at about 52 and 42 mm. FLUX.1 Kontext and LongCat-Image-Edit are pulled much harder. Finally, from a level camera a camera-control LoRA executes pose commands at only 50--70% of their strength, and a board painted into its output agrees with the camera it produced.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过让指令式图像编辑器绘制棋盘格等具有透视结构的图案，无监督地反演出编辑器在"作画"时所隐含假设的相机参数（pitch、roll、焦距、yaw及主点），并揭示其隐含相机带有"roll趋向水平"和"长焦趋向约30mm"两种先验。
AI.motivation: 指令式图像编辑器能够插入物体、重打光、渲染新视角，但我们并不清楚它们在向照片中"作画"时假定了何种相机。作者希望将"编辑器作画时隐含的相机"与"图像本身的相机"区分开，从而单独考察编辑器内部的透视先验，这一知识无法通过显式任务（如直接画地平线或标记消失点）获得。
AI.method: 让编辑器在照片上绘制棋盘格等带透视线索的图案，再用经典消失点几何（vanishing-point geometry）从绘制结果中读取pitch、roll、焦距、yaw以及渲染图上的主点，全程无需训练。在120个有精确真值的渲染相机上进行评测，并与GeoCalib等标定器对比；同时研究模糊退化、任务表述、真实照片、变焦镜头、不同模型（FLUX.1 Kontext、LongCat-Image-Edit）以及相机控制LoRA的影响。
AI.result: 在120个渲染相机上，Qwen-Image-Edit-2511绘制的瓷砖边缘与其消失点误差在0.26度以内，其隐含相机在pitch上误差0.8度、焦距误差6%，除roll外均优于GeoCalib。隐式相机存在两种先验：roll向水平偏移（斜率0.71），长焦视角趋向约30mm默认值。模糊去掉五分之四线证据时该先验不增强；在真实照片上更强。NYUv2上更短的任务表述会消除roll差异。对24–240mm变焦镜头照片，绘制透视仅以0.62斜率增长，而GeoCalib与MoGe-2在约52mm与42mm处饱和；FLUX.1 Kontext与LongCat-Image-Edit被拉得更强。相机控制LoRA仅以50–70%强度执行姿态命令，但其输出中绘制的棋盘格与所产生相机一致。
AI.conclusion: 指令式图像编辑器隐含一套稳定的相机先验，可通过"作画"这一间接方式被几何反演，而非通过显式的画地平线/标消失点任务获得。该先验在模糊下稳健、在真实照片上更强，并表现出对水平roll与约30mm长焦的偏好；不同模型与相机控制LoRA的干预会系统地改变这一先验强度。

title: Multi-Site Real-World Performance of Commercial AI for Pulmonary and Incidental Pulmonary Embolism Detection
summary: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a leading cause of cardiovascular mortality, yet the real-world performance of FDA-cleared AI detection models remains incompletely characterized. We retrospectively evaluated two FDA-cleared AI algorithms from a single commercial platform (Aidoc Medical BriefCase), one for PE triage on dedicated CT pulmonary angiography (CTPA; n = 30,678) and one for incidental PE (iPE) detection on routine contrast-enhanced CTs (n = 37,191), across a 17-facility academic health system. Reference-standard labels were extracted from radiology reports using a validated LLM pipeline (97% accuracy, kappa = 0.94). The PE model achieved 86.8% sensitivity and 99.1% specificity, with sensitivity declining from 99.3% for saddle emboli to 72.9% for subsegmental PE, and from 89.7% for acute to 65.3% for non-acute PE. The iPE model achieved 73.5% sensitivity and 99.8% specificity. Both models demonstrated lower sensitivity than FDA-clearance benchmarks while exceeding cleared specificity, with diminishing performance for peripheral and non-acute emboli mirroring known human reader limitations and underscoring the need for standardized post-market surveillance of AI-enabled medical devices.

AI.tldr: 该研究回顾性评估了同一商业平台两款FDA认证AI模型在多中心真实世界中的肺栓塞检测性能：PE分诊模型敏感度86.8%、特异度99.1%，偶发PE模型敏感度73.5%、特异度99.8%，敏感度均低于FDA认证基准，尤其对亚段性及非急性栓子表现明显下降。
AI.motivation: 肺栓塞是心血管死亡的主要原因，但已获FDA认证的AI检测模型在真实世界中的实际性能尚未被充分刻画，存在认证基准与临床实际表现之间的证据缺口。
AI.method: 在覆盖17家机构的学术卫生系统内，对同一商业平台（Aidoc Medical BriefCase）的两款FDA认证算法进行回顾性评估：一款用于专用CTPA上的PE分诊（n=30,678），另一款用于常规增强CT上的偶发PE检测（n=37,191）。参考标准标签通过经验证的LLM流程从影像报告中提取（准确率97%，kappa=0.94）。
AI.result: PE分诊模型敏感度86.8%、特异度99.1%；敏感度随栓子位置由鞍状栓子的99.3%降至亚段性PE的72.9%，随病程由急性的89.7%降至非急性的65.3%。偶发PE模型敏感度73.5%、特异度99.8%。两款模型敏感度均低于FDA认证基准，特异度则高于认证基准。
AI.conclusion: AI模型在真实世界中对周围型及非急性栓子的敏感度下降，与已知的人类阅片者局限相似，凸显了对AI医疗器械开展标准化上市后监测的必要性。

title: Which papyrus HTR is good enough? Character-error-rate tolerance of four papyrological tasks on Greek texts
summary: Purpose: Most Greek papyri remain unpublished and undigitised; a handwritten text recognition (HTR) pipeline that transcribes them automatically would let scholars discover documents and literary works that have so far gone unread. Recognition systems for Ancient Greek papyri are in statu nascendi, and how accurate they must be for a given papyrological task has not been examined. To answer this and set a benchmark for Greek papyrus HTR, we test a range of character error rates (CER) against four papyrological tasks, using published editions as ground truth. Methods: From 63,846 current editions of Greek texts in papyri.info, we imitate a letters-only "perfect HTR" output by removing the editorial layer, then degrade it with a seeded algorithm to exact CERs of 1 - 50%, with lost lines and four error-shape variants. On these data we train small models (TF-IDF, fastText, a character CNN, ByT5-small) for document type, dating and documentary-versus-literary classification, and apply eight keyword search methods. We compare models trained on clean text with models retrained at a specific CER level, and evaluate across CERs. Results: Tolerance differs by task. With clean-trained models, documentary-versus-literary classification retains 90% of its metric up to 20% CER; document type up to 7.5%; subtypes and search up to 5%; dating only up to 3%. Retraining on text containing character errors largely eliminates the sharp degradation that otherwise sets in above 15% CER. Models generally tolerate concentrated damage in a long document better than small errors spread across a short text. Conclusion: The study provides a CER target for each of the four tasks and shows that models trained on noisy text make current, imperfect text recognition useful for them.

AI.tldr: 该研究以papyri.info上63,846份希腊文纸草文献的既有校勘本为真值，构造"完美HTR"输出并按1–50%字符错误率(CER)的受控方式降解，训练小模型并测试八种检索方法，为四类纸草学任务确定了可容忍的CER基准。结论是：任务不同，容忍度不同——文献/文学二分类可容忍至20% CER，文书类型7.5%，子类型与关键词检索5%，断代仅3%；在含噪文本上重新训练可显著缓解15% CER以上的急剧性能下降。
AI.motivation: 绝大多数希腊文纸草文献尚未出版、也未数字化，若能以手写文本识别(HTR)流水线自动转录，可让学者发现此前无人读过的文书与文学作品。然而面向古希腊纸草文献的识别系统尚处萌芽期(in statu nascendi)，且"对某一具体纸草学任务而言精度需达到何种水平"这一问题从未被系统考察。因此，本文旨在回答该问题并为希腊纸草HTR设定基准。
AI.method: 以papyri.info中63,846份现行希腊文文本校勘本为数据源：先剥离校勘层(即编辑性标记与注释)，得到仅含字母的"完美HTR"模拟输出；再用带种子(seeded)的算法将其精确降解至1–50%的CER，并模拟行丢失及四种错误形态变体。在此基础上训练四类小型模型(TF-IDF、fastText、字符级CNN、ByT5-small)完成文书类型、断代、文书/文学二分类任务，并应用八种关键词检索方法。评估上对比"干净文本训练"与"在特定CER水平上重训练"两类模型，并跨CER水平评测。
AI.result: 容忍度因任务而异：使用干净文本训练的模型时，文书/文学二分类在CER高达20%时仍保持其指标值的90%；文书类型可保持至7.5%；子类型与检索至5%；断代仅至3%。在含字符错误的文本上重训练，可大幅消除原本出现在15% CER以上的急剧性能衰减。此外，模型通常更能容忍长文档中集中的损伤，而对短文本中分散的小错误容忍度较低。
AI.conclusion: 研究为四类纸草学任务分别给出了CER目标阈值，并证明用含噪文本训练的模型可使当前并不完美的文本识别结果对这些任务仍然有用。

title: Selective Channel Restoration for Backdoored Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong multimodal capabilities but remain vulnerable to backdoors implanted through poisoned fine-tuning data. Existing defenses often require extensive parameter updates during fine-tuning or incur per-query overhead during inference. To address these limitations, we propose Perturb-Select-Restore (PSR), a post-training defense that performs sparse updates to the projection interface and introduces no additional computation during inference. We reveal that backdoored VLM projectors are substantially more sensitive to bounded perturbations than clean VLM projectors, a phenomenon we term projection fragility. Building on this finding, PSR identifies the output channels most sensitive to perturbations in each projection layer of a backdoored VLM and restores their parameters to the corresponding pretrained values. Experiments across multiple tasks show that PSR reduces attack success rates to near zero while preserving clean-task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Perturb-Select-Restore (PSR)，一种针对视觉语言模型（VLM）后门攻击的后训练防御方法。PSR 利用"投影脆弱性"现象，对投影层中最敏感的通道进行稀疏恢复，将参数还原为预训练值，在不增加推理开销的前提下将近乎消除攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型虽具备强大多模态能力，但容易被通过投毒微调数据植入的后门攻击。现有防御方法存在两大局限：微调阶段需要大量参数更新，或推理阶段产生逐查询的额外开销。因此需要一种既轻量又不影响推理效率的防御方案。
AI.method: 提出 PSR（Perturb-Select-Restore）后训练防御框架。首先揭示"投影脆弱性"（projection fragility）现象：被植入后门的 VLM 投影器相比干净投影器对受限扰动更敏感。基于此，PSR 在 VLM 各投影层中识别对扰动最敏感的输出通道，并将这些通道的参数恢复为对应的预训练权重值，实现对投影接口的稀疏更新。
AI.result: 在多个任务上的实验表明，PSR 将攻击成功率（ASR）降至接近零，同时保持干净任务上的性能不受影响。此外，该方法无需在推理阶段引入额外计算开销。
AI.conclusion: PSR 通过稀疏恢复敏感通道，提供了一种高效且实用的 VLM 后门防御方案，兼顾防御有效性与推理效率，为多模态模型的安全部署提供了新的思路。

title: HiRAE: Hierarchical Representation Autoencoding with Residual Budgets
summary: Pretrained visual representations support image generation, but may not fully preserve the fine-grained details needed for faithful reconstruction. Meanwhile, intermediate encoder layers contain complementary visual details, but learning to fuse them for reconstruction can produce a latent distribution that is difficult to model. Existing fusion methods require empirical tuning of layer selection or staged optimization of fusion and decoding, increasing configuration effort or training complexity. We introduce HiRAE (Hierarchical Representation Autoencoder), which learns a hierarchical fusion framework over the full encoder hierarchy to improve reconstruction fidelity while maintaining compatibility with generative modeling. HiRAE groups encoder layers by depth and learns residual corrections to the deepest representation. Group-wise norm caps bound these corrections relative to the deep anchor, with tighter budgets for shallower groups. Our HiRAE-24 preserves the latent token count and channel dimension. On ImageNet-256, HiRAE-24 reduces reconstruction FID from 0.299 to 0.209 relative to RAEv2 while maintaining competitive guided generation quality. For text-to-image generation, HiRAE-24 improves alignment over RAEv2 on GenEval, DPG-Bench, and GenAI-Bench both before and after supervised fine-tuning. Under the same generator-training and evaluation protocol, post-fine-tuning GenEval increases from 84.86 to 87.70.

AI.tldr: HiRAE提出了一种分层表示自编码器，通过对编码器全部层级进行分组融合并学习对最深表示的残差修正，在保持与生成建模兼容的同时提升重建保真度。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉表示虽支持图像生成，但难以完整保留忠实重建所需的细粒度细节；编码器中间层含有互补的视觉细节，然而学习融合这些层会得到难以建模的隐分布。现有融合方法需要经验性地选择层或分阶段优化融合与解码，增加了配置成本与训练复杂度。
AI.method: HiRAE按深度对编码器层分组，并以最深表示为锚点学习残差修正；采用组级范数上限将这些修正约束在深锚点相对范围内，对更浅层组施加更紧的预算。HiRAE-24保持隐token数量与通道维度不变。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-256上，HiRAE-24将重建FID从0.299降至0.209（相较RAEv2），并保持有竞争力的引导生成质量。在文生图任务中，无论是否经过监督微调，HiRAE-24在GenEval、DPG-Bench和GenAI-Bench上的对齐均优于RAEv2；相同生成器训练与评测协议下，微调后GenEval从84.86提升至87.70。
AI.conclusion: HiRAE通过全层级的分层融合框架，在无需经验性层选择或分阶段优化的前提下，同时改善了重建保真度与生成建模兼容性。

title: Selecting What Matters: Semantic Compression-Guided Selective Pooling for Long-Context Embeddings
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential as training-free text encoders for long-context embeddings. Existing approaches primarily improve information flow under causal attention and typically construct embeddings by uniformly averaging all token representations. However, for long documents, such mean pooling can dilute salient semantic information with abundant redundant or weakly informative content. To this end, we propose SCSP, a training-free framework that leverages semantic compression for informative token selection in long-context embedding. Specifically, SCSP first partitions a document into sentence-aware chunks and appends a semantic compression prompt to each chunk. A prompt-isolated attention mask preserves information flow among document tokens while restricting each prompt to its corresponding local context. We then use the attention patterns elicited by these prompts to estimate token importance, select informative tokens, and aggregate their intermediate-layer representations into the final embedding. Extensive experiments on long-context embedding benchmarks demonstrate that SCSP can be integrated into both zero-shot and fine-tuned models in a plug-and-play manner, consistently improving their performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCSP——一个无需训练的框架，通过语义压缩提示估计token重要性，筛选信息量大的token来构建长文本嵌入，在长上下文嵌入基准上即插即用地提升零样本与微调模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有以LLM作为免训练文本编码器的方法主要改进因果注意力下的信息流，并通常对所有token表示做均匀平均池化。但对长文档而言，均值池化会被大量冗余或弱信息内容稀释，导致显著语义信息被削弱。
AI.method: SCSP首先将文档切分为句子感知的chunk，并为每个chunk追加语义压缩提示；采用提示隔离注意力掩码，在保留文档token间信息流的同时，限制每个提示仅关注其对应局部上下文；利用这些提示引发的注意力模式估计token重要性，选择信息量大的token，并聚合其中间层表示形成最终嵌入。
AI.result: 在长上下文嵌入基准上的大量实验表明，SCSP能以即插即用方式集成到零样本模型和微调模型中，并持续提升其性能。
AI.conclusion: SCSP通过语义压缩驱动的信息性token选择，缓解了长文档嵌入中均值池化的语义稀释问题，无需训练即可通用地增强现有长文本嵌入模型。

title: A Benchmark & Dataset for Detecting AI-Manipulated Visual Evidence in the Court System
summary: Photographic evidence is becoming increasingly vulnerable to forms of alteration and fabrication that existing legal and technical workflows are not well equipped to evaluate. Surveillance frames, dashcam stills, and phone photographs may be used to establish presence, sequence, causation, damage, or identity, yet contemporary generative systems allow non-experts to alter or fabricate such images through ordinary prompt-based interfaces. Existing image-forensics benchmarks provide important resources for face manipulation, classical tampering, and general synthetic-image detection, but they are not organized around the forms of visual evidence submitted in courts, the localized edits that can change what an exhibit appears to prove, or the consumer-tool threat model now facing the justice system. We introduce the CIFAR Synthetic Evidence Corpus for Detecting AI-Manipulated Images, a benchmark for evidentiary image authentication in court and justice-system contexts. The corpus contains 1,505 photographic items, including 720 authentic controls and 785 manipulated or fabricated images, spanning surveillance, dashcam, and consumer-photo imagery. Manipulations are organized into scene-condition edits, localized element edits, and full fabrications produced with contemporary generative systems. Each item is released with structured metadata covering source provenance, manipulation tier, subtype, generator, prompt template, and scene attributes, enabling controlled evaluation beyond aggregate binary detection. We also establish baselines with publicly available image-manipulation detectors, showing that current systems exhibit error profiles that remain problematic for evidentiary use. The dataset, prompts, metadata, code, and baseline evaluation scripts are released to support research on visual evidence authentication, information integrity, and trustworthy AI for the justice system.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了 CIFAR Synthetic Evidence Corpus，一个面向法庭与司法系统情境的 AI 篡改图像检测基准，包含 1,505 张图像（720 张真实对照、785 张篡改或伪造图像），覆盖监控、行车记录仪和消费级照片，并按场景条件编辑、局部元素编辑和完全伪造三类组织，附带结构化元数据，同时评估了现有检测器基线。
AI.motivation: 现有图像取证基准主要面向人脸操纵、传统篡改和通用合成图像检测，未围绕法庭提交的视觉证据形式组织，也未针对可改变证据证明力的局部编辑，以及当前消费级生成工具给司法系统带来的威胁模型，因此缺乏适配司法情景的评估资源。
AI.method: 构建 CIFAR Synthetic Evidence Corpus 基准：收集监控、行车记录仪与消费级照片共 1,505 项，其中 720 项为真实对照、785 项为篡改或伪造；将操纵划分为场景条件编辑、局部元素编辑和完全伪造三类，使用当代生成系统制作；每项配有来源溯源、操纵层级、子类型、生成器、提示模板和场景属性等元数据；并采用公开图像操纵检测器建立基线进行受控评估。
AI.result: 基线评估显示，现有公开图像操纵检测器在证据级使用场景下仍表现出较为严重的错误分布（误差特征），难以满足司法证据的可靠性要求。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了面向司法图像证据认证的基准数据集，发布数据、提示、元数据、代码及基线评估脚本，支持视觉证据认证、信息完整性与面向司法系统的可信 AI 研究。

title: Planetary Feature Fields are Scalable Earth Representations
summary: Satellite observations, precomputed embeddings, and map products describe the same evolving Earth, yet are stored as independent, petabyte-scale data products. Their continued growth calls for compact representations of multiple products while preserving spatial and temporal detail. We introduce Planetary Feature Fields (PFFs), which exploit redundancy across data products by modeling them jointly as continuous functions of space and time at planetary scale. PFFs are spatially local explicit-implicit (hybrid) neural fields. Each field shares a factored feature volume---a decomposition of an explicit 3D grid with smaller factors---across products, while lightweight implicit decoders reconstruct individual products across multiple timesteps. PFFs reconstruct EO products over space and time more accurately than single-product fields at matched compression rates. At $1800\times$ compression relative to the uncompressed source data, reconstructed features retain approximately $90\%$ or more of the performance achieved with the original features on pixel-level segmentation, change detection, and patch-level classification tasks. PFFs can add new timesteps by extending their factored feature volumes and add new products by attaching new decoders, while leaving existing outputs unchanged. PFFs reduce end-to-end feature access latency by an order of magnitude relative to evaluated API and cloud-storage pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Planetary Feature Fields（PFFs），将多源对地观测数据产品联合建模为时空连续函数，利用产品间冗余实现行星尺度的紧凑表示，在1800倍压缩下仍保持约90%以上下游任务性能，并显著降低特征访问延迟。
AI.motivation: 卫星观测、预计算嵌入与地图产品描述同一演化中的地球，却作为独立、PB级的数据产品分别存储，其持续增长亟需在保留时空细节的前提下对多产品进行紧凑表示。现有单产品神经场方法未利用跨产品冗余，难以应对多产品联合压缩的需求。
AI.method: PFFs是空间局部显式-隐式（混合）神经场。每个场在多个产品间共享一个分解式特征体（将显式3D网格分解为更小的因子），同时用轻量级隐式解码器跨多个时间步重建各个产品。新增时间步可通过扩展分解式特征体实现，新增产品可通过附加新解码器实现，且不影响已有输出。
AI.result: 在匹配压缩率下，PFFs在时空维度上比单产品场更准确地重建EO产品。相对于未压缩源数据实现1800倍压缩时，重建特征在像素级分割、变化检测和块级分类任务上仍保留约90%或更高的原始特征性能。PFFs将端到端特征访问延迟相较所评估的API与云存储流水线降低一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: PFFs通过跨产品共享分解式特征体与隐式解码器的混合神经场设计，实现了行星尺度多产品数据的高压缩率、高保真联合重建，并具备良好的可扩展性（支持增量添加时间步与产品）与高效访问能力，为大规模地球观测数据的紧凑表示提供了有效方案。

title: CHOQOLATE: Organizing Concept Bottleneck Latent Spaces with Choquet Integrals
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) built on vision-language models such as CLIP represent a latent space as human-understandable concepts. These representations are unfaithful: related concepts are entangled, so individual scores do not reflect their intended meaning. We propose CHOQOLATE, an interpretable-by-design layer based on 2-additive Choquet integrals, which merges correlated concepts into compact nodes. Across four datasets, CHOQOLATE achieves a favorable accuracy-interpretability trade-off, with weight-sparse and semantically coherent nodes. A closed-form gradient derivation, backed by experiments, explains why Choquet layers drive this organization without explicit supervision. Choquet weights also map directly to Shapley values, which enables test-time intervention. On standard bias-mitigation benchmarks, suppressing spurious concepts after training performs on par with methods that require group annotations or retraining, while needing neither.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CHOQOLATE，一种基于2-可加Choquet积分的可解释设计层，用于解决CLIP等视觉语言模型构建的概念瓶颈模型中概念纠缠、表征不忠实的问题，通过合并相关概念为紧凑节点，在四个数据集上取得良好的精度-可解释性权衡，并支持无需群体标注或重训练的测试时干预。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉语言模型（如CLIP）构建的概念瓶颈模型（CBM）将潜在空间表示为人类可理解的概念，但这些表征并不忠实：相关概念相互纠缠，导致单个概念分数无法反映其预期含义。
AI.method: 提出CHOQOLATE，一种基于2-可加Choquet积分的可解释设计层（interpretable-by-design），将相关概念合并为紧凑节点；给出闭式梯度推导以解释Choquet层在无显式监督下驱动该组织方式的原因；并利用Choquet权重与Shapley值的直接映射实现测试时干预。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上，CHOQOLATE取得有利的精度-可解释性权衡，节点权重稀疏且语义连贯；实验验证了闭式梯度推导对Choquet层组织机制的说明；在标准偏差缓解基准上，训练后抑制虚假概念的效果与需要群体标注或重训练的方法相当，且无需二者。
AI.conclusion: 基于2-可加Choquet积分的可解释层能够在不依赖显式监督的情况下将纠缠概念组织为语义连贯的紧凑节点，并提供可解释的Shapley值映射，实现高效且无需群体标注或重训练的测试时偏差缓解。

title: A Proposed Rubric for Evaluating Expressed Clinical Reasoning in Large Language Model Responses
summary: We propose a rubric for assessing expressed clinical reasoning in model responses, drawing on three bodies of work: medical education assessment frameworks (ART, SCT, Key Feature Problems and OSCE); clinical LLM benchmarks (MedR-Bench, HealthBench, TIMER-Bench, DR. BENCH, PrIME-LLM and PatientSafeBench); and general LLM reasoning evaluation research, including the Factuality-Validity-Coherence-Utility taxonomy, FaithCoT-Bench and C2-Faith. We use groundedness as a clinically oriented adaptation of the taxonomy's factuality category. The rubric brings these concepts together in a multidimensional framework for scoring free-text responses to gold-standard clinical vignettes. It includes provisional behavioural anchors, applicability rules and a separate flag for case-specific safety-critical errors. General-domain frameworks inform its design but are not treated as validated clinical instruments. The rubric does not replace case-specific reference criteria or the task-specific metrics of existing benchmarks. It has not yet been tested for inter-rater reliability, construct validity or clinical utility. Its immediate purpose is to make evaluation decisions explicit and open to scrutiny before empirical testing.

AI.tldr: 提出一个用于评估模型回答中临床推理表达的多维评分量表，整合医学教育评估框架、临床LLM基准与通用LLM推理评估研究，尚待实证验证。
AI.motivation: 现有临床LLM评测多依赖任务特定指标或基准分数，缺乏对自由文本中临床推理表达过程的显式、可审查的评估框架。
AI.method: 综合三类工作构建量表：医学教育评估框架（ART、SCT、Key Feature Problems、OSCE）、临床LLM基准（MedR-Bench、HealthBench、TIMER-Bench、DR. BENCH、PrIME-LLM、PatientSafeBench）及通用LLM推理评估研究（Factuality-Validity-Coherence-Utility分类、FaithCoT-Bench、C2-Faith）；将groundedness作为factuality的临床化改编，形成包含暂定行为锚点、适用规则和案例特异性安全关键错误独立标记的多维评分框架。
AI.result: 该量表可对金标准临床情境题的自由文本回答进行多维评分，并单列安全关键错误标记；通用领域框架仅作设计参考，不视为已验证的临床工具。
AI.conclusion: 量表不替代案例特异性参考标准或现有基准的任务特定指标，其评分者间信度、结构效度和临床效用尚未检验；当前目的是在实证测试前使评估决策显式化并可供审查。

title: ByteTraX: Enhancing the ByteTrack Architecture with Optimised Thresholding
summary: The ByteTrack algorithm is a widely used and computationally efficient multi-object tracking architecture. Its core innovation lies in the combination of lenient bounding box associations with tracklet similarity matching to robustly deal with object occlusions. However, this strategy is nevertheless vulnerable to erroneous track reclassification and identity switching, as detection confidence scores dictate association priority. To address this, I present a simple enhancement of the ByteTrack architecture--named ByteTraX--that optimises track continuity via a single unified matching threshold, while penalising identity switches through stringent track initiation criteria. This approach achieves consistently improved performance across a range of diverse benchmarks including GMOT-40, LC-MOT, SportsMOT, TeamTrack, DAMUNT, and DeepSea-MOT, while simultaneously increasing processing speed by >10%. Specifically, results demonstrate a >40% reduction in identity switches, accompanied by mean increases in HOTA of 3.6, IDF1 of 5.6, and FPS of 6.3. As such, adoption of the ByteTraX algorithm has the potential to substantially enhance tracking performance over the ByteTrack baseline, while retaining the efficiency needed for real-time deployment. To facilitate usage, I provide the source code, integration functionality for the YOLO family of object detection models, and deployment instructions via an open source repository.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ByteTraX，对ByteTrack架构进行简单增强：使用统一匹配阈值优化轨迹连续性，并通过严格的轨迹初始化准则抑制身份切换，在多个基准上取得一致提升且速度更快。
AI.motivation: ByteTrack虽计算高效、广泛使用，但其策略依赖检测置信度分数决定关联优先级，导致易出现错误的轨迹重分类和身份切换，尤其在遮挡场景下鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 在ByteTrack基础上提出ByteTraX：(1) 采用单一统一的匹配阈值来优化轨迹连续性，替代原有宽松的边界框关联策略；(2) 通过严格的轨迹起始准则惩罚身份切换。
AI.result: 在GMOT-40、LC-MOT、SportsMOT、TeamTrack、DAMUNT、DeepSea-MOT等多个基准上性能一致提升；身份切换减少超过40%，HOTA平均提升3.6，IDF1平均提升5.6，FPS平均提升6.3，处理速度提高超过10%。
AI.conclusion: ByteTraX能够在保持实时部署所需效率的同时，显著提升相对ByteTrack基线的跟踪性能，并开源代码、提供YOLO系列集成与部署说明。

title: CompOrca: Corpus-Scale Compliance Labelling of Instruction-Tuning Data
comment: Accepted to PlurVA-LLM Workshop @ AACL-IJCNLP 2026. Dataset available on HuggingFace
summary: Studying how fine-tuning shapes refusal and noncompliance behaviour requires knowing which training examples refuse or otherwise fail to fulfil the request. Existing annotations cover evaluation sets, which are far smaller than training corpora. We present CompOrca, compliance labels for all 4,233,923 examples of the OpenOrca corpus. Every example was classified as compliant or noncompliant by five passes of an open-weight LLM judge (LongCat-2.0, 1.6T parameters). The corpus is released as unanimous compliance (94.75%), unanimous noncompliance (1.28%), and nonunanimous rows (3.97%), with the raw vote counts. A single pass flags 2.7-3.2% of the corpus as noncompliant, while only 1.28% is flagged by all five, so the most ambiguous rows can be filtered out. Against 450 human-annotated examples (150 annotated twice; human-human $κ=0.93$), the unanimous compliance and noncompliance labels are 97.3% and 86.7% precise. The noncompliance label is a high-precision subset of the corpus's noncompliance. Published refusal-detection methods recall between 0.4% and 94.1% of human-labelled noncompliance. We release the full corpus with its per-row labels and vote counts at https://huggingface.co/datasets/cemiu/CompOrca

AI.tldr: 构建 CompOrca：对 OpenOrca 全部 4,233,923 条样本用开源大模型五次投票标注合规/不合规，并公开逐行标签与投票数。
AI.motivation: 研究微调如何影响拒答与不服从行为，需要知道训练样本中哪些属于拒答或未满足请求，但现有标注仅覆盖规模远小于训练语料的评测集。
AI.method: 用开源权重模型 LongCat-2.0（1.6T 参数）作评判，对 OpenOrca 全量 4,233,923 条样本各进行 5 次独立评判，将每条样本判为合规或不合规，并按投票一致性划分为一致合规（94.75%）、一致不合规（1.28%）与非一致（3.97%）三类，保留原始投票计数；同时以 450 条人工标注样本（其中 150 条双人标注，人工间 κ=0.93）验证标签质量，并评估已有拒答检测方法的召回率。
AI.result: 一致合规与一致不合规标签相对人工标注的精确率分别为 97.3% 与 86.7%；单次评判即可将 2.7-3.2% 语料标为不合规，而五次全票仅 1.28%，说明可据此过滤最模糊样本。不合规标签是语料内不合规的高精确子集。已发表拒答检测方法对人工标注不合规的召回率介于 0.4%-94.1%。
AI.conclusion: CompOrca 为训练语料提供了规模化合规标注，支持按投票一致性筛选样本，并揭示现有拒答检测方法召回率差异悬殊；完整语料、逐行标签与投票计数已公开。

title: Pixel-Level Transformers in Remote Sensing: A Canopy Height Case Study
summary: Predicting canopy height from medium-resolution satellite imagery is a common and scalable approach for assessing the condition of the world's forests, which play a crucial role in climate change mitigation. While Transformer-based architectures have shown strong performance in many domains, their straightforward application to dense (i.e., pixel-level) regression tasks often yields suboptimal results. In particular, the patch size has a crucial impact on the model performance. In this work, we consider pixel-level attention schemes and show that the resulting models generally outperform those relying on larger patch sizes. However, pixel-level attention can be a prohibitively resource-intensive operation. For this reason, we conduct an extensive experimental study using efficient attention variants to identify favorable trade-offs between prediction quality and resource requirements, facilitating the practical deployment of the proposed models. In addition, we perform a comprehensive comparison with several well-established models in the field and show that, with suitable hyperparameter choices, Transformer-based architectures can outperform competing approaches. Our findings provide practical guidance for designing models for pixel-level regression tasks on medium-resolution satellite imagery, including canopy height and biomass estimation, soil moisture mapping, and yield forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于中分辨率卫星影像的冠层高度预测，发现像素级注意力Transformer优于大patch方案，但资源开销高；通过系统实验比较高效注意力变体以权衡精度与资源，并证明合适超参下Transformer可超越现有模型。
AI.motivation: 中分辨率卫星影像预测冠层高度是评估全球森林状况、支撑气候缓解的可扩展方法。Transformer在多领域表现优异，但直接用于像素级密集回归时效果次优，尤其patch size对性能影响关键，且像素级注意力资源开销过大，亟需明确其可行性与权衡。
AI.method: 考虑像素级注意力方案（小patch），并开展大规模实验研究多种高效注意力变体，以在预测质量与资源需求之间寻找有利折中；同时与领域内多个成熟模型进行综合对比，并考察超参数选择的影响。
AI.result: 像素级注意力模型通常优于依赖较大patch size的模型；高效注意力变体可在资源受限下保持较好质量；在合适超参数下，Transformer架构可超越竞争方法。
AI.conclusion: 为基于中分辨率卫星影像的像素级回归任务（如冠层高度与生物量估计、土壤水分制图、产量预测）提供模型设计的实用指导，指出像素级注意力与高效变体结合是可行方向。

title: WINGS: Reference-Free Gaussian Splatting Inpainting with 3D-Native Generative Priors
summary: Inpainting 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes, a key challenge in 3D editing, requires generating plausible content within a masked region of 3D space. Prior approaches rely on 2D diffusion models to produce one or several inpainted reference views, making them susceptible to challenges associated with multi-view inconsistency and lengthy optimization times. Departing from these approaches, we introduce a reference-free Gaussian splatting inpainting method operating natively in 3D. Our method leverages the embedding space of a large, pre-trained 3D prior, combined with a structure completion network to feed a generative prior which reconstructs the missing region's geometry and appearance. Performing content generation entirely in 3D, it avoids the need to reconcile inconsistencies of multiple inpainted reference images, and is faster than related 2D-based methods. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method qualitatively and quantitatively, through extensive experiments and a user study. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first Gaussian splatting inpainting method to operate in the learned representation space of a 3D-native generative prior without relying on inpainted reference views.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无参考视图、直接在3D空间运行的3D高斯泼溅修复方法，借助预训练3D先验的嵌入空间与结构补全网络实现缺失区域的几何与外观生成。
AI.motivation: 现有3D高斯泼溅修复方法依赖2D扩散模型生成一张或数张修复参考视图，易受多视图不一致问题困扰，且优化时间长。
AI.method: 在预训练大规模3D先验的嵌入空间中操作，结合结构补全网络，将信息输入生成先验，从而在3D原生空间内重建缺失区域的几何与外观，全程无需修复参考视图。
AI.result: 通过大量实验与用户研究，从定性和定量两方面验证了方法有效性，且速度优于相关2D方法。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个在3D原生生成先验的习得表示空间中运行、且不依赖修复参考视图的高斯泼溅修复方法。

title: Minkowski Attractor Networks: Closed-Form Hyperbolic Flows for Visual Representations
summary: Geometric representation learning predominantly scaffolds representations onto flat Euclidean subspaces or compact product tori ($\mathbb{T}^K$). However, flat manifolds possess vanishing curvature and polynomial volume growth, inherently suffering from metric distortion when embedding multi-scale, tree-like visual hierarchies. While hyperbolic spaces ($\mathbb{H}^m$) circumvent this via constant negative curvature ($K<0$) and exponential volume expansion, prior hyperbolic deep architectures are hindered by computationally cumbersome Riemannian optimization, non-linear gyrovector calculus, and floating-point instabilities. In this work, we introduce \textbf{Minkowski Attractor Networks (MAN)}, an operator-splitting-inspired framework that embeds representations within pseudo-Riemannian Minkowski spacetime ($\mathbb{R}^{1,m}$). By framing hyperbolic manifolds as quadric level sets, MAN resolves hyperbolic geometry by combining linear Lorentz group transport with non-linear cone lifting and closed-form radial rescaling, evaluating in a single forward pass without numerical ODE solvers or iterative retractions. We establish \textbf{MAN-2D} ($\mathbb{R}^{1,1} \to \mathbb{H}^1$) as our primary, high-throughput visual backbone, which maximizes channel factorization granularity into $D/2$ independent two-dimensional Minkowski blocks. We further formulate \textbf{MAN-4D} ($\mathbb{R}^{1,3} \to \mathbb{H}^3$) as a spacetime extension, leveraging a commuting Cartan-subalgebra parameterization of $\mathrm{SO}^+(1,3)$ to evaluate 4D Lorentz isometries via two commuting 2D planar maps without matrix-exponential overhead.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Minkowski Attractor Networks (MAN)，一个基于算子分裂思想的伪黎曼Minkowski时空（R^{1,m}）表示学习框架，将双曲流形视为二次曲面水平集，通过线性Lorentz群传输、非线性锥提升与闭式径向重缩放，在单次前向传播中完成双曲几何计算，无需ODE求解器或迭代回缩。主推的MAN-2D（R^{1,1}→H^1）将通道分解为D/2个独立的二维Minkowski块，实现高吞吐；MAN-4D（R^{1,3}→H^3）利用SO^+(1,3)的交换Cartan子代数参数化，以两个交换的二维平面映射求值4D Lorentz等距，避免矩阵指数开销。
AI.motivation: 几何表示学习多依赖平坦欧氏子空间或紧致乘积环面（T^K），但平坦流形曲率为零、体积多项式增长，在嵌入多尺度树状视觉层次时存在度量畸变。双曲空间（H^m）以恒定负曲率（K<0）和指数体积扩张规避该问题，然而既有的双曲深度架构受困于繁琐的黎曼优化、非线性陀螺向量演算以及浮点数值不稳定。
AI.method: 提出Minkowski Attractor Networks (MAN)，一种受算子分裂启发的框架，将表示嵌入伪黎曼Minkowski时空（R^{1,m}）。核心思路是把双曲流形视为二次曲面水平集，用线性Lorentz群传输结合非线性锥提升与闭式径向重缩放来解算双曲几何，在单次前向传播中完成，无需数值ODE求解器或迭代回缩。设计两种实例：MAN-2D（R^{1,1}→H^1）作为高吞吐视觉主干，把通道分解粒度最大化到D/2个独立的二维Minkowski块；MAN-4D（R^{1,3}→H^3）作为时空扩展，采用SO^+(1,3)的交换Cartan子代数参数化，通过两个交换的二维平面映射求值4D Lorentz等距，规避矩阵指数开销。
AI.result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果，但声称MAN在单次前向传播内完成双曲几何评估，避免了数值ODE求解器与迭代回缩，从而提升计算效率；MAN-2D实现最大通道分解粒度（D/2个独立二维块）以支持高吞吐；MAN-4D通过交换Cartan子代数参数化避免矩阵指数开销。
AI.conclusion: MAN以伪黎曼Minkowski时空上的算子分裂视角统一了双曲表示学习，用线性Lorentz传输与闭式径向重缩放替代繁琐的黎曼优化与陀螺向量演算，兼顾数值稳定性与计算效率，并提供二维高吞吐主干与四维时空扩展两种可扩展实例。

title: Thinking in Depth, Speaking Directly: Recurrent Latent Reasoning for Paralinguistically Grounded Spoken Dialogue
summary: Empathetic spoken dialogue requires models to use both what is said and how it is said to decide how to respond. Explicit CoT can improve paralinguistic perception and make acoustic cues more explicit in replies, yet does not ensure their effective use in response planning. We call this mismatch the perception-reasoning gap. In addition, CoT may not fully capture acoustic cues in words, and generating it adds inference latency. To address these limitations, we introduce LoopSLM, which builds on looped Transformers for latent reasoning, reusing a decoder block to refine hidden states with acoustic grounding at every pass. Its two-stage training further narrows the perception-reasoning gap by separating learning to reason from learning to respond, enabling direct inference without CoT. On EchoMind, LoopSLM improves paralinguistic understanding, reasoning, and reply quality over Qwen2.5-Omni-7B. Against the CoT-SFT baseline, LoopSLM gains over 20 points in reasoning accuracy while generating 64.5% fewer tokens at half the latency. It also outperforms Qwen3-Omni-Thinking on most empathetic reply metrics with 34x lower latency. Despite training only on dialogue data, LoopSLM improves accuracy on general audio benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出LoopSLM，用循环Transformer做潜在推理并在每轮迭代中进行声学接地，配合两阶段训练分离"学会推理"与"学会回应"，无需CoT即可直接推理，在共情对话中兼顾性能与效率。
AI.motivation: 共情语音对话需同时利用"说了什么"与"怎么说"来决定回应方式。显式CoT虽能提升副语言感知、让声学线索在回复中更显式，却不能保证其在回应规划中被有效利用，作者将这一不匹配称为"感知-推理鸿沟"（perception-reasoning gap）。此外，CoT未必能充分把声学线索转化为文字，且生成CoT带来额外推理延迟。
AI.method: LoopSLM基于looped Transformer进行潜在推理（latent reasoning），复用同一个decoder block，在每次迭代中结合声学接对对隐状态进行多轮精化；并采用两阶段训练，将"学习推理"与"学习回应"分开，从而在缩小感知-推理鸿沟的同时支持无CoT的直接推理。
AI.result: 在EchoMind上，LoopSLM在副语言理解、推理与回复质量上均优于Qwen2.5-Omni-7B；相比CoT-SFT基线，推理准确率提升超过20分，同时生成token减少64.5%、延迟减半；在多数共情回复指标上超过Qwen3-Omni-Thinking，延迟低34倍；且仅在对话数据上训练，却在通用音频基准上获得提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过循环潜在推理与两阶段训练，LoopSLM有效缓解感知-推理鸿沟，在共情语音对话中同时实现更强的副语言推理与更高的推理效率，并展现出跨任务的正向迁移。

title: Which Models Work Well Together? Measuring Heterogeneity for LLM Team Selection
summary: The performance ceiling of an LLM team is constrained not only by individual model capabilities, but also by inter-member error resonance and predictive differences. Although heterogeneous teaming is often observed to be effective in practice, existing approaches lack complementarity metrics that are computable, interpretable, and optimizable, leaving team composition to rely on heuristics. We propose a heterogeneity-driven team selection framework that performs offline profiling to characterize individual capability along with two complementary signals: one captures decorrelation in error patterns to reduce co-failures, while the other measures divergence in predictive behavior to capture strategy diversity. We formulate team selection as a standardized quality--complementarity combinatorial objective and apply an efficient greedy search to select a small team from a candidate pool. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms quality-only baselines under controlled candidate pools and team sizes, establishing reusable selection principles for multi-LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种异质性驱动的LLM团队选择框架，通过离线画像刻画个体能力及两种互补信号（错误模式去相关、预测行为分歧），将团队选择建模为质量-互补性组合优化目标，并用贪心搜索选出小规模团队。实验表明该框架在多个基准上稳定优于仅考虑质量的基线。
AI.motivation: LLM团队的性能上限不仅受个体模型能力限制，还受成员间错误共振与预测差异影响。异质组队虽在实践中有效，但现有方法缺乏可计算、可解释、可优化的互补性度量，导致团队构成依赖启发式。
AI.method: 提出异质性驱动的团队选择框架：离线画像刻画个体能力，并引入两种互补信号——一种捕捉错误模式的去相关性以降低共同失败，另一种度量预测行为的分歧以捕获策略多样性。将团队选择形式化为标准化的质量-互补性组合优化目标，并采用高效贪心搜索从候选池中选出小规模团队。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，于受控候选池与团队规模条件下，该框架持续优于仅考虑质量的基线，验证了互补性建模的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为多LLM系统的团队组建提供了可复用的选择原则，表明显式建模互补性可提升团队整体性能。

title: The Geometry of Inference in Transformer Residual Streams
summary: Transformer language models build predictions through successive residual updates, but how their representations become specific to an eventual outcome remains unclear. We study this process by comparing intermediate residual states with their own final states and an empirical bank of final states from other contexts. Across six pretrained language models, the own endpoint becomes preferable to the average alternative early, while many individual endpoints remain closer. These competing sets generally shrink with depth, but their membership changes and their surviving endpoints need not become more similar to one another. Directional alignment and endpoint rank can therefore improve while Euclidean distance to the final state changes little. We develop a simple high-dimensional model that separates the roles of norm, alignment, and endpoint geometry, showing how gradual directional changes can produce sharp reductions in competition. We also prove that a straight path toward the own endpoint cannot introduce new competitors under either Euclidean or cosine distance; observed entries thus establish departures from straight-line convergence. Finally, endpoints associated with lower-ranked output tokens tend to lie farther away in cosine distance across all studied models, connecting residual geometry to output organization. Together, these findings characterize increasing geometric specificity during transformer inference and explain why distance, competitor count, and concentration of the surviving endpoints provide distinct views of that process.

AI.tldr: Transformer语言模型通过连续的残差更新构建预测。论文比较中间残差状态与其自身最终状态及其他上下文最终状态的经验库，发现"自身终点"较早优于平均替代项，但许多单个终点仍更接近；竞争集合随深度总体收缩，但其成员变化且存活端点未必彼此趋同。方向对齐与端点排名可改善而欧氏距离变化很小。作者提出高维模型分离范数、对齐与端点几何的作用，证明直线路径在欧氏/余弦距离下不引入新竞争者，并将残差几何与输出token排名关联。
AI.motivation: Transformer语言模型通过连续残差更新逐步构建预测，但其表示如何变得特定于某一最终结果尚不清楚。论文旨在刻画推理过程中表征的"几何特异性"如何随深度增加而演化，并厘清距离、竞争者数量与存活端点集中度等不同度量视角之间的关系。
AI.method: 在六个预训练语言模型中，将中间残差状态分别与其自身最终状态以及来自其他上下文的最终状态经验库进行对比；统计自身终点与平均替代项、单个终点的偏好与竞争集合并随深度的变化。构建一个简单高维模型，分离范数、方向对齐与端点几何的作用。在欧氏与余弦距离下证明直线路径不引入新竞争者，以此对照观测到的竞争者进入现象。
AI.result: 六个模型中，自身终点较早优于平均替代项，但许多单个终点仍更接近中间状态；竞争集合随深度总体收缩，但成员持续变化，存活的端点未必更相似；方向对齐与端点排名可以改善而欧氏距离几乎不变。理论证明直线趋近自身终点在欧氏或余弦距离下不会引入新竞争者，观测到的竞争者进入表明实际收敛偏离直线。所有模型中，低排名输出token对应的端点在余弦距离上更远。
AI.conclusion: 残差表示在推理过程中逐步获得几何特异性。距离、竞争者数量与存活端点的集中度提供了描述该过程的三种不同视角，其差异源于范数、方向对齐与端点几何的不同作用；残差几何与输出token的组织方式存在系统联系。

title: ReCaVSR: One-Step Streaming Diffusion Video Super-Resolution with Recycled Latents and Learned Cache Routing
comment: The code is available at https://github.com/kopperx/ReCaVSR
summary: Real-time diffusion-based video super-resolution (VSR) is in high demand for online streaming, yet stringent latency requirements often compromise generative fidelity. We propose ReCaVSR, a Wan2.2-based, one-step framework for streaming VSR that builds on two observations: recycled SR latents retain local temporal context, reducing the need for full historical Key-Value (KV) caches; and individual transformer layers benefit from distinct temporal scopes. ReCaVSR combines three complementary designs: (i) layer-wise cache routing with recycled SR latents: each DiT layer learns its KV-cache temporal scope under a cache budget and exports a static inference schedule, while recycled SR latents propagate local context by conditioning each new block on the model's own preceding predictions. (ii) Multi-Scope Query (MSQ) Discriminator: a compositional discriminator combining global, spatial-window, and temporal-tube feedback for holistic realism, local texture generation, and temporal stability. (iii) LR-conditioned adaptation of FlashDecoder: a VAE decoder that incorporates LR observations for efficient latent decoding. ReCaVSR enables streaming VSR without iterative sampling or full historical KV-cache materialization. Experiments on synthetic and real-world VSR benchmarks show better perceptual quality, temporal consistency, and streaming efficiency than representative VSR baselines. At $1080{\times}1920$ output resolution on a single NVIDIA A100-80GB, ReCaVSR achieves 21.20 FPS with 15.16 GB peak allocated GPU memory, running 2.72$\times$ faster while using 38.0\% less peak allocated memory than FlashVSR Tiny. The code is available at https://github.com/kopperx/ReCaVSR.

AI.tldr: ReCaVSR 是一个基于 Wan2.2 的单步流式视频超分框架，通过层间 KV 缓存路由、回收 SR 隐变量、多尺度查询判别器与 LR 条件化 FlashDecoder，在不进行迭代采样与完整历史 KV 缓存物化的前提下实现实时高保真 VSR。
AI.motivation: 在线流媒体对实时扩散式视频超分（VSR）需求强烈，但严格的延迟约束往往牺牲生成保真度。作者观察到两点：回收的 SR 隐变量保留局部时序上下文，可减少对完整历史 KV 缓存的依赖；同时不同 Transformer 层适合不同的时序感受范围。据此设计单步流式 VSR 方案以兼顾速度与质量。
AI.method: ReCaVSR 基于 Wan2.2，包含三项互补设计：(i) 层间缓存路由 + 回收 SR 隐变量：每层 DiT 在缓存预算下学习其 KV 缓存时序范围并导出静态推理调度，回收 SR 隐变量通过以模型自身前序预测为条件传播局部上下文；(ii) 多尺度查询（MSQ）判别器：组合全局、空间窗口与时序管状反馈，分别提升整体真实感、局部纹理与时序稳定性；(iii) LR 条件化的 FlashDecoder 适配：在 VAE 解码器中引入 LR 观测以实现高效隐变量解码。整体无需迭代采样或完整历史 KV 缓存物化。
AI.result: 在合成与真实 VSR 基准上，ReCaVSR 在感知质量、时序一致性与流式效率上优于代表性基线。在单张 NVIDIA A100-80GB、输出 1080×1920 分辨率下达到 21.20 FPS，峰值分配显存 15.16 GB，相比 FlashVSR Tiny 快 2.72×，峰值分配显存减少 38.0%。
AI.conclusion: ReCaVSR 通过单步、无完整历史 KV 缓存的流式设计，验证了层间缓存路由与回收隐变量的有效性，实现了实时高保真 VSR，在速度与显存效率上显著优于现有方案，代码已开源。

title: Can a Cacheable Decision Model Follow Rules?
summary: Certo is a small non-generative decision model (Qwen3-4B): it scores candidate actions from their text and returns a probability, instead of generating an answer. The accurate design reads the state, the rules, and each candidate together (a joint scorer), so cost grows with the menu. Independent encoding lets each candidate be encoded once and reused across states (about 5x cheaper at 77 candidates), but separates state from candidate. We ask how much rule-sensitivity survives that move, and whether it can be trained back. Four experiments on Certo: (1) the tested conversion to cacheable scoring loses rule-sensitivity (recall@1 1.00 -> 0.24) while the joint scorer holds 1.00, and a shortlist+rerank rescue fails; (2) targeted counterfactual supervision restores strong performance on held-out synthetic rule tasks (paraphrase, counterfactual, composition; reproducible across seeds), though we do not isolate whether predictions depend on the supplied rule; (3) on real rules the added benefit is not established -- after fixing a truncation confound, the joint scorer wins significantly on the short tier (0.861 vs 0.500) and directionally on the hard tier (0.655 vs 0.483, n=29); (4) a matched cross-domain real-prose mixture did not help and reduced contract accuracy (-9.3, -16.2 points). A cacheable encoder can be made rule-sensitive on its training distribution, but transfer to unseen-source real rules is not established; the joint scorer keeps an edge at the cost of caching.

AI.tldr: Certo（Qwen3-4B）是非生成式决策打分模型。联合打分（状态+规则+候选一起读）规则敏感性强但成本随候选数增长；独立编码可缓存、便宜约5倍，却丢失规则敏感性。反事实监督可把规则敏感性训练回来，但迁移到未见来源的真实规则尚未证实。
AI.motivation: 联合打分器将状态、规则与每个候选一起编码，规则敏感但计算成本随候选菜单规模线性增长。独立编码可让每个候选只编码一次并跨状态复用（77个候选时约便宜5倍），但把状态与候选解耦。作者要考察：这种可缓存化转换后还能保留多少规则敏感性、以及能否通过训练恢复。
AI.method: 在Certo上进行四项实验：(1) 对比联合打分与可缓存独立编码的规则敏感性，并尝试"短名单+重排"补救；(2) 用针对性的反事实监督在合成规则任务（改写、反事实、组合）上训练独立编码器；(3) 在真实规则上评测，并修正截断混淆；(4) 用匹配的跨领域真实散文混合数据做对照实验。
AI.result: (1) 可缓存转换后规则敏感性下降：recall@1 从1.00降至0.24，联合打分器保持1.00，短名单+重排补救失败；(2) 反事实监督在留出合成规则任务上恢复较强性能且跨随机种子可复现，但未分离预测是否真正依赖所给规则；(3) 真实规则上增益未被确证——修正截断混淆后，联合打分器在简单档显著更优（0.861 vs 0.500），困难档方向性更优（0.655 vs 0.483，n=29）；(4) 匹配的跨领域真实散文混合未带来帮助，反而降低合同准确率（-9.3、-16.2个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 可缓存编码器能在其训练分布上被训练出规则敏感性，但与未见来源真实规则的迁移尚未证实；联合打分器保持优势，代价是无法缓存、成本随候选数增长。是否真正依赖规则输入仍未被隔离验证。

title: Can Vision-Language Models Stay Helpful When Facing Implicit Risks? Intent-Privilege OPSD for Efficient Safety-Helpfulness Alignment
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remain vulnerable to cross-modal implicit risks: visual and textual inputs that appear benign in isolation can jointly elicit unsafe responses. Existing safety methods often require large preference datasets, costly multi-rollout training, or additional safeguards at inference time. They may also sacrifice helpfulness by directly refusing requests that could be answered safely. In this paper, we propose Intent-Privilege On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which leverages evidence-grounded intent as privileged supervision during training to help VLMs recognize implicit risks and provide safe, useful responses instead of blanket refusals. OPSD distills a teacher's intent-conditioned preferences over responses into a student using a single rollout per prompt; the student then responds without intent annotations or an additional safety module. With only 1,447 safety-specific examples - 95% fewer than standard preference datasets - OPSD reduces training time by 5x relative to multi-rollout GRPO-style training and average inference length by 7%. It attains the highest ratio for joint safety-helpfulness success, which measures the proportion of responses that are both safe and helpful, across all five evaluation groups. Remarkably, on pooled SIUO+HoliSafe, this success ratio rises from 43.9% to 53.5%. These results show that training-time intent supervision can improve both safety and helpfulness while substantially reducing data, training, and inference costs.

AI.tldr: 提出 Intent-Privilege On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD)，用证据支撑的意图作为训练期特权监督，使 VLM 在无需推理期额外安全模块的情况下识别隐式风险并给出安全且有用的回复。
AI.motivation: VLM 面临跨模态隐式风险：单独看似无害的图文组合可能共同诱发不安全回复。现有方法依赖大规模偏好数据、昂贵的多轮 rollout 训练或推理期附加防护，并常因一刀切拒答而损害有用性。
AI.method: OPSD 采用在策略自蒸馏：以“意图条件化”的教师模型对回复的偏好作为特权监督，学生模型每个 prompt 仅需单次 rollout 即可蒸馏；训练后学生无需意图标注或额外安全模块即可直接作答。仅使用 1,447 条安全专用样本。
AI.result: 相比多轮 rollout 的 GRPO 式训练，训练时间减少 5 倍，平均推理长度降低 7%；在五个评测组上均取得最高的安全-有用联合成功率（同时安全且有用的回复占比）。在 SIUO+HoliSafe 汇总集上，该成功率由 43.9% 提升至 53.5%。
AI.conclusion: 训练期的意图监督可在显著降低数据、训练与推理成本的同时，同时提升安全性与有用性，优于依赖大规模偏好数据和推理期防护的现有方案。

title: Evaluation Choices Shape Biomedical ML Claims: A Pediatric Pneumonia Benchmark Case Study
summary: Biomedical machine learning papers often compress model performance into one headline number. That number can look like a property of the model even when it depends strongly on how the benchmark was evaluated. We study this problem on the widely used Kermany pediatric chest radiograph dataset using nine image classifiers and a controlled evaluation protocol. Under the same protocol, the eight pretrained backbones differ by only 0.026 AUROC. In contrast, changing whether the backbone is frozen or fine-tuned changes AUROC by 0.044 on average, and changing the decision threshold changes balanced accuracy by 0.090 on average. The official test split is also measurably different from the training pool: a partition classifier distinguishes them at AUC 0.697, rising to 0.898 for normal radiographs. Most strikingly, a classifier using only file properties, with no image anatomy, reaches 0.992 balanced accuracy within the training pool but falls to 0.496 on the official test split. Validation-fitted thresholds and calibration also transfer imperfectly. These results show that a high benchmark score can support different conclusions when the split, training policy, threshold, metric, calibration, and uncertainty are not communicated with it. We end with a seven-item reporting recommendation in which each item is tied to an effect measured in the study

AI.tldr: 该研究以Kermany儿科胸片数据集为例，用9个分类器和受控评估协议证明：基准分数的高低很大程度上取决于评估方式（冻结/微调、阈值、数据划分等），而非模型本身，并提出7项报告建议。
AI.motivation: 生物医学机器学习论文常将模型性能压缩为单一头条数字，但该数字看似是模型属性，实则强烈依赖基准评估方式，容易导致误导性结论，因此需要系统研究评估选择对性能度量的影响。
AI.method: 在广泛使用的Kermany儿科胸片数据集上，采用9个图像分类器和一套受控评估协议，分别改变主干网络、冻结/微调策略、决策阈值、数据划分、校准与不确定性报告，量化各因素对AUROC和平衡准确率的影响。
AI.result: 同一协议下8个预训练主干网络AUROC仅相差0.026；而冻结与微调切换平均改变AUROC 0.044，阈值变化平均改变平衡准确率0.090。官方测试集与训练池可被分区分类器以AUC 0.697区分（正常胸片达0.898）；仅用文件属性、不含解剖信息的分类器在训练池内达0.992平衡准确率，但在官方测试集降至0.496。验证集拟合的阈值与校准迁移也不理想。
AI.conclusion: 高基准分数在未同时说明数据划分、训练策略、阈值、度量、校准与不确定性时，可能支持不同结论；作者据此提出7项报告建议，每项均对应本研究测量到的效应。

title: RelayVSR: Large-Small Model Collaboration for Efficient Real-World Video Super-Resolution
comment: The code is available at https://github.com/kopperx/RelayVSR
summary: Large generative models can recover realistic detail in real-world video super-resolution (VSR), but processing an entire video with them is computationally expensive. In this work, we present RelayVSR, a streaming VSR framework built on the Sparse Generative Relay mechanism. A large generative model generates reference latents for sparse keyframes, while a lightweight VSR network uses these references and low-resolution video to super-resolve every frame. The lightweight VSR network, implemented as a Dual-Memory Video Transformer, reuses keyframe information across frames and updates recent video context, supporting first-keyframe conditioning and dual-endpoint conditioning with bounded lookahead. However, errors in shared keyframes can propagate and accumulate across output frames, making keyframe quality alone an insufficient optimization target. We address this collaboration gap with Video-Aware Reference Optimization (VARO), which uses reinforcement learning to update the large generative model with two reward levels: a system-level reward evaluates videos produced by the fixed lightweight VSR network, while a reference-level reward evaluates decoded keyframe quality. VARO improves final video quality over direct joint training, and its dual-level rewards outperform a system-level reward alone. At 1080p on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB, dual-endpoint RelayVSR with a 15-frame keyframe interval reaches 29.29 FPS, 13.82 GB peak GPU memory, and 0.327 s first-frame model latency, compared with 7.80 FPS, 24.447 GB, and 2.83 s for FlashVSR-Tiny. The code is available at https://github.com/kopperx/RelayVSR.

AI.tldr: RelayVSR：稀疏生成接力框架，用大模型为稀疏关键帧生成参考潜变量，轻量VSR网络据此超分所有帧，并通过VARO强化学习优化大模型，实现高效流式视频超分。
AI.motivation: 大生成模型能恢复真实视频超分的细节，但逐帧处理整段视频计算代价过高，难以实用。
AI.method: 构建基于稀疏生成接力机制的流式VSR框架：大生成模型为稀疏关键帧生成参考潜变量，轻量VSR网络（双记忆视频Transformer）利用参考与低分辨率视频超分每帧，复用关键帧信息并更新近期视频上下文，支持首关键帧条件与有界前瞻的双端条件。针对关键帧误差传播累积、关键帧质量非充分优化目标的问题，提出视频感知参考优化VARO，用强化学习以系统级奖励（评估固定轻量网络输出的视频）与参考级奖励（评估解码关键帧质量）双层奖励更新大生成模型。
AI.result: VARO优于直接联合训练，双层奖励优于仅系统级奖励。单张A100 80GB下1080p、15帧关键帧间隔的双端RelayVSR达29.29 FPS、峰值显存13.82 GB、首帧模型延迟0.327 s；FlashVSR-Tiny为7.80 FPS、24.447 GB、2.83 s。
AI.conclusion: RelayVSR通过稀疏生成接力与VARO优化，在大幅降低计算与显存开销的同时提升视频超分质量，实现了高效的流式真实视频超分。

title: FlowMap-OPD: Rollout--Kernel Separation for On-Policy Distillation of Few-Step Flow-Map Generators
summary: Few-step flow-map generators, including MeanFlow and consistency models, enable efficient sampling through long-range transport, yet their on-policy distillation remains underexplored. We introduce FlowMap-OPD, an on-policy distillation framework that separates student-state acquisition from teacher--student distribution comparison. A formulation based on state marginals establishes this separation, while flow--velocity consistency connects local supervision to the deployed long-range map. Within this framework, we develop flow-map, induced-velocity, and instantaneous-velocity distribution supervision, each paired with a separately specified native flow-map rollout. Cross-capacity ImageNet experiments across three teacher rewards identify instantaneous-velocity distribution supervision with independently tunable student consistency as the most effective choice. In text-to-image experiments, FlowMap-OPD demonstrates strong multi-specialist consolidation capabilities and surpasses multi-reward Flow-Map GRPO in task performance and convergence speed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FlowMap-OPD，一种面向少步流映射生成器的 on-policy 蒸馏框架，通过分离“学生状态获取”与“师生分布比较”两类过程，系统比较多种分布监督形式，并在 ImageNet 与文本到图像任务上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 少步流映射生成器（如 MeanFlow、一致性模型）虽能通过长程输运实现高效采样，但其 on-policy 蒸馏研究仍不充分。核心难点在于：on-policy 蒸馏需要学生自身状态，而师生分布比较又依赖这些状态，二者相互耦合，导致监督信号与部署时的长程映射难以对齐。
AI.method: FlowMap-OPD 将学生状态获取与师生分布比较解耦，并以状态边缘分布的形式化建立该分离；同时利用流–速度一致性，将局部监督与部署阶段的长程映射相连接。在此框架下，作者设计了三种分布监督：流映射分布监督、诱导速度分布监督、瞬时速度分布监督，并分别为每种监督指定其原生流映射 rollout 方式。
AI.result: 在跨容量（cross-capacity）的 ImageNet 实验中，作者比较了三种教师奖励下的表现，发现“瞬时速度分布监督 + 可独立调节的学生一致性”效果最佳。在文本到图像实验中，FlowMap-OPD 展现出较强的多专家合并（multi-specialist consolidation）能力，并在任务性能与收敛速度上均优于多奖励 Flow-Map GRPO。
AI.conclusion: FlowMap-OPD 通过解耦 on-policy 蒸馏中的状态获取与分布比较，并借助流–速度一致性连接局部监督与长程映射，为少步流映射生成器提供了有效的 on-policy 蒸馏方案；其中瞬时速度分布监督配合可独立调节的一致性最为有效，并在多专家合并场景中优于 Flow-Map GRPO。

title: AnthroDial: Benchmarking LLM Anthropomorphism in Autonomous Social Interaction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as social agents, yet credible human-like interaction requires more than fluent responses or persona consistency. Agents must autonomously decide whether, when, and how to communicate while adapting to evolving contexts, goals, and relationships. Existing research, however, lacks a unified approach to enabling, evaluating, and improving such capabilities in continuous, open-ended interaction. We introduce AnthroDial, a unified framework for developing anthropomorphic social agents from three complementary aspects: MindFlow, a lightweight interaction harness that enables autonomous, asynchronous, and adaptive communication through a dynamic Mind Buffer; CAPS-Eval, a theory-grounded framework for evaluating cognitive, affective, and behavioral dimensions of anthropomorphic interaction; and a scalable training paradigm that combines SEEDS for environment expansion with DiAPO for adaptive capability optimization. We further construct evaluation datasets covering everyday communication, game interaction, and long-horizon character interaction. Extensive experiments across diverse models and scenarios demonstrate improved interaction autonomy and naturalness, validate the reliability, discriminativeness, and agreement with human rankings of CAPS-Eval, and confirm the effectiveness of our training paradigm. Together, these components provide a unified framework for developing credible human-like social agents in open-ended interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AnthroDial统一框架，从MindFlow交互机制、CAPS-Eval评估体系、可扩展训练范式三方面，构建具备自主社交能力的拟人化智能体。
AI.motivation: LLM作为社交智能体时，仅靠流畅回答或人设一致性不足以实现可信的人机交互，智能体需自主决定是否、何时、如何沟通，并适应动态情境、目标与关系；现有研究缺乏在连续开放式交互中统一实现、评估与提升此类能力的方法。
AI.method: 提出AnthroDial框架，包含三部分：MindFlow（借助动态Mind Buffer实现自主、异步、自适应沟通的轻量交互框架）；CAPS-Eval（基于理论、从认知/情感/行为三维度评估拟人交互的评估框架）；可扩展训练范式（结合SEEDS进行环境扩展、DiAPO进行自适应能力优化）。并构建覆盖日常交流、游戏交互、长时程角色交互的评估数据集。
AI.result: 在多模型、多场景实验中，交互自主性与自然度得到提升；CAPS-Eval在可靠性、区分度及与人类排序一致性方面得到验证；训练范式有效性获得证实。
AI.conclusion: AnthroDial各组件共同构成统一框架，为在开放式交互中开发可信的类人社交智能体提供了系统性方案。

title: HandAnthro: Automated Hand Anthropometry from a Single Image
comment: 21 pages, including 7 pages of main text and references and 14 pages of supplementary material
summary: Hand anthropometry supports protective-glove design, but existing measurement methods often require trained operators, specialized hardware, or manual landmarking. We present HandAnthro, which estimates 44 projected hand dimensions from a smartphone photograph of a palm-up hand on US letter-size paper. The pipeline reconstructs wrist-occluded paper boundaries for rectification, whitens non-hand pixels, and refines 41 anthropometry-specific landmarks from a fine-tuned You Only Look Once (YOLO) pose model using image-specific geometry and contours. Controlled evaluation comprised 720 captures from 45 held-out participants, each contributing 16 images across two smartphones, two backgrounds, two angles, and two nominal illumination settings. HandAnthro produced complete outputs for 704 captures (97.8%); among these, mean absolute error (MAE) was 3.80 mm per dimension against two trained operators' caliper measurements. Regional MAEs were 2.48 mm for non-thumb fingers, 6.04 mm for thumbs, and 6.17 mm for palm and wrist. In a researcher-assisted mobile-app pilot, automated batch processing returned all 44 dimensions for 260 of 268 retained, researcher-screened firefighter images (97.0%). A descriptive, unpaired comparison with an independent national firefighter reference yielded a mean absolute difference of 2.40 mm across 28 sex-by-dimension group-mean contrasts. These results characterize controlled measurement performance and researcher-assisted field feasibility for future distributed hand-anthropometry studies.

AI.tldr: HandAnthro 可从一张掌心向上、置于美式信纸上的智能手机照片中估计 44 项手部投影尺寸，受控实验中平均绝对误差为 3.80 mm，展示了无专业硬件条件下的可扩展手部人体测量学方案。
AI.motivation: 手部人体测量学是防护手套设计的基础，但现有测量方法通常依赖受训操作员、专用硬件或人工标注基准点，成本高、难以规模化，因此需要一种低成本、易部署的自动化测量手段。
AI.method: 提出 HandAnthro 流水线：重建被手腕遮挡的纸张边界以进行校正，将非手部像素白化，并基于微调的 YOLO 姿态模型，结合图像特定几何与轮廓信息，精化 41 个测量学专用关键点，从而输出 44 项投影手部尺寸。受控评估使用 45 名留出参与者的 720 张图像，每人在两部手机、两种背景、两种角度、两种标称光照下各拍 16 张。
AI.result: 704 张图像（97.8%）生成完整输出；与两名受训操作员的卡尺测量相比，各维度平均绝对误差为 3.80 mm。分区误差为：非拇指手指 2.48 mm、拇指 6.04 mm、手掌与手腕 6.17 mm。研究者辅助的手机应用试点中，消防员图像 268 张中 260 张（97.0%）自动批量返回全部 44 项尺寸；与独立全国消防员参考数据的描述性非配对比较显示，28 组性别×维度组均值对比的平均绝对差为 2.40 mm。
AI.conclusion: HandAnthro 刻画了受控条件下的测量性能以及研究者辅助的现场可行性，为未来分布式手部人体测量学研究提供了可扩展的低成本方案，但拇指与手掌/手腕区域精度仍有提升空间。

title: Storage Is Not Strategy: State-Conditioned Support Control for LLM Unlearning
summary: Many localized large language model (LLM) unlearning methods select a small parameter subset from a localization signal and keep it fixed during optimization. The parameters most associated with a target, however, need not be the best ones to update, and candidate interventions can change value as optimization proceeds. In a controlled experiment, a storage-localization score reaches an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.981, yet storage identity agrees with the better intervention on only 17/36 targets, while low-rank adaptation (LoRA) wins 35/36. We introduce Intervention Score, which ranks editable groups by the predicted effect of the actual unlearning update while accounting for collateral damage, and use it to form the static intervention-value baseline (Static-IV). We then introduce selective dynamic intervention re-ranking (DIR-R), which revisits that subset only when a calibrated probe justifies the comparison. On the Natural-TOFU dataset, our method has positive descriptive margins in 19/20 comparisons between methods and objectives, although several are near zero. On the LACUNA localization-precision benchmark, our mean terminal utility is higher in all six negative preference optimization (NPO) and SimNPO comparisons: NPO margins range from +0.431 to +0.848, and SimNPO margins range from +0.503 to +0.571. The gradient-difference (GradDiff) objective reveals substantial field dependence. Relative to Static-IV, the primary four-field GradDiff evaluation has six wins, six ties, and no losses, with mean and median paired gains of +0.165 and +0.0025. The evidence supports separating localization, initial intervention selection, and checkpoint-dependent support revision.

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有LLM卸载方法将定位信号选出的参数子集固定优化存在缺陷，提出以“干预评分”（Intervention Score）和静态基线Static-IV，以及选择性动态干预重排DIR-R，在Natural-TOFU和LACUNA基准上多数比较取得正向优势。
AI.motivation: 现有局部化LLM卸载方法从定位信号中选一个小参数子集后在优化中保持固定，但最关联目标的参数未必是最该更新的参数，且候选干预的价值会随优化进程变化。需验证“存储定位”与“有效干预”是否一致，并解耦定位、初始干预选择与随检查点变化的支持集修正。
AI.method: 受控实验中对比存储定位分数与LoRA：存储定位AUROC达0.981，但与更优干预仅在17/36目标上一致，LoRA则胜出35/36。据此提出Intervention Score，按实际卸载更新的预测效果并计入附带损害来对可编辑参数组排序，形成静态干预价值基线Static-IV；进一步提出选择性动态干预重排DIR-R，仅在校准探针支持比较时重访该子集。
AI.result: Natural-TOFU上方法在19/20的方法×目标比较中具正向描述性裕度（部分接近零）；LACUNA定位精度基准上六项NPO与SimNPO比较平均终端效用均更高：NPO裕度+0.431至+0.848，SimNPO裕度+0.503至+0.571。GradDiff目标显示显著场依赖：相对Static-IV的四场GradDiff评估为6胜6平0负，配对标配增益均值+0.165、中位数+0.0025。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持将定位、初始干预选择与依赖检查点的支持集修正三者分离；定位质量高不等于干预选择最优，静态选择可被动态、探针触发的重排进一步改进，尤其对NPO/SimNPO目标稳定有效，而GradDiff效果高度依赖评估场。

title: One Threshold Does Not Fit All Languages: Language-Conditional Deferral for Reliable and Efficient Low-Resource Text Classification
comment: Got accepted and published in NeurIPS 2026 GlobalSouthAI
summary: In the Global South, the lower-income countries of Africa, Asia, and Latin America where most of the world's languages are spoken, a deployed text classifier usually runs on ordinary CPUs, serves many languages with a single model, has few labeled examples in any of them, and relies on people to catch its mistakes. Such a system is only useful if it can promise how often it will be wrong: at most a fixed fraction of the labels it assigns on its own may be incorrect, and everything else must go to a person. Split conformal prediction delivers this promise through a single confidence threshold, normally estimated on validation data pooled across languages. We ask whether the promise reaches every language, and it does not. On MasakhaNEWS (16 African languages) and AfriSenti (12 languages plus two never seen in training), a pooled threshold meets the 90% target on average but covers Somali at 77.5%, Tigrinya at 83.7%, and the two unseen languages at 77.5% and 81.2%. Estimating one threshold per language brings every language to between 89.1% and 91.0% without retraining, and it shows how unequal the cost of the promise is: keeping it means sending 43% of Somali news and over 80% of Amharic and Xitsonga tweets to a person, against under 8% of Nigerian Pidgin news. One or two hundred labels per language are enough and the models train in minutes on one CPU core, so the fix is affordable: calibrate, report, and budget human review one language at a time.

AI.tldr: 汇聚阈值的一致性预测在语言间覆盖不均，改为逐语言校准阈值可在不重训模型的前提下使各语言覆盖率收敛到89.1%–91.0%。
AI.motivation: 全球南方部署的文本分类器多运行于普通CPU、单模型服务多语言、各语言标注稀少且依赖人工兜底。此类系统承诺"自动打标错误率不超过固定比例"才可用；但该承诺通常通过在所有语言汇合验证集上估计的单一置信阈值实现，作者关注这一承诺是否对每种语言都成立。
AI.method: 采用split conformal prediction；在MasakhaNEWS（16种非洲语言）与AfriSenti（12种语言，另含2种训练中未见语言）上比较两种阈值估计方式：跨语言汇合估计单一阈值，与逐语言单独估计阈值。评估指标为承诺覆盖率（目标90%）及由此产生的人工复核比例，并考察每语言标注量与CPU训练成本。
AI.result: 汇合阈值平均可达90%目标，但语言间差异显著：索马里语77.5%、提格里尼亚语83.7%，两种未见语言分别仅77.5%与81.2%。逐语言估计阈值可将所有语言覆盖率提升至89.1%–91.0%，且无需重新训练模型。同时揭示承诺代价的不平等：维持承诺需将43%的索马里语新闻、逾80%的阿姆哈拉语与聪加语推文转人工，而尼日利亚皮钦语新闻不足8%。每语言100–200条标注即足够，模型在单CPU核心上数分钟即可训练完成。
AI.conclusion: 汇合式一致性预测的覆盖率承诺不能覆盖所有语言，存在系统性欠覆盖；逐语言阈值校准可低成本修复该问题，代价差异显著且需显式预算人工复核量。作者建议按语言逐一进行校准、报告覆盖率并规划人工审核预算。

title: It's Not What the Image Shows: Irrelevant Context Destabilises VLM Judges Without Informing Them
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in place of human annotators, making it important that substitutability tests reflect the model rather than incidental evaluation conditions. We introduce MIST, the Misleading-Image Stress Test: 200 English sentences, each built around a phrase readable either figuratively or literally and shown with an aligned image depicting its reading, a misleading image depicting the opposite, or no image at all. The guidelines require the label to be decided from the sentence alone, so no image should change any answer. We expected each image to pull a judge's labels toward the sense it depicts, and neither kind did. Across thirteen VLM judges, an aligned image changed 20.5% of labels and a misleading one 19.4%, close for every judge and both above the 11.6% produced by deleting the ignore-the-image instruction with the image left in place. Yet only 37% of the labels that differ between the two images moved toward the sense shown, and agreement with our human annotators is unchanged whether the image is absent, aligned or misleading. The effect is smaller in the seven judges that pass the alt-test than in the six that never do, but present in all of them: what moves a judge is that an image is there, not which of the two it is, so a substitutability verdict describes a configuration as much as a model.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MIST 误导性图像压力测试：200 条含有可作比喻或字面解读短语的英文句子，配以对齐图像、误导图像或无图像。预期图像会改变判断，但实际上图像只是"存在"就足以改变标签，与图像内容无关，说明模型可替代性评估反映的是评估配置而非模型本身。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）日益被用作人类标注者的替代品，因此可替代性测试应反映模型本身的特性，而非偶然的评估条件。既有评估可能混淆了"模型能力"与"配置效应"，需要一个能明确检验图像存在与图像内容各自影响的压力测试。
AI.method: 构建 MIST（Misleading-Image Stress Test）：200 条英文句子，每条围绕一个可作比喻或字面解读的短语，并分别与对齐图像（呈现其解读）、误导图像（呈现相反解读）或无图像配对。标注指南要求仅依据句子本身确定标签，因此任何图像都不应改变答案。在十三种 VLM 判断器上比较三种条件下的标签变化。设置了对照条件：保留图像但删除"忽略图像"指令。此外按是否通过 alt-test 将判断器分为七组与六组进行比较。
AI.result: 对齐图像改变了 20.5% 的标签，误导图像改变了 19.4%，两者各判断器均接近，且均高于"删除忽略图像指令但保留图像"条件下的 11.6%。然而，两种图像间存在差异的标签中仅 37% 朝图像所示语义移动；与人类标注者的一致率在无图像、对齐与误导三种条件下均不变。七种通过 alt-test 的判断器效应小于六种从未通过的判断器，但效应在所有判断器中都存在。
AI.conclusion: 驱动判断器改变的是"存在图像"这一事实，而非图像究竟是对齐还是误导，因此可替代性结论描述的是某种评估配置，与描述模型本身同等重要；VLM 可替代性评估需要控制配置效应。

title: Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) methods such as GRPO rely on successful self-generated trajectories, but finite rollout budgets can produce all-fail groups with no reward-based policy-gradient signal. While additional rollouts improve the chance of success at higher cost, successful trajectories missing from one model's rollouts may already have been discovered by another. Indeed, we observe that heterogeneous models often succeed on complementary prompts, creating opportunities for mutual learning without a designated stronger teacher. To exploit this complementarity, we propose GRAFT (Gated Replacement of Answer-Failed groups with peer Trajectories), an off-policy-aware framework that replaces all-fail groups with informative peer groups. GRAFT transfers both successful and unsuccessful peer responses with peer-computed advantages, while controlling cross-model mismatch through sequence-level compatibility weighting and token-level importance ratio clipping. Across three heterogeneous model pairs and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, GRAFT consistently improves both models over GRPO with the same per-model rollout budget, gaining 2.1 points on average and up to 4.5 points in model-level average performance. Stored peer trajectories preserve most of the gains, improving over GRPO by 1.8 points on average without simultaneous co-training.

AI.tldr: GRAFT框架通过用同伴模型轨迹替换全失败组，实现异构模型互补学习，平均提升2.1分。
AI.motivation: RLVR方法（如GRPO）依赖自生成的成功轨迹，但有限采样预算会导致全失败组，无法产生基于奖励的策略梯度信号。增加采样可提高成功率但成本高；而一个模型缺失的成功轨迹可能已被另一模型发现，异构模型常在互补提示上成功，存在无需指定更强教师的互学习机会。
AI.method: 提出GRAFT（Gated Replacement of Answer-Failed groups with peer Trajectories），一种离策略感知框架，用信息量丰富的同伴组替换全失败组。它迁移同伴的成功与失败响应及同伴计算的advantage，同时通过序列级兼容性加权和token级重要性比率裁剪控制跨模型不匹配。
AI.result: 在三个异构模型对和五个数学推理基准上，GRAFT在相同单模型采样预算下持续优于GRPO，模型级平均性能提升2.1分，最高4.5分。存储的同伴轨迹保留大部分增益，在无同步协同训练情况下平均优于GRPO 1.8分。
AI.conclusion: 利用异构模型的互补性进行同伴轨迹迁移，可在不增加采样预算、无需更强教师的情况下有效缓解全失败组问题，提升RLVR训练效果。

title: Masked Swingers: Harnessing Data Augmentation to Advance Autoencoders for Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) removes the need for annotations and makes models that are capable across more domains than supervised learning. The autoencoder SSL framework learns by reconstructing its own input after information loss through a bottleneck or noise injection. Masked autoencoders (MAE) are the most successful instantiation of this framework: they encode a random subset of patches, then decode the masked-out patches. In this work, we introduce key modifications to improve MAEs. Our method augments an image in two different ways, then masks and encodes each view separately. It then exchanges the global representations (CLS tokens) between views before decoding the masked patches. By design, our Masked Swingers encourages learning a view-agnostic summary of the image to facilitate efficient transfer. We perform extensive experiments, and find Masked Swingers outperforms MAE by +3-5% on ImageNet-1K kNN and provides large gains on fine-grained tasks, e.g., relative gains of +45% on instance retrieval, +22% on animal re-ID, and +76% on Omniglot character recognition. To boot, Swingers reduces error -64% relative to MAE on three new state-probing datasets, opening the door to world modeling. Welcome to our Swingers party.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Masked Swingers，一种改进的掩码自编码器（MAE）自监督方法：对图像进行两种不同增强，分别对每个视图掩码编码，并在解码掩码 patch 前交换两视图的全局表示（CLS token），从而学习视图无关的图像摘要。实验显示其在 ImageNet-1K kNN 上超越 MAE 3-5%，并在细粒度任务上取得显著增益。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习无需标注，能获得跨域能力更强的模型。MAE 通过编码随机 patch 子集并重建被掩码 patch 来学习，但其表示可能缺乏视图无关的全局性，限制了下游迁移效率，因此作者希望改进 MAE 的框架设计。
AI.method: 对同一图像施加两种不同的数据增强，得到两个视图。对每个视图分别进行掩码和编码，随后在解码被掩码 patch 之前，交换两个视图的全局表示（CLS token）。这种"交换"机制通过设计促使模型学习视图无关（view-agnostic）的图像摘要，以提升迁移效率。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-1K kNN 上比 MAE 高 3-5%。细粒度任务增益显著：实例检索相对提升 +45%，动物再识别 +22%，Omniglot 字符识别 +76%。在三个新的 state-probing 数据集上相对 MAE 降低误差 64%。
AI.conclusion: Masked Swingers 通过交换跨视图的全局表示，有效提升了掩码自编码器的表示质量与迁移能力，在多项下游任务上大幅超越 MAE，并为世界建模研究打开了新方向。

title: Learning from synthetic photorealistic raindrop for single image raindrop removal
comment: 2019 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision Workshop (ICCVW)
summary: Raindrops adhered to camera lens or windshield are inevitable in rainy scenes and can become an issue for many computer vision systems such as autonomous driving. Because raindrop appearance is affected by too many parameters, therefore it is unlikely to find an effective model based solution. Learning based methods are also problematic, because traditional learning method cannot properly model the complex appearance. Whereas deep learning method lacks sufficiently large and realistic training data. To solve it, in our work, we propose the first photo-realistic dataset of synthetic adherent raindrops for training. The rendering is physics based with consideration of the water dynamic, geometric and photometry. The dataset contains various types of rainy scenes and particularly the rainy driving scenes. Based on the modeling of raindrop imagery, we introduce a detection network which has the awareness of the raindrop refraction as well as its blurring. Based on that, we propose the removal network that can well recover the image structure. Rigorous experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of our proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个基于物理渲染的照片级真实感附着雨滴合成数据集，并基于雨滴成像建模设计了含折射与模糊感知的检测网络及能恢复图像结构的去除网络，实验达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 雨天附着于镜头或挡风玻璃的雨滴会严重干扰自动驾驶等计算机视觉系统。雨滴外观受众多参数影响，难以建立有效的模型化解法；传统学习方法难以建模其复杂外观，而深度学习方法又缺乏足够大规模且真实的训练数据。
AI.method: 构建首个照片级真实感的合成附着雨滴数据集，渲染过程基于物理，综合考虑水滴动力学、几何与光度特性，覆盖多种雨天场景（尤其雨天驾驶场景）；基于雨滴成像建模，提出具有雨滴折射与模糊感知能力的检测网络；在此基础上提出能良好恢复图像结构的去除网络。
AI.result: 严格的实验表明，所提框架取得了当前最优（state-of-the-art）的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过物理渲染数据集与成像先验驱动的检测—去除网络，可有效解决附着雨滴对视觉系统的干扰问题。

title: EndoPrior-GS: Dynamic Endoscopic Reconstruction with a Joint Texture Prior
summary: Dynamic endoscopic reconstruction is fundamental to robotic surgery and computer-assisted interventions. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) realises real-time rendering, its application to deformable intraoperative environments remains constrained by spurious geometry and varying illuminations. To address these limitations, we introduce EndoPrior-GS, a novel pipeline that explicitly couples frame-extracted vision heuristics and estimated depth maps. EndoPrior-GS derives a joint texture prior from a tool-filtered valid tissue mask, a non-specular photometric filter, and anatomical structural salience, yielding a probability map that guides primitive initialisation and subsequent density control. The prior is further extended to the temporal domain through a texture-aware term that dynamically weighs pairwise primitive contributions during training. We conduct extensive experiments on benchmark datasets EndoNeRF and SCARED, and the obtained results show that our method EndoPrior-GS reduces Flow Error by 27.7% and 25.8% over the representative approaches while preserving competitive rendering quality and real-time rendering speed. Our project website is available at https://jiaqi-huang-77.github.io/EndoPrior-GS/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EndoPrior-GS，将帧提取的视觉启发式信息与估计深度图耦合进 3DGS 流程，用于动态内窥镜重建，在 EndoNeRF 与 SCARED 上显著降低 Flow Error。
AI.motivation: 机器人手术与计算机辅助干预需要对动态内窥镜场景进行重建。3D Gaussian Splatting 虽能实时渲染，但在可变形术中环境下受伪几何与光照变化影响，直接应用受限。
AI.method: EndoPrior-GS 显式耦合帧提取的视觉启发式与估计深度图：由器械过滤后的有效组织掩膜、去镜面高光光度滤波与解剖结构显著性共同构建联合纹理先验，生成概率图以引导基元初始化与后续密度控制；并通过纹理感知项将先验扩展到时间域，在训练中动态加权成对基元贡献。
AI.result: 在 EndoNeRF 和 SCARED 基准上，相比代表性方法 Flow Error 分别降低 27.7% 和 25.8%，同时保持有竞争力的渲染质量与实时渲染速度。
AI.conclusion: 利用组织掩膜、去高光与结构显著性等先验引导 3DGS 的初始化与密度控制，可有效缓解动态内窥镜重建中的伪几何与光照变化问题，在精度与实时性间取得良好平衡。

title: Retrieval Capacity of Self-Attention Under Competition
summary: How many tokens from its context does a language model actually use, and what determines that number? We study this question through self-attention. Without retraining, we retain only the tokens with the highest attention weights at each head, layer, and query, keeping their original weights unchanged. By varying the selected set size and measuring the increase in negative log-likelihood (NLL), we estimate the effective attention set size needed to stay within a chosen loss tolerance. Relatively small selected sets can keep NLL close to the full-attention baseline, although the required size varies across models. Attention-based selection substantially outperforms random selection. Selected sets exhibit geometric structure, although geometric separation alone does not establish that model loss is preserved. Extending context while evaluating the same prediction targets increases the required set size, while its fraction of context decreases over the tested range.
