Experiments with a fixed supporting fact show that additional background pushes its tokens down the attention ranking and reduces their attention mass. Renormalizing the retained weights can substantially reduce the required set size, showing that it also depends on how selected representations are combined. Conditional theoretical models explain how competition and attention-mass retention can produce growing set sizes without more distinct information to retrieve. These results provide a way to measure effective attention set size in language models and investigate its dependence on context, competition, and aggregation.

AI.tldr: 论文通过自注意力权重选取实验，提出“有效注意力集规模”的度量方法，考察语言模型实际使用多少上下文token及其影响因素。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型实际从上下文中利用多少token、以及这一数量由什么决定，是理解长上下文能力与注意力机制的关键问题，但此前缺乏直接、可测量的量化手段。
AI.method: 无需重训练：在每个注意力头、层和查询处，仅保留注意力权重最高的token并保持其原始权重不变；通过改变保留集大小并测量负对数似然（NLL）的上升，估计在给定损失容忍度下所需的有效注意力集规模。文中还与随机选取对比，并检验保留集的几何结构、上下文长度、背景事实干扰及权重重归一化的影响，辅以条件性理论模型分析。
AI.result: 较小的保留集即可将NLL保持在接近全注意力基线的水平，但所需规模因模型而异；基于注意力的选取显著优于随机选取；保留集呈现几何结构，但几何可分性本身不足以保证损失不变；延长上下文而保持预测目标不变会增大所需集规模，但其占上下文的比例在测试范围内下降；固定支撑事实实验中，额外背景会将支撑事实token的注意力排名和注意力质量压低；权重重归一化可显著减小所需集规模，说明其还依赖保留表示的组合方式；条件性理论模型解释了竞争与注意力质量保留如何在没有更多可检索的差异化信息时仍导致集规模增长。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了一种度量语言模型有效注意力集规模的方法，并揭示该规模依赖上下文长度、token间竞争以及聚合方式。

title: How Many Labels Does a Language Need? Annotation Budgets and Cross-Lingual Pooling for African-Language Text Classification
summary: Every text classifier for an African language begins with a budgeting question: how many labelled examples are needed, and can labels from other African languages stand in for them? We answer both questions empirically for 28 language-task pairs, news topic classification in 16 languages (MasakhaNEWS) and tweet sentiment in 12 languages (AfriSenti), using a character n-gram linear model that trains in seconds on two CPU cores with no pretrained weights and no accelerator. Monolingual learning curves at budgets from 25 to several thousand labels show that topic classification reaches 90\% of its full-data macro-F1 with about 400 labels in the median language, while sentiment is still improving at the full training size in 11 of 12 languages and needs thousands of labels. Pooling the full training data of the other languages in the benchmark is worth a great deal at small budgets and nothing at large ones: at 25 target labels it adds 0.20 macro-F1 on average for news (up to 0.43 for Lingala) and 0.08 for sentiment, the gain decays to zero by 800 labels, and at full size pooling hurts in 9 of 16 and 8 of 12 languages. Twenty-five target labels plus pooled data match what 100 to 400 monolingual labels achieve for most news languages. A complete zero-shot transfer matrix shows that transfer without any target labels recovers a median of only 13\% (news) and 4\% (sentiment) of the gap between a majority-class predictor and the in-language model, with the exceptions explained by shared script (Amharic and Tigrinya), shared lexicon (English and Nigerian Pidgin, the Arabic dialects), or a shared label prior rather than by language family. We release code that regenerates every number from the public benchmark files and translate the results into concrete annotation guidance for teams building African-language classifiers without GPUs.

AI.tldr: 本文针对非洲语言文本分类的标注预算问题，基于28个语言-任务对（16种语言的新闻主题分类与12种语言的推文情感分析），用字符n-gram线性模型实证研究了单语学习曲线、跨语言数据池化以及零样本迁移的效果。
AI.motivation: 非洲语言文本分类器构建面临核心的预算问题：需要多少标注样本，以及能否用其他非洲语言的标签替代。论文希望以实证方式回答这两个问题，为缺乏GPU的团队提供具体的标注指导。
AI.method: 采用字符n-gram线性模型，在两核CPU上数秒内完成训练，不使用预训练权重和加速器。在预算25到数千标签范围内绘制单语学习曲线，并评估将基准中其他语言全部训练数据池化的效果，同时构建完整的零样本迁移矩阵。
AI.result: 新闻主题分类在中等语言中约400个标签即可达到全量数据宏F1的90%，而情感分析在12种语言中的11种仍需数千标签。池化数据在小预算下收益显著（25个目标标签时新闻平均提升0.20宏F1，林加拉语最高达0.43；情感提升0.08），但收益在约800标签后衰减为零，全量时在多数语言中反而有害。零样本迁移仅恢复中位13%（新闻）和4%（情感）的差距，例外主要源于共享文字、共享词汇或共享标签先验，而非语系。
AI.conclusion: 研究发布了可从公开基准文件复现所有数值的代码，并将结果转化为面向无GPU团队构建非洲语言分类器的具体标注建议。

title: Zero-shot Dependency Parsing with Unsupervised Cross-Lingual Bootstrapping
summary: Pre-trained language models (PLMs) with encoder-based architectures have shown impressive capabilities in zero-shot cross-lingual transfer for various language understanding tasks. However, applying this technique to dependency parsing remains a significant challenge due to its syntactic nature. To boost model generalizability across linguistic typologies, we propose a cross-lingual unsupervised bootstrapping method to improve syntactic knowledge within the PLM. We show that our method achieves a significant improvement in zero-shot parsing performance in low-resource languages. Analysis of these bootstrapped models uncovers increased robustness in recognizing syntactic structures, evidenced by higher scores in parameter-free tree probing tests.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种跨语言无监督自举方法，用于增强预训练语言模型内部的句法知识，从而提升零样本跨语言依存句法分析性能。
AI.motivation: 基于编码器架构的预训练语言模型在零样本跨语言迁移的语义理解任务上表现优异，但依存句法分析因其句法特性，迁移效果仍不理想。作者希望通过提升模型跨语言类型学的泛化能力来解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出跨语言无监督自举（bootstrapping）方法，在预训练语言模型内部注入并强化句法知识。
AI.result: 在低资源语言的零样本句法分析性能上取得显著提升；通过无参数树探测（tree probing）测试显示，自举后的模型在识别句法结构方面鲁棒性更强，得分更高。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言无监督自举能有效增强预训练语言模型的句法知识，改善零样本跨语言依存句法分析表现，并提升模型对句法结构的识别鲁棒性。

title: Visual Branch is What You Need for CLIP-based Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) requires models to recognize new classes over time without forgetting previously learned ones. With the rise of vision-language pre-training, CLIP has become a strong foundation for CIL. A common design in CLIP-based CIL is to construct textual classifier weights by encoding class-name templates with the CLIP text encoder, and then classify visual features by image-text cosine similarity. This design is appealing: since CLIP aligns images and text in a shared embedding space, textual weights appear to provide an off-the-shelf classifier for incremental classes. However, we show that this seemingly natural design is not always beneficial, as a modality gap can still separate the two modalities and make textual classifier weights deviate from visual class distributions. Empirically, under identical task-wise CIL training, initializing the cosine classifier with visual class centers yields lower loss and better incremental accuracy than using CLIP textual features. Motivated by these observations, we propose VIS, a visual-only method for CLIP-based CIL that removes the deployed textual branch and constructs the incremental classifier entirely in the visual space. To obtain stronger task-adaptive visual representations, VIS uses only base-session data to enhance CLIP's final visual representation with informative visual-layer features. Built on the enhanced visual representation, VIS employs a simple kernelized incremental least-squares SVM, whose classifier weights are solved in closed form from additive sufficient statistics. When new classes arrive, VIS accumulates their sufficient statistics and recomputes the classifier weights for all seen classes, enabling efficient incremental updates while preserving historical class knowledge. Extensive experiments show that VIS achieves state-of-the-art performance without a textual branch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VIS，一种仅视觉的CLIP类增量学习方法，移除文本分类分支，在视觉空间构建增量分类器，结合视觉层特征增强与核化增量最小二乘SVM，实现高效增量更新并达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: CLIP-based CIL常以文本编码器生成的类别模板作为文本分类器权重，借助图文共享嵌入空间实现增量分类。但作者发现该设计并非总有益：模态鸿沟使文本分类器权重偏离视觉类别分布。实验表明，在相同任务式CIL训练下，用视觉类中心初始化余弦分类器比CLIP文本特征损失更低、增量精度更高。
AI.method: VIS完全在视觉空间构建增量分类器，去掉部署阶段的文本分支。仅使用base-session数据，将CLIP最终视觉表示与有信息量的视觉层特征融合，得到更强的任务自适应视觉表示。在此基础上采用简单的核化增量最小二乘SVM，分类器权重由可加充分统计量闭式求解；新类到来时累积其充分统计量并重算所有已见类权重，实现高效增量更新并保留历史知识。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，VIS无需文本分支即达到最先进性能；在相同CIL训练下，视觉类中心初始化余弦分类器比CLIP文本特征具有更低损失和更好增量准确率。
AI.conclusion: 文本分类器权重并非CLIP-based CIL的必需设计，模态鸿沟会削弱其有效性。仅依赖视觉空间、结合视觉特征增强与核化增量最小二乘SVM，可在无文本分支条件下高效实现SOTA类增量学习。

title: ReCAP: Retrieval-Guided Capability Reuse for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Multimodal continual instruction tuning (MCIT) aims to enable multimodal large language models to acquire new capabilities from sequential tasks while preserving previously learned knowledge. Existing methods primarily mitigate catastrophic forgetting by constraining parameter updates or separating task-specific adaptations. However, continual adaptation can also benefit from external knowledge that provides domain-specific information and reusable reasoning patterns for solving diverse instructions. For example, to answer "How many red cubes are to the left of the sphere?", domain knowledge can provide relevant concepts about objects and spatial relations, while reasoning knowledge can specify ordered operations such as object recognition, spatial filtering, and counting. Despite this potential, how to leverage external knowledge for continual adaptation remains largely unexplored in existing MCIT methods. To this end, we propose ReCAP, a retrieval-guided framework that leverages external knowledge to guide capability reuse during continual adaptation. At each continual stage, ReCAP uses external search and an LLM to incrementally build a knowledge base of domain, reasoning, and format knowledge based on the current-stage training data. For each instruction, retrieved domain knowledge guides generation, while retrieved reasoning knowledge selects and orders capability modules to form an instance-specific capability path. As these capability modules are reused across stages, subsequent adaptation can overwrite previously learned parameters. To enable stable cross-stage reuse, ReCAP introduces adaptive subspace recycling, which parameterizes reusable capability modules with shared bases and stage-specific cores, protects historically important directions while recycling residual capacity. Extensive experiments on MCIT benchmarks show that ReCAP achieves SOTA performance.

AI.tldr: 提出ReCAP框架，通过检索引导的外部知识（领域、推理、格式知识）结合自适应子空间回收，实现多模态持续指令微调中的能力复用与稳定跨阶段复用，达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态持续指令微调（MCIT）方法主要通过约束参数更新或分离任务特定适配来缓解灾难性遗忘，但未探索利用外部知识提供领域信息和可复用推理模式来辅助持续适应。例如回答"球体左侧有多少个红色方块"时，领域知识可提供物体和空间关系概念，推理知识可指定有序操作（物体识别、空间过滤、计数）。如何利用外部知识进行持续适应仍是空白。
AI.method: ReCAP检索引导框架：每个持续阶段用外部搜索和LLM基于当前阶段训练数据增量构建包含领域、推理、格式知识的知识库；对每条指令，检索到的领域知识引导生成，推理知识选择并排序能力模块以形成实例专属能力路径；因模块跨阶段复用会导致参数被覆盖，引入自适应子空间回收，用共享基和阶段特定核参数化可复用能力模块，保护历史重要方向并回收剩余容量。
AI.result: 在MCIT基准上大量实验显示ReCAP取得SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 利用外部知识引导能力复用并结合自适应子空间回收，可有效缓解持续适应中的遗忘问题，为MCIT提供新思路。

title: It's All Training: A Fully Synthetic Single-Stage Recipe for LLMs
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 35 pages, 9 figures. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/PleIAs/SYNTH
summary: Current pre-training datasets are derived from web crawls, with all their issues, and were not designed to support mid- and post-training pipelines--for instance, they contain little explicit reasoning. Thus, many frontier labs have begun to develop their own internal datasets, starting from state-of-the-art models, to augment their pre-training data mix, eg, with reasoning traces to address cold-start problems. While demonstratively effective, none of these datasets are public, and the effect of this so-called synthetic data on knowledge and skill acquisition of language models, including small ones, remains poorly understood. We present SYNTH, the first open-source synthetic corpus derived from 58,698 Wikipedia articles that collapses pre-, mid-, and post-training into a single training stage via structured amplification of curated encyclopedic seeds. We evaluate SYNTH by training a suite of models: a 56M tiny model (Monad), 0.3B-0.6B dense models (Baguettotron), and a 13B / 1B-active MoE. At iso-compute, SYNTH outperforms filtered web data, and our models remain competitive with similarly-sized open-weight baselines. Because SYNTH is back-translated from grounded passages, SYNTH-trained models achieve high factual precision despite 10-140x fewer training tokens, with memorization targeted by the seed corpus. These results show that synthetic datasets, including our SYNTH dataset, are capable of producing competitive generalist models from a fraction of the training data, enabling rapid iteration as the frontier advances. These findings open up possibilities for both generalist models with significantly increased data efficiency, as well as domain-specific models where no instruction or conversational data is available. Finally, we publicly release our SYNTH dataset and the suite of Baguettotron models under a permissive license, thus supporting open-source language model development.

AI.tldr: SYNTH是首个开源合成语料库，基于58,698篇维基百科文章构建，将预训练、中期训练和后训练合并为单一训练阶段，通过结构化放大精选百科种子实现。在等计算量下，SYNTH训练的模型优于过滤后的网页数据，训练token减少10-140倍仍保持高事实精度，并公开数据集与模型。
AI.motivation: 现有预训练数据集源自网络爬虫，存在诸多问题，并非为中期和后训练流程设计，例如缺乏显式推理内容。许多前沿实验室已开始开发内部数据集，从最先进模型出发扩充预训练数据混合（如加入推理轨迹以解决冷启动问题），但这些数据集均未公开，且所谓合成数据对语言模型（包括小型模型）知识与技能习得的影响仍鲜为人知。
AI.method: 提出SYNTH——首个开源合成语料库，源自58,698篇维基百科文章，通过对精选百科种子进行结构化放大，将预训练、中期训练与后训练压缩为单一训练阶段。通过训练一系列模型进行评估：56M微小模型（Monad）、0.3B-0.6B稠密模型（Baguettotron）以及13B/1B激活的MoE模型。
AI.result: 在等计算量下，SYNTH优于过滤后的网页数据，模型与同规模开源权重基线相比具有竞争力。由于SYNTH由有依据的段落回译而成，训练出的模型在训练token减少10-140倍的情况下仍实现高事实精度，记忆由种子语料库定向控制。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据集（包括SYNTH）能够以一小部分训练数据产出有竞争力的通用模型，支持随着前沿进展快速迭代。这些发现为显著提高数据效率的通用模型，以及无指令或对话数据的领域特定模型开辟了可能性。公开SYNTH数据集与Baguettotron模型套件（宽松许可），支持开源语言模型发展。

title: Pixels to Keys: Exploring Spatial and Motion Cues in Gameplay Inverse Dynamics
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Multimodal Digital Agents (ECCV 2026): https://mda-workshop.allen.ai/
summary: Video games offer scalable environments for studying perception and control in embodied agents. Abundant online gameplay videos could supply demonstrations, but they rarely include player inputs for training. Inverse Dynamics Models (IDMs) have thus been proposed to infer inputs from frames. Large (up to 1B parameters) IDMs trained on $\sim$1K-2K gameplay hours demonstrate feasibility and cross-environment generalization at this scale, but researchers do not clarify what the key components are to recover individual actions and often report only aggregate accuracy that can mask rare-action failures. We study the problem in a data-constrained scenario to evaluate how spatial motion features, model architectures, and training objectives affect an IDM's outcome and we analyse our models on per-key and balanced metrics such as $F_1^{macro}$. Our experiments on Trackmania highlight the importance of factors like the model architecture and motion flow extraction in preprocessing, while also showing the limits of evaluation through unbalanced metrics. The application of the same architecture and training recipe to Cyberpunk 2077 reveals uneven performance across game mechanics. Our per-action evaluation and failure analysis highlight ambiguities from camera motion, delayed effects and imbalanced key-press frequencies that call for explicit modeling of 3D scene structure, long-term state and the adoption of proper losses in future implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文在数据受限场景下研究逆动力学模型（IDM）从游戏画面推断玩家按键输入的问题，通过Trackmania和Cyberpunk 2077实验，揭示架构、光流预处理等因素的重要性，并指出非平衡指标掩盖稀有动作失败的问题。
AI.motivation: 游戏视频可提供大规模演示数据，但通常缺少玩家输入，无法直接用于训练。已有研究用逆动力学模型（IDM）从帧推断输入，规模可达10亿参数、约1K-2K小时游玩数据，但研究者未厘清恢复单个动作的关键要素，且多报告聚合准确率，掩盖了稀有动作的失败情况。
AI.method: 在数据受限场景下，系统评估空间运动特征、模型架构与训练目标对IDM效果的影响；采用逐按键（per-key）及平衡指标（如F1_macro）进行分析；在Trackmania上进行实验，并将相同架构与训练方案迁移至Cyberpunk 2077进行验证。
AI.result: Trackmania实验表明模型架构与预处理中的运动流（motion flow）提取等因素至关重要，同时显示非平衡指标评估的局限；迁移至Cyberpunk 2077后，不同游戏机制间性能表现不均衡。
AI.conclusion: 逐动作评估与失败分析揭示了相机运动、延迟效应和按键频率不均衡带来的歧义，未来实现需显式建模3D场景结构、长期状态并采用合适的损失函数。

title: The Unequal Influence of Bad Advice: Using Training Data Attribution to Modulate Emergent Misalignment
summary: Fine-tuning large language models on narrow, misaligned tasks can undo their post-training alignment and induce novel misaligned behaviors -- a phenomenon known as \emph{emergent misalignment} (EM). EM has been linked to persona-like representations, where fine-tuning might reduce loss by amplifying a harmful or 'evil' persona. It remains unclear which properties of the training data drive this effect: whether all harmful examples contribute approximately equally to misalignment and whether different models are equally affected by the same fine-tuning examples. In this work, we use training data attribution to quantitatively estimate how much each harmful example contributes to EM. We benchmark the quality of the attribution via retraining -- a sound attribution score should enable us to enhance or attenuate EM by filtering data on that score. Score-based filtering can substantially enhance or attenuate EM; we find that both data-attribution scores and a black-box harmfulness score can identify consequential examples. All models we test become misaligned when trained on the same dataset, and influence scores perform best when filtering data from the same model that computed them. We find cross-model generalization of influence scores from scores derived from the three model families we tested, but this generalization does not recover same model filtering performance.

AI.tldr: 本文利用训练数据归因定量估计每条有害样本对"涌现性失对齐"（EM）的贡献，并通过重训练验证归因质量。结果显示：基于分数的数据过滤可显著增强或削弱EM；归因分数与黑盒有害性分数均能识别关键样本；所有被测模型在同一数据集上都会失对齐；影响力分数在同模型过滤时表现最佳，跨模型泛化虽有但性能不及。
AI.motivation: 在窄域、失对齐任务上微调大语言模型会破坏其训练后对齐，诱发新的失对齐行为（EM），该现象被认为与"邪恶人格"表征相关。但尚不清楚训练数据中哪些属性驱动这一效应：是否所有有害样本贡献大致相同，以及不同模型对同一微调样本是否同等敏感。作者旨在定量刻画单条有害样本对EM的贡献。
AI.method: 采用训练数据归因（training data attribution）方法，为每条有害训练样本计算影响力分数，定量估计其对EM的贡献。以重训练作为归因质量的基准验证：若归因分数合理，则可据此过滤数据来增强或削弱EM。同时对比数据归因分数与黑盒有害性分数，并测试影响力的同模型与跨模型泛化性（涉及三个模型家族）。
AI.result: 基于分数的数据过滤能显著增强或削弱EM；数据归因分数与黑盒有害性分数均可识别出有实质影响的样本；所有被测模型在同一数据集上训练后都会失对齐；影响力分数在同模型（计算分数的模型与过滤数据的模型一致）时过滤效果最佳；影响力分数在三个模型家族间存在跨模型泛化，但该泛化无法达到同模型过滤的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: EM由特定而非均等贡献的有害样本驱动，可通过可量化的归因分数识别并加以调控。归因分数具有实际可用性（可用于数据过滤），且其效果依赖于计算与应用的模型一致性；跨模型泛化虽存在但不充分。这为理解并缓解微调引发的失对齐提供了数据层面的定量工具。

title: Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student to match a privileged teacher distribution along its own sampled trajectory. Standard OPSD applies this supervision to unverified student rollouts while conditioning the teacher on privileged context, typically a reference solution. We separate these roles in a factorial analysis and find that scaffold correctness has a stronger effect on downstream accuracy than context correctness. Unverified scaffolds create an imitation gap because the teacher can use information unavailable to the student. This gap shrinks with model scale, yet OPSD continues to supervise mostly unverified trajectories. In contrast, verified scaffolds remain effective even when the teacher is conditioned on the student's own unsuccessful rollout. Based on this finding, we introduce OASIS, which retains the OPSD objective but supervises mostly verified by label on-policy trajectories and replaces written solutions with unverified model-generated attempts as the teacher context. OASIS therefore requires only final-answer labels. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025, OASIS improves over the base model by 3.2--3.8 points on average, while OPSD's gain falls from 3.05 points at 1.7B to 0.14 at 8B. At 8B, OASIS improves over OPSD by 3.05 points, showing that verified on-policy scaffolds preserve the effectiveness of self-distillation as models scale.

AI.tldr: 本文将OPSD中的"特权上下文正确性"与"学生轨迹是否被验证"两个因素解耦,发现已验证轨迹比正确参考解更关键,据此提出OASIS,仅用最终答案标签即可在规模扩大时保持自蒸馏收益。
AI.motivation: 标准OPSD在未验证的学生采样轨迹上施加监督,同时让教师以特权上下文(通常是参考解)为条件。这两者在已有工作中被绑定,导致"模仿差距":教师使用了学生无法获得的信息。作者希望厘清究竟是上下文正确性还是轨迹验证性驱动了性能,并解决OPSD随模型规模增大而收益衰减的问题。
AI.method: 作者进行因子分析,将"支架是否已按标签验证"与"教师上下文是否正确"作为两个独立因素。基于发现(已验证支架影响力更强),提出OASIS:保留OPSD目标函数,但主要对"按标签验证的on-policy轨迹"施加监督,并以模型自身生成的未验证尝试替代书面参考解作为教师上下文。因此训练只需最终答案标签,无需人工参考解。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B上,于AIME 2024、AIME 2025、HMMT 2025评测:OASIS相对基座平均提升3.2–3.8分;而OPSD的增益从1.7B时的3.05分下降到8B时的0.14分。在8B规模上,OASIS比OPSD高出3.05分。
AI.conclusion: 已验证的on-policy支架能够随模型规模扩大保持自蒸馏的有效性,而依赖未验证轨迹与特权参考解的标准OPSD收益会随规模衰减。OASIS证明仅用最终答案标签即可实现更强的可扩展自蒸馏。

title: SYNCR: Diagnosing and Learning Cross-Video Reasoning from Simulation
summary: Reasoning across videos requires aligning events, matching identities, comparing motion, and integrating partial observations. Evaluating these capabilities and testing how to improve them requires both reliable labels and targeted supervision. We introduce SYNCR, a simulator-grounded framework that connects these two needs through shared task generators. Built on Habitat, Kubric, and CLEVRER, SYNCR derives answers from environment state and provides 4,000 evaluation questions and 15,960 training questions over disjoint videos, spanning eight cross-video reasoning tasks. Visual ablations and human evaluation assess dependence on the supplied evidence and answer recoverability. Evaluation of 22 multimodal large language models reveals persistent difficulties in physical comparison and scene integration that increasing model size does not consistently resolve. Supervised fine-tuning raises Qwen3-VL-8B's average SYNCR accuracy from 32.6% to 61.6%, with gains extending to task configurations and video sources absent from training for those tasks. Transfer to real footage is most consistent for temporal ordering: accuracy improves by 9.0-20.5 percentage points on constructed Assembly101 and Panoptic ordering sets across three checkpoints spanning two model families and two model sizes, with additional gains on existing temporal reasoning benchmarks. These results establish SYNCR as a controlled setting for diagnosing cross-video reasoning failures, testing their learnability, and identifying where synthetic supervision transfers.

AI.tldr: SYNCR是一个基于仿真器（Habitat、Kubric、CLEVRER）的跨视频推理基准与训练数据框架，包含8类跨视频推理任务、4000道评测题与15960道训练题，用于诊断多模态大模型的跨视频推理能力并检验合成监督的可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 跨视频推理需要对齐事件、匹配身份、比较运动并整合部分观测，评估并提升这些能力既依赖可靠标注，也依赖有针对性的监督信号。现有基准难以同时提供可验证标签与可控训练数据。
AI.method: 提出SYNCR框架，通过共享任务生成器同时满足标注与监督需求：答案由仿真器环境状态推导，而非人工标注；基于Habitat、Kubric与CLEVRER构建，评测与训练视频互不重叠；共8类跨视频推理任务；通过视觉消融与人工评估检验模型对给定证据的依赖程度及答案可恢复性；并对22个多模态大模型进行评测，以及开展监督微调与跨数据集迁移实验。
AI.result: 22个多模态大模型在物理比较与场景整合任务上持续表现困难，增大模型规模并不能稳定解决；监督微调使Qwen3-VL-8B的平均准确率从32.6%提升至61.6%，且增益可扩展到训练中未出现的任务配置与视频来源；向真实视频迁移在时间排序任务上最为一致，在Assembly101与Panoptic构建的排序集上，跨两个模型家族、两种规模的三个检查点提升9.0–20.5个百分点，并在已有时间推理基准上取得额外增益。
AI.conclusion: SYNCR为诊断跨视频推理失效、检验其可学习性以及识别合成监督可迁移的边界提供了可控的实验环境。

title: EpiCon: Collective Agent Learning through Co-Evolving Multimodal Memory
summary: Agents can learn from past executions, but enabling different agents to reuse and build on one another's experience remains challenging. We introduce EpiCon, a shared multimodal memory framework for agent collective learning without updating host model parameters. EpiCon links question-level memory evolution to a persistent experience bank through two independently trained 2B models: a memory controller and a tree self-organizer. The controller jointly refines textual guidance and visual evidence across attempts and selectively includes visual memory. The self-organizer consolidates lessons hierarchically and retrieves experience and rules for new problems. We evaluate EpiCon on eleven benchmarks spanning four multimodal task domains, using two harnesses and multiple backbones. A frozen bank improves other systems even with a single solving attempt. A second harness raises the original system's macro-average score by 2.6 points across eleven benchmarks. Across four host configurations, EpiCon improves macro-average scores by 1.7 to 4.9 points over No Memory and reduces memory-operation time by 67\% to 74\% relative to backbone-sized memory models.

AI.tldr: 提出EpiCon共享多模态记忆框架，使不同智能体无需更新宿主模型参数即可复用与积累经验。
AI.motivation: 智能体可从历史执行中学习，但不同智能体之间难以复用和基于彼此经验进行再学习。现有方法通常依赖更新宿主模型参数，成本高且不利于跨智能体共享。
AI.method: EpiCon将问题级记忆演化与持久经验库连接，采用两个独立训练的2B模型：记忆控制器与树状自组织器。控制器在多次尝试中联合优化文本引导与视觉证据，并选择性纳入视觉记忆；自组织器对经验进行层次化整合，并为新问题检索经验与规则。
AI.result: 在覆盖四个多模态任务域的十一个基准上，使用两种测试框架与多种骨干模型评估。冻结经验库即使仅一次求解尝试也能提升其他系统；第二种框架使原系统在十一个基准上的宏平均分提升2.6分。在四种宿主配置下，EpiCon较无记忆基线提升宏平均分1.7至4.9分，并将记忆操作时间较骨干规模记忆模型减少67%至74%。
AI.conclusion: EpiCon验证了无需更新宿主模型参数的共享多模态记忆框架在智能体集体学习中的有效性，兼顾性能提升与记忆操作效率。

title: Time-Anchored Diffusion Language Models: Latent-Space Caching for Fast Generation
summary: Recent work on anchored diffusion language models improves denoising by shaping an intermediate latent space with supervised important-token targets. In this work, we introduce time-based (self-supervised) anchoring, which learns and reuses latent anchors without requiring such targets. Our key observation is that anchors encode persistent properties of the clean sequence, such as its semantic intent, global structure, or intermediate plan. Although their hidden representations become stale as the token canvas evolves, their semantic content remains useful across nearby diffusion times. This is implemented through a two-stage architecture consisting of a relatively expensive anchor network that generates the latent cache state and a lightweight denoising network that intelligently combines the cached latent state with the current state at each reverse step using a fusion module. This gives anchoring a latent-space caching interpretation: the anchor network is evaluated periodically, while its cached representation is reused across multiple reverse steps. We instantiate this framework as TADM:Post-train, which time-anchorizes pretrained DLMs, and TADM:Pretraining, which learns time-based anchors during pretraining. Applied to DiffusionGemma-26B, TADM:Post-train improves throughput by approximately 49% to 79% on several math, code, and STEM benchmarks (GSM8K, AIME26, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench-v6, HumanEval, MMLU-Pro). TADM:Pretraining reduces Transformer-layer computation by up to 38% relative to a standard single-stage DLM, achieves up to 73% higher measured throughput than ADLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于时间的（自监督）锚定方法，无需重要token监督目标即可学习并复用潜空间锚点，通过两阶段架构（锚网络+轻量去噪网络）实现潜空间缓存，实例化为TADM，可提升扩散语言模型吞吐量并降低计算量。
AI.motivation: 已有锚定扩散语言模型依赖监督式的重要token目标来塑造中间潜空间以改进去噪，这限制了其适用性并需要额外标注。作者希望摆脱这类监督目标，实现自监督的锚定机制，从而提升扩散语言模型的效率。
AI.method: 提出基于时间的自监督锚定，核心观察是锚点编码了干净序列的持久属性（语义意图、全局结构、中间计划），其隐藏表示虽随token画布演化而陈旧，但语义内容在相邻扩散时间内仍有效。实现采用两阶段架构：较昂贵的锚网络生成潜缓存状态，轻量去噪网络在每个反向步骤通过融合模块将缓存潜状态与当前状态组合，从而将锚定解释为潜空间缓存。实例化为TADM:Post-train（对预训练DLM进行时间锚定）与TADM:Pretraining（在预训练期间学习时间锚点）。
AI.result: 在DiffusionGemma-26B上，TADM:Post-train在多个数学、代码和STEM基准（GSM8K、AIME26、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench-v6、HumanEval、MMLU-Pro）上提升吞吐量约49%至79%。TADM:Pretraining相比标准单阶段DLM减少最多38%的Transformer层计算，并实现比ADLM高最多73%的实测吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 基于时间的自监督锚定无需监督目标即可复用潜空间锚点，通过锚网络与轻量去噪网络的缓存式融合架构，在保持语义有效性的同时显著提升扩散语言模型推理吞吐量并降低计算开销。

title: Rollout-Marginal Distillation for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion enables low-latency, streamable video generation, but prediction errors often accumulate over long rollouts. Training the generator on its own rollouts exposes it to these imperfect histories. However, existing video-level distribution matching distillation (DMD) scores the whole rollout jointly. Because a chunk is evaluated together with its past and future, its correction can favor matching artifacts in the surrounding context merely to preserve temporal consistency. To provide a clearer visual-quality signal, we introduce Rollout-Marginal Distillation (RMD). RMD retains the generated history for AR prediction but scores each chunk independently against a chunk teacher, ensuring its quality correction is not compromised by an imperfect temporal context. To compensate for the lack of temporal context in independent chunk scoring, RMD subsequently applies video-level DMD to restore temporal coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RMD maintains high visual quality far beyond its training horizon and outperforms video-level DMD baselines. Code and video results are available at https://cjeen.github.io/RMD

AI.tldr: 本文提出Rollout-Marginal Distillation (RMD)，通过独立地对每个chunk进行评分并辅以视频级DMD恢复时序一致性，缓解自回归视频扩散中预测误差累积导致长rollout视觉质量下降的问题。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散支持低延迟、可流式生成，但预测误差在长rollout中会不断累积。在自身rollout上训练生成器可以使其暴露于不完美的历史，但现有视频级分布匹配蒸馏(DMD)对整个rollout联合评分，导致某个chunk的修正会受其过去与未来上下文影响，可能为了保持时序一致性而匹配周围的伪影，从而削弱视觉质量信号。
AI.method: 提出Rollout-Marginal Distillation (RMD)。RMD在自回归预测时保留生成的历史，但对每个chunk独立地针对chunk teacher进行评分，使其质量修正不受不完美时序上下文的干扰；随后再施加视频级DMD以弥补独立chunk评分缺失的时序上下文，恢复时序一致性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RMD在远超其训练horizon的情况下仍能保持高视觉质量，并优于视频级DMD基线。代码与视频结果见 https://cjeen.github.io/RMD。
AI.conclusion: 通过将chunk级独立评分与视频级DMD相结合，RMD在保持自回归视频扩散可流式生成优势的同时，显著缓解长rollout中的质量退化，证明解耦视觉质量信号与时序一致性约束的有效性。

title: Learning What to Remember: Long-horizon Counterfactual Memory Optimization
summary: Persistent textual memory allows language models to carry information across long interactions, but learning what to remember is fundamentally a credit-assignment problem. A memory rewrite may only become useful many steps later, while much of the observed utility may be inherited from information already stored before the rewrite. We introduce Memory Gain Policy Optimization (MGPO), which isolates the incremental value of each memory rewrite by crediting it for its marginal contribution to current and future downstream utility. This turns delayed memory utility into a direct learning signal for optimizing what information should persist. We study MGPO on document-level information extraction, where structured supervision makes the effects of individual memory updates directly measurable. MGPO improves extraction while reducing average memory length by nearly 80% relative to the initial memory policy before optimization. The learned memory policy also supports reuse and transfer across domains, downstream models without further training. These results show that effective memory learning depends not only on preserving useful information, but on identifying which memory updates create lasting incremental value.

AI.tldr: 本文提出记忆增益策略优化（MGPO），通过将记忆重写的价值归因于其对当前及未来下游效用的边际贡献，把延迟的记忆效用转化为直接学习信号，优化“该记住什么”。在文档级信息抽取任务上，MGPO 在提升抽取效果的同时将平均记忆长度减少近 80%，并支持跨领域迁移与下游模型复用。
AI.motivation: 持久化文本记忆能让语言模型在长交互中携带信息，但"该记住什么"本质上是一个信用分配（credit assignment）问题：一次记忆重写可能多步之后才显现价值，而观察到的效用往往继承自重写前已存储的信息，导致难以判断哪次更新真正有功。现有方法缺乏对记忆更新增量价值的隔离与度量。
AI.method: 提出 Memory Gain Policy Optimization（MGPO），将每次记忆重写的价值归因其对当前与未来下游效用的边际贡献（增量价值），从而把延迟出现的记忆效用转化为直接的学习信号，用于优化记忆策略中"应持久保留哪些信息"。在文档级信息抽取任务上开展研究，因为结构化监督使单次记忆更新的效果可被直接测量。
AI.result: 相较优化前的初始记忆策略，MGPO 提升了抽取性能，同时将平均记忆长度减少近 80%；学习到的记忆策略还支持跨领域重用与迁移，并可迁移到无需进一步训练的下游模型。
AI.conclusion: 有效的记忆学习不仅取决于保留有用信息，更取决于识别哪些记忆更新能创造持久的增量价值；以边际贡献为核心的信用分配是优化持久记忆内容的关键。

title: Look Closer: Patch-wise Supervision for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: How much of an image does a detector need to see? Small RGB regions can retain useful evidence of image synthesis even when they reveal little of the full scene. Motivated by single-patch detection, we study patch-wise supervision: a shared backbone classifies explicit crops, each crop receives its own loss, and patch probabilities are averaged only at inference. The procedure requires neither handcrafted residual filtering nor a learned image-level fusion module. Experiments span single-patch selection, multiple generator collections, and four CNN and Transformer backbones. On GenImage, the reported patch-wise variants improve average accuracy over their whole-image counterparts across all four backbones. Comparisons of supervision granularity, source resolution, crop size, and inference coverage further characterize the approach, while post-processing tests and difficult-image evaluation reveal its limitations. The historical experiments include evaluation-based model selection, so their scores are not presented as a uniformly selected leaderboard comparison. Overall, the study identifies explicit local input and patch-level supervision as a simple, useful combination for investigating generalizable AI-generated image detection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"patch-wise supervision"（逐块监督）用于AI生成图像检测：共享骨干网络对显式裁剪块分类，每块独立计算损失，仅在推理时平均块概率，无需手工残差滤波或图像级融合模块。
AI.motivation: 动机源于single-patch detection（单块检测）：小尺寸RGB区域即使只揭示场景的极少信息，仍能保留有用的图像合成证据。因此作者希望探究显式的局部输入与块级监督能否构成一种简单且有效的组合，用于研究具有泛化性的AI生成图像检测。
AI.method: 方法为patch-wise supervision：共享骨干网络对每个显式裁剪块进行分类，每块获得各自的损失，仅在推理阶段对块概率取平均。该流程既不依赖手工设计的残差滤波，也不需要学习图像级融合模块。实验涵盖单块选择、多个生成器集合，以及四种CNN与Transformer骨干网络，并比较了监督粒度、原始分辨率、裁剪尺寸与推理覆盖范围等因素。
AI.result: 在GenImage数据集上，所报告的逐块变体在四种骨干网络上均相较其整图对应版本提升了平均准确率。后处理测试与困难样本评估揭示了该方法的局限性；历史实验包含基于评估的模型选择，因此其分数并非作为统一筛选的排行榜比较来呈现。
AI.conclusion: 总体而言，该研究将显式局部输入与块级监督识别为一种简单且有用的组合，可用于研究具有泛化性的AI生成图像检测。

title: Does Local Video Understanding Transfer Across Encounters? The EgoGears Benchmark
summary: Embodied systems must make knowledge acquired during one encounter usable in another despite changes in viewpoint, motion, and illumination. Yet aggregate cross-video accuracy conflates failures of local perception with failures to preserve observation identity, establish correspondence, and compose evidence, obscuring whether local video understanding actually transfers. We introduce EgoGears, a complementary single- and multi-video benchmark designed to diagnose this transition. It contains 567 single-video and 1,487 multi-video questions derived from 126 human-collected egocentric recordings covering 39 outdoor routes. Repeated traversals across movement speeds and lighting conditions ground comparisons in shared physical environments; 531 questions require alignment across independent recordings. Single-video questions measure the local visual, spatial, and motion evidence available to a model, while multi-video questions test whether evidence remains bound to the correct observation and can be composed into consistent route relationships. We report 29 single-video and 31 multi-video MLLM configurations across six model families in the main leaderboard. Among the 20 configurations evaluated comparably on both splits, every model performs worse on multi-video questions, with a mean decrease of 22.5 percentage points, and the gap persists when answer format and scoring are held fixed. The gap is not explained simply by additional videos or recording boundaries. The central bottlenecks are observation--evidence binding and ordered route-state tracking. The code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/lei-qi-233/EgoGears.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EgoGears，一个单视频与多视频互补的具身视频理解诊断基准，揭示多模态大模型在多视频推理中存在显著的性能落差，核心瓶颈为观测-证据绑定与有序路线状态追踪。
AI.motivation: 具身系统需将一次遭遇中获得的知识迁移到另一场景，但视角、运动和光照变化会带来挑战。现有跨视频聚合准确率将局部感知失败与观测身份保持、对应关系建立、证据组合失败混为一谈，无法判断局部视频理解是否真正可迁移。
AI.method: 构建 EgoGears 基准，包含 567 个单视频问题和 1,487 个多视频问题，源自 126 段人工采集的第一视角录像，覆盖 39 条户外路线。通过在不同移动速度和光照条件下重复穿行同一物理环境形成可比对基础，其中 531 个问题要求跨独立录像进行对齐。单视频问题衡量局部视觉、空间与运动证据；多视频问题测试证据是否仍绑定于正确观测并能组合成一致的路线关系。主榜评测 6 个模型族、29 种单视频与 31 种多视频 MLLM 配置。
AI.result: 在 20 个可在两个划分上可比评估的配置中，所有模型在多视频问题上表现更差，平均下降 22.5 个百分点；固定答案格式与评分方式后差距依然存在。该差距不能仅由视频数量增加或录像边界解释，核心瓶颈是观测-证据绑定与有序路线状态追踪。
AI.conclusion: 多视频视频理解是 MLLM 的显著短板，局部视频能力并未自动迁移到跨视频组合推理。EgoGears 提供了可诊断该迁移过程的基准，代码与数据已公开于 https://github.com/lei-qi-233/EgoGears。

title: Video-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Understanding Agents via Harness Evolution
summary: Video understanding agents acquire evidence through an executable harness that controls what they observe and how they use those observations. However, execution traces contain only the evidence acquired by the current harness, leaving competing explanations for failure unresolved and limiting the basis for self-improvement. We introduce Video-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement in which a video understanding agent uses its own language model to revise its harness. Through active video investigation, the model revisits the original training videos to test competing failure explanations with additional observations, grounding proposed changes in evidence beyond the existing trace. Cost-aware harness evolution turns these diagnoses into reusable revisions and determines which revisions to retain by considering both answer accuracy and visual cost. Across our evaluation settings on video understanding benchmarks, the evolved agent improves accuracy while processing fewer frames and achieves competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs against existing video understanding agents. These results demonstrate the potential for video understanding agents to improve their own evidence acquisition and use through harness evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/Video-RSI .

AI.tldr: 提出 Video-RSI 框架，让视频理解智能体用自身语言模型递归改写其执行“harness”，通过主动视频调查与成本感知进化提升精度并降低帧数。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解智能体的执行轨迹只包含当前 harness 所采集的证据，无法区分造成失败的竞争性解释，从而限制自我改进的证据基础。
AI.method: Video-RSI 通过主动视频调查让模型重回原始训练视频，采集额外观测以检验竞争性失败解释，并将诊断结果落地为可复用的 harness 修订；同时采用成本感知的 harness 进化机制，依据答案准确率与视觉成本决定修订的保留。
AI.result: 在视频理解基准的多个评测设置上，进化后的智能体在减少处理帧数的同时提升了准确率，并在准确率—效率权衡上相较现有视频理解智能体具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明视频理解智能体可通过 harness 进化改进自身的证据采集与使用方式。

title: GaugeVLM: Structuring Spatial Supervision with Measured Geometric Interventions
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can contradict themselves across views of the same spatial relation and fail to respond when that relation changes. Addressing these failures requires supervision that captures error magnitude and geometric dependencies across observations, both of which remain implicit in training on individual answers or ordinal preferences. Therefore, we introduce GaugeVLM, which makes this structure explicit through controlled object and camera interventions in explicit 3D scenes, producing linked observations with measured differences between spatial relations and shared truths across views. To translate this structure into learning signals, its core objective, GaugeDPO, converts measured errors into preference margins, directly supervises correct canonical rankings across views, and links intervention-induced answer-odds contrasts to measured relation changes with view-specific scales. Our analysis bounds canonical prediction error and establishes that the cross-view and intervention constraints can be jointly satisfied. Empirically, GaugeVLM improves all 10 established spatial metrics over supervised fine-tuning across three VLM backbones, with the main 7B model gaining 15.0 and 18.9 percentage points on MSMU distance and QSpatial+, respectively. These gains also extend to autonomous driving and embodied reasoning, demonstrating the robust generalization across domains.

AI.tldr: GaugeVLM通过显式3D场景中的可控物体与相机干预，生成带误差度量与跨视图几何依赖的监督信号，并以核心目标GaugeDPO将误差转化为偏好边际，显著提升视觉语言模型的空间关系推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在观察同一空间关系的不同视图时会自相矛盾，且当空间关系发生变化时无法做出响应。解决这些失败需要能够捕捉误差幅度和跨观测几何依赖的监督，而基于单个答案或序数偏好的训练方式无法显式提供此类信息。
AI.method: 提出GaugeVLM，在显式3D场景中通过受控的物体与相机干预生成相互关联的观测，包含空间关系间的实测差异与跨视图共享真值。核心目标GaugeDPO将实测误差转化为偏好边际，直接监督跨视图的正确规范排序，并将干预引起的答案几率对比与实测关系变化以视图特定尺度相链接。理论分析给出了规范预测误差的界，并证明跨视图约束与干预约束可同时满足。
AI.result: 在三个VLM主干上，GaugeVLM在全部10项已有空间指标上均优于监督微调；主7B模型在MSMU distance和QSpatial+上分别提升15.0和18.9个百分点，且增益可泛化至自动驾驶与具身推理领域。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模误差幅度与跨视图几何依赖，并将其实例化为偏好学习信号，可有效缓解VLM空间推理中的自相矛盾与不响应问题，且具备跨领域泛化能力。

title: SelfSearch: Reward-Free Search for Self-Improving Agents
summary: Advances in the coding capabilities of LLM agents allow them to inspect and modify their own instructions, tools, and execution procedures. Existing approaches use this ability to search for improved agents through repeated downstream evaluation, which incurs substantial costs and ties the search to the evaluated tasks. We introduce \textbf{SelfSearch}, a reward-free search procedure in which agents modify themselves using records of previous self-improvement episodes. These records capture the reasoning, tool actions, and outcomes of earlier modification attempts, providing concrete experience for improving both task solving and self-modification. Without downstream reward signals during search, SelfSearch improves population-mean success over the initial agent in all six model--benchmark settings, with individual agents gaining up to 11.2 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On SWE-bench Multilingual, an agent improves success by \textbf{5.0} percentage points while reducing execution cost by \textbf{38.5}\% on tasks solved by both the initial and evolved agents. SelfSearch achieves competitive task success with evaluation-guided search baselines at lower search cost. With only \textbf{\$4.03} in search cost, it produces a harness that solves \textbf{82.0}\% of Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks with DeepSeek V4 Flash under the settings of a public nine-harness comparison, matching the top-scoring harness, Codex. These results suggest that experience gained through self-modification can improve agents' downstream capabilities and efficiency.

AI.tldr: SelfSearch：一种无需奖励信号的自我改进搜索方法，利用既往自我修改回合的记录引导 LLM 智能体自我修改，在多个模型—基准组合上提升成功率并降低成本。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 智能体编码能力的自我改进方法依赖对下游任务的反复评估来搜索更优智能体，成本高昂，且搜索过程被绑定在所评估的具体任务上，难以泛化。
AI.method: 提出 SelfSearch，一种无奖励（reward-free）搜索流程：智能体利用先前自我改进回合的记录进行自我修改，这些记录包含此前修改尝试的推理过程、工具动作与结果，为改进任务求解与自我修改本身提供具体经验；搜索过程中不使用下游奖励信号。
AI.result: 在全部六个模型—基准设置上，群体平均成功率均优于初始智能体，单体智能体在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上最高提升 11.2 个百分点；在 SWE-bench Multilingual 上成功率提升 5.0 个百分点，同时在被初始与进化后智能体均解决的任务上执行成本降低 38.5%；以更低搜索成本达到与评估引导基线相当的任务成功率；仅用 4.03 美元搜索成本，在公开九种 harness 对比设置下，以 DeepSeek V4 Flash 生成解决 Terminal-Bench 2.1 82.0% 任务的 harness，与最高分 harness（Codex）持平。
AI.conclusion: 通过自我修改所积累的经验，能够同时提升智能体的下游能力与执行效率，且无需依赖昂贵的下游奖励评估即可实现有效的自我改进搜索。

title: SoL-Refiner: Speed-of-Light One-Step Refinement for High-Resolution Video
summary: High-resolution video generation is expensive, as its cost grows rapidly with the number of spatiotemporal tokens. A practical alternative first generates a lower-resolution video and then applies a refiner, but conventional multi-step refinement introduces a second sampling bottleneck. We present SoL-Refiner, a one-step video refiner that transforms low-resolution model outputs into 4K videos with a single denoising step. Our three-stage recipe combines high-resolution continual training, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training, and a final one-step distillation. We introduce Refiner-Bench, a video refinement benchmark constructed from the outputs of different video generators, and use a shared-input protocol to compare refiners at approximately 2K output resolution. At 2K, the one-step SoL-Refiner outperforms all external refiners on the VBench and UniPercept averages, while at $3840\!\times\!2176$ it improves both metrics over the three-step LTX-2.3 Refiner. With the complete acceleration stack, SoL-Refiner achieves an $8.91\times$ speedup in refinement latency over the same baseline in our 2K latency setting.

AI.tldr: SoL-Refiner 是一种单步视频精修器，可将低分辨率生成结果一步去噪提升至 4K 分辨率；通过三阶段训练（高分辨率持续训练、强化学习后训练、单步蒸馏）实现，并配套提出 Refiner-Bench 基准。在 2K 下其 VBench 与 UniPercept 平均指标超过所有外部精修器，在 3840×2176 下优于三步 LTX-2.3 Refiner，2K 设定下精修延迟相对同基线加速 8.91×。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率视频生成成本随时空 token 数量快速增长，直接生成代价高。实用替代方案是先低分辨率生成再精修，但传统多步精修会引入第二重采样瓶颈，因此需要一种高效的一步式高分辨率精修方法。
AI.method: 提出 SoL-Refiner，采用三阶段训练配方：(1) 高分辨率持续训练；(2) 强化学习（RL）后训练；(3) 最终一步蒸馏，从而以单次去噪步骤把低分辨率模型输出转换为 4K 视频。同时构建 Refiner-Bench 基准，基于不同视频生成器的输出，并采用共享输入协议在约 2K 输出分辨率下比较各精修器。
AI.result: 在 2K 分辨率下，单步 SoL-Refiner 在 VBench 与 UniPercept 平均指标上优于所有外部精修器；在 3840×2176 下两项指标均超过三步 LTX-2.3 Refiner。在完整加速栈下，2K 延迟设定中精修延迟相比同基线加速 8.91×。
AI.conclusion: 一步式精修器可在保持甚至提升视频质量的前提下显著降低高分辨率视频生成的精修成本与延迟，说明高分辨率持续训练、RL 后训练与单步蒸馏的组合是可行的加速方案。

title: PhysWAM: Physically Consistent World Action Model for Autonomous Driving
summary: World-action models (WAMs) jointly predict how a scene will evolve and how an agent should act, however joint generation alone does not necessarily impose a shared geometric constraint on these predictions. We present PhysWAM, a unified world-action model for autonomous driving that co-denoises multiview video, metric depth, and ego motion within a single flow-matching transformer. To ground world and action generation in measured scene geometry, we introduce Coupled Point Projection (CPP) that unprojects the generated depth into 3D points, transforms them using the generated $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ ego motion, and minimizes their distance to LiDAR points transformed using the recorded ego motion. This geometric constraint promotes physical consistency with the measured scene by jointly supervising generated depth and motion alongside their standard flow-matching objectives. At inference, trajectory selection relies only on a simple label-free consensus rule, with no learned scorer or simulator feedback. We evaluate PhysWAM across NAVSIM v1 and v2 planning, zero-shot closed-loop transfer, and future video and metric-depth prediction. Despite PhysWAM's simple selection procedure, it achieves strong planning performance and transfers zero-shot to unseen driving environments. It also generates accurate metric depth and temporally coherent video, with CPP improving both planning and depth prediction. Together, these results demonstrate that the geometric relationship between scene depth and ego motion provides a direct way to couple world and action generation within a simple unified model.

AI.tldr: PhysWAM 是一个统一的驾驶世界-动作模型，在单个流匹配 Transformer 中联合去噪多视图视频、度量深度与自车运动，并通过耦合点投影（CPP）几何约束将世界生成与动作生成锚定到实测场景几何。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型虽联合预测场景演化与智能体动作，但联合生成本身并不对二者施加共享的几何约束，因此难以保证预测与实测场景的物理一致性。
AI.method: 提出 PhysWAM：在单一流匹配 Transformer 内共去噪多视图视频、度量深度与自车运动；引入 Coupled Point Projection（CPP），将生成深度反投影为 3D 点，用生成的 SE(3) 自车运动变换后，最小化其与经记录自车运动变换的 LiDAR 点之间的距离；该约束与标准流匹配目标联合监督深度与运动；推理阶段轨迹选择仅用无标签一致性规则，无需学习的评分器或模拟器反馈。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM v1 与 v2 规划、零样本闭环迁移、未来视频与度量深度预测上评估。尽管选择流程简单，仍取得较强规划性能，并可零样本迁移至未见驾驶环境；度量深度准确，视频时序连贯，且 CPP 同时提升规划与深度预测。
AI.conclusion: 场景深度与自车运动之间的几何关系为在简单统一模型中耦合世界生成与动作生成提供了直接途径。

title: On Trajectory-Aware Training for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate text by unmasking several tokens per step, but they are trained and sampled under different conditions. The model is trained on randomly masked sequences, whereas inference follows a trajectory shaped by the model's own predictions. Additionally, each step has no access to what the previous one computed. Recent methods narrow these limitations from separate angles, leaving open how these choices interact. We introduce PUMBA, a unified framework for trajectory-aware training that trains the denoiser on consecutive steps of policy-induced trajectories, passes information between steps, and optimizes them jointly by backpropagation through time. A controlled study of this design space shows that i) exact train--inference alignment fails due to local overfitting, whereas a looser alignment still brings training masks closer to those seen at inference; ii) passing continuous information outperforms discrete gradient estimators through the commitment at each step; and iii) performance improves as backpropagation through time spans more steps, which we support theoretically. Combined, these components match the best checkpoint of a same-size autoregressive model. Building on these findings, we scale PUMBA to supervised fine-tuning of LLaDA-8B, where it improves the trade-off between performance and number of function evaluations (NFEs) in both full-canvas and block diffusion generation. At matched performance, it needs up to 22% fewer NFEs than standard fine-tuning with twice the budget in full-canvas generation, and up to 26% fewer than standard fine-tuning for the same number of steps in block diffusion.

AI.tldr: PUMBA：面向掩码扩散模型的轨迹感知统一训练框架，通过对策略诱导轨迹的连续步骤进行联合优化，缩小训练-推理差距并提升生成效率。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散模型（MDM）在训练时使用随机掩码序列，而推理时则沿模型自身预测形成的轨迹进行，且各步之间缺乏信息传递，导致训练与推理条件不一致。已有方法从不同角度单独缓解这一问题，但各设计选择之间的相互作用尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出 PUMBA 统一框架：在策略诱导轨迹的连续步骤上训练去噪器，步骤之间传递信息，并通过时间反向传播（BPTT）联合优化。作者对该设计空间进行了受控研究，比较了训练-推理对齐程度、连续信息传递与离散梯度估计器、以及 BPTT 跨步数的影响。
AI.result: 受控研究显示：i）精确的训练-推理对齐会因局部过拟合而失败，较宽松的对齐反而使训练掩码更接近推理时所见；ii）通过每步 commitment 传递连续信息优于离散梯度估计器；iii）性能随 BPTT 跨步数增加而提升，并有理论支持。组合各组件后性能匹配同规模自回归模型的最佳检查点。将 PUMBA 扩展至 LLaDA-8B 的监督微调，在 full-canvas 与 block diffusion 生成中均改善了性能与 NFE 的权衡：在性能相同时，full-canvas 生成所需 NFE 比标准微调（两倍预算）最多减少 22%，block diffusion 在相同步数下最多减少 26%。
AI.conclusion: PUMBA 通过统一的轨迹感知训练缩小了 MDM 训练与推理的差距，验证了对齐程度、连续信息传递与 BPTT 步数的关键作用，并在大规模监督微调中显著提升了性能与 NFE 的权衡效率。

title: UnifiedAttack: Evaluating the Safety of Large Multimodal Models in Synergistic Harmful Image-Text Generation
summary: As Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) transition toward natively unified architectures, evaluating their safety in synergistic harmful image-text generation tasks becomes a critical challenge. Unlike unimodal threats, synergistic risks emerge when text and image modalities are coordinated to produce harm that significantly exceeds their individual components. We introduce UnifiedAttack, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate LMM safety in collaborative scenarios by focusing on the harmfulness gain achieved through cross-modal synergy. The benchmark incorporates samples filtered for their multimodal potential alongside a novel subset of synthesized disinformation queries. To verify identified vulnerabilities, we propose a synergistic hijacking framework featuring In-Context Reskinning (ICR) and Cognitive Planning Injection (CPI). ICR utilizes few-shot learning to wrap adversarial intent in benign virtual shells to desensitize safety filters, while CPI hijacks the reasoning path by enforcing a plan-then-execute paradigm. By compelling the system to commit to a neutral logical plan, we exploit its internal drive for consistency to induce the synchronized generation of harmful multimodal content. Extensive evaluations on state-of-the-art architectures demonstrate that UnifiedAttack consistently bypasses modern alignment. Our findings reveal that the structural helpfulness and logical coherence of unified models can be systematically weaponized, highlighting the urgent need for logic-aware defenses in synergistic generation tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/UnifiedAttack .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UnifiedAttack 基准与协同劫持框架（ICR + CPI），用于评估原生统一架构大模型在图文协同有害生成任务中的安全性，实验表明现有对齐机制可被系统性绕过。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型向原生统一架构演进，文本与图像模态协同产生的危害远超单模态威胁，而现有安全评测缺少针对跨模态协同增益的评估手段，亟需新的基准与攻击验证方法。
AI.method: 构建 UnifiedAttack 基准，筛选具多模态潜力的样本并加入合成虚假信息查询子集；提出协同劫持框架，包含 In-Context Reskinning（ICR，用少样本学习将对抗意图包装为表面无害的虚拟外壳以降低安全过滤器敏感度）与 Cognitive Planning Injection（CPI，通过"先规划后执行"范式劫持推理路径，利用模型对逻辑一致性的内在驱动力诱导同步生成有害多模态内容）。
AI.result: 在多个最先进架构上进行广泛评测，UnifiedAttack 能够持续绕过现代对齐机制，揭示统一模型的结构性有用性与逻辑连贯性可被系统性武器化。
AI.conclusion: 统一模型的结构有用性与逻辑一致性构成新的安全攻击面，协同生成任务中亟需引入逻辑感知的防御机制。

title: $S^3$: Spectral Null-Space Swap Makes Reasoning Models Efficient
summary: LLMs trained with Chain-of-thought excel in reasoning capability, but often come with excessive token cost. We find that the core of reasoning capacity lies in the Thinking model's weight component within the null space of a projection defined by the corresponding Non-thinking model's dominant singular directions, and removing the subspace component can largely improve reasoning efficiency without hurting the accuracy gained during thinking-mode post-training. Unlike existing efforts that mostly operate within the dominant subspace, we are the first to unveil the critical role of the null space and harness it for model optimization. Motivated by this finding, we propose Spectral Null-Space Swap ($S^3$), a training-free composition of paired Non-thinking and Thinking checkpoints. Our method keeps the Non-thinking model inside its own dominant subspace and takes the Thinking checkpoint outside it, improving reasoning efficiency while maintaining accuracy. We extensively evaluate $S^3$ on 2B-30B dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures spanning 28 evaluation environments across mathematical, multimodal, and audio reasoning domains. $S^3$ establishes new empirical Pareto Frontiers among training-free model composition strategies: across all settings, it reduces inference token overhead by an average of 27.4% compared to full Thinking models while simultaneously improving overall task accuracy by 1.0 percentage point (e.g., yielding +8.3% accuracy on HMMT25 alongside a 33.0% token speedup). We further use attention entropy for explanation and find that the retained component produces more concentrated attention, and we use a simplified analytical model about optimization to demonstrate why null-space can effectively reduce attention entropy, thereby improving the efficiency of reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现推理能力的关键存在于Thinking模型权重在Non-thinking模型主导奇异方向所定义投影的零空间分量中，据此提出免训练的组合方法S^3，在保持精度的同时平均降低27.4%的推理token开销。
AI.motivation: 用Chain-of-thought训练的LLM推理能力强但token开销过大。现有工作多在主导子空间内操作，未揭示零空间的作用，作者希望找到兼顾推理效率与精度的优化路径。
AI.method: 提出Spectral Null-Space Swap（S^3），一种免训练的配对Non-thinking与Thinking检查点组合方法：将Non-thinking模型保留在其自身主导子空间内，并从其零空间外引入Thinking检查点的权重分量；并用注意力熵与简化优化分析模型进行解释。
AI.result: 在2B–30B的dense与MoE架构、覆盖数学/多模态/音频共28个评测环境上验证。相比完整Thinking模型，推理token开销平均降低27.4%，整体任务精度提升1.0个百分点（如HMMT25上精度+8.3%且token加速33.0%），在免训练模型组合策略中建立新的Pareto前沿。
AI.conclusion: 首次揭示零空间对推理能力的关键作用并将其用于模型优化；S^3无需训练即可同时提升推理效率与精度，保留的分量使注意力更集中，零空间可有效降低注意力熵。

title: ORMA: Optimization-based Monocular 4D Reconstruction of Articulated Animals
summary: Recovering articulated 4D representations of animals from monocular videos remains challenging due to the large diversity of quadruped morphologies and lack of animal 4D supervision data. Existing learning-based reconstruction methods operate on individual images and rely on synthetic or model-fitted 3D supervision, which inherits the constraints of strong parametric priors and limits generalization to out-of-distribution species. When applied to out-of-distribution animals, they often recover a plausible pose while producing inaccurate geometry because the underlying shape model cannot faithfully represent the observed instance. We present ORMA, a training-free reconstruction framework that decouples articulation from shape, using the predicted pose as reference for optimization while leveraging generative 3D priors for accurate shape reconstruction. Given a reference image, we reconstruct the animal geometry and register it to the parametric model SMAL+, yielding an articulated shape adapted to the observed instance. We then combine per-frame articulated pose estimates with globally consistent camera poses to recover animal motion in a shared world coordinate frame, and further refine the reconstruction using self-supervised DINO correspondences and temporal consistency. To enable quantitative evaluation, we introduce PAW4D, a synthetic multi-species benchmark with ground-truth 3D geometry and camera motion. Experiments on PAW4D, PFERD, and challenging in-the-wild videos demonstrate that ORMA improves reconstruction accuracy while recovering globally consistend animal motion across diverse quadruped species.

AI.tldr: ORMA 是一个免训练框架，将关节运动与形状解耦，利用生成式3D先验重建单体4D动物，并引入 PAW4D 基准进行评测。
AI.motivation: 从单目视频恢复动物的关节化4D表示困难，原因在于四足动物形态多样且缺乏动物4D监督数据。现有方法基于单帧、依赖合成或模型拟合的3D监督，受强参数化先验限制，对分布外物种泛化差，常出现位姿合理但几何不准的问题。
AI.method: ORMA 免训练重建框架：将关节与形状解耦，以预测位姿作为优化参考，同时利用生成式3D先验重建精确形状。给定参考图像，重建几何并配准到SMAL+参数模型，得到适配实例的关节化形状；随后结合逐帧关节位姿估计与全局一致相机位姿，在共享世界坐标系中恢复运动，并用自监督DINO对应与时间一致性进一步精化。
AI.result: 在 PAW4D、PFERD 以及具挑战性的野外视频上，ORMA 提升了重建精度，并在多种四足动物上恢复了全局一致的运动。
AI.conclusion: ORMA 通过解耦关节与形状并借助生成式先验，有效克服参数化先验限制，实现跨物种的准确保真重建与全局一致运动恢复；PAW4D 为多物种4D重建提供定量评测基准。

title: BITEM at the NTCIR-19 R2C2 Task: Predicting Confidence from Agentic RAG Pipeline Signals
comment: 8 pages. Participant paper for the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task
summary: The BITEM team entered both subtasks of the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task with a single agentic pipeline, in which a model searches, reads and records evidence over a movie corpus while an orchestrator holds the record and rules on what may be submitted. A claim is admitted only once an entailment cascade has checked it against the passage it cites, and an answer is released only once enough checked evidence stands behind it. Each question is run three or four times, every pass retrieving from a corpus stripped of what the earlier passes have already seen. The confidence filed with each answer is computed by the orchestrator from what the run leaves behind and is never asked of the model, which is offered no way to rate itself. The two retrieval runs placed 4th and 5th of 22, pooling the passes was worth 0.0709 nDCG@20, and the gain was largest on the multi-hop and post-processing-heavy questions, where the organisers rank the pooled run top of the field. Sixteen of the 25 answer runs were built on passages these two runs supplied, 12 of them filed by other teams. HMR rewards a system whose confidence is high where it answers right and low where it answers wrong. The pipeline reached an accuracy of 0.9219, 6th of 25, while the confidence filed with those answers gave an HMR of 0.4915, 13th. A few rules crafted over those same recorded signals, with no further model call and no further retrieval, raise that to an accuracy of 0.9375, 5th, and an HMR of 0.6985, 9th. Ranking on HMR alone can reward a system for answering wrongly with low confidence, so we propose accHMR, the accuracy multiplied by HMR, which reports the reward in proportion to the accuracy, and on which the revised rules would have scored 0.6549, 5th. For future work, fitting a model on the numbers the pipeline already produces, rather than writing such rules by hand, would be a real step forward.

AI.tldr: BITEM团队以单一agentic流水线参加NTCIR-19 R2C2两个子任务：模型负责检索、阅读并记录证据，编排器掌管记录并裁决可提交内容；答案仅在蕴含级联校验通过且证据充分时释放，置信度由编排器依据运行残留信号计算，模型无自评权。检索排名4/5（共22），多趟融合增益0.0709 nDCG@20；答案准确率0.9219（6/25），HMR 0.4915（13/25），经规则修订提升至0.9375（5/25）与0.6985（9/25）。提出accHMR指标。
AI.motivation: 作者希望在不依赖模型自评置信度的情况下，构建可信的多跳问答与检索系统，并解决HMR指标可被"低置信度错误作答"套利的问题，从而更合理地衡量"答案正确性"与"置信度校准"的联合表现。
AI.method: 采用单一agentic流水线：模型在电影语料上搜索、阅读并记录证据，编排器保存记录并裁定提交资格。claim需经蕴含级联对其所引段落校验后方被接纳，答案需有足量已校验证据支撑才释放。每题运行三到四次，每轮从剔除前几轮已见内容的语料中检索；置信度由编排器基于运行残留信号计算，模型无自评接口。后期仅基于相同记录信号手工设计规则进行后处理，不额外调用模型或检索。
AI.result: 两次检索运行分别位列22支队伍中第4和第5；多趟融合带来0.0709 nDCG@20增益，在多跳与后处理密集型问题上增益最大（组织者将其融合运行列为该类别榜首）。25次答案运行中16次基于该两轮检索提供的段落，其中12次由其他团队提交。流水线准确率0.9219（第6/25），置信度HMR为0.4915（第13）；基于同信号的规则修订后准确率0.9375（第5）、HMR 0.6985（第9）。
AI.conclusion: 在HMR排名下，系统可能因"错误但低置信"而获益，因此作者提出accHMR（准确率×HMR），按准确率比例报告奖励，修订规则在该指标上得0.6549（第5）。未来方向是用流水线已产生的数值拟合模型，替代手工规则。

title: HybridCUA: Learning to Orchestrate GUI and CLI for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer use agents (CUAs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in completing digital tasks. However, existing CUAs either rely solely on graphical user interface (GUI) interactions, which are often inefficient and error prone, or augment GUI interactions with application specific APIs or tools, which require substantial engineering effort and are difficult to scale across applications. We argue that the next generation of CUAs should combine GUI interactions with the command line interface (CLI), leveraging the generality of the GUI and the efficiency of shell commands. A critical challenge, however, is that current models do not know when or how to use the CLI during task execution. To address this challenge, we develop a data construction pipeline that produces three types of trajectories: GUI only, CLI only, and interleaved GUI and CLI trajectories. This pipeline results in HybridCUA-8K, containing 5K hybrid trajectories and 3K verified RLVR tasks. Building on these data, we propose a training framework with two stages: supervised fine tuning on the constructed trajectories, followed by reinforcement learning with our CLI aware rewards that encourages agents to use the CLI selectively and reliably. Experiments show that HybridCUA-9B achieves 53.6% accuracy on OSWorld, improving over the base model by 14.8 percentage points, and improves performance on WindowsAgentArena by 4.0 percentage points. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and cross platform generalizability of the hybrid GUI and CLI paradigm for computer use agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合GUI与CLI的计算机使用代理（CUA）范式：构建了包含GUI、CLI及交织轨迹的数据构造管线（HybridCUA-8K），并采用"监督微调+CLI感知奖励强化学习"的两阶段训练框架。HybridCUA-9B在OSWorld上达到53.6%准确率（较基座提升14.8个百分点），在WindowsAgentArena上提升4.0个百分点，验证了该范式的有效性与跨平台泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有CUA存在两条路线局限：仅依赖GUI交互效率低、易出错；而引入应用专用API或工具则需大量工程投入、难以跨应用扩展。因此作者主张下一代CUA应结合GUI的通用性与shell命令的高效性，但同时面临关键挑战——当前模型不知道在执行任务时何时以及如何使用CLI。
AI.method: 1）数据构造管线，生成三类轨迹：纯GUI、纯CLI、GUI与CLI交织，形成HybridCUA-8K（含5K混合轨迹与3K经校验的RLVR任务）；2）训练框架分两阶段：先对构造轨迹进行监督微调，再以CLI感知奖励进行强化学习，促使代理有选择且可靠地使用CLI。
AI.result: HybridCUA-9B在OSWorld上取得53.6%准确率，较基座模型提升14.8个百分点；在WindowsAgentArena上性能提升4.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，GUI与CLI混合范式对计算机使用代理具有有效性与跨平台泛化性，为下一代CUA提供了结合通用性与效率的可行路径。

title: From Unity Simulation to Diffusion-Based Augmentation: Quantifying Dataset Balance for Robust Object Detection
summary: Modern computer vision models achieve high accuracy when trained on large-scale annotated datasets. In critical domains such as construction safety monitoring, data collection is costly, hazardous, and ethically constrained. This paper presents a systematic study comparing two complementary data generation paradigms, (1) Unity Simulation-based rendering and (2) Controllable Diffusion-based generation (CIA), for object detection under real data-scarce conditions. A unified experimental framework enables controlled dataset mixing across real, simulated, and generative sources, while maintaining identical model and training settings. Quantitative evaluation using Precision, Recall, mAP, and custom $Δ$-metrics, reveals that neither simulation nor generative augmentation alone achieves optimal transferability. Unity-only training yields an mAP@0.5 drop of $-50\%$ relative to real data, while CIA-only training shows a milder $-16.5\%$ degradation. Hybrid compositions significantly improve performance, with the 90\% real + 10\% Unity configuration achieving the best overall mAP@0.5 of $62.68\%$ ($+7.64\%$ over baseline), and the 90\% real + 10\% CIA configuration maximizing precision at $74.45\%$. Results demonstrate that limited synthetic inclusion enhances generalization, while excessive substitution induces domain drift.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了Unity仿真渲染与可控扩散生成（CIA）两种数据生成范式在真实数据稀缺的施工安全目标检测中的迁移效果，并验证混合数据集的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在施工安全监测等关键领域，真实标注数据采集成本高、风险大且受伦理约束，亟需评估合成与生成式数据替代真实数据的可行性与最优混合策略。
AI.method: 构建统一实验框架，在相同模型与训练设置下，对真实、仿真（Unity）、生成式（CIA）三类数据源进行受控混合；采用Precision、Recall、mAP及自定义Δ指标进行定量评估。
AI.result: 仅用Unity训练时mAP@0.5相对真实数据下降50%，仅用CIA训练下降16.5%；混合配置显著提升性能，90%真实+10%Unity取得最佳mAP@0.5为62.68%（较基线+7.64%），90%真实+10%CIA取得最高Precision 74.45%。
AI.conclusion: 有限比例引入合成或生成数据可增强泛化能力，但过度替代会引发域漂移；两种生成范式单独使用均无法达到最优迁移性，需与真实数据按合理比例混合。

title: Brain-SAD: A Brain-Inspired Safe Autonomous Driving Control Framework with Dynamic Fear-Oriented Constraint on Dual-Policy
summary: Constrained Reinforcement Learning has recently gained increasing attention in the field of Safe Autonomous Driving, where the general mechanism is to maximize the expected reward while keeping the overall action risk bounded. In this way, the safety issues arising in AD can be mitigated through constrained actions. However, existing Constrained RL methods still lack dynamics on the imposed constraints. For instance, the action cost adopted by the existing Primal-Dual/soft-constrained methods is often defined as static state-to-cost mapping, and the safe-action projection in hard-constrained methods relies on the static projection with the fixed feasible region boundary estimated from offline demonstrations. The above drawback tightly couples the imposed constraints to the training scenarios, leaving the AD policy hard to handle different interaction scenarios, due to the improper state-level action-cost and the static projection boundary. Consequently, in this paper, we propose Brain-SAD, a brain-inspired safe autonomous driving control framework with dynamic fear-oriented constraints. By perceiving the current vehicle-interaction scene, Brain-SAD generates dynamic fear signal as fear reaction to online decide long-term policy for regular interaction or short-term policy for urgent-collision defense. In such two policy, the above fear-reaction will be constructed as the dynamic fear constraints, respectively reflecting the overall fear cost directly coupled with action-impact, and the dynamic fear boundary of the feasible region derived from different risky neighbors, both of which will in turn serve for the online policy optimization. Experimental results show that Brain-SAD outperforms existing methods, achieving higher success rate in shorter task-completion and collision-recovery time, and exhibits stronger reliability across continuous intersections of fluctuating complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Brain-SAD，一种受大脑启发的安全自动驾驶控制框架，通过感知车-交互场景生成动态恐惧信号，构建动态恐惧约束用于在线策略优化，在成功率和碰撞恢复等指标上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有受限强化学习（Constrained RL）方法在自动驾驶中的约束缺乏动态性：原对偶/软约束方法的动作代价通常定义为静态的状态-代价映射，硬约束方法的安全动作投影依赖基于离线示范估计的固定可行域边界的静态投影。这使约束与训练场景紧密耦合，导致策略难以应对不同的交互场景（源于状态级动作代价不当与静态投影边界）。
AI.method: 提出 Brain-SAD，一种具有动态恐惧导向约束的类脑安全自动驾驶控制框架。通过感知当前车-交互场景，生成动态恐惧信号作为恐惧反应，在线决定用于常规交互的长期策略或用于紧急碰撞防御的短期策略。在这两类策略中，将恐惧反应构造为动态恐惧约束，分别体现与动作影响直接耦合的整体恐惧代价，以及由不同风险邻居推导出的可行域动态恐惧边界，二者反过来服务于在线策略优化。
AI.result: 实验结果显示 Brain-SAD 优于现有方法：任务完成时间更短、碰撞恢复时间更短且成功率更高，并在复杂度波动的连续交叉口中表现出更强的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: Brain-SAD 通过动态恐惧约束解决了现有受限 RL 约束静态化的问题，验证了动态约束在安全自动驾驶中的有效性与鲁棒性。

title: Beyond Lip Sync: Reference-Grounded Oral Refinement for Audio-Driven Portrait Animation
summary: We present RGOR (Reference-Grounded Oral Refinement), an audio-driven lip-sync framework that renders the mouth of the specific person being dubbed rather than a generic one. Existing lip-sync systems follow the audio closely and keep the face recognizable, yet the mouth they render is an average mouth: the shape and texture of the lips, the arrangement of the teeth, and how much of them shows as the mouth opens are not that person's. The problem persists because nothing in current training or evaluation asks for the person's own mouth: perceptual losses accept any plausible mouth, face identity is carried mostly by the skin around it, and the released inference code of inpainting systems uses the unmasked target frame as the reference, which hides the gap. To address this, RGOR conditions every generated frame on frames from separate enrollment recordings of the same person and on HD patches of the mouth that bypass the VAE, and trains the generator against a paired judge that compares each rendered mouth with the person's reference and learns to reject a realistic mouth of someone else. We further build an evaluation protocol and use it to compare open-source and commercial lip-sync systems on held-out identities. Experiments show that RGOR achieves the best or second-best result on most metrics, and preserves the person's own lip and dental detail while keeping synchronization and the rest of the face intact.

AI.tldr: RGOR是一种音频驱动唇形同步框架，通过参考帧与高清嘴部块条件化生成"此人自己的嘴"，并用配对判别器与专用评测协议验证其优于现有开源与商业系统。
AI.motivation: 现有唇形同步系统虽能贴合音频并保持面部可识别性，但生成的嘴是"平均嘴"：唇形、唇部纹理、牙齿排布及张口时牙齿暴露量都非该人特有。根源在于训练与评测均未要求还原本人嘴部：感知损失接受任何合理的嘴，人脸身份主要由嘴周皮肤承载，且inpainting类系统的开源推理代码以未遮挡的目标帧作参考，掩盖了这一缺陷。
AI.method: RGOR将每一生成帧条件化于两路信息：同一人另一段注册（enrollment）录音的帧，以及绕过VAE的嘴部高清patch（HD patches）。训练时引入配对判别器（paired judge），将渲染的嘴与本人参考进行对比，并学习拒绝"他人类别的逼真嘴"。此外构建了新的评测协议。
AI.result: 用该评测协议在留出身份（held-out identities）上比较开源与商业唇形同步系统，RGOR在多数指标上取得最佳或次佳结果，同时保留本人唇部与牙齿细节，并维持同步性与面部其余部分的完整性。
AI.conclusion: 通过参考接地（reference-grounded）的条件化与配对判别监督，可显式建模说话人自身的嘴部外观；新评测协议揭示了既有系统的"平均嘴"问题，RGOR在该协议下表现领先。

title: Auditing Long-Term Memory Evaluation: Repeated Judging, Reader Variation, and Negative Controls
comment: 23 pages. Evaluation-audit revision; adds fixed-answer KU re-scoring, a one-pass full-package versus baseline reader comparison, and post-hoc evidence coverage. Includes ancillary data and an offline recount script. Method sources remain held; all 500 questions were used for development
summary: This report audits evaluation of a long-term-memory retrieval chain on the 500 LongMemEval-S development questions. Its strongest historical reader lane scores 479 and 475 under an adapted GPT-4o rubric; re-judging the same pass-1 answers changes three labels and yields 478. Fixed-answer knowledge-update re-scoring gives 70/72 under the upstream template and 69/72 under the modified template. Reader lanes span 93 to 479 on fixed packets; paired tests between the two strongest historical lanes establish neither superiority nor equivalence. A different-family reader, configured without client tools or operator files, scores 474, 1.0 percentage point below the headline pass (paired 95% interval [-3.0,+1.0]). Live reader request bodies were not retained. With the same requested reader label, route and judge snapshot, the full package scores 474 versus 454 for baseline sessions, a difference of +4.0 percentage points [95% interval +2.2,+6.0]. Eighteen of the 23 gains, and no losses, occur where baseline packets lacked listed evidence; this post-hoc split does not identify a component effect. In recovered LoCoMo data, token-F1 gains do not survive answer-line extraction. A negative control rejects a verifier that repairs three wrong drafts but breaks eleven correct ones. All questions were used to develop the components; no untouched holdout was evaluated. These findings do not establish a new leaderboard leader or transferable memory advantage. The A/D comparison has one pass per arm, including six reused identical-prompt outcomes, with no pinned reader snapshot; B/C and repeats remain unrun. Original headline requests cannot be reconstructed and stages 1--4 remain closed. Released artifacts support packet inspection and saved-verdict recounting and re-scoring; they do not reconstruct the method.

AI.tldr: 该报告对LongMemEval-S上500道题的长期记忆检索链进行了审计：最强历史reader lane在改编GPT-4o评分标准下得479和475，重判pass-1答案后变化3个标签得478；固定答案knowledge-update重评分为70/72与69/72。跨家族reader（无工具/操作文件）得474，低于头条结果1.0个百分点。整体结论是：这些发现不足以确立新的榜单领先者或可迁移的记忆优势。
AI.motivation: 审计既有长期记忆检索链评测的可复现性与结论可靠性。作者关注：（1）头条分数在评分标准、reader快照变化下的稳健性；（2）与基线的提升是否来自记忆组件的真实效应，还是由证据列示、后验切分等混杂因素造成；（3）在缺乏未触碰holdout、原始请求不可重建、部分阶段未运行的条件下，发布成果能否支撑所宣称的"记忆优势"。动机是验证而非推广，即对可能存在的方法论漏洞进行系统复核。
AI.method: 在500道LongMemEval-S开发题上审计长期记忆检索链：以改编GPT-4o评分标准复评两条最强历史reader lane，重判同一pass-1答案；对knowledge-update做固定答案重评分（上游模板与修改模板）；在固定packets上比较93—479范围的reader lanes，并对两条最强历史lane做配对检验。另配置无客户端工具/操作文件的异家族reader与头条pass比较（配对95%区间）。对full package与baseline sessions在相同reader标签、路由与judge快照下做A/D对比（每臂一拍，含6个复用相同prompt结果，无固定reader快照）；对23项增益按基线packets是否列示证据做post-hoc切分。在恢复的LoCoMo数据上检验token-F1增益在答案行抽取后是否存活；并设置负对照（verifier修复3个错误草稿但破坏11个正确草稿）。所有题目均参与组件开发，无未触碰holdout；B/C与重复实验未运行。
AI.result: 最强历史reader lane在改编GPT-4o评分标准下得479与475；重判同一pass-1答案改变3个标签，得478。固定答案knowledge-update重评分为上游模板70/72、修改模板69/72。固定packets上reader lanes跨93—479；两条最强历史lane的配对检验既不能确立优越性也不能确立等价性。异家族reader得474，比头条pass低1.0个百分点（配对95%区间[-3.0,+1.0]）。相同请求reader标签、路由与judge快照下，full package 474 vs baseline sessions 454，差+4.0个百分点[+2.2,+6.0]；23项增益中18项增益、0项损失出现在基线packets未列示证据处，该post-hoc切分不能识别组件效应。恢复的LoCoMo数据中token-F1增益在答案行抽取后不存活。负对照拒绝了修复3个错误草稿但破坏11个正确草稿的verifier。所有题目均参与组件开发，无未触碰holdout。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现不足以确立新的榜单领先者或可迁移的记忆优势。A/D对比每臂仅一拍，含6个复用相同prompt结果，且无固定reader快照；B/C与重复实验仍未运行。原始头条请求无法重建，阶段1—4保持关闭。已发布artifacts仅支持packet检查、已保存裁决的重计数与重评分，不支持重建方法本身。因此该链的评测主张在现有证据下不被支持，需要未触碰holdout、固定读者快照与可重建请求方能给出可迁移结论。

title: Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generated responses using dense, token-level supervision from a stronger teacher. Vanilla OPD treats all teacher signals equally, assuming that the teacher's supervision is equally important for every token. However, teacher signals at different tokens may have very different effects on the student's performance: some correct important reasoning errors, while others have little effect on the final answer. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Dr. OPD (OPD Done Right), which defines the optimal weighted OPD to maximize the student's performance. We formulate Dr. OPD as a bilevel optimization problem in which the student learns from weighted teacher supervision, while the weights are selected to maximize the expected reward of the resulting student. To solve Dr. OPD, we develop an efficient iterative solver that updates the token weights and student policy alternatively. At each round, it updates weights in closed form and then takes one gradient step on the resulting weighted OPD objective. Under regularity conditions, we show that this weighted update achieves a higher expected reward than a vanilla OPD update. Empirically, across strong-to-weak and same-size distillation on math and code, Dr. OPD consistently outperforms all evaluated baselines. In particular, in the strong-to-weak distillation setting, Dr. OPD improves average math performance by $9.7$ points over vanilla OPD, and enables the smaller student to surpass its larger teacher.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Dr. OPD，将 on-policy distillation 形式化为双层优化问题，通过对教师 token 级监督进行最优加权以最大化学生期望奖励，并给出高效迭代求解器，在数理与代码任务上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: Vanilla OPD 对所有教师信号一视同仁，假设每个 token 的监督同等重要；但作者观察到不同 token 的教师信号对学生表现的贡献差异很大，有些能纠正关键推理错误，有些则影响甚微，因此需要差异化的 token 级加权。
AI.method: 提出 Dr. OPD，将最优加权 OPD 建模为双层优化：内层学生基于加权的教师监督学习，外层选择权重以最大化学生期望奖励。设计迭代求解器交替更新 token 权重与学生策略，每轮以闭式解更新权重，再对加权 OPD 目标做一步梯度更新。
AI.result: 在正则条件下证明该加权更新比 vanilla OPD 更新获得更高期望奖励；在数学与代码任务的强到弱及同尺寸蒸馏中，Dr. OPD 一致优于所有评估基线，强到弱设定下数学平均性能较 vanilla OPD 提升 9.7 分，并使较小的学生模型超越其更大的教师。
AI.conclusion: token 级教师监督的最优加权能有效提升 on-policy distillation 的效果，Dr. OPD 通过双层优化与迭代求解实现了理论与实证的双重收益，具备良好的可扩展性与实用价值。

title: doPlan: A Variable-Horizon Dataset for Multi-Stage Language-Conditioned Planning in Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous vehicles interacting with passengers through natural language must reason beyond immediate commands. Passenger intent may span multiple stages of behavior, depend on future events, refer to surrounding agents or landmarks, and remain relevant as driving conditions evolve. Existing language-enabled driving datasets largely focus on short, localized interactions, leaving these longer-horizon forms of passenger intent comparatively underexplored. We introduce doPlan, to our knowledge the first publicly available, human-annotated real-world dataset designed to study passenger language as persistent task context. Built on nuPlan, doPlan contains 5,154 human-written passenger instructions spanning 169.1 hours of cumulative instruction-aligned context over 50.9 hours of unique driving, with annotation windows ranging from 30.0 to 508.8 s. The annotations capture immediate, deferred, event-conditioned, persistent, and multi-stage passenger intent. The dataset, annotation interface, and supporting resources are publicly available at https://github.com/Mi3-Lab/doPlan. We evaluate four language-conditioned driving models and find that sensitivity to passenger language does not reliably translate into behavior consistent with the requested direction. More broadly, among 2,161 examples with a matched future maneuver, the first associated maneuver occurs a median of 24.6 s after the evaluation point, and only 9.8% occur within the models' common 5 s prediction horizon. These findings highlight the need to connect persistent passenger intent with successive planning decisions. doPlan provides a setting for studying how unresolved goals can be retained, grounded in evolving scenes, and tracked across multiple stages, including how a planner determines when a future goal becomes relevant to the current plan.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了doPlan——首个公开、人工标注的真实世界乘客语言数据集，将乘客指令视为持续性任务上下文，并揭示现有语言条件驾驶模型难以将持久意图转化为连续行为。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆通过自然语言与乘客交互时，需要超越即时命令进行推理。乘客意图可能跨越多个行为阶段、依赖未来事件、指代周围智能体或地标，并随驾驶条件演变而保持相关性。然而现有语言驱动驾驶数据集多聚焦于短时、局部交互，长时程乘客意图未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建于nuPlan之上，doPlan包含5,154条人工书写的乘客指令，覆盖50.9小时独特驾驶、169.1小时累计指令对齐上下文，标注窗口从30.0秒到508.8秒不等。标注涵盖即时、延迟、事件触发、持续和多阶段五类乘客意图。数据集、标注界面及配套资源已公开。作者评估了四个语言条件驾驶模型。
AI.result: 对乘客语言的敏感度并不能可靠地转化为符合所请求方向的行为。在2,161个具有匹配未来机动动作的样本中，首个相关机动动作平均出现在评估点后24.6秒（中位数），仅9.8%落在模型常见的5秒预测时域内。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调需将持久乘客意图与连续规划决策相连接。doPlan为研究未解决目标如何被保留、如何在演变场景中落地、以及如何跨多阶段追踪提供了平台，包括规划器如何判断未来目标何时与当前规划相关。

title: Gender bias across LLMs is common and highly heterogeneous
summary: Understanding gender biases in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly important as these systems become embedded in decision-support tools with real consequences. Prior research has focused only on a small set of models, leaving open the extent to which gender biases are common and heterogeneous across LLMs. We address this gap across ten models released between April 2025 and June 2026, spanning nine vendors, using two paradigms: gender attribution to stereotyped phrases (Study 1) and moral judgment of abuse or torture against a woman or a man to prevent a catastrophic outcome (Study 2). In Study 1, two of ten models attributed masculine-stereotyped phrases to female writers more often than the reverse, while three models showed the opposite pattern. In Study 2, several models converged on a male-disadvantaging asymmetry that was directionally consistent with a documented human tendency to protect female targets from harm, though the specific conditions under which this asymmetry emerged varied by model; three other models, by contrast, showed no variation across conditions. These results indicate that gender-related biases are common in LLMs. Their direction and magnitude, however, are highly heterogeneous, to the point that some models behave in diametrically opposite ways to others. Bias auditing should therefore be treated as an ongoing, multi-vendor process, rather than a one-time assessment.

AI.tldr: 该研究跨10个模型、9家厂商，用性别归因与道德判断两范式考察LLM性别偏见，发现偏见普遍存在但方向与强度高度异质，甚至相反；主张偏见审计应持续、多厂商进行。
AI.motivation: LLM日益嵌入具现实后果的决策支持工具，理解其性别偏见愈发重要。既有研究仅覆盖少量模型，无法判断性别偏见的普遍性及其跨模型异质性程度。
AI.method: 覆盖2025年4月至2026年6月发布的10个模型、9家厂商，采用两种范式：研究1为对刻板印象短语的性别归因；研究2为在"为阻止灾难性后果而虐待或折磨女性/男性"情境下的道德判断。
AI.result: 研究1中，10个模型里有2个更常把男性刻板短语归因于女性作者，另3个呈相反模式。研究2中，若干模型趋同于一种不利于男性的不对称性，方向与人类保护女性目标免受伤害的倾向一致，但该不对称出现的具体条件因模型而异；另有3个模型在各条件间无差异。
AI.conclusion: 性别相关偏见在LLM中普遍存在，但其方向与幅度高度异质，某些模型之间行为截然相反。因此偏见审计应被视为持续、多厂商的过程，而非一次性评估。

title: Pow3R-SLAM: Real-Time RGB-D SLAM with 3D Reconstruction Priors
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://chriskolios.github.io/Pow3R-SLAM/
summary: We present Pow3R-SLAM, a real-time RGB-D simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system that uses Pow3R for tracking and mapping. Inspired by MASt3R-SLAM, a recent work on monocular SLAM using two-view 3D reconstruction priors, we extend the work to incorporate depth as a prior on the network's prediction, rather than as geometry to fuse. Where traditional RGB-D SLAM systems struggle with sparsity in the depth images, Pow3R utilizes the available depth to give a better-conditioned pointmap, while inferring the depths in empty regions from the two-view photometric, depth, and intrinsic data. Evaluated against MASt3R-SLAM following its protocol on 24 sequences from TUM, 7-Scenes, and Replica, Pow3R-SLAM runs 1.6x faster in wall time, has 15% lower mean trajectory error, a 3.1x lower unscaled error, and produces denser maps, with a 30% lower Chamfer distance. We also introduce a hybrid variant that runs 2.1x faster than MASt3R-SLAM at 25.3 frames per second (FPS), while maintaining improved tracking and mapping accuracy. Against ORB-SLAM3 in RGB-D mode, Pow3R-SLAM is more accurate on TUM, 7-Scenes, and ETH3D-SLAM, and completes every TUM sequence. While Pow3R-SLAM can struggle on a small set of self-similar scenes, its overall performance shows that adding depth as a prior for two-view 3D reconstruction SLAM can be beneficial. A project webpage is available at: https://ChrisKolios.github.io/Pow3R-SLAM , and code will be made open-source upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: Pow3R-SLAM是一种实时RGB-D SLAM系统，将深度作为先验融入双视图三维重建，在跟踪与建图上优于MASt3R-SLAM和ORB-SLAM3。
AI.motivation: 传统RGB-D SLAM在深度图像稀疏时表现不佳；作者受MASt3R-SLAM（利用双视图三维重建先验的单目SLAM）启发，探索将深度作为网络预测的先验而非用于融合的几何信息，以缓解深度稀疏问题并提升整体性能。
AI.method: 基于Pow3R进行跟踪与建图，将可用深度用于生成条件更好的pointmap（点图），并从双视图光度、深度及内参数据推断空白区域的深度；另提出一种混合变体以提升运行速度。
AI.result: 在TUM、7-Scenes和Replica共24条序列上按MASt3R-SLAM协议评测：墙钟时间快1.6倍，平均轨迹误差低15%，未缩放误差低3.1倍，地图更稠密，Chamfer距离低30%；混合变体比MASt3R-SLAM快2.1倍，达25.3 FPS，且跟踪与建图精度仍有提升。与RGB-D模式的ORB-SLAM3相比，在TUM、7-Scenes和ETH3D-SLAM上更准确，并完成全部TUM序列。
AI.conclusion: 尽管在少量自相似场景中表现欠佳，但整体结果表明，将深度作为双视图三维重建SLAM的先验是有益的。项目网页已公开，代码将在论文录用后开源。

title: HARDE: Optimizing Agent Harnesses for Runtime Risk Detection and Execution Control
