Our method outperforms existing works on all part-quality metrics across all three tasks, and improves compatibility among parts by an order of magnitude over previous SOTA methods. Code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 该论文将3D部件分解重新表述为对整个形状的联合划分，提出一个可提示（promptable）模型，通过每个部件的3D点提示，输出非重叠且完整覆盖原形状的部件，统一支持图像/网格到部件的生成与部件分割。
AI.motivation: 现有3D部件分解方法不保证部件之间非重叠且共同覆盖整个形状，可能出现重叠或空隙，从而阻碍下游部件级应用；作者的核心洞察是部件分解应联合考虑所有目标部件，而非独立建模每个部件。
AI.method: 基于预训练3D生成模型，先从图像或网格获取形状潜码（shape latent）；引入提示编码器，将每个3D点提示映射为部件token并关注形状潜码；提出新颖的部件解码器，以由粗到细的方式联合对所有部件token评分，将形状体积内每个位置唯一分配给一个部件；整个分解在共享形状潜空间中完成。
AI.result: 在图像到部件生成、网格到部件生成、部件分割三项任务的所有部件质量指标上均优于现有方法，且部件间兼容性较此前SOTA提升一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 联合划分式建模与共享潜空间设计可有效实现可控、完整且非重叠的3D部件分解，为部件级下游应用提供更可靠的基础；代码与模型将开源。

title: Multi-agent discussion gains less when dissent is withheld
summary: Multi-agent systems of LLMs add discussion to majority voting and are therefore expected to be more capable. However, empirical reports conflict on whether discussion improves accuracy or leads to an incorrect consensus. Here, we introduce a parsimonious model that explains when discussion improves accuracy and when it ends in an incorrect consensus, built from four behaviors repeatedly observed in LLM agents: (1) withholding dissent, (2) internalizing a stated answer, (3) reconsidering after seeing dissent, and (4) correcting toward the correct answer. The model shows that discussion can overturn an incorrect initial majority only when the withholding rate $c$ is below a critical rate $c^* = γ/(γ+ a)$, set by the net correction rate $γ$ and the internalization rate $a$. We estimate these rates from conversation logs with a Bayesian method and place LLM teams relative to $c^*$. As the model predicts, the gain from discussion shrinks as withholding rises, across LLMs and on a hidden profile benchmark, HiddenBench, and MedEInst. Instructing agents not to withhold dissent increases this gain. Turning reasoning off also increases the gain, because reasoning raises the internalization rate $a$ and keeps agents from reconsidering a minority answer. These findings reconcile the conflicting reports and identify when discussion outperforms majority voting.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个简约模型,用四种反复观察到的LLM智能体行为(保留异议、内化已有答案、见到异议后重新考虑、向正确答案纠正)来解释多智能体讨论何时提高准确率、何时导致错误共识。模型给出讨论能推翻错误初始多数所需的关键条件:保留率 c 低于临界值 c*=γ/(γ+a),并通过贝叶斯方法从对话日志估计参数,在多个基准上验证。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统在多数投票基础上加入讨论,理应更强,但实证结果相互矛盾:讨论有时提高准确率,有时却导致错误共识。作者希望用一个简约模型统一解释这种分歧,明确讨论优于多数投票的条件。
AI.method: 从LLM智能体反复出现的四种行为构建简约模型:(1)保留异议,(2)内化已陈述的答案,(3)看到异议后重新考虑,(4)向正确答案纠正。模型推导出推翻错误初始多数的条件:保留率 c 需低于临界率 c*=γ/(γ+a),其中 γ 为净纠正率,a 为内化率。采用贝叶斯方法从对话日志估计这些速率,并将LLM团队定位在相对 c* 的位置。
AI.result: 如模型预测,随着保留率上升,讨论带来的增益缩小;该结论在多个LLM、隐藏画像基准 HiddenBench 与 MedEInst 上均成立。指示智能体不要保留异议可提高增益;关闭推理也会提高增益,因为推理会提高内化率 a,使智能体不再重新考虑少数答案。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现调和了相互矛盾的实证报道,并识别出讨论何时优于多数投票:当保留率低于临界率、内化率不高时,讨论更可能提升准确率。

title: Strike a Chord! Modal Kinetic Typography
summary: We introduce modal kinetic typography, which animates a vector glyph to express a semantic concept while keeping it legible. Our key idea is to build motion from the glyph's natural vibration modes. Specifically, a finite-element eigenproblem assembled from the vector outline yields the glyph's softest modes, for the whole letter and for each of its parts, allowing it to bend. The problem's zero-energy solutions, i.e., rigid translations and rotations, are applied in closed form to each part, allowing parts to also move as blocks. To animate the glyph, a frozen video diffusion model supervises only the modes' amplitudes and phases. Our modal approach addresses two weaknesses of prior work. Free-form point optimization under video score distillation (SDS) moves each point and frame independently along noisy gradients, tearing the outline and causing jitter. In contrast, our modes are smooth along the outline and driven by a few whole-cycle harmonics, which restricts these gradients to smooth, seamlessly looping motion. On the other hand, structured alternatives rely on skeletons or keypoints from category-specific priors, whereas our modes come from the glyph itself; the only prior is a list naming each letter's moving parts, generated once for the whole alphabet by a language model. In modal kinetic typography, shape and motion are disentangled by construction: a single base outline is sculpted toward the concept, and the modal drive cannot alter it, so a letter can also be animated without being reshaped. Our method produces more articulated and smoother motion than Dynamic Typography and AniClipart at comparable or better concept alignment, with less glyph tearing than Dynamic Typography, and is preferred by human raters, including in a frozen-shape setting where motion alone must carry the concept. Our results were also preferred over Astra (GPT-6) by human raters.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“模态动态字体”（modal kinetic typography），利用字形矢量轮廓的有限元本征模态驱动动画，仅由冻结视频扩散模型监督模态幅值与相位，实现平滑、无缝循环且解耦形状与运动的字形动画，效果优于 Dynamic Typography、AniClipart 与 Astra。
AI.motivation: 既有方法存在两类缺陷：基于视频分数蒸馏（SDS）的自由点优化逐点逐帧沿噪声梯度移动，导致轮廓撕裂与抖动；结构化方法依赖类别特定的骨架或关键点先验，缺乏通用性。因此需要一种既平滑又能保持字形可读性的动画方案。
AI.method: 从字形矢量轮廓装配有限元本征问题，得到整字及其各部件的低阶最软模态以支持弯曲；对零能量解（刚体平移与旋转）以闭式形式施加于各部件，使部件可作为整体移动。动画阶段由冻结视频扩散模型仅监督各模态的幅值与相位。整体字形仅有一份基础轮廓，模态驱动不改变形状，从而实现形状与运动在构造上的解耦；唯一先验是由语言模型一次性为整个字母表生成的“各字母运动部件列表”。
AI.result: 相比 Dynamic Typography 与 AniClipart，方法产生更关节化、更平滑的运动，在概念对齐相当或更优的情况下字形撕裂更少；在冻结形状（motion-only）设定下也获得人类评分者偏好，并且其结果的人类偏好度超过 Astra（GPT-6）。
AI.conclusion: 以字形自身的振动模态作为运动基元，可将运动约束到沿轮廓平滑、由少量整周期谐波驱动的无缝循环，从而在保持可读性的同时表达语义概念，并在客观指标与人类偏好上均优于现有方法。

title: ExploreNet: Learning Where to Explore in Diffusion GRPO
summary: Group-relative RL methods such as Flow-GRPO post-train image generators by exploring with isotropic Gaussian noise added at every denoising step. This noise decides which rollouts the model learns from, yet it perturbs every channel and spatial position of the latent equally. In this paper, we instead show that latent elements differ in how much they change the generated image, so exploration should adapt to these differences. We introduce EXPLORENET to learn an adaptive exploration distribution. EXPLORENET is a policy that predicts a noise scale for every latent element from the current latent, the denoising step, and the prompt, before any reward is observed; it is trained on the reward spread of each rollout group and discarded after training, leaving inference unchanged. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, EXPLORENET improves held-out GenEval2 by 14% over Flow-GRPO, transfers to two independent compositional benchmarks and five preference and image-quality models, and reaches a 67.2% human preference win-rate. Overall, across our group-relative diffusion RL experiments, we find that exploration is learnable, the shape of the exploration distribution outweighs its magnitude, and rollout quality is more effective than rollout quantity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EXPLORENET，通过为扩散模型 RL 后训练学习自适应探索分布（逐 latent 元素预测噪声尺度），在 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 上显著提升生成质量与人类偏好。
AI.motivation: 现有 group-relative RL 方法（如 Flow-GRPO）在每步去噪时添加各向同性高斯噪声进行探索，噪声对所有通道和空间位置施加同等扰动。但本文指出 latent 元素对生成图像的影响程度不同，探索应适应这种差异，而现有方法忽略了这一点。
AI.method: 提出 EXPLORENET：一个策略网络，在观测到任何奖励之前，依据当前 latent、去噪步数和提示词，为每个 latent 元素预测噪声尺度，从而学习自适应探索分布；该策略以每个 rollout group 的奖励离散度作为训练信号，训练完成后被丢弃，推理阶段保持不变。
AI.result: 在 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 上，EXPLORENET 相比 Flow-GRPO 在留出的 GenEval2 上提升 14%，并迁移到两个独立的组合性基准和五个偏好/图像质量模型，达到 67.2% 的人类偏好胜率。
AI.conclusion: 在 group-relative 扩散 RL 实验中，探索是可学习的；探索分布的"形状"比其"幅度"更重要；且 rollout 的质量比数量更有效。

title: Hermes: Learning Contextual Reasoning Unlocks Test-Time Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling improves model performance by allocating additional compute during inference. Using this compute effectively across multiple context windows requires deciding how to allocate fresh contexts and what information to carry between them. We call a model's ability to make these decisions contextual reasoning. Existing approaches largely prescribe these decisions through their harness; we instead shift them to the model. We introduce 1) Hermes, a family of simple, configurable harnesses that progressively varies model control over context allocation and reuse, and 2) Hermes-Learn, a two-stage framework for learning these capabilities. We find that capable models can exploit this flexibility to scale with additional inference-time compute, while smaller open-source models initially struggle to do so. Training with Hermes-Learn closes this gap, inducing adaptive contextual reasoning strategies that vary with both the problem and the progress of reasoning. These gains generalize across benchmarks and models, extrapolate beyond the inference-time compute seen during training, and transfer to complementary test-time scaling methods beyond Hermes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Hermes系列可配置harness与Hermes-Learn两阶段训练框架，将多上下文窗口的分配与信息复用决策交给模型本身（即"上下文推理"），使小模型也能借助额外推理算力有效扩展性能。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展（test-time scaling）通过在推理阶段分配额外算力提升模型性能，但跨多个上下文窗口时，如何分配新窗口、如何在窗口间传递信息，现有方法大多由harness预设，未让模型自主决策。作者将这种决策能力定义为"上下文推理"（contextual reasoning），并希望把决策权从harness转交给模型。
AI.method: 提出两部分工作：1) Hermes，一族简单、可配置的harness，逐步变化模型对上下文分配与复用的控制程度；2) Hermes-Learn，一个两阶段框架，用于学习上述上下文推理能力。通过改变harness赋予模型的自由度，并配合两阶段训练，使模型习得决策策略。
AI.result: 能力强的模型能利用这种灵活性，随推理算力增加而有效扩展；较小的开源模型起初难以做到。经Hermes-Learn训练后，小模型差距被弥合，习得随问题与推理进展而变化的自适应上下文推理策略。这些收益可跨基准与模型泛化，能外推到训练时未见过的推理算力规模，并可迁移到Hermes之外的互补测试时扩展方法。
AI.conclusion: 将上下文分配与复用决策从harness转交给模型是可行的，且可通过Hermes-Learn有效习得；所得自适应上下文推理策略具备泛化性、外推性与迁移性，为测试时扩展提供了一条模型自主决策的路径。

title: EVOKE: Eliciting World Knowledge in Agents for Transferable Decision-Making
comment: 19 pages. Project page: https://gnonymous.github.io/EVOKE ; Code: https://github.com/Gnonymous/EVOKE ; Models: https://huggingface.co/Gnonymous/EVOKE
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents for multi-step decision-making, yet transfer poorly to unseen environments. World-model methods address this by training agents to predict future observations, at the cost of additional training and errors that compound when predictions are used for planning. However, for LLM agents operating in digital environments, much of this world knowledge is already internalized during pretraining, which shifts the problem from acquiring it to eliciting it. We argue that typical post-training provides little pressure for such elicitation, since supervision under a single goal at each visited state inadvertently drives policies to rely on superficial contextual habits. We introduce EVOKE, a post-training method that supplies this pressure through goal diversity at fixed states. Motivated by theory showing that an agent competent across diverse goals must encode a world model recoverable from its action preferences, EVOKE holds the environment state and interaction history fixed and ranks the same candidate actions under alternative goals, forcing action preferences to change, so that a policy relying on contextual habits or single-goal correlations cannot order them correctly. This implicitly elicits the policy's pretrained world knowledge to inform decisions. We evaluate EVOKE across diverse tasks in three backbones, demonstrating improved task performance, unseen environment generalization, and data efficiency. We further conduct controlled analyses to better understand what drives these gains. These findings offer a new perspective on eliciting internalized world knowledge for transferable action through direct decision supervision.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出EVOKE——一种后训练方法，通过在固定状态下引入目标多样性，迫使策略利用预训练阶段已内化的世界知识来做决策，从而提升LLM智能体的任务表现、未见环境泛化能力和数据效率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在多步决策中难以迁移到未见环境。世界模型方法需额外训练预测未来观测，且预测误差在规划中会累积。作者认为，对于在数字环境中运行的LLM智能体，大量世界知识在预训练时已经内化，问题从"获取知识"转变为"引导知识"。而典型后训练在每一访问状态下仅以单一目标进行监督，无意中驱使策略依赖表层的上下文习惯，缺乏引导世界知识的压力。
AI.method: EVOKE通过对固定状态下的目标多样性施加压力来实现引导。理论表明，一个能在多样目标下胜任的智能体必须编码可从其行动偏好中恢复的世界模型。基于此，EVOKE固定环境状态与交互历史，在备选目标下对同一组候选动作进行排序，迫使行动偏好发生变化，从而让依赖上下文习惯或单目标相关性的策略无法正确排序，隐式地引导策略运用其预训练的世界知识来指导决策。
AI.result: 在三种骨干模型、多种任务上评估EVOKE，结果显示任务性能提升、未见环境泛化能力增强以及数据效率提高。作者进一步进行了受控分析，以理解上述增益的驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为通过直接决策监督来引导内化世界知识以实现可迁移行动提供了新视角。

title: Learning Semantic Inpainting for Animatable Gaussian Head Avatars
summary: We present SInGA, a novel method for learning Semantic Inpainting for animatable Gaussian head Avatars from a single image. Existing avatar approaches often rely on multi-view observations and lack effective handling of unobserved regions in single-view settings, limiting their applicability in such scenarios. To address this, we propose a semantic inpainting framework defined in UV space for completing unobserved facial regions. Our key insight lies in the structured topology of the UV representation, which provides consistent spatial correspondences and enables reliable completion of identity-specific features using the inherent symmetry cues of human faces. We extract features from observed regions and use them to complete unobserved regions. The completed representation is then used to regress Gaussian attributes, effectively performing Gaussian inpainting. In addition, instead of relying on a single Gaussian at each surface or pixel location, we stack multiple Gaussians to enhance detail. The resulting avatar generalizes across identities without requiring per-identity optimization and can be animated with driving inputs. Experimental results show that our method generates high-quality head avatars with improved completeness and identity preservation, while supporting realistic animation and consistent rendering from unobserved views.

AI.tldr: 提出SInGA，一种从单张图像学习可动画高斯头部化身的方法，通过在UV空间进行语义补全来完成未观测面部区域。
AI.motivation: 现有化身方法多依赖多视角观测，且在单视角设置下缺乏对未观测区域的有效处理，限制了其适用性。
AI.method: 在UV空间构建语义补全框架：利用UV表示的结构化拓扑提供一致的空间对应，并借人脸固有的对称线索完成身份特定特征。从观测区域提取特征补全未观测区域，完成后的表示用于回归高斯属性（即高斯补全）。此外在每个表面/像素位置堆叠多个高斯以增强细节。该化身无需逐身份优化即可泛化到不同身份，并可用驱动输入进行动画。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法生成的头部化身质量高，在完整性和身份保持方面有所提升，支持真实感动画，并在未观测视角下实现一致渲染。
AI.conclusion: SInGA通过UV空间的语义补全与多高斯堆叠，有效解决了单图可动画头部化身的未观测区域问题，泛化性好。

title: OpenCollab: A Multi-Agent Coding Framework with Programmable Collaboration and Controllable Runtime
summary: Multi-agent coding systems are designed to tackle complex software engineering tasks through collaboration. However, existing evaluations typically assume configured organizations are followed faithfully, whereas reality differs. This behavioral gap, combined with differences in underlying system components, prevents clear attribution of observed gains. To this end, we introduce OpenCollab, a multi-agent coding framework that provides a unified infrastructure for programmable collaboration and controllable runtime. Specifically, OpenCollab unifies organization design, enforces experimental control on a shared runtime, and tracks execution through fine-grained event streams. On this basis, we define Adherence to quantify whether the declared organization is actually realized. Our experiments reveal that agents collaborate very differently across configurations: changing any single dimension shifts Adherence, from 47.2% to as high as 97.2%. Furthermore, extensive agentic coding benchmarks show that OpenCollab (Duo) establishes new SOTA performance compared to the mainstream harnesses such as Mini-SWE-agent, OpenHands, Codex CLI, and Claude Code, showing that a well-designed organization can outperform strong existing harnesses, while OpenCollab's single-agent configuration uses the fewest tokens across all evaluated suites. OpenCollab establishes a unified multi-agent infrastructure for easy programmable collaboration and controlled causal evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出 OpenCollab 多智能体编码框架，统一组织设计、共享运行时控制与细粒度事件流追踪，并定义 Adherence 指标量化声明组织是否真正实现。实验显示配置变化使 Adherence 从 47.2% 波动至 97.2%，Duo 配置在多项基准上超越现有主流框架达到 SOTA，且单智能体配置 token 消耗最低。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体编码系统的评估通常假设预设组织被忠实执行，但实际行为与设计存在偏差；加之底层系统组件差异，导致性能增益难以清晰归因。因此需要一个统一基础设施来支持可编程协作与可控运行时，从而进行受控的因果评估。
AI.method: 提出 OpenCollab 框架：统一组织设计、在共享运行时上实施实验控制，并通过细粒度事件流追踪执行过程。在此基础上定义 Adherence 指标，量化声明的组织是否被真正实现。
AI.result: 实验表明智能体在不同配置下协作方式差异显著：改变任一维度都会使 Adherence 变化，范围从 47.2% 到 97.2%。在大量智能体编码基准上，OpenCollab（Duo）相比 Mini-SWE-agent、OpenHands、Codex CLI 和 Claude Code 等主流框架达到新的 SOTA，说明良好设计的组织可超越强基线；同时其单智能体配置在所有评估套件中 token 消耗最少。
AI.conclusion: OpenCollab 为多智能体编码建立了统一基础设施，支持便捷的可编程协作与受控因果评估，并证明组织设计与运行时控制对性能归因和实际表现均至关重要。

title: TrackFish3D: Self-Supervised 3D Tracking of Schooling Fish from Multi-view Videos
comment: to be published in the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Quantifying collective fish behavior requires accurate trajectories, yet multi-view 3D tracking remains challenging due to frequent occlusions, visually similar individuals, and the long-standing scarcity of identity annotations. We present TrackFish3D, a geometry-driven self-supervised framework for dense multi-camera 3D tracking of schooling fish. Instead of relying on appearance-based re-identification or manually annotated identities, TrackFish3D turns calibrated multi-view geometry into supervision: triangulation and reprojection consistency provide pseudo-associations, while a geometric encoder and global association transformer learn all-to-all cross-view correspondence within each frame. To make these associations identity-aware, TrackFish3D introduces a self-supervised contrastive objective that separates co-visible individuals in the embedding space, together with a temporal predictor that preserves identities and bridges short occlusions across frames. The resulting model is trained once on unlabeled footage and applied directly to unseen test videos, requiring no cross-view identity labels, temporal annotations, 3D ground truth, appearance features, or test-time optimization. On our benchmark, TrackFish3D improves 3D Multi-Object Tracking Accuracy from 87.7% for the strongest baseline to 95.8%. On the 3D-ZeF zebrafish benchmark, it achieves 81.1% MOTA, compared with 77.4% for the best geometric baseline. TrackFish3D also generalizes beyond fish, achieving strong results on real-world bird tracking.

AI.tldr: TrackFish3D：一个几何驱动的自监督多视角3D密集鱼群跟踪框架，无需身份标注、3D真值或外观特征，在自建基准上将3D MOTA从87.7%提升到95.8%，在3D-ZeF上达到81.1%，并可泛化到鸟类跟踪。
AI.motivation: 多视角3D鱼群跟踪面临频繁遮挡、个体外观高度相似以及长期缺乏身份标注等难题。现有方法依赖外观重识别或人工标注身份，而这类标注成本高且稀缺，因此需要一种不依赖身份标注的密集3D跟踪方案。
AI.method: 提出TrackFish3D，将标定好的多视角几何转化为监督信号：(1) 通过三角化与重投影一致性生成伪关联；(2) 用几何编码器与全局关联Transformer学习帧内全对全跨视角对应；(3) 引入自监督对比目标，使共视个体在嵌入空间中被区分开；(4) 用时间预测器维持身份并桥接跨帧的短时遮挡。模型在无标注视频上训练一次，直接应用于未见测试视频。
AI.result: 在自建基准上，3D多目标跟踪准确率（MOTA）由最强基线的87.7%提升至95.8%；在3D-ZeF斑马鱼基准上达到81.1% MOTA，优于最佳几何基线的77.4%。此外，方法可推广到真实鸟类跟踪任务，取得良好效果。
AI.conclusion: TrackFish3D证明了标定多视角几何本身即可作为有效的自监督信号，无需身份标注、时序标注、3D真值、外观特征或测试时优化，即可实现高精度的密集3D多目标跟踪，并具备跨物种泛化能力。

title: Halluscoring 2026: The first shared task on llms hallucination detection and answer verification
summary: We present HalluScoring 2026, a shared task for evaluating hallucination detection and factual verification in Arabic question answering under challenging generalization settings. Its four subtasks are organized into two tasks. Task~1 evaluates binary hallucination detection, considering generalization to unseen questions (Subtask 1.1) and responses generated by unseen LLMs (Subtask 1.2). Task 2 extends the evaluation beyond detection by requiring the systems to additionally identify the correct factual answer from six related candidates, covering Islamic knowledge (Subtask 2.1) and general knowledge (Subtask 2.2). The shared task is based on two Arabic datasets: HalluScore and HalluTruthQA. A total of 13 teams participated in the shared task, ten of which submitted system description papers. The results of Task 1 demonstrate that hallucination detection remains challenging. On the Task 1 test sets, the top-ranked systems achieved AUC-ROC scores of 0.7717 for Subtask 1.1 (REGLAT) and 0.7670 for Subtask 1.2 (NAMAA). Under assisted evaluation, the highest combined detection and answer-selection scores for Subtasks 2.1 and 2.2 were 0.8824 and 0.8565, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了阿拉伯语问答幻觉检测与事实核查的共享任务 HalluScoring 2026，共 4 个子任务，覆盖未见过问题与未见过模型两类泛化场景，并进一步要求选出正确答案；13 支队伍参赛，检测任务仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语问答中的幻觉检测与事实核查缺乏在困难泛化场景下的系统评测；需要检验系统在未见过问题、未见过LLM生成回答条件下的鲁棒性，并将评测从"是否幻觉"拓展到"选出正确事实答案"。
AI.method: 构建共享任务，分为两大类：Task 1 为二分类幻觉检测，含向未见过问题泛化（Subtask 1.1）和向未见过LLM生成回答泛化（Subtask 1.2）；Task 2 在检测基础上增加从六个相关候选中选出正确事实答案，分伊斯兰知识（Subtask 2.1）与通用知识（Subtask 2.2）。基于 HalluScore 与 HalluTruthQA 两个阿拉伯语数据集，采用 AUC-ROC 及辅助评测下检测与答案选择的组合得分进行评估。
AI.result: 共 13 支队伍参赛，其中 10 支提交系统描述论文。Task 1 测试集上，最高系统 AUC-ROC 为 Subtask 1.1 的 0.7717（REGLAT）和 Subtask 1.2 的 0.7670（NAMAA）。辅助评测下，Subtask 2.1 与 2.2 的最高检测与答案选择组合得分分别为 0.8824 和 0.8565。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明阿拉伯语幻觉检测在泛化设定下仍是难题，最高 AUC-ROC 仅约 0.77；而在引入候选答案的辅助评测中，系统可获得较高的组合得分（约 0.86–0.88），提示答案选择环节相对更易，检测本身仍是主要瓶颈。

title: Evaluating Language Model Safety Across Long Adversarial Conversations
summary: Conversational safety evaluations often test language models with a single harmful prompt, even though real-world systems interact with users through long, adaptive conversations. This study examines whether models continue to respond safely when an adversarial user persists across multiple turns. We evaluate three open-weight, instruction-tuned models on two harmful prompts across different conversation lengths and random seeds. In each setting, a second language model acts as a persistent adversarial user, while a safety classifier labels every response as safe or unsafe. Across all model-prompt combinations, first-turn safe-response rates ranged from 85% to 100%. By depth 11, they dropped to 38-61%, and by depth 101, to 15-44%. This decline appeared across models and continued well beyond the short interactions typically used in multi-turn safety evaluations. These results provide proof-of-concept evidence that strong single-turn safety does not necessarily persist during sustained adversarial interaction. They highlight the need for long-horizon evaluations and conversation-level safeguards that account for risk accumulating across turns.

AI.tldr: 该研究验证了指令微调模型在持续对抗性多轮对话中的安全性衰减：首轮安全回复率为85%-100%，第11轮降至38%-61%，第101轮进一步降至15%-44%，表明单轮安全性无法在长时对抗交互中维持。
AI.motivation: 现有对话安全评估多采用单一有害提示进行测试，而真实系统与用户的交互是长时、自适应的多轮对话；因此需要检验模型在对抗用户持续施压的多轮场景下是否仍能保持安全响应。
AI.method: 选取三个开放权重、指令微调模型与两类有害提示，设置不同对话长度与随机种子；每一轮中由另一个语言模型扮演持续对抗用户，并用安全分类器对每条回复标注安全/不安全。
AI.result: 在所有模型-提示组合中，首轮安全回复率为85%-100%；到第11轮降至38%-61%，到第101轮降至15%-44%。该下降趋势跨模型一致，且远超现有多轮安全评估常用的短交互长度。
AI.conclusion: 强单轮安全性并不必然在持续对抗交互中延续；需引入长时程安全评估与对话级防护机制，以应对跨轮次累积的风险。

title: Beyond Mode Collapse: Generating Diverse Synthetic Expert Conversations via Generative Flow Networks
summary: High quality synthetic data is central to post training LLMs for adaptive AI applications that represent the diverse expert strategies and decisions in conversations. Prompting LLMs directly or conditioning them on end use scenarios yields low diversity data that collapses onto dominant modes. We propose a method to generate diverse high quality synthetic data using Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets). We show that training GFlowNets to generate latent conversation structure using a Gaussian mixture density over key interaction features (e.g., confusion episode dynamics, scaffolding directive balance) enables sampling expert strategies in proportion to their prevalence in the training data. Across two structurally distinct domains, tutoring and emotional support dialogues, our GFlow based synthetic data generation approach offers a better balance of fidelity, mode coverage and authenticity than reinforcement-learning and end to end LLM baselines, without copying training data. Evaluated on three downstream outcome prediction tasks, classifiers trained on synthetic GFlowNet generated conversations provide a stronger training signal than competitive synthesis baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用生成流网络（GFlowNets）在潜在对话结构上按高斯混合密度建模，实现按训练数据中专家策略分布比例采样的高质量合成对话数据生成，在辅导与情感支持两个领域上优于强化学习和端到端LLM基线。
AI.motivation: LLM后训练需要高质量合成数据以覆盖多样化的专家策略与决策。但直接提示LLM或以其末端使用场景为条件，会导致数据多样性低、坍缩到主导模式，无法充分代表训练数据中的专家策略分布。
AI.method: 提出基于GFlowNets的合成数据生成方法，在潜在对话结构上进行生成式建模，并以关键交互特征（如困惑情境动态、脚手架指令平衡）上的高斯混合密度为奖励/目标分布，从而按训练数据中各专家策略的流行度比例进行采样。
AI.result: 在两个结构不同的领域（辅导与情感支持对话）上，基于GFlowNet的合成数据生成在保真度、模式覆盖与真实性之间取得了比强化学习及端到端LLM基线更好的平衡，且不复制训练数据。在三个下游结果预测任务上，用GFlowNet合成对话训练的模型提供了更强的训练信号。
AI.conclusion: 将GFlowNets应用于潜在对话结构建模，可生成高质量、高多样性且分布比例合理的合成对话数据，为后训练提供优于现有合成基线的训练信号。

title: On the Off-Policy Teacher in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as a promising post-training paradigm in which the student learns from trajectories generated by its own policy under dense teacher supervision. However, OPD introduces a fundamental asymmetry: although the sampled trajectories are on-policy for the student, they are off-policy for the teacher. The teacher is typically optimized to continue from prefixes generated by its own policy, but during OPD it must instead supervise prefixes generated by the student. Empirically, we find that its continuation performance degrades as these prefixes grow longer. To address this issue, we propose Student-COnditioned Updates of the Teacher (SCOUT), a co-training framework that adapts the teacher to student-generated prefixes. Alongside standard OPD updates, SCOUT periodically optimizes the teacher's conditional ability using reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, where the teacher generates continuations from student prefixes and learns from outcome rewards. Controlled experiments show that SCOUT improves the teacher's ability to continue from student-generated prefixes, supporting the intended mechanism of student-conditioned teacher adaptation. Across multiple teacher--student configurations, model scales, and reasoning domains, SCOUT also consistently improves the effectiveness of on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: OPD中学生轨迹对教师构成off-policy，导致教师续写学生前缀能力随长度下降；作者提出SCOUT，通过RLVR周期性微调教师以适应学生前缀，从而提升OPD效果。
AI.motivation: On-policy distillation (OPD) 已成为一种有前景的后训练范式：学生从自身策略生成的轨迹中接受教师的密集监督。然而 OPD 存在一个根本性的不对称：采样轨迹对学生是 on-policy 的，但对教师是 off-policy 的。教师通常被优化为从自身策略生成的前缀继续，而在 OPD 中却必须监督由学生生成的前缀。实证发现，随着这些前缀变长，教师的续写性能会下降。因此需要一种方法让教师适应学生生成的前缀。
AI.method: 提出 Student-COnditioned Updates of the Teacher (SCOUT)，一个协同训练框架，用于使教师适应学生生成的前缀。在标准 OPD 更新之外，SCOUT 周期性地使用带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）优化教师的条件能力：教师从学生前缀生成续写，并从结果奖励中学习。
AI.result: 受控实验表明，SCOUT 提升了教师从学生生成前缀继续的能力，支持了学生条件化教师适应这一预期机制。在多种教师—学生配置、模型规模和推理领域上，SCOUT 也持续提升了 on-policy 蒸馏的效果。
AI.conclusion: SCOUT 通过周期性地用 RLVR 对学生前缀下的教师续写能力进行协同优化，缓解了 OPD 中教师对off-policy前缀监督能力退化的问题，并在多配置、多规模、多领域上一致提升蒸馏效果。

title: Inductive Visual Logic for Few-Shot Out-Of-Distribution Adaptation in VLMs
summary: Generative vision-language models (VLMs) such as Qwen-VL and LLaVA achieve strong zero-shot performance on tasks overlapping with their pretraining distribution, yet fail on specialized domains where the required discriminative features were never learned, a regime we term distant out-of-distribution (OOD). Standard adaptation methods cannot overcome this representational absence because they operate within the encoder's existing feature space. However, VLMs retain a robust descriptive capacity even when discrimination collapses: a model that cannot classify a medical scan can still articulate its visual patterns. Exploiting this asymmetry, we introduce Inductive Visual Logic (IVL), a training-free framework that constructs classification knowledge from the model's surviving descriptive ability. IVL extracts visual traits from few-shot support images through dual-mode prompting, combining semantic descriptions with primitive visual observations, and organizes them into per-class trait dictionaries. At inference, hierarchical filtering identifies spatially grounded trait evidence for classification. Across multiple distant-OOD benchmarks, IVL achieves the highest aggregate accuracy under two VLM backbones while producing interpretable, trait-traceable predictions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出免训练的归纳视觉逻辑（IVL）框架，利用生成式VLM在判别能力崩溃时仍保留的描述能力，从少样本支持图像构建类别特征字典并用于分类，从而应对“远距离分布外”（distant OOD）任务。
AI.motivation: 生成式视觉语言模型（如Qwen-VL、LLaVA）在与预训练分布重叠的任务上零样本表现强，但在需要特定判别特征、预训练从未学到的专业领域（distant OOD）上失败。标准适配方法受限于编码器已有特征空间，无法弥补这种表征缺失。然而VLM即使在判别崩溃时仍保有关键的描述能力，这一不对称性为解决问题提供了切入口。
AI.method: IVL为免训练框架：通过双模式提示（dual-mode prompting）从少样本支持图像中提取视觉特征，将语义描述与基础视觉观察相结合，组织为逐类特征字典；推理阶段采用分层过滤（hierarchical filtering）定位具有空间依据的特征证据以完成分类。
AI.result: 在多个distant-OOD基准上，IVL在两种VLM骨干下均取得最高总体准确率，并生成可解释、可追溯特征依据的预测。
AI.conclusion: 利用VLM残余描述能力构建分类知识，可有效应对表征缺失的远距离分布外任务，且兼具免训练、可解释的优势。

authors: L. D. M. S. Sai Teja
title: Composition, Not Conversation: VLMs Lose the Scene, Not the Thread
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly reason over visual evidence that is cropped, segmented, retrieved, or revealed over time. Yet most VQA benchmarks present the complete image and question at once. We ask what models lose when the same information is fragmented. We introduce Layered-VQA, with 93 scenes and 300 questions. Each image is decomposed into ordered RGBA layers that exactly recompose the original scene, and each question is annotated with supporting, minimal-sufficient, and distractor layers. We evaluate eleven open-weight VLMs from 3B to 32B parameters and two proprietary models with a scale of 187,200 conversations, graded by 1.74M open-model cross-judgments. We find three consistent failures. Loss in Composition: fragmenting the question has a small effect, but fragmenting the scene substantially reduces accuracy; recomposing the same layers largely restores performance. Oracle Inversion: even oracle-selected sufficient evidence can perform worse than the complete scene. Loss in Grounding: as more evidence is required, grounding degrades much faster than answer accuracy. Together, these results show that having the right visual evidence is not enough. How that evidence is composed and presented determines whether models can use and ground it. The right evidence is not enough: VLMs need the scene it came from.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Layered-VQA基准，将图像分解为有序RGBA图层，考察视觉语言模型在信息被碎片化时的表现，发现证据组合方式与呈现方式比证据本身更关键。
AI.motivation: 当前多数VQA基准一次性给出完整图像与问题，但真实应用中视觉证据常被裁剪、分割、检索或逐步揭示。作者想探究：当同样的视觉信息被碎片化呈现时，模型会损失什么能力。
AI.method: 构建Layered-VQA，含93个场景、300个问题；每张图像分解为可精确重组原场景的有序RGBA图层，每个问题标注支持层、最小充分层和干扰层。评测11个开源模型（3B–32B）和2个闭源模型，共187,200轮对话，并由174万次开源模型交叉判断进行评分。
AI.result: 发现三类一致失败：组合损失（问题碎片化影响小，但场景碎片化显著降低准确率，重组图层可基本恢复性能）；预言机反转（即使精选的充分证据，表现也可能不如完整场景）；接地损失（所需证据越多，接地能力比答案准确率下降更快）。
AI.conclusion: 拥有正确的视觉证据并不足够；证据如何组合与呈现，决定了模型能否使用并接地这些证据。模型需要证据所来自的完整场景，即“正确的证据本身并不够”。

title: TALK-Dem: Benchmarking Embodied Task Planning under Dementia-Associated Communication Patterns
summary: Existing LLM-driven robot task planners rely on a taken-for-granted assumption of an ideal user whose instructions are clear, complete, and task-focused. However, when interacting with real-world users, especially those experiencing cognitive impairments, such as people living with dementia (PLWD), the planners often make mistakes and even pose physical safety risks. We proposed TALK-Dem (Talking Attributes and Linguistic Knowledge in Dementia), the first benchmark for evaluating LLM-driven robot task planning under dementia-associated verbal communication. TALK-Dem contains 4,800 instructions and covers five typical communication patterns, including Referential Imprecision, Object Substitution, Empty Speech, Topic Drift, and Intrusion, at three intensity levels. Experiments across six open-weight LLMs reveal a substantial robustness gap. Across communication patterns, open-weight models exhibited performance drops of up to 22.3 percentage points compared to ideal instructions. This revealed a critical gap and even danger for real-world applications, especially in assistive robotics, where locally deployable models are necessary due to privacy concerns and connectivity constraints. To mitigate this issue, we proposed the Context-Aware Retrieval from Experience (CARE) method, which retrieves relevant previously resolved tasks to provide task-specific interpretation and planning context. CARE generally outperformed standard prompting baselines across the six open-weight models, improving average task success by 18.1 percentage points over the vanilla prompt. These results highlighted the importance of both evaluating communication robustness and developing effective adaptation strategies for locally deployable assistive robots. The TALK-Dem dataset is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TALK-Dem-A6B3/.

AI.tldr: 提出TALK-Dem基准（4800条指令、5种痴呆相关交流模式×3个强度）评估LLM机器人任务规划鲁棒性，并给出CARE检索增强方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM机器人任务规划假设理想用户，指令清晰完整；但面对真实用户（尤其痴呆症患者PLWD）时易出错甚至带来物理安全风险，缺乏相应评测基准。
AI.method: 构建TALK-Dem基准，涵盖指代不精确、物体替代、空语、话题漂移、侵入五种交流模式及三个强度等级；在六个开源权重LLM上测试；提出Context-Aware Retrieval from Experience（CARE），检索既往已解决任务以提供任务特定的解释与规划上下文。
AI.result: 相比理想指令，开源模型在不同交流模式下性能下降最高达22.3个百分点；CARE在六个模型上普遍优于标准提示基线，任务成功率平均提升18.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 需重视交流鲁棒性评测，并为本地可部署的辅助机器人开发有效适应策略；TALK-Dem数据已公开。

title: Doc2LoRA Provides Decodable Representations of Scientific Ideas
summary: Representing scientific papers as points in a space lets us search for similar papers and inquire about how fields relate to one another and drive innovation. Beyond search, the vector space of papers invites generation: mixing papers through simple vector operations creates new points, mirroring combinatorial novelty, the recombination of existing ideas into new ones. However, a mixed point often represents an idea no paper has yet realized, with no papers nearby to identify the idea. We propose representing each paper by a LoRA adapter generated by the Doc-to-LoRA hypernetwork. Every point in the space, including mixtures, thus represents a large language model (LLM) open to questions and instructions in natural language. On papers from the American Physical Society (APS), we instruct the LLM at the average of each subfield to name the field in a few words and obtain labels closer to the official names than the labels of five baselines, as judged by word overlap and a panel of five LLM judges. We also ask the LLMs at points between two APS papers to write an abstract and obtain descriptions shifting from one paper to the other in step with the mixing weight. While Doc-to-LoRA is trained for generation, a small invertible transform makes the embeddings competitive for search, on par with SPECTER2 and EmbeddingGemma and close to SBERT. Because the transform is invertible, every point in the transformed space still maps back to an LLM. The embeddings thus serve both search and generation, enabling researchers to question the idea at any point in the space as a starting point for generating new ideas.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用 Doc-to-LoRA 超网络为每篇论文生成一个 LoRA 适配器，将论文表示为可查询的 LLM 坐标点；该空间既支持向量混合生成新想法，也通过可逆变换实现与 SPECTER2 等相当的检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有论文向量空间多用于检索相似论文，但简单向量运算产生的"混合点"往往对应尚不存在的新想法，附近没有论文可供解释，因而无法从该点识别或理解这一新想法。作者希望让空间中的每个点（包括混合点）本身就能以自然语言被提问和指令，从而既支持搜索又支持生成。
AI.method: 1) 用 Doc-to-LoRA 超网络为每篇论文生成对应的 LoRA 适配器，使每个空间点（含混合点）都代表一个可用自然语言询问和指令的 LLM；2) 在 APS 论文上，让位于各子领域平均点的 LLM 用几个词命名该领域；3) 让位于两篇 APS 论文之间各点的 LLM 撰写摘要，观察描述随混合权重从一个论文向另一个过渡；4) 训练目标是生成，但通过一个小的可逆变换使嵌入具备检索竞争力，并与 SPECTER2、EmbeddingGemma、SBERT 对比。
AI.result: 在命名子领域任务中，由词重叠和五位 LLM 评委评判，所得标签比五个基线更接近官方名称；在两篇 APS 论文之间的点生成摘要时，描述随混合权重同步地从一篇论文转向另一篇；经可逆变换后嵌入的检索性能与 SPECTER2、EmbeddingGemma 相当，并接近 SBERT。由于变换可逆，变换后空间中的每个点仍可映射回一个 LLM。
AI.conclusion: 该嵌入同时服务于检索与生成：研究者可以在空间中任意点对该想法进行提问，并将其作为生成新想法的起点。

title: PhyProbe: Rethinking Physical Consistency Evaluation in Generated Videos
summary: Evaluating the physical consistency of generated videos remains a fundamental challenge. Existing approaches rely on off-the-shelf vision-language models, which can often be myopic to physical dynamics, or fine-tuned evaluators trained on human annotations, which overfit to dataset-specific cues and fail to generalize. A key challenge is that existing supervision sources provide either relative ordering or absolute scores, but not both reliably and consistently across varied settings. To this end, we introduce PhyProbe, an evaluator that extracts features from a frozen pretrained spatio-temporal encoder and maps them to a scalar physical consistency violation score via a lightweight scoring head. PhyProbe is trained through a unified objective combining pairwise ranking, regression on noisy scalar annotations, and anchor-based calibration over a curated set of heterogeneous supervision sources. Experiments show that PhyProbe outperforms prior methods on most pairwise benchmarks spanning real-generated and generated-generated pairs under varying correspondence, with the largest gains in no-correspondence and generated-generated settings where existing fine-tuned evaluators degrade sharply. PhyProbe achieves strong correlation with human judgments, with close agreement between rank-based and linear metrics, indicating that scores are both well ordered and anchored to a stable [0, 1] scale. Further, despite being trained on supervision indicative of physical consistency, without explicit general-preference labels, PhyProbe also performs competitively on human preference benchmarks: consistent with the observation that physics violations are entangled with broader quality degradations.

AI.tldr: 提出 PhyProbe，用冻结的时空编码器加轻量评分头，通过统一的排序+回归+锚定校准目标训练，输出 [0,1] 的物理一致性违规分数，在多数成对评测上超越既有方法。
AI.motivation: 生成视频的物理一致性评估仍是难题：现成的视觉语言模型对物理动态"短视"，而基于人工标注微调的评估器会过拟合数据集特定线索、难以泛化。核心症结在于现有监督源只能可靠提供相对序或绝对分数之一，难以在不同设定下同时保证两者。
AI.method: PhyProbe 从冻结的预训练时空编码器抽取特征，经轻量评分头映射为标量物理一致性违规分数；训练采用统一目标，融合成对排序、对噪声标量标注的回归，以及基于锚点的校准，监督源来自一组异质数据。
AI.result: 在覆盖真实-生成与生成-生成、不同对应关系的大多数成对基准上优于先前方法，在无对应与生成-生成设定中提升最大（既有微调评估器在此显著退化）；与人类判断相关性高，排序指标与线性指标结果接近，说明分数既有序又锚定在稳定的 [0,1] 区间；在未使用显式通用偏好标签的情况下，于人类偏好基准上也具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 统一排序与绝对分数监督可得到既有序又可校准的物理一致性评估器；物理违规与更广泛的质量退化相互纠缠，因此物理一致性监督可迁移至人类偏好评测。

title: Fine-Tuning Diffusion Language Models with Context Selection and Target Weighting
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. Main text 10 pages, references and appendix follow. Project page with interactive visualizations: https://loaym.github.io/GoldiMask/
summary: Supervised fine-tuning of discrete diffusion language models masks some response tokens and trains the model to recover their original values from the visible context. The masking pattern therefore determines both the context available to the model and the tokens it learns to predict. Uniform random masking does not explicitly account for the interaction between these choices. We introduce GoldiMask, which selects tokens to reveal as context by approximately maximizing a submodular objective. This objective uses model signals to balance the benefit of revealing tokens against their value as prediction targets. GoldiMask then weights the remaining targets according to how they benefit from the selected context and their remaining learning potential. Across three backbones and three training datasets, GoldiMask achieves the highest average accuracy in most evaluated settings, demonstrating gains on both reasoning and code generation. Component ablations show that both context selection and target weighting contribute to the gains. GoldiMask also reduces decoding iterations on GSM8K and MATH-500 under confidence-threshold parallel decoding, while maintaining comparable accuracy at higher confidence thresholds.

AI.tldr: 提出GoldiMask，一种用于离散扩散语言模型监督微调的掩码策略：通过近似最大化次模目标选择上下文token，并按收益加权预测目标，在多骨干、多数据集上取得最优平均准确率，并在并行解码中减少迭代次数。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散语言模型的监督微调依赖掩码模式，而掩码模式同时决定了模型可见的上下文和需要预测的目标token。均匀随机掩码未显式考虑这两者之间的相互作用，因而次优。
AI.method: GoldiMask首先利用模型信号构建次模目标，权衡“揭示某token作为上下文的收益”与“保留其作为预测目标的价值”，从而近似最大化地选择要揭示的上下文token；随后对剩余目标token，依据其从所选上下文中获益的程度以及剩余学习潜力进行加权。
AI.result: 在三种骨干模型和三个训练数据集上，GoldiMask在多数评测设置中取得最高平均准确率，在推理与代码生成任务上均有提升；组件消融表明上下文选择与目标加权均有贡献；在GSM8K与MATH-500的置信度阈值并行解码下减少了解码迭代次数，并在较高置信度阈值下保持可比准确率。
AI.conclusion: 掩码模式的设计应显式建模上下文选择与预测目标之间的耦合关系；通过次模目标选择上下文并对目标加权，可同时提升监督微调效果与并行解码效率。

title: The Geometry of Harmfulness in Multi-Turn Attacks
summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks that circumvent safety alignment to elicit harmful outputs. It remains unclear how harmfulness and refusal representations evolve over the course of multi-turn attacks, and why single-turn defenses are less effective in multi-turn settings. This work investigates how the geometry and temporal dynamics of harmfulness and refusal representations evolve across multi-turn attacks. We analyzed hidden-state representations from three instruction-tuned LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and Gemma-2-9B-it) using three multi-turn attack frameworks (Crescendo, ActorAttack, and X-Teaming), and examined representation behavior across conversation turns, model layers, and token positions under various context configurations. Across models and frameworks, we found that (1) each attack framework traverses different geometric directions, yet each achieves comparable success in eliciting harmful outputs; (2) multi-turn harmfulness directions became increasingly linearly separable at the end-of-turn token position across turns in middle to late model layers; and (3) harmfulness representations are weakly aligned with refusal-related representations. The results indicate that multi-turn attacks do not succeed by suppressing the model's internal representation of harmfulness. Instead, harmfulness representations become increasingly separable across conversation turns, while remaining only weakly aligned with refusal-related representations. The findings are one possible explanation for why static single-turn safety probes may degrade in multi-turn settings, and suggest that robust defenses must consider temporal representation dynamics rather than identifying harmfulness with isolated or single-turn prompts.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多轮攻击中危害性与拒绝表征的几何与时间动态，发现不同攻击框架沿不同几何方向却同等有效，危害性方向在中后层EOT位置随轮次愈发线性可分，且与拒绝表征弱对齐，为单轮防御在多轮场景失效提供了解释。
AI.motivation: LLM虽经安全对齐仍易被对抗攻击绕过而输出有害内容；现有研究不清楚多轮攻击中危害性与拒绝表征如何演化，也不明白单轮防御为何在多轮场景下效果较差。
AI.method: 从三个指令微调模型（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Gemma-2-9B-it）提取隐藏状态表征，结合三种多轮攻击框架（Crescendo、ActorAttack、X-Teaming），在不同上下文配置下跨对话轮次、模型层与token位置分析表征行为。
AI.result: （1）每种攻击框架沿着不同的几何方向，但都能以相当的成功率诱导有害输出；（2）多轮危害性方向在轮末token（EOT）位置、随轮次增加，在中后层愈发线性可分；（3）危害性表征与拒绝相关表征仅弱对齐。
AI.conclusion: 多轮攻击并非通过抑制模型内部的危害性表征而成功；相反，危害性表征随轮次愈发可分，却与拒绝表征弱对齐。这解释了静态单轮安全探针在多轮场景中退化，并指出鲁棒防御需考虑时间表征动态，而非依赖孤立或单轮提示来识别危害性。

title: Team MSU GenText-Forensics Challenge 2026 Technical Report
summary: Document text forgery has evolved beyond simple pixel-level manipulation: modern attacks alter not only the appearance of a document but also its meaning, and increasingly target the OCR & LLM pipelines that consume such documents. The ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics challenge therefore requires systems that not only decide whether a multilingual text image is forged, but also localize the point of manipulation, identify the attack type, and produce a human-readable forensic report with supporting evidence. We present our solution, a decomposed chain-of-thought (CoT) pipeline that combines a document tampering detector (DTD) with two Qwen3-VL-32B vision-language models, each LoRA-adapted to a distinct sub-task. DTD produces tampering probability maps that are converted into numbered candidate regions; a first model (the Filterer) validates these regions and assigns a preliminary forgery type, while a second model (the Semantic Detective) merges and re-grounds the surviving regions, searches for purely semantic anomalies that are invisible to pixel-level detectors, and writes the final report. Both models are trained by distilling chain-of-thought traces from a privileged Qwen3-VL-235B teacher that has access to ground-truth masks and reports. Our approach secured third place in the ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics challenge. We describe the data preparation, test-time augmentation, region rendering, distillation protocol, and training configuration in detail, and report ablations over detector thresholds, prompt designs, and pipeline decompositions.

AI.tldr: 提出分解式思维链（CoT）流水线，结合文档篡改检测器（DTD）与两个LoRA微调的Qwen3-VL-32B模型，实现多语言文本图像的伪造判别、篡改定位、攻击类型识别与取证报告生成，在ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics挑战赛中获得第三名。
AI.motivation: 文档伪造已超越简单像素级篡改：现代攻击同时改变文档外观与语义，并针对消费这些文档的OCR与LLM流水线。现有方法难以同时完成伪造判定、篡改点定位、攻击类型识别及可解释取证报告生成，因此该挑战赛要求系统具备上述综合能力。
AI.method: 采用分解式思维链（CoT）流水线：DTD生成篡改概率图并转化为带编号的候选区域；第一个模型（Filterer）验证候选区域并给出初步伪造类型；第二个模型（Semantic Detective）对保留区域进行合并与重定位，搜索像素级检测器无法发现的纯语义异常并撰写最终报告。两个模型通过从可访问真值掩码与报告的Qwen3-VL-235B特权教师模型蒸馏CoT轨迹进行训练，并采用数据准备、测试时增强、区域渲染与蒸馏协议。
AI.result: 在ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics挑战赛中获得第三名。同时报告了针对检测器阈值、提示设计及流水线分解方式的消融实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 分解式CoT流水线配合LoRA微调的多模态模型与特权教师蒸馏，能够有效应对兼顾外观篡改与语义篡改、并面向OCR/LLM流水线的文档伪造任务，验证了检测器与语义侦测器分工协作、区域级验证与重定位设计的有效性。

title: Evaluating Whether LLMs Can Reliably Connect the DOTs?
summary: Access to real-world information is often noisy and fragmented. Constructing a coherent narrative from such fragments requires models to reconstruct missing spans within a broader storyline, commonly referred to as text infilling, while preserving consistency with both the local context and the global storyline. Despite using text infilling as a pre-training objective in many Large Language Models (LLMs), their actual performance on real-world narrative infilling remains underexplored. In this paper, we address this gap by introducing a multi-domain benchmark of ~9.2K instances for narrative infilling, constructed by masking one to three sentences across four narrative types: encyclopedic text, commonsense stories, news articles, and visual narratives. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 20 instruction-tuned open-source LLMs ranging from 1.5B to 70B parameters across varying levels of instruction specificity and reasoning guidance. Outputs are assessed using standard automatic metrics and a qualitative framework covering five narrative dimensions. Results show that model scale does not reliably predict infilling quality: Gemma-2-2B achieves the highest qualitative score (4.02/5), outperforming models over ten times larger, including DeepSeek-Qwen-32B (3.77/5, 6.6%) and LLaMA-3.3-70B (3.71/5, 8.3%). We further find that explicit reasoning offers limited benefits as chain-of-thought reasoning yields only a marginal improvement (+0.6%). Additionally, short narratives and domain characteristics emerge as stronger predictors of task difficulty than infill position alone for narrative infilling in current LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个约9.2K实例的多领域叙事文本填充基准，评估20个开源指令微调LLM，发现模型规模并不能可靠预测填充质量，显式推理收益有限，叙事长度与领域特性比填充位置更能决定任务难度。
AI.motivation: 现实世界信息常呈噪声化与碎片化，从碎片重建连贯叙事需要模型在整体故事线中填补缺失片段（text infilling），并同时保持局部上下文与全局故事线的一致性。尽管许多LLM将文本填充作为预训练目标，但其在真实叙事填充任务上的实际表现仍缺乏系统探究，因此需要建立专门基准加以评估。
AI.method: 构建约9.2K实例的多领域叙事填充基准，覆盖四类叙事：百科文本、常识故事、新闻文章、视觉叙事，通过遮蔽1至3个句子生成填充任务。评估20个指令微调开源LLM（1.5B至70B参数），设置不同指令具体程度与推理引导水平；采用标准自动指标以及涵盖五个叙事维度的定性评估框架进行打分。
AI.result: 模型规模并不能可靠预测填充质量：Gemma-2-2B取得最高定性得分（4.02/5），优于规模十倍以上的模型，如DeepSeek-Qwen-32B（3.77/5，低6.6%）与LLaMA-3.3-70B（3.71/5，低8.3%）。显式推理收益有限，思维链仅带来约+0.6%的边际提升。此外，叙事长度较短与领域特性是比填充位置更强的任务难度预测因素。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在真实叙事填充上表现与模型规模不成正比，显式推理引导作用有限，任务难度更多由叙事长度和领域特性决定。研究提示应重视基准构建与领域自适应，而非单纯依赖参数扩展或思维链提示来提升叙事填充能力。

title: ArgGYM: A Procedural, Engine-Verified Benchmark for Structured Defeasible Reasoning
summary: Recent progress in large language model reasoning has been driven by benchmarks and reinforcement learning environments with automatically verifiable rewards, particularly in mathematics, code, and formal logic. These settings make model accuracy easier to evaluate and optimize, but it remains unclear how far success under fixed problem specifications and stable evaluation criteria transfers to reasoning outside such domains. Real-world reasoning often proceeds under incomplete and revisable information: conclusions may be supported provisionally, defeated by counter-evidence, reinstated by further arguments, or revised when stronger reasons become available. Reasoning of this kind is generally referred to as defeasible reasoning. We introduce ArgGYM, a procedural benchmark and RLVR-compatible training environment for structured defeasible reasoning. ArgGYM decomposes this reasoning into twelve tasks and grounds task-specific scoring in a symbolic argumentation engine that computes the formal states used to evaluate model outputs. It includes a frozen benchmark of 1,440 verified instances across fifteen curriculum configurations, two argument preference orderings (weakest-link and last-link), and two set orderings (elitist and democratic), while the same generators and verifiers can produce fresh instances for evaluation that reduces dependence on static test sets and for verifiable-reward training. On the frozen benchmark, frontier and open-weight models show sharply different reasoning profiles: they can recover substantial parts of structured answers without solving the complete task, and performance declines in later curriculum configurations with longer dependencies and more interacting structures. We release the benchmark, generators, and verifiers for reproducible evaluation and RLVR training.

AI.tldr: 提出ArgGYM：一个面向可废止推理（defeasible reasoning）的程序化基准与RLVR兼容训练环境，将推理分解为12类任务，由符号论证引擎计算形式状态并评分；含1440条验证实例、15种课程配置、两类偏好序与集合序，支持生成新实例以降低对静态测试集的依赖，并可用于可验证奖励训练。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理进展主要依赖数学、代码、形式逻辑等领域中"问题规格固定、评价标准稳定"的基准与可自动验证奖励的强化学习环境，这类设定便于评估与优化准确率，但难以说明其成功能否迁移到此类领域之外的推理。真实世界推理常在信息不完整且可修正的条件下进行：结论可被暂时支持、被反证击败、被进一步论证恢复，或在出现更强理由时被修正，即"可废止推理"，目前缺乏系统化的评测与训练手段。
AI.method: 1) 构建ArgGYM程序化基准与RLVR兼容训练环境，面向结构化可废止推理；2) 将该推理分解为十二类任务，并基于符号论证引擎计算的形式状态（formal states）进行任务特定评分；3) 基准包含1440条已验证实例，覆盖15种课程配置、两种论证偏好序（weakest-link与last-link）以及两种集合序（elitist与democratic）；4) 同一套生成器与验证器可持续生成新实例，既用于减少对静态测试集依赖的评估，也用于可验证奖励训练。
AI.result: 在冻结基准上，前沿模型与开源权重模型呈现显著不同的推理特征：它们能在未完整求解任务的情况下恢复相当部分结构化答案，且在依赖更长、结构交互更多的后续课程配置中性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 作者发布基准、生成器与验证器，以支持可复现评估与RLVR训练；同时指出当前模型在可废止推理上的能力不完整，随依赖链加长与结构交互增强而退化。

title: VidHarness: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Cost-Efficient Long Video Understanding
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer questions about hour-long videos, but processing every frame is prohibitively expensive, even though the evidence for a question usually spans only a few seconds. Video agents, i.e., harness programs wrapped around a frozen VLM, address this by observing the video selectively, yet existing harnesses are hand-crafted by experts through slow build-and-test cycles. We propose VidHarness, a framework that automates harness design for cost-efficient long video understanding, in which a harness proposer iteratively evolves harnesses based on execution feedback from an evolution environment. To escape the local optima of greedy refinement, we organize the evolution as Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS), and to reduce the evaluation cost, we integrate uncertainty-aware multi-fidelity validation, which screens new harnesses on a few questions and promotes only the promising ones. Since the best harness varies with the frame budget, we further introduce a mixture-of-harness that routes each question to a harness specialized for its budget. VidHarness sets new state-of-the-art results on LongVideoBench, Video-MME, and Video-Holmes, outperforms the strongest hand-crafted video agent by up to $11.2$ points, and generalizes to the knowledge-intensive benchmarks Video-MMMU and MMVU with fewer than half of the frames of uniform sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出VidHarness框架，将视频智能体的harness设计自动化，通过MCTS演化与不确定性感知多保真验证实现低成本长视频理解，并引入mixture-of-harness按帧预算路由，在多个基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 长视频中回答问题所需证据通常仅持续数秒，但逐帧处理全部帧代价过高；现有视频智能体harness依赖专家手工构建，需经历缓慢的build-and-test循环，效率低且难以优化。
AI.method: VidHarness用harness proposer基于演化环境的执行反馈迭代演化harness；将演化组织为蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）以跳出贪心精炼的局部最优；引入不确定性感知的多保真验证，用少量问题筛选新harness，仅提升有潜力的候选；并在最优harness随帧预算变化的情况下，提出mixture-of-harness为每个问题路由到适配其预算的专用harness。
AI.result: 在LongVideoBench、Video-MME和Video-Holmes上创下新的SOTA，比最强手工视频智能体最高提升11.2分；并泛化到知识密集型基准Video-MMMU与MMVU，所用帧数不到均匀采样的一半。
AI.conclusion: 自动化harness设计可有效替代专家手工构建，结合MCTS搜索、多保真验证与按预算路由的混合harness，能够在显著降低帧成本的同时提升长视频理解性能并具备跨基准泛化能力。

title: Colorectal Cancer Segmentation with Adaptive Augmentation and Multi-Resolution Ensemble Models
comment: SPIE Eighteenth International Conference on Machine Vision (ICMV 2025), Paris, France
summary: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is the second most deadly and third most common cancer, and the leading cause of death among gastrointestinal cancers. Early diagnosis is crucial for the treatment of this cancer and increasing the survival rates. Although CRC is more common in developed regions, its occurrence is also increasing in developing regions as well. CRC diagnosis relies on histopathology assessment post-biopsy. Automated deep learning algorithms can significantly reduce diagnosis time, enhancing efficiency and supporting timely clinical decisions. We present an automated segmentation pipeline for whole-slide histopathology images that labels tumor grades 1-3 and normal mucosa. It utilizes dense prediction transformers with various encoder backbones, overlapping patches, and test-time augmentation. An adaptive augmentation policy, guided by large language models, further improves training. Top models were ensembled via soft voting, and mask refining post-processing steps, Gaussian blurring, morphological closing, and connected components analysis. On a colorectal cancer grade dataset, our method improved the F1 score from 62.92 to 69.84. Code is available here: github.com/caglarmert/ICIP2025

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种全切片结直肠癌组织病理图像自动分割流水线，结合密集预测Transformer、重叠分块、测试时增强及LLM引导的自适应增强策略，实现对肿瘤1-3级与正常黏膜的分割，F1由62.92提升至69.84。
AI.motivation: 结直肠癌是致死率第二、发病率第三的癌症，也是胃肠道肿瘤的首要死因；早期诊断对治疗和生存率提升至关重要。临床诊断依赖活检后的组织病理学评估，流程耗时，因此需要自动化的深度学习诊断方法以提高效率并支持及时的临床决策。
AI.method: 构建全切片组织病理图像的自动分割流水线：采用密集预测Transformer（dense prediction transformers）搭配多种编码器骨干网络；使用重叠分块（overlapping patches）与测试时增强（test-time augmentation）；引入由大语言模型引导的自适应增强策略（adaptive augmentation policy）改进训练；对表现最佳的模型通过软投票（soft voting）集成；并采用掩膜精炼后处理，包括高斯模糊、形态学闭运算和连通组件分析。
AI.result: 在结直肠癌分级数据集上，该方法将F1分数从62.92提升至69.84。代码已开源于 github.com/caglarmert/ICIP2025。
AI.conclusion: 该自动化分割流水线可有效提升结直肠癌组织病理分级的诊断效率与准确性，验证了Transformer架构、LLM引导增强及多模型集成与后处理策略在该任务中的有效性。

title: What Was Said, Not What Was 'Thought': Type-6 Logic for CoT Verification
summary: We introduce Type-6 logic, a variant of dynamic epistemic logic augmented with two operators (uncertainty and recurrence), designed to model the inferential dynamics of contemporary large language model (LLM) chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. Type-6 accounts for common LLM reasoning pathologies such as unlicensed revision, enthymemes, loopbacks, and unverifiable/incorrect claims. We propose a verifier based on Type-6 logic that builds a graph out the trace, and checks it against Type-6's axioms and inference rules. We evaluate our framework on LLM-generated CoTs four splits spanning formal and informal reasoning. Our verifier detects structurally unsound reasoning steps that surface-level heuristics miss, and allows for easy visualisation of the model's reasoning process. In our corpus, our verifier shows that derived contradiction is the most common hard-fail category in CoT, and that only about 3\% of the propositions of a trace have impact on the final derivation. Ablation studies show that other verification methods (LLMs-as-judges, other neurosymbolic approaches, etc.) cannot be considered interchangeable: for example, agreement between LLMs-as-judges and LINC is $κ\approx 0.034$, and this persists within a method across underlying models. Type-6, however, is the most agreed-with method amongst the ones we tested. We prove our verifier runs on average-case linear time; and release our logic specification and artefacts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Type-6 逻辑，一种在动态认知逻辑基础上加入"不确定性"与"递推"两个算子的变体，用于刻画当代大语言模型（LLM）思维链（CoT）推理的推理动态，并基于该逻辑构造验证器对 CoT 轨迹进行结构校验。
AI.motivation: LLM 的 CoT 推理常出现无授权修正、省略论证（enthymeme）、回环、不可验证或错误主张等病理现象，而表层启发式方法难以捕捉这些结构性缺陷，现有验证手段（LLM-as-judge、其他神经符号方法）之间是否可互换也缺乏系统检验。
AI.method: 提出含不确定性算子与递推算子的 Type-6 动态认知逻辑变体，用以形式化 LLM 推理中的上述病理；基于该逻辑设计验证器，将推理轨迹构建为图结构，并依据 Type-6 的公理与推理规则进行校验；在覆盖形式与非形式推理的四个 CoT 数据划分上评估，并开展消融研究对比 LLM-as-judge、LINC 等神经符号方法；同时给出复杂度证明。
AI.result: 验证器可检出表层启发式遗漏的结构性不健全推理步骤，并便于可视化推理过程；在语料中"导出矛盾"是最常见的硬失败类别，且轨迹中仅约 3% 命题对最终推导有影响；消融实验表明不同验证方法不可互换，例如 LLM-as-judge 与 LINC 的一致性仅 κ≈0.034，且该方法间差异在同一底层模型内依然存在；Type-6 在受测方法中一致度最高。验证器被证明具有平均情况线性时间复杂度。
AI.conclusion: Type-6 逻辑为 LLM 思维链推理提供了可形式化、可自动校验且高效的分析框架，能揭示表层方法忽略的结构缺陷并量化推理中真正起作用的命题比例；不同验证范式不可简单互替，而 Type-6 在所测方法中一致性最高。作者公开了逻辑规范与相关工件。

title: LoopVL: Recurrent Visual Intelligence
summary: We introduce LoopVL to study whether Loop Transformers can be effectively extended to vision- language models. LoopVL combines Module-Loop and Model-Loop computation to iteratively update a unified vision-language state through shared modules. We train LoopVL from scratch through language pre-training, multimodal training, and post-training. LoopVL outperforms a range of similarly sized and larger non-recurrent models on multimodal understanding and visual reasoning benchmarks. We also observe Visual Aha Moments in LoopVL, characterized by pronounced shifts in visual attention across loops. LoopVL provides practical evidence for recurrent vision-language modeling and offers an intuitive perspective on how shared parameters can support deeper multimodal computation over continuously evolving visual-language states.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LoopVL，探索循环Transformer在视觉-语言模型中的可行性；通过模块循环与模型循环的共享参数迭代更新统一多模态状态，并在多模态理解与视觉推理任务上超越同级及更大规模的非循环模型，同时观察到"视觉顿悟时刻"现象。
AI.motivation: 循环（recurrent）结构在语言模型中已展现深层计算的潜力，但其能否有效迁移到视觉-语言模型中尚缺乏验证。作者希望探究共享参数是否能够支撑更深的跨模态推理，以及循环机制在统一视觉-语言状态上的表现。
AI.method: LoopVL将Module-Loop（模块循环）与Model-Loop（模型循环）计算相结合，通过共享模块对统一的视觉-语言状态进行迭代更新。模型从零开始训练，经历语言预训练、多模态训练和后训练三个阶段。
AI.result: LoopVL在多模态理解与视觉推理基准上超过了一系列规模相当甚至更大的非循环模型。此外，作者观察到LoopVL出现"视觉顿悟时刻"（Visual Aha Moments），表现为视觉注意力在不同循环轮次间发生显著转移。
AI.conclusion: LoopVL为循环视觉-语言建模提供了实践性证据，并给出共享参数如何支持在持续演化的视觉-语言状态上进行更深层多模态计算的直观视角。

title: Policy-Conditioned AI-Use Detection: An Evidentiary Framework for Academic Publishing
summary: Major venues now publish detailed rules about how authors, reviewers, and area chairs may use AI, and those rules differ by role, by task, and by what must be disclosed. AI detection, the instrument usually proposed to enforce them, estimates something else: whether an AI model wrote the text. We argue that this target is misaligned with the decisions conferences and journals face, and propose policy-conditioned AI-use detection, an evidentiary framework for assessing whether a human--AI workflow complied with a stated rule. Policy makes the governing rule an explicit input. Inference reports hypotheses, evidence, calibration regime, and uncertainty in place of verdicts such as "AI detected". Evaluation builds benchmarks from reproducible pipelines that generate compliant and non-compliant workflows, and reports true positive rate at a false positive rate the venue fixes in advance. We work the framework through peer review, where at plausible violation rates a detector at a strong operating point still flags more compliant authors than violating ones. The framework therefore also names what a venue must instrument: structured disclosure, approved-tool routing that respects reviewer confidentiality, and a path by which a finding can be contested. Under this framing a detector is not an authorship classifier but an auditable procedure with an error rate the venue fixes in advance and can defend.

AI.tldr: 论文指出当前"AI检测"（判断文本是否由AI生成）与会议/期刊实际需要裁决的"作者是否遵守了既定AI使用规则"这一决策目标错位，提出"政策条件化的AI使用检测"（policy-conditioned AI-use detection）框架：把政策规则作为显式输入，以假设、证据、校准机制与不确定性取代"检测到AI"式裁决，并用可复现流程构建合规/违规工作流基准、按会场预先固定的假阳性率报告真阳性率。
AI.motivation: 主要会议与期刊已发布针对作者、审稿人、领域主席的细致AI使用规则，且规则因角色、任务与披露要求而异。然而用于执行这些规则的工具——AI检测——实际估计的是"文本是否由AI模型撰写"，这与会场真正面临的决策（某人类—AI工作流是否遵守了某条明确规则）并不一致，导致检测结论无法直接支撑纪律处分或合规判定。
AI.method: 提出政策条件化的AI使用检测框架：1）将治理规则作为显式输入，使推断目标由"作者身份"转为"规则合规性"；2）推断输出假设、证据、校准机制与不确定性，而非"AI detected"式二元裁决；3）用可复现管线生成合规与非合规工作流，据此构建评测基准；4）按会场事先固定的假阳性率报告真阳性率（TPR@固定FPR）。作者以同行评审为场景对该框架进行推演。
AI.result: 在同行评审场景下推演显示：即便检测器处于强操作点，在合理的违规率水平下，被标记的合规作者数量仍多于违规作者；即高精度检测器在低违规率环境下产生大量误伤。框架进一步指出会场必须配套建设的三项机制：结构化披露、尊重审稿人保密性的经批准工具路由，以及可供被指控者申诉的路径。
AI.conclusion: 在该重构视角下，检测器不应被视为作者身份分类器，而应被理解为一种可审计的程序：其错误率由会场事先固定并可为其辩护。政策条件化检测把合规判定从"文本像不像AI"转为"是否满足明示规则"，从而与会议和期刊实际面临的决策对齐，并明确了会场需要投入的制度性基础设施。

title: MOBA-VL: Event-Localized Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning for Real-Time MOBA Commentary
summary: Real-time commentary for Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA) esports requires a vision-language model (VLM) to narrate a live match second by second, both fluently and accurately. Existing streaming VLMs sound natural but often miss key events such as kills and objectives. To address this limitation, we use game telemetry, which records exactly when each event occurs, as a supervision signal. We introduce MOBA-VL, a 9B-parameter model trained on this signal with event-localized multi-turn reinforcement learning, which rewards the turns that describe each event. We also collect MOBACast, 860 professional matches (about 460 hours) across three MOBA games with word-level timestamped commentary, and MOBACast-Bench, a benchmark from held-out tournaments. On MOBACast-Bench, MOBA-VL achieves the highest Overall score on full matches (63.25 vs. 55.12 for StreamingVLM) and clips (63.45 vs. 56.22 for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash). Event-localized credit also raises event recall from 34.5 to 42.1 over supervised fine-tuning. Code and data will be released, and demos are available on an anonymous project page at https://moba-vl.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MOBA-VL，利用游戏遥测作为监督信号，结合事件定位的多轮强化学习训练9B视觉语言模型，实现MOBA电竞赛事实时解说，并构建MOBACast数据集与基准。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视觉语言模型生成解说虽流畅却常漏掉关键事件（如击杀、目标争夺），缺乏准确性。MOBA实时解说需要逐秒兼具流畅性与准确性的叙述能力。
AI.method: 以记录事件发生时刻的游戏遥测作为监督信号，提出MOBA-VL（9B参数模型），采用事件定位的多轮强化学习，对描述各事件的对话轮次给予奖励；同时收集MOBACast数据集（3款MOBA游戏、860场职业比赛、约460小时、词级时间戳解说）及MOBACast-Bench基准。
AI.result: 在MOBACast-Bench上，MOBA-VL在完整比赛（63.25 对 55.12，优于StreamingVLM）和片段（63.45 对 56.22，优于DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）均取得最高Overall分数；事件定位奖励机制将事件召回率从34.5提升至42.1（相较监督微调）。
AI.conclusion: 游戏遥测信号与事件定位强化学习可有效提升流式解说模型对关键事件的捕捉能力，代码与数据将开源，并提供了演示页面。

title: BIND: Binding 3D Robot Actions to 2D Image Features
summary: We introduce BIND, a new action representation for visuomotor robot policies that binds 3D robot actions to their corresponding 2D image features, yielding strong data efficiency gains and robustness to out-of-distribution object positions and camera viewpoints. The action heads of current robot policies are typically formulated as an MLP regression from a single global feature vector produced by a pre-trained vision encoder. This global formulation requires the policy network to discover, from demonstrations alone, the relationship between target robot actions and the image features they project onto. The consequence is that although modern image features are semantically descriptive, spatially robust, and even multiview-consistent, the policies built on them are brittle to subtle changes in camera viewpoint and object placement--and surprisingly data-inefficient. BIND closes this gap by supplying the action-feature relationship through camera geometry rather than learning: it discretizes a volume of candidate end effector positions, attaches each candidate to the pre-trained features at its projection in each camera view, and selects actions by scoring each candidate's position and image-bound feature combination. On a real robot, we study data efficiency and out-of-distribution robustness to unseen object positions and camera viewpoints, as well as general long-horizon task execution and dexterity. We find BIND to be highly data-efficient and robust: it achieves near-perfect success on tasks with as few as 5 demonstrations, and degrades gracefully under steep camera-viewpoint shifts and held-out object positions where coordinate-regression baselines completely fail.

AI.tldr: BIND提出一种将3D机器人动作与其在2D图像上的投影特征相绑定的动作表征，通过相机几何而非学习来建立动作-特征关系，在真实机器人上实现高数据效率与对分布外物体位置和视角的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉运动策略的动作头通常是从预训练视觉编码器输出的单一全局特征向量做MLP回归。这种全局形式要求策略网络仅从演示中自行发现目标机器人动作与其投影到的图像特征之间的关系。其后果是：尽管现代图像特征语义丰富、空间鲁棒甚至多视角一致，但基于它们的策略对相机视角和物体位置的细微变化很脆弱，且数据效率出乎意料地低。
AI.method: BIND通过相机几何而非学习来提供动作-特征关系。具体做法是：离散化一个候选末端执行器位置的体积/体素空间，将每个候选位置与预训练特征在各相机视角下其投影位置处的特征相关联，然后通过对每个候选的位置及其图像绑定特征组合进行评分来选择动作。
AI.result: 在真实机器人上研究了数据效率、对未见物体位置与相机视角的分布外鲁棒性，以及长时程任务执行与灵巧性。BIND高度数据高效且鲁棒：在少至5个演示的任务上达到接近完美的成功率，并在相机视角剧烈变化和留出物体位置下优雅退化，而坐标回归基线则完全失败。
AI.conclusion: 将动作与图像特征通过相机几何显式绑定，而非依赖网络从演示中隐式学习，可显著提升视觉运动策略的数据效率与对分布外位姿和视角的鲁棒性。

title: Audible World Models: Spatially Aware Sound Generation for 3D Worlds
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Text- and image-conditioned world generators can create visually rich 3D environments, yet these worlds often remain silent or rely on soundtracks synthesized solely from text or rendered video. Although such audio can convey what should be heard, it lacks an explicit representation of where sound sources are located and how their perceived sound should vary with listener movement. We introduce Audible World Models, a training-free framework that incorporates sound into the generated world state. Starting from a text prompt, our system constructs a panoramic 3D proxy, separates it into semantic layers, identifies sound-producing foreground objects and ambient background regions, and synthesizes dry audio for each sound label. It then anchors these sources to reconstructed geometry and renders listener-dependent spatial audio using geometric acoustic propagation. By explicitly linking semantics, geometry, and sound propagation, the framework maintains persistent source locations while adapting the rendered audio to changes in listener viewpoint and motion. Experiments across 80 generated scenes demonstrate substantial gains in spatial consistency over text-, video-, and panorama-conditioned baselines, while preserving competitive semantic alignment. VLM-based assessments and human evaluations further indicate that our soundtracks are preferred for their audio-visual consistency, spatial plausibility, and motion-dependent behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出 Audible World Models，一个免训练框架，将声音显式融入生成的世界状态中，实现与听众视角和运动相关的空间音频渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有文本/图像条件的世界生成器能创建视觉丰富的3D环境，但世界往往无声，或仅依赖由文本或渲染视频合成的音轨。这类音频虽能表达"应听到什么"，却缺乏对声源位置的显式表示，也无法体现声音随听众移动的变化。
AI.method: 从文本提示出发构建全景3D代理，将其分离为语义层，识别发声前景物体与环境背景区域，并为每个声音标签合成干音频；随后将声源锚定到重建几何，并利用几何声学传播渲染听众相关的空间音频。
AI.result: 在80个生成场景上的实验表明，空间一致性相较文本、视频和全景条件基线有显著提升，同时保持有竞争力的语义对齐；基于VLM的评估与人工评价显示音轨在视听一致性、空间合理性和运动相关行为上更受偏好。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式关联语义、几何与声音传播，该框架在保持声源位置持久性的同时，使渲染音频适配听众视角和运动变化，验证了将声音纳入世界状态表示的有效性。

title: What Pretraining and Midtraining Make Learnable from Rewards?
summary: A reward can identify a correct answer while leaving the computation needed for new inputs undetermined. We study how pretraining and midtraining supply the information and computation that make reward adaptation effective. In sequential state computation and contextual memory, we characterize mechanisms that agree on every training reward yet demand different held-out answers. Task-independent source observations resolve this ambiguity. We construct finite sampled Adam paths from specified random initializations through source prediction and reward adaptation in the same parameters, proving how prediction acquires execution or retrieval and rewards learn their task-specific use. Experiments with pretrained Qwen2.5 checkpoints test this division of labor. Across eight worlds, Sequential models trained with correct source and first-operation supervision reach 82.61% success, versus 44.15% for a private-random source control. Memory replay preserves retrieval during reward adaptation, and an independent eight-world confirmation achieves 75.32% task success versus 49.86% after matched alternative-retrieval training. GSM8K and HotpotQA separate accuracy at reward entry, subsequent gain and final performance. Together, these results connect information acquisition, executable computation and reward-guided task learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究预训练与中训练如何提供信息与计算能力，使奖励适配有效，并区分了"预测获取可执行计算/检索机制"与"奖励学习其任务特定用法"的分工。
AI.motivation: 奖励只能标识正确答案，却无法确定新输入所需的计算过程。同一训练奖励下可能存在多种机制，它们对训练集一致但在留出集上给出不同答案，因此需要理解预训练与中训练如何为奖励适配提供必要的信息与计算。
AI.method: 在序列状态计算与上下文记忆中刻画对训练奖励一致但留出答案不同的机制，用任务无关的源观测消解歧义；构造从指定随机初始化出发、在同一参数中经源预测与奖励适配的有限采样Adam路径，证明预测如何获得执行或检索能力、奖励如何学习其任务特定用法；用预训练Qwen2.5检查点及GSM8K、HotpotQA进行实验验证。
AI.result: 八个世界中，使用正确源与首操作监督的Sequential模型成功率达82.61%，而私有随机源对照仅44.15%；记忆回放在奖励适配中保持检索能力，独立八世界确认达75.32%任务成功，匹配的替代检索训练仅49.86%；GSM8K与HotpotQA在奖励进入时准确率、后续增益和最终性能上呈现分离。
AI.conclusion: 结果将信息获取、可执行计算与奖励引导的任务学习联系起来，说明源预测提供执行或检索机制、奖励则学习其任务特定用法，二者分工共同决定奖励适配的有效性。

title: Reach Into The CHOIR: Free-List Elicitation Uncovers Distinct Model Voices in LLM Ensembles
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the Third Conference on Language Modeling (COLM 2026)
summary: Open-ended LLM homogeneity can create false plurality when several systems appear to offer independent perspectives while returning the same familiar default. Single-pass answers obscure the distinction between agreement produced by a tightly constrained answer space, prompt-vocabulary echo, and broader answer spaces with stable alternatives beneath the surface. We introduce CHOIR (Collective Hierarchically-Ordered Inquiry Responses), a framework that adapts free-list elicitation from cognitive anthropology to LLM ensembles. CHOIR repeatedly elicits ranked lists, clusters items into prompt-level concepts, and measures concept salience across models, prompt variants, and persona conditions. We evaluate CHOIR on Infinity-Chat 100, an external prompt bank from recent work on open-ended model homogeneity, and on a 27-question targeted diagnostic bank designed to isolate mechanism-level contrasts. On Infinity-Chat 100, CHOIR reproduces high surface agreement (93/100 prompts above chance) while separating narrow prompts from broad prompts with recoverable depth. Across targeted probes and the external prompt bank, base-model identity remains the strongest recoverable signature, and persona prompts shift surfaced concepts within base-model signatures. A source-blind ranking module prioritises rare-but-stable candidates for later inspection. CHOIR turns open-ended homogeneity into a diagnostic measurement problem by asking where models converge, why they converge, and what remains reachable under structured depth probing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CHOIR框架，借鉴认知人类学的自由列举法，通过反复引出排序列表、聚类为提示级概念并测量跨模型/提示变体/人格条件的显著性，将开放式LLM同质性转化为可诊断的测量问题。
AI.motivation: 开放式LLM同质性会造成"虚假多元"：多个系统看似提供独立观点，实则返回相同默认答案。单次生成无法区分"受限答案空间导致的趋同""提示词词汇回响"与"表层之下仍存在稳定替代项的广阔答案空间"，因此需要新的测量方法。
AI.method: CHOIR（Collective Hierarchically-Ordered Inquiry Responses）将认知人类学的自由列举（free-list）引出法适配到LLM集成：反复引出排序列表，将条目聚类为提示级概念，并在模型、提示变体和人格条件下测量概念显著性。在Infinity-Chat 100（外部提示库）与27题针对性诊断库上评估；另设源盲排序模块，优先筛选稀有但稳定的候选概念。
AI.result: 在Infinity-Chat 100上复现出高表层一致性（100个提示中93个高于随机水平），同时区分出窄提示与可恢复深度的宽提示；在针对性探针与外部提示库中，基座模型身份始终是最强的可恢复签名，人格提示在基座签名内改变表层概念；源盲排序模块能优先选出稀有但稳定的候选。
AI.conclusion: CHOIR把开放式同质性转化为诊断性测量问题：模型在哪里趋同、为何趋同、以及在结构化深度探测下什么仍然可达。

title: TrafficSignBench: Rule-Centric Closed-Loop Evaluation of Traffic-Sign Compliance in Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving planners are typically evaluated using aggregate metrics such as driving score, destination rate, and collision rate, which do not explicitly measure compliance with traffic rules. As a result, planners can achieve high benchmark scores while still exhibiting unsafe or illegal behaviors, limiting their applicability to real-world deployment. To address this gap, we introduce TrafficSignBench, a large-scale, traffic sign-centric benchmark for systematic and interpretable evaluation of traffic-rule compliance in autonomous driving. Our framework combines real-map-based simulation for realistic road layouts with rule-targeted procedural scenario generation for scalable and balanced coverage of underrepresented rules. We implement traffic rules corresponding to 34 traffic signs, each equipped with an automatic rule checker for detecting violations during closed-loop execution. This design yields 29,000 diverse road scenes and 29 distinct testing scenario types, enabling controlled evaluation of rule-specific planner behavior. We construct 5,800 testing scenes and demonstrate that current autonomous driving planners can exhibit poor traffic-rule compliance despite strong performance on standard evaluation metrics. To address this limitation, we transform existing planners into rule-compliant trajectory experts via explicit traffic-sign constraints, enabling scalable generation of high-quality oracle trajectories for fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrafficSignBench，一个以交通标志为核心的大规模基准，用于系统且可解释地评估自动驾驶规划器的交通规则合规性，并揭示现有规划器在标准指标高分下仍违规的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶规划器评价多依赖驾驶得分、到达率、碰撞率等聚合指标，无法显式衡量交通规则合规性，导致规划器可能高分但存在不安全或违法行为，限制其实际部署。
AI.method: 结合真实地图仿真与规则导向的程序化场景生成，实现34种交通标志对应的交通规则，每种配备自动规则检查器以在闭环执行中检测违规；构建29,000个道路场景与29类测试场景，并从中构造5,800个测试场景；同时通过显式交通标志约束，将现有规划器转化为合规轨迹专家以生成高质量oracle轨迹用于微调。
AI.result: 实现大规模、可解释的规则合规评估，覆盖不足规则并保持平衡；在5,800个测试场景中验证当前规划器尽管标准指标表现良好，交通规则合规性仍较差；并可通过约束生成oracle轨迹支持微调。
AI.conclusion: TrafficSignBench填补交通规则合规评估空白，暴露现有规划器合规性不足，并提供可扩展的合规轨迹生成方案以提升规划器规则遵从能力。

title: Does Gradient Conflict Predict the Understanding--Generation Trade-off? A Controlled Audit of Conflict-Metric Validity in Unified Multimodal Models
comment: 23 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) are increasingly designed around gradient conflict between understanding and generation objectives. The premise that reducing these metrics improves the downstream understanding-generation trade-off has never been tested directly. We audit it in a controlled testbed, GRIDUMM, which mirrors key structural ingredients of UMM training while making the ground-truth trade-off exactly computable. Across 63 configurations and 372 measured checkpoints, no directional conflict metric reaches an absolute Spearman correlation of 0.3 with a confidence interval excluding zero for conflict measured during training against the eventual trade-off. A dose-response intervention that monotonically suppresses conflict leaves the trade-off flat, separating correlation from causation. The norm ratio is a generation-failure detector and becomes null among configurations that master generation. Functional interference measures outperform directional conflict metrics, while training loss tracks the trade-off strongly. Our results do not show that conflict is useless; they show that its validity as a diagnostic target must be established, not assumed, and we release the audit protocol as a reusable standard.

AI.tldr: 该文通过可控测试床 GRIDUMM 审计"梯度冲突指标可诊断理解-生成权衡"这一前提，发现方向性冲突指标与最终权衡几乎不相关，抑制冲突也不改变权衡。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMM）的设计日益围绕理解与生成目标之间的梯度冲突展开，但"降低这些冲突指标即可改善下游理解-生成权衡"这一前提从未被直接验证。
AI.method: 构建可控测试床 GRIDUMM，复现 UMM 训练的关键结构要素，同时使真实权衡可精确计算；在 63 种配置、372 个 checkpoint 上测量方向性冲突指标与最终权衡的相关性，并进行单调抑制冲突的剂量-反应干预实验。
AI.result: 没有任何方向性冲突指标的 Spearman 相关系数绝对值达到 0.3，且置信区间不含零；剂量-反应干预使冲突单调下降，但权衡保持平坦，分离了相关性与因果性。范数比仅在生成失败时有效，在已掌握生成的配置中失效；功能性干扰度量优于方向性冲突指标，而训练损失与权衡强相关。
AI.conclusion: 梯度冲突并非无用，但其作为诊断目标的有效性必须被实证检验而非默认假设；论文发布审计协议作为可复用标准。

title: PAMI: Part Anchored Motion for Text to Human-Object Interaction Generation
summary: Text-conditioned full-body human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires synthesizing human motion and object trajectories that match the input text while remaining precisely coordinated over time. Most methods represent the human and object as separate trajectories and predict the global human-object couplings. Learning this complex, dynamically changing relationship implicitly, however, often yields object drift, missed contact, and penetration. We introduce PAMI, a Part-Anchored Motion framework for Interaction generation. Inspired by the classic Hough Transform, our key idea is to localize object motion by letting body-part anchors vote for it: we express object motion relative to multiple body-part anchors and use PamiVAE to learn an interaction latent space, decoding frame-wise weights that aggregate these part-specific votes. Building on this representation, PAMI generates interactions in a coarse-to-fine hierarchy. PamiGen first generates a coarse human-object interaction from text in this structured latent space, and PamiRefiner then recursively resolves fine-grained contact geometry using a hybrid surface-sensing representation, combining long-range probes that capture overall body-part influence with short-range sensors that resolve detailed contacts near the object surface. Experiments on InterAct show that PAMI generates more faithful interactions and more accurate human-relative object motion than previous methods, achieving 14.5% higher contact recall than the previous state of the art. Extensive ablations validate the contributions of both the part-anchored voting representation and hybrid surface-sensing refinement.

AI.tldr: PAMI提出一种部件锚定运动框架，将物体运动表示为相对于多个身体部件锚点的投票并加权聚合，通过粗到细的生成与细化流程，实现文本驱动的人-物交互生成，物体漂移、接触缺失和穿透问题显著缓解。
AI.motivation: 文本条件下的全身人-物交互生成需要合成与文本匹配且时序上精确协调的人体运动和物体轨迹。现有方法多将人体与物体表示为独立轨迹并隐式预测全局人-物耦合关系，这种复杂且动态变化的关系难以隐式学习，常导致物体漂移、接触缺失和穿透。
AI.method: 受经典Hough变换启发，提出部件锚定运动框架PAMI：将物体运动表示为相对于多个身体部件锚点的相对运动，用PamiVAE学习交互隐空间并解码逐帧权重，聚合各部件特定的投票以定位物体运动。在此基础上采用粗到细的层级生成：PamiGen先在结构化隐空间中由文本生成粗粒度人-物交互，PamiRefiner再用混合表面感知表示递归求解细粒度接触几何，其中长程探针捕捉整体身体部件影响，短程传感器解析物体表面附近的细节接触。
AI.result: 在InterAct数据集上的实验表明，PAMI生成的交互更忠实、人体相对物体运动更准确，接触召回率较此前最先进方法提升14.5%。大量消融实验验证了部件锚定投票表示与混合表面感知细化两部分的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 部件锚定投票表示与混合表面感知细化共同提升了文本驱动人-物交互生成的质量与接触精度，为显式建模人-物动态耦合提供了有效范式。

title: The Backdrop Exposes What the World Around an Agent Costs It
summary: Agent benchmarks test agents in worlds that stay still. Deployed agents work in worlds that other people also change. Someone texts the agent to send the money elsewhere or an order confirmation asks it to reply with a door code. We present BACKDROP, which asks how much of an agent's capability in a clean world survives in such a world. BACKDROP takes a task along with the agents execution environment, and plants four everyday hazards in its world, one at a time and all together. The instruction and the correct end state stay the same. Each hazard asks one question. Authority: does a message from another person override the user? Injection: does text planted in a record redirect the agent? Boundary: does a request pull it into an app it was not given? Fault: after a write fails without saying whether it landed, does the agent check before it retries? Across 3,678 variants and 16 models, , the average pass rate falls from 69.5% to 31.3% once all four hazards are present; the strongest models fall furthest (Claude Fable 5.1 from 96.6% to 56.0%). Agents have learned to resist injected text but often follow other unauthorized requests of other people. With all four hazards present, and counting only runs where the planted text reached the agent, agents followed another person's message in 46.4% of runs and injected text in 20.3%. The gap is consistent throughout all 16 models. BACKDROP formalizes these gaps and shows how an agent's score in a task's world is a ceiling on real-world performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BACKDROP 基准，通过在智能体任务环境中植入四类日常"隐患"（权威、注入、越界、故障），检验干净环境下能力在扰动世界中的存活率。在 3,678 个变体与 16 个模型上，全部隐患存在时平均通过率从 69.5% 降至 31.3%，最强模型降幅最大。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准在静态、无干扰的世界中评测能力，而真实部署环境会被他人改动（如他人发消息要求转账、订单确认要求回复门禁码）。因此需要量化"干净世界中的能力有多少能迁移到有干扰的真实世界"，揭示干净环境得分是真实性能的上限。
AI.method: BACKDROP 将任务与智能体的执行环境一起作为输入，在保持指令与正确终态不变的前提下，逐个并同时植入四类日常隐患：Authority（他人消息是否覆盖用户意图）、Injection（记录中被植入的文本是否重定向智能体）、Boundary（请求是否将其拉入未被授权的应用）、Fault（写入失败且结果未知时，智能体是否在重试前先检查）。共构造 3,678 个变体，评测 16 个模型。
AI.result: 四类隐患全部存在时，平均通过率由 69.5% 降至 31.3%；最强模型下降最明显（Claude Fable 5.1 从 96.6% 降至 56.0%）。智能体已学会抵御注入文本，但常顺从他人的其他未授权请求：在四类隐患齐备且仅统计植入文本确实到达智能体的运行中，46.4% 的运行顺从了他人消息，20.3% 顺从了注入文本；该差距在全部 16 个模型中一致存在。
AI.conclusion: BACKDROP 形式化了智能体在权威、注入、越界、故障方面的能力缺口，表明智能体在单一任务世界中的得分是其真实世界性能的上限；安全对齐存在结构性薄弱环节，尤其是对他人未授权请求的顺从。

title: Curating Synthetic Data for Task-Specific Visual Perception
summary: Synthetic data are most valuable where general-purpose datasets cannot provide the domain-specific priors a task requires, and where manual annotation is expensive, imprecise, or infeasible. In this article we argue that the central question for specialized vision systems is not how to generate more data, but which data to generate.
