We therefore discuss curated synthetic data, whose scene content, appearance variations, sensing characteristics, and annotations are deliberately designed around a given task. We examine three complementary curation paradigms. Procedural rendering offers explicit control over scene parameters and the annotations follow by construction. Physically-based simulation encodes the mechanism behind an observed effect and yields exactly aligned supervision pairs. Generative AI learns sensor-specific appearance from small real seed sets and attains plausible realism, though it remains prone to hallucination and to inaccurate annotation. These paradigms are illustrated with examples from industrial surface defect detection, restoration of degraded digitized autochrome plates, and 6DoF pose estimation from RGB and event data. Using these examples, we analyze different data regimes and training strategies that combine synthetic and real data across these paradigms. We conclude that curated synthetic data are best understood as a complement to real observations, and that hybrid pipelines combining controllable supervision with learned appearance are the most promising direction for reliable sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文主张专用视觉系统的核心问题不是"生成更多数据"，而是"生成哪些数据"，提出"精选合成数据"（curated synthetic data）概念，并梳理三大策展范式及其在工业缺陷检测、彩色干版修复、6DoF位姿估计中的应用与混合训练策略。
AI.motivation: 通用数据集无法提供特定任务所需的领域先验，而人工标注在专用场景下昂贵、不精确甚至不可行。因此需要重新审视合成数据的价值定位：关键在于生成什么数据，而非单纯扩大数据规模。
AI.method: 提出"精选合成数据"范式，其场景内容、外观变化、传感特性和标注均围绕给定任务刻意设计。分析三种互补策展范式：(1) 过程化渲染（procedural rendering），显式控制场景参数，标注由构造自然导出；(2) 物理仿真，编码效应背后的物理机制，得到精确对齐的监督对；(3) 生成式AI，从小规模真实种子集学习传感器特定外观，实现合理真实感。并在工业表面缺陷检测、退化数字化彩色干版修复、RGB与事件数据的6DoF位姿估计三个案例中验证，同时分析合成与真实数据的不同数据区间及混合训练策略。
AI.result: 三种范式各有侧重：过程化渲染可控性最强，物理仿真监督对齐最精确，生成式AI真实感最佳但易出现幻觉和标注不准。案例展示了不同数据区间下合成与真实数据的组合方式及其效果。
AI.conclusion: 精选合成数据应被理解为真实观测的补充而非替代；将可控监督与学习外观相结合的混合流水线，是实现可靠sim-to-real迁移最有前景的方向。

title: Caption-Mediated Perceived-Safety Estimation for Pedestrian Routing
summary: This paper presents an explainable approach to pedestrian routing, in which perceived safety is estimated from street-level imagery through an explicit natural-language intermediate representation. A vision--language model caption is generated and stored before any scoring is undertaken, and the perceived-risk class is derived entirely from structured features of that stored text, so that every segment score remains inspectable by the user. Nine captioning conditions across five model families are benchmarked against a direct Contrastive Language--Image Pre-training (CLIP) image-embedding baseline under an identical downstream pipeline, and the caption-mediated representation is found to reach parity with the image embedding rather than to trail it. The approach was deployed over 654,115 images covering 36 electoral wards in two locations in Northern England (Manchester and Huddersfield). Independent field validation against 3,669 locally collected ratings of 494 images across 70 participant sessions established agreement that is statistically significant but modest, at $r=0.262$, against a measured noise ceiling of 0.737 imposed by disagreement between raters. A single-use confirmatory test then found that a pipeline 44\% stronger on the supervised benchmark did not produce measurable improvement in the field ($r=0.250$, $p=0.84$), so the benchmark gains did not predict the deployment gains in this case. Routing behaviour varies systematically with journey length. There is negligible change below 1\,km, reaching a median increase of 12.78\% in low-risk route length for a median detour of 2.73\% on journeys of 3 to 6 km.

AI.tldr: 提出可解释的行人路径规划方法：用自然语言字幕作为中间表征估计街道感知安全，性能与CLIP图像嵌入基线持平，并在英格兰北部部署验证。
AI.motivation: 行人路径规划中"感知安全"通常由不透明的图像嵌入模型直接打分，缺乏可解释性，用户无法审查每个路段评分的依据。作者希望构建一种评分过程可被用户逐段检查的感知安全估计方法。
AI.method: 先生成并存储视觉-语言模型对街景图像的自然语言字幕，再完全基于该存储文本的结构化特征推导感知风险类别，从而保证评分可审查。在相同下游管线中，对5个模型族的9种字幕条件与直接CLIP图像嵌入基线进行基准比较。方法部署于英格兰北部（曼彻斯特与哈德斯菲尔德）两个地区、36个选区的654,115张图像。以3694份本地收集评分（494张图像、70次参与者会话）作独立实地验证，并做一次性确认性检验。
AI.result: 字幕中介表征未落后于图像嵌入基线，达到与之相当的水平。实地验证一致性与评分者噪声上限0.737相比仅为中等显著（r=0.262）。监督基准上强44%的管线在实地未产生可测改进（r=0.250, p=0.84）。路径行为随出行距离系统性变化：1 km以下变化可忽略，3–6 km出行中低风险路线长度中位增加12.78%，对应中位绕行2.73%。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言字幕可作为可解释的中间表征，在不牺牲性能的情况下替代不透明的图像嵌入。但监督基准的提升并不能预测实地部署效果，基准与实地之间存在明显脱节；可解释性与实地收益需分别评估。

title: KlinikeBench: Evaluating Language Models Beyond Diagnostic Accuracy
summary: Most clinical benchmarks evaluate language models (LMs) on diagnosis using complete case descriptions. In clinical practice, however, patients present information in different ways, and clinicians must obtain relevant history and determine which examinations are needed before reaching a diagnosis. Diagnostic accuracy alone therefore cannot establish whether an agent gathered essential information or conducted an appropriate clinical assessment. Furthermore, existing benchmarks lack professional clinicians' verification. To address this gap, we introduce KlinikeBench, a benchmark of 333 clinician-authored tasks, each providing an isolated sandbox environment with a virtual patient, clinical tools, and task-specific success criteria. More than 35 clinicians contributed to case authoring and benchmark evaluation. In an empirical study, clinicians gave simulated dialogues higher mean quality ratings than reference conversations, which is adapted from real conversation. In each task, an LM has a fixed budget of turns to communicate with the patient, ask about relevant history, request examinations, follow action constraints, and record a final diagnosis. We score these steps separately as well as together. Across 31 models and seven model families, the best-performing models (e.g., GPT-6-astra and Claude Opus 5) succeed on less than 30% of tasks, even though their diagnosis accuracy reaches 90.7%. Some models benefit from talking with the patient; others diagnose well from a complete chart but perform much worse in conversation. Overall, KlinikeBench provides a testbed for evaluating the full clinical encounter and reveals a substantial gap between diagnostic accuracy and performance in interactive clinical assessment. All the code and data is available on https://zehui127.github.io/klinikebench/

AI.tldr: 提出KlinikeBench基准，包含333个临床医生编写的交互式诊断任务，通过沙箱环境评估语言模型在完整临床问诊中的表现，揭示诊断准确率与交互式评估能力间的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有临床基准多基于完整病例描述评估模型诊断能力，但真实临床中患者信息呈现方式多样，医生需主动采集病史并决定检查项目。仅凭诊断准确率无法判断模型是否收集了必要信息或执行了恰当的临床评估，且现有基准缺乏专业临床医生的验证。
AI.method: 构建KlinikeBench基准，含333个由临床医生编写的任务，每个任务提供隔离沙箱环境，包含虚拟患者、临床工具和任务特定的成功标准，超过35位临床医生参与病例编写与基准评估。每个任务中语言模型在固定轮次预算内与患者交流、询问病史、请求检查、遵守行动约束并记录最终诊断，分别及综合评分这些步骤。在31个模型、7个模型家族上进行实证评估。
AI.result: 临床医生对模拟对话的质量评分均值高于从真实对话改编的参考对话。最佳表现模型（如GPT-6-astra和Claude Opus 5）任务成功率不足30%，尽管其诊断准确率达90.7%。部分模型从与患者交流中获益，另一些模型能根据完整病历做出良好诊断，但在对话中表现明显更差。
AI.conclusion: KlinikeBench为评估完整临床问诊过程提供了测试平台，揭示了诊断准确率与交互式临床评估表现之间的显著差距。

title: Beyond Layers: Position-Resolved Gradient Conflict and Position-Aware Modulation for Unified Multimodal Models
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) train image understanding and autoregressive image generation on shared parameters, and the two objectives are known to interfere. Existing diagnoses and remedies operate at the resolution of layers or experts, measuring conflict per layer and resolving it by separating parameters. We argue that this resolution hides an orthogonal axis. Generation in a UMM is next-token prediction over a raster sequence of visual tokens whose roles vary systematically with position, so how strongly a generation gradient interferes with understanding should depend on where in the sequence it originates. We introduce a position-resolved interference map that attributes understanding-generation gradient conflict to visual-token positions within every layer, computed from a single backward pass at $1.2\times$ the cost of a standard backward pass. On Show-o and Janus-Pro, position explains a large share of conflict variance after controlling for depth (partial $η^2=0.31$ vs. $0.35$ for layer on Show-o; $0.15$ vs. $0.30$ on Janus-Pro): the first quarter of the sequence has a mean gradient cosine of $-0.18$ against understanding, the last quarter $-0.02$. The dependence survives per-position gradient-norm normalization, retaining $80%$ of its effect size, and conflict strength tracks semantic content (Spearman $ρ=0.64$). Building on the map, we propose position-aware modulation (PAM), which removes the anti-aligned component of generation gradients only at high-conflict positions without changing the architecture. Under a matched trainable-parameter budget, PAM improves over layer-wise separation by $+21$ MME and $+2.4$ GenEval points on Show-o while matching it on POPE and overall FID; a random-position control recovers about $31%$ of the gain. Position-based and layer-based separation are complementary degrees of freedom and can be combined.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"位置分辨的干扰图"，将统一多模态模型中理解与生成梯度冲突归因到序列中视觉token的具体位置，并据此设计位置感知调制（PAM），在Show-o上以匹配参数预算超越层级分离方法。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMM）共享参数同时训练图像理解与自回归图像生成，两个目标存在干扰。既有诊断与缓解方法均在"层"或"专家"粒度上度量冲突并靠参数分离解决，作者认为这一粒度掩盖了一个正交维度：生成本质是在视觉token的栅格序列上做下一token预测，而token的角色随位置系统性变化，因此生成梯度对理解的干扰强度应取决于其在序列中出现的位置。
AI.method: 提出位置分辨的干扰图（position-resolved interference map），在每一层内将理解-生成梯度冲突归因到各个视觉token位置，仅用一次反向传播即可计算，代价为标准反向传播的1.2倍。基于该图提出位置感知调制（PAM）：不改变架构，仅在高冲突位置移除生成梯度中与理解反对齐的分量。
AI.result: 在Show-o与Janus-Pro上，控制深度后位置可解释冲突方差的很大份额（偏η²：Show-o上位置0.31 vs 层0.35；Janus-Pro上0.15 vs 0.30）。序列前四分之一的平均梯度余弦为-0.18，后四分之一为-0.02。该位置依赖在逐位置梯度范数归一化后仍保留80%效应量，且冲突强度与语义内容相关（Spearman ρ=0.64）。在匹配可训练参数预算下，PAM在Show-o上较层级分离提升+21 MME与+2.4 GenEval，在POPE与整体FID上持平；随机位置对照仅恢复约31%的增益。
AI.conclusion: 位置维度与层维度是两个互补的自由度，可结合使用；位置感知调制验证了按序列位置区分对待生成梯度的有效性。

title: Deep Learning for Longitudinal Medical Imaging: A Scoping Review
summary: Longitudinal medical imaging analysis is a cornerstone of modern medical practice and patient care. Deep learning applied to longitudinal imaging offers wide potential to enhance diagnosis and track disease progression by capturing spatial changes over time. With major advances in single-timepoint deep learning for imaging, there has been growing interest in longitudinal image analysis, given its increased clinical relevance, though technical challenges remain. Several recent innovations may lead to a new era of multi-timepoint image evaluation, yet the scientific landscape, recent progress, and areas of need remain under-characterized. To address this gap, we conducted a scoping review of deep learning methodologies applied to longitudinal medical imaging, yielding 102 studies published between 2018 and 2025. Neurological disorders (48%) and ophthalmic conditions (12%) were the most common clinical applications, with MRI serving as the predominant imaging modality (67%). Sequential feature modeling approaches combining convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with temporal models (LSTM/RNN) were the most frequent methodology (40%), followed by direct feature aggregation across timepoints (23%). Most studies targeted classification tasks (56%), while external validation was performed in only 24% of studies. Our findings highlight that deep learning-based longitudinal imaging analysis remains a promising field, though newer temporal architectures and larger datasets may improve success and clinical adoption of these tools.

AI.tldr: 对2018–2025年深度学习应用于纵向医学影像的102项研究进行范围综述，梳理临床应用、模态、方法学与验证现状。
AI.motivation: 纵向影像对诊断与病程追踪至关重要，单时间点深度学习已较成熟，纵向分析临床相关性更强但技术挑战大；近年新进展不断，然而该领域的科学版图、最新进展与需求缺口仍缺乏系统刻画。
AI.method: 采用范围综述（scoping review）方法，系统检索并纳入2018–2025年间发表的深度学习纵向医学影像研究，共102项，从疾病领域、影像模态、建模策略、任务类型与外部验证等维度进行归纳分析。
AI.result: 神经系统疾病（48%）与眼科疾病（12%）最常见，MRI为主要模态（67%）；方法上以CNN结合时序模型（LSTM/RNN）的序列特征建模最多（40%），其次为跨时间点直接特征聚合（23%）；任务以分类为主（56%），仅24%的研究开展外部验证。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习纵向影像分析是前景广阔的方向，但外部验证不足、方法学集中度较高；更新的时序架构与更大规模数据集有望提升其性能与临床转化。

title: Anthropomorphism in the age of Large Language Models: An overview of potential risks and mitigations
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) and more broadly Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems are often described and understood in human-like terms, a phenomenon known as anthropomorphism. This paper provides a synthesis of recent literature on anthropomorphism in AI, covering theoretical frameworks, the role of language in framing AI as human-like, the various risks of anthropomorphizing machines, and strategies to mitigate these issues. After examining why we tend to anthropomorphize AI systems and whether we are right to do so, we highlight the impact of linguistic framing on anthropomorphism. Then, we introduce a conceptual taxonomy of risks associated with AI anthropomorphism. This taxonomy groups twenty-one concerns within five analytical categories: epistemic, affective, human agency, normative, and societal and institutional risks. Finally, we relate these concerns to proposed interventions in design, communication, education, and governance. We argue that a better understanding of AI systems requires concepts and theories grounded in their organization and demonstrated capacities. The linguistic shaping of anthropomorphic perceptions should form part of this scientific effort, since our descriptions influence both how these systems are understood and the roles we allow them to occupy in society.

AI.tldr: 本文综述AI拟人化研究，提出五类风险分类框架并对应提出干预策略。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型等AI系统常被以类人术语描述与理解，即拟人化现象。该现象影响AI的认知与社会角色定位，但相关文献分散，需要系统性整合以厘清成因、语言机制、风险与应对措施。
AI.method: 文献综述与概念分析：先探讨拟人化成因及合理性，再分析语言框架对拟人化的塑造作用，随后构建风险概念分类体系，将21项关切归入五类分析范畴，并与设计、传播、教育、治理四方面的干预措施相对应。
AI.result: 建构了AI拟人化的风险分类框架，包含五类：认识论风险、情感风险、人类能动性风险、规范性风险、社会与制度风险，共归纳21项具体关切，并匹配了设计、传播、教育、治理层面的干预路径。
AI.conclusion: 理解AI系统需以其组织结构和实际能力为基础的概念与理论；语言对拟人化感知的塑造应纳入这一科学努力，因为描述方式既影响对系统的理解，也影响其被允许承担的社会角色。

title: Multidimensional Observer Model and Perceptual Dimensions of Human Image Quality Assessment
summary: Judging image quality is not only ecologically relevant to everyday human tasks, but also underpins many machine vision tasks such as image generation. This paper proposes a framework to understand the inherent perceptual space underlying image quality judgment in humans. We propose a multi-dimensional observer model that represents images as distributions in a latent perceptual space and that models human judgment as comparing noisy samples. Being constrained by neural representations in the primate ventral stream and fit to large-scale behavioral data, the model enables analysis of perceptual structure while matching the predictive power of existing metrics. Using this model, we find that the perceptual spaces needed to account for image quality judgment in humans are extremely low-dimensional compared to the image space even when considering its sparsity. The exact structure of the space (e.g., dimensionalities, information encoded) varies between low-level and high-level quality judgments, suggesting that, despite a shared retinal encoding in the beginning, humans selectively construct task-dependent perceptual spaces in visual decision making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多维观察者模型，将图像表示为潜在知觉空间中的分布，并把人类判断建模为对含噪样本的比较，从而刻画图像质量判断背后的知觉空间结构。
AI.motivation: 图像质量判断既与人类日常任务相关，也是图像生成等机器视觉任务的基础，但人类进行质量判断时所依赖的内在知觉空间结构尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建多维观察者模型：将图像表征为潜在知觉空间中的分布，将人类判断建模为对含噪样本的比较；模型受灵长类腹侧通路神经表征约束，并在大规模行为数据上拟合。
AI.result: 模型在保持与现有指标相当预测能力的同时支持知觉结构分析；发现解释人类图像质量判断所需的知觉空间维度极低，远低于图像空间（即使考虑其稀疏性）；空间的具体结构（如维度数、编码信息）在低层与高层质量判断之间不同。
AI.conclusion: 尽管起始阶段共享视网膜编码，人类在视觉决策中会选择性地构建任务依赖的知觉空间。

title: Gaussian Stippling: Efficient Sorting-Free 3D Gaussian Rendering through Hybrid Sampling and Spatiotemporal Reconstruction
summary: Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) requires depth sorting and ordered alpha blending to correctly render overlapping Gaussian primitives. Stochastic transparency enables sorting-free rendering by replacing fractional alpha contributions with discrete stochastic visibility samples, but produces substantial spatial and temporal noise at low sample counts. We refer to this conversion from continuous Gaussian splats to discrete visibility samples as \textit{Gaussian Stippling}. Based on this, we present an efficient order-independent rendering and reconstruction framework that operates directly on unmodified 3DGS assets. Our method adaptively integrates primitive-based and fragment-based stippling, leveraging their complementary strengths across different rendering regimes to significantly improve rendering throughput. To recover high-quality images from sparse stochastic samples, we further introduce a lightweight Gaussian-aware spatiotemporal reconstruction network. By exploiting the Gaussian attributes retained by each stipple, the network aggregates structured stochastic clues across both space and time, effectively suppressing stippling noise. Experiments show that our hybrid Gaussian stippling method, coupled with a spatiotemporal reconstruction network trained on diverse scenes, generalizes to unseen scenes and enables interactive, temporally stable, and visually plausible rendering on mobile devices without retraining or preprocessing. With scene-specific training and appropriately scaled sampling and network capacity, our method further outperforms the baselines in visual quality, offering a high-fidelity configuration for quality-prioritized applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"高斯点画"(Gaussian Stippling)框架，将3DGS的连续透明度转换为离散随机可见性采样，实现无需排序的渲染，并配合轻量级时空重建网络抑制噪声。
AI.motivation: 传统3DGS渲染依赖深度排序和有序alpha混合来正确渲染重叠高斯基元，这一过程开销大且难以并行。随机透明度虽可免排序，但在低采样计数下会产生严重的空间与时间噪声。作者希望在不修改原有3DGS资产的前提下，实现高效的顺序无关渲染并恢复高质量图像。
AI.method: 核心是将连续高斯splat转换为离散可见性采样（Gaussian Stippling）。方法自适应融合基元级(primitive-based)与片元级(fragment-based)点画，利用二者在不同渲染区间下的互补优势提升吞吐量；随后引入轻量级、高斯感知的时空重建网络，利用每个stipple保留的高斯属性，在空间和时间维度聚合结构化随机线索以抑制点画噪声。
AI.result: 混合高斯点画结合在多样化场景上训练的时空重建网络，可泛化到未见场景，在移动设备上实现交互式、时间稳定且视觉合理的渲染，无需重训练或预处理。配合场景特定训练及适当的采样与网络容量扩展，该方法在视觉质量上进一步超越基线，提供面向质量优先应用的高保真配置。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过顺序无关的点画渲染与时空重建网络，在不修改原始3DGS资产的情况下兼顾了渲染效率与图像质量，既支持移动端实时稳定渲染，也可通过场景特定训练达到高保真效果，为质量优先与效率优先的应用提供了灵活的配置方案。

title: Personalized State-Transition-Aware Memory for Clinical Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents that reason over clinical records must track changes in a patient's state while preserving the history needed to understand them. Simply accumulating memories leaves it unclear which information still applies, whereas overwriting earlier memories can erase evidence needed to reconstruct treatment history and clinical trajectories. We introduce STAM, a state-transition-aware memory framework that records state changes as new clinical entries arrive. STAM combines semantic retrieval with typed clinical relations to identify affected memories, maintaining current information in Active and superseded or resolved information in History. At read time, a query-dependent gate selectively serves historical memory. Across four longitudinal clinical benchmarks, we evaluate STAM with downstream question answering, direct state-maintenance diagnostics, and comparisons at approximately matched context lengths.

AI.tldr: 提出STAM——一种状态转移感知的记忆框架，用于LLM临床智能体，在保留历史的同时跟踪患者状态变化。
AI.motivation: 临床记录推理需跟踪患者状态变化并保留理解所需的历史。单纯累积记忆无法明确哪些信息仍适用，而直接覆盖早期记忆会抹去重建治疗史与临床轨迹所需的证据。
AI.method: STAM在新临床条目到来时记录状态变化，结合语义检索与类型化临床关系识别受影响的记忆，将当前信息保存在Active中、被取代或已解决信息保存在History中；读取时通过查询相关门控选择性地提供历史记忆。
AI.result: 在四个纵向临床基准上，通过下游问答、直接状态维护诊断以及近似匹配上下文长度下的对比进行评估。
AI.conclusion: STAM能够兼顾状态更新与历史保留，为临床LLM智能体提供状态转移感知的记忆管理方案（摘要未给出具体量化结论）。

title: Contrastive Covariance Subspaces for Activation Steering
summary: Activation steering controls large language model behavior by adding a direction to hidden activations during inference. For steering to work well, that direction must be a pure signal for the target concept: any confound entangled with it, such as an incidental topic or writing style, is injected into the residual stream alongside the concept itself and degrades the generated text. We introduce Contrastive Covariance Steering (CCS), a training-free method that eliminates this confound variation. CCS projects steering vectors to a low-dimensional subspace obtained in closed form by solving a contrastive variance objective, which retains the directions along which the target concept varies while suppressing directions shared with the other classes. Across three LLMs and four steering domains, CCS consistently beats all baseline steering methods in all $12$ model-domain settings. The largest relative improvement occurs on AxBench and Emotion where we outperform the next strongest steering baseline by $48$ to $70\%$ and $13$ to $27\%$, respectively. Furthermore, CCS outperforms naive difference-of-means steering by up to $151\%$, showcasing the importance of deconfounding concepts. A toy experiment verifies our motivation on why: planting a topic nuisance into the training data reduces unprojected steering by $46\%$, whereas CCS loses only $12\%$ and recovers most of the gap to an oracle that explicitly deletes the planted direction. A human study with $23$ raters on $296$ generations reproduces the LLM judge's ranking. Our extensive ablation verifies the importance of our method's components and robustness to the number of nuisance classes. Finally, we extend our method to multi-turn conversations, where CCS sustains both concept expression and fluency, matching system prompt performance as other steering methods drift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Contrastive Covariance Steering (CCS)，一种无需训练的激活引导方法，通过对比方差目标将引导向量投影到低维子空间，以去除与目标概念纠缠的混淆变量，在 12 个模型-领域设置中全面优于基线。
AI.motivation: 激活引导通过向隐藏激活添加方向来控制大语言模型行为，但该方向若混杂了无关话题或写作风格等混淆变量，会随概念一起注入残差流并降低生成质量，因此需要去混淆。
AI.method: CCS 通过求解对比方差目标以闭式解获得低维子空间，将引导向量投影到该子空间：保留目标概念变化的方向，抑制与其他类别共享的方向，全程无需训练。
AI.result: 在 3 个 LLM 与 4 个引导领域共 12 个设置中，CCS 均优于所有基线。AxBench 和 Emotion 上相对提升最高达 48–70% 与 13–27%；相比朴素均值差引导最高提升 151%。玩具实验显示植入话题干扰使未投影引导下降 46%，而 CCS 仅损失 12%。23 名评分者对 296 条生成的人工研究复现了 LLM 评判的排名，消融验证了各组件重要性及对干扰类数量的鲁棒性。CCS 还可扩展到多轮对话，维持概念表达与流畅度。
AI.conclusion: CCS 通过去混淆的概念方向投影显著提升激活引导质量，消融与人工研究支持其有效性，并可推广至多轮对话场景。

title: What to Attend, What to Keep: Skill-Conditioned Visuotactile Representation with Progress-Guided Event Memory
summary: Robotic manipulation integrates vision, touch, and language, whose importance shifts across stages: vision guides reaching, while touch, through its evolution over time, decides grasping, alignment, and contact. Yet existing multi-modal manipulation policies typically use fixed temporal contexts and fusion strategies, despite shifts in what each modality contributes across different skills. We study how vision and touch should be combined at the level of primitive skills, asking what each skill needs from each sensor, and propose a skill-conditioned representation in which the queried skill conditions fusion over modality-specific short-term observation tokens while attending to a sparse event memory that retains terminal observations from the last $K$ executed skills. Evaluated by skill progress estimation on three contact-rich tasks, it reduces slip-detection delay by 87% against fine-tuned SOTA progress models, twist-completion delay by 67.5% against a vision-only ablation, and progress error on a blind search task by 92% through sparse event memory. Gains concentrate exactly where completion is defined by contact or task history. More broadly, our results suggest that observation formation not only policy architecture is a central challenge in multi-modal representation. Project Website: http://what-to-attend-what-to-keep.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出技能条件化的多模态表征：以被查询技能条件化视觉与触觉的融合，融合局部短期观测token并对稀疏事件记忆进行注意力，记忆保留最近K个已完成技能的终端观测；在三个富接触任务上显著降低滑移/扭转检测延迟与进度误差。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作中视觉、触觉与语言的重要性随阶段变化：视觉引导接近，触觉随时间演化决定抓取、对齐与接触。但现有多模态策略多采用固定时序上下文与固定融合策略，忽略了不同技能对各模态贡献的差异，因此需要在基元技能层面研究"每个技能需要什么传感器信息"。
AI.method: 提出技能条件化表征：由查询技能条件化模态专属短期观测token的融合，同时注意力聚合稀疏事件记忆——该记忆仅保留最近K个已执行技能的终端观测。以技能进度估计为评估任务，在三个富接触任务上与微调的SOTA进度模型、视觉单模态消融进行对比。
AI.result: 滑移检测延迟较微调SOTA进度模型降低87%；扭转完成延迟较视觉单模态消融降低67.5%；盲搜索任务进度误差借助稀疏事件记忆降低92%。增益集中出现在完成由接触或任务历史定义之处。
AI.conclusion: 观测构建（而非仅策略架构）是多模态表征的核心挑战；技能条件化融合与稀疏事件记忆能有效匹配不同技能对视觉/触觉的差异化需求。

title: DEdit: Iterative Draft Editing for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive LLMs by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Diffusion-based drafters further reduce drafting latency by proposing multiple tokens at once. However, these tokens are predicted independently, so a single early error causes prefix verification to discard the rest of the draft, even when it contains useful downstream predictions. We introduce DEdit, a diffusion-based drafter that can not only draft by conventional parallel unmasking but also iteratively edit its draft through token-to-token predictions. Through editing, later predictions can serve as bidirectional context for repairing earlier errors and extending the accepted prefix. To teach the model to repair errors while preserving correct predictions, we propose ProposalMix, a training scheme that mixes draft predictions with ground-truth tokens based on first-pass confidence during training. Across seven benchmarks on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, DEdit achieves the highest macro-average token acceptance and speedup among the evaluated drafters, reaching macro-average speedups of $5.72\times$ and $5.97\times$ over autoregressive generation under greedy decoding, respectively. Further analysis shows that acceptance improves with more editing passes and wider drafting windows, and that ProposalMix halves harmful edits that shorten the accepted prefix. Moreover, restricting the editor to causal attention lowers acceptance, especially on highly predictable outputs, indicating that future context is a key source of these gains.

AI.tldr: DEdit：一种可迭代编辑草稿的扩散式drafting方法，结合ProposalMix训练，显著提升推测解码的接受长度与加速比。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式drafter虽能并行提出多个token以降低drafting延迟，但这些token是独立预测的，单个早期错误会导致前缀验证丢弃后续草稿，即使其中包含有用预测，限制了接受长度与加速效果。
AI.method: 提出DEdit，一种扩散式drafter，既支持常规并行unmasking式drafting，也可通过token-to-token预测迭代编辑草稿，使后续预测作为双向上下文修复早期错误并延长接受前缀；并提出ProposalMix训练方案，在训练中依据首轮置信度混合草稿预测与ground-truth token，以在修复错误的同时保留正确预测。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B与Qwen3-8B的七个基准上，DEdit在所评估drafter中取得最高宏平均token接受率与加速比，贪婪解码下相对自回归生成分别达5.72×与5.97×；更多编辑轮次和更宽drafting窗口可提升接受率，ProposalMix将缩短接受前缀的有害编辑减半；将编辑器限制为因果注意力会降低接受率，尤其在高度可预测输出上。
AI.conclusion: 迭代编辑与双向上下文是提升扩散式drafter接受长度与推测解码加速的关键，ProposalMix能有效抑制有害编辑，未来上下文信息带来主要增益。

title: GazeFlow: From Human Gaze Behavior to Generative Egocentric Gaze Prediction
summary: Egocentric gaze prediction enables many downstream applications but remains challenging, as human gaze is inherently stochastic. This stochasticity is constrained by structured temporal dynamics alternating between fixations and saccades, top-down influences from tasks, and bottom-up visual saliency. Based on this observation, we introduce GazeFlow, a framework that directly models gaze as a joint distribution of temporal gaze positions conditioned upon both top-down and bottom-up information. In particular, GazeFlow uses conditional flow matching (CFM): a learned velocity field iteratively transports a Gaussian noise sample into a plausible gaze trajectory drawn from this joint distribution. The velocity field is conditioned on bottom-up visual features extracted by a video encoder and on top-down task information obtained by globally querying these features. On standard datasets, GazeFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance on per-frame metrics, and the generated trajectories align better with human gaze temporal dynamics.

AI.tldr: GazeFlow：以条件流匹配建模自我中心注视的时空联合分布，实现最优预测
AI.motivation: 自我中心注视预测具挑战性，因注视具有内在随机性；该随机性受注视-扫视交替的时间动态、自上而下任务影响及自下而上视觉显著性的结构化约束。
AI.method: 提出 GazeFlow，将注视直接建模为以自上而下与自下而上信息为条件的时序注视位置联合分布；采用条件流匹配（CFM），由学习到的速度场将高斯噪声样本迭代传输为合理的注视线轨迹；速度场以视频编码器提取的自下而上视觉特征及通过全局查询这些特征得到的自上而下任务信息为条件。
AI.result: 在标准数据集上，GazeFlow 在逐帧指标上达到最先进性能，且生成轨迹与人类注视的时间动态更为一致。
AI.conclusion: 将注视建模为条件联合分布并结合条件流匹配，可有效捕捉注视随机性与时空动态，优于现有逐帧预测方法，生成更符合人类注视动态的轨迹。

title: Shifting Mechanisms: How Positional Encoding Choice Shapes In-Context Retrieval
summary: Language models increasingly use architectures that vary attention span and positional encoding across layers, such as applying RoPE with sliding-window attention and NoPE with global attention (SWA NoPE). However, how these choices shape in-context retrieval remains unclear. To study this question, we take a mechanistic view, tracing how positional encoding (PE) choice shapes the internal mechanisms models use for in-context retrieval. Across 22 open-weight models spanning eight families, we find that standard RoPE models rely primarily on positional retrieval, while PE hybrids shift toward semantic retrieval. We further show on a controlled pre-training ablation that confining positional encoding to local layers produces this semantic shift, degrading representations of positional information. Finally, we show that the reported long-context gains of PE hybrids mask a retrieval trade-off: SWA NoPE improves over RoPE on multiple-target retrieval and QA, but degrades when distinguishing competing keys. We show that these behavioral differences better track the mechanism shift from positional toward semantic mechanisms than a uniform improvement in long-context retrieval.

AI.tldr: 该论文从机制视角研究了位置编码（PE）选择如何塑造语言模型的上下文检索内部机制。通过对22个开源模型（8个家族）及受控预训练消融实验的分析，发现标准RoPE模型主要依赖位置检索，而PE混合模型（如SWA NoPE）转向语义检索，并且这种长上下文性能提升掩盖了一个检索权衡。
AI.motivation: 语言模型越来越多地使用跨层变化的注意力跨度和位置编码架构（如滑动窗口注意力配RoPE、全局注意力配NoPE，即SWA NoPE），但这些选择如何影响上下文检索尚不清楚。作者希望从机制角度理解PE选择如何塑造模型用于上下文检索的内部机制。
AI.method: 1）对22个开源权重模型（跨越8个家族）进行机制分析，追踪PE选择对内部检索机制的影响；2）在受控预训练消融实验中，将位置编码限制在局部层，观察其对语义转换及位置信息表示的影响；3）通过多目标检索、问答和竞争键区分等任务，对比SWA NoPE与RoPE的行为差异。
AI.result: 标准RoPE模型主要依赖位置检索，而PE混合模型转向语义检索。受控预训练消融表明，将位置编码限制在局部层会产生这种语义转换，并降低位置信息的表示质量。此外，PE混合模型的长上下文性能提升掩盖了检索权衡：SWA NoPE在多目标检索和问答上优于RoPE，但在区分竞争键时性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 这些行为差异更好地反映了从位置机制向语义机制的转变，而非长上下文检索的均匀改进。研究揭示了PE选择对上下文检索机制的根本影响，并指出长上下文性能提升背后存在的检索权衡。

title: ThinkV2V: Unleashing the Reasoning Capability of MLLMs for Instruction-Guided Video Editing
summary: Instruction-guided video editing has made significant progress, yet existing methods use multimodal large language models (MLLMs) primarily as semantic encoders, so they often fall short in working with implicit edits that require causal or semantic reasoning. To bridge this fundamental gap in video editing, we propose ThinkV2V, a reasoning-driven framework for complex instruction-guided video editing, explicitly activating MLLM thinking before visual generation. At its core, ThinkV2V builds on a practical MLLM-to-DiT architecture to turn explicit thinking over the source video and instruction into refined conditioning signals for video editing. Further, we equip it with a dedicated training and inference recipe, combining Progressive Curriculum Training, which gradually cultivates the model from basic editing to reasoning-intensive cases, with Inference-Time Thinking Scaling, which iteratively refines candidate prompts and selects the most reliable one, to better elicit reasoning in challenging editing scenarios. We also curate the ThinkV2V-150K dataset and introduce ThinkV2V-Bench to support training and evaluation of video editing with implicit intent and causal reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of ThinkV2V on both complex and standard editing scenarios, in which our 5B-scale DiT model substantially outperforms larger 10B-scale baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 ThinkV2V，一个以推理驱动的指令引导视频编辑框架，在视觉生成前显式激活 MLLM 思考过程，在复杂与标准编辑场景均取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑方法仅将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）当作语义编码器使用，缺乏因果与语义推理能力，难以处理需要推理的隐式编辑指令。
AI.method: 构建 MLLM-to-DiT 架构，将源视频与指令的显式思考转化为精细化的条件信号；并提出由 Progressive Curriculum Training（从基础编辑逐步过渡到推理密集型任务）与 Inference-Time Thinking Scaling（迭代优化并筛选候选提示）组成的训练与推理方案。
AI.result: 构建 ThinkV2V-150K 数据集并提出 ThinkV2V-Bench 评测基准；实验显示在复杂与标准编辑场景均达到 SOTA，5B 规模 DiT 模型显著优于 10B 规模基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过在生成前激活 MLLM 推理，ThinkV2V 有效弥合了隐式意图与因果推理场景下的视频编辑能力鸿沟，为推理驱动的视频编辑提供了新范式。

title: MedKIT: Evaluating Knowledge Integration and Generalization in Large Language Models
summary: Constantly evolving real-world knowledge necessitates models to be updated continuously. Especially in medicine, as clinical evidence changes over time, outdated knowledge can pose safety risks. Existing evaluations of knowledge integration focus on factual recall, offering limited insight into whether newly integrated knowledge is actually usable. Our benchmark MedKIT (Medical Knowledge Integration and Transfer) provides a granular evaluation of how models integrate and apply knowledge under realistic sequences of clinical updates. Each instance corresponds to a factual update derived from clinical evidence, paired with targeted probes that assess transfer across lexical variation, relational transformations, compositional reasoning, and open-ended operationalization, as well as locality tests for knowledge preservation. Using MedKIT, we conduct a large-scale empirical study of 12 knowledge integration strategies across 5 diverse models, including both general-purpose and medical LLMs. Our results reveal a consistent gap between recall and usable knowledge: while most methods achieve strong gains on the original update task and under lexical variation, relational generalization is limited, and no method yields meaningful improvements on compositional or operational tasks. These findings highlight a fundamental challenge in knowledge integration and position MedKIT as a testbed for developing methods that make newly integrated knowledge more consistently usable across tasks and contexts.

AI.tldr: 提出MedKIT基准，细粒度评估大模型在真实临床知识更新序列下的知识整合与迁移能力，发现"记忆整合"与"可用知识"之间存在持续差距。
AI.motivation: 现实世界知识持续演化，医学领域临床证据随时间变化，过时知识会带来安全风险。然而现有知识整合评测主要聚焦事实召回，难以揭示新整合的知识是否真正可用，因此需要一个更细粒度、贴近真实更新序列的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建基准MedKIT（Medical Knowledge Integration and Transfer）。每个实例对应一个源自临床证据的事实更新，并配备针对性探针，覆盖四类迁移能力：词汇变体、关系变换、组合推理、开放式操作化；同时设置局部性测试以检验知识保持。基于该基准，对5个多样化模型（含通用与医学LLM）上的12种知识整合策略进行大规模实证研究。
AI.result: 多数方法在原始更新任务及词汇变体下取得显著提升，但关系泛化能力有限；在组合推理与操作化任务上没有任何方法带来有意义的改进，普遍存在召回与可用知识之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 知识整合存在根本性挑战：当前方法多停留在表层召回层面。MedKIT可作为测试平台，用于开发使新整合知识在跨任务、跨情境中更一致可用的方法。

title: Detail in Context: A Dual-Scale Machine Learning Framework for Mycosis Fungoides Detection
summary: Mycosis fungoides (MF) is a rare form of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma that is often misdiagnosed in early stages due to its visual similarity to benign inflammatory dermatoses. Early and accurate diagnosis is critical for improving patient outcomes. In this paper, we propose a comprehensive diagnostic framework for automated MF detection that combines dual- scale histopathological image analysis with deep learning. To distinguish MF from other lymphoproliferative skin conditions, the proposed approach leverages a late-fusion ensemble of dual- magnification (10x and 20x) convolutional neural networks (CNNs), complemented by a random forest classifier trained on 16 clinical features. Experimental results on an expanded dataset of 6,267 images (4,306 MF; 1,961 Non-MF) across 463 patients demonstrate that strong detection performance is obtained by prioritizing higher-resolution cytological details (20x) within broader architectural context (10x). The image-based late-fusion model achieves an accuracy of 83.58% and a sensitivity of 89.13%, while the clinical random forest model achieves an accuracy of 96.6% and sensitivity of 93.8%, highlighting the po- tential of this multimodal framework as a robust clinical decision support system in dermatology. This framework addresses two distinct clinical objectives: an image-based dual-scale pipeline optimized for the early diagnostic screening of MF versus non- MF dermatoses, and a complementary clinical metadata model designed for the subsequent staging of confirmed MF cases (patch/plaque versus tumor)

AI.tldr: 提出一个结合双尺度组织病理图像深度学习与临床特征随机森林的多模态框架，用于蕈样肉芽肿（MF）的自动检测与分期。
AI.motivation: MF是一种罕见的皮肤T细胞淋巴瘤，早期因与良性炎症性皮肤病外观相似而常被误诊，早期准确诊断对改善患者预后至关重要。
AI.method: 采用双放大倍数（10x与20x）CNN的晚期融合集成进行图像分析，并辅以基于16个临床特征训练的随机森林分类器；框架对应两个临床目标：图像双尺度流程用于MF与非MF皮肤病的早期筛查，临床元数据模型用于确诊MF的分期（斑片/斑块 vs 肿瘤）。
AI.result: 在扩展数据集（463名患者、6,267张图像：4,306 MF、1,961 Non-MF）上，图像晚期融合模型准确率83.58%、灵敏度89.13%；临床随机森林模型准确率96.6%、灵敏度93.8%。
AI.conclusion: 在更广的组织结构背景（10x）下优先利用高分辨率细胞学细节（20x）可获得较强检测性能；该多模态框架有望作为皮肤科稳健的临床决策支持系统。

title: LongTake: Learning to Sustain Dynamics in Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: World models, game simulators, and long-take video creation require coherent scene evolution and sustained dynamics over extended durations. Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion provides a natural framework for long-horizon generation, yet extended rollouts often become near-static or lose visual quality. We hypothesize that these failures reflect the limited guidance provided by short-video supervision on how ongoing scene dynamics develops over longer durations. This motivates us to introduce LongTake, a two-stage training pipeline built around Long-Horizon Teacher Forcing (TF) on curated real long videos. Long-Horizon TF trains the AR model to predict later frames conditioned on long ground-truth video prefixes, extending direct supervision beyond the short training horizon. This supervision is designed to help the model sustain dynamics and preserve visual quality during long-horizon generation. Our central finding is that this training stage strengthens direct initialization for distribution matching distillation (DMD) under student self-rollout, without the intermediate few-step distillation stage used in standard pipelines. Under the same five-second DMD training setup, our initialization yields substantially higher dynamic degree than short horizon TF initialization on 30-second rollouts at comparable aesthetic quality, and surpasses the evaluated baselines in both measures. Hybrid DMD further reuses this teacher to extend supervision to later frames of the self-rollout while retaining bidirectional joint supervision over the initial window. On long-horizon self-rollouts, LongTake lies on the Pareto front of dynamic degree and aesthetic quality, and Hybrid DMD attains the highest dynamic degree among evaluated methods at both 30s and 60s.

AI.tldr: LongTake 通过两阶段训练流程（长时程教师强制预训练 + DMD 蒸馏）提升自回归视频扩散模型的长时程生成动态性与视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散在长时程生成中常出现画面趋近静止或视觉质量退化，作者假设其根源在于短视频监督对长时程场景动态演化提供的指导不足。
AI.method: 提出 LongTake 两阶段流程：第一阶段在精选真实长视频上做 Long-Horizon Teacher Forcing，以长真实前缀为条件预测后续帧，将直接监督延伸出短训练窗口；该初始化直接用于学生自rollout下的分布匹配蒸馏（DMD），跳过标准流程中的中间少步蒸馏阶段。进一步提出 Hybrid DMD，复用该教师把监督延伸至自rollout的后期帧，同时保留初始窗口的双向联合监督。
AI.result: 在相同5秒DMD训练设置下，该初始化在30秒rollout上的动态程度显著高于短时程TF初始化，美学质量相当；Hybrid DMD 在30s与60s上取得所评估方法中最高的动态程度，LongTake 位于动态程度与美学质量的帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: 长时程教师强制能有效缓解自回归视频扩散的长时程退化，并为DMD提供更强的直接初始化，在不增加中间蒸馏阶段的情况下兼顾动态性与视觉质量。

title: Towards Model as a Library: Offline, Community-Sourced AI for Low-Resource African Languages
summary: Large language models are frequently proposed as a route to AI-powered services for African communities, but they are least reliable exactly where the need is greatest: all African languages remain low-resource by any standard measure, and models trained on scraped, standardised text systematically misrepresent the dialectal and regional variation of how people actually speak. We introduce \textbf{Model as a Library (MaaL)}, a software architecture that packages small, community-enrolled speech models as versioned on-device dependencies, enabling offline structured data collection that cannot generatively hallucinate, for populations that current language models serve worst. Rather than relying on web-scraped corpora, MaaL's vocabulary is enrolled directly from a small number of example recordings by the speakers themselves, at the point of deployment. We describe the architecture and its central mechanism - keyword spotting that turns a closed-vocabulary text form into a voice form, filled and submitted entirely on-device - and propose transpiling the closed-vocabulary elements already present in widely-deployed digital form tools into MaaL schemas, a low-friction path to voice-first, offline data collection for the low-literacy populations these tools already reach. This is a position and system-design paper: we describe the concept, the mechanism, and an analytical feasibility case, and identify what a working implementation still requires.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MaaL（Model as a Library）架构，将小型、社区自注册的语音模型打包为版本化的端侧依赖，实现离线、不可生成式幻觉的结构化数据采集，服务非洲低资源语言与低识字人群。论文属定位与系统设计类工作，给出概念、机制与分析性可行性论证。
AI.motivation: 大模型常被宣传为服务非洲社区的途径，但在需求最迫切处最不可靠：所有非洲语言按任何标准衡量均为低资源；基于爬取的标准化文本训练的模型系统性歪曲真实口语的方言与地区差异。现有数字工具已触达低识字人群，却以封闭词表文本形式存在，缺乏语音优先、离线的数据采集路径。
AI.method: 提出 MaaL 软件架构：将小型社区自注册语音模型封装为版本化端侧依赖。词表不依赖网络爬取语料，而由说话者在部署现场通过少量示例录音直接注册。核心机制为关键词检测（keyword spotting），把封闭词表文本形式转换为语音形式，全程在设备端填写并提交，从而避免生成式幻觉。另提出将广泛部署的数字表单工具中已有的封闭词表元素转译（transpile）为 MaaL schema，以低摩擦方式实现语音优先的离线采集。
AI.result: 本文未提供实测结果，仅给出架构描述、机制说明与一项分析性可行性论证（analytical feasibility case）。
AI.conclusion: MaaL 为当前语言模型服务最差的人群提供语音优先、离线、不可幻觉的结构化数据采集路径；封闭词表转译是低摩擦落地方式。作为定位与系统设计论文，作者明确指出尚需明确工作实现所需的条件，即完整实现尚未完成。

title: Retargeting Motions to Diverse Skeletons via Learnable Flattening
summary: Cross-structural motion retargeting aims to transfer motion between different skeletal topologies. Despite recent progress, existing state-of-the-art models struggle with reliability in zero-shot settings, i.e. skeletons with different topologies which were unseen during training, and recent Transformer-based attempts have failed to outperform specialized geometric methods. We bridge this gap with a Transformer Autoencoder that learns a topology- and translation-invariant latent space. Our core contribution is a learnable flattening of skeletal graphs that captures both local dependencies and global structure. Unlike the standard transformer architecture, which adds positional information to token content, we integrate graph-based positional encodings multiplicatively, a design choice that follows directly from our flattening formulation. The resulting model handles diverse skeletal topologies within a single unified architecture and trains in a fully unsupervised manner, requiring no paired retargeting data. Ablation studies show, that the graph encodings, multiplicative formulation, and Transformer backbone is critical for the performance. In zero-shot evaluations, our method reduces global joint position error by $43-47\%$ over current benchmarks. A user study ($n = 37$), including expert animators, further ranks our approach highest in motion alignment and physical plausibility ($p < 0.05$). These results demonstrate that our model design is key to making transformer architectures effective for motion retargeting, outperforming existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Transformer自编码器的跨结构动作重定向方法，通过学习拓扑与平移不变的隐空间，并结合可学习的骨骼图扁平化与乘法式图位置编码，在零样本设置下显著优于现有基准。
AI.motivation: 现有最优模型在零样本（训练时未见过的不同拓扑骨架）设置下可靠性不足，且近期基于Transformer的方法未能超越专门的几何方法。因此需要一种统一架构来处理多样骨架拓扑。
AI.method: 采用Transformer自编码器学习拓扑与平移不变的隐空间；核心贡献是骨骼图的可学习扁平化，捕捉局部依赖与全局结构；不同于标准Transformer将位置信息加成到token内容上，本文以乘法方式整合图位置编码（该设计直接来源于扁平化公式）；模型在单一统一架构下处理多样骨架拓扑，并完全无监督训练，无需配对重定向数据。
AI.result: 消融实验表明图编码、乘法式公式与Transformer骨干对性能至关重要；零样本评估中，全局关节位置误差较当前基准降低43-47%；用户研究（n=37，含专家动画师）在动作对齐与物理合理性上均将本方法排名最高（p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 模型设计是使Transformer架构在动作重定向中有效的关键，本方法优于现有方法，证明统一的无监督Transformer架构可有效解决跨结构动作重定向问题。

title: Restoring without Forgetting: Filter-Level Continual Image Restoration via Parameter-Space Integrated Gradients
summary: Adapting image restoration models to a stream of new tasks without revisiting past data remains challenging due to catastrophic forgetting. In this work, we propose Restoring without Forgetting (RwF), a filter-level continual adaptation framework for image restoration built upon a critical observation: task-specific knowledge is centered in a small subset of filters and can be separated from those reconstructing general content. RwF first performs parameter-space integrated gradients attribution to localize degradation-critical filters in a coarse-to-fine manner. It then adapts to new tasks by generating task-specific filters from a filter bank using compact factorized low-rank transformations, further augmented with cross-task attention and prototypical contrastive learning, and lastly assembles them back only at localized positions. Experiments on six restoration tasks show that RwF effectively avoids forgetting and achieves competitive restoration quality against all-in-one methods that have full data access, and outperforms LoRA-style adaptation with $\sim$10$\times$ fewer additional parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/funkdub/Restoring-without-Forgetting.

AI.tldr: 提出RwF框架，通过定位并重组任务关键滤波器，在不重访旧数据的条件下实现图像复原的持续适配，避免灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 图像复原模型需连续适配新任务，但重访历史数据不可行，直接微调会导致灾难性遗忘。作者观察到任务特定知识集中于少数滤波器，且可与重建通用内容的滤波器分离，据此设计持续适配方案。
AI.method: RwF包含三步：1）在参数空间用积分梯度归因，以粗到细方式定位对退化关键的滤波器；2）借助滤波器库（filter bank），通过紧凑的因式分解低秩变换生成任务特定滤波器，并引入跨任务注意力与原型对比学习增强；3）仅在定位位置将生成滤波器装配回网络。
AI.result: 在六个复原任务上，RwF有效避免遗忘，复原质量与可使用全部数据的all-in-one方法相当，并优于LoRA式适配方法，且额外参数量约少10倍。
AI.conclusion: 任务知识可通过滤波器级定位与低秩生成实现解耦与复用，RwF以极小参数开销在无历史数据条件下实现持续图像复原，兼顾抗遗忘与复原性能。

title: StereoGaussians: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Stereo Images
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables reconstruction without per- scene optimisation, but practical stereo-camera applications require nearby-view extrapolation beyond the input views. Stereo depth anchors visible surfaces, yet rendering newly exposed regions also requires learned appearance and additional scene capacity. We introduce StereoGaussians, which predicts a metric 3DGS representation from a single calibrated stereo pair. It reuses intermediate repre- sentations from frozen pretrained stereo networks to predict Gaussian attributes, while calibrated disparity anchors the geometry. A second Gaussian layer and an expanded image canvas provide capacity for disoccluded and outside-field-of- view content. For training, we construct SceneSplat-Stereo from quality-filtered 3DGS teachers, pairing stereo inputs with nearby target views across 803 training scenes. Experiments on unseen real and photorealistic stereo benchmarks demon- strate improvements over strong view-synthesis baselines, while ablation studies support our main design choices.

AI.tldr: 提出 StereoGaussians，从单张标定立体图像对前馈预测度量 3DGS 表示，通过复用冻结立体网络中间特征、标定视差锚定几何，并借助第二高斯层与扩展画布增强新暴露区域与视场外内容的渲染能力；同时构建 SceneSplat-Stereo 数据集用于训练。
AI.motivation: 前馈 3DGS 虽免去逐场景优化，但实际立体相机应用需要超出输入视角的邻近视角外推；立体深度仅能锚定可见表面，渲染新暴露区域还需学习外观与额外场景容量。
AI.method: 1) 从单个标定立体图像对预测度量 3DGS 表示；2) 复用冻结预训练立体网络的中间表示预测高斯属性，用标定视差锚定几何；3) 引入第二高斯层并扩展图像画布，为去遮挡和视场外内容提供容量；4) 从质量过滤的 3DGS 教师模型构建 SceneSplat-Stereo，涵盖 803 个训练场景，配对立体输入与邻近目标视角。
AI.result: 在未见过的真实与照片级真实立体基准上，方法优于强视图合成基线；消融实验验证了主要设计选择的有效性。
AI.conclusion: StereoGaussians 实现了从单张立体图像对的前馈度量 3DGS 重建，并通过第二高斯层与扩展画布解决新视角外推难题，实验与消融共同支持其设计有效性。

title: Prompt2Skill: Unsupervised Skill Optimization From Natural Language Instructions
summary: Skills are external artifacts that Large Language Models (LLMs) consume at inference time to improve their performance on specialized domains by incorporating relevant procedural and domain knowledge. Expert-authored skills are expensive to produce, and the resulting artifacts are not optimized for the specific model that consumes them, whose failure modes can vary with version, scale and training. In addition, emerging tasks may fall outside the scope of existing skill libraries, creating a need to develop new skills before curated training data become available. Recent works have explored automated skill optimization through reflection, but they require a curated, in-distribution training set, which users might not always have. To address these limitations, we present Prompt2Skill, a framework that builds skills from natural-language task description alone. From the prompt, the system derives a task specification, discovers or synthesizes datasets, and refines the skill in a closed loop of reflective editing. Across four domains spanning question answering, reading comprehension, spreadsheet manipulation, and mathematical reasoning, Prompt2Skill consistently outperforms the direct prompting baseline, achieving an average improvement of 10.8 across open-source and frontier models.

AI.tldr: 提出 Prompt2Skill 框架，仅凭自然语言任务描述即可自动构建技能，通过推导任务规格、发现或合成数据集并在反思式编辑闭环中优化，在四个领域平均提升 10.8 分。
AI.motivation: 专家编写的技能成本高昂，且未针对具体消费模型优化，其失效模式随版本、规模和训练变化；新兴任务可能超出已有技能库范围；现有自动技能优化方法依赖策展的分布内训练集，用户往往不具备。
AI.method: 从自然语言提示出发推导任务规格，发现或合成数据集，并在反思式编辑的闭环中迭代精炼技能，无需策展的训练数据。
AI.result: 在问答、阅读理解、电子表格操作和数学推理四个领域，Prompt2Skill 一致优于直接提示基线，在开源与前沿模型上平均提升 10.8。
AI.conclusion: Prompt2Skill 证明仅凭自然语言任务描述即可自动构建并优化技能，摆脱对专家编写技能与策展训练集的依赖，为新兴任务提供可扩展的技能生成途径。

title: PixelUMM: Encoder-Free Unified Image and Video Understanding and Generation
summary: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) often rely on separate visual representations for understanding and generation, increasing visual context length and complicating integration with established vision-language pretraining pipelines. Recent advances in pixel-space modeling offer an encoder-free alternative, but extending this paradigm from images to videos is non-trivial: video understanding and generation adopt different temporal representations, leaving the design of a unified visual interface an open question. We present PixelUMM, an encoder-free model for unified image and video understanding and generation directly in pixel space. PixelUMM represents images as spatial patches and videos as spatiotemporal tubelets, connecting raw pixels to a shared multimodal backbone through single-layer linear projections. Its Mixture-of-Transformers architecture combines shared attention with task-specific parameters and extends clean-pixel prediction to video generation, jointly supporting autoregressive text prediction and pixel-space flow matching. Experiments show that PixelUMM achieves competitive performance across image and video understanding and generation tasks. We further conduct empirical studies of key design choices, including decoder design and spatial-temporal patch size, providing insights for future pixel-space unified multimodal models.

AI.tldr: PixelUMM是一种无编码器（encoder-free）的统一多模态模型，直接在像素空间完成图像与视频的理解和生成任务。它用空间patch表示图像、时空tubelet表示视频，通过单层线性投影连接共享多模态骨干，并采用Mixture-of-Transformers架构实现理解与生成的统一。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型（UMMs）通常为理解和生成使用各自独立的视觉表示，导致视觉上下文长度增加，且难以与已有的视觉-语言预训练流程集成。虽然像素空间建模提供了无编码器方案，但从图像扩展到视频并非易事：视频理解与生成采用不同的时间表示，统一视觉接口的设计仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 1) 无编码器、直接在像素空间建模；2) 图像表示为空间patch，视频表示为时空tubelet，通过单层线性投影接入共享多模态骨干；3) 采用Mixture-of-Transformers架构，将共享注意力与任务特定参数相结合；4) 将clean-pixel预测扩展到视频生成，联合支持自回归文本预测与像素空间flow matching；5) 对解码器设计和时空patch大小等关键设计选择进行实证研究。
AI.result: PixelUMM在图像和视频的理解与生成任务上均取得有竞争力的性能；并通过消融式的实证研究，分析了包括解码器设计、时空patch大小在内的关键设计选择，为未来像素空间统一多模态模型提供了经验参考。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了无编码器、纯像素空间的统一多模态建模在图像与视频任务上的可行性，提出的统一视觉接口（空间patch与时空tubelet + 单层投影 + Mixture-of-Transformers）为理解与生成的统一提供了有效范式，并为后续研究给出设计指引。

title: Aperture: Training-Free Multiscale Concept Bottlenecks for Remote Sensing
summary: While earth observation models have advanced substantially, they still lack interpretability. While concept-bottleneck models provide interpretability and expert interaction, they are either too expensive to train for the remote sensing domain or perform poorly without annotation. We posit that in expert domains like remote sensing, such training-free models require both fine details in both image and concept space. In image space, we propose a multiscale concept bottleneck using greedy quadtree routing to locate small concepts. In concept space, we replace contrastive vision language models with pre-trained MLLMs and present a way to get reliable concept scores from them. We introduce APERTURE that blends concept scores at the global image and native concept-scale level to give state-ofthe-art training-free model performance. To test these models, introduce SiFC, a fine-grained concept-centric dataset across three countries, with human-reviewed class-level concept maps. On SiFC, APERTURE outperforms the best training-free baselines by more than 10 percentage points in macro F1-score, and notably also outperforms supervised concept bottleneck models. Targeted component-removal tests examine whether concept scores respond to changes in visual evidence, while temporal experiments show that descriptor updates improve recognition of technological changes without retraining.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出无需训练的遥感概念瓶颈模型APERTURE，通过多尺度图像概念定位与MLLM可靠概念打分，在新建细粒度数据集SiFC上显著超越无训练与有监督基线。
AI.motivation: 地球观测模型缺乏可解释性；现有概念瓶颈模型在遥感领域要么训练成本过高，要么在无标注情况下性能不佳。作者认为，在遥感这类专家领域，无训练模型需要在图像空间与概念空间均具备细粒度细节。
AI.method: 图像空间：提出多尺度概念瓶颈，使用贪心四叉树路由定位小尺度概念。概念空间：以预训练MLLM替代对比式视觉语言模型，并提出从MLLM获取可靠概念分数的方法。模型APERTURE融合全局图像级与原生概念尺度级的概念分数。
AI.result: 在跨三个国家、含人工审核类别级概念图的细粒度概念数据集SiFC上，APERTURE的宏观F1比最佳无训练基线高10个百分点以上，并优于有监督概念瓶颈模型。组件移除测试检验概念分数对视觉证据变化的响应；时间实验表明描述符更新无需重训练即可提升技术变化的识别。
AI.conclusion: 在专家领域实现无需训练的高性能可解释概念瓶颈模型是可行的，关键在于图像与概念双空间的细粒度建模；概念分数具备证据敏感性与可更新的时间适应性。

title: Beyond Oracle Communication: Benchmarking Interactive Intent Alignment Under Miscommunication and Evolving User Intent
summary: Modern LLM agents increasingly tackle complex tasks through interactive, long-horizon exchanges with users, while existing benchmarks generally assume that users always accurately and sufficiently communicate a fixed intent. However, this oracle communication assumption rarely holds in practice: users may miscommunicate, change their goals, and run out of patience. We define this task setting as Interactive Intent Alignment, where agents must recover and continuously track the user's current intent despite imperfect communication and evolving goals. To study this setting, we introduce Drift-Bench++, a principled benchmark construction pipeline for verified executable tasks with controlled misalignment and intent shifts, along with an interaction protocol featuring finite patience, diverse simulated users, and silent interaction-conditioned shifts. We further develop GRIP, a comprehensive evaluation protocol covering task grounding, user realism, inquiry effectiveness, and adaptation to evolving intent. Across diverse environments, models, and interaction conditions, stronger interaction consistently helps but remains far from oracle performance; Validation on deployed ProdAgent sessions further shows that the modeled failures are prevalent and consequential in deployment. By providing a unified, executable benchmark for interactive intent alignment, Drift-Bench++ offers a foundation for evaluating and advancing agents under realistic communication and evolving intent.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"交互式意图对齐"(Interactive Intent Alignment)任务设定,并构建了 Drift-Bench++ 基准与 GRIP 评估协议,用以评测 LLM 智能体在沟通不完美、意图漂移场景下持续追踪用户真实意图的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体基准普遍假设用户能准确、充分地表达固定意图(即"oracle communication assumption"),但现实中用户会误表达、改变目标并失去耐心,该假设很少成立,因此缺少针对真实交互条件下意图对齐的评测手段。
AI.method: 1) 定义 Interactive Intent Alignment 任务设定,要求智能体在不完美沟通与目标演化中恢复并持续追踪用户当前意图;2) 提出 Drift-Bench++,通过原则化的基准构建流水线生成经校验的可执行任务,并施加受控的错位与意图漂移;3) 设计交互协议,包含有限耐心、多样化模拟用户以及静默的(由交互状态触发的)意图转移;4) 提出 GRIP 评估协议,覆盖任务落地、用户真实性、询问有效性与对意图演化的适应性。
AI.result: 在多种环境、模型与交互条件下,更强的交互能力始终带来收益,但距离 oracle 表现仍有较大差距;在已部署的 ProdAgent 会话上验证表明,所建模的失败模式在实际部署中普遍存在且后果显著。
AI.conclusion: Drift-Bench++ 为交互式意图对齐提供了统一的可执行基准,为在真实沟通与意图演化条件下评测和推进智能体奠定了基础。

title: SecureVibe: Making Vibe Coding More Secure
summary: As vibe coding becomes increasingly capable and widespread, security vulnerabilities in even functionally correct solutions are a growing concern. When investigating functionally correct but insecure solutions, we find that the insecure agent is less than half as likely to conduct effective planning and testing for the hidden security risks behind the functional requirements. Motivated by this, we develop SECUREVIBE, a training recipe that explicitly targets planning and testing for code security. SECUREVIBE constructs training signals around these security behaviors. It includes supervised fine-tuning on the security suite with 4 security tasks, and post-training methods, SECUREVIBE_rl and SECUREVIBE_hg, to enhance security capabilities from verifiable execution feedback and hint-based self-supervision. Our SECUREVIBE outperforms the baseline on two types of security coding tasks across 4 benchmarks. Specifically, SECUREVIBE improves the security pass@1 by 6.9 points on BaxBench. The gains extend to unseen CWE categories, with improvements of 11.5 points on SusVibes. Meanwhile, it also improves functionality pass@1 by 13.6 points on the security coding task SusVibes and 4.1 points on the generic coding task SWE-bench Verified. Further analysis offers two practical insights: (i) diversifying supervision across security planning, coding, and testing strengthens security behaviors more effectively than adding coding trajectories alone, and (ii) hint-guided supervision is particularly valuable when the agent's existing security capabilities are insufficient to learn effectively from outcome feedback.

AI.tldr: SECUREVIBE是一种训练方案，通过显式针对代码安全的规划与测试行为构建训练信号（含4项安全任务的SFT、基于验证反馈的强化学习与基于提示的自监督），在4个基准上同时提升安全性与功能性表现。
AI.motivation: 随着vibe coding能力增强与普及，即使功能正确的生成方案也存在安全漏洞隐忧。作者发现，功能正确但不安全的智能体针对功能需求背后隐藏安全风险进行有效规划与测试的概率不足其一半，因此需要显式训练规划与测试安全行为。
AI.method: SECUREVIBE围绕安全规划与测试构建训练信号：在包含4项安全任务的安全套件上进行监督微调；并采用后训练方法SECUREVIBE_rl（基于可验证执行反馈的强化学习）和SECUREVIBE_hg（基于提示的自监督）增强安全能力。
AI.result: 在4个基准、两类安全编码任务上超越基线：BaxBench安全pass@1提升6.9分；对未见CWE类别也有增益，SusVibes提升11.5分；功能性pass@1在SusVibes上提升13.6分、在通用编码任务SWE-bench Verified上提升4.1分。
AI.conclusion: 两点实践启示：(i) 在安全规划、编码与测试上多样化监督，比仅增加编码轨迹更有效地强化安全行为；(ii) 当智能体既有安全能力不足、难以从结果反馈中有效学习时，提示引导式监督尤为有价值。

title: After a Decade: Bringing Shadow Removal into the Real World with Agentic Training Data
summary: Shadow removal looks nearly solved on established benchmarks, yet remains brittle in the real world. Models have advanced; the paired training data they rely on have barely changed in nearly a decade. The reason is simple: obtaining a shadow-free target requires removing the occluder while keeping the scene, camera, and illumination otherwise unchanged, making diverse paired data difficult to capture. Meanwhile, large shadow detection datasets already contain diverse real-world images and masks, but no shadow-free targets. To turn this abundant but incomplete data into paired supervision, we propose an offline agentic workflow combining physics-motivated generation, failure detection, feedback-driven retry, candidate selection, and deterministic correction. Using this workflow, we construct AgenticShadow, a dataset of 17,138 image-mask-target triplets spanning general scenes, faces, and remote sensing. Our construction workflow reduces Color Distribution Difference by 50.5% over previous shadow removal work, while training existing shadow removal models on AgenticShadow reduces cross-domain LAB RMSE by 19.7-37.5%.

AI.tldr: 提出离线智能体工作流,将大规模阴影检测数据转化为配对监督,构建AgenticShadow三元组数据集(17,138),显著提升阴影去除的跨域性能。
AI.motivation: 阴影去除在既有基准上近乎解决,但真实场景中依然脆弱。模型不断进步,而依赖的配对训练数据近十年几乎未变。根本原因在于:获取无阴影目标需在去除遮挡物的同时保持场景、相机与光照不变,使多样化配对数据难以采集。与此同时,大型阴影检测数据集已包含多样的真实图像与掩码,但缺少无阴影目标。
AI.method: 将丰富但不完整的检测数据转化为配对监督:设计离线智能体(agentic)工作流,包含物理启发式生成、失败检测、反馈驱动的重试、候选选择与确定性校正五个环节。
AI.result: 构建AgenticShadow数据集,含17,138个图像-掩码-目标三元组,覆盖通用场景、人脸与遥感。构造流程相较以往阴影去除工作将色彩分布差异(Color Distribution Difference)降低50.5%;在其上训练现有阴影去除模型,跨域LAB RMSE降低19.7%-37.5%。
AI.conclusion: 通过智能体工作流复用已有阴影检测数据即可获得高质量配对监督,突破配对数据采集瓶颈,显著提升阴影去除模型的跨域泛化能力。

title: StreamDecisionBench: Evaluating Decisions in Force on Evolving Language Streams
summary: Language models increasingly make real-time decisions in applications that apply the latest answer until a newer one arrives. A late answer can prolong an outdated decision, such as a call recorder still running while a customer reads out card details, an error offline accuracy misses. We make three contributions. First, we release StreamDecisionBench (SDB), a dataset of eight streaming scenarios in four application families, with executable reference decisions derived from public rules. Second, we propose an evaluation protocol and a metric, in-force accuracy: the share of time the applied decision is correct across update intervals of 0.5-8 s. It reflects accuracy and latency jointly, attributing each error to judgment, latency or both. Third, we evaluate fifteen single-model settings, and this attribution separates speed-limited from judgment-limited models: slower, more accurate models lose 42-47% of the time to outdated answers, a fast model 35% to wrong ones. We therefore test hybrids in which a slow model corrects a fast one; with the right pairing and configuration, a hybrid outperforms every single model. However, even the best evaluated system keeps a correct decision in force only about two-thirds of the time, leaving a substantial gap for real-time use.

AI.tldr: 论文关注流式场景中语言模型实时决策的时效性问题，提出StreamDecisionBench数据集、in-force accuracy指标及混合模型方案，发现现有系统仍有约三分之一的生效时间决策错误。
AI.motivation: 语言模型越来越多地用于实时决策应用，系统在新答案到达前会一直沿用旧答案。若答案迟到，过时决策的持续时间会被拉长（如通话录音在客户读出卡号时仍在运行），从而带来实际风险，而传统离线准确率无法刻画这一时效性损失。
AI.method: 1）发布StreamDecisionBench（SDB），涵盖四个应用族、八个流式场景，并基于公开规则构造可执行的参考决策；2）提出评估协议与指标"in-force accuracy"，即在0.5-8秒更新间隔内，生效决策正确的累计时间占比，该指标联合反映准确率与延迟，并将每次错误归因于判断错误、延迟错误或两者兼有；3）评测十五种单模型配置，并进一步测试由慢模型纠错快模型的混合系统。
AI.result: 归因分析区分出"速度受限"与"判断受限"两类模型：更慢、更准确的模型因答案过时而损失42%-47%的生效时间，而一个快速模型则有35%的时间因判断错误而失效。混合系统中，合适的模型配对与配置可超越所有单模型表现；但即便最佳系统，生效决策正确的时间也仅约三分之二。
AI.conclusion: 实时流式决策需同时优化准确率与延迟，单一指标准确率不足；慢模型纠错快模型的混合策略有效但尚未充分，与实时应用需求之间仍存在明显差距。

title: Exo2EgoHOI: Hand-Object-Interaction Aware Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
summary: Egocentric videos of human manipulation provide valuable visual experience for embodied intelligence, yet collecting such data at scale is costly. Exocentric-to-egocentric video generation offers a scalable alternative by transforming abundant third-person manipulation videos into first-person observations. However, existing methods often struggle to faithfully preserve demonstrated hand-object interactions (HOI) across large viewpoint changes due to insufficient fine-grained interaction guidance and weak object-centric anchoring. We present Exo2EgoHOI, an HOI-aware video generative framework for interaction-preserving exocentric-to-egocentric translation. To preserve fine-grained HOI, we introduce a unified 4D HOI prior that combines scene geometry, articulated hand renderings, and dense hand-object relation fields, together with a dual-branch residual adapter for injecting structural and relational cues into the video generation backbone. To preserve object consistency, we introduce Decomposed Gated Cross-Attention, which separately encodes object and background references and adaptively integrates global semantic and local appearance features as object-centric anchors. Experiments on ARCTIC-HOI and Ego-Exo4D demonstrate substantial improvements in object consistency and HOI preservation while maintaining competitive visual fidelity. In particular, on ARCTIC-HOI, Exo2EgoHOI improves object mIoU by 32.3% and reduces MPJPE and PA-MPJPE by 34.7% and 50.0%, respectively, relative to the respective best baseline results. Project page: https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Exo2EgoHOI/.

AI.tldr: 提出Exo2EgoHOI，一种交互感知的外中心到自我中心视频生成框架，通过4D HOI先验与分解门控交叉注意力，在大视角变化下保持手-物交互与物体一致性。
AI.motivation: 自我中心（第一人称）操作视频对具身智能有重要价值，但大规模采集成本高昂。将丰富的第三人称视频转换为第一人称是可扩展的替代方案，然而现有方法在大视角变化下难以忠实保持演示的手-物交互（HOI），原因在于缺乏细粒度交互引导和以物体为中心的锚定不足。
AI.method: 1) 统一4D HOI先验：融合场景几何、关节手部渲染、稠密手-物关系场；2) 双分支残差适配器：将结构与关系线索注入视频生成骨干网络；3) 分解门控交叉注意力（Decomposed Gated Cross-Attention）：分别编码物体与背景参考，自适应整合全局语义与局部外观特征作为以物体为中心的锚点。
AI.result: 在ARCTIC-HOI与Ego-Exo4D数据集上显著提升物体一致性与HOI保持能力，同时保持有竞争力的视觉保真度。在ARCTIC-HOI上，物体mIoU提升32.3%，MPJPE和PA-MPJPE分别相对最佳基线降低34.7%与50.0%。
AI.conclusion: Exo2EgoHOI通过引入细粒度HOI先验与以物体为中心的锚定机制，有效缓解了大视角变化下交互保持与物体一致性的难题，为可扩展的具身智能数据获取提供了可行路径。

title: Correcting WHERE, Preserving HOW: Compositional Generalization for Vision-Language-Action Models via Referential Guidance
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable flexible action generation, their generalization across diverse environmental elements, including manipulated objects, destinations, and backgrounds, is limited by the lack of diversity in robotic training data. Trained end-to-end on such data, VLAs tend to exploit visual shortcuts, associating actions with task-irrelevant visual features rather than the intended task semantics. These shortcuts block recomposition of elements already seen by the policy, that is, compositional generalization. Existing approaches mitigate such entanglement through task-relevant perception or targeted data diversification, but offer no explicit mechanism for unseen recomposition and require backbone-specific modifications with retraining. We observe that under such recomposition, VLAs often fail at global grounding while retaining local manipulation skills that recover near the correct target in familiar configurations. Therefore, we propose Referential Guidance (ReGuide), a training-free wrapper that, given object poses from a grounding module, combines semantic and geometric rebinding to guide the end-effector into demonstration-supported configurations of the instructed referent, where the frozen policy can resume execution. Experiments in simulation across multiple VLA backbones as well as on a real robot show that ReGuide improves success rates under compositional shifts by up to 56.8 and 75.0 percentage points, respectively, while preserving standard-task performance.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的ReGuide包装器，通过语义与几何重绑定引导机械臂末端进入示范支持的配置，缓解VLA在组合泛化上的视觉捷径问题。
AI.motivation: VLA模型虽能灵活生成动作，但机器人训练数据多样性不足，导致其在被操作物体、目标位置与背景等环境元素上泛化受限。端到端训练使模型利用视觉捷径，将动作与任务无关的视觉特征相关联而非任务语义，从而阻碍对已见元素的重新组合（组合泛化）。现有方法依赖任务相关感知或针对性数据多样化，缺乏对未见重组的显式机制，且需针对特定主干修改并重训练。
AI.method: 作者观察到在重组情形下VLA常在全局定位上失败，但仍保留局部操作技能，在熟悉配置中能接近正确目标。基于此提出Referential Guidance（ReGuide）：一种免训练包装器，利用定位模块提供的物体位姿，结合语义重绑定与几何重绑定，引导末端执行器进入指令所指参照物在示范中支持过的配置，使冻结策略能够恢复执行。
AI.result: 在多种VLA主干上的仿真实验以及真实机器人实验表明，ReGuide在组合性偏移下将成功率分别提升至多56.8和75.0个百分点，同时保持标准任务性能。
AI.conclusion: ReGuide通过免训练、主干无关的语义与几何重绑定机制，有效提升VLA在组合泛化场景下的成功率，且不损害原有任务表现。

title: HIGS: Hierarchical Implicit Grids for Joint Geometric and Semantic Scene Understanding
summary: Neural implicit representations have had a significant impact on scene reconstruction by enabling robots to build continuous, differentiable, and high-fidelity 3D maps. Most existing works focus on geometric reconstruction and lack semantic information for high-level spatial understanding and task planning. Also, as the scale and complexity of the environment increase, neural representations face the challenge of maintaining computational efficiency in back-end optimization. To resolve these two challenges, we introduce a hierarchical neural field that leverages multiresolution submaps to achieve an efficient and scalable implicit representation, and a unified query and decoding mechanism to support both geometric and semantic features. More specifically, the learnable map features can be converted to the output with the query and decoding process for both training and inference. For large-scale representation, we decompose a scene into overlapping submaps and do hierarchical optimization within each local submap, thus enabling scalable computation. To further improve efficiency, we design feature encoders that predict initial hierarchical grid features to substantially reduce the time needed to optimize the submap features from scratch. To correct estimation drift among submaps, we align and fuse them entirely within the implicit feature space, leading to substantial acceleration by avoiding the need to decode the final output. Building upon this efficient hierarchical representation, we embed both geometric features and vision-language latent features into the map, and demonstrate it on both Signed Distance Field (SDF) construction and open-vocabulary object grounding. Our approach significantly improves computation and memory efficiency, maintains high estimation accuracy, and endows the robot with spatial awareness on large-scale real-world benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层神经隐式场表示方法，通过多分辨率子图实现高效可扩展的隐式建图，并统一支持几何与语义特征的查询与解码，在大规模场景的SDF构建与开放词汇物体定位上兼顾精度与计算/内存效率。
AI.motivation: 现有神经隐式表示多聚焦几何重建，缺乏用于高层空间理解与任务规划的语义信息；同时随环境规模与复杂度增长，后端优化面临计算效率瓶颈。因此需要同时解决语义缺失与大规模优化效率两大挑战。
AI.method: 提出分层神经场：将场景分解为重叠子图并在各局部子图内进行分层优化以实现可扩展计算；可学习地图特征经统一查询与解码机制同时输出几何与语义结果；设计特征编码器预测初始分层网格特征，减少从零优化子图特征的时间；子图间估计漂移在隐式特征空间内对齐与融合，避免解码最终输出以加速。基于该表示嵌入几何特征与视觉-语言隐特征。
AI.result: 在有符号距离场（SDF）构建与开放词汇物体定位两项任务上验证，显著提升计算与内存效率，保持较高估计精度，并使机器人在大规模真实基准上具备空间感知能力。
AI.conclusion: 分层子图与统一查询解码机制能够在隐式特征空间内完成对齐融合，兼顾几何与语义表示，为大规模场景下的高效可扩展神经隐式建图提供有效方案。

title: When Scientific Contradictions Are Lost in Translation
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 AI for Science Workshop: Verification in the Age of AI Scientists. This version is not included in the official NeurIPS proceedings
summary: Two scientific findings can disagree without contradicting each other. Determining whether they conflict requires knowing whether they describe comparable measurements. We study how language models behave at this decision point. In a controlled task, we generate an unsatisfiable XOR constraint system and translate its constraints into scientific reports from different laboratories. One assignment satisfies more constraints, while another satisfies fewer but better matches expected biology. This creates a simple dilemma: does the model choose the assignment that best fits the constraints, or the one that better matches biological expectations? When the constraints are stated directly, GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 5 recover the best-supported assignment in 90% and 96% of cases, respectively. In scientific prose, however, the models behave differently. Claude Opus 5 often prefers the biologically expected assignment. Removing that biological preference increases recovery of the better-supported assignment from 27% to 79% (p<.001); recovery reaches 92% when the same Biology-favored record is accompanied by a formalization request and an explicit paired-design cue (p<.001). GPT-5.6 Sol is less sensitive, with neither corresponding change reaching statistical significance. These results suggest that reliable scientific verification depends not only on formal reasoning, but also on how models decide which findings should be compared and what relations they imply.

AI.tldr: 论文研究语言模型在判断两项科学发现是否冲突时的行为：将不可满足的XOR约束系统转写为不同实验室的科学报告，制造"约束拟合最优"与"生物学预期更优"的两难。直接陈述约束时模型恢复率高达90%/96%；但在科学散文中Claude Opus 5倾向生物学预期解，去除该偏好后恢复率由27%升至79%，加入形式化请求与配对设计提示后达92%。
AI.motivation: 科学发现之间的"分歧"未必意味着"矛盾"，判断是否存在冲突的前提是确认两项发现是否描述了可比的测量。现有研究多关注模型的形式推理能力，却忽视了模型在"选择哪些发现应当相互比较、这些发现蕴含何种关系"这一前置决策环节的行为倾向，该环节对可靠的科学验证同样关键。
AI.method: 采用受控任务设计：生成一个不可满足的XOR约束系统，并将其约束转写为来自不同实验室的科学报告（科学散文形式），同时保留直接陈述约束的条件作为对照。构造两难权衡：一个赋值满足更多约束（更好支持），另一个满足较少约束但更契合预期生物学。在两个模型（GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Opus 5）上比较直接约束与科学散文表述下的表现，并进一步操纵三个变量——移除生物学偏好、加入形式化请求、提供显式配对设计线索。
AI.result: 直接陈述约束时，GPT-5.6 Sol与Claude Opus 5分别以90%和96%的正确率恢复最佳支持的赋值。在科学散文表述下，Claude Opus 5常倾向生物学预期赋值：移除该生物学偏好使最佳支持赋值的恢复率从27%提升至79%（p<.001）；当同一"生物学偏好记录"附加形式化请求与显式配对设计线索时，恢复率达92%（p<.001）。GPT-5.6 Sol敏感度较低，上述两项变化均未达到统计显著。
AI.conclusion: 模型在科学散文情境下的验证失败，并非源于形式推理能力不足，而是源于其关于"哪些发现应被比较、彼此蕴含何种关系"的隐性偏好（如对生物学预期的偏向）。可靠的科学验证不仅依赖形式推理，还依赖模型对可比性与关系蕴含的判定；通过形式化请求与显式配对设计线索可显著缓解这一偏差，且不同模型间存在显著差异。

title: Eulerian Motion Reconstruction for Water Scenery
summary: Reconstructing and animating water scenery from nature produces compelling and immersive visual experiences. Previous work examined this task from the perspective of 2D video textures, with the goal of creating a looping video. In our work, we tackle the problem from a 3D perspective, creating a looping 4D dynamic reconstruction which can be interactively rendered from novel viewpoints from a single non-looping 2D source video. We represent motion as a 3D static \textit{Eulerian} motion field that advects canonical Gaussian splats that are cyclically reborn at fixed time periods, supervised using rendering losses. To model non-periodic and stochastic dynamics present in real-world scenes, we add a non-periodic, time-varying residual term to capture deviations from the static Eulerian motion field. We show quantitatively and qualitatively that our framework enables photorealistic animation of water scenes better than prior art.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种从单段非循环2D视频构建循环4D动态水景重建的框架，支持从新视角交互式渲染，效果优于已有方法。
AI.motivation: 从自然水景重建并动画化可带来沉浸式视觉体验。已有工作多从2D视频纹理角度出发，目标是生成循环视频，缺乏3D视角上的动态表征与自由视点渲染能力。
AI.method: 将运动表示为3D静态欧拉运动场，用于平流传输按固定周期循环重生的规范高斯溅射（canonical Gaussian splats），并以渲染损失进行监督；额外引入非周期性、时变的残差项，以建模真实场景中的非周期与随机动态。
AI.result: 定量与定性实验表明，该框架能实现照片级真实的水景动画，效果优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从3D视角解决了水景重建任务，由单段非循环2D视频生成可自由视点渲染的循环4D动态重建，并通过欧拉运动场加残差项的表示有效刻画周期与非周期动态。

title: Marking Contour Tones in Yorùbá: A Typographic and Computational Proposal
comment: 13 pages. v5: proposes the caron and circumflex as a revision of the standard Yoruba orthography, with a formal recommendation (Section 5) for their use in lexicography, reference writing and computational resources; notes remaining gaps, including mid-tone vowel sequences, for future work
summary: Yorùbá is a tonal language in which contour tones pose persistent orthographic challenges. These are especially notable for personal names and lexical items whose conventional spellings avoid vowel lengthening that would otherwise provide a host syllable for the second tone. A particular concern is a class of names in which the conventional spelling does not just omit tonal information but inverts the meaning of said name, sometimes asserting the opposite of what the name intends. This paper describes the problem, illustrates the inadequacy of current solutions, and proposes the adoption of the caron and circumflex marks. These are symbols with precedent in Yorùbá phonological scholarship since Olmsted (1951), used as orthographic conventions on single vowels to encode rising and falling contour tones, making them accessible for the first time through standard keyboard input and computational text processing. The proposal is supported by an implementation in the WriteYoruba keyboard and the TTSYoruba speech synthesizer, whose architecture and listener evaluation are reported separately (Tubosun et al., 2026).

AI.tldr: 该论文讨论约鲁巴语（Yorùbá）声调在正字法中，尤其是人名和词项中曲拱调（contour tones）的拼写难题，指出常规拼写有时不仅缺失声调信息，甚至会反转名字含义。作者主张采用抑扬符（caron, ˇ）与扬抑符（circumflex, ˆ）标注单韵母以表示升调和降调，并在 WriteYoruba 键盘与 TTSYoruba 语音合成器中实现。
AI.motivation: 约鲁巴语是声调语言，曲拱调在正字法上长期难以表达。对某些人名与词项而言，传统拼写为避免使用会为第二声调提供承载音节的元音延长，往往省略声调信息；更严重的是，部分名字的常规拼写会颠倒甚至取反其本义。现有方案不足以解决这一问题，因此需要提出可行且可计算处理的标注方式。
AI.method: 作者首先界定并例示该拼写问题，论证现有解决方案的不足；随后提出采用抑扬符（caron）与扬抑符（circumflex）作为正字法约定，标注在单韵母上，分别编码升调与降调。该方法在约鲁巴语音系学研究中自 Olmsted（1951）以来已有先例。作者通过 WriteYoruba 键盘与 TTSYoruba 语音合成器进行实现，使这些符号首次可通过标准键盘输入和计算文本处理获得。
AI.result: 所提方案在 WriteYoruba 键盘与 TTSYoruba 语音合成器中得到实现，使曲拱调符号可通过标准键盘输入并支持计算文本处理。合成器的架构与听者评测另行报告（Tubosun et al., 2026），本文不展开具体评测数据。
AI.conclusion: 采用抑扬符与扬抑符标注单韵母，可为约鲁巴语曲拱调提供有学术先例、可键盘输入且便于计算处理的实用正字法方案，特别有助于避免人名与词项因省略元音延长而丢失或反转声调语义的问题。

title: Strong Multilingual Privacy Tagging at Encoder Speed
comment: 49 pages, 23 figures, incl. supplementary appendices. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review, October 2026 cycle. Code: https://github.com/graehl/multilingual-pii-span-tagging/tree/v1.4. v3: restructured for readability; fine-tuned GLiNER2 baseline retrained with shuffled entity types; scores at operating points fixed on dev; each system reads Chinese and Japanese in its preferred input form
summary: Privacy redaction must reliably remove personal information while preserving the relationships expressed in the text. We develop a general-purpose multilingual named-entity tagger with distinctions fine-grained enough to support a broad range of redaction policies, and methods for cheaply learning additional distinctions. We fine-tune the multilingual encoder XLM-R-large on text in 35 languages annotated by prompted frontier language models, plus existing human-annotated corpora with labels mapped onto our entity types. We evaluate on human-annotated test sets in seven languages and on LLM-annotated text in 35 languages. On the human-annotated sets, at operating points fixed on development data, our tagger reaches 88.2 redaction F1, against 69.1 for published GLiNER2 and 61.4 for Microsoft Presidio, and its architecture runs 4.9 times faster than GLiNER2's on CPU. Compared with frontier-model annotations alone, adding the mapped human-annotated corpora to training raised redaction F1 on those sets by ten points, with essentially no change on the LLM-annotated text. Open-weight LLMs fitting on one 96-GB GPU were less accurate than our tagger, whether prompted to tag text or used as encoders beneath a trained tagging layer, and roughly 30 to 1,100 times slower. We release code, prompts and training recipes, with data-acquisition scripts and source links.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个面向隐私脱敏的通用多语言命名实体标注器：以XLM-R-large为底座，结合前沿LLM提示标注的35种语言数据与人工标注语料（标签映射后）进行微调，在7种语言的人工标注测试集上达到88.2脱敏F1，显著优于GLiNER2（69.1）与Presidio（61.4），且CPU推理速度比GLiNER2快4.9倍。
AI.motivation: 隐私脱敏不仅要移除个人信息，还需保留文本中的关系表达，因此需要粒度足够细、能支撑多种脱敏策略的实体标注体系。现有方案（如GLiNER2、Presidio）在多语言场景下准确率不足，且大模型直接提示或作为编码器的方式成本高、速度慢，缺乏兼顾精度、速度与多语言覆盖的实用方案。
AI.method: 1) 设计细粒度多语言命名实体标注体系，并给出低成本学习额外实体区分的训练方法；2) 以多语言编码器XLM-R-large为基础，在两类数据上微调：由提示前沿语言模型生成的35种语言标注数据，以及标签映射到本实体类型体系的人工标注语料；3) 在7种语言的人工标注测试集与35种语言的LLM标注文本上评估，操作点固定在开发集上确定；4) 与GLiNER2、Microsoft Presidio及开权重LLM（提示标注、或作为编码器接训练标注层）进行对比，并比较CPU速度。
AI.result: 在人工标注测试集上，本标注器脱敏F1为88.2，GLiNER2为69.1，Presidio为61.4；架构在CPU上比GLiNER2快4.9倍。相比仅用前沿模型标注数据训练，加入映射后的人工标注语料使这些测试集上的脱敏F1提升10个点，而在LLM标注文本上基本无变化。单张96 GB GPU可容纳的开权重LLM，无论提示标注还是作为编码器配合训练标注层，精度均低于本标注器，且慢约30至1100倍。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度多语言实体标注体系配合LLM标注与人工标注语料联合微调，能在多语言隐私脱敏任务上同时实现高准确率与高推理效率，明显优于现有工具与开权重LLM方案。研究公开代码、提示词与训练配方，并提供数据获取脚本与来源链接，便于复现与后续扩展。

title: TSGL: Teacher-Student Graph Learning for 3DGS Compression
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a popular representation for novel view synthesis. However, 3DGS contains millions of Gaussian primitives, each with rich attributes, resulting in large file sizes. We propose a novel 3DGS compression method based on Teacher-Student Graph Learning (TSGL) that operates directly on a trained model, without 3DGS retraining or access to training images. Specifically, for each block of Gaussian primitives, using decoded positions and DC spherical harmonic (SH) coefficients as predictors, we learn a signal-dependent geometry graph G encoding the pairwise similarities between neighbouring Gaussians via a teacher-student model. Given G, we perform Graph Fourier Transform (GFT) on the remaining attributes, so that signal energies are predominantly projected into the low-frequency coefficients for compact representation. On three standard benchmarks, the method reaches 27x to 33x compression with less than 0.6 dB of PSNR loss, improving on recent post-training compression methods in both size and rendering quality.

AI.tldr: 一种免重训练、免原始图像的3DGS压缩方法TSGL，通过师生图学习构建几何图并做图傅里叶变换，在三个基准上实现27–33倍压缩且PSNR下降不足0.6 dB。
AI.motivation: 3DGS表示包含数百万个高斯基元，每个基元附带丰富属性，导致文件体积庞大，亟需高效压缩。
AI.method: 直接作用于已训练模型，无需3DGS重训练或访问训练图像。对每个高斯基元块，以解码后的位置和DC球谐系数为预测因子，借助师生模型学习信号相关的几何图G，编码相邻高斯间的相似性；再基于G对剩余属性施加图傅里叶变换（GFT），使信号能量主要集中于低频系数以实现紧凑表示。
AI.result: 在三个标准基准上达到27倍至33倍压缩，PSNR损失低于0.6 dB，在压缩体积和渲染质量上均优于近期后训练（post-training）压缩方法。
AI.conclusion: TSGL是一种有效的后训练3DGS压缩方案，无需重训练和数据访问，兼具高压缩率与高质量渲染。

title: STEPS: Scene Text Editing with Preserved Style Using Diffusion and Contrastive Style Encoding
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. A version of this paper appeared in PAKDD 2026 (LNCS vol. 16618)
summary: We introduce Scene Text Editing with Preserved Style (STEPS), a novel diffusion model architecture for quality text replacement in images. Scene Text Editing (STE), also known as Visual Text Editing, consists of changing the textual content in an image while conserving the original style, e.g. font, colors, orientation, background, etc. STEPS advances the state of the art in STE through directed focus on improved style preservation. We introduce a style encoder for visual text that captures style independently of textual content, and a model architecture that combines the style encoder with multiple semantic conditions (target text characters encoding and rendered glyphs).
