STEPS achieves superior results to previous STE methods in style preservation, output readability, and subjective quality.

AI.tldr: STEPS：一种用于场景文本编辑的新型扩散模型架构，通过风格编码器与多重语义条件（字符编码与渲染字形）结合，在保持原风格的前提下实现高质量文本替换，在风格保持、可读性与主观质量上超越此前方法。
AI.motivation: 场景文本编辑（STE/Visual Text Editing）的核心目标是在修改图像文本内容的同时保留原有风格（字体、颜色、朝向、背景等），而既有方法在风格保持方面仍存在不足，因此需要一种更强调风格保持的架构。
AI.method: 提出 STEPS 扩散模型架构，引入面向视觉文本的风格编码器，使风格表征与文本内容解耦；并将该风格编码器与多种语义条件（目标文本字符编码、渲染字形）相结合构建模型。
AI.result: STEPS 在风格保持、输出可读性和主观质量三方面均优于此前的 STE 方法，取得当前最优结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过对风格保持的针对性设计，STEPS 有效提升了场景文本编辑的整体质量，验证了风格编码与多语义条件结合的有效性。

title: Template-Search Domain Adaptation via Multi-Stage Feature Alignment for Cross-Modal Object Tracking
summary: Visual object tracking typically assumes that the initial template and subsequent search frames share the same sensing modality. In practice, sensor availability or operation may change over time, creating a substantial representation gap between template and search frames. Unlike conventional multi-modal tracking where paired modalities are simultaneously available, cross-modal tracking requires localization when template and search frames originate from different active modalities. Accordingly, we introduce TSDA-Track, a Template-Search Domain Adaptation framework to reduce modality discrepancy during training. We investigate two feature alignment strategies. Pre-AFA TSDA-Track applies adversarial alignment before transformer's template-search interaction to suppress modality-specific bias. Enc-CFA TSDA-Track applies contrastive alignment to encoder representations after interaction to strengthen target-level cross-modal correspondence. Both variants retain a shared inference pipeline without modality-specific branches. Experiments on LasHeR, and zero-shot evaluations on RGBT234 and GTOT under multiple cross-modal protocols demonstrate improvements over representative state-of-the-art trackers. For instance, under the modality-switch protocol on RGBT234, Pre-AFA TSDA-Track achieves an SR/PR of 43.2/56.0, compared with 36.8/50.0 for ToMP-101 baseline. In addition, a study on Anti-UAV-024 further verifies the applicability of TSDA-Track to aerial tracking. Our study highlights the effectiveness of feature alignment domain adaptation for cross-modal tracking.

AI.tldr: 提出TSDA-Track模板-搜索域自适应框架，通过两种特征对齐策略缩小跨模态跟踪中模板与搜索帧的表示差距，在多个数据集上优于代表性SOTA。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉目标跟踪假设初始模板与后续搜索帧来自同一传感模态，但实际中传感器可用性或工作状态会随时间变化，造成模板与搜索帧之间巨大的表示鸿沟。与模板和搜索帧成对模态同时可用的常规多模态跟踪不同，跨模态跟踪需在模板与搜索帧来自不同活跃模态时完成目标定位。
AI.method: 提出TSDA-Track模板-搜索域自适应框架，在训练阶段减小模态差异，研究了两种特征对齐策略：Pre-AFA在Transformer模板-搜索交互之前施加对抗对齐以抑制模态特定偏置；Enc-CFA在交互之后对编码器表示施加对比对齐以增强目标级跨模态对应。两种变体均保持无模态特定分支的共享推理流程。
AI.result: 在LasHeR上实验，并在RGBT234和GTOT上进行多种跨模态协议下的零样本评估，相较代表性SOTA跟踪器均有提升。例如RGBT234模态切换协议下，Pre-AFA TSDA-Track取得SR/PR为43.2/56.0，而ToMP-101基线为36.8/50.0。此外，在Anti-UAV-024上的研究进一步验证了TSDA-Track对空中跟踪的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明特征对齐域自适应对跨模态跟踪具有有效性。

title: Vision-Language-Action Autonomous Driving Agent with Language-based Memory
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have recently emerged as one of the prevailing solutions for autonomous driving, as they can utilize knowledge acquired during vision-language pretraining for accurate and interpretable driving. However, VLAs can take only a limited number of frames as visual input due to the high token cost of an image, which is problematic for memory-dependent tasks such as determining the arrival order at all-way stops and long-horizon driving scene understanding. Existing solutions use latent vector memories accessed through cross-attention, which are neither interpretable nor portable. In this paper, we propose AD-Memo, a general-purpose VLA driving agent with language-based memory. The agent outputs memory as an extension of its Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to record surrounding objects critical to driving; this memory becomes part of the agent's future input. We curate memory-based datasets and train VLAs with a two-stage recipe: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and \textit{Da Capo}, a novel semi-closed-loop Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithm which uses trajectory-level advantage for memory and step-level advantage for driving, leading to better credit assignment. Across scenarios such as all-way stops and general driving, AD-Memo improves driving quality, enables better question answering on driving scenes, and produces plug-and-play memory for other models.

AI.tldr: AD-Memo：一种带语言式记忆的通用VLA驾驶智能体，将记忆作为CoT扩展，配合两阶段训练（SFT + Da Capo半闭环RL），提升长时程场景驾驶与问答能力，并生成可迁移的即插即用记忆。
AI.motivation: VLA基础模型因图像token开销高，仅能输入有限帧，难以处理依赖记忆的任务（如全向停车到达顺序判断、长时程驾驶场景理解）；现有基于潜在向量记忆+交叉注意力的方案既不可解释也不可移植。
AI.method: 提出AD-Memo通用VLA驾驶智能体，采用基于语言的记忆：智能体将记忆作为Chain-of-Thought的扩展输出，记录对驾驶关键的相关物体，并作为未来输入的一部分。构建基于记忆的数据集，采用两阶段训练：监督微调（SFT）与Da Capo——一种新颖的半闭环强化学习算法，对记忆使用轨迹级优势、对驾驶使用步级优势，以实现更好的信用分配。
AI.result: 在全向停车和一般驾驶等场景中，AD-Memo提升了驾驶质量，改善了对驾驶场景的问答表现，并能为其他模型生成即插即用的记忆。
AI.conclusion: 语言式记忆结合两阶段SFT-RL训练，可有效解决VLA帧数受限导致的记忆缺失问题，兼具可解释性与可移植性。

title: ChartRevise: A Dataset and Evaluation Protocol for Exact Chart Editing via Code
summary: Chart editing requires cross-modal edit grounding, realizing a requested visual change in the code that draws it, with necessary related updates and without altering unrelated content. Existing benchmarks emphasize either code executability or chart quality, but their metrics do not clearly distinguish request completion from missed coupled updates and gratuitous changes. We introduce ChartRevise, a structured dataset and evaluation protocol for exact program-grounded chart editing. For dataset construction, we build on the grammar of graphics to systematically cover chart-editing operations, using source-program checks to verify their applicability across chart types and libraries. To improve edit exactness, our pipeline checks individual requirements and guides repair or exclusion when they are unmet. The resulting dataset contains 92,438 records covering 344 edit types across 20 chart types and three plotting libraries. For evaluation, our reference-free protocol separately measures atomic requirement completion, identifies gratuitous changes, and detects missed coupled updates. These checks are combined with successful execution and rendering to determine exact-edit success. Across five models and four external benchmarks, fine-tuning yields relative gains of 16\% in mean requirement recall and 22\% in mean exact-edit rate.

AI.tldr: 提出ChartRevise数据集与评估协议，用于严格度量"程序级图表编辑"的精确性，覆盖344种编辑类型、20种图表类型、3个绘图库。
AI.motivation: 图表编辑需要跨模态编辑定位：在绘制图表的代码中实现所要求的视觉改动，同时完成必要的关联更新且不改动无关内容。现有基准要么强调代码可执行性，要么强调图表质量，其指标无法清晰区分"需求完成"、"遗漏的耦合更新"与"多余改动"三类情况。
AI.method: 1) 数据集构建：基于图形语法（grammar of graphics）系统覆盖图表编辑操作，用源程序检查验证其在各图表类型与库上的适用性；流水线逐条检查需求，对不满足者进行修复或排除，以提升编辑精确性。2) 评估协议：无参考（reference-free）评估，分别度量原子需求完成度、识别多余改动、检测遗漏的耦合更新，并与成功执行与渲染结合判定"精确编辑成功"。
AI.result: 数据集包含92,438条记录，覆盖3个绘图库、20种图表类型下的344种编辑类型。在5个模型与4个外部基准上，微调带来平均需求召回率16%的相对提升、平均精确编辑率22%的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: ChartRevise通过结构化数据构建与细粒度无参考评估，能够将编辑完成、耦合更新遗漏与多余改动区分开来，为程序级图表编辑提供更精确的评测标准，并验证微调可显著提升模型的精确编辑能力。

title: Joint Supervised and Self-Supervised Training with Acquisition-Robust Techniques for Accelerated 4D Flow MRI Reconstruction
summary: 4D flow MRI measures time-resolved, three-directional blood velocity but requires long acquisition times, and its diagnostic signal is carried by the phase difference \emph{between} velocity encodings, not by image magnitude. Recent work has developed a per-encoding variational network to address image reconstruction in this field. In this work, we incorporate a joint supervised and self-supervised training regime and utilize both magnitude and velocity data during supervision. At the same time, we add multiple acquisition-robust and conditioning strategies based on the acceleration factors. On the CMRx4DFlow~2026 aortic dataset (1.5 and 3T), our model lowers RelErr by $38$--$50\%$ and AngErr by $7.0$--$8.7^\circ$ against a training-matched baseline across $R{=}10$--$50$, improving on every held-out subject at every acceleration. Our model also shows strong generalization ability to transfer on out-of-distribution data by employing the joint training scheme, with an increase of $7.2\%$ in SSIM and decrease of $38\%$ and $31\%$ in AngErr and RelErr respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于4D flow MRI重建的联合监督与自监督训练框架，结合幅度与速度数据监督，并引入面向加速因子的采集鲁棒性与条件化策略，在CMRx4DFlow 2026主动脉数据集上显著降低重建误差并提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 4D flow MRI可测量时间分辨的三方向血流速度，但采集时间长；其诊断信号主要来自速度编码之间的相位差而非图像幅度。现有的按编码变分网络方法在重建精度与泛化性上仍有提升空间，尤其需要更有效的监督信号设计与对不同加速因子的适应性。
AI.method: 在现有逐编码变分网络基础上，引入联合监督与自监督训练机制；监督时同时利用幅度和速度数据；并针对不同加速因子（R=10–50）添加多种采集鲁棒性与条件化策略。
AI.result: 在CMRx4DFlow 2026主动脉数据集（1.5T与3T）上，相比训练匹配的基线，模型在R=10–50范围内将RelErr降低38%–50%，AngErr降低7.0–8.7°，且在每一加速倍数下对每个留出受试者均有改善。借助联合训练，模型在分布外数据上展现强泛化：SSIM提升7.2%，AngErr和RelErr分别下降38%和31%。
AI.conclusion: 联合监督与自监督训练、幅度与速度双重监督以及加速因子条件化策略，可显著提升4D flow MRI重建精度与跨分布泛化能力，为缩短采集时间下的血流定量成像提供了有效方案。

title: Tacit-TTS: From Autoregressive Decoding to Masked Prediction for Efficient Transcript-Free Voice Cloning
summary: TTS systems with autoregressive semantic modeling have demonstrated strong zero-shot voice cloning performance and rich expressive variation, but their sequential decoding incurs substantial latency. Non-autoregressive alternatives offer much faster generation, yet often rely on more restrictive reference conditioning, such as requiring transcripts of the reference speech during inference. We present Tacit-TTS, an efficient transcript-free zero-shot voice cloning system distilled from IndexTTS2. Our model replaces autoregressive text-to-semantic decoding with masked non-autoregressive generation, introduces training-free acoustic length estimation, and accelerates the flow-matching renderer through ReFlow distillation. Across two English and two Mandarin datasets, Tacit-TTS achieves competitive zero-shot quality while generating speech over 10x faster than IndexTTS2 for utterances longer than 5 seconds. Its transcript-free conditioning further supports cross-lingual and non-lexical references. We validate this capability using references from eight other languages, infant babble, and synthetic gibberish, where transcript-dependent systems often degrade or fail due to unreliable ASR transcripts.

AI.tldr: Tacit-TTS：从IndexTTS2蒸馏出的免转写零样本语音克隆系统，以掩码非自回归生成替代自回归文本到语义解码，配合免训练声学长度的估计和ReFlow蒸馏，实现超10倍加速。
AI.motivation: 自回归语义建模的TTS零样本克隆能力强，但序列解码延迟高；非自回归方案速度快，但参考条件苛刻（如推理时需参考语音转写），故需兼顾速度与宽松条件。
AI.method: 以掩码非自回归生成取代自回归文本到语义解码；引入免训练声学长度估计；通过ReFlow蒸馏加速流匹配渲染器。
AI.result: 在两个英语和两个普通话数据集上，Tacit-TTS零样本质量具竞争力，对超5秒语音生成速度比IndexTTS2快10倍以上；免转写条件支持跨语言和非词汇参考（8种其他语言、婴儿咿呀、合成无意义语音），而依赖转写系统常因ASR不可靠而退化或失败。
AI.conclusion: Tacit-TTS在保持竞争力零样本克隆质量的同时显著降低延迟，并拓展了对跨语言与非词汇参考的适用性。

title: Vmem-$\varphi$: Low-Compute Out-of-Distribution Detection in Spiking Neural Networks from Membrane-Potential Statistics
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient approach to processing event-camera data, yet out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging in this setting. Existing OOD detection methods often depend on model outputs or computational components that are unavailable in object detection SNNs or are poorly suited to low-compute deployment. To that effect, we show that the subthreshold membrane potential \(V_{\mathrm{mem}}(t)\) provides a useful internal signal for detecting distribution shifts. Simple per-channel statistics derived from these membrane dynamics enable OOD detection. To evaluate this approach, we introduce Gen1-C, an event-camera corruption benchmark developed upon the Prophesee Gen1 automotive detection dataset, containing six sensor-motivated histogram-level stress tests at five severity levels. We further propose the Multi-Descriptor Deviation (MDD), a corruption-blind method that operates on membrane-potential statistics. At the highest corruption severity, MDD achieves an AUROC of more than 0.88 on five of the six corruptions using only a bounded 64-frame observation window. Notably, the remaining corruption is also the one that has the smallest effect on the underlying detector. These results show that the temporal membrane-potential dynamics can provide an effective and low-cost signal for OOD detection in SNN-based event perception.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用脉冲神经网络（SNN）的阈下膜电位 \(V_{\mathrm{mem}}(t)\) 作为内部信号进行分布外（OOD）检测，并构建事件相机损坏基准 Gen1-C 及免损坏方法 MDD，实现低成本、有效的 OOD 检测。
AI.motivation: 事件相机数据处理的 SNN 虽能效高，但 OOD 检测困难：现有方法依赖目标检测 SNN 中不可用的模型输出或计算组件，且不适合低算力部署。
AI.method: 利用阈下膜电位 \(V_{\mathrm{mem}}(t)\) 的逐通道统计量作为内部信号；构建基于 Prophesee Gen1 汽车检测数据集的 Gen1-C 事件相机损坏基准（6 种传感器直方图层压力测试 × 5 个严重程度）；提出免损坏的 Multi-Descriptor Deviation（MDD）方法，基于膜电位统计量运行。
AI.result: 在最高损坏严重程度下，MDD 仅使用有界 64 帧观测窗口，在 6 种损坏中的 5 种上 AUROC 超过 0.88；剩余一种损坏对底层检测器影响最小。
AI.conclusion: 膜电位的时间动态可为 SNN 事件感知提供有效且低成本的 OOD 检测信号。

title: Breaking Babel: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Long-Form Subtitle Translation
summary: Long-form subtitle translation requires reasoning over discourse and cultural context spanning episodes or entire series, while maintaining consistent terminology and style. Existing single-LLM methods are largely sentence-level, and multi-agent systems often use static workflows that do not adapt to scene complexity or production context. We propose SMART, a Self-evolving Multi-Agent system for long-foRm subtitle Translation. During test-time training, SMART builds persistent series-level memory and translates a subset of sentences through a dynamic router and Mixture-of-Agents layer with tools for terminology verification, subtitle constraint validation, and contextual retrieval. A judge-refiner loop scores candidates and uses textual critiques to update agent prompts and routing policies without retraining the underlying LLMs. During test-time inference, the evolved configuration translates the remaining series. We also introduce Subtitle Arena, covering 14 genres, 2--198 episodes per series, production years 1959--2023, and 15 target locales, together with SubMQM, a subtitle-adapted MQM framework with seven dimensions and 19 error categories. SMART achieves the best overall MQM score in all 15 Subtitle Arena directions, reducing average penalty by 6.9% over the strongest competing agent system. On a public benchmark, MuSC, SMART obtains the best model result across all 4 language pairs. SMART also achieves the best result in human evaluation with an overall score of 4.50/5.

AI.tldr: 提出SMART——一种自进化多智能体长格式字幕翻译系统，通过测试时训练构建剧集级记忆并动态更新路由与提示，在Subtitle Arena全部15个方向上取得最优MQM成绩。
AI.motivation: 长格式字幕翻译需要跨集乃至整季的篇章与文化语境推理，并保持术语与风格一致。现有单LLM方法多为句子级，多智能体系统常采用静态工作流，无法根据场景复杂度或制作语境自适应调整。
AI.method: SMART在测试时训练阶段构建持久的剧集级记忆，通过动态路由器与Mixture-of-Agents层翻译部分句子，并配备术语验证、字幕约束校验与上下文检索工具；由judge-refiner循环对候选打分并用文本批评更新智能体提示与路由策略，无需重训底层LLM；测试时推理阶段用进化后的配置翻译剩余剧集。同时构建Subtitle Arena（14种类型、每剧2–198集、1959–2023年、15个目标语区）与SubMQM（7维度、19类错误）。
AI.result: 在Subtitle Arena全部15个翻译方向上取得最佳总体MQM分数，相较最强竞争智能体系统平均惩罚降低6.9%；在公开基准MuSC上4个语言对均取得最佳模型结果；人工评测总体得分4.50/5，为最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: SMART验证了自进化多智能体配置在长格式字幕翻译中的有效性，配套的Subtitle Arena与SubMQM为跨类型、长跨度、多语区的字幕翻译评测提供了系统化基准与错误分析框架。
